学术侧已经由简单灭菌前后比较，发展到设备: The academic side has developed from simple before and after sterilization comparisons to equipment
学术侧提供可用于验收的具体指标：麻醉模型关注阻力和超声，切除模型关注切缘与组织保: The academic side provides specific indicators that can be used for acceptance: the anesthesia model focuses on resistance and ultrasound, the resection model focuses on resection margins and tissue preservation, the endoscopic model focuses on operating force, and the puncture model focuses on images, leakage, and catheterization completion. Replaceable parts and multi-organ platforms on the enterprise side provide a product organization method for continuous practice
学术侧最直接的产业价值是解释参数之间的相互作用。提高固化程度可能同时改变尺寸和力: The most direct industrial value on the academic side is to explain the interactions between parameters. Increasing the degree of curing may change both dimensions and mechanics; changing material fillers or ceramic routing may also affect forming and post-processing. What companies need is not a single best number, but a combination that can stably cover product applicable conditions.
学术侧正在从制剂开发扩展到生产系统研究。实验关注点增加了吞吐量、稳定性、快速检测: The academic side is expanding from formulation development to production system research. The experimental focus increased on throughput, stability, rapid detection and personnel differences, and the evaluation object changed from equipment to drug supply process.
学术侧正在从材料或设备之间的单因素比较，走向组合设计和分步骤测量。尺寸、转化率、: The academic side is moving from single-factor comparisons between materials or equipment to combination design and step-by-step measurement. Dimensions, conversion rates, mechanics and surface indicators complement each other to identify what a process adjustment has improved and what it may have affected.
学术侧正在从简单“有无导板”比较，转向分解接触面、切面和骨块位置。不同专科开始采: The academic side is moving from a simple "with or without guide plate" comparison to a breakdown of contact surfaces, cut surfaces, and bone fragment locations. Different specialties have begun to adopt three-dimensional registration before and after surgery, making execution deviations easier to track.
学术侧的主要变化是多功能设计逐渐替代单一成分优化。开放孔隙、颗粒载体和蛋白添加让: The main change on the academic side is the gradual replacement of single-component optimization by multifunctional design. Open pores, particulate carriers, and protein additions allow structure and biological effects to be adjusted separately, and then the coordination is tested through comprehensive experiments
学术侧解决的问题: Problems solved on the academic side
学术发展具有明显的分支：永久性结构强调稳定和服役表现，骨传导或可降解结构强调组织: Academic development has obvious branches: permanent structures emphasize stability and service performance, and osteoconductive or degradable structures emphasize tissue replacement and time matching; both rely on reliable geometric design and manufacturing verification. Observing these two lines separately can explain existing research better than generalizing "new materials replace old materials"
学术发展由单个变量比较走向结构与材料协同。研究者开始区分载药区、控制层和支撑结构: Academic development moves from single variable comparison to structure and material collaboration. Researchers began to distinguish the drug-loaded area, control layer and support structure, so that each part has a clearer task
学术发现对应的产品任务: Product tasks corresponding to academic discoveries
学术变化体现为从外部形状比较，推进到内部结构和预测设计，再将使用者接受性纳入约束: Academic changes are reflected in the advancement from external shape comparison to internal structure and predictive design, and then incorporating user acceptance into constraints. Geometry is no longer just a free form, but a variable that works with the recipe to determine performance
学术变化可概括为“间隙测量: Academic changes can be summarized as “gap measurement
学术变化呈现为从制造可行性到使用场景分化：临时修复关注治疗阶段与周围组织，永久后: Academic changes are presented as differentiation from manufacturing feasibility to usage scenarios: temporary restorations focus on the treatment stage and surrounding tissues, permanent posterior crowns focus on continued use and re-intervention, and children's restorations also need to consider wear and oral hygiene performance
学术变化正在从病例可行性走向设计条件的显式表达。髋臼研究把剩余骨和计划位置量化；: Academic change is moving from case feasibility to explicit expression of design conditions. The acetabulum study quantifies remaining bone and planned location; the spine and ankle study incorporates functional support into the design; the long bone review further organizes evidence by defect and fixation type
学术和企业最有价值的联系是把使用中的具体事件转化为明确的设计或流程问题。相同品牌: The most valuable link between academia and industry is the translation of concrete events in use into explicit design or process problems. The results of the same brand, different materials, generations, and different patient conditions need to be kept separately to track whether the improvements are effective.
学术实验帮助企业找出处理与失效的关系，企业的真实使用反馈则帮助选择实验条件。两端: Academic experiments help companies find out the relationship between processing and failure, and real use feedback from companies helps choose experimental conditions. Records should be established on both ends around the same parts and their purpose: what changes will affect protection, when replacement is needed, and how original functionality will be restored after replacement.
学术提供解释，产品提出边界条件: Academics provide explanations, products propose boundary conditions
学术机构与医院提供需求定义和评价，企业与社区提供制造扩展。最有效的协作让验证与设: Academic institutions and hospitals provide demand definition and evaluation, and businesses and communities provide manufacturing expansion. The most effective collaboration allows verification and design to advance simultaneously and determine in advance which changes will affect existing results.
学术模型最有价值的产业用途，是缩小设计和试验范围、解释失败位置，并为制造偏差设定: The most valuable industrial uses of academic models are to narrow the scope of design and testing, explain the location of failures, and set reasonable boundaries for manufacturing deviations
学术研究与企业最关键的接口是“版本明确的临床数据”。同样标注打印义齿，材料、设备: The most critical interface between academic research and industry is "clearly versioned clinical data." For printed dentures, the materials, equipment, collection, tooth position design and assembly can be different; only by retaining this information can it be possible to explain the changes brought about by product improvements.
学术研究中的参数化设计可以对应企业的工程工时和返工率；定位、切割与临床结果研究则: Parametric design in academic research can correspond to the company's engineering hours and rework rate; positioning, cutting and clinical results research correspond to product verification. The most direct connection between the two ends is to convert clinical failure patterns into checkable design rules and confirm whether the rules are effective in subsequent cases.
学术研究可以回答配件改善来自哪里：边缘贴合、固定力还是接口密封。企业据此形成设计: Academic research could answer where improvements in fittings come from: edge fit, retention, or interface sealing. Based on this, the company forms a design parameter and compatibility list, and then uses feedback from actual use to check the wearing burden.
学术研究可以控制材料和孔形，辨认哪些因素改变组织进入；企业必须在实际尺寸、接触面: Academic research can control materials and hole shapes to identify factors that alter tissue entry; companies must implement these factors in actual dimensions, contact surfaces, device connections, and manufacturing batches. Therefore, the most valuable cross-over study is to use the enterprise's finished product geometry as experimental input and measure the relationship between pore distribution, residue, bone contact position and mechanical fixation.
学术研究定义学习目标和评价方式，企业制造把模型结构与材料稳定下来。有效的联系是让: Academic research defines learning objectives and evaluation methods, and corporate manufacturing stabilizes model structures and materials. An effective connection is to make a certain model feature correspond to a certain teaching activity, for example, the detachable structure corresponds to the fracture relationship and treatment options, rather than a general comparison between "with model" and "without model"
学术研究定义目标样本、分离机制及分析收益；制造平台将复杂结构变为可测试器件。两端: Academic research defines target samples, separation mechanisms, and analytical benefits; manufacturing platforms turn complex structures into testable devices. The common evaluation of both ends should fall on "After passing this chip, will the subsequent detection be more stable and more time-saving?"
学术研究帮助定义哪些结构必须保留、哪些信息适合分层显示，以及何种变形或流动具有训: Academic research helps define which structures must be preserved, which information is suitable for layered display, and what kind of deformation or flow has training significance. Businesses translate this into design and delivery specifications
学术研究帮助定义沟通效果，企业能力提供稳定、及时的模型。两端的连接应由咨询任务决: Academic research helps define communication effectiveness, and corporate capabilities provide stable, timely models. The connection between the two ends should be determined by the consulting task: whether the location, size, surgical path or reconstructive results need to be explained
学术研究提供了识别适用场景的方法：如果主要瓶颈是复杂切割和定位，预先设计的约束更: Academic research provides methods for identifying applicable scenarios: if the main bottleneck is complex cutting and positioning, pre-designed constraints are more likely to reduce repeated operations; if routine surgery is already highly proficient, the placement and verification of new instruments may add steps.
学术研究提供从工序误差到功能影响的解释，企业工具提供重复执行的制造条件。将二者连: Academic research provides explanations from process errors to functional impacts, and enterprise tools provide manufacturing conditions for repeatable execution. Connecting the two can help focus quality investment where it most impacts puncture and delivery
学术研究提供机制和参数选择，企业将其收敛为可生产、可放置和可评价的产品组合。两端: Academic research provides mechanisms and parameter choices that companies converge into a producible, placeable, and evaluable product portfolio. The most important connection between both ends is the drug delivery window for specific diseases.
学术研究提供组织形成机制与可测功能，企业把制造和培养环节组织成可使用的平台。两端: Academic research provides organizational formation mechanisms and measurable functions, and companies organize manufacturing and training links into usable platforms. The most important common question on both ends is whether the design changes produce consistent functional changes across multiple batches
学术研究提供识别效率来源的方法，企业提供可以在真实生产中运行的组合。两者可共同建: Academic research provides methods for identifying sources of efficiency, and companies provide combinations that can be run in real production. The two can jointly establish sub-step records: acquisition and design time, equipment operation, post-processing, assembly, chairside adjustment, reproduction and maintenance
学术研究提供负载模型、失效现象和性能边界，企业能够将设计改动转为稳定部件与装配流: Academic research provides load models, failure phenomena and performance boundaries so companies can translate design changes into stable parts and assembly processes. The most direct intersection is to identify key weak points based on testing, and then verify whether the usable range will be expanded after modifications.
学术研究提出可量化性能与参照实验，产业制造将这些要求转成过程控制和交付标准。两端: Academic research proposes quantifiable performance and reference experiments, and industrial manufacturing translates these requirements into process control and delivery standards. The common products from both ends should include test methods, configurations and acceptance ranges, not just equipment drawings
学术研究提出需要再现的物理量，企业将其转为稳定制造和测量接口。两端应围绕同一成像: Academic research proposes physical quantities that need to be reproduced, and companies translate them into stable manufacturing and measurement interfaces. Both ends should be verified based on the same imaging protocol, not just based on similar model appearance.
学术研究揭示变化机制，企业将其转化为可重复的制造与交付范围: Academic research reveals mechanisms of change that companies translate into repeatable manufacturing and delivery scope
学术研究正在由连接强度排名，转向失效机制、组合效应和环境响应。剪切测试用于识别界: Academic research is moving away from connection strength rankings and toward failure mechanisms, combinatorial effects, and environmental responses. Shear testing is used to identify interface differences, thermomechanical cycling is used to observe durability, and monolithic structural testing raises the possibility of changing manufacturing routes.
学术研究由单个流程的可行性，推进到比较研究，再逐渐将数字路线拆分: Academic research advances from the feasibility of a single process to comparative research, and then gradually splits the digital route
学术研究由数字化获取形状，推进到数字修型与临床体验，再进一步将局部结构设计纳入个: Academic research has advanced from digital shape acquisition to digital shaping and clinical experience, and then further integrated local structural design into individualization. The information added at each step is different: scanning saves the surface, clinical judgment is introduced for shape modification, mechanical calculation determines structural allocation, and try-on and follow-up feedback the actual results.
学术研究能为企业提供可复现的抓握测试与设计变量；企业的实际使用反馈则能帮助研究选: Academic research can provide companies with reproducible grip tests and design variables; real-world usage feedback from companies can help research select tasks that truly impact life. Joint evaluation should include both standardized actions and individual needs
学术研究能够为这一类开发提供材料响应与结构机制；企业的体内定位结果则帮助反向选择: Academic research can provide material response and structural mechanisms for this type of development; the company's in vivo positioning results can help reverse selection and in vitro evaluation closer to usage conditions.
学术研究能够帮助解释流程的作用，而企业标准化可以减少多步骤操作带来的差异。两者结: Academic research can help explain what the process does, and corporate standardization can reduce the variability caused by multi-step operations. The combination of the two makes it easier for laboratories to determine which conditions must be maintained and which operating ranges can be adjusted.
学术研究识别处理引起的变形和性能变化，企业将这些发现转成工艺范围、检验项目及使用: Academic research identifies deformation and performance changes caused by processing, and companies translate these findings into process scope, inspection items, and instructions for use. Effective cross-over is to map specific structural failures to manufacturing steps and then verify whether the modifications improve the final function.
学术端不断提出更精细的流体与细胞操控结构，设备企业提供实现这些结构的加工手段。两: The academic side continues to propose more sophisticated fluid and cell manipulation structures, and equipment companies provide processing methods to realize these structures. The most direct connection between the two ends is the expansion of the manufacturable design space
学术端发现标准器械难以满足的操作需求，企业端可以提供重复制造、材料和交付体系。最: The academic side discovers operational needs that are difficult to meet with standard equipment, and the enterprise side can provide repetitive manufacturing, materials and delivery systems. The most promising connection is not to directly copy a prototype in large quantities, but to extract a stable functional structure and then allow the contact size and local morphology to be adjusted according to the patient.
学术端发现特定条件下的误差与验证方法，企业端将这些方法转为可重复的测试服务。实际: The academic side discovers errors and verification methods under specific conditions, and the enterprise side converts these methods into repeatable testing services. Practical contact should be documented around specific treatment planning issues rather than quantity of phantoms produced as a substitute for quality improvement
学术端将制造方法连接到具体细胞实验，企业端提供精度和材料选择。两端交汇在可复用工: The academic side connects manufacturing methods to specific cell experiments, and the enterprise side provides precision and material selection. The two ends meet in a reusable process package: master mold design, surface treatment, replication materials, bonding methods and finished product acceptance need to be jointly defined
学术端将材料和几何转化为特定分析性能，产业端提供可采购的耗材和读出组件。二者之间: The academic end translates materials and geometries into specific analytical properties, and the industrial end provides purchasable consumables and readout components. The key between the two is interface and validation: the electrode should produce a repeatable signal under the specified sample and instrument configuration
学术端形成的认识: Understanding formed on the academic side
学术端提供具体任务的成本与效果，企业端提供持续交付能力。有效交叉是找到影响推广的: The academic side provides the costs and effects of specific tasks, and the enterprise side provides continuous delivery capabilities. Effective cross-over is to find the dominant link that affects promotion: if the bottleneck is splitting work hours, priority is given to improving the data process; if the bottleneck is consumables, a replaceable structure is more suitable; if the bottleneck is course scheduling, unified tasks and reuse models are needed
学术端提供解剖尺寸、受力与采样机理，企业端把这些参数转成可制造范围和检验要求。与: The academic side provides anatomical dimensions, forces and sampling mechanisms, and the enterprise side converts these parameters into manufacturable range and inspection requirements. Optimizing local geometry is often better at simultaneously handling flexibility, grip and release requirements than simply increasing material strength.
学术端提出如何减少步骤并保持测量性能，企业端负责制造、组件及服务可获得性。两端最: The academic side proposes how to reduce steps and maintain measurement performance, while the enterprise side is responsible for manufacturing, component and service availability. The most meaningful common metrics for both ends are time, cost, and success rate for effective results every time
学术端提出实验步骤和控制需求，产业及开源平台提供执行模块。两端的连接不仅是机械尺: The academic side proposes experimental procedures and control requirements, and the industrial and open source platforms provide execution modules. The connections at both ends are not only mechanical dimensions, but also include operating commands, status feedback, data formats and exception handling
学术端提出需要操控的微环境变量，企业将可重复制造和操作功能集成到设备。两端的联系: The academic side proposes microenvironmental variables that need to be manipulated, and companies integrate reproducible manufacturing and operating functions into equipment. Contact between the two ends should be verified by cell readouts in the same experimental protocol rather than just comparing print resolutions
学术端提出需要澄清的解剖或操作问题，企业端提供重复转换和交付能力。最直接的联系是: The academic side raises anatomical or operational questions that require clarification, and the enterprise side provides iterative conversion and delivery capabilities. The most direct connection is to write the model usage into a verifiable task, and then record whether it changes the clinical plan
学术端揭示漏气位置、压降及佩戴变化，企业端可据此改进接触边缘、过滤面积和连接密封: The academic side reveals the location of air leaks, pressure drop and wear changes, and the enterprise side can improve the contact edge, filter area and connection sealing accordingly. The cross-fertilization focus of the two is complete product verification and feedback of measurement results into structural parameters.
学术端正在由系统排名走向误差解释。七系统研究揭示制造一致性差异，支撑实验进一步分: The academic side is moving from systematic ranking to error explanation. Seven-system study reveals differences in manufacturing consistency, supporting experiments to further analyze the causes of adjustability, and clinical comparisons to examine whether fit translates into retention and comfort
学术端正形成组合评价：配方与设备决定成形，后固化改变聚合与尺寸，老化测试呈现性能: Academic integrity forms a combined evaluation: formulation and equipment determine shaping, post-curing changes polymerization and size, aging testing reveals performance changes, and intraoral follow-up identifies actual failure modes. The increasingly important question is "which combination is suitable for which repair task" rather than a unified ranking of printing methods
学术端的任务比较可以帮助企业确定何时需要打印、何时数字展示已经足够。企业平台又能: Comparing tasks on the academic side can help businesses determine when printing is necessary and when digital presentation is sufficient. The enterprise platform can also keep segmentations, plans and model versions consistent, providing a stable basis for comparative research.
学术端的关键贡献是把企业产品的技术性能连接到临床用途：更准确的截骨可作为机制证据: The key contribution of the academic side is to connect the technical performance of the company's products to clinical use: more accurate osteotomy can serve as evidence of mechanism, and patient recovery and reoperation can answer the question of therapeutic value.
学术端的变化不是用传感取代患者反馈，而是让反馈有更具体的解释。几何决定接触位置，: The change on the academic side is not to replace patient feedback with sensing, but to give the feedback a more specific interpretation. Geometry determines contact location, tissue and padding influence load transfer, sensing examines interface changes, and patient evaluation presents the final experience.
学术端的变化是从工艺时间走向服务流程。支撑研究关注资源使用，交叉试验关注就诊，回: The change on the academic side is from craft time to service process. Supporting studies focus on resource use, cross-over trials focus on medical visits, and retrospective studies further incorporate actual costs and clinical outcomes.
学术端的深化主要体现在三个层次。第一，力学指标从单次压缩性能延伸至循环失效；第二: The deepening of the academic side is mainly reflected in three levels. First, the mechanical index extends from single compression performance to cyclic failure; second, the geometric input is from the ideal
学术端能够比较生产流程和资源投入，企业端提供实际交付与扩产经验。交叉分析应把“快: The academic side can compare production processes and resource inputs, while the enterprise side provides practical delivery and expansion experience. Cross-analysis should separate "rapid completion of first batch verification" and "sustained low-cost supply" and identify transition conditions between the two.
学术端解释何种细胞与环境组合能够重现目标现象；产业端关注模型能否持续产生可用于研: The academic side explains which combination of cells and environment can reproduce the target phenomenon; the industrial side focuses on whether the model can continue to produce results that can be used for R&D decisions. The common unit of translation is the validated experimental task, not the name “organ-on-a-chip” itself
学术端证明开放工具能够完成实验，企业或本地服务者提供稳定交付与支持。两者可以通过: The academic side has proven that open tools can complete experiments, and enterprises or local service providers provide stable delivery and support. The two can establish a continuous relationship through standard configurations, acceptance samples and sharing agreements
学术端通过光学设计和实验确定需要的形状及质量，企业平台提供制造窗口。最有价值的对: The academic end determines the required shape and quality through optical design and experiments, and the enterprise platform provides a manufacturing window. The most valuable correspondence is whether a certain manufacturable geometry improves the target beam, field of view, background, or resolution
学术端验证材料、界面和探测方法，企业端将其组织为可重复服务。两端应使用清楚的测量: The academic side validates the materials, interfaces, and detection methods, and the enterprise side organizes them into repeatable services. Clear measurement metrics and calibration conditions should be used at both ends to enable different hospitals to explain differences in results
学术端验证特定样本的成像与识别表现，企业端组织采集、数据和算法服务。二者应围绕同: The academic side verifies the imaging and recognition performance of specific samples, and the enterprise side organizes collection, data and algorithm services. The two should be compared around the same process: whether on-site users can obtain qualified images, how much work the algorithm can reduce, and which results still need to be confirmed by experts.
学术证据呈现两个方向的深入：一是制造路线越来越具体，从树脂加工扩大到打印氧化锆；: Academic evidence shows in-depth development in two directions: First, the manufacturing route is becoming more and more specific, expanding from resin processing to printing zirconia; second, the clinical endpoints are becoming more and more detailed, extending from failure and retention to surface, color, periodontal response and maintenance
学术评价正从单一颜色变化，扩展到表面处理与环境的交互，并开始通过实际器械随访观察: Academic evaluation is expanding from single color changes to the interaction of surface treatment with the environment and beginning to observe esthetic maintenance through actual device follow-up. Experimental color differences and roughness help explain changes, and clinical records supplement whether patients noticed changes, whether maintenance was needed, and the effects of treatment.
学术评价正在从“能否更接近术前计划”拓展到“这种接近是否改变患者结果”。不同术式: Academic evaluation is expanding from “can we get closer to preoperative planning” to “does this closeness change patient outcomes?” The positive and neutral results of different surgical procedures together indicate that the advantage of the guide depends on whether the original error has affected the treatment and whether the improvement is sufficient.
学术评价正在由终点骨量转向修复过程。原位模型提供局部骨形成证据，大型动物进一步暴: Academic evaluation is shifting from endpoint bone mass to repair process. In situ models provide evidence of local bone formation, and large animals further expose soft tissue and fixation issues; multi-time point and regional analysis help explain where bones come from and where they grow.
学术评价逐渐从“义齿是否固位”扩展到多个使用维度，并采用交叉设计减少个体差异影响: Academic evaluation has gradually expanded from "whether dentures are retained" to multiple dimensions of use, and a crossover design has been adopted to reduce the impact of individual differences. Different studies show that patient preference is affected both by the prosthesis and by the adaptation and treatment process
学术调查提供不同岗位的真实要求，企业设计与生产能力把这些要求转为框架、固定和屏障: Academic surveys provide the real requirements of different positions, and corporate design and production capabilities translate these requirements into frameworks, fixations, and barrier structures. 本研究对14只足部进行微创hallux valgus矫正，采用基于CT的3D打印: In this study, minimally invasive hallux valgus correction was performed on 14 feet, using CT-based 3D printed patient-specific guides to achieve precise intraoperative operations. The results showed that the foot deformity angle was improved, the pain score was significantly reduced, and the functional score was improved.
本研究对15例成年患者进行术前CBCT虚拟规划，制作个性化3D打印手术导板，辅助: This study conducted preoperative CBCT virtual planning on 15 adult patients, produced personalized 3D printed surgical guides, and assisted in the MARPE treatment of median palatal process perforation. The results showed that the midpalatal suture dehiscence rate was high, the lateral bone expansion reached 3.6±0. There were few complications, and the surgical operation was accurate and safe.
本研究对201例膝骨关节炎患者采用CT辅助3D打印定制切导板进行股骨和胫骨截骨，: In this study, 201 patients with knee osteoarthritis were subjected to femoral and tibial osteotomies using CT-assisted 3D printed customized cutting guides. Intraoperative measurements were compared with preoperative CT predicted values. The results showed that 94% of the osteotomy errors were ≤1.5mm, 90% were ≤1mm, and the average error was ≤0.60mm, indicating that this technology can accurately predict the amount of bone osteotomy.
本研究对20例患者在全数字化流程中使用动态导航技术植入20颗种植体，通过CBCT: This study used dynamic navigation technology to implant 20 implants in 20 patients in a fully digital process. Through CBCT and 3D printing model evaluation, the average position angular deviation was 2.7° and the three-dimensional shoulder deviation was 1.83mm. The results show that navigation technology can achieve high-precision implantation and is especially suitable for minimally invasive surgery.
本研究对22名需临时冠修复的前磨牙或磨牙患者，比较了自固化PMMA、CAD/CA: This study compared the performance of self-curing PMMA, CAD/CAM milled PMMA and 3D printed resin temporary crowns in terms of edge fit, color stability and flexural strength in 22 patients who needed temporary crowns for repair of premolars or molars. The results showed that CAD/CAM milled crowns were the best in terms of edge fit and flexural strength, self-curing PMMA had the largest color change and the worst mechanical properties, and 3D printed crowns were in between.
本研究对25例部分缺牙患者采用数字化导板进行种植手术，通过三维扫描对比计划与实际: This study used digital guides for implant surgery on 25 patients with partially missing teeth. By comparing the planned and actual implant positions through three-dimensional scanning, it was found that the origin displacement, depth error, horizontal displacement and angle error were 0.71mm, 0.36mm, 0.52mm and 3.34° respectively. The surgical process and learning curve were the main factors leading to the deviation.
本研究对30例前交通动脉动脉瘤患者采用基于数字减影血管造影的3D打印模型辅助手术: This study used 3D printed models based on digital subtraction angiography to assist surgery in 30 patients with anterior communicating artery aneurysms. The results show that the use of 3D models can improve surgical accuracy, improve postoperative functional outcomes, reduce complications, and is highly feasible.
本研究对30名患者颌骨植入4枚直接金属激光烧结钛种植体，用于支持bar保留的上颌: In this study, 4 direct metal laser sintered titanium implants were implanted in the jaws of 30 patients to support bar-retaining maxillary overdentures. The results were followed up for 3 years. The results showed that the survival rate of the implants was high, there was no obvious bone level absorption, and the incidence of biological and prosthetic complications was low.
本研究对31例翻修膝关节置换术患者使用患者特异性3D打印锥体，所有病例均实现良好: This study used patient-specific 3D printed cones in 31 patients undergoing revision knee replacement. All cases achieved good osseointegration without loosening or infection. Knee function scores improved significantly at 12 months. The trend continued but did not reach statistical significance at 24 months.
本研究对32例上颌及下颌种植病例使用3D打印手术导板进行种植，结果显示种植体颈缘: In this study, 32 cases of maxillary and mandibular implants were implanted using 3D printed surgical guides. The results showed that the implant neck edge, tip and angle deviations were 1.11±0.67mm, 1.43±1.053mm, 3.01±2.53° respectively, and the vertical deviation was 0.71±0.57mm. There was no statistical difference in each deviation between gender, dental arch position and position. The guide plate has high accuracy in three-dimensional positioning.
本研究对3例下颌成釉细胞瘤切除后大缺损患者，采用GMP级自体脂肪干细胞、β-TC: In this study, 3 patients with large defects after resection of mandibular ameloblastoma were treated with GMP-grade autologous adipose stem cells, β-TCP particles, and rhBMP-2 to construct tissue engineering scaffolds, combined with computer-aided manufacturing technology to customize implants, achieving one-step in situ bone regeneration without the need for allogeneic bone or vascularized free flaps, and supporting subsequent implant placement.
本研究对3例晚期原发性距骨坏死患者实施了患者特异性3D打印全距骨置换术，术后6周: In this study, 3 patients with advanced primary talar osteonecrosis underwent patient-specific 3D printed total talar bone replacement. Follow-up at 6 weeks and 3 months after surgery showed a decrease in pain scores, improvement in FAOS scores, and maintenance or enhancement of joint mobility. This preliminary indication shows that this surgery can improve early clinical outcomes.
本研究对3例颌面缺损患者采用CBCT/CT扫描数据，利用Geomagic软件设计: This study used CBCT/CT scan data of 3 patients with maxillofacial defects, designed them using Geomagic software and produced patient-specific implants through three-dimensional printing, and evaluated their surgical adaptability, postoperative pain, aesthetic scores, and intraoperative challenges.
本研究对4例患有下颌慢性弥漫性硬化性骨髓炎/肌腱周围炎的女性患者，采用对侧下颌镜: In this study, 4 female patients with chronic diffuse sclerosing osteomyelitis/peritendonitis of the mandible underwent mandibular reshaping surgery using contralateral mandibular mirror-image design and 3D printing of patient-specific surgical guides. The results showed that 3 patients were satisfied with the surgery, 1 required a repeat surgery due to aesthetic problems, and 1 gave up the surgery due to psychological acceptance.
本研究对5例滑脱股骨头青少年患者术后CT分析显示，使用3D打印导引装置后股骨头和: In this study, postoperative CT analysis of 5 adolescent patients with slipped femoral head showed that the femoral head and rotational misalignment were significantly improved after using the 3D printed guide device, but the guide device and plate still had residual deviations of 3-13 mm displacement and 8-28° rotation.
本研究对5例远端桡骨巨细胞瘤患者采用3D打印金属假体联合网状补片治疗，术后随访平: In this study, 5 patients with giant cell tumors of the distal radius were treated with 3D printed metal prostheses combined with mesh patches. The average postoperative follow-up was 40.8 months. Wrist joint mobility and grip strength were basically restored, and no infection or prosthetic loosening was found. Two cases had radioulnar joint dislocation, and one case had ulnar impingement syndrome and lunate degeneration. There was no recurrence or metastasis, and the functional recovery was good and the risk of complications was low.
本研究对5名先天性手缺失青少年及其主要照护者进行定性访谈，发现使用者虽视3D打印: This study conducted qualitative interviews with five teenagers who were born with missing hands and their primary caregivers. It was found that although the users viewed 3D printed prosthetic hands as an opportunity to return to normal, they had difficulties in use due to material and design issues, and the function and appearance of the prosthetic hands did not meet expectations.
本研究对6位无牙患者使用CAD/3D打印制作的诊断性全口义齿记录的颌位关系进行定: This study quantitatively evaluated the jaw position relationships recorded by diagnostic complete dentures produced using CAD/3D printing for 6 edentulous patients. The results showed that there was a significant difference in the forward movement direction compared with the traditional control group, indicating that this method is feasible but the patient's protrusion needs to be paid attention to.
本研究对7例儿童下肢恶性骨肿瘤患者应用定制3D打印超短柄 多孔 钛合金假体进行骨: In this study, 7 children with lower limb malignant bone tumors were treated with custom-made 3D printed ultra-short-stem porous titanium alloy prostheses for bone defect reconstruction. Postoperative follow-up showed that the prostheses were stable, with no loosening or fractures, functional scores and pain scores improved, and no tumor recurrence or complications were seen.
本研究对7例距骨关节内骨折患者采用术前CT建模、三维打印患者特异性器械辅助导航，: In this study, 7 patients with intra-articular talus fractures used preoperative CT modeling and three-dimensional printing patient-specific instruments to assist navigation to achieve precise reduction. Postoperative joint mobility was significantly restored, and the fracture fragments were reduced through ligament traction with good results.
本研究对8例下肢骨髓炎所致部分骨缺损患者应用3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V假体，通过: In this study, 3D printed porous Ti6Al4V prostheses were used in 8 patients with partial bone defects caused by lower limb osteomyelitis. Finite element analysis and clinical follow-up showed that the prostheses effectively shared stress, reduced residual bone load, promoted bone regeneration, and improved function. Although 2 cases of infection recurred, the LEFS scores of the remaining patients increased from 31.5 to 61.0.
本研究对9例12个无牙颌患者使用CAD-CAM数控铣削制作手术导板，植入44颗种: In this study, 9 cases of 12 edentulous patients used CAD-CAM CNC milling to produce surgical guides and implanted 44 implants. The results showed that the average three-dimensional linear deviation of the implant position was 1.53 mm (tooth neck) and 1.58 mm (tooth cusp), and the angular deviation was 3.96°. The maxillary deviation was significantly smaller than that of the mandibular, and it had nothing to do with whether anchors were used.
本研究对9例早期掌指关节骨关节炎患者行基底掌骨延长截骨术，采用患者特制导板辅助手: In this study, 9 patients with early metacarpophalangeal joint osteoarthritis underwent basal metacarpal lengthening osteotomy, using a patient-specific guide to assist the surgery. Three-dimensional CT analysis showed that the metacarpal position and load distribution changed slightly before and after surgery, indicating that the load distribution tended to be flat and the peak load area was shifted dorsally, but the results did not reach statistical significance.
本研究对9例距骨骨折患者采用3D打印纯钛锁定钢板行开放复位内固定，结果显示9例钢: In this study, 9 patients with talus fractures underwent open reduction and internal fixation using 3D printed pure titanium locking steel plates. The results showed that the plates were stable without loosening in 9 cases, and 1 case required revision due to neurofibroma. No complications such as infection or skin irritation were found.
本研究对两只大型犬的IV级外侧髌骨脱位伴复杂股骨畸形，采用患者特制3D打印截骨导: In this study, two large dogs with grade IV lateral patellar dislocation and complex femoral deformity were treated with patient-specific 3D printed osteotomy guides and titanium plates to perform distal femoral osteotomy and internal fixation. Preoperative CT virtual planning was used to evaluate the correction effect. Significant clinical improvement was achieved postoperatively, and no serious complications were found.
本研究对住院期间3D打印的聚醚醚酮（PEEK）患者特异性颅骨植入物进行定量评估，: This study quantitatively evaluated the 3D printed polyetheretherketone (PEEK) patient-specific skull implant during hospitalization. The results showed that it has high geometric accuracy, good morphological continuity, a peak load of 798.38±211.45 N, and different fracture modes. The overall performance is in line with clinical expectations but there is still room for improvement.
本研究对使用3D打印技术制作临时牙科修复体的患者进行观察，结果显示该方法在临床应: This study observed patients who used 3D printing technology to produce temporary dental restorations. The results showed that this method is feasible in clinical application and can effectively meet the needs of temporary restorations.
本研究对全口缺牙患者的义齿（obturators）进行椅旁三维扫描，将其数据标准: This study conducted chairside three-dimensional scanning of the dentures (obturators) of patients with complete edentulousness, standardized and stored the data, and used 3D printing technology to reconstruct simulated dentures, verifying the feasibility of the digital database in emergency situations.
本研究对比了3D打印个性化钛植入物与Latarjet手术在修复20%骨缺损肩关节: This study compared the biomechanical effects of 3D printed personalized titanium implants and Latarjet surgery in repairing shoulder joints with 20% bone defects. The results showed that both significantly increased the peak force required for anterior dislocation, and there was no significant difference between the two.
本研究对比了3D打印含胃溶包衣奥美拉唑颗粒的半固体凝胶与溶解型奥美拉唑凝胶，结果: This study compared 3D printed semi-solid gel containing gastric-coated omeprazole particles with dissolved omeprazole gel. The results showed that the former has higher gastric tolerance and suitable release characteristics, providing an effective solution for children's medication.
本研究对比了9具人体标本与3D打印模型的骨结构距离，发现Ultimaker 3打: This study compared the bone structure distance between 9 human specimens and 3D printed models, and found that the accuracy of the models printed by Ultimaker 3 was slightly higher than that of Makerbot Replicator Z18, and the overall printed model could meet the needs of preoperative planning.
本研究对比了三种3D打印多孔椎间融合器，通过有限元分析评估其在压缩载荷下的应力与: This study compared three types of 3D printed porous intervertebral cages and evaluated their stress and displacement responses under compressive load through finite element analysis. The results showed that the stress of the C-type implant dropped to 89.21 MPa and the displacement was only 0.006 mm at 60% porosity, and the stress of each vertebral body was lower than the yield limit of the bone material.
本研究对比了三种晶格结构髋关节植入物在生理载荷下的机械性能，结果显示六角晶格在应: This study compared the mechanical properties of three lattice structure hip implants under physiological loads. The results show that the hexagonal lattice is optimal in terms of stress distribution and structural integrity, and has the best weight reduction effect, providing an effective solution for lightweight design.
本研究对比了三种种植系统在黏膜支持手术模板引导下植入的定位准确性，结果显示系统C: This study compared the positioning accuracy of three implant systems guided by mucosal-supported surgical templates. The results showed that system C was significantly better than systems A and B in coronal, root, and angular deviations.
本研究对比了三维打印与手工制作的人工眼罩，结果显示三维打印眼罩在生物安全性、力学: This study compared three-dimensional printed and hand-made artificial eye patches. The results showed that the three-dimensional printed eye patches were no different from handmade products in terms of biological safety, mechanical strength, and patient satisfaction. They did not cause conjunctival inflammation or allergic reactions, and their appearance and function were both recognized.
本研究对比了不同表面处理对3D打印义齿重衬接合强度的影响，结果显示打磨结合单体应: This study compared the effects of different surface treatments on the joint strength of 3D printed denture relinings. The results showed that grinding combined with monomer application or specific adhesives can significantly improve the joint strength, but it did not reach the level of the untreated control group. All relinings showed interface bonding fractures.
本研究对比了传统、注塑和3D打印技术制作的上颌完全义齿基托在精度和抗冲击性能方面: This study compared the differences in accuracy and impact resistance of maxillary complete denture bases made by traditional, injection molding and 3D printing technologies, and clearly pointed out that the three technologies performed differently in key indicators.
本研究对比了传统义齿与3D打印义齿在患者满意度方面的差异，结果显示传统义齿在发音: This study compared the differences in patient satisfaction between traditional dentures and 3D printed dentures. The results showed that traditional dentures were better than 3D printed dentures in terms of pronunciation, cleanliness, stability, comfort and overall satisfaction. However, 20% of patients still preferred and used 3D printed dentures daily.
本研究对比了传统预成型钛网与基于院内3D打印模型定制钛网在眶底骨折修复中的应用，: This study compared the application of traditional preformed titanium mesh and customized titanium mesh based on in-hospital 3D printing models in the repair of orbital floor fractures. It was found that the use of 3D printing preformed titanium mesh can more accurately restore orbital volume, and the postoperative orbital volume is closer to normal, and the functional recovery is more reliable.
本研究对比了使用3D打印手术导板与自由操作方式在下颌骨病变活检中的准确性，结果显: This study compared the accuracy of using a 3D printed surgical guide with that of free operation in mandibular lesion biopsy. The results showed that the guide group was significantly better than the free operation group in biopsy axis and angle deviation, and the depth difference was not statistically significant.
本研究对比了全口修复体在All-on-4与All-on-6情况下，使用PEEK框: This study compared the strain distribution in the premolar and molar areas of full-mouth restorations in the All-on-4 and All-on-6 situations when using PEEK frames. The results showed that the strain of the inclined implant in the premolar area was smaller under the All-on-6 configuration, and the stress was dispersed through the wing-shaped implant.
本研究对比了在内侧间室膝骨关节炎患者中，采用3D打印患者特异性导板与不采用导板进: This study compared the surgical accuracy and functional improvement of high tibial osteotomy using a 3D printed patient-specific guide versus not using a guide in patients with medial compartment knee osteoarthritis.
本研究对比了常规与数字可摘局部义齿在60名无牙患者中的临床效果与成本效率，发现数: This study compared the clinical effects and cost efficiency of conventional and digital removable partial dentures in 60 edentulous patients. It was found that digital dentures significantly shortened chairside time and reduced laboratory costs, while there was no difference in bite force and masticatory function, and patient satisfaction decreased slightly but without clinical significance.
本研究对比了常规制作与三维打印临时修复体对下颌后区早期非功能加载种植体周围硬软组: This study compared the effects of conventionally produced and three-dimensional printed temporary restorations on early non-functional loading of hard and soft tissues around implants in the posterior mandibular region. The results showed that there was no significant difference in tissue response between the two.
本研究对比了铸造与选择性激光熔融（SLM）钴铬合金牙桥在咀嚼载荷下的强度与变形特: This study compared the strength and deformation characteristics of cast and selective laser melting (SLM) cobalt-chromium alloy dental bridges under chewing load. Through simulation analysis, it was found that although the equivalent von Mises stress of SLM dental bridges in the key connection areas is similar, its safety factor is higher than that of cast dental bridges, indicating that the SLM structure has higher reserve strength.
本研究将3D打印与注塑技术结合，通过在注塑片基上直接覆印制备个性化固体制剂，使用: This study combines 3D printing and injection molding technology to prepare personalized solid preparations by directly printing on the injection molded tablet base, and uses theophylline and polymer blends to prepare filaments. The results show that the printed tablets are faster to prepare and release drugs faster than traditional injection molded tablets.
本研究将乳清蛋白浓缩物（WPC）加载至3D打印聚乳酸（PLA）支架中，探究不同浓: This study loaded whey protein concentrate (WPC) into 3D printed polylactic acid (PLA) scaffolds to explore the effects of different concentrations of WPC on scaffold performance. The results showed that the higher the concentration of WPC, the higher the scaffold swelling and degradation rates. The cell viability in the 50% WPC group was significantly improved, and the drug release duration was prolonged.
本研究将用于急性早幼粒细胞白血病特异性PML::RARA检测的微流控芯片从玻璃结: In this study, the microfluidic chip used for acute promyelocytic leukemia-specific PML::RARA detection was transferred from a glass structure to a 3D printed structure. Different methacrylate resins were printed by DLP and SLA to verify its feasibility in terms of biocompatibility, functionalization and detection performance. The results showed that the sensitivity of the printed structure was slightly lower than that of the glass structure, but it has good application potential.
本研究将脂肪源间充质干细胞分泌组封装于藻酸盐-石英砂3D打印栓剂中，通过牛血清白: In this study, the secretome of adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells was encapsulated in alginate-quartz sand 3D printed suppositories, and controlled release was achieved through a bovine serum albumin replacement strategy. It verified its anti-inflammatory effect on M1 type inflammatory macrophages in vitro, and revealed that the suppository matrix itself has immunomodulatory capabilities.
本研究开发了含布地奈德的口服黏稠悬浮液及3D打印成型固体剂型，比较其黏膜黏附性，: This study developed oral viscous suspensions and 3D printed solid dosage forms containing budesonide, and compared their mucosal adhesion. The results showed that the L2-XG and P1-0.5-XG dosage forms containing xanthan gum had the best adhesion, significantly better than L1-MC, among which P1-0.5-XG had the strongest adhesion.
本研究开发了将帕米膦酸和塞来昔布预封装于纳米结构脂质载体后的3D打印口崩片，通过: This study developed a 3D printed orally disintegrating tablet that pre-encapsulates pamidronic acid and celecoxib in a nanostructured lipid carrier. By adjusting the filling rate, the dose, disintegration and release can be controlled predictably, providing a personalized drug delivery platform for children's tumor treatment.
本研究开发了负载抗肿瘤药物阿克里氟胺（ACF）的3D打印缓释植入物，用于胶质母细: This study developed a 3D printed sustained-release implant loaded with the anti-tumor drug acriflunomide (ACF) for postoperative treatment of glioblastoma. It achieves sustained release of ACF in tumor targeting and has an antibacterial effect, especially effective against Staphylococcus aureus.
本研究开发并评估了基于RT-LAMP的多重颜色反应法，用于快速检测猪瘟病毒（SV: This study developed and evaluated a multiple color reaction method based on RT-LAMP for rapid detection of swine fever virus (SVV). Through the dual primer combination of VP1 and 3D gene targeting, specific amplification was achieved within 40 minutes at 65°C. Combined with a 3D printed RNA extraction device, a simple point-of-care detection process was formed, which can be used as a low-cost and rapid alternative to RT-qPCR.
本研究开发并验证了一种半自动化软件，用于从颞骨锥形束CT扫描中分割圆窗 nich: This study developed and validated a semi-automated software for segmenting the round window niche and membrane from temporal bone cone beam CT scans. The results showed that the RWN volume and RWM area of semi-automatic segmentation were smaller than those of manual segmentation, and personalized implants based on semi-automatic segmentation could successfully achieve pressure-sealing implantation, while manually segmented implants failed to fit.
本研究总结了在正畸领域中使用丙烯酸树脂和甲基丙烯酸树脂3D打印手术导板的应用。: This study summarizes the applications of 3D printed surgical guides using acrylic resin and methacrylic resin in the field of orthodontics.
本研究报道了一例利用数字模板和三维打印供牙复制品，将上颌双根前磨牙移植至下颌受体: This study reports a case in which a maxillary double-rooted premolar was transplanted to a mandibular recipient site using a digital template and a three-dimensional printed donor tooth replica. Through digital planning and double-rooted surgical guides, precise reduction was achieved, surgery time was shortened, and root damage and dislocation time were reduced.
本研究探讨3D打印医疗设备在应对新冠疫情中的作用，分析其在医疗产品供应链中的应用: This study explores the role of 3D printed medical equipment in responding to the COVID-19 epidemic, analyzes its application in the medical product supply chain, and focuses on assessing the availability of existing 3D printed equipment and the integrity of design data and operating instructions.
本研究探讨了3D打印技术在设计个性化药物递送系统中的应用，通过对比传统制剂，展示: This study explores the application of 3D printing technology in designing personalized drug delivery systems. By comparing traditional preparations, it demonstrates its advantages in accurately controlling drug release profiles, dose intensity, and geometric structure, thereby improving therapeutic effects.
本研究探讨了基于智能生物材料的新型骨科植入物，通过与生物组织主动交互提升骨整合与: This study explores a new type of orthopedic implant based on smart biomaterials, which improves osseointegration and regeneration through active interaction with biological tissues, and combines 3D printing and nanotechnology to achieve personalized design. However, due to cost, regulatory and clinical trial requirements, its long-term stability and immune compatibility still require further research.
本研究探讨了用于义齿制作的生物相容性纳米材料、先进陶瓷和新一代高分子材料的应用，: This study explores the application of biocompatible nanomaterials, advanced ceramics and new generation polymer materials for denture production, combining 3D printing and CAD/CAM technology to achieve precise customization and rapid prototyping of dentures, improving patient comfort and treatment effects.
本研究探讨数字技术在完全无牙颌患者完全义齿制作中的应用，通过三维扫描、智能设计软: This study explores the application of digital technology in the production of complete dentures for completely edentulous patients. Through three-dimensional scanning, intelligent design software and CNC processing or 3D printing, the accuracy of dentures and patient satisfaction are improved, showing its advantages in accuracy, efficiency and clinical experience.
本研究比较了100%椰子油、2%戊二醛和70%乙醇对3D打印手术导板消毒后形态和: This study compared the effects of 100% coconut oil, 2% glutaraldehyde and 70% ethanol on the morphology and volume size of 3D printed surgical guides after disinfection. The results showed that the coconut oil group had the highest morphological accuracy. There was no volume change among the three and they had the same antibacterial effect, and all grew sterile.
本研究比较了3D打印PEKK与PEEK薄网在定制上颌骨增量中的性能，结果显示PE: This study compared the performance of 3D printed PEKK and PEEK thin meshes in customized maxillary augmentation. The results showed that PEKK mesh was superior to PEEK mesh in terms of thickness control, surface smoothness and mechanical properties. Cell proliferation was slightly lower but biocompatibility was similar. It is recommended that the pore size be less than 2mm and the thickness be 0.2μm to ensure clinical stability.
本研究比较了3D打印、CAD/CAM铣削和传统热聚合牙托基材料在烟丝烟草影响下的: This study compared the color stability and surface roughness changes of 3D printing, CAD/CAM milling and traditional thermally polymerized dental tray base materials under the influence of cut tobacco. The results showed that the color and surface roughness changes of 3D printed dental tray base materials were significantly higher than those of traditional and CAD/CAM milled materials.
本研究比较了3D打印、磨削和椅旁塑形临时修复体的微渗漏情况，结果显示3D打印修复: This study compared the microleakage of 3D printing, grinding and chairside shaping temporary restorations. The results showed that the 3D printing restoration had the least microleakage and was better than the grinding and chairside shaping groups.
本研究比较了3D打印与5轴 铣削工艺制备的氧化锆冠边缘密合度，结果显示3D打印冠: This study compared the edge tightness of zirconia crowns prepared by 3D printing and 5-axis milling processes. The results showed that the edge gaps of 3D printed crowns were significantly larger than milled crowns at all stages.
本研究比较了3D打印与传统方法制备的义齿基托材料，结果显示3D打印组在弯曲强度、: This study compared denture base materials prepared by 3D printing and traditional methods. The results showed that the 3D printing group was superior to the traditional group in terms of bending strength, compressive strength, and microhardness. The water absorption rate was lower, and the water solubility difference was statistically significant.
本研究比较了3D打印与传统铣削制备的全瓷冠边缘及内部配合情况，结果显示铣削冠的边: This study compared the edge and internal fit of all-ceramic crowns prepared by 3D printing and traditional milling. The results showed that the edge and internal gaps of the milled crown were significantly smaller than those of the 3D printed crown, and both were within the clinically acceptable range.
本研究比较了3D打印与磨削制备的氧化锆冠在循环载荷下的抗折强度，结果显示磨削冠在: This study compared the flexural strength of zirconia crowns prepared by 3D printing and grinding under cyclic load. The results showed that the flexural strength of the ground crown under no load and cyclic load was significantly higher than that of the 3D printed crown, but both were higher than the occlusal force, which is clinically acceptable.
本研究比较了3D打印与铣削技术制作的临时固定修复体的边缘密合度，结果显示铣削组边: This study compared the edge tightness of temporary fixed restorations made by 3D printing and milling technology. The results showed that the edge gap of the milling group was the smallest, which was better than the 3D printing group of GC and PR materials.
本研究比较了3D打印手术导板与自由操作法在下颌颊骨板临时锚钉植入中的准确性，结果: This study compared the accuracy of the 3D printed surgical guide plate and the free operation method in the temporary anchor implantation of the mandibular buccal plate. The results showed that the guide plate group was better than the free operation group in terms of anchor position parallelism, distance from the buccal plate, distance from the hyoid plate and apex, angle, and nerve safety, and the implantation success rate was also significantly higher.
本研究比较了3D打印树脂与CAD/CAM铣磨PMMA临时冠在模拟临床条件下的抗折: This study compared the flexural strength of 3D printed resin and CAD/CAM milled PMMA temporary crowns under simulated clinical conditions. The results showed that after artificial aging, the flexural strength of 3D printed resin crowns was significantly higher than that of CAD/CAM PMMA crowns, but there was no significant difference between the two under unaging conditions.
本研究比较了3D打印树脂与传统CAD/CAM块在不同染色剂和储存时间下的颜色稳定: This study compared the color stability of 3D printing resin and traditional CAD/CAM blocks under different dyes and storage times. The results showed that the color difference of 3D printing resin in all dyes after storage for more than 7 days exceeded the clinical limit and was significantly higher than that of CAD/CAM blocks.
本研究比较了3D打印树脂与传统PMMA基底上软衬层的粘附强度，结果显示砂blas: This study compared the adhesion strength of the soft liner on 3D printing resin and traditional PMMA substrates. The results showed that sand blast treatment significantly improved the adhesion strength of the soft liner on both substrates, and the adhesion of the sample directly mixed into the paste stage was better than that of the traditional PMMA substrate.
本研究比较了3D打印树脂与传统自固化双甲基丙烯酸酯树脂在抗弯强度、显微硬度、耐磨: This study compared the differences in flexural strength, microhardness, wear resistance and water absorption between 3D printing resin and traditional self-curing dimethacrylate resin. The results showed that 3D printing resin has better mechanical properties, but the water absorption rate is significantly higher. Self-curing resin is still recommended as a long-term temporary repair material in clinical practice.
本研究比较了3D打印树脂材料与传统预制树脂牙在芯片和间接拉伸断裂阻力方面的表现，: This study compared the performance of 3D printed resin materials and traditional prefabricated resin teeth in terms of chip and indirect tensile fracture resistance. The results showed that the fracture load of 3D printed teeth was higher than Premium-8, Surpass and SR-Orthosit-PE, but lower than Preference teeth. The chip resistance was equivalent to Surpass and SR-Orthosit-PE, but lower than Premium-8 and Preference teeth.
本研究比较了3D打印树脂材料在临时固定义齿中的弯曲强度，结果显示DLP与SLA技: This study compared the flexural strength of 3D printed resin materials in temporary fixed dentures. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the flexural strength of restorations prepared by DLP and SLA technologies. Only cracks and no fractures occurred in the FDM group, indicating that the temporary restorations prepared by the two technologies have sufficient flexural strength.
本研究比较了3D打印牙托基树脂在120°和135°打印方向下的表面粗糙度与弯曲强: This study compared the surface roughness and bending strength of 3D printed dental tray base resin in 120° and 135° printing directions, as well as the difference with CAD-CAM milled dental tray base resin. The results showed that CAD-CAM resin was superior to 3D printing resin in surface roughness and mechanical properties, and the two printing directions had no significant impact on surface roughness.
本研究比较了3D打印牙科种植体与螺纹种植体在骨整合方面的表现，结果显示两者在植入: This study compared the osseointegration performance of 3D printed dental implants and threaded implants. The results showed that no clear differences were observed in implant stability, BIC and BAFO indicators between the two.
本研究比较了3D打印的义齿基托和牙齿树脂与传统热聚合丙烯酸树脂的表面粗糙度，结果: This study compared the surface roughness of 3D printed denture base and tooth resin with traditional thermally polymerized acrylic resin. The results showed that the surface roughness of 3D printed materials was higher than that of the thermally polymerized control group, with tooth resin having the highest roughness, followed by base resin. There was no significant difference between the two, and all materials were within the clinically acceptable range.
本研究比较了3D打印铸件与传统石膏铸件在牙支持及种植体支持修复中的准确性，结果显: This study compared the accuracy of 3D printing castings and traditional plaster castings in tooth-supported and implant-supported restorations. The results showed that traditional plaster castings were better in interdental distance, while 3D printing castings were better than traditional castings in implant distance. There was no significant difference between the two 3D printing technologies.
本研究比较了3D打印静态钻导板与术中实时动态导航在牙槽外科植入术中的定位准确性，: This study compared the positioning accuracy of a 3D printed static drill guide with intraoperative real-time dynamic navigation in alveolar surgical implant surgery. The results showed that the dynamic navigation was better than the static guide in drilling direction and position deviation, especially when close to the marking point.
本研究比较了3D打印高性能聚合物与CAD/CAM混合陶瓷内冠在不同冠部预备设计下: This study compared the edge adaptability and flexural strength of 3D printed high-performance polymer and CAD/CAM hybrid ceramic crowns under different crown preparation designs. The results showed that the flexural strength of VITA ENAMIC ceramic crowns was significantly higher than that of Nanoksa G-PLUS polymer crowns, and the edge adaptability was better.
本研究比较了3Shape与Exocad软件设计的全口上颌义齿适应性，结果显示3S: This study compared the adaptability of full maxillary dentures designed by 3Shape and Exocad software. The results showed that the denture designed by 3Shape was significantly better than the Exocad design in terms of pressure area and total deviation.
本研究比较了89例舟骨重建病例中，患者特异性导引与传统手法在三维变形矫正方面的差: This study compared the differences in three-dimensional deformation correction between patient-specific guidance and traditional techniques in 89 scaphoid reconstruction cases. The results showed that patient-specific guidance achieved greater correction in multiple parameters, especially in improving sagittal flexion and ulnar tilt compared with traditional techniques.
本研究比较了CAD-CAM铣削、热压和3D打印制成的PEEK种植体冠在边缘及内部: This study compared the differences in marginal and internal adaptability of PEEK implant crowns made by CAD-CAM milling, hot pressing and 3D printing. The results showed that the milled crown had the best adaptability on the occlusal surface, the 3D printed crown had the best adaptability on the axial wall and inner corner, and the hot-pressed crown had the largest gaps in each area.
本研究比较了CAD-CAM铣削与3D打印义齿基托树脂在热循环老化前后的尺寸精度和: This study compared the dimensional accuracy and color stability of CAD-CAM milling and 3D printing denture base resin before and after thermal cycle aging. The results showed that milling resin was better than 3D printing resin in dimensional accuracy and color stability, and traditional thermal polymerization resin performed in the middle.
本研究比较了CAD/CAM与传统工艺制作的全口义齿在舒适度、美观性、咀嚼效率及患: This study compared the differences in comfort, aesthetics, chewing efficiency, and patient satisfaction between complete dentures made by CAD/CAM and traditional processes. The results showed that CAD/CAM dentures have higher accuracy and better patient-reported oral health-related quality of life, but they are more expensive and have limited accessibility.
本研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削、3D打印和传统椅旁制作的3单位临时固定修复体的边: This study compared the edge gap and bending strength of 3-unit temporary fixed restorations produced by CAD/CAM milling, 3D printing and traditional chairside production. The results showed that the CAD/CAM milling group had the smallest edge gap and the highest bending strength, while the 3D printing group had the largest edge gap. The differences between the three groups were statistically significant.
本研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削、3D打印和传统热聚合丙烯酸树脂在临床使用3个月和: This study compared the surface roughness of CAD/CAM milling, 3D printing and traditional thermally polymerized acrylic resin after 3 months and 6 months of clinical use. The results showed that CAD/CAM milling resin had the smoothest surface, 3D printing resin had the roughest surface, traditional resin was in the middle, and the interaction between material type and time was significant.
本研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削与3D打印完全义齿基托的适配精度，结果显示铣削基托: This study compared the fitting accuracy of CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing complete denture bases. The results showed that the milling bases fit better in the overall and main load-bearing areas, while the 3D printing bases fit better in the palatal edge sealing area.
本研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削与3D打印手术导板在牙种植中的定位准确性，结果显示: This study compared the positioning accuracy of CAD/CAM milling and 3D printed surgical guides in dental implants. The results showed that the CAD/CAM guides were better than the 3D printed guides in terms of coronal, apical and angular deviations.
本研究比较了Clear和牙科 SG树脂对L929细胞及人龈成纤维细胞的影响，发现: This study compared the effects of Clear and dental SG resin on L929 cells and human gingival fibroblasts. It was found that liquid Clear resin inhibited cell activity more strongly, while printing and post-curing could reduce its toxicity, indicating that the post-curing step has clinical significance on cell response.
本研究比较了DLP与LCD打印系统及三种倾角对全口义齿基托精度的影响，结果显示D: This study compared the effects of DLP and LCD printing systems and three inclination angles on the accuracy of complete denture bases. The results showed that DLP had the best accuracy at an inclination angle of 90°, and LCD performed better with recommended resins. The printing system, inclination angle and resin all affect the accuracy of denture bases.
本研究比较了DLP制备的义齿牙在0°、45°、90°不同建模方向下的耐磨性与硬度: This study compared the wear resistance and hardness of denture teeth prepared by DLP in different modeling directions of 0°, 45°, and 90°. The results showed that the wear resistance and hardness in the 0° direction were the best, and its wear resistance was significantly better than PMMA and comparable to milled teeth, but its hardness was lower than milled and composite resin teeth.
本研究比较了DPI牙模丙烯酸粉、Protemp 4双丙烯酸复合树脂及3D打印树脂: This study compared the flexural strength of temporary restorations made of DPI dental mold acrylic powder, Protemp 4 dual acrylic composite resin and 3D printing resin. The results showed that Protemp 4 had the highest flexural strength and was superior to 3D printing resin and DPI dental mold acrylic powder.
本研究比较了FDM和PolyJet两种3D打印技术在血管解剖模型中的精度，发现两: This study compared the accuracy of two 3D printing technologies, FDM and PolyJet, in vascular anatomical models. It was found that the wall thickness and surface fit of large and small vascular models printed by the two technologies were in line with the current accuracy standards. The overall average wall thickness deviation was +5%, and the surface deviation was 100 μm and 180 μm respectively.
本研究比较了Lucitone Digital 打印与SprintRay High: This study compared the clinical performance of two 3D printed dentures, Lucitone Digital printing and SprintRay High Impact. The results showed that the functional retention of SRHI dentures was significantly worse, the fracture rate and fracture-free survival rate were similar, and the failure was mainly related to the design and process.
本研究比较了PCL与PCL/β-TCP三维打印支架对MG-63细胞的影响，结果显: This study compared the effects of PCL and PCL/β-TCP three-dimensional printing scaffolds on MG-63 cells. The results showed that the PCL/β-TCP scaffold was superior to the PCL scaffold in alkaline phosphatase activity and mineralization degree, and promoted bone cell differentiation and mineralization.
本研究比较了PMMA、DMA和PEEK义齿基托材料在不同制造工艺及表面处理下的老: This study compared the aging performance of PMMA, DMA and PEEK denture base materials under different manufacturing processes and surface treatments. The results showed that the surface and mechanical properties of PEEK changed minimally after aging, and water absorption and dissolution of all materials increased significantly. Rough surfaces are more susceptible to aging than smooth surfaces, and 3D printing direction and surface treatment significantly affect the aging resistance of materials.
本研究比较了SLA与DLP打印技术、打印方向及壳厚对全口牙模型制造精度的影响，结: This study compared the effects of SLA and DLP printing technology, printing direction and shell thickness on the manufacturing accuracy of full-mouth dental models. The results showed that none of the factors significantly affected the overall accuracy, and the deviations of all models were lower than the clinically acceptable threshold.
本研究比较了三种3D打印技术（MEX、VPP、PBF）在制作牙科手术导板方面的表: This study compared the performance of three 3D printing technologies (MEX, VPP, and PBF) in the production of dental surgical guides. The results showed that VPP has the best cost and time efficiency in the production of multiple sets. MEX is competitive in the production of single sets due to its fast processing and low material cost. PBF is insufficient in dimensional accuracy.
本研究比较了三种3D打印牙科种植手术导板在121°C蒸汽灭菌20分钟后的体积变化: This study compared the volume changes of three 3D printed dental implant surgical guides after steam sterilization at 121°C for 20 minutes. The results showed that the volumes of Visijet and eResin changed significantly, which may affect surgical accuracy.
本研究比较了三种PMMA义齿基托材料的尺寸精度与稳定性，结果显示CAD/CAM铣: This study compared the dimensional accuracy and stability of three PMMA denture base materials. The results showed that the CAD/CAM milling group had the smallest deviation (0.06 mm) in the three-dimensional overlay analysis, which was significantly better than 3D printing and traditional thermal polymerization methods.
本研究比较了三种不同品牌3D打印机制作的导板在上颌即刻种植中的定位准确性，发现各: This study compared the positioning accuracy of guide plates produced by three different brands of 3D printers in immediate maxillary implants and found that there were significant differences in multiple deviation indicators between the brands, but all deviations did not exceed 0.5 mm or 1 degree.
本研究比较了三种临时修复材料的边缘密合度，结果显示3D打印树脂组（107.97: This study compared the edge adhesion of three temporary restoration materials. The results showed that the edge adhesion of the 3D printing resin group (107.97 µm) was better than that of the DPI self-setting dental tray powder group (192.56 µm) and the Bisacryl composite resin group (177.67 µm).
本研究比较了三种前牙临时修复体的抗折强度，结果显示3D打印临时冠的抗折强度最高，: This study compared the fracture strength of three types of temporary restorations for anterior teeth. The results showed that the 3D printed temporary crown had the highest fracture strength, followed by CAD/CAM technology, and the traditional indirect technology had the lowest.
本研究比较了三种化学消毒方案对SLA制造的完整义齿基托（含或不含软重衬树脂）的机: This study compared the effects of three chemical disinfection schemes on the mechanical properties, physical properties and cytotoxicity of complete denture bases made of SLA (with or without soft relining resin). The results showed that glutaraldehyde disinfection had the least impact on the mechanical properties of SLA relining dentures, while peroxy acid and foam-type disinfectants significantly reduced their strength, and the cell survival rate of relining dentures dropped to 0% after disinfection.
本研究比较了三种半固态挤出3D打印机制备泼尼松含片的效果，结果显示Allevi: This study compared the effectiveness of three semi-solid extrusion 3D printers in preparing prednisone lozenges. The results showed that the Allevi 2 bioprinter can prepare soluble films that meet European Pharmacopoeia standards, have high mechanical strength, neutral pH and low moisture, enabling on-site preparation of personalized doses for animals.
本研究比较了三种基于低成本3D打印技术的乳腺物理模型，评估其在CT扫描下的客观与: This study compared three breast physical models based on low-cost 3D printing technology and evaluated their objective and subjective performance under CT scanning. The results showed that PB1 performed well in terms of tissue HU value matching, while PB2 and PB3 had low HU values in material selection, and there was no significant difference in subjective visual quality.
本研究比较了三种手术导板在前颌骨种植中的准确性，结果显示CAD-CAM椅旁导板在: This study compared the accuracy of three surgical guides in premaxillary implants. The results showed that the CAD-CAM chairside guide was better than the manual guide at different dental surgeon experience levels, and was equivalent to the laboratory 3D printed guide. It also had a short manufacturing time and fewer patient visits.
本研究比较了三种液态树脂在不同倾角下3D打印的咬合垫的抗压强度，结果显示三种树脂: This study compared the compressive strength of three types of liquid resin 3D printed bite pads at different inclination angles. The results showed that the overall compressive strength of the three resins was similar, except that the strength of Cosmos Splint resin in the 0-degree inclination group was lower than that of the 45-degree group, and the strength of the 90-degree group was between the two.
本研究比较了三种面部假体设计方法的准确性与重复性，结果显示3D形变模型法在误差分: This study compared the accuracy and repeatability of three facial prosthesis design methods. The results showed that the 3D deformation model method has the most consistent error distribution and the best repeatability. Although there is no statistical difference in the overall error, it is better than the traditional CAD and manual engraving methods.
本研究比较了三维打印与传统方法制作的内冠边缘密合度，结果显示传统方法制作的内冠边: This study compared the marginal tightness of endocaps produced by three-dimensional printing and traditional methods. The results showed that the marginal tightness of endocaps produced by traditional methods was significantly better than that of three-dimensional printing methods.
本研究比较了三维打印与预制义齿牙在磨损和抗折强度方面的表现，结果显示三维打印牙在: This study compared the performance of three-dimensional printed and prefabricated denture teeth in terms of wear and fracture strength. The results showed that the strength and wear resistance of three-dimensional printed teeth were equivalent to those of prefabricated teeth. Except for the NextDent type, which had significantly lower fracture strength, the other types were suitable for long-term clinical use.
本研究比较了不同3D打印和CNC铣削系统制备的上颌完全义齿基托内表面精度，结果显: This study compared the inner surface accuracy of maxillary complete denture bases prepared by different 3D printing and CNC milling systems. The results showed that the inner surface obtained by subtractive manufacturing method is the most accurate and has the best consistency, while additive manufacturing has lower accuracy and obvious differences between systems.
本研究比较了不同3D打印机、树脂类型和咬合设计对外科导板精度的影响，结果显示DL: This study compared the effects of different 3D printers, resin types and bite designs on the accuracy of surgical guides. The results showed that DLP printers and guides with groove seal designs were more accurate in all measurement parameters, and the bite design had a significant impact on accuracy.
本研究比较了不同3D打印材料和装配方式对全口义齿牙齿定位精度的影响，结果显示整体: This study compared the effects of different 3D printing materials and assembly methods on the tooth positioning accuracy of complete dentures. The results showed that the positioning accuracy of monolithically printed dentures was significantly better than that of segmented and bonded dentures.
本研究比较了不同制备方法的义齿基质材料在修复及热循环后的弯曲强度，结果显示各组间: This study compared the flexural strength of denture matrix materials prepared with different preparation methods after repair and thermal cycling. The results showed that the differences between the groups were statistically significant.
本研究比较了不同制造技术制备的可摘局部义齿金属框架的贴合精度，结果显示常规铸造的: This study compared the fitting accuracy of removable partial denture metal frames prepared by different manufacturing technologies. The results show that the conventional casting milling mold technology has the best fitting accuracy before polishing. After polishing, its accuracy is better than the traditional lost wax method and selective laser melting method, and is equivalent to the printed mold method and direct metal laser sintering method. However, digital technology still needs to be improved in the accuracy of the connection area.
本研究比较了不同制造方法义齿基托树脂与牙体的剪切结合强度，结果显示3D打印组结合: This study compared the shear bonding strength of denture base resin and teeth using different manufacturing methods. The results showed that the 3D printing group had the highest bonding strength, which was significantly higher than the CAD/CAM milling group, and artificial gastric acid immersion did not significantly reduce the bonding strength of either group.
本研究比较了不同厚度下CAD/CAM与传统义齿基托树脂的弯曲强度，结果显示，除P: This study compared the bending strength of CAD/CAM and traditional denture base resins at different thicknesses. The results show that, except for P-DO and C-LC, the bending strength of CAD/CAM resin is significantly different from that of traditional resin, and increasing the thickness can improve the bending strength. Especially when the thickness is 1.6mm and above, the strength of CAD/CAM resin is higher than the ISO standard.
本研究比较了不同打印方向和水老化对3D打印牙科树脂托架力学性能的影响，结果显示9: This study compared the effects of different printing directions and water aging on the mechanical properties of 3D printed dental resin brackets. The results showed that the 90° printing direction had the highest strength and modulus when not aged. After aging, both resins decreased. The strength loss of Comfort resin reached 52%, and was always significantly lower than that of dental LT resin.
本研究比较了不同支持结构减少对3D打印全口义齿基托几何精度的影响，结果显示去除腭: This study compared the effects of reducing different support structures on the geometric accuracy of 3D printed complete denture bases. The results showed that removing the palatal and edge support structures was optimal in terms of accuracy and resource utilization, and was significantly better than the solution of only removing the edge support structures.
本研究比较了不同材料（PEEK与钛）及不同暴露长度的口内扫描体在有唾液条件下对数: This study compared the effects of intraoral scan bodies of different materials (PEEK and titanium) and different exposure lengths on the accuracy of digital implant transfer in the presence of saliva. The results showed that saliva significantly affects accuracy, and titanium scan bodies with longer exposure lengths can improve scanning accuracy.
本研究比较了不同树脂材料在传统工艺与数字制造技术下的弯曲强度，结果显示CAD-C: This study compared the bending strength of different resin materials under traditional processes and digital manufacturing technology. The results showed that CAD-CAM milling resin has the highest strength. There is no significant difference between 3D printing resin and traditional resin under 40 minutes of polymerization, and polymerization technology is significantly related to strength.
本研究比较了不同消毒方法对3D打印义齿基质树脂弯曲强度的影响，结果显示紫外线消毒: This study compared the effects of different disinfection methods on the bending strength of 3D printed denture matrix resin. The results showed that ultraviolet disinfection maintained the highest strength at 90 days, while chemical, microwave and ultrasonic disinfection all caused a significant decrease in strength.
本研究比较了不同牙槽窝设计和牙齿固位方式对3D打印全口义齿牙齿位置准确性的影响，: This study compared the effects of different alveolar socket designs and tooth retention methods on the tooth position accuracy of 3D printed complete dentures. The results showed that group VII had the smallest tooth deviation in the overall and posterior teeth areas, which was significantly better than other groups. The anterior tooth deviation was not statistically different from group III.
本研究比较了不同种类的交联PMMA材料在CAD/CAM全数字义齿制作中的应用，评: This study compared the application of different types of cross-linked PMMA materials in CAD/CAM fully digital denture manufacturing and evaluated their performance in digital denture manufacturing.
本研究比较了不同纳米修饰程度和表面处理对3D打印树脂与钛表面剪切结合强度的影响，: This study compared the effects of different degrees of nano-modification and surface treatment on the shear bonding strength of 3D printing resin and titanium surface. The results showed that surface treatment significantly improved the surface roughness and bonding strength. Among them, the 0.4% TiO2 nano-modification combined with rough titanium surface group had the highest bonding strength after thermal cycling.
本研究比较了不同表面处理和粘接系统对3D打印树脂基托的剪切强度和微渗漏影响，结果: This study compared the effects of different surface treatments and bonding systems on the shear strength and microleakage of 3D printed resin bases. The results showed that the adhesive application group had the highest shear strength, while surface treatment reduced the bonding strength but reduced microleakage.
本研究比较了不同表面处理对3D打印永久性树脂修复结合强度的影响，结果显示金刚石钻: This study compared the effects of different surface treatments on the bonding strength of 3D printed permanent resin repairs. The results showed that diamond drilling and grinding combined with adhesive treatment significantly improved the bonding strength of repairs, which was better than the untreated group, while there was no statistical difference in the effect of sandblasting.
本研究比较了不锈钢手动、塑料和超声波刮治法对五种3D打印树脂冠表面粗糙度的影响，: This study compared the effects of stainless steel manual, plastic and ultrasonic scaling on the surface roughness of five 3D printed resin crowns. The results showed that ultrasonic scaling significantly increased the surface roughness.
本研究比较了两种3D打印义齿基质材料与传统热聚合PMMA在转化率、维氏硬度、断裂: This study compared the differences in properties such as conversion rate, Vickers hardness, and fracture strength between two 3D printed denture matrix materials and traditional thermally polymerized PMMA. The results showed that there are significant differences in some properties.
本研究比较了两种3D打印树脂（Graphy TC-80DP和NextDent C: This study compared the mechanical properties of two 3D printing resins (Graphy TC-80DP and NextDent C&B MFH) and milled nanocomposite resin (Mazic Duro) in children's temporary repairs. The results show that NextDent is the best in terms of flexural strength, Mazic Duro is better in bending strength and modulus, and Graphy TC-80DP polymerizes faster and has better thermal stability.
本研究比较了两种3D打印系统制备的临时冠桥材料的抛光性能，结果显示两组在抛光后表: This study compared the polishing performance of temporary crown and bridge materials prepared by two 3D printing systems. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the surface roughness after polishing between the two groups.
本研究比较了两种制造技术制备的种植体支持临时固定部分义齿的边缘密合度，结果表明减: This study compared the marginal fit of temporary fixed partial dentures supported by implants prepared by two manufacturing technologies. The results showed that the marginal gap of subtractively manufactured dentures was significantly smaller than that of additively manufactured dentures.
