本研究比较了两种口扫仪在不同种植体角度及扫描体位下的数字印模准确性，发现种植体倾: This study compared the digital impression accuracy of two oral scanners at different implant angles and scanning positions. It was found that implant tilt and scanning position significantly affect the fidelity and accuracy of scanning. CS3600 is better than Trios3 in terms of fidelity, while Trios3 is better in accuracy.
本研究比较了两种增材制造 denture 基树脂与两种硬质椅旁重衬材料在热循环条: This study compared the shear bonding strength of two additive manufacturing denture-based resins and two rigid chairside relining materials under thermal cycling conditions. The results showed that the U material has higher bonding strength than the R material and is more resistant to debonding caused by thermal aging.
本研究比较了两种树脂（DentaGuide与DentaClear）及不同后处理方: This study compared the effects of two resins (DentaGuide and DentaClear) and different post-processing methods on the accuracy and precision of full-mouth implant surgery guides. The results showed that DentaClear resin was more accurate, while nitrogen-free post-processing significantly reduced accuracy.
本研究比较了五种临时修复材料在khat提取液与蒸馏水浸泡下颜色稳定性，发现kha: This study compared the color stability of five temporary repair materials when soaked in khat extract and distilled water. It was found that khat extract significantly affected the color of the materials. Among them, the color of temporary repair materials produced by CAD/CAM milling was the most stable, and the color change of 3D printing materials was the most obvious. The longer the soaking time, the more significant the color change.
本研究比较了五种口罩类型在意大利典型使用场景下的全生命周期环境影响，结果显示可重: This study compared the full life cycle environmental impact of five mask types in typical use scenarios in Italy. The results showed that reusable masks and masks with replaceable filters performed better in various environmental impact indicators.
本研究比较了传统、增材、减材及一体化CAD/CAM工艺下义齿牙基台粘接强度，结果: This study compared the bonding strength of denture abutments under traditional, additive, subtractive and integrated CAD/CAM processes. The results showed that the integrated milling process has the highest bonding strength and is resistant to heat aging, while the separate milling process has the lowest strength and is prone to degradation with thermal cycles.
本研究比较了传统、铣削和3D打印临时修复体的弯曲强度、表面硬度和表面粗糙度，结果: This study compared the bending strength, surface hardness and surface roughness of traditional, milled and 3D printed temporary restorations. The results showed that milled PMMA restorations performed well in terms of bending strength, surface hardness and surface roughness and were comparable to traditional methods.
本研究比较了传统、铣削和3D打印制作的临时冠桥在茶液暴露后颜色稳定性和表面粗糙度: This study compared the color stability and surface roughness of temporary crowns and bridges made by traditional, milling and 3D printing after exposure to tea liquid. The results show that the milling method is superior to other methods in color stability and surface smoothness, and surface sealing treatment can significantly improve color stability and surface roughness.
本研究比较了传统及数字化制作的义齿基托树脂在不同表面处理下的剪切结合强度，结果显: This study compared the shear bonding strength of traditional and digitally produced denture base resins under different surface treatments. The results showed that the bonding strength of 3D printing resin was significantly lower than traditional and CAD-CAM milling resin. The application of sand blast and monomer can significantly improve the bonding strength, among which sand blast has the best effect.
本研究比较了传统磨削与DLP打印锆瓷冠的边缘及内部差异，发现0度建模方向的DLP: This study compared the edge and internal differences between traditional grinding and DLP-printed zirconium ceramic crowns. It was found that the edge and internal differences of DLP-printed crowns in the 0-degree modeling direction were equivalent to those of traditional grinding crowns, while the 45-degree and 90-degree directions were less adaptable.
本研究比较了传统铸造与选择性激光熔融技术制造固定修复体的边缘密合度，结果显示钴铬: This study compared the edge adhesion of fixed restorations manufactured by traditional casting and selective laser melting technology. The results showed that the edge gap of cobalt-chromium alloy was the smallest, and the shoulder gap of nichrome alloy was the smallest. The edge adhesion of laser melting technology was better than that of traditional methods.
本研究比较了传统香烟与加热烟草对四种义齿材料表面粗糙度、细菌定植及颜色变化的影响: This study compared the effects of traditional cigarettes and heated tobacco on the surface roughness, bacterial colonization, and color changes of four denture materials. The results showed that both resulted in increased material surface roughness and bacterial accumulation, with traditional cigarettes causing more significant discoloration and heated tobacco causing higher bacterial accumulation.
本研究比较了使用Blue Sky Plan和Exoplan软件设计的立体打印手术: This study compared the accuracy, stability, and operation time of a three-dimensional printed surgical guide designed using Blue Sky Plan and Exoplan software with traditional techniques in root canal microsurgery. The results showed that the Exoplan guide was superior to Blue Sky Plan and traditional methods in terms of stability, accuracy, and efficiency.
本研究比较了使用热塑性与3D打印手术导板植入牙科种植体的准确性，结果显示3D打印: This study compared the accuracy of implanting dental implants using thermoplastic and 3D printed surgical guides. The results showed that the 3D printed guide was superior to the thermoplastic guide in terms of angular, three-dimensional and vertical deviations, and the implantation position was closer to the preoperative plan.
本研究比较了八种制造复杂儿科肿瘤解剖模型的策略，基于四种3D打印技术与间接或混合: This study compared eight strategies for manufacturing complex pediatric tumor anatomical models, based on four 3D printing technologies with indirect or hybrid methods, using nine materials, and evaluated the differences in application suitability, production time, mechanical properties and cost of each strategy. The results showed that material jetting has the best effect but is costly, and indirect printing is a more economically feasible option.
本研究比较了含植物活性成分的热压成型片与半固态挤出3D打印片，发现3D打印片孔隙: This study compared hot-pressed molded tablets containing plant active ingredients with semi-solid extruded 3D printed tablets. It was found that the 3D printed tablets have higher porosity and more uneven structure. Especially in the collagen-pectin system, weak interactions between polymers lead to enhanced pore formation and drug diffusion, and the overall release rate is increased by about 95%.
本研究比较了四种3D打印机制造的手术导板在整体表面、目标区域及孔径方向上的准确性: This study compared the accuracy of four surgical guides manufactured by 3D printers in the overall surface, target area, and aperture direction. The results showed that the DLP group had better overall accuracy, the SLA group performed best in the target area, the RS group's guide aperture was closest to the standard part, and the VC group had significant differences in the y-axis direction.
本研究比较了四种CAD/CAM材料的色泽稳定性和硬度，结果显示铣磨PMMA的色泽: This study compared the color stability and hardness of four CAD/CAM materials. The results show that the color stability of milled PMMA is better than that of 3D printing resin, and the hardness of tooth-colored material is higher than that of pink material, among which milled tooth-colored PMMA has the highest hardness.
本研究比较了四种不同制造方式的义齿基托材料的断裂韧性，结果显示NextDent打: This study compared the fracture toughness of four different manufacturing methods of denture base materials. The results showed that NextDent printing material had the highest fracture toughness, which was better than FormLabs light-cured materials. AvaDent and XANTECH prepolymer materials also performed better, but all materials did not meet the highest impact resistance requirements specified by ISO.
本研究比较了四种不同类型的义齿基托材料与四种不同类型的义齿衬里在未热循环和热循环: This study compared the tensile bonding strength of four different types of denture base materials and four different types of denture linings before and after thermal cycling. The results showed that thermal cycling has an impact on the bonding strength of silicone linings and bases, but has less effect on acrylic linings.
本研究比较了四种牙托树脂材料的表面粗糙度及念珠菌附着情况，发现3D打印树脂附着最: This study compared the surface roughness and Candida adhesion of four types of dental tray resin materials. It was found that 3D printing resin has the strongest adhesion and the highest surface roughness, while milling resin has the least adhesion and the smoothest surface. Different printing directions significantly affect microbial adhesion.
本研究比较了四种牙托树脂的表面粗糙度及白色念珠菌附着情况，发现3D打印树脂附着最: This study compared the surface roughness and Candida albicans adhesion of four types of dental tray resins. It was found that 3D printing resin had the strongest adhesion and the highest surface roughness, while milling resin had the least adhesion and the smoothest surface. This indicates that the manufacturing method and printing direction significantly affect bacterial adhesion. Milling and 0-degree direction 3D printing resin are more conducive to reducing Candida adhesion.
本研究比较了四种牙科咬合垫材料在人工唾液加速老化后的机械性能，结果显示SLA打印: This study compared the mechanical properties of four dental bite pad materials after accelerated aging of artificial saliva. The results showed that the mechanical properties of SLA printing resin HARZ Labs Dental Clear and NextDent Ortho Rigid decreased significantly, which was better than thermoformed PETG and milled PMMA.
本研究比较了在硬骨条件下三种引导方式的钻孔和开窗术精度，结果显示全引导 trep: This study compared the drilling and fenestration accuracy of three guided methods under hard bone conditions. The results showed that fully guided trephine had the highest accuracy, while partially guided trephine and drilling had greater deviations, and the difference was significant in the vertical direction.
本研究比较了增材和减材制造对临时固定修复体边缘及内部密合度的影响，结果表明增材制: This study compared the effects of additive and subtractive manufacturing on the marginal and internal fit of temporary fixed restorations. The results showed that the fit of additive manufacturing was better than that of subtractive manufacturing in crown restorations, while subtractive manufacturing performed better in bridge restorations, and the manufacturing method significantly affected the edge fit.
本研究比较了大型及滑动机制钛植入物与常规钛髋关节植入物患者血液钛水平，发现脊柱杆: This study compared the blood titanium levels in patients with large and sliding mechanism titanium implants and conventional titanium hip implants. It was found that the blood titanium levels in patients with spinal rods and giant acetabular implants were significantly higher than those with conventional titanium hip implants, but no adverse metal reactions were observed.
本研究比较了常规、减材和增材制造的义齿基质在刷洗和染色后的表面粗糙度与着色性，结: This study compared the surface roughness and colorability of conventional, subtractive and additively manufactured denture matrices after brushing and staining. The results showed that the surface of subtractively manufactured materials is the most stable, while additively manufactured materials are more prone to surface deterioration and staining.
本研究比较了常规、减法（CAD/CAM）和增材（3D打印）技术制备的固定临时修复: This study compared the edge gaps and fracture strengths of fixed temporary restorations prepared by conventional, subtractive (CAD/CAM) and additive (3D printing) technologies. The results showed that the subtractive technology had smaller edge gaps and the highest fracture strength, while the additive technology had the smallest edge gaps but the lowest fracture strength.
本研究比较了常规、铣削和3D打印工艺制备的义齿基托与人工牙之间的剪切结合强度，结: This study compared the shear bonding strength between denture bases and artificial teeth prepared by conventional, milling and 3D printing processes. The results showed that the combination of conventional bases and conventional artificial teeth had the highest bonding strength, while the combination of 3D printing bases and milled artificial teeth had the lowest bonding strength.
本研究比较了常规热压、高抗冲热压及3D打印义齿基托树脂的表面粗糙度（Ra），结果: This study compared the surface roughness (Ra) of conventional hot pressing, high-impact hot pressing and 3D printing denture base resin. The results showed that the surface roughness of 3D printing resin was significantly higher than the first two materials.
本研究比较了干式灭菌、环氧乙烷气体和过氧化氢等离子体对3D打印种植手术导板的机械: This study compared the effects of dry sterilization, ethylene oxide gas and hydrogen peroxide plasma on the mechanical, physical and dimensional properties of 3D printed implant surgery guides. The results showed that ethylene oxide sterilization significantly improved the bending strength and modulus without compromising the dimensional accuracy and implant positioning accuracy.
本研究比较了引导骨再生、骨移植、骨劈开及上颌窦提升等骨增量技术，分析其适应症与局: This study compared bone augmentation techniques such as guided bone regeneration, bone grafting, bone splitting, and maxillary sinus lifting, analyzed their indications and limitations, and pointed out that although new bone augmentation materials and 3D printing technology improve efficacy and reduce trauma, they are costly and have limited clinical application.
本研究比较了手工制作、CAD/CAM铣削和3D打印三种技术制备的3单位临时修复体: This study compared 3-unit temporary restorations prepared by hand-made, CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing technologies. It was found that the edge tightness and flexural strength of the milling and 3D printing groups were better than those of the manual group. Among them, the 3D printing group had the highest flexural strength and the edge tightness was similar to that of the milling group.
本研究比较了手工铸造与DMLS打印全口义齿的支托铸件可铸性，结果显示DMLS组在: This study compared the castability of the support castings of hand-cast and DMLS-printed complete dentures. The results showed that the structural accuracy of the support holes in the DMLS group was better than that of the manual group in the wax-up and casting stages.
本研究比较了拼接式与传统手术模板系统在下颌缺损重建中的稳定性，结果显示拼接系统在: This study compared the stability of spliced ​​and traditional surgical template systems in mandibular defect reconstruction. The results showed that the spliced ​​system was significantly better than the traditional system in terms of three-dimensional positioning deviation, especially the errors in the X, Y, and Z axes were smaller, improving the accuracy of bone segment positioning.
本研究比较了接受定制3D钛植入物与传统钛板或游离腓骨移植的口腔肿瘤患者，发现定制: This study compared oral tumor patients who received customized 3D titanium implants with traditional titanium plates or free fibula transplantation. It was found that customized titanium implants significantly improved surgical efficiency and accuracy. Patients were more satisfied with their facial appearance, had fewer postoperative complications, improved mandibular contour symmetry, good recovery of occlusal function, and no temporomandibular joint pain.
本研究比较了接受腰椎融合术的患者使用定制3D打印椎体植入物与通用椎体植入物的经济: This study compared the economics of using custom 3D printed vertebral implants with universal vertebral implants in patients undergoing lumbar fusion. The results showed that custom implants were superior to universal implants in terms of health-related quality of life and reoperation rates, and were cost-effective in the Australian healthcare setting.
本研究比较了数字叠加与微断层扫描两种方法在评估可摘局部义齿框架贴合度上的差异，结: This study compared the differences between digital superposition and microtomography in assessing the fit of the removable partial denture framework. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the gap thickness measured by the two and there was a positive correlation. The digital superposition method can be used as a feasible alternative to microtomography.
本研究比较了根模拟植入体（RAI）与传统螺纹植入体（TI）的微移动情况，发现RA: This study compared the micro-movement of Root Analog Implant (RAI) and traditional threaded implant (TI) and found that the overall micro-movement of the RAI group was significantly higher than that of the TI group, and the micro-movement of the 3D printed zirconia group was significantly higher than that of other RAI subgroups.
本研究比较了模拟技术和数字技术在完全可摘局部义齿制造中的准确性、生物相容性、美观: This study compared the accuracy, biocompatibility, esthetics, and clinical effects of analog and digital technologies in the manufacture of complete removable partial dentures, clearly indicating that digital technology is superior to traditional analog technology in these aspects.
本研究比较了消费者级与高端3D打印机在制作手术导板方面的精度，结果表明两者在精度: This study compared the accuracy of consumer-grade and high-end 3D printers in making surgical guides. The results showed that there is no significant difference in accuracy between the two, which is acceptable for clinical applications. Consumer-grade equipment maintains similar accuracy while reducing costs.
本研究比较了滴落沉积建模（DDM）、熔融丝制造（FFF）和注塑成型（IM）三种技: This study compared the effects of three technologies: drop deposition modeling (DDM), fused filament manufacturing (FFF) and injection molding (IM) on the release characteristics of hydrochlorothiazide oral formulations. It was found that the microstructure of tablets prepared by FFF and DDM at the same filling density was different, resulting in differences in release behavior. Reducing the filling density increased the porosity and accelerated the release rate. There were also significant differences in the release curves of DDM and IM tablets.
本研究比较了热压成型与3D打印牙托基树脂的机械强度，结果显示热压成型树脂的弯曲强: This study compared the mechanical strength of thermoformed and 3D printed dental tray base resins. The results showed that the flexural strength of thermoformed resin was significantly higher than that of 3D printed resin.
本研究比较了热聚合与3D打印义齿材料在橙汁浸泡下的表面粗糙度和硬度变化，结果显示: This study compared the surface roughness and hardness changes of thermal polymerization and 3D printed denture materials when soaked in orange juice. The results showed that commercial orange juice had the greatest impact on the surface roughness and hardness of the two materials.
本研究比较了牙支持与黏膜支持型3D打印手术导板在种植牙植入中的准确性，结果显示牙: This study compared the accuracy of tooth-supported and mucosa-supported 3D printed surgical guides in dental implant placement. The results showed that tooth-supported guides were better than mucosal-supported guides in terms of angle and implant point deviation.
本研究比较了电纺、浇铸和3D打印制备的阿立哌唑口崩片，结果显示电纺片在1.0秒内: This study compared aripiprazole orally disintegrating tablets prepared by electrospinning, casting, and 3D printing. The results showed that the electrospun tablets disintegrated within 1.0 seconds, which was better than other methods. However, the storage conditions were sensitive, causing partial recrystallization of aripiprazole and affecting the dissolution rate.
本研究比较了砂喷处理对3D打印基托与常规及铣磨人工牙之间剪切结合强度的影响，结果: This study compared the effect of sandblasting on the shear bonding strength between 3D printed bases and conventional and milled artificial teeth. The results showed that sandblasting significantly improved the bonding strength, and the bonding strength of milled teeth was better than that of conventional teeth. As the particle size of aluminum oxide increases, the bonding strength increases.
本研究比较了硬质椅旁重衬材料与3D打印义齿基托及传统热聚合义齿基托之间的剪切和拉: This study compared the shear and tensile bond strengths between rigid chairside relining materials and 3D printed denture bases and traditional thermally polymerized denture bases.
本研究比较了自固化PMMA、光固化UDMA树脂和SLA打印光聚合物在热与机械老化: This study compared the bending properties of self-curing PMMA, light-curing UDMA resin and SLA printing photopolymer under thermal and mechanical aging. The results show that thermal aging significantly reduces the bending strength of PMMA and SLA. Although UDMA is resistant to aging, its initial strength is much lower than other materials.
本研究比较了选择性激光熔融（SLM）和数字光处理（DLP）两种3D打印技术在制备: This study compared the accuracy and precision of two 3D printing technologies, selective laser melting (SLM) and digital light processing (DLP), in preparing maxillary removable partial denture frames. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the accuracy of the two methods, and the SLM technology was more precise.
本研究比较了通过半固态挤出3D打印与湿法造粒压片制备的番石榴和刺梨喷雾干燥提取物: This study compared spray-dried extracts of guava and roxburghii prepared by semi-solid extrusion 3D printing versus wet granulation tableting and found that the 3D-printed products had higher mechanical strength, longer disintegration times, and extract-dependent differences in dissolution behavior.
本研究比较了酒精喷雾、酒精浸泡、低温干灭菌及两种蒸汽灭菌法对3D打印手术导板尺寸: This study compared the effects of alcohol spray, alcohol immersion, low-temperature dry sterilization and two steam sterilization methods on the dimensional stability of 3D printed surgical guides. The results showed that 121°C steam sterilization and 54°C low-temperature dry sterilization can effectively maintain dimensional stability, among which 121°C steam sterilization has the best effect.
本研究比较了采用3D打印模压和选择性激光烧结（SLS）制成的可摘局部义齿框架的精: This study compared the accuracy of removable partial denture frames made by 3D printing molding and selective laser sintering (SLS). It was found that there were significant differences between the two methods in structural parts such as supports, mesial plates, connectors and clamping arms, and the deviations in different structural parts were different.
本研究比较了采用CAD设计的数字化义齿基托，通过3D打印、PMMA铣削和蜡铣后注: This study compared the fit of digital denture bases designed using CAD and manufactured by three methods: 3D printing, PMMA milling, and wax milling followed by injection molding and thermal polymerization. The results showed that the 3D printing method had the smallest overall gap, but the gaps at the midline of the palate were larger than those at the buccolingual side for all methods.
本研究比较了采用传统、减材和增材制造方法制成的咬合垫在弯曲强度上的差异，结果显示: This study compared the differences in flexural strength of bite pads made using traditional, subtractive and additive manufacturing methods, and the results showed that the flexural strength of traditional and subtractive manufacturing methods was significantly higher than that of additive manufacturing methods.
本研究比较了采用立体光刻（SLA）和数字光处理（DLP）技术打印的种植体扫描体与: This study compared the accuracy of implant scans printed using stereolithography (SLA) and digital light processing (DLP) technologies with the manufacturer's original scans. The results showed that the angle and linear deviation of the SLA group were significantly higher than those of the DLP group and the control group. The accuracy of the DLP prints was better than that of SLA and lower than the original scans.
本研究比较了重新衬装后CAD-CAM铸造全口义齿树脂与传统热聚合PMMA树脂的剪: This study compared the shear bonding strength of CAD-CAM cast complete denture resin and traditional thermal polymerization PMMA resin after relining. The results showed that the 3D printing resin group was significantly lower than the milling and traditional thermal polymerization groups, and there was no difference between the three.
本研究比较了金属与聚合物3D打印手术导板在犬颅骨模型中引导下颌段切除的性能，发现: This study compared the performance of metal and polymer 3D printed surgical guides in guiding mandibular segment resection in a canine skull model. It was found that the polymer guide was easier to place quickly. Although there were cracks, there was no significant difference in surgical accuracy, while the metal guide had more obvious placement difficulties and bone gaps.
本研究比较了铣削、PolyJet、激光烧结、光固化和注塑等CAD/CAM技术及传: This study compared the dimensional accuracy of complete denture bases produced by CAD/CAM technologies such as milling, PolyJet, laser sintering, light-curing, and injection molding, and traditional methods. It was found that milling technology performed best overall, and removal of specific connectors had a significant impact on DLP technology. Each technology reached clinically acceptable levels.
本研究比较了铣削、SLA和DLP三维打印及传统方法制作的上颌完全义齿，结果显示铣: This study compared maxillary complete dentures made by milling, SLA and DLP three-dimensional printing and traditional methods. The results showed that milling dentures had the highest fitting accuracy, and SLA printing at a support angle of 45° was as accurate as or slightly better than traditional dentures.
本研究比较了铣削与3D打印PMMA材料制成的单冠、前牙桥及支托桥的边缘密合度，结: This study compared the edge fit of single crowns, anterior bridges and braced bridges made of milled and 3D printed PMMA materials. The results showed that the edge fit of milled restorations was better than that of 3D printed restorations, especially in the distal surface of the midline design of the anterior bridge. The difference was significant.
本研究比较了铣削与3D打印制备的外科引导器在重叠精度和准确性上的表现，结果显示两: This study compared the overlay precision and accuracy of surgical guides prepared by milling and 3D printing. The results showed that there was no significant difference in accuracy and precision between the two, but there was a significant difference in the standard deviation of the matching deviation from the benchmark model.
本研究比较了骨水泥对3D打印多孔与非多孔植入物表面的粘附强度，发现多孔表面粘附力: This study compared the adhesion strength of bone cement to the surfaces of 3D printed porous and non-porous implants and found that the adhesion of porous surfaces was significantly higher than that of non-porous surfaces. The adhesion strength of porous surfaces with a specific combination of pore size and layer depth reached 26.3 MPa, which was more than twice that of non-porous surfaces.
本研究比较四种陶瓷材料冠桥的抗折强度，结果显示氧化锆增强锂硅陶瓷抗折强度最高（1: This study compares the flexural strength of crowns and bridges of four ceramic materials. The results show that zirconia-reinforced lithium silicon ceramic has the highest flexural strength (1473.1), while EMAX CAD has the lowest (1013.7). The material type affects the flexural performance, but the preparation method has no significant difference.
本研究确定了用于制造Zr-Ti-Nb合金牙科植入物空白件的电子束成形工艺参数，获: This study determined the electron beam forming process parameters for manufacturing Zr-Ti-Nb alloy dental implant blanks, and obtained a sample with smooth surface, uniform structure, and no internal defects. Its elastic modulus is 59.8 GPa, which is lower than titanium alloy (113.8 GPa) and close to the elastic modulus of human bone. This process can be used as a feasible alternative technology for the manufacturing of low-modulus zirconium alloy implants.
本研究筛选了27篇关于3D打印技术在牙科修复体制造中的文献，涵盖SLA、SLM、: This study screened 27 documents on the use of 3D printing technology in the manufacturing of dental restorations, covering processes such as SLA, SLM, FDM and inkjet, which are used to produce surgical guides, implants, models, removable dentures, etc. The results show that the restorations prepared by this technology are clinically acceptable and can replace traditional methods.
本研究系统分析了单牙种植体、种植体支持桥及种植体保留义齿的设计流程、咬合与应力分: This study systematically analyzes the design process, occlusion and stress distribution of single-tooth implants, implant-supported bridges and implant-retained dentures, and discusses the current status and future development direction of additive manufacturing technology in the application of implant materials.
本研究系统评估了温度（20–40°C）和湿度（20–80%）对半固态挤出3D打印: This study systematically evaluates the effects of temperature (20–40°C) and humidity (20–80%) on the drying process of semi-solid extrusion 3D printed tablets, and finds that 38°C and 40% relative humidity are the optimal conditions. Under these conditions, tablets dry stably, have good dissolution, and the drying process can achieve point-to-point manufacturing.
本研究纳入27名患者，对比使用牙托黏合剂与不使用黏合剂时，数字化制作的全口可摘义: This study included 27 patients and compared the changes in occlusal balance time (OT), debiting time (DT) and oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL) of digitally produced complete removable dentures using tray adhesive and without using adhesive. The results showed that adhesives significantly shortened occlusion and debiting time and improved patients' quality of life.
本研究纳入82名患者，共植入110枚3D打印钛种植体，用于单牙缺失修复。3年随访: This study included 82 patients, and a total of 110 3D printed titanium implants were implanted to repair single missing teeth. Three-year follow-up showed that the implant survival rate was 94.5%, the implant-crown success rate was 94.3%, and the bone-implant contact distance changed stably at different time points.
本研究结合3D打印与机械加工制备两阶段钛合金牙种植体，结果显示其机械性能优良、细: This study combined 3D printing and mechanical processing to prepare a two-stage titanium alloy dental implant. The results show that it has excellent mechanical properties, low cytotoxicity, and an osseointegration effect comparable to commercial SLA surface implants.
本研究综述了3D打印和生物3D打印在肾移植及再生医学中的应用，包括用于外科培训、: This study reviews the application of 3D printing and bio-3D printing in kidney transplantation and regenerative medicine, including its use in surgical training, patient education, preoperative planning and the production of customized tools, showing that it can improve operation time and blood loss; bio-3D printing has made progress in the construction of functional models of proximal tubules, glomeruli and interstitial tissues and the construction of renal organoids, which can be used for disease modeling and drug development.
本研究综述了3D打印完全义齿的临床表现，分析了其在物理性能、生物相容性及工艺优势: This study reviews the clinical performance of 3D printed complete dentures, analyzes its progress in physical properties, biocompatibility and process advantages, and points out that issues such as color stability, occlusal surface wear resistance, relining adaptability and surface roughness still need to be further improved.
本研究综述了丝素羟凝胶在细胞与药物递送中的应用，系统阐述其结构特性、生物相容性及: This study reviews the application of silk fibroin hydroxygel in cell and drug delivery, systematically explains its structural characteristics, biocompatibility and degradation behavior, analyzes current technological progress and common misunderstandings, and points out the potential of emerging directions such as 3D printing.
本研究综述了医院中3D打印解剖模型的应用现状，系统梳理了FDA对用于生产此类模型: This study reviews the current application status of 3D printed anatomical models in hospitals, systematically sorts out the FDA regulatory process for software used to produce such models, lists for the first time verified software platforms and their matching 3D printers, and discusses model accuracy verification methods, standards and potential errors, emphasizing the need to establish clear software and product standards to ensure safety and accuracy.
本研究综述了基于热响应聚合物的生物工程支架在伤口愈合中的应用，通过3D打印和电纺: This study reviews the application of bioengineered scaffolds based on thermoresponsive polymers in wound healing. Their physical and chemical properties are controlled through 3D printing and electrospinning technology to achieve spatial and temporal controllable release of drugs to regulate inflammatory responses, promote tissue regeneration and prevent infection.
本研究综述了基于纸张的电化学分析器件（ePADs）在点-of-care检测中的应: This study reviews the application of paper-based electrochemical analysis devices (ePADs) in point-of-care detection, focusing on its ability to achieve accurate detection of a variety of biochemical substances through electrochemical sensing technology, highlighting its advantages of self-supply liquid transmission, low cost, environmental protection, and its feasibility in actual scenarios.
本研究综述了用于药物控释和组织再生的杂化水凝胶，重点分析其类型、改性策略及纳米微: This study reviews hybrid hydrogels for controlled drug release and tissue regeneration, focusing on analyzing their types, modification strategies and nano-microstructure integration, and exploring preparation methods such as click reactions, 3D printing and photopatterning, highlighting their application potential in soft and hard tissue regeneration.
本研究综述了用于药物递送的多糖3D打印进展，重点聚焦于纤维素及其衍生物、壳聚糖和: This study reviews the progress of polysaccharide 3D printing for drug delivery, focusing on cellulose and its derivatives, chitosan and sodium alginate, to achieve personalized drug delivery through fused deposition and extrusion printing technology.
本研究综述了硅氧烷及其衍生物在医疗和制药领域的应用，涵盖引流管、导管、植入物、医: This study reviews the applications of silicones and their derivatives in the medical and pharmaceutical fields, covering drainage tubes, catheters, implants, medical device coatings, cosmetic implants and drug delivery systems, focusing on their biocompatibility, stability and antimicrobial protection mechanisms, and analyzing their toxicity and environmental impact.
本研究综述了羟基凝胶作为多功能药物递送系统的特性，重点阐述其在细胞与药物递送、组: This study reviews the characteristics of hydroxygel as a multifunctional drug delivery system, focusing on its applications in biomedical fields such as cell and drug delivery, tissue repair, targeted release, and stem cell microencapsulation. It covers preparation methods such as 3D printing and conjugation modification, as well as existing products and regulatory guidance on the market.
本研究综述了骨科植入物表面抗菌修饰的进展，聚焦于感染相关因素及表面抗感染改性方法: This study reviews the progress of antibacterial modification of the surface of orthopedic implants, focusing on infection-related factors and surface anti-infection modification methods. It clearly points out that the current main technologies include antibacterial coatings, antibiotic coatings, inorganic antibacterial coatings, etc., which can effectively inhibit bacterial adhesion and biofilm formation, but their mechanism of action is still controversial.
本研究考察了三种人骨密度与四种增材制造钛合金表面纹理在不同载荷下骨-植入物界面摩: This study examined the changes in friction coefficient at the bone-implant interface under different loads with three types of human bone density and four types of additively manufactured titanium alloy surface textures. The results show that the friction coefficient is significantly affected by surface roughness, bone density and load, and the friction is more unstable when low-density bone is combined with sharp surface textures.
本研究考察了兽用加巴喷丁可咀嚼片3D打印中胶原基墨水的重复使用可行性，发现低浓度: This study examined the reusability of collagen-based inks in 3D printing of veterinary gabapentin chewable tablets and found that low-concentration formulations maintained printability and dosing accuracy after 14 days of refrigeration, while high-concentration formulations exhibited crystallization, indicating differences in stability.
本研究考察了聚乙烯醇或丙烯吡咯烷酮不同化学特性对3D打印固体制剂性能的影响，发现: This study examined the impact of different chemical properties of polyvinyl alcohol or propylene pyrrolidone on the performance of 3D printed solid formulations. It was found that the viscosity, degree of hydrolysis and molecular weight of the polymer significantly affect the drug release rate and supersaturation. Different polymer types can adjust the release behavior and determine appropriate printing parameters and final formulation properties.
本研究聚焦于制药3D打印中FDM、SLS和粉末床打印技术，系统梳理了关键工艺参数: This study focuses on FDM, SLS and powder bed printing technologies in pharmaceutical 3D printing. It systematically sorts out the impact of key process parameters and material properties on the critical quality attributes of drugs. It emphasizes the need to explore these factors in depth to ensure the in vivo and in vitro performance of preparations. It proposes a fishbone diagram of three mainstream technologies to clarify the key impact paths.
本研究设计了一款轻便的3D打印义手，通过 前臂 肌肉的EMG信号控制掌心开合，利: This study designed a lightweight 3D printed prosthetic hand that uses EMG signals from the forearm muscles to control the opening and closing of the palm. It uses six sets of motors to drive fingertip and wrist movements respectively, and is equipped with force sensors to provide feedback to achieve basic functions such as grabbing and releasing, replacing traditional expensive commercial prostheses.
本研究设计了一种低成本临时用于经股骨假肢静态对齐的装置，通过SolidWorks: This study designed a low-cost temporary device for static alignment of transfemoral prostheses. Through SolidWorks modeling and Ansys finite element analysis, it was found that carbon fiber materials performed best and had feasible manufacturing potential.
本研究评估了27种Formlabs树脂在不同管电流下的CT衰减特性，发现其衰减值: This study evaluated the CT attenuation characteristics of 27 Formlabs resins under different tube currents and found that they have a wide range of attenuation values (-3.33 to 2666.27 HU), can simulate a variety of human tissues, and have stable attenuation values, providing reliable data for the construction of more accurate tissue simulation medical phantoms.
本研究评估了3D打印PLGA患者特异性骨板的力学与结构特性，结果显示其Young: This study evaluated the mechanical and structural properties of 3D printed PLGA patient-specific bone plates. The results showed that its Young's modulus was higher than that of standard absorbable plates. After sterilization by hydrogen peroxide plasma, the modulus decreased by 36% (p=0., etc.), and slight deformation occurred, but the printing accuracy reached 0.1mm, indicating that PLGA bone plates have application potential in craniofacial surgery.
本研究评估了3D打印不同解剖模型的总成本及其在实践中的成本效益，结果显示打印成本: This study evaluates the total cost of 3D printing different anatomical models and its cost-effectiveness in practice. The results show that the printing cost mainly depends on personnel time, and the technology is cost-effective in producing anatomical models.
本研究评估了3D打印硅胶支架在模拟阴道液中对甲硝唑的持续释放性能，发现支架的压缩: This study evaluated the sustained release performance of 3D printed silicone stent for metronidazole in simulated vaginal fluid. It was found that the compressive strength and drug release kinetics of the stent can be adjusted through the printing process parameters. The release process is consistent with the Higuchi, Korsmeyer-Peppas and Peppas-Sahlin models, indicating the feasibility of sustained release of metronidazole within 14 days.
本研究评估了50个用于美学牙冠延长术的手术导板在134°C下经4分钟高压灭菌后尺: This study evaluated the dimensional stability of 50 surgical guides used for esthetic crown lengthening after autoclaving at 134°C for 4 minutes. The results showed that all groups except the VC group showed significant dimensional changes after sterilization, with the SR group showing the worst performance before and after sterilization.
本研究评估了HTPLA、PLA和尼龙聚合物在常规高温灭菌下的几何稳定性，结果显示: This study evaluated the geometric stability of HTPLA, PLA, and nylon polymers under conventional high-temperature sterilization. The results showed that PLA had no significant deformation, HTPLA could withstand repeated thermal cycles due to its crystalline properties, and nylon performed poorly due to hygroscopicity, indicating that PLA and HTPLA can be safely used in surgical cutting guides.
本研究评估了Z-Corp-Z510 3D打印并浸渍Sil-25硅胶的软组织面部假: This study evaluates the mechanical and optical properties of Z-Corp-Z510 3D printed soft tissue facial prosthesis impregnated with Sil-25 silica gel. The tensile strength, tear strength, hardness and elongation are tested through ASTM standards. The interaction between starch particles and silica gel is observed with SEM, and a color reproduction evaluation method is proposed.
本研究评估了不同后固化时间对3D打印牙冠桥材料力学性能和颜色变化的影响，结果表明: This study evaluates the effects of different post-curing times on the mechanical properties and color changes of 3D printed crown and bridge materials. The results show that post-curing for 60-90 minutes can significantly improve the flexural strength, hardness and conversion rate of the material, and the color change reaches ΔE00≥2.25 in some groups, which is clinically identifiable. Curing after at least 60 minutes can improve the overall clinical performance of the material.
本研究评估了不同灭菌方法对3D打印手术导板精度的影响，结果表明各灭菌方式对导板准: This study evaluated the impact of different sterilization methods on the accuracy of 3D printed surgical guides. The results showed that no clear difference was observed in the accuracy of the guides between each sterilization method.
本研究评估了不同类型的口罩和面纱的过滤效率，发现密封型外科口罩过滤效率最高，未密: This study evaluated the filtration efficiency of different types of masks and veils and found that sealed surgical masks had the highest filtration efficiency, while unsealed surgical masks, cotton masks, and veils had similar filtration efficiencies, and wearing a surgical mask inside a veil could significantly improve the overall filtration effect.
本研究评估了不同老化周期下3D打印义齿基托在不同后固化时间下的尺寸稳定性，结果表: This study evaluated the dimensional stability of 3D printed denture bases at different post-curing times under different aging cycles. The results showed that the longer the post-curing time, the smaller the dimensional changes, and mandibular dentures are more prone to dimensional deviations than maxillary dentures.
本研究评估了不锈钢托槽及锥形束CT扫描协议对牙槽骨高度和宽度测量的影响，结果显示: This study evaluated the impact of stainless steel brackets and cone-beam CT scanning protocols on alveolar bone height and width measurements. The results showed that regardless of the presence of brackets or different pixel sizes, the differences in measurement values were not significant and did not affect the planning of implants in the bracket area.
本研究评估了使用桌面3D打印黏膜支持导板进行无牙颌种植手术的准确性，结果显示导板: This study evaluates the accuracy of using a desktop 3D printed mucosal support guide for edentulous jaw implant surgery. The results show that the position deviation of the guide is small when the mucosa is used as a reference, but the elasticity of the mucosa will reduce the stability of the guide and increase implant deflection.
本研究评估了使用生物相容性甲基丙烯酸酯树脂3D打印的钻导板经灭菌后的尺寸变化，结: This study evaluated the dimensional changes of drill guide plates 3D printed using biocompatible methacrylate resin after sterilization. The results showed that the dimensional changes of all materials after sterilization did not exceed 0.05mm. Amber and black resins were least affected by the sterilization method and can be preferred.
本研究评估了全口种植钛框架在完全数字化工作流程下的贴合精度，发现多数框架贴合不佳: This study evaluated the fitting accuracy of titanium frames for full-mouth implants under a fully digital workflow and found that most frames fit poorly and had significant scanning and processing errors, indicating obvious limitations of this process.
本研究评估了医院现有蒸汽灭菌方法对3D打印患者专用手术导板机械性能、尺寸精度及灭: This study evaluates the impact of existing steam sterilization methods in hospitals on the mechanical properties, dimensional accuracy and sterilization effect of 3D printed patient-specific surgical guides. The results show that after sterilization, the material strength and stiffness are improved but the brittleness is increased. The maximum size change is 0.12 mm, and the overall size deviation is less than 0.3 mm. Sterilization is a necessary condition for the clinical use of the guides.
本研究评估了用于部分缺牙患者计算机引导种植的立体光刻手术模板的准确性，通过三维叠: This study evaluated the accuracy of a stereolithography surgical template for computer-guided implantation in partially edentulous patients. Preoperative digital files were compared with postoperative digital impressions through a three-dimensional overlay protocol. The results showed significant differences between the mandible and the maxilla, confirming the high accuracy of the template.
本研究评估了蒸汽灭菌对3D打印生物相容树脂材料尺寸精度的影响，发现所有组别均出现: This study evaluated the effect of steam sterilization on the dimensional accuracy of 3D printed biocompatible resin materials. It was found that linear expansion occurred in all groups, with the outer size increasing and the inner size decreasing. There was no statistical difference except for PolyJet Glossy. The overall RMS value was lower than 100 and 20 and 200 microns. The proprietary material had the highest accuracy before and after sterilization, and the third-party material had equivalent accuracy and was economical.
本研究评估了金属3D打印牙冠基台的精度，结果显示“交叉填充”与“90度定向”组合: This study evaluates the accuracy of metal 3D printed crown abutments. The results show that the combination of "cross-filling" and "90-degree orientation" has the best accuracy. However, when the orientation angle is less than 45 degrees, the inner surface of the abutment is rough, which affects the fit of the crown.
本研究调查了儿童对四种3D打印药片（Printlets™）的视觉偏好，结果显示D: This study investigated children's visual preferences for four types of 3D printed pills (Printlets™). The results showed that DLP printed pills are the most attractive to children. However, after being told that they can be chewed, most children chose chewable SSE printed pills instead. Appearance, taste, texture and familiarity were regarded as equally important evaluation dimensions by children.
本研究调查了新加坡坦托克森医院55名医生和药师对3D打印口服制剂的认知与态度，结: This study surveyed 55 doctors and pharmacists at Tantok Sen Hospital in Singapore on their knowledge and attitudes towards 3D printed oral preparations. The results showed that most of the respondents recognized its potential advantages, and more than 60% were willing to prescribe 3D printed tablets to patients. The main concerns were centered on preparation design, manufacturing process and administrative management.
本研究通过 同轴 3D 生物打印技术，将经微流控制备的含百里香油脂质体与含自由百: This study uses coaxial 3D bioprinting technology to combine thyme oil-containing liposomes prepared by microfluidics with composite hydrogels containing free thyme oil to prepare a diabetic foot ulcer dressing with dual drug release characteristics, achieving initial rapid release and long-term sustained release, and verifying its antibacterial activity against Gram-positive and negative bacteria.
本研究通过3D打印不同内部几何结构（圆柱、角形、倒角形）的聚乙烯醇片剂，实现药物: This study achieved controllable adjustment of drug release curves by 3D printing polyvinyl alcohol tablets with different internal geometric structures (cylindrical, angular, chamfered), and successfully obtained three release curves: constant, increasing and decreasing, with no residue after dissolution, providing a feasible solution for personalized drug preparations.
本研究通过3D打印制备了载药（庆大霉素、甲氨蝶呤）的患者特异性骨固定植入物，结果: In this study, patient-specific bone fixation implants loaded with drugs (gentamicin, methotrexate) were prepared through 3D printing. The results showed that the mechanical properties of the drug-loaded implants were significantly lower than the blank PLA structure, but they had antibacterial and anti-tumor effects.
本研究通过3D打印头骨模型模拟临床放疗，比较不同钛板几何形状对散射辐射剂量分布及: This study simulated clinical radiotherapy by 3D printing skull models, and compared the effects of different titanium plate geometries on scattered radiation dose distribution and proliferation of human mesenchymal stem cells and endothelial cells. It was found that plate diameter and geometric design affect dose distribution and are associated with differences in cell proliferation, suggesting that optimizing titanium plate design can reduce local radiation interference.
本研究通过3D打印技术制备个性化儿童氯硝西泮片，优化乳状胶体制剂组成，使片剂在质: In this study, personalized children's clonazepam tablets were prepared through 3D printing technology, and the composition of the emulsion colloid preparation was optimized to ensure that the quality attributes of the tablets met pharmacopoeia standards and showed better permeability than commercially available products in in vitro digestion and permeation experiments.
本研究通过3D打印技术，利用滴落沉积建模制备了填充密度从60%到100%的个性化: This study used 3D printing technology and drop deposition modeling to prepare personalized vaginal rings with filling densities ranging from 60% to 100%. The results showed that the higher the filling density, the greater the weight, modulus, hardness and compressive strength of the vaginal ring, the lower the porosity, and the smaller the drug release percentage, and all products showed controlled drug release characteristics.

本研究针对3D打印定制骨假体和支架，采用质量源于设计（QbD）方法，通过识别关键: This study uses the quality-by-design (QbD) method for 3D printing customized bone prostheses and scaffolds. By identifying key quality attributes and sorting out the design and manufacturing processes, a full-process map including risk classification is constructed, and its effectiveness is evaluated through expert research to ensure that customized manufacturing and standardized manufacturing are comparable in quality.

Space is set up in the inner cavity of the removable denture and orthodontic microscrews are used to fix the radiographic image and surgical guide plate to stabilize the guide plate, improve implant positioning accuracy and reduce the risk of mental nerve injury.

It is suitable for areas with limited resources.

At the same time, an overload protection mechanism is introduced to deal with the problem of insufficient support stiffness under a wide range of movements.
本研究针对发展中国家缺乏专业 prosthetic 工作坊的问题，提出一种基于3: This study addresses the lack of professional prosthetic workshops in developing countries and proposes a fully assembled active prosthetic design based on 3D printing. By integrating deposition modeling technology, no post-assembly is required. The resulting prosthetic limb can complete a variety of grasping movements, and its starting force, energy consumption and quality are significantly lower than body-moving commercial prosthetic limbs, providing a feasible alternative for amputees in developing countries.
