现有研究总结了通过表面微纳米结构、超疏/亲水性设计及活性释放涂层预防细菌附着，或: Existing studies have summarized strategies to prevent bacterial adhesion through surface micro-nano structures, superphobic/hydrophilic design, and active release coatings, or to use contact killing and degradation of extracellular matrix to inhibit biofilm formation. They have compared the mechanisms and limitations of organic and inorganic antibacterial agents, and pointed out that intelligent adaptive antibacterial implants have potential in lasting bacteriostasis and promoting osseointegration.
现有研究显示，3D打印、虚拟手术规划、CAD/CAM及组织工程等技术正推动口腔颌: Existing research shows that technologies such as 3D printing, virtual surgical planning, CAD/CAM and tissue engineering are promoting the development of oral and maxillofacial reconstruction in a precise, safe and efficient direction, significantly improving treatment effects and aesthetic results. However, their widespread application still faces challenges of high cost and training requirements.
现有研究显示，3D打印与传统制作的牙科修复体在患者满意度上无显著差异，证据确定性: Existing research shows that there is no significant difference in patient satisfaction between 3D printed and traditionally produced dental restorations, and the certainty of the evidence is low. Clinical selection should consider the type of restoration, suitability and patient preference.
现有研究显示，3D打印临时固定义齿在零度建模方向下边际和内部贴合优于非零度方向，: Existing research shows that the marginal and internal fit of 3D printed temporary fixed dentures in the zero-degree modeling direction is better than that in the non-zero-degree direction. Although the differences at other angles are within the clinically acceptable range, the conclusions need to be viewed with caution due to the high heterogeneity of the research.
现有研究显示，3D打印修复体在不同应用中表现各异：柔性支托具高抗冲击性，刚性支托: Existing research shows that 3D printed restorations perform differently in different applications: flexible supports have high impact resistance, and rigid supports have the same wear resistance as ground parts; printed crowns have lower strength than ground parts but are tougher, and wear is still questionable; printed denture bases are as strong as traditional materials, and teeth have good wear resistance; choosing appropriate resins and printing parameters, and following clinical protocols can improve the accuracy and performance of restorations.
现有研究显示，3D打印假体和专用设备已被用于泌尿系统器官的教育与疾病管理，帮助医: Existing research shows that 3D printed prostheses and special equipment have been used in the education and disease management of urinary system organs, helping medical students and doctors intuitively grasp the anatomical characteristics of organs, assisting in preoperative planning, and playing an important role in the diagnosis and treatment of kidneys, bladders, prostates and other organs.
现有研究显示，3D打印全口义齿在技术层面已较成熟，但其临床应用效果仍处于发展期，: Existing research shows that 3D printed complete dentures are relatively mature at the technical level, but their clinical application effects are still in the development stage, and relevant quality data are both clear and unclear.
现有研究显示，3D打印在上肢假肢、socket设计及末端附件方面具备成本低、个性: Existing research shows that 3D printing has the advantages of low cost and strong personalization in terms of upper limb prostheses, socket design and end accessories, especially in areas with limited resources. However, due to insufficient material performance, supervision and clinical evidence, there is still a lack of non-inferiority verification compared with traditional prostheses. Rigorous clinical trials need to be carried out in the future to promote its clinical application.
现有研究显示，3D打印在个性化药物生产中具有潜力，但受限于监管指导不一、药典标准: Existing research shows that 3D printing has potential in personalized drug production, but is limited by inconsistent regulatory guidance, lack of pharmacopoeia standards, and insufficient quality assurance strategies. Key attributes need to be systematically controlled through quality design and process analysis technology to ensure drug quality and safety.
现有研究显示，3D打印多孔钛笼融合率高于聚醚醚酮，且 subsidence 和再: Existing research shows that the fusion rate of 3D printed porous titanium cages is higher than that of polyetheretherketone, and the subsidence and re-intervention rates are lower, but the difference in clinical efficacy is small; expandable cages have advantages in restoring intervertebral space height, but have not been proven to be better than static cages; materials, geometric structures and surface properties significantly affect cage performance. New technologies such as additive manufacturing and bioactive surfaces have good prospects, but long-term studies are needed to clarify their clinical value.
现有研究显示，3D打印完全义齿在临床和患者体验方面表现良好，其固位与舒适度不逊于: Existing research shows that 3D printed complete dentures perform well in terms of clinical and patient experience. Their retention and comfort are no less than those of traditional dentures, especially when using conventional impressions and digital castings, which are better than digital scanning solutions. However, the results in terms of chewing efficiency, aesthetics and pronunciation are mixed, and more high-quality studies are needed for further verification.
现有研究显示，3D打印微针贴片通过精准定制针阵结构，实现无痛、自给式皮肤递送疫苗: Existing research shows that 3D printed microneedle patches achieve painless, self-sufficient skin delivery of vaccines by precisely customizing the needle array structure, improve antigen exposure and immune response, and have the advantages of rapid iteration and scalability, significantly enhancing the accessibility of vaccines in resource-constrained areas.
现有研究显示，3D打印微针通过纳米/微制造技术实现定制化、低成本、快速迭代的设计: Existing research shows that 3D printed microneedles use nano/micro manufacturing technology to achieve customized, low-cost, rapid iteration design, improve the performance of drug controlled release, body fluid collection, biological signal acquisition and diagnostic equipment, and its applications cover a variety of biomedical equipment in personalized medicine.
现有研究显示，3D打印患者特异性器械在全膝关节置换术中可提升截骨精度和机械轴对齐: Existing research shows that 3D printing patient-specific instruments can improve osteotomy accuracy and mechanical axis alignment in total knee replacement surgery, which has cost and time advantages, but the results of different studies are controversial.
现有研究显示，3D打印患者特异性钛植入物在腰椎间融合术中，相较于传统技术，能改善: Existing research shows that 3D printed patient-specific titanium implants can improve patient pain scores during lumbar interbody fusion compared with traditional technology, suggesting that it has clinical advantages in spinal fusion.
Existing research shows that 3D printed surgical guides exhibit high accuracy in dental implants, with linear and angular deviations of 0.2–1 mm and 1–3° respectively. The accuracy is comparable to dynamic navigation, and the robotic system is better. The stability of the guide plate, printing technology and imaging protocol significantly affect the results.
现有研究显示，3D打印手术导板通过实现患者特异性切削，改善了膝关节置换、椎体螺钉: Existing research shows that 3D printed surgical guides improve the problem of implant position deviation in surgeries such as knee replacement, vertebral screw placement, and mandibular reconstruction by achieving patient-specific cutting, and effectively reduce defects such as difficulty in intraoperative fixation. However, there are both technical progress and limitations.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术中，半固态挤出法常用于热敏药物制备，而数字光处理、粘结: Existing research shows that in 3D printing technology, semi-solid extrusion methods are often used for the preparation of heat-sensitive drugs, while non-heating technologies such as digital light processing, bonded inkjet and stereolithography are feasible but have the risk of light degradation. Fusion deposition modeling combined with filling technology can effectively avoid thermal degradation. Low melting point polymer selection and parameter optimization and the combined use of multiple technologies are key strategies.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术可克服传统微流控制造在三维结构构建、设计变更成本及量产: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology can overcome the limitations of traditional microfluidic manufacturing in terms of three-dimensional structure construction, design change costs, and mass production conversion. Although it is still in its early stages, stereolithography has the most potential. In the future, with the optimization of hardware and materials, 3D printing is expected to become a mainstream microfluidic manufacturing method.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术因分辨率高、操作简便，已被广泛用于制备微型化和微流控系: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology has been widely used to prepare miniaturized and microfluidic systems due to its high resolution and easy operation. It is suitable for biotechnology applications such as cell culture, separation and biosensors, reducing device size and sample requirements.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术在医疗设备领域实现个性化定制，广泛应用于假肢、矫形器、: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology enables personalized customization in the field of medical equipment and is widely used in prostheses, orthotics, surgical guides, and absorbable implants to improve preoperative planning and drug delivery. However, it faces challenges such as material selection, process verification, sterilization, and scale, and the regulatory system needs to be updated accordingly to ensure safety and effectiveness.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术在完全可摘局部义齿中主要用于定制托架、记录基托、临时或: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology is mainly used for customized brackets, recording bases, and temporary or immediate dentures in completely removable partial dentures. It is not yet suitable for final denture production. It is limited by issues such as aesthetics, retention, occlusal balance, and printing resolution. Clinical application still requires more research support.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术在康复中心用于制造上肢（56.25%）和下肢（31.2: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology is used in rehabilitation centers to manufacture upper limb (56.25%) and lower limb (31.25%) orthotics and prostheses, most of which involve people with disabilities. The products cover wrists, hands, fingers, writing instruments, knees and feet, etc. Although the performance is good, there are limitations such as insufficient strength, stiffness and durability.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术在微流控芯片制造中具备成本低、设计灵活等优势，已可应用: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology has the advantages of low cost and flexible design in microfluidic chip manufacturing, and can be applied in various research laboratories to realize droplet microfluidic printing, although there are still technical challenges.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术在药物递送中展现出个性化制剂与精准释放的潜力，但受限于: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology shows the potential for personalized formulation and precise release in drug delivery. However, due to the lack of regulatory guidelines, insufficient quality stability, and equipment that does not meet good manufacturing practices, its standardization and clinical application still face challenges.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术在骨科领域广泛应用，用于制造患者特异性骨刀具、植入物及: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology is widely used in the field of orthopedics to manufacture patient-specific bone cutters, implants and dental implants. Among them, biodegradable metals such as magnesium, calcium, zinc, iron, etc. have attracted attention due to their degradability. This technology has advantages in complex structure manufacturing, cost control and rapid prototyping.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过分层沉积热塑性聚合物或水凝胶等材料，可实现患者特异: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology can achieve customized design of patient-specific drug delivery systems through layered deposition of materials such as thermoplastic polymers or hydrogels, with diverse drug release characteristics. However, due to material compatibility and cost, further optimization is needed to expand its application in the field of drug delivery.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过定制化植入物和手术方案，显著提升颌面重建的解剖匹配: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology can significantly improve the anatomical matching and surgical accuracy of maxillofacial reconstruction through customized implants and surgical plans. It is widely used in the repair of trauma, congenital defects, and tumor resection, but it is limited by regulatory approval, cost, and lack of long-term clinical data.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过实现药物剂量、释放特性及剂型的个性化定制，已在儿科: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology has shown potential in the fields of pediatrics, geriatric diseases, tumors, and rare diseases by realizing personalized customization of drug dosage, release characteristics, and dosage forms, improving medication compliance and treatment effects. However, due to challenges such as materials, standards, supervision, and manpower, pharmacists need to assume more responsibilities for preparation development and quality control.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过层叠制造实现药物递送系统的个性化设计，多种技术可将: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology realizes the personalized design of drug delivery systems through layered manufacturing. Various technologies can embed active ingredients into thermoplastic polymers, light-curing resins and biocompatible hydrogels to form complex structures and customized release curves, which are especially suitable for children and the elderly. It is also used in tissue engineering to prepare drug-loaded scaffolds, but there are still challenges such as regulations, scalability and material limitations.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过提升精度与个性化水平，广泛应用于牙科修复体的设计与: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology has been widely used in the design and production of dental restorations, including implants, crowns and bridges, removable dentures and maxillofacial prostheses, by improving the level of precision and personalization, improving the accuracy, efficiency and clinical effects of dental restorations.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过构建复杂多尺度结构，实现了对可植入药物递送系统的空: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology achieves spatial controllable and sustained release of implantable drug delivery systems by constructing complex multi-scale structures, especially showing potential in multi-drug synergistic release and tissue engineering, but it still faces challenges such as adaptation to biological dynamic environments.
现有研究显示，3D打印技术通过计算机辅助设计，结合患者特定解剖数据，可实现骨缺损: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology can realize the manufacturing of bone scaffolds matching the shape of bone defects through computer-aided design and combined with patient-specific anatomical data. The focus is on optimizing the internal structure, material composition and process parameters of the scaffold to improve bionic performance. However, its material composition, proportion, structural connection and manufacturing to adapt to different defect requirements still face challenges.
现有研究显示，3D打印树脂义齿基托的物理机械性能和精度受打印方向显著影响：水平方: Existing research shows that the physical and mechanical properties and accuracy of 3D printed resin denture bases are significantly affected by the printing direction: the horizontal direction (0°) increases the bending strength, the 45° and 90° directions have better accuracy and adaptability, and the surface roughness is highest at 45°. The vertical direction saves material but takes longer, and microbial adhesion is affected by surface roughness. There is no clear consensus on the optimal direction.
现有研究显示，3D打印牙托基托的精度受打印方向显著影响，其中45°方向表现出最高: Existing research shows that the accuracy of 3D printed dental tray bases is significantly affected by the printing direction, with the 45° direction showing the highest accuracy, and the base surface reinforcement structure and density position also affect the final accuracy.
现有研究显示，3D打印牙托基质与重衬材料的剪切结合强度与CAD-CAM铣削基质无: Existing research shows that the shear bonding strength of 3D printed dental tray matrix and relining material is not significantly different from that of CAD-CAM milled matrix. However, the tensile bonding strength of 3D printed matrix under non-aging conditions is lower than that of CAD-CAM matrix. Mechanical surface treatment (such as sandblasting) can significantly improve the bonding strength.
现有研究显示，3D打印牙科修复体的打印角度对尺寸精度影响，其最优角度因修复体类型: Existing research shows that the printing angle of 3D printed dental restorations affects the dimensional accuracy. The optimal angle varies depending on the type of restoration, printing technology and resin formula. Different angles have different effects on fixed restorations, removable dentures, occlusal devices and surgical guides, and specific equipment and materials need to be selected for targeted selection.
现有研究显示，3D打印牙科树脂的生物相容性受材料成分、后处理工艺和制造方法影响，: Existing research shows that the biocompatibility of 3D printed dental resins is affected by material composition, post-processing processes and manufacturing methods. Some resins show good biocompatibility, while others are cytotoxic. Careful selection and comprehensive biocompatibility evaluation are required.
现有研究显示，3D打印的人工牙与基托树脂结合强度较低，断裂模式不理想，而铣削和传: Existing research shows that the bonding strength between 3D printed artificial teeth and base resin is low, and the fracture mode is not ideal, while the combination of artificial teeth made by milling and traditional processes is more stable. Material incompatibility and incomplete polymerization are the main reasons for failure, and further research is needed to optimize the combination.
现有研究显示，3D打印聚合物临时牙修复体的打印方向影响其物理和力学性能，不同方向: Existing research shows that the printing direction of 3D printed polymer temporary dental restorations affects its physical and mechanical properties. Different directions have different performance in terms of fracture strength, wear resistance, color stability and surface roughness. Among them, the 0° direction is better than the 90° direction in fracture strength, and the 90° direction is better than the 0° direction in wear resistance and microhardness. However, the results of bending strength and elastic modulus are different.
现有研究显示，3D打印聚合物复合材料被用于制备个性化颅面植入物，以克服传统生物材: Existing research shows that 3D printing polymer composite materials are used to prepare personalized craniofacial implants to overcome the limitations of traditional biomaterials in shape adaptability, osseointegration and mechanical properties. Although it still faces challenges such as stress shielding, image visualization and osseointegration, this technology is gradually becoming an important direction in the repair of craniofacial defects.
现有研究显示，3D打印聚合物牙冠在美学、粘接性和成本方面优于传统陶瓷，但其抗压强: Existing research shows that 3D printed polymer crowns are superior to traditional ceramics in terms of aesthetics, adhesion and cost, but their compressive strength and wear resistance are still insufficient. Long-term clinical data and standardized testing procedures are lacking, and the regulatory path is unclear. In the future, it is expected to improve performance and bioactivity through technologies such as four-dimensional printing, nanocomposites and AI design.
现有研究显示，3D打印药物通过个性化剂量设计、可调释药 曲线 和独特剂型制造，提: Existing research shows that 3D printed drugs improve treatment matching through personalized dosage design, adjustable drug release curves and unique dosage form manufacturing, but they face challenges such as material compatibility, large-scale production, supervision and individual rights protection.
现有研究显示，3D打印通过生物墨水与AI优化，实现个性化药物的精准制备，相较传统: Existing research shows that 3D printing can achieve precise preparation of personalized drugs through bioink and AI optimization. Compared with traditional "one-size-fits-all" production, 3D printing can provide customized dosage, controllable release and multi-drug combinations, improving treatment matching and medication compliance.
现有研究显示，3D打印陶瓷和树脂类修复体在尺寸精度、边缘密合度和抗折强度方面多与: Existing research shows that 3D printed ceramic and resin restorations are mostly comparable to traditional ground products in terms of dimensional accuracy, edge adhesion and flexural strength. In particular, printed zirconia is stable, while resins are often limited by strength and color stability, and the results are significantly affected by process parameters. Long-term clinical performance still needs further verification.
现有研究显示，3D数字模型在神经外科教育、术前规划和术中导航中广泛应用，通过增强: Existing research shows that 3D digital models are widely used in neurosurgery education, preoperative planning, and intraoperative navigation. By enhancing anatomical cognition and preoperative simulation, operational sensitivity is improved, AR/VR enables real-time visualization, and photometry and 3D printing provide tactile and low-cost models. However, cost, standards, and accessibility are still barriers to promotion.
现有研究显示，3D生物打印可通过精确控制多种细胞类型的三维空间布局和可灌注网络，: Existing research shows that 3D bioprinting can be closer to the real tumor microenvironment by precisely controlling the three-dimensional spatial layout and perfusable network of multiple cell types, which is superior to traditional two-dimensional culture and existing three-dimensional models. It has shown application potential in tumor microenvironment simulation and immunotherapy pre-screening.
现有研究显示，3D生物打印技术通过精准控制细胞空间布局和微环境 cues，可构建: Existing research shows that 3D bioprinting technology can construct in vitro cardiovascular tissue models with physiologically relevant structures and functions through precise control of cell spatial layout and microenvironmental cues, support angiogenesis and maturation, and provide a physiological biomimetic platform for drug development and treatment strategies.
现有研究显示，3D生物打印技术通过精确控制细胞群、细胞外基质沉积和微环境，已显著: Existing research shows that 3D bioprinting technology has significantly improved the ability to construct in vitro models of complex human tissues through precise control of cell populations, extracellular matrix deposition and microenvironment, especially in modeling of cancer, heart, muscle and liver, and promoted the development of toxicology models.
现有研究显示，90%的人类癌症源于上皮细胞，针对乳腺和前列腺等上皮源肿瘤，通过3: Existing research shows that 90% of human cancers originate from epithelial cells. For epithelial tumors such as breast and prostate, the tumor structure and microenvironment are reproduced through 3D cell culture, organoid and 3D printing models, and high-content imaging and nanotechnology are combined to improve the accuracy of drug screening and model authenticity.
现有研究显示，CAD-CAM技术在可摘局部义齿制造中应用广泛，通过数字扫描、三维: Existing research shows that CAD-CAM technology is widely used in the manufacturing of removable partial dentures. Through digital scanning, three-dimensional printing or milling methods, it is more efficient and comfortable than traditional processes, has acceptable biocompatibility and surface roughness, and can explore the application of new materials such as polyetheretherketone, but more research is needed to verify its advantages.
现有研究显示，CAD-CAM系统在可摘局部义齿框架制造中优于传统方法，表现为更佳: Existing research shows that the CAD-CAM system is superior to traditional methods in the manufacturing of removable partial denture frames, showing better fit and adaptation, and digital impressions, advanced software and equipment capabilities are key factors affecting its success.
现有研究显示，CAD/CAM 3D打印全口义齿在患者满意度方面与传统全口义齿相当: Existing research shows that CAD/CAM 3D printed complete dentures are equivalent to traditional complete dentures in terms of patient satisfaction, but there are concerns about appearance and pronunciation.
现有研究显示，CAD/CAM与3D打印义齿在临床应用中可节省工作时间、提升治疗结: Existing research shows that CAD/CAM and 3D printed dentures can save working time, improve treatment results, and facilitate medical record preservation in clinical applications. Clinical trials are required to optimize aesthetics, retention, and vertical distance. Moreover, 3D printing equipment costs less and is more suitable for areas with limited resources. However, there are still limitations in application.
现有研究显示，CAD/CAM与3D打印义齿在临床应用中可节省时间、提升治疗结果并: Existing research shows that CAD/CAM and 3D printed dentures can save time, improve treatment results, and facilitate medical record preservation in clinical applications. Clinical trials are required to optimize aesthetics, retention, and vertical distance. Moreover, 3D printing equipment costs less and is more suitable for individual dentists and remote areas.
现有研究显示，CAD/CAM铣削在固定修复体中精度更优，尤其在边缘密合度方面优于: Existing research shows that CAD/CAM milling has better accuracy in fixed restorations, especially in terms of edge tightness than 3D printing; while 3D printing has outstanding performance in material utilization, complex structures and removable restorations, and has better color stability, both of which meet the requirements within clinical thresholds.
现有研究显示，FDM 3D打印技术在制备快速溶解口服固体制剂方面面临药物-聚合物: Existing research shows that FDM 3D printing technology faces challenges such as poor drug-polymer compatibility and slow release rate in preparing fast-dissolving oral solid dosage forms. The literature reviews a variety of strategies to improve dissolution properties, and proposes methods to improve drug solubility, compatibility, and printability through case analysis.
现有研究显示，三维打印个性化药物通过满足个体化用药需求，可弥补传统疗法中剂量固定: Existing research shows that 3D printing of personalized medicine can make up for the shortcomings of fixed dosage and variable efficacy in traditional therapies by meeting the needs of individualized medication. Although there are challenges in practical application, regulations and operations, it has feasibility and implementation potential.
现有研究显示，三维打印技术通过简化流程、降低成本，使复杂微流控结构得以快速实现，: Existing research shows that 3D printing technology enables the rapid realization of complex microfluidic structures by simplifying the process and reducing costs, improving the accessibility and application potential of droplet microfluidic technology.
现有研究显示，三维扫描、3D软件和快速成型技术已逐步替代传统流程中的取模、建模与: Existing research shows that 3D scanning, 3D software and rapid prototyping technology have gradually replaced the impression taking, modeling and production steps in the traditional process, improving the effect of facial prostheses in terms of color matching and surface detail processing. Current digital technology is constantly evolving in maxillofacial prosthetics and has shown the potential to replace traditional processes.
现有研究显示，与3D打印基托相比，铣削基托在牙-基托及重衬-基托界面的粘接强度均: Existing research shows that compared with 3D printed bases, milling bases have better bonding strength at the tooth-base and relining-base interfaces. Especially after excluding abnormal data, the bonding performance of milling bases is more significant and more reliable.
现有研究显示，与3D打印完全义齿相比，铣削制造的完全义齿的内表面精度更高，差异具: Existing research shows that compared with 3D printed complete dentures, the inner surface accuracy of complete dentures manufactured by milling is higher, and the difference is statistically significant.
现有研究显示，与传统丙烯酸树脂相比，3D打印树脂在尺寸稳定性方面表现更优，其制造: Existing research shows that compared with traditional acrylic resin, 3D printing resin performs better in terms of dimensional stability, its manufacturing process and clinical process are simpler, and it has cost-effective advantages.
现有研究显示，与传统全口义齿相比，3D打印全口义齿在佩戴稳定性方面较差，其余如患: Existing research shows that compared with traditional complete dentures, 3D printed complete dentures have poorer wearing stability, and there are no significant differences in other indicators such as patient satisfaction, quality of life, chewing power, and clinical satisfaction.
现有研究显示，与传统加工树脂修复体相比，3D打印树脂修复体在老化后颜色变化（ΔE: Existing research shows that compared with traditional processed resin restorations, 3D printed resin restorations have more significant color changes (ΔE) and light transmittance changes (ΔTP) after aging, but there is insufficient evidence for differences in light transmittance (TP).
现有研究显示，与传统工艺相比，采用CAD/CAM和快速成型技术制作的可摘局部义齿: Existing research shows that compared with traditional processes, removable partial denture frames produced using CAD/CAM and rapid prototyping technology perform better in terms of fit and accuracy, and have clinically acceptable fitting effects.
现有研究显示，与传统或铣削类临时修复材料相比，三维打印临时树脂材料在弯曲强度、显: Existing research shows that compared with traditional or milled temporary repair materials, 3D printed temporary resin materials perform better in terms of bending strength, microhardness, surface smoothness, wear volume and wear resistance, showing good mechanical performance potential.
现有研究显示，与传统方法相比，数字化制作的可摘局部义齿在固位、适配和患者满意度方: Existing research shows that compared with traditional methods, digitally produced removable partial dentures perform equally or better in terms of retention, fit, and patient satisfaction, and reduce the number of visits and adjustments, but there are still concerns about material performance, cost-effectiveness, and long-term effects.
现有研究显示，与传统树脂相比，CAD/CAM铣削树脂在体外实验中更不易附着白色念: Existing research shows that compared with traditional resins, CAD/CAM milling resins are less likely to adhere to Candida albicans in in vitro experiments, while 3D printing resins show a higher tendency to adhere, but the differences in surface roughness and contact angle are not statistically significant.
现有研究显示，与传统铸造或部分数字化工艺相比，3D打印金属可摘局部义齿框架在临床: Existing research shows that compared with traditional casting or partial digital processes, 3D printed metal removable partial denture frameworks perform equally or better in terms of clinical adaptability, mechanical properties, and precision. In particular, SLM and DMLS processes have outstanding performance in density and mechanical properties.
现有研究显示，与减材制造相比，增材制造的氧化锆固定修复体真度较低、精度更高，材料: Existing research shows that compared with subtractive manufacturing, additively manufactured zirconia fixed restorations have lower accuracy and higher accuracy. The accuracy of material injection method is equivalent to that of subtractive manufacturing. Both technologies meet clinical accuracy requirements.
现有研究显示，与复合树脂和/或丙烯酸树脂制成的后牙修复体相比，3D打印后牙修复体: Existing research shows that 3D printed posterior dental restorations perform comparably in terms of flexural strength and have similar mechanical properties compared to posterior dental restorations made of composite resin and/or acrylic resin.
现有研究显示，与铣削制备的义齿基托相比，3D打印义齿基托表现出更高的微生物代谢活: Existing research shows that compared with denture bases prepared by milling, 3D printed denture bases show higher microbial metabolic activity and bacterial colony attachment, and surface roughness is not a significant influencing factor.
现有研究显示，与铸造和增材制造相比，铣削可获得更优的可摘局部义齿卡环贴合精度；增: Existing research shows that compared with casting and additive manufacturing, milling can achieve better fitting accuracy of removable partial denture clasps; the surface roughness of additively manufactured clasps is inferior to casting and milling, and repeated laser sintering and high-speed milling can improve surface smoothness and retention.
现有研究显示，个性化3D打印材料在引导骨再生中具有潜力，但尚需更多人体研究评估种: Existing research shows that personalized 3D printing materials have potential in guiding bone regeneration, but more human studies are needed to evaluate short-term and long-term changes in surrounding bone level and volume after functional loading of implants.
现有研究显示，为满足儿童用药需求，mini-tablets作为固体制剂可有效兼顾: Existing research shows that in order to meet the medication needs of children, mini-tablets as solid preparations can effectively balance efficacy and safety. In particular, 3D printing technology can reduce the use of ingredients, avoid mixing and granulation, improve safety, and reduce the common practice of dispensing drugs at home or in hospitals.
现有研究显示，人工智能与3D打印等数字技术正被整合于完全义齿制作中，提升定制化水: Existing research shows that digital technologies such as artificial intelligence and 3D printing are being integrated into complete denture production, improving the level of customization and production efficiency, and promoting improvements in clinical effects and patient satisfaction.
现有研究显示，传统热凝牙托与人工牙的粘接效果受材料兼容性及聚合不完全影响，机械与: Existing research shows that the bonding effect of traditional thermosetting dental trays and artificial teeth is affected by material compatibility and incomplete polymerization, and the effects of mechanical and chemical treatment methods are uncertain; the bonding strength of 3D printed artificial teeth and dental trays is low, and the failure mode is poor, while the combination of milling and traditional processes is more reliable.
现有研究显示，使用3D打印解剖模型进行术前规划可减少手术时间、降低出血量、提升诊: Existing research shows that using 3D printed anatomical models for preoperative planning can reduce surgical time, reduce blood loss, improve diagnostic accuracy, and reduce operating room costs. Each improvement is presented in quantitative data, and the overall surgical results are better than traditional methods.
现有研究显示，光子学技术通过重新利用现有设备、增材制造及开发新型诊断和疫苗，支持: Existing research shows that photonics technology supports short-term, medium- and long-term measures to respond to the COVID-19 epidemic through the reuse of existing equipment, additive manufacturing, and the development of new diagnostics and vaccines, providing fundamental contributions to future epidemic prevention and control.
现有研究显示，减材制造技术在冠及固定修复体中已足够成熟，可推荐用于常规临床，且数: Existing research shows that subtractive manufacturing technology is mature enough in crowns and fixed restorations and can be recommended for routine clinical use. Digital technologies such as CAD/CAM are widely used in dental restorations, and the overall application effect is good.
现有研究显示，制作颌面缺损患者口内义齿多采用数字与传统方法结合的流程，数据采集以: Existing research shows that the production of intraoral dentures for patients with maxillofacial defects mostly uses a process that combines digital and traditional methods. Data collection is mainly based on intraoral scanning, and the application of complete digital workflows is limited. Simplifying the collection methods and improving the usability of software can promote the wider adoption of digital processes in clinical practice.
现有研究显示，制药3D打印从中心化生产转向点-of-care场景面临监管与实施挑: Existing research shows that pharmaceutical 3D printing faces regulatory and implementation challenges as it shifts from centralized production to point-of-care scenarios, with quality control, regulatory gaps, and ethical and legal issues being the most prominent. The study proposes a four-stage integration path to address the gap between technological development and regulatory lag.
现有研究显示，制药领域选择性激光烧结（SLS）缺乏系统性的温度依赖性和热学分析，: Existing research shows that selective laser sintering (SLS) in the pharmaceutical field lacks systematic temperature dependence and thermal analysis, especially in powder design, process window and thermal behavior characterization. It is urgent to learn from experience in the technical field, expand analysis methods and clarify the molding process mechanism.
现有研究显示，去除骨整合牙种植体的常用技术包括反扭矩棘轮法（CTRT）、超声骨刀: Existing research shows that common techniques for removing osseointegrated dental implants include counter-torque ratcheting (CTRT), ultrasonic osteotome, drill, and laser. Among them, CTRT performs best in terms of success rate, patient complications, and amount of bone tissue removal, and is considered a conservative and effective method, but more high-quality studies are needed to further verify it.
现有研究显示，双层封装、肠溶涂层及3D打印等技术显著提升了口服胶囊的靶向释放与药: Existing research shows that technologies such as double-layer encapsulation, enteric coating and 3D printing have significantly improved the targeted release and drug stability of oral capsules, especially in protecting peptides, proteins and RNA drugs from gastric acid degradation, enhancing bioavailability and reducing systemic side effects.
现有研究显示，双牙支持型导板在体外精度最高，体内外精度与单牙支持型相近，黏膜支持: Existing research shows that the double-tooth-supported guide plate has the highest in vitro accuracy, and the in-vivo and in-vitro accuracy is similar to that of the single-tooth-supported type. The reliability of in vitro data of the mucosa-supported type is low. The in vitro and in vivo accuracy of the milling guide plate is better than that of 3D printing. The structural design of the guide plate affects the surgical accuracy, but there is still a lack of unified standards for the accuracy evaluation of implant surgeries.
现有研究显示，口服速溶膜、浮泡制剂、黏膜黏附剂、纳米乳剂、微针透皮贴剂及3D打印: Existing research shows that new drug delivery forms such as oral instant films, bubbly preparations, mucoadhesives, nanoemulsions, microneedle transdermal patches and 3D printed personalized preparations rely on nanotechnology, smart polymers and artificial intelligence to achieve targeted release, improve bioavailability and patient compliance, and promote the development of patient-centered personalized treatment.
现有研究显示，口服黏膜给药系统通过绕过肝脏代谢、提升药物释放速度与持续性，有效改: Existing research shows that oral mucosal drug delivery systems can effectively improve the bioavailability of cannabinoid drugs such as CBD and THC by bypassing liver metabolism and improving drug release speed and sustainability. Its formulation design and penetration enhancement strategy can significantly improve the stability and efficacy of fat-soluble cannabinoids with poor solvent properties and rapid metabolism.
现有研究显示，可加工陶瓷增强复合树脂在低应力区域应用尚可，但长期耐用性不足；首代: Existing research shows that processable ceramic-reinforced composite resin can be used in low-stress areas, but its long-term durability is insufficient. Although the first-generation 3D printed ceramic-reinforced composite resin has the advantage of customization, its mechanical strength and wear resistance are poor, and it is still not suitable for final restorations. Clear classification and guidance are needed for clinical use.
现有研究显示，固定剂量组合制剂通过单一体、多层或多颗粒形式将两种及以上活性成分整: Existing research shows that fixed-dose combination preparations integrate two or more active ingredients into a single dosage form through a single body, multi-layer or multi-granule form, using technologies such as film coating, tablet coating and liquid delivery. 3D printing has also attracted attention. It can improve efficacy and tolerability in the treatment of diseases such as hypertension, diabetes, tuberculosis, reduce patients' medication burden, and improve treatment compliance and quality of life.
现有研究显示，基于3D建模的定制植入物在颅面缺损修复中优于通用植入物，因其能精准: Existing research shows that customized implants based on 3D modeling are better than universal implants in the repair of craniofacial defects because they can accurately match the implantation area, shorten the operation time and improve the appearance, and additive manufacturing technology has achieved personalized design of shape, size and mechanical properties.
现有研究显示，基于CTA数据经医学影像软件处理后制成的3D打印模型，广泛应用于血: Existing research shows that 3D printed models based on CTA data processed by medical imaging software are widely used in the planning and training of vascular surgeries, which can improve physician confidence and operating performance, shorten operation time, and reduce contrast agent consumption.
现有研究显示，基于CT、MRI或超声影像数据制作的患者特异性3D打印模型，已在先: Existing research shows that patient-specific 3D printing models based on CT, MRI or ultrasound imaging data have been used to enhance anatomical understanding, assist preoperative planning, simulate interventional operations, improve diagnosis and treatment accuracy, and serve as a training tool for medical students and young doctors in cardiovascular diseases such as congenital heart disease, coronary heart disease, pulmonary embolism, aortic aneurysm, and aortic dissection.
现有研究显示，基于光子超材料、石墨烯、设计DNA纳米结构及可规模化增材制造的聚合: Existing research shows that polymers based on photonic metamaterials, graphene, designed DNA nanostructures and scalable additive manufacturing can improve the sensitivity, selectivity and speed of COVID-19 detection, enabling simple processes, low cost, point-of-care detection and rapid large-scale production.
现有研究显示，基于分室给药系统的模块化设计可通过组合含药与辅料的单元，实现药物的: Existing research shows that the modular design based on compartmental drug delivery systems can achieve personalized and customized release of drugs by combining units containing drugs and excipients, especially in edible electronic devices, showing the potential for innovative regulation of drug release.
现有研究显示，基于天然高分子的生物支架通过3D打印、微流控和电纺等生物制造技术，: Existing research shows that bioscaffolds based on natural polymers can achieve co-loading of complex structures and cells through biomanufacturing technologies such as 3D printing, microfluidics and electrospinning, improving their biocompatibility and tissue regeneration potential, especially showing application prospects in bone, dental, cardiovascular and muscle tissue repair and wound healing.
现有研究显示，基于心脏CT和磁共振成像的患者特异性3D打印心血管模型，经材料喷射: Existing research shows that patient-specific 3D printed cardiovascular models based on cardiac CT and magnetic resonance imaging are prepared by material jetting or stereolithography technology, with an average geometric accuracy deviation of less than ±1 mm. They are widely used in interventional treatment planning, teaching and disease simulation. However, there are differences in verification methods between different studies, and standardized comparisons are still needed to determine the optimal production process.
现有研究显示，基于胃腔滞留和黏膜界面的新型口服给药系统，如3D打印胶囊和胃肠贴片: Existing research shows that new oral drug delivery systems based on gastric cavity retention and mucosal interface, such as 3D printed capsules and gastrointestinal patches, are being explored to improve the bioavailability of biomacromolecule drugs and achieve personalized treatment. Some technologies have entered clinical application or are about to be launched.
现有研究显示，增材制造技术可生产复杂定制化医疗植入物，其中钛合金适用于关节置换，: Existing research shows that additive manufacturing technology can produce complex customized medical implants. Titanium alloy is suitable for joint replacement. The porous structure helps bone ingrowth and reduces stress shielding. This technology shows broad application prospects in the fields of orthopedics, dentistry and tissue engineering.
现有研究显示，增材制造通过定制化设计、优化材料选择及表面处理，显著改善骨植入物的: Existing research shows that additive manufacturing can significantly improve the biocompatibility and mechanical properties of bone implants and enhance the osseointegration effect through customized design, optimized material selection and surface treatment. Although it faces challenges such as high cost, insufficient material development and process optimization, its application prospects in various bone implants are broad.
现有研究显示，复制全口义齿可减少就诊次数和治疗时间，尤其适用于适应能力下降的老年: Existing research shows that replicating complete dentures can reduce the number of doctor visits and treatment time. It is especially suitable for the elderly with reduced adaptability because of its familiar appearance and low pressure; digital technology is more efficient and can save data for reuse.
现有研究显示，天然产物如海藻酸、壳聚糖和淀粉已用于3D打印药剂的丝材，作为填充剂: Existing research shows that natural products such as alginic acid, chitosan and starch have been used in 3D printing pharmaceutical filaments as fillers, carriers or drug release regulators. Some, such as chitosan and papain, have potential but have not yet been applied. High temperatures limit their use. Reasonable selection of materials and parameters can expand their application in medicinal 3D printing.
现有研究显示，完全义齿修复的数字工作流程中，印模、试戴和最终加工可全程数字化实现: Existing research shows that in the digital workflow of complete denture restoration, the impression, try-on and final processing can be realized digitally throughout the entire process, but the jaw position recording needs to be combined with traditional methods; digital impressions have good accuracy but have limitations in the edge area, 3D printing is suitable for trial-fitting, milling processing is more accurate and patient satisfaction is high. There is currently a lack of evidence to support the complete digital recording of jaw position.
现有研究显示，将3D打印患者特异性模型应用于下颌重建手术，可有效缩短术中操作时间: Existing research shows that applying 3D printed patient-specific models to mandibular reconstruction surgery can effectively shorten intraoperative operation time, reduce surgical risks and costs, and has significant application potential, especially in areas with limited medical resources.
现有研究显示，将器官类器官与传统组织工程结合，通过先进生物材料调控细胞自组织和功: Existing research shows that combining organoids with traditional tissue engineering and controlling cell self-organization and functional maturation through advanced biomaterials can improve the structural and functional reproduction of complex tissues, especially in the reconstruction of load-bearing tissues such as bone and cartilage.
现有研究显示，将水凝胶嵌入3D打印微流控装置中可构建更接近体内环境的三维细胞培养: Existing research shows that embedding hydrogels into 3D printed microfluidic devices can build a three-dimensional cell culture system that is closer to the in vivo environment. Despite its increased complexity, 3D printing technology is becoming an important means to solve the integration challenges of microfluidic systems by achieving structural complexity and rapid customization.
现有研究显示，将非晶态固体分散体与水凝胶平台结合，可提升活性成分在伤口敷料中的溶: Existing research shows that combining amorphous solid dispersions with hydrogel platforms can improve the solubility and uniform distribution of active ingredients in wound dressings, help accelerate chronic wound healing, reduce complications, and support personalized treatment design.
现有研究显示，小动物预临床放疗模型因缺乏标准化剂量学标准和方法学报告不充分，难以: Existing research shows that small animal pre-clinical radiotherapy models lack standardized dosimetry standards and insufficient methodological reporting, making it difficult to ensure the accuracy and repeatability of dose measurement between different laboratories. There is an urgent need to improve the accuracy and consistency of dose measurement through tissue-equivalent small animal water models and 3D printing technology combined with commonly used detectors.
现有研究显示，开放源代码的3D打印上肢假肢在技术上可实现部分功能操作，具备较高可: Existing research shows that open source 3D printed upper limb prostheses can technically achieve some functional operations and are highly accessible. However, their mechanical and motion performance data are not systematic, and their clinical effectiveness has not yet been verified. Further research is needed to clarify their application value and formulate unified specifications.
现有研究显示，微流体平台通过精确操控细胞与生物材料，改善了干细胞及工程细胞在体内: Existing research shows that microfluidic platforms improve the retention rate, dose control, shear resistance and spatial targeting of stem cells and engineered cells in the body through precise manipulation of cells and biological materials, support immune isolation and cell microenvironment regulation, and promote the precise development of cell therapy in regenerative medicine.
现有研究显示，微流体技术结合人工智能，通过软光刻等方法实现定制化微流控平台，广泛: Existing research shows that microfluidic technology combines artificial intelligence to realize customized microfluidic platforms through soft lithography and other methods. It is widely used in separation technologies such as gas chromatography, high-performance liquid chromatography and electrophoresis to improve analysis accuracy, automation and scalability, and achieve intelligent optimization and real-time detection.
现有研究显示，微流体辅助和场辅助3D打印通过调控流体流动与物理场作用，提升材料沉: Existing research shows that microfluidic-assisted and field-assisted 3D printing improve material deposition accuracy, gradient formation and multi-material integration capabilities by regulating fluid flow and physical field effects, effectively overcoming the limitations of traditional 3D printing in resolution, speed and functional integration, and expanding the application potential of biomedical devices and functional materials.
现有研究显示，微流控芯片通过优化设计与生物传感器集成，结合人工智能技术，提升了实: Existing research shows that microfluidic chips integrate with biosensors through optimized design and combine with artificial intelligence technology to improve the automation, sensitivity and clinical applicability of laboratory diagnosis, and have achieved innovative applications in the fields of cancer, infectious diseases, point-of-care detection and other fields.
现有研究显示，心血管图像分割多采用亮度阈值、区域生长和手动编辑等方法，依赖Mim: Existing research shows that cardiovascular image segmentation mostly uses methods such as brightness thresholding, region growing, and manual editing, relying on software such as Mimics. However, the segmentation process is time-consuming, has high operational requirements, and most studies lack sufficient details and are difficult to reproduce.
现有研究显示，患者特异性CAD/CAM设计及3D打印固定板在急性创伤性下颌骨折中: Existing research shows that the application of patient-specific CAD/CAM design and 3D printed fixation plates in acute traumatic mandibular fractures still lacks specific evidence support. Most existing systematic reviews include mandibular fractures in a combined analysis of multiple surgical types, and the biomechanics and treatment urgency of the trauma population have not been fully considered.
现有研究显示，患者特异性的3D打印心脏与血管模型能高精度复现解剖结构与病理变化，: Existing research shows that patient-specific 3D printed heart and blood vessel models can reproduce anatomical structures and pathological changes with high precision. Compared with conventional images, they are more conducive to surgical planning, interventional simulation and doctor-patient communication, and can optimize CT scans to reduce radiation dose.
现有研究显示，手术模板通过三维成像与打印技术提升正畸微创钉及种植体植入的精准度，: Existing research shows that surgical templates use three-dimensional imaging and printing technology to improve the accuracy of minimally invasive orthodontic nail and implant placement. Although there are challenges in image quality, stability and cost, it overall improves the predictability and safety of clinical operations.
现有研究显示，打印方向和层厚均显著影响3D打印固定义齿的尺寸精度及边缘适应性，但: Existing research shows that both printing direction and layer thickness significantly affect the dimensional accuracy and edge adaptability of 3D printed fixed dentures. However, due to the heterogeneity of research, the optimal parameter combination cannot yet be determined.
现有研究显示，数字全口义齿根据制造流程可分为铣削、3D打印及混合型 workfl: Existing research shows that digital complete dentures can be divided into milling, 3D printing and hybrid workflows based on the manufacturing process. Hybrid workflows are widely used, with milling mostly used for final dentures, and 3D printing used for final, temporary and trial dentures. Its structural design, bonding strategy, material properties and usage needs need to be comprehensively considered to guide clinical and laboratory decisions.
现有研究显示，数字化工作流程结合减材和增材制造推动了个性化牙种植体的发展，钛及其: Existing research shows that digital workflow combined with subtractive and additive manufacturing has promoted the development of personalized dental implants. Titanium and its alloys are still the first choice for clinical use due to their strength and biocompatibility. Titanium-zirconium and β-type alloys can reduce stress shielding. Zirconia has aesthetic advantages but is brittle. PEEK has good elasticity but limited biological activity. Surface modification contributes to osseointegration. Each type of material has its own advantages and disadvantages and requires further clinical verification.
现有研究显示，数字印模技术通过口腔扫描或实验室扫描，相比传统方法能提升牙科修复体: Existing research shows that digital impression technology can improve the accuracy of dental restorations compared with traditional methods through oral scanning or laboratory scanning. The impact of different impression methods on the accuracy of restorations has been supported by the literature.
现有研究显示，数字可摘局部义齿中，钴铬、钛、氧化锆及聚醚醚酮等材料用于CAD/C: Existing research shows that in digital removable partial dentures, materials such as cobalt chromium, titanium, zirconia, and polyether ether ketone are used in CAD/CAM frames. Their mechanical properties are better than traditional casting frames, but the accuracy of the frame and clasps of the selective laser melting process is equivalent to that of the casting process. The material properties of polymethyl methacrylate discs are better than thermally condensable PMMA, but there are still technical challenges in the accuracy and durability of the combination between the frame and the base, and manual operation factors affect the final quality.
现有研究显示，数字技术制作的全口义齿在精度和临床效果上与传统方法相当，尤其在短跨: Existing research shows that complete dentures made with digital technology are comparable to traditional methods in terms of accuracy and clinical effect, especially in short spans, while traditional materials are more reliable in full-mouth impressions; milled PMMA dentures are stronger and more stable than printed dentures, which are flexible in design but weak in bonding force. Digital dentures can reduce chairside time and achieve patient satisfaction and quality of life that are equivalent to or better than traditional dentures.
现有研究显示，数字技术通过三维扫描、智能设计软件及数控加工或3D打印，可实现全口: Existing research shows that digital technology can achieve high-precision production of complete dentures through three-dimensional scanning, intelligent design software, and CNC machining or 3D printing. However, due to the complexity of the restorations, its clinical application has made slow progress. This review summarizes the current application status in dental clinical and laboratory settings.
现有研究显示，数字技术通过口内扫描、面部扫描、3D打印和数控加工等手段，提升了完: Existing research shows that digital technology has improved the accuracy, predictability and patient comfort of complete denture repair through intraoral scanning, facial scanning, 3D printing and CNC processing, and reduced the number of medical visits. However, case selection, standardized processes and long-term efficacy evaluation still need to be clarified. Expert consensus proposes indications, operating specifications and evaluation standards for clinical application.

研究不同3D打印机与厂家指定后固化装置组合对3D打印牙冠树脂的尺寸精度、抗压强度: Studying the effects of different combinations of 3D printers and manufacturer-specified post-curing devices on the dimensional accuracy, compressive strength and polymerization conversion rate of 3D printed crown resins. The results show that the post-curing device has a greater impact on resin performance, and the ND-N and PN-P combinations perform better in terms of dimensional accuracy, strength and polymerization conversion rate.
研究不同几何设计和制造工艺对固定桥修复体抗折强度的影响，结果显示修复体的几何构型: The effects of different geometric designs and manufacturing processes on the flexural strength of fixed bridge restorations were studied. The results showed that the geometric configuration and manufacturing methods of the restorations affected their flexural properties.
研究不同厚度（1mm、2mm、3mm）和后固化时间（20、25分钟）对NextD: Studying the effects of different thicknesses (1mm, 2mm, 3mm) and post-curing time (20, 25 minutes) on the light transmittance, color difference and microhardness of NextDent 3D printed temporary restorations, the results show that thickness significantly affects light transmittance and hardness, while changes in post-curing time have less impact.
研究不同含量钛氧化物纳米颗粒对PMMA基复合材料结构行为的影响，通过FT-IR和: Studying the effects of different contents of titanium oxide nanoparticles on the structural behavior of PMMA-based composites, through FT-IR and microscopy analysis, it was found that adding titanium oxide nanoparticles in the range of 0.2% to 2.5% can achieve appropriate adhesion between the polymer matrix and the filler.
研究不同层厚与建模角度对数字光处理打印瓷固定修复体性能的影响。: Study the effects of different layer thicknesses and modeling angles on the performance of digital light processing printed porcelain fixed restorations.
研究不同建角对数字光处理打印全口义齿基托表面特性、精度和尺寸稳定性的影响，结果显: The effects of different construction angles on the surface properties, accuracy and dimensional stability of digital light processing printed complete denture bases were studied. The results showed that 0-degree construction angle performed the best, and the accuracy and stability of the maxillary bases were better than those of the mandibular bases.
研究不同构建方向（0°、45°、90°）对钴铬全口义齿金属框架内表面精度与贴合度: Studying the effects of different construction directions (0°, 45°, 90°) on the inner surface accuracy and fit of cobalt-chromium complete denture metal frames, the results show that the 45° direction is better than other directions in accuracy and fit, while the 90° direction is significantly worse.
研究不同柱体设计的无套管3D打印手术导板，通过在引导柱设置窗口开口，以降低植骨手: Research on sleeveless 3D printed surgical guides with different column designs, by setting window openings in the guide columns to reduce the temperature increase of the cortical bone during bone grafting surgery.
研究不同温度（40、60、80°C）和时间下热后固化对3D打印牙科树脂材料力学性: Studying the effects of thermal post-curing at different temperatures (40, 60, 80°C) and time on the mechanical properties and biocompatibility of 3D printed dental resin materials, the results showed that heating significantly increased the bending strength and cell viability, with the 80°C 120-minute group performing the best, and the 40°C group showing more obvious changes in cytotoxicity and fibroblast morphology.
研究不同铸造方向对可摘局部义齿金属框架精度及内部孔隙率的影响，发现铸造方向影响其: Studying the effects of different casting directions on the accuracy and internal porosity of the metal frame of removable partial dentures, it was found that the casting direction affects its structural integrity and pore distribution.
研究不同颜色ABS Plus材料在氙弧灯老化后机械与光学性能变化，发现黄色样品抗: Studying the changes in mechanical and optical properties of ABS Plus materials of different colors after aging under xenon arc lamp, it was found that the yellow sample has the highest tensile strength, the purple sample has the lowest strength after aging, the green and blue samples are less affected by aging, and the purple sample has the most significant color change.
研究与产品的联系应沿着明确的性能目标建立：是改善分散、溶出，还是覆盖多个剂量。目: The study-to-product link should be established along clear performance goals: whether to improve dispersion, dissolution, or cover multiple doses. Only after the goals are clear can the actual contributions of different processes be compared.
研究个性化3D打印心血管复合药片的作用机制，聚焦患者导向的治疗方案。: Study the mechanism of action of personalized 3D printed cardiovascular compound pills and focus on patient-oriented treatment options.
研究主线从形状匹配逐步转向接触力和人体动作。全定制与可调结构形成两种互补路线：前: The main line of research gradually shifted from shape matching to contact force and human body motion. Full customization and adjustable structure form two complementary routes: the former emphasizes geometric precision, and the latter emphasizes rapid coverage and maintenance.
研究了3D打印呼吸机患者电路部件在不同后处理条件下的挥发性有机物（VOCs）排放: The volatile organic compounds (VOCs) emissions of 3D printed ventilator patient circuit components under different post-processing conditions were studied. It was found that post-curing reduced VOCs emissions, and the emissions continued to decline over time. All compounds did not exceed the recommended dose of 360 μg/d.
研究了3D打印聚己内酯/氧化锆复合材料对牙周组织细胞的影响，结果显示PCL/AT: The effect of 3D printed polycaprolactone/zirconia composite materials on periodontal tissue cells was studied. The results showed that PCL/ATZ 80/20 performed best in promoting fibroblast growth and gingival cell adhesion, and periodontal ligament cell proliferation was significantly lower than other groups at 7 days. This material is a candidate material for customized dental implants.
研究了3D打印药片中填充几何结构（交叉、星形、网格）对药含量和释放的影响，发现不: The effect of filling geometry (cross, star, grid) on drug content and release in 3D printed tablets was studied, and it was found that different filling structures affect drug dissolution behavior.
研究了3D打印药物在高温加工及储存过程中的稳定性，比较了不同药物-聚合物体系的热: The stability of 3D printed drugs during high-temperature processing and storage was studied, and the thermal, crystallographic and spectroscopic properties of different drug-polymer systems were compared. It was found that most systems remained chemically stable, but the combination of acetaminophen and polyvinyl alcohol showed obvious thermal instability and chemical decomposition.
研究了FFF 3D打印PEEK对牙颌面植入物中成骨细胞的体外反应，结果显示其表面: The in vitro response of FFF 3D printed PEEK to osteoblasts in dentofacial implants was studied, and the results showed that its high surface roughness and excellent structure may become a suitable bionic material for craniofacial reconstruction surgery.
研究了Fe-Mn-Cu、Fe-Mn-W和Fe-Mn-Co三种纳米结构生物可降解合: The biocompatibility of three nanostructured biodegradable alloys, Fe-Mn-Cu, Fe-Mn-W and Fe-Mn-Co, in normal oral epithelial cells and their potential anti-cancer effects on MG-63 osteosarcoma cells were studied. The results showed that they have good biocompatibility and promote cell proliferation. They also exhibit anti-cancer activity against osteosarcoma cells, but the antibacterial effect is still questionable.
研究了Ti-12Cr-3Sn合金在模拟生理环境中的耐腐蚀性，结果显示其在168小: The corrosion resistance of Ti-12Cr-3Sn alloy was studied in a simulated physiological environment. The results showed that it remained stable passivation after 168 hours of immersion, had low corrosion current density, metal ion release was below the detection limit, and was more corrosion-resistant than Ti-6Al-4V.
研究了Ti-6Al-4V多孔结构的拓扑优化设计、可制造性及性能，建立了多孔结构参: The topology optimization design, manufacturability and performance of the Ti-6Al-4V porous structure were studied, and a numerical model of porous structure parameters (unit size and porosity) and elastic modulus was established to provide a theoretical basis for matching the elastic modulus of human bones of different ages, genders and skeletal parts.
研究了Ti6Al4V合金蜂窝结构在不同取向下的压缩性能，发现[001]方向加载的: The compressive properties of the Ti6Al4V alloy honeycomb structure under different orientations were studied, and it was found that the structural strength and plasticity loaded in the [001] direction were higher than those in the [011] and [111] directions, and its fracture originated from stress concentration in the non-[001] direction structure and crack expansion from micropores.
研究了三种药用制剂在激光选区激光粉末床融合打印中的可回收性，发现聚乙烯醇和甲基丙: The recyclability of three pharmaceutical preparations in selective laser powder bed fusion printing was studied. It was found that polyvinyl alcohol and ethyl methacrylate-ethylene propylene copolymer-based preparations could maintain key quality attributes after 5 and 9 cycles respectively, while the particle size and weight of povidone-based preparations gradually changed with increasing cycles and were considered non-recyclable. Aging was mainly manifested by changes in particle size, powder cohesion and glass transition temperature.
研究了不同孔隙结构和孔径的Ti6Al–4V支架，发现孔径越大，机械性能越接近人骨: Ti6Al–4V scaffolds with different pore structures and pore sizes were studied and found that the larger the pore size, the closer the mechanical properties are to human bone and the better the electrochemical corrosion performance, and the pore structure has a significant impact on the mechanical and corrosion behavior.
研究了不同形状3D打印药物释放植入物的药物释放特性，发现表面积与体积比是影响释放: The drug release characteristics of 3D printed drug release implants of different shapes were studied and it was found that the surface area to volume ratio is a key parameter affecting release. The release behavior of individualized shape implants was predicted and verified based on the model, showing its predictability.
研究了不同打印方向和水存时间对FDM制备PEEK可摘局部义齿框架尺寸精度的影响，: The effect of different printing directions and water storage time on the dimensional accuracy of PEEK removable partial denture frames prepared by FDM was studied. The results showed that the water storage time significantly affects the accuracy and fidelity. Clinically acceptable accuracy can be achieved after 24 hours and remains stable for more than two months. The 90° direction has the best repeatability.
研究了不同残余牙槽嵴形态及数字制造方法对下颌义齿基托精度的影响，结果表明铣削法基: The effects of different residual alveolar ridge shapes and digital manufacturing methods on the accuracy of mandibular denture bases were studied. The results showed that the accuracy of the milling method base was better than that of light-curing 3D printing, and the surface deviation of the blade-shaped alveolar ridge was large, and all bases showed significant dimensional changes at different time points.
研究了不同浓度塑化剂对羟考酮负载Eudragit RS丝材打印性能的影响，结果表: The effect of different concentrations of plasticizers on the printing performance of oxycodone-loaded Eudragit RS filament was studied. The results showed that 15% triethyl citric acid can improve the melt fluidity and mechanical properties without affecting the drug form, making it the best choice for preparing filament for this preparation.
研究了不同灭菌方式对3D打印手术导板精度和贴合度的影响，结果表明灭菌方式和材料会: The impact of different sterilization methods on the accuracy and fit of 3D printed surgical guides was studied. The results showed that the sterilization methods and materials will affect the accuracy, but it is clinically acceptable after increasing the reduction load.
研究了不同能量密度下TiNbZrMoTa基高熵合金的加工性能，比较了切削与磨削工: The processing performance of TiNbZrMoTa-based high-entropy alloys under different energy densities was studied, and the effects of cutting and grinding processes and feed rates on cutting forces and surface roughness were compared. The results showed that the cutting process combined with VED88 alloy can obtain the best surface integrity and processing stability.
研究了两种可打印牙科树脂在不同打印角度和载荷方向下的弯曲强度，结果表明打印角度对: The flexural strength of two printable dental resins at different printing angles and load directions was studied, and the results showed that the printing angle has a significant effect on the flexural strength.
研究了假肢套筒与衬垫界面的摩擦行为，发现硅橡胶织物摩擦系数显著低于泡沫衬垫，3D: The friction behavior of the interface between the prosthetic sleeve and the liner was studied, and it was found that the friction coefficient of the silicone rubber fabric was significantly lower than that of the foam liner, and the friction energy consumption of the 3D printed sleeve interface was higher than that of the acrylic resin material, and the temperature increase was positively correlated with the friction coefficient and energy dissipation. Reinforcement fibers have an impact on the friction behavior of 3D printed nylon.
研究了含泼尼松龙的聚乙烯醇丝材的打印性能及打印件几何结构对药物释放的影响，发现药: The printing performance of polyvinyl alcohol filament containing prednisolone and the effect of the geometric structure of the printed parts on drug release were studied. It was found that the drug content significantly reduced the melt viscosity, and the surface area to volume ratio of the printed parts was a key factor affecting drug release.
研究了含纳米颗粒的增材制造树脂在不同打印方向及人工老化下的弯曲性能，结果显示打印: The bending properties of additive manufacturing resin containing nanoparticles under different printing directions and artificial aging were studied. The results showed that the printing direction, nanoparticle type and concentration have a significant impact on the bending strength and elastic modulus. After artificial aging, the performance of the modified group changed little, and the bending strength of the sample in the 0-degree direction was higher.
研究了在0°和90°打印方向下，含5% TEGDMA对增材制造咬合垫材料力学性能: The effect of 5% TEGDMA on the mechanical properties of additively manufactured bite pad materials in the 0° and 90° printing directions was studied. The results showed that TEGDMA reduced the bending strength and modulus in the 90° direction and increased the hardness in the 0° direction, and the performance changes were related to the printing direction.
研究了激光选区熔融制备的Ti64–HA复合材料在生理盐水和模拟体液中的摩擦学性能: The tribological properties of the Ti64–HA composite prepared by laser selective melting were studied in physiological saline and simulated body fluids. The results showed that the Ti64–10HA composite showed a lower wear rate than Ti64–5HA and pure Ti64 in both biological fluids.
研究了热敏性难溶药 escitalopram oxalate 在热熔挤出和3D打: The degradation and solid-state changes of the heat-sensitive insoluble drug escitalopram oxalate during hot melt extrusion and 3D printing were studied. It was found that the drug in the HPMC system was amorphous, and the bPMMA system was amorphous in situ during the printing process. The drug degradation was reduced under the bPMMA formula, and no R-enantiomer was detected. Although the drug release was slow, it still met the requirements for immediate release.
研究了热稳定3D打印材料对HEK 293E细胞的生物相容性，发现其提取液不影响细: The biocompatibility of heat-stable 3D printing materials for HEK 293E cells was studied, and it was found that the extract did not affect cell viability and growth, and there was no difference in the effect after steam sterilization or 70% ethanol disinfection. However, the biocompatibility of other cell types needs to be re-evaluated.
研究了环境温度和湿度对3D打印PLA多孔支架结构及生物相容性的影响，发现温度升高: The effects of ambient temperature and humidity on the structure and biocompatibility of 3D printed PLA porous scaffolds were studied. It was found that increased temperature increased the compression modulus, high humidity affected cell viability and ROS generation, and high temperature caused an increase in intracellular ROS, indicating that 25-35°C and 30-50% RH are suitable conditions for both mechanical properties and biocompatibility.
研究了聚集体粒径范围对激光选择性烧结制备的药用片lets结构强度和药物释放速率的: The effect of aggregate particle size range on the structural strength and drug release rate of pharmaceutical tablets prepared by laser selective sintering was studied. It was found that the larger median particle size group showed higher compressive strength and faster drug release rate within the initial 12 hours.
研究了适用于微流挤出3D打印的陶瓷义齿打印膏的制备，通过优化浆料流变性能和烧结特: The preparation of ceramic denture printing paste suitable for microfluidic extrusion 3D printing was studied. By optimizing the rheological properties and sintering characteristics of the slurry, the molding and densification of ceramic materials were achieved. The resulting sintered body met the mechanical performance requirements of oral dentures, providing a technological breakthrough for ceramic material 3D printing technology.
研究五类牙科材料在模拟胃食管反流病环境下的耐久性，结果显示钴铬合金和3D打印光聚: Studying the durability of five types of dental materials in simulated gastroesophageal reflux disease environments, the results show that cobalt-chromium alloys and 3D printed photopolymers are the most durable, while acrylic resin and nylon have risks in long-term use. It is recommended to select materials based on the condition.
研究人员为一名右手中指缺失的患者设计并制作了采用3D打印技术的仿生义手，通过Ar: Researchers designed and produced a bionic prosthetic hand using 3D printing technology for a patient with a missing middle finger on his right hand. They controlled the fingertip movement through Arduino, combined 3D hand scanning and CAD design, and printed it using PLA material, which verified the feasibility of the device in terms of low cost and ease of operation.
研究人员为低收入国家的神经外科医生开发并评估了一种3D打印的内镜第三脑室造瘘术训: Researchers developed and evaluated a 3D-printed endoscopic third ventriculostomy training model for neurosurgeons in low-income countries. The results showed that after training, trainees had significant improvements in operation time, number of punctures, and access to key structures.
研究人员为大鼠设计了可三维打印的耳蜗圆窗腔植入物，通过硅胶材料制备并验证其在体外: Researchers designed a three-dimensionally printable cochlear round window cavity implant for rats. It was prepared from silicone material and verified its uniform drug release and biocompatibility in vitro. The results showed that the implant can effectively inhibit fibrosis around the cochlear implant, providing a reliable platform for cochlear drug treatment.
研究人员为截肢者设计并制作了一款连接心率、体温监测系统的3D打印假手，通过物联网: Researchers designed and produced a 3D printed prosthetic hand for amputees that was connected to a heart rate and body temperature monitoring system. The data was uploaded to a web application through the Internet of Things for doctors to view. The device met the design requirements of latency, cost and weight, verifying its reliability.
研究人员利用3D打印和二维切割技术，快速制造了一种模块化机械通气器，通过体外和活: The researchers used 3D printing and 2D cutting technology to quickly manufacture a modular mechanical ventilator. After testing in vitro and in vivo pig models, its mechanical efficiency was equivalent to that of standard ventilators. The improved gear design improved durability and shortened the manufacturing time to less than 2 hours. The total cost was 300 Australian dollars.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制作了具解剖准确性的马头训练模型，集成激光传感器与LED: Researchers used 3D printing technology to create an anatomically accurate horse head training model that integrated laser sensors and LED eyes. Through preset aiming paths and instant feedback mechanisms, veterinarians and first responders were trained to master the correct aiming method for fatal shootings.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制作了模拟患者胸廓形态的仿生胸 体模，通过十二种不同比例: The researchers used 3D printing technology to create a bionic chest phantom that simulated the patient's chest shape. The heterogeneity of bone radiation attenuation was achieved through twelve different proportions of epoxy resin, polypropylene, and bone powder mixtures. The density range measured by CT was 42–705 HU, which was equivalent to the density of ribs and thoracic vertebrae in the real patient's chest. The structural coincidence rate reached 97%, and the geometric accuracy reached 0.00–4.57 mm.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制作了模拟肋骨的超声教学模型，基于公开软件和数据构建，通: The researchers used 3D printing technology to create an ultrasound teaching model that simulated ribs, built it based on public software and data, and evaluated its effectiveness in teaching training through clinical ultrasound scanning.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制作定制化低成本生物反应器，观察Mach1菌株细菌细胞的: The researchers used 3D printing technology to create a customized low-cost bioreactor and observed the growth of bacterial cells of the Mach1 strain. The results showed that the growth of bacterial cells in the reactor was enhanced.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制作定制扫描电子显微镜样品架，通过导电聚乳酸材料实现纳米: The researchers used 3D printing technology to produce a customized scanning electron microscope sample holder. They used conductive polylactic acid materials to achieve high-resolution imaging of nanoelectrodes and nanocapillaries. They successfully obtained the nanocapillary cone angle and used it for radius calculation. They also achieved imaging of non-conductive materials such as alumina powder. The production time of a single sample holder is less than 30 minutes, the cost is less than $0.5, and it is durable enough to be reused.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制作脑动脉瘤夹闭训练模型，通过硅胶模拟脑组织和血管，注入: Researchers used 3D printing technology to create a brain aneurysm clipping training model, using silicone to simulate brain tissue and blood vessels, and injecting capsanthin-containing liquid to simulate pulsating blood flow, providing a repeatable, low-cost training tool for neurosurgery residents.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制备了兽用咀嚼片，其设计尺寸与实际药量高度一致，符合US: Researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare veterinary chewable tablets. The design size is highly consistent with the actual dosage, meets USP and Ph. Eur. content uniformity standards, and the formulation remains stable within three months after printing.
研究人员利用3D打印技术制备了四种多模态影像用仿生体，通过对比常规商用仿生体，发: Researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare four bionic bodies for multi-modal imaging. By comparing the conventional commercial bionic bodies, they found that the standard deviation of the uniformity of HU values in CT scans was less than 3 HU, and they performed well in multi-modal imaging such as MRI, CT, PET/MR and PET/CT. They have the advantages of customization and rapid manufacturing.
研究人员利用3D打印技术开发了Vent-Lock呼吸机分流系统，将一台呼吸机或麻: Researchers used 3D printing technology to develop the Vent-Lock ventilator shunt system, which uses one ventilator or anesthetic gas equipment for two patients to achieve individualized ventilation control through flow resistors. The feasibility was verified in a pig model, confirming that the shunt technology needs to be operated by experienced medical staff in emergency situations.
研究人员利用LCD 3D打印技术制备含褪黑素的片剂，表面刻印盲文以辅助视障患者识: The researchers used LCD 3D printing technology to prepare melatonin-containing tablets, with Braille engraved on the surface to assist visually impaired patients in identifying them. The sustained release of melatonin was controlled by adjusting the molecular weight of PEGDA and additives. NMR confirmed that the resin photopolymerized. Small batch printing can be completed quickly in about 24 minutes.
研究人员利用三维打印技术制作了适用于新生儿的穿刺假人模型，不同临床经验的医护人员: Researchers used 3D printing technology to create a puncture dummy model suitable for newborns. Medical staff with different clinical experience successfully completed the puncture operation under ultrasound guidance. The model is reusable and helps improve the operational coordination, proficiency and safety of clinical personnel.
研究人员利用人胎盘与3D打印颅骨切口构建了模拟前庭神经鞘瘤切除的训练模型，通过配: The researchers used human placenta and 3D printed skull incisions to build a training model to simulate vestibular schwannoma resection. The tumor capsule and key anatomical structures were reproduced by configuring placenta and amniotic membrane tissue. After evaluation by two experts and two senior residents, they believed that the model had good anatomical realism in terms of microsurgical training, hand coordination, and simulation of narrow deep surgical channels.
研究人员利用低成本立体光刻3D打印机，成功制备了集成膜阀的微流控装置，其水平和垂: The researchers used a low-cost stereolithography 3D printer to successfully prepare a microfluidic device with integrated membrane valves. The horizontal and vertical microchannel dimensions are designed accurately. The valves can be opened and closed under the same pressure, and can effectively switch more than 800 times.
研究人员利用六块3D打印部件、基本电子元件和Raspberry Pi，组装出一种: The researchers used six 3D printed parts, basic electronic components and a Raspberry Pi to assemble a portable fluorescence microscope that can detect single cells in bright field and three-color fluorescence modes. Its performance has been compared and verified to be equivalent to high-end microscopes.
研究人员利用大鼠脂肪来源间充质干细胞，结合生物3D打印技术，构建了无支架、具备成: The researchers used rat adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells, combined with bio-3D printing technology, to construct a scaffold-free cell construct with mature cartilage tissue structure and mechanical properties. Its glycosaminoglycan content and histological characteristics are better when treated with high concentrations of BMP2 and bFGF, and its compressive strength is comparable to natural cartilage.
研究人员利用家用3D打印机结合新型复制成型技术，快速制作定制尺寸和几何结构的3D: The researchers used a home 3D printer combined with a new replication molding technology to quickly produce a 3D culture device with customized size and geometry to achieve in vitro culture of myogenic precursor cells derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells in skeletal muscle tissue engineering. This method can be easily implemented in a standard biological laboratory.
研究人员利用廉价3D打印技术制备了透明、密封性良好的微流控装置，通过模块化设计实: Researchers used cheap 3D printing technology to prepare a transparent and well-sealed microfluidic device. Through modular design, rapid assembly was achieved, and dental pulp stem cells were successfully encapsulated and maintained in activity, supporting single-cell imaging and lowering the threshold for using microfluidic technology.
研究人员利用手机镜头反向设计了一种3D打印的高分辨率傅里叶光场显微镜FPscop: Researchers used the lens of a mobile phone to reversely design a 3D printed high-resolution Fourier light field microscope FPscope. Through multi-angle illumination and image synthesis of the LED array, it achieved a maximum synthetic numerical aperture of 0.5 and a depth of focus of 0.1 mm. It is superior to traditional objective lenses and is suitable for medical testing and teaching demonstrations in low-resource environments.
研究人员利用桌面3D打印和硅胶铸造技术，快速设计并制造了可重复使用、贴合舒适的口: The researchers used desktop 3D printing and silicone casting technology to quickly design and manufacture a reusable, snug-fitting and comfortable mask, using household air conditioning filter material as the filter layer as a temporary alternative to N95 masks to provide basic protection. No filtration performance test was conducted.
研究人员利用桌面3D打印机制作了纸质微流控装置，通过调控纤维素粉末与水的混合物在: The researchers used a desktop 3D printer to create a paper-based microfluidic device. By regulating the capillary action of the mixture of cellulose powder and water in the microchannel, the programmable flow rate was achieved, and the quantitative analysis of nitrate ions and the preparation of T-shaped sensors were successfully completed.
