The device has a simple structure and low cost, and is suitable for rapid on-site detection.
研究人员利用熔融沉积建模3D打印技术，制备了具有可调释药性能的柔性聚氨酯阴道环，: Researchers used fused deposition modeling 3D printing technology to prepare a flexible polyurethane vaginal ring with adjustable drug release properties. By adjusting the film thickness and micropore structure, the controlled and sustained release of hydroxychloroquine, IgG, gp120 fragments and coumarin 6 nanoparticles was achieved.
研究人员利用现有DICOM文件自制3D打印解剖模型，用于耳鼻喉科、神经外科、肿瘤: Researchers used existing DICOM files to create their own 3D printed anatomical models for medical training in the fields of otolaryngology, neurosurgery, oncology, and neuroradiology. Compared with existing anatomical models on the market, this method is highly recognized by students. It has multi-structure printability and high detail accuracy, improving the applicability of resident training and surgical planning.
研究人员利用银泥挤出结合885°C退火，制备出高强度、耐高温高压且化学稳定的微流: The researchers used silver paste extrusion combined with annealing at 885°C to prepare a microfluidic device with high strength, high temperature and pressure resistance, and chemical stability. The structure has good linearity and can achieve 150 μm thick layers and 200 μm narrow channels, and the catalytic microreactor performance is consistent with model predictions.
研究人员制备了嵌入近红外发光晶体的3D打印生物可降解支架，证实其在近红外光照下可: The researchers prepared a 3D printed biodegradable scaffold embedded with near-infrared luminescent crystals, and confirmed that it can controllably release nitric oxide and achieve photoisomerization of drug precursors under near-infrared illumination, and that it shows good biocompatibility when co-cultured with human adipose stem cells.
研究人员在健康贝吉尔犬中比较了3D打印的匹莫苯丹片与商业制剂Vetmedin®的: Researchers compared the pharmacokinetics of 3D printed pimobendan tablets and the commercial preparation Vetmedin® in healthy Bezier dogs and found that the 3D printed tablets have different absorption characteristics and are safe and feasible, supporting their application in individualized treatment of dogs.
研究人员在印度尼西亚为无PCNL经验的年轻泌尿外科医生开发了基于3D打印模具的低: Researchers developed a low-cost silicone renal prosthesis based on 3D printing molds for young urological surgeons without PCNL experience in Indonesia for ultrasound-guided percutaneous nephrolithotomy training. All participants spoke highly of the model, believing that the model performed well in terms of anatomical authenticity, puncture and stone visualization, and was recommended for training.
研究人员基于CT数据制作了3D打印训练模型，通过传感器模拟鼻咽部蛛网膜在切除垂体: The researchers created a 3D printing training model based on CT data, using sensors to simulate the pressure state of the nasopharyngeal arachnoid during the resection of pituitary tumors, and providing real-time feedback on the operating force. 11 experienced surgeons used the model for simulation training. The results showed that the maximum operating force reached 0.526N, and the arachnoid simulation effect was good. The model was considered helpful for training.
研究人员基于患者CT数据，结合专家分割和放射科医生确认，利用FDM 3D打印制作: Based on patient CT data, combined with expert segmentation and radiologist confirmation, the researchers used FDM 3D printing to create a physical lung model with real anatomical structure and CT intensity. They randomly added nodules of different shapes and sizes and achieved the target HU value by adjusting the filling rate, which verified the accuracy of the quantification software in measuring nodule size and intensity.
研究人员基于患脑瘤犬的CT数据，构建了3D打印的犬头模拟体UPDOG，用于验证千: Based on the CT data of dogs with brain tumors, researchers constructed a 3D printed dog head simulator UPDOG to verify the dose distribution of the tumor site in kilovoltage radiation therapy. The results showed that it can effectively simulate the anatomical structure of the dog head, and the dose difference with the Monte Carlo simulation results was within an acceptable range.
研究人员基于断层数据制作个性化3D打印解剖模型，用于鼻内镜手术技能培训，结果显示: Researchers created personalized 3D printed anatomical models based on tomographic data for endoscopic sinus surgery skills training. The results showed that trainees' operating accuracy was improved and surgery time was shortened. Technical performance can be objectively evaluated through the OSATS tool.
研究人员基于解剖图谱制作了3D打印的兔类解剖模型，通过填充示踪剂实现各器官与血管: The researchers created a 3D printed rabbit anatomical model based on the anatomical atlas, and filled it with tracers to visualize various organs and blood vessels. This was used to optimize experimental parameters such as magnetic resonance, CT, and magnetic particle imaging, so as to accurately plan before in vivo experiments and reduce the number of animals used.
研究人员对比了3D打印PLA支架在静态与搅拌生物模拟环境中的降解行为，发现静态条: The researchers compared the degradation behavior of 3D printed PLA scaffolds in static and stirred biological simulation environments. They found that under static conditions, the damage to the scaffold was more severe and the glass transition temperature increased faster, while under stirring conditions, the scaffold was more brittle, but the trend of Tg changing with infiltration time was consistent, showing that the results were repeatable.
研究人员将3D打印与纸基微流控技术融合，构建了无需专用设备、可手动操作的混合微流: The researchers integrated 3D printing with paper-based microfluidic technology to build a hybrid microfluidic device that does not require special equipment and can be operated manually, achieving flexible fluid path switching and reversible control, demonstrating its application potential in portable detection.
研究人员将一种新型荧光PAMAM树枝状聚合物涂层于3D打印PLA支架上，用于递送: Researchers coated a new fluorescent PAMAM dendrimer on a 3D printed PLA scaffold and used it to deliver miRNA mimics to human cells. This system can promote cell proliferation and achieve efficient transfer of miRNA without changing the oligonucleotide binding ability and transfection characteristics.
研究人员将三维打印电极应用于光电化学传感平台，其光电流响应达724.1 μA，检: The researchers applied the three-dimensional printed electrode to the photoelectrochemical sensing platform. Its photocurrent response reached 724.1 μA and the detection limit was as low as 0.05 μM, which was better than the ITO/FTO glass electrode. Energy devices can be quickly manufactured by optimizing materials and structures.
研究人员将人间充质干细胞来源的小外泌体嵌入甲基化透明质酸3D打印敷料中，通过体外: The researchers embedded small exosomes derived from human mesenchymal stem cells into a methylated hyaluronic acid 3D printed dressing and verified through in vitro experiments that it promoted the proliferation and migration of fibroblasts and endothelial cells. In vivo experiments showed that the dressing could improve wound epithelialization, angiogenesis and nerve regeneration in a diabetic pressure ulcer mouse model.
研究人员将聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯（PEGDA）3D打印的微生物反应器应用于发育中的鸡: Researchers applied polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) 3D printed microbial reactors to the developing chick embryo chorionic membrane (HET-CAM) model. The PEGDA printed material with appropriate post-processing outperformed other commercial resins in cell tests without adverse reactions, verifying its biocompatibility and the feasibility of 3D printing biomaterials.
研究人员将表达IL-1Ra的基因编辑诱导多能干细胞封装于3D打印的琼脂糖水凝胶中: Researchers encapsulated gene-edited induced pluripotent stem cells expressing IL-1Ra in 3D printed agarose hydrogel and implanted them through subcutaneous injection. The system can respond to inflammatory signals and continuously release anti-inflammatory factors, significantly alleviate disease symptoms in the K/BxN arthritis model, and has a longer implantation life than previous scaffold systems.
研究人员将通过超临界技术浸渍的芒果叶提取物导入PLA 3D打印器件，通过体外内皮: The researchers introduced mango leaf extract impregnated through supercritical technology into PLA 3D printed devices and evaluated their biocompatibility through in vitro endothelial cell culture. The results showed that the 3D printed devices impregnated at 35°C performed best in calcein culture.
研究人员开发了3D打印的磁驱动药物载药丸，在交变磁场作用下实现胃癌治疗中的局部加: Researchers have developed 3D printed magnetically driven drug-loaded pills to achieve local heating and drug release in gastric cancer treatment under the action of alternating magnetic fields.
研究人员开发了一款基于3D打印和通用硬件的低成本自动化荧光成像系统“Micros: Researchers have developed a low-cost automated fluorescence imaging system "Microscopi" based on 3D printing and general hardware. It realizes automatic navigation and imaging of samples through a simple web interface, supports switching of multiple imaging modes, and is suitable for teaching, science and field use.
研究人员开发了一款开源、3D打印的全自动显微镜，支持多种成像模式，已在坦桑尼亚和: Researchers have developed an open source, 3D printed, fully automated microscope that supports multiple imaging modes. It has been manufactured locally in Tanzania and Kenya and used in education, scientific research and clinical practice, proving that localized production can effectively improve the accessibility of microscopes.
研究人员开发了一种3D打印的压电核心/坚固包层种植牙，通过将咀嚼力转化为电信号并: Researchers have developed a 3D printed piezoelectric core/solid cladding dental implant, which reconstructs the sensory feedback of the implanted tooth by converting chewing force into electrical signals and transmitting them to the brain via the alveolar nerve. Clinical cases show that more than 90% of patients subjectively feel the restoration of chewing perception.
研究人员开发了一种3D打印的壳聚糖-淀粉网状结构填充米诺环素-海藻酸盐水凝胶，通: The researchers developed a 3D printed chitosan-starch network structure-filled minocycline-alginate hydrogel. By optimizing the formula and printing parameters, they confirmed that it inhibited methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus biofilm formation in vitro and promoted human osteoblast-like cell proliferation and bone regeneration.
研究人员开发了一种基于mRNA-LNP的微针疫苗，通过三维打印和硅胶微模制技术制: The researchers developed a microneedle vaccine based on mRNA-LNP, prepared through three-dimensional printing and silicone micro-molding technology. The system remains stable when stored at 4°C for one month or 25°C for two weeks. It can effectively induce humoral immunity and multifunctional cellular immunity in mice, and induce T cell responses in the lungs, which has certain advantages over intramuscular injection.
研究人员开发了一种基于微流体的开源3D生物打印系统（MOS3S），用于实现多材料: Researchers developed an open source 3D bioprinting system (MOS3S) based on microfluidics to achieve multi-material deposition and high-resolution printing of hierarchical tissues, verifying its feasibility in constructing centimeter-scale complex scaffold structures.
研究人员开发了首款3D打印多功能阴道环，装载抗HIV、抗HSV-2和避孕药物，通: Researchers have developed the first 3D printed multifunctional vaginal ring, which is loaded with anti-HIV, anti-HSV-2 and contraceptive drugs. The sustained release of the three drugs is achieved through single-step loading. It is stable and safe in macaques and can effectively prevent unwanted pregnancy and two sexually transmitted infections.
研究人员开发并测试了首个全3D打印的RAKT模拟器“RAKT Box”，用于模拟: Researchers developed and tested the first fully 3D printed RAKT simulator "RAKT Box" to simulate the vascular anastomosis steps in robot-assisted kidney transplantation. It was used by experts and four training doctors with different backgrounds. The results showed that its technology is reliable and can effectively distinguish differences in operating time and performance among different trainees.
研究人员构建了一种开源、模块化的双视角显微镜（GLUBscope），用于观察具有: Researchers built an open-source, modular dual-view microscope (GLUBscope) for observing aquatic organisms with complex morphologies. It achieves comprehensive visualization through top and side-view images, and is more suitable for studying organisms with complex morphologies than traditional systems.
研究人员研制了一种模拟大鼠头部的仿生模型，包含仿生脑组织、六个电偶极子和十四个电: The researchers developed a bionic model that simulates a rat head, including bionic brain tissue, six electric dipoles and fourteen electrodes. The 3D printed skull based on CT scans was enlarged and used to test the performance of EEG source positioning technology.
研究人员设计了一款三维打印的肌电控制义手，经健康人和截肢者测试，该义手在50%的: Researchers designed a three-dimensional printed myoelectrically controlled prosthetic hand. After testing on healthy people and amputees, the prosthetic hand successfully picked up objects of different shapes and sizes in 50% of the grasping tests, with a grasping force of 30.4 N and a response time of 4.5 seconds.
研究人员设计了低成本、一次性、3D打印的共轴视频喉镜，经人形模型验证，在易到难的: Researchers designed a low-cost, disposable, 3D-printed coaxial video laryngoscope. It was verified by a humanoid model that it can successfully complete tracheal intubation under different operating conditions from easy to difficult, and complies with ISO7376:2020 standards.
研究人员设计并3D打印了一款鼻咽拭子采集模拟器，其可模拟鼻咽部结构软硬度与解剖标: Researchers designed and 3D printed a nasopharyngeal swab collection simulator, which can simulate the softness and hardness of the nasopharyngeal structure and anatomical landmarks. It has real-time feedback function, allows incorrect insertion operations, and facilitates training. The manufacturing files can be obtained for free through open links.
研究人员设计并制作了模拟锥细胞的3D打印假体，用于评估眼底自适应光学成像系统的横: The researchers designed and produced a 3D printed prosthesis that simulated cones to evaluate the lateral resolution and contrast of the fundus adaptive optics imaging system. The prosthesis has been verified by multiple samples and can effectively support the performance evaluation of two different imaging modes.
研究人员设计并制备了一种基于3D打印的Printzyme装置，将来自Tramet: Researchers design and prepare a 3D printing-based Printzyme device that will be sourced from Trametes Versicolor's laccase is immobilized in polyethylene glycol diacrylate hydrogel. The device is stable under mild conditions and performs better than free enzymes in extreme environments of pH and temperature. After testing, it can efficiently degrade two drugs in water - diclofenac and ethinyl estradiol, with removal rates of 95% (24 hours) and 95% (2 hours) respectively, which is better than free enzymes.
研究人员设计并制备了一种基于聚合物的透皮给药系统，该系统集成3D打印的压电微泵与: The researchers designed and prepared a polymer-based transdermal drug delivery system that integrates 3D printed piezoelectric micropumps and microneedle arrays and is realized through additive manufacturing technology. It can achieve stable water delivery with a maximum flow rate of 1.03 mL/min, a maximum back pressure of 1.37 kPa, and an energy consumption of only 400 mW. It has good manufacturability and application potential.
研究人员设计并制造了3D打印的微流控芯片，通过将单模光纤插入装置，利用反向激光与: The researchers designed and manufactured a 3D printed microfluidic chip. By inserting a single-mode optical fiber into the device and using reverse laser and fluid flow to form optofluidic separation, the researchers achieved separation and sorting of particles based on refractive index and size, verifying the device's stable performance in optical manipulation of particles.
研究人员设计并制造了一款低成本（低于1000美元）的3D打印义手，具备五指活动、: The researchers designed and manufactured a low-cost (less than US$1,000) 3D printed prosthetic hand with five-finger movable, rotating wrists and adjustable sleeves. It achieves 18 degrees of freedom of movement through 7 servo motors and tendon systems. The finger structure was optimized through SolidWorks modeling to achieve grasping and object manipulation in actual use.
研究人员设计并制造了一种3D打印的喷射混合器，通过两组微喷嘴对射增强可混溶液体界: The researchers designed and manufactured a 3D printed jet mixer that enhances interfacial mixing of miscible liquids through two sets of micro-nozzles. Its mixing efficiency is significantly better than that of commonly used Y-shaped micro-mixers, and effective mixing can be achieved within 3 seconds.
研究人员设计并评估了一种3D打印微流控芯片，用于脑脊液引流，该装置采用柔性材料并: Researchers designed and evaluated a 3D printed microfluidic chip for cerebrospinal fluid drainage. The device uses flexible materials and has a one-way valve to effectively regulate cerebrospinal fluid flow. Experiments show no obstruction and minimal cell attachment, providing a feasible model for the next generation of cerebrospinal fluid shunt devices.
研究人员设计并验证了一台全3D打印的低成本光学显微镜，采用3D打印支架与光学组件: The researchers designed and verified a fully 3D printed low-cost optical microscope, using 3D printed brackets and optical components, combined with LED lighting controlled by Raspberry Pi, and using a single 3D printed objective lens with 2.9x magnification and a numerical aperture of 0.07 to image Giemsa-stained blood smears and hematoxylin-eosin-stained mouse kidney tissue sections, achieving subcellular resolution and observing individual red blood cells and the fine structure of kidney tissue.
研究人员设计并验证了一种低成本、多功能的3D打印影像质量与剂量验证假体，其包含水: Researchers designed and validated a low-cost, multifunctional 3D-printed image quality and dose verification prosthesis that contains a water- and wax-filled homogeneous slab, a high spatial resolution slab, and a low-contrast detectable slab that meets American College of Radiology (ACR) quality control standards for CT simulators and linear accelerators.
研究人员评估了改良型全脸潜水面罩在耳鼻喉科和胸外科手术中的舒适性与实用性，结果显: Researchers evaluated the comfort and practicality of the modified full-face diving mask in otolaryngology and thoracic surgery. The results showed that it has a good field of vision, no obvious obstacles to use, water vapor condensation is rare, and the blood gas parameters of the surgeon remain normal during the operation.
研究人员通过3D打印制备了具有肌电敏感性的水凝胶电极，集成于可拉伸高密度肌电阵列: Researchers prepared hydrogel electrodes with electromyographic sensitivity through 3D printing and integrated them into stretchable high-density electromyographic arrays to achieve high-fidelity electromyographic signal collection at complex skin interfaces. In vivo studies of the system confirmed that it can achieve real-time and precise control of prosthetic hands.
研究人员通过3D打印结合微加工等工艺制备集成微针生物传感装置，将其植入小鼠皮肤真: The researchers used 3D printing combined with micromachining and other processes to prepare an integrated microneedle biosensing device and implanted it into the dermis layer of mouse skin to achieve continuous and painless monitoring of subcutaneous blood sugar in normal and diabetic mice. The test results were highly correlated with commercial blood glucose meters.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制作了具有复杂几何结构的单体EIT成像幻影，通过调节内部: The researchers used 3D printing technology to produce a single EIT imaging phantom with a complex geometric structure. By adjusting the internal filling density to achieve different conductivity areas, it was successfully used for EIT equipment calibration. The obtained images were consistent with the simulation results, verifying the effectiveness of the method.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制作腹壁深静脉筋膜下血管树的等比例模型，辅助腹壁穿支血管: Researchers used 3D printing technology to create an equal-scale model of the subfascial vascular tree of the deep abdominal wall vein to assist in the intramuscular anatomy of the abdominal wall perforating vessels to clarify their intramuscular path.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制备了低成本电极，结合差分脉冲伏安法，用于乳腺乳汁、合成: Researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare low-cost electrodes, combined with differential pulse voltammetry, for the detection of sulfa drugs in breast milk, synthetic urine and pharmaceutical liquid samples. The sensor has low detection limit, wide linear range, high precision and good selectivity, does not require complex sample pre-processing, and shows excellent accuracy and anti-interference ability.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制备了基于FRET原理的葡萄糖传感器，将ConA和dex: The researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare a glucose sensor based on the FRET principle. ConA and dextran were encapsulated in alginate microspheres and embedded in PVA hydrogel. Through the characteristic that the fluorescence intensity increases with the increase of glucose concentration, the continuous monitoring of dynamic changes in glucose in HEK cell culture fluid was achieved, and it showed good cell compatibility and adhesion.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制备了新型牙种植体附件，金属原型在模拟临时修复中表现可行: Researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare a new type of dental implant attachment. The metal prototype was feasible in simulating temporary repairs, but there was a problem with thread accuracy and required further processing.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制备壳聚糖/海藻酸盐水凝胶，实现银硫胺的控释，验证了该技: The researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare chitosan/alginate hydrogel to achieve controlled release of silver thiamine, verifying the feasibility of this technology in wound healing.
研究人员采用3D打印技术制备聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）耳假体，探究其对压力和温度的响: Researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare a polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) ear prosthesis and explored its response to pressure and temperature. The results showed that the prosthesis has reliable performance in the pressure range of 0 Pa to 16,350 Pa and the temperature range of 2°C to 90°C. The pressure and temperature changes have an approximately linear and inverse relationship with the frequency response. It is the first time that 3D printing materials have pressure and temperature sensing functions.
研究人员采用3D打印技术，利用熔融沉积建模法设计并制作了面罩护具，旨在为医疗人员: Researchers used 3D printing technology and fused deposition modeling to design and produce face shields, aiming to provide medical personnel with a feasible personal protective equipment to meet the protection needs of the new coronavirus epidemic.
研究人员采用3D打印技术，在视觉障碍患者用的布洛芬盐酸盐缓释片表面刻印盲文图案，: Researchers used 3D printing technology to engrave Braille patterns on the surface of ibuprofen hydrochloride sustained-release tablets for visually impaired patients. By optimizing the hydrogel ink and regulating the polymer system, the drug dissolution rate was controlled, and the Braille pattern could be recognized by visually impaired patients.
研究人员采用3D打印技术，结合热熔挤出和压力辅助微注射法，制备了缓释他克莫司片，: The researchers used 3D printing technology, combined with hot melt extrusion and pressure-assisted microinjection, to prepare sustained-release tacrolimus tablets. By optimizing the formula, 86% of the drug was released in 12 hours. The dissolution characteristics are similar to commercial products and meet quality standards, with the potential for personalized drug delivery.
研究人员采用3D打印模具结合双层成型工艺，制备了不同形状、尺寸的柔性空心微针，用: Researchers used 3D printing molds combined with a double-layer molding process to prepare flexible hollow microneedles of different shapes and sizes for the treatment of psoriasis. In vivo experiments in mice showed that it can achieve efficacy with only 0.1 times the oral dose, and the side effects and toxicity are reduced.
研究人员采用3D生物打印技术制备了聚乙烯醇/壳聚糖-海藻酸盐双交联复合支架并涂覆: The researchers used 3D bioprinting technology to prepare a polyvinyl alcohol/chitosan-alginate double cross-linked composite scaffold and coated it with turmeric extract. Through rheology, scanning electron microscopy and in vitro release experiments, it was found that the scaffold had excellent mechanical properties, controllable degradation behavior and long-lasting turmeric release capability, and showed significant antioxidant activity and cytocompatibility, which was better than the pure PVA group.
研究人员采用低成本3D打印的集成透镜-双棱镜元件，改进立体显微镜照明均匀性，使透: The researchers used low-cost 3D printed integrated lens-biprism components to improve the illumination uniformity of the stereomicroscope, increasing the image contrast of transparent biological samples to 67.62% of conventional settings, effectively enhancing the visibility of refractive structures.
研究人员采用微流体打印技术制备了具有滑液填充多孔表面的三维聚氨酯微纤维织物，用于: Researchers used microfluidic printing technology to prepare three-dimensional polyurethane microfiber fabrics with synovial fluid-filled porous surfaces for periwound drainage. The fabric can transport droplets non-destructively and quickly, and combined with negative pressure drainage can significantly improve drainage efficiency, reduce tissue damage and extend use time.
研究人员采用微流体调控3D生物打印技术，制备了聚氨酯与生物活性玻璃墨水组成的双功: The researchers used microfluidic controlled 3D bioprinting technology to prepare a bifunctional skin patch composed of polyurethane and bioactive glass ink. It has a bionic structure and electronic sensing functions, which can promote blood vessel regeneration, enhance hemostasis, inhibit bacterial growth, and realize pressure signal detection. The sensitivity reaches 5.87 kPa⁻¹, the detection range is 0–150 kPa, and the cycle stability exceeds 500 times.
研究人员采用数字光处理3D打印技术制备了含微米级光致变色染料（粉红、蓝色及其混合: The researchers used digital light processing 3D printing technology to prepare ultraviolet sensing optical fibers containing micron-level photochromic dyes (pink, blue and their mixtures), and detected ultraviolet exposure through optical fibers of different lengths and directions. The results showed that the reflection and transmission losses increased with increasing length. The pink dye fibers responded quickly to ultraviolet, and the response time of the mixed fibers was up to 12-20 seconds.
研究人员采用立体光刻3D打印技术制备了三种容量（1、10、100 µL）的薄型可: The researchers used stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare thin refillable microreservoirs of three volumes (1, 10, 100 µL). Its force-free membrane structure achieves zero forward flow and 2% reverse flow. The pre-compressed septum can withstand about 65,000 leak-free fillings. It is suitable for implantable and transdermal drug delivery in animals and humans, as well as laboratory and point-of-care testing applications.
研究人员采用立体光刻3D打印技术制备聚合物扩散细胞，通过施加不同涂层以防止药物残: The researchers used stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare polymer diffusion cells, and applied different coatings to prevent drug residues. The results showed that one of the coatings reduced drug adsorption, and finally verified the effectiveness of the model in voriconazole eye drops.
研究人员采用选择性激光熔融3D打印技术，制备了具有多孔结构的乐高式钛支架，通过手: The researchers used selective laser melting 3D printing technology to prepare a Lego-style titanium stent with a porous structure, and achieved personalized matching of defective parts through manual assembly. The results showed that the cell proliferation and bone formation capabilities of the semi-porous and super-porous groups were better than those of the non-porous group, and the scaffold had good biocompatibility and mechanical properties.
研究人员采用高仿真3D打印儿童肘部模型，结合实时荧光影像反馈，对19名骨科住院医: Researchers used high-simulation 3D printed children's elbow models, combined with real-time fluorescence image feedback, to train 19 orthopedic residents on supracondylar fracture K-wiring operations. The results showed that the trainees' self-confidence increased by an average of 1.15 points after surgery.
研究人员，体现材料制造、传感与生物过程共同开发的关系: Researchers embodying the relationship between materials manufacturing, sensing and biological processes co-developed
研究从“能够释放抗菌或抗肿瘤药物”推进到比较组合与时序。局部浓度越高、释放越久并: Research has advanced from “being able to release antibacterial or anti-tumor drugs” to comparing combinations versus timing. Higher local concentrations and longer releases do not automatically constitute the best solution. The real optimization goal is to reach the window of action and manage local damage.
研究从个别设备的快速响应转向组织能力：谁提出需求、谁验证、谁生产、谁接收。产品类: The study moves from the rapid response of individual equipment to organizational capabilities: who requests it, who verifies it, who produces it, who receives it. The closer the product type is to patient contact, diagnostics, or life support, the more prominent the role of joint validation in the overall process.
研究从低成本单透镜发展到整机应用和特殊阵列。表面测量、光束测试与生物成像相互补充: Research progresses from low-cost single lenses to full machine applications and special arrays. Surface measurement, beam testing and bioimaging complement each other, gradually forming a verification chain from manufacturing to mission
研究从几何展示进入工作流和决策评价。新趋势是把不同模型形式组合使用，并按问题选择: Research moves from geometric presentation into workflow and decision evaluation. The new trend is to combine different model forms and choose rigid, soft tissue or dynamic representation according to the problem
研究从制造多个成分，转向分别控制成分的空间位置、物理状态与释放。随后，医院供药与: Research has shifted from manufacturing multiple components to individually controlling the spatial location, physical state and release of the components. Subsequently, the hospital provides drugs and patients use the combination plan into the specific treatment process.
研究从外形匹配进入力学功能匹配。扫描解决形状问题，材料和结构决定刚度分布，行走测: The study proceeds from appearance matching to mechanical function matching. Scan to solve the shape problem, the material and structure determine the stiffness distribution, and the walking test verifies whether these parameters meet the usage requirements. The value of digitalization has gradually shifted from "being able to customize" to "being able to explain why it is customized in this way".
研究从应急替代逐步走向群体适配和结构功能设计。儿童尺寸与微晶格分别体现解剖约束和: Research gradually moves from emergency substitution to group adaptation and structural functional design. Children's size and micro lattice reflect the two routes of anatomical constraints and deformable structure respectively, and the test model helps the two to be compared under real tasks.
研究从支架结构与细胞存活，扩展到长期灌流、机械刺激及多细胞功能。打印的作用也由一: Research has expanded from scaffold structure and cell survival to long-term perfusion, mechanical stimulation and multi-cell function. The role of printing also extends from one-time manufacturing to the spatial organization of the entire culture system.
研究从材料价格与打印耗时，逐步扩展到完整工作流与服务组织。开放工具降低起步门槛，: The research has gradually expanded from material prices and printing time to complete workflow and service organization. Open tools lower the threshold for starting, and quality inspection and personnel capabilities determine whether it can expand steadily.
研究从满意度与结构识别，推进到病理解释和病例推理。可拆分、患者特异性和混合呈现形: Research progresses from satisfaction and structure identification to pathological interpretation and case reasoning. Divisible, patient-specific and hybrid presentation formats gradually enrich course design
研究从辅料能否打印，发展到药物状态、内部结构与释放的联合表征。非破坏结构测量和光: Research has evolved from whether excipients can be printed to the joint characterization of drug status, internal structure and release. Non-destructive structural measurements and spectral analysis enable easier interpretation of relationships between designs and actual formulations
研究从透明、相容的静态结构，延伸到灌流、梯度和力学刺激共同参与的培养系统。评价范: Research extends from transparent, compatible static structures to culture systems involving perfusion, gradients and mechanical stimulation. The scope of evaluation has also expanded from short-term survival to long-term functionality and experimental reproducibility.
研究任务因而从“哪种纹理促进成骨”扩展为“同一表面如何兼顾不同细胞和细菌作用”。: The research task thus expanded from "which texture promotes osteogenesis" to "how the same surface accommodates different cellular and bacterial effects." The next step is to align the texture area, ion release location, and actual tissue contact boundary and observe the duration of action and surface changes.
研究优化了90:10 wt% PLGA/HA支架的3D打印参数，发现层高0.12: The study optimized the 3D printing parameters of the 90:10 wt% PLGA/HA scaffold and found that when the layer height was 0.12 mm and the nozzle temperature was 205°C, the bending strength and modulus increased by 20% and 50% respectively, and the fatigue limit reached 1.2 MPa after 106 cycles in PBS. After 60 days of degradation in vitro, the strength and modulus were still higher than the lower limit of cancellous bone.
研究优化了人骨髓间充质干细胞嵌入藻酸盐-明胶微球的电喷雾制备，将其组装于3D打印: The study optimized the electrospray preparation of human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells embedded in alginate-gelatin microspheres and assembled them into 3D printed polyε-caprolactone scaffolds. The results showed that under 3D bioreactor culture, cell proliferation and cartilage-specific marker expression in the microsphere-embedded scaffold group were significantly better than those in the 2D culture group.
研究会同时记录温度、停留、剪切和后处理，以解释差异: The study records temperature, dwell, shear and post-processing simultaneously to account for differences
研究使用3D打印心脏支架和Catphan 500 体模，对比120与100 kV: The study used a 3D printed cardiac stent and Catphan 500 phantom to compare the image quality of different ASIR intensities under conditions of 120 and 100 kVp. The results showed that ASIR 60% has the best low-contrast detection effect at 120 kVp, and the image quality changes slightly under each tube voltage.
研究使用3D打印手术导板进行无切口种植体植入的技术操作。: Study the technical operation of incisionless implant placement using 3D printed surgical guides.
研究使用实体可拆打印牙齿的离体上颌模型验证CBCT注册方法，属于医疗实验模型；打: This study uses an in vitro maxillary model with solid detachable printed teeth to verify the CBCT registration method, which is a medical experimental model; the printing material and process are not clear in the local context.
研究使用患者定制的肺模型，对比了基于CZT的光子计数CT与传统能量积分探测CT在: The study used a patient-customized lung model to compare the image quality and radiomic consistency of CZT-based photon counting CT and traditional energy integral detection CT in low-dose lung cancer screening. The results showed that CZT-CT was superior to traditional CT in terms of lower noise, higher contrast, and better feature stability.
研究公开结构与控制方案，使其他研究者能够制作同类设备。要形成可比较结果，还需要保: The research exposes the structure and control scheme so that other researchers can build similar devices. To produce comparable results, it is also necessary to retain the objective, camera, material and software configurations and to make it clear which version the measurements were made for
研究分别针对3D食物打印和脊柱植入物，通过调节食品墨水的流变性能优化打印效果，以: The research focuses on 3D food printing and spinal implants respectively, optimizing the printing effect by adjusting the rheological properties of food ink, and constructing a hybrid structure of polycaprolactone and E-shell polymer to improve the mechanical strength and cell growth adaptability of the implants.
研究分析了37个面罩和31个面屏的3D打印参数，结果显示面屏打印速度约为面罩的两: The study analyzed the 3D printing parameters of 37 masks and 31 visors. The results showed that the printing speed of visors is about twice that of masks, the consumables are about half, and 1.5 parts need to be printed for visors and 5 parts for masks.
研究则让三十名儿童尝试吞咽打印安慰剂，并评价口感和接受性。两项工作分别回答“愿意: The study asked 30 children to try swallowing a printed placebo and evaluate taste and acceptability. The two tasks answer "what are you willing to choose" and "is it actually acceptable" respectively, and provide patient-side constraints for geometric design.
研究利用 photorealistic 虚拟图像训练机器视觉模型，对 SLA 3: The study used photorealistic virtual images to train a machine vision model to classify the quality of SLA 3D printed capsules, tablets and films. It achieved a classification accuracy of 80.8% for capsules, 74.3% for tablets and 75.5% for films, and maintained stable performance in large-scale and interference image tests, verifying the feasibility of virtual images in 3D printed drug quality control.
研究利用3D打印与液态灌装协同技术，实现患者特异液体胶囊的即需制备，通过同步或分: The research uses 3D printing and liquid filling collaborative technology to realize the on-demand preparation of patient-specific liquid capsules. By printing the shell layer synchronously or step by step and filling the medicinal solution, the thickness and structure of the shell layer can be adjusted to achieve controlled drug release, and the dispenser dosage is accurate and suitable for a variety of liquid preparations.
研究利用3D打印制备人甲板替代模型，将含 ciclopirox olamine: The study used 3D printing to prepare a human deck replacement model, and applied an antifungal solution containing ciclopirox olamine to the model surface every day for 14 days. Confocal Raman spectroscopy was used to detect drug penetration. The results showed that the drug could be absorbed by the model deck and formed a repeatable depth distribution, and no drug was detected in the receptor phase.
研究利用3D打印微流控装置，通过多重免疫亲和层析技术从人血清中选择性提取三种早产: The study used a 3D printed microfluidic device to selectively extract three premature biomarkers from human serum through multiplex immunoaffinity chromatography technology, achieving collaborative extraction and separation of the three markers and providing a new method for preterm birth risk detection.
研究利用3D打印心 体模模拟心脏动态，通过超敏感数字PET/CT首次通过图像测量: The study used a 3D printed heart phantom to simulate cardiac dynamics, and used ultra-sensitive digital PET/CT to measure left ventricular ejection fraction through images for the first time. The manually segmented 3D PET images were highly consistent with MRI and reference values. The results obtained by the pseudo-two-dimensional PET image method were also close to the reference values. However, automated software performed poorly on PET images.
研究利用3D打印技术制备含多种药物的口服装置，通过多层或双腔结构设计实现药物的独: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare oral devices containing multiple drugs, and achieved independent release of drugs through multi-layer or dual-chamber structural design. Raman spectroscopy verified the hierarchical distribution of drugs, and the release behavior varied with the structural design, confirming that this technology can achieve special release characteristics that cannot be obtained by traditional methods.
研究利用3D打印技术结合基因手段制造个性化医疗产品，实现药物按需分配，目前已有植: Research uses 3D printing technology combined with genetic means to manufacture personalized medical products to achieve on-demand distribution of drugs. Currently, implants and other products are on the market, but regulatory obstacles still exist. The focus is on the future application challenges of FDM technology in clinics and pharmacies.
研究利用3D打印技术，以单一配方制备不同几何形状（网状、环状和实心）的对乙酰氨基: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare acetaminophen tablets of different geometric shapes (network, ring and solid) with a single formula. Adjustable drug release performance was achieved by regulating the geometric structure. The release rate was positively correlated with the surface area/volume ratio and surface area, and all indicators met USP standards.
研究利用3D打印技术，基于开源设计制作防护面罩头带，经对比筛选科学支持的模型，最: The research uses 3D printing technology to produce protective mask headbands based on open source designs. After comparison and screening of scientifically supported models, the Prusa RC 3 design was finally adopted to produce about 30 masks per week, and a total of 126 masks were produced and delivered within 4 weeks, effectively alleviating the shortage of protective equipment on the frontline of medical care.
研究利用3D打印技术，针对个体化定制药物产品，实现按需设计，替代传统批量生产，推: Research uses 3D printing technology to customize drug products for individual needs, realize on-demand design, replace traditional mass production, and promote the development of clinical pharmacy practice in the direction of personalization.
研究利用3D打印树脂制备针对大肠杆菌的表面印迹聚合物，通过荧光显微镜评估其结构与: The study used 3D printing resin to prepare surface-imprinted polymers for E. coli, and evaluated its structure and rebinding ability through fluorescence microscopy, verifying its specific recognition of the target strain and testing its cross-selectivity against five other strains.
研究利用三维打印技术在药房制造肠溶胶囊的可行性。: Study the feasibility of using 3D printing technology to manufacture enteric-coated capsules in pharmacies.
研究利用低成本SLA和FDM 3D打印机，将硬质聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯部件与软质热塑性: The study used low-cost SLA and FDM 3D printers to combine hard polymethyl methacrylate parts with soft thermoplastic polyurethane parts. Leak-free connections were achieved through precise alignment and heating, and finger-driven pumps, quick-connect couplers and nucleic acid amplification detection devices were successfully prepared.
研究利用加速度计和麦克风采集肌电振动信号，通过小波包变换和均方根提取特征，结合支: The study uses accelerometers and microphones to collect myoelectric vibration signals, extracts features through wavelet packet transform and root mean square, and combines support vector machine classification to identify the hand movements of 6 subjects (including 2 amputees) to achieve prosthetic control based on MMG signals. The average accuracy of offline and online tests was 88.94% and 84.45% respectively.
研究利用双材料3D打印微流控技术，构建具有化学极性的功能化人工细胞，通过滴液网络: The research uses dual-material 3D printing microfluidic technology to construct functionalized artificial cells with chemical polarity. Through the integration of droplet networks, lipid membranes and nanomaterials, internal gradients and spatial hierarchical structures are achieved, forming an asymmetric artificial cell system with directional and separated chemical reactions.
研究利用商用3D打印机快速、低成本制造微针母模，通过调节层高、层数和灰度，实现尖: The study uses commercial 3D printers to quickly and cost-effectively manufacture microneedle master molds. By adjusting the layer height, number of layers, and gray scale, sharp microneedles with a tip radius of about 15 μm and a size deviation of ±5% can be achieved, shortening the preparation time and improving structural accuracy.
研究利用增强现实技术辅助盆腔肿瘤切除术中手术导板放置与骨切开，结果显示该方法在3: The study uses augmented reality technology to assist surgical guide placement and bone incision during pelvic tumor resection. The results show that this method is feasible and accurate in 3D printed models. Even if the surgical guide fails, it can provide reliable guidance, significantly improve the operation accuracy, and do not increase the operation time.
研究利用开源软件和院内3D打印技术，制作颌骨截骨导板，实现术前精准规划与术中准确: The study uses open source software and in-hospital 3D printing technology to produce jaw osteotomy guides to achieve precise preoperative planning and accurate intraoperative positioning. Compared with outsourcing solutions, the cost is lower, the cycle is shorter, and the predictability of surgery is improved.
研究利用开源软件对颅面CT数据进行处理，分割解剖结构，构建三维虚拟模型并转换为可: The research uses open source software to process craniofacial CT data, segment anatomical structures, build three-dimensional virtual models and convert them into formats that can be used for additive manufacturing, aiming to produce localized craniofacial implants that are equivalent to commercial products.
研究利用患者来源的鼻上皮祖细胞，通过滴基于3D生物打印技术，在Transwell: The study uses patient-derived nasal epithelial progenitor cells to build a nasal epithelial tissue model in a Transwell well plate at high throughput based on 3D bioprinting technology to achieve the formation of pseudolamellar columnar epithelial structure, cilia and tight junctions, and support respiratory virus infection.
研究利用手机微距镜头和3D打印低成本显微镜，结合卷积神经网络优化相位对比照明，通: The research uses mobile phone macro lenses and 3D printed low-cost microscopes, combined with convolutional neural networks to optimize phase contrast illumination, determines the optimal illumination shape through machine learning, and improves the phase contrast and optical resolution of transparent samples without the need for additional optical components.
研究利用木薯纤维制备PVA-纤维生物聚合物复合材料，通过3D打印构建多孔结构，发: The study used cassava fiber to prepare PVA-fiber biopolymer composites and constructed a porous structure through 3D printing. It was found that the pore width and structural thickness can regulate drug release behavior. Wide pores promote diffusion, while narrow pores and thick structures exhibit non-Fickian release dominated by water absorption of the polymer.
研究利用气泡相关原理构建呼吸支持装置，进行性能与基准测试。研究处于原理和台架验证: Research on using bubble-related principles to construct respiratory support devices and conduct performance and benchmark testing. The research is in the proof-of-principle and bench-based stages, and its focus is on what the device can output under different conditions rather than on proven patient benefit.
研究利用热熔喷墨3D打印技术，将Compritol HD5 ATO脂质与药物单独: The study uses hot-melt inkjet 3D printing technology to print Compritol HD5 ATO lipids and drugs individually or in combination, successfully preparing complex personalized solid preparations with immediate, delayed release, delayed and pulse release characteristics.
研究利用生物打印、Kenzan及生物夹持等技术，构建含原始微血管的纳米至微米级球: The research uses technologies such as bioprinting, Kenzan and biological clamping to construct nano- to micron-sized spheres or bead-like aggregates containing original microvessels to simulate the densely distributed capillary network in the vascular system, focusing on its application in vascular tissue engineering.
研究利用立体光刻3D打印结合碱活化技术，对废弃药用玻璃进行再利用，制备出可重复使: The study uses stereolithography 3D printing combined with alkali activation technology to reuse waste medicinal glass to prepare a reusable adsorption filter material, which has an adsorption efficiency of 81% for methyl blue and can be easily separated and recycled.
研究利用选择性激光烧结3D打印技术，制备了5至25毫克不同剂量的泼尼松片，其释放: The study used selective laser sintering 3D printing technology to prepare prednisone tablets of different dosages from 5 to 25 mg. The release characteristics are similar to commercially available preparations and comply with pharmacopoeia quality standards, demonstrating the feasibility of personalized dosage administration.
研究利用黑茶和乌龙茶 kombucha 生物膜经部分水解制备3D打印生物支架，通: The study used partial hydrolysis of black tea and oolong tea kombucha biofilms to prepare 3D printed bioscaffolds. The cell viability was evaluated by culturing L929 cells and fibroblasts. The results showed that the cell survival rate of the oolong tea group was higher and the cells could adhere to the scaffold, indicating that the material can be used as a tissue scaffold.
研究利用鼻腔铸模等体外模型，评估不同鼻用制剂在鼻腔内的沉积分布，通过区域分割和定: The study uses in vitro models such as nasal cavity casts to evaluate the deposition distribution of different nasal preparations in the nasal cavity, and compares the deposition differences between powder and liquid forms through regional segmentation and quantitative analysis to optimize targeted deposition and guide patient use. The results show that this model is helpful in understanding the distribution characteristics of drugs in the nasal cavity.
研究制作肾脏与腮腺相关体模，比较已知注入活度与影像估计。研究发现部分容积效应相关: Research on making kidney and parotid gland-related phantoms and comparing known injection activity with image estimation. The study found deviations related to partial volume effects, indicating that organ shape can affect quantitative results and that standard simple geometry cannot cover all situations.
研究制备了含卡马西平的3D打印口崩片，经PVP K30赋形，平均硬度18.5 N: A 3D printed orally disintegrating tablet containing carbamazepine was prepared in this study. It was extruded with PVP K30, has an average hardness of 18.5 N, disintegrates in 84 seconds, has a drug loading of 90.56%, and releases 68.3% in acid within 45 minutes. The taste test shows that there is no bitter taste, and sweeteners can mask the bitter taste. The preparation is suitable for administration to children.
研究制备了含氟康唑10%至70%的3D打印口崩片，通过熔融沉积法打印，经扫描电镜: The study prepared 3D printed orally disintegrating tablets containing 10% to 70% fluconazole, which were printed by fused deposition method. The structural quality was confirmed by scanning electron microscopy. All samples disintegrated within 3 minutes, with a release rate of over 95% within 30 minutes, and were stable for two weeks when stored at room temperature.
研究制备了基于非异氰酸酯聚氨酯丙烯酸酯（NIPUA）的光敏树脂，通过优化PEGD: The study prepared a photosensitive resin based on non-isocyanate polyurethane acrylate (NIPUA), and improved its mechanical properties and biocompatibility by optimizing the PEGDA content. The results showed that it was better than commercial resin, showed good biocompatibility for bone cells, muscle cells and macrophages, and did not trigger an inflammatory reaction when implanted in the body.
研究制备了由珊瑚衍生羟基磷灰石纳米颗粒/聚己内酯/明胶组成的3D打印复合支架，通: The study prepared a 3D printed composite scaffold composed of coral-derived hydroxyapatite nanoparticles/polycaprolactone/gelatin. Its mechanical properties were optimized by adjusting the components. The results showed that its compressive modulus and strength reached 0.29 GPa and 9.9 MPa, a hydroxyapatite layer is formed on the surface within 28 days, the drug loading efficiency is 1.6%, the release is stable, and it is non-toxic to MG-63 cells and promotes their proliferation. It has good biological activity, mechanical properties and biocompatibility, and can be used as a carrier for bone tumor treatment.
研究制备了载有卡铂和紫杉醇的PCL丝材，通过热熔挤出法优化配方，经表征显示其药物: The study prepared PCL filaments loaded with carboplatin and paclitaxel, and optimized the formula through hot-melt extrusion. Characterization showed that the drug encapsulation rate reached 85% and could achieve controlled release for 10 days. In vitro experiments showed that cell viability was reduced by more than 60%, providing a feasible 3D printed drug release device for personalized treatment of uterine cancer.
研究加工商Ti-6Al-4V合金在牙科和颌面植入物中的疲劳行为与表面改性，通过喷: Study the fatigue behavior and surface modification of processor Ti-6Al-4V alloy in dental and maxillofacial implants, improve cell attachment and osseointegration through sandblasting and coating treatment, and combine in vitro cell and in vivo experiments to confirm the synergistic optimization effect of appropriate surface roughness and manufacturing process on biocompatibility and mechanical properties.
研究半固态挤出3D打印在药物递送与生物医学中的个性化医疗解决方案。: Research on semi-solid extrusion 3D printing for personalized medical solutions in drug delivery and biomedicine.
研究发展由“哪一种更准确”转向“哪一步需要哪一种约束或反馈”。颅骨联合流程、骨盆: Research and development shifted from "which one is more accurate" to "which step requires which constraint or feedback". Cranial symphysis flow, augmented reality pelvic positioning and adjustable physical guides reflect this change
研究发现，3D打印手术导板切割过程中产生的聚氨酯和光聚合物碎屑会抑制鼠成骨细胞增: Studies have found that polyurethane and photopolymer debris generated during the cutting process of 3D printed surgical guides can inhibit mouse osteoblast proliferation and bone formation. Although the substrate itself has good biocompatibility, the debris may have an adverse effect on bone healing.
研究发现，3D打印牙科修复树脂的打印方向（0°与90°）会影响其颜色和半透明度，: Research has found that the printing direction (0° and 90°) of 3D printed dental restorative resin will affect its color and translucency. Different materials and color numbers have different performances. It is necessary to select the appropriate printing direction according to the material characteristics to ensure the aesthetic effect.
研究发现，3D打印钛材料中开放型多孔结构（钛A）因孔隙互联且接近天然骨结构，提升: Research has found that the open porous structure (titanium A) in 3D printed titanium materials improves the adhesion and osteoinductive properties of dental pulp stem cells and is superior to other structural designs because the pores are interconnected and close to the natural bone structure.
研究发现，E-Shell 300材料对斑马鱼胚胎造成严重发育毒性并抑制体外细胞增: The study found that E-Shell 300 material caused severe developmental toxicity to zebrafish embryos and inhibited cell proliferation in vitro, but post-treatment with 96% ethanol could reduce embryonic mortality and eliminate the toxic effects.
研究发现，ESCC细胞中NRAGE核表达升高可增强放射抵抗，与Wnt/β-cat: Studies have found that increased nuclear expression of NRAGE in ESCC cells can enhance radioresistance and is related to the activation of the Wnt/β-catenin pathway. Furthermore, the nuclear expression level of NRAGE increases significantly in patients ineffective for radiotherapy and is positively correlated. It can be used as a potential biomarker of radiotherapy response.
研究发现，与仅培养的细胞组相比，脂肪组织和骨髓来源的间充质干细胞在三维打印PCL: The study found that compared with the culture-only cell group, adipose tissue and bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells cultured on three-dimensional printed PCL/β-TCP scaffolds showed greater osteogenic differentiation, while the group using osteodifferentiation medium had a lower degree of differentiation.
研究发现，仅由壳聚糖微条带构成的3D打印速溶口腔薄膜能形成亲水通道，缩短崩解时间: The study found that 3D printed instant oral films composed only of chitosan microstrips can form hydrophilic channels, shorten the disintegration time, and can be achieved at lower concentrations.
研究发现，牙科聚合物表面横向特征间距（LS）显著影响白色念珠菌的致病相关生物膜特: The study found that the lateral feature spacing (LS) on the surface of dental polymers significantly affects the pathogenicity-related biofilm properties of Candida albicans. Even if the narrow LS surface is smooth, it significantly increases bacterial viability, EPS production and metabolic activity, and its pathogenicity level is comparable to that of rough surfaces.
研究发现，采用45°打印方向制备立体光固化3D打印义齿时，其准确性、精密度及表面: The study found that when using the 45° printing direction to prepare stereolithography 3D printed dentures, the accuracy, precision and surface adaptability are the best, making it the preferred direction for manufacturing SLA 3D printed dentures.
研究变化体现为检查粒度从批次进入单片，检查对象从重量扩展到药物信号，验证范围从单: Research changes are reflected in the fact that the inspection granularity has changed from batch to single piece, the inspection object has expanded from weight to drug signal, and the scope of verification has expanded from a single location to different actual institutions.
研究变化可以概括为三次连接：形状与图案的连接，器械制造与佩戴评价的连接，以及患者: Research changes can be summarized as three connections: the connection between shape and pattern, the connection between device manufacturing and wearing evaluation, and the connection between patient data and automatic design. The prosthetic eye route has already connected these links in a complete manner; facial soft prostheses need to further solve the collaborative manufacturing of flexibility, edge and color.
研究可将任务分为空间辨认、方案修改、器械预演与团队沟通，控制教学时间及病例难度，: Research can divide tasks into space identification, plan modification, equipment rehearsal and team communication, control teaching time and case difficulty, and then measure accuracy, completion time and burden respectively. The effects of combined interventions cannot all be attributed to any one tool
研究同时数值模拟和实际LPBF Ti6Al4V粉打印梯度结构评估疲劳及流动，明确: Research on simultaneous numerical simulation and actual LPBF Ti6Al4V powder printed gradient structure to evaluate fatigue and flow to clarify bone implant optimization; not only design speculation.
研究同时记录不可修复断裂、可处理的小断裂、脱粘与颜色变化，使“仍在使用”和“没有: The study simultaneously records irreparable fractures, manageable minor fractures, debonding and color changes, allowing the distinction between "still in use" and "no problems"
研究含二氧化钛纳米颗粒3D打印假牙基质的抗真菌性能及弯曲强度。: Study the antifungal properties and bending strength of 3D printed denture matrix containing titanium dioxide nanoparticles.
研究四种3D打印义齿树脂，采用HPLC-MS分析其化学成分，发现其中甲基丙烯酸甲: Four types of 3D printed denture resins were studied and their chemical components were analyzed using HPLC-MS. It was found that methyl methacrylate (MMA) and its derivatives accounted for the main proportion. There were significant differences in component distribution and abundance between different materials, highlighting the diversity of resin formulations.
研究四种公开可用的增材制造口罩在不同滤材组合及框架改良下的密封性与透气性，结果表: Studying the sealing and breathability of four publicly available additively manufactured masks under different filter material combinations and frame improvements, the results showed that the filter material combination and frame improvements improved the leakage performance of the masks, with frame improvements reducing leakage by up to 69.6%.
研究四种结构相似的低成本仿生义肢，比较拇指掌侧外展运动在不同方式下的功能表现，结: Four low-cost bionic prostheses with similar structures were studied to compare the functional performance of thumb volar abduction in different ways. The results showed that independent movements of thumb abduction and flexion and extension were better, and fixed mild volar abduction was the best design.
研究团队与奥兰多健康及Stratasys合作，开发并量产了3D打印定制贴合的N9: The research team collaborated with Orlando Health and Stratasys to develop and mass-produce 3D printed custom-fit N95 masks and visors, and has delivered more than 5,000 visors to multiple hospitals in Central Florida.
研究团队为一名儿童患者制作了颈椎脊索瘤手术用三维打印解剖模型，通过图像分割和立体: The research team produced a three-dimensional printed anatomical model for cervical chordoma surgery for a pediatric patient. It was constructed through image segmentation and stereolithography technology for preoperative planning, helping the surgical team optimize the plan and shorten the operation time.
研究团队为防止动力空气净化呼吸器使用过程中防护服被吸入，设计并制造了定制化滤罩，: In order to prevent the protective clothing from being inhaled during the use of the powered air purifying respirator, the research team designed and manufactured a customized filter cover, which completely isolated the protective clothing from the equipment by interfering with the air flow, effectively avoiding the risk of the protective clothing being inhaled.
研究团队利用3D打印和激光切割技术，结合丙烯酸材料增强稳定性，制备出可逆密封的多: The research team used 3D printing and laser cutting technology, combined with acrylic materials to enhance stability, to prepare a reversibly sealed multi-material microfluidic device, which enables detachable sampling of the microfluidic chip and is suitable for a variety of biological research scenarios.
研究团队利用3D打印技术制作了符合患儿个体解剖特征的高仿真气道模拟器，用于模拟困: The research team used 3D printing technology to create a highly realistic airway simulator that conforms to the individual anatomical characteristics of children, which is used to simulate difficult airway intubation training to improve medical students' operating experience and coping abilities in real scenarios.
研究团队利用3D打印技术制造了一款便携式、低成本的qPCR设备，通过互联网共享设: The research team used 3D printing technology to create a portable, low-cost qPCR device. The design files were shared through the Internet, allowing grassroots users to print and assemble themselves. The device can perform reverse transcription and quantitative PCR detection on 20 μL samples containing lentiviruses at different concentrations, enabling rapid diagnosis of infectious diseases such as HIV.
研究团队利用3D打印技术定制制造机械拉伸生物反应器的组件，包括培养腔和电机外壳，: The research team used 3D printing technology to customize the components of the mechanical stretch bioreactor, including the culture chamber and motor housing, as well as the sample clamp specially designed for thin and soft biological samples. Their functions were verified through physical testing and finite element analysis. The results showed that each component was reasonably designed, easy to operate and performed well, achieving independent optimization of the entire process from design to manufacturing.
研究团队利用数字光合成技术制造了具有蜂窝结构的鼻咽拭子，该拭子在疑似新冠感染者中: The research team used digital light synthesis technology to create a nasopharyngeal swab with a honeycomb structure. The swab showed non-inferiority to traditional swabs in patients with suspected COVID-19 infection, enabling rapid deployment of COVID-19 testing.
研究团队利用本地可及的3D打印机、CAD软件和组件，制作出成本仅310美元、重量: The research team used locally available 3D printers, CAD software and components to create an open flexible microscope prototype that costs only US$310 and weighs 525 grams. Its image resolution is 13% and 15% higher than the LED microscope captured by a mobile phone at 40x and 100x magnification respectively. It can clearly identify cell characteristics such as rheumatic heart disease, tuberculosis soft tissue and roundworms, and can reach 1000x magnification without the need for an oil lens.
研究团队利用院内3D打印技术，基于术前面部CT扫描设计定制化定位与切割导板，实现: The research team used in-hospital 3D printing technology to design customized positioning and cutting guides based on preoperative facial CT scans to accurately reproduce the bone incisions in chin plastic surgery, shortening the production cycle from 10 days to 24 hours, reducing costs by more than 90%, and simultaneously producing postoperative models to pre-shape steel plates to improve surgical efficiency.
研究团队制备了具有腹主动脉瘤几何结构和空间变异性材料特性的组织仿生假体，通过调节: The research team prepared a tissue biomimetic prosthesis with abdominal aortic aneurysm geometry and spatial variability material properties, controlled its mechanical modulus by adjusting the PVA-c concentration and the number of freeze-thaw cycles, combined with physiological pressure flow cyclic deformation, and used ultrasound image sequences to calculate the pressure normalized strain, clearly demonstrating its mechanical response characteristics.
研究团队在医院药房实施半固态挤出3D打印技术，通过V模型质量框架定义需求与验证流: The research team implemented semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology in the hospital pharmacy, defined requirements and verification processes through the V-model quality framework, trained pharmacists to operate the customized printer, prepared placebo tablets and verified that they complied with pharmacopoeia standards, confirming that the technology has repeatability and operational stability in the actual pharmacy environment.
研究团队在新冠疫情下，基于易呼吸®面罩设计四款3D打印改良版，用于手术场景，改善: During the COVID-19 epidemic, the research team designed four 3D printed improved versions based on EasyBreathe® masks for use in surgical scenarios to improve wearing comfort, vision and communication. Although not officially approved, they can be used as temporary personal protective equipment when there is a lack of effective alternatives.
研究团队在新冠疫情初期，为麻醉科医护人员快速制作了3D打印面罩，并通过简单有效的: In the early days of the COVID-19 epidemic, the research team quickly produced 3D printed masks for anesthesia medical staff, and achieved disinfection and reuse through simple and effective methods, achieving an inactivation effect of ≥4 log10 on both Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus.
研究团队基于CALPHAD、机器学习与多目标优化，设计并验证了一种专为增材制造优: Based on CALPHAD, machine learning and multi-objective optimization, the research team designed and verified a Ti-Nb-Ta-Zr-Sn titanium alloy optimized for additive manufacturing. Its printing performance is better than commercial Ti-6Al-4V, with low modulus (about 42.7 GPa) and high ductility (about 30.9%), and good cell compatibility.
研究团队基于CT扫描定制3D打印个体化超声仿真模型，用于测试人工智能辅助的超声引: The research team customized a 3D printed personalized ultrasound simulation model based on CT scans to test the artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound-guided surgical robot system. The results showed that operators without medical experience could quickly and reliably complete punctures in the upper arm and groin, with success rates of 81% and 100% respectively.
研究团队基于CT数据，利用3D打印技术制作了首个能模拟颈椎生物力学特性的脊髓造影: Based on CT data, the research team used 3D printing technology to produce the first myelography prosthesis that can simulate the biomechanical properties of the cervical spine. It maintains good stability during flexion and extension movements. Its dynamic performance under fluorescence imaging is similar to that of the specimen, and it can effectively display the sagittal and coronal dimensions of the spinal cord diameter.
研究团队基于头颅区域MRI T1加权图像，利用CAD软件设计并3D打印高保真解剖: Based on MRI T1-weighted images of the cranial region, the research team used CAD software to design and 3D print a high-fidelity anatomical prosthesis, filled with tissue simulation gel, and verified by a 1.5T clinical MRI system. The resulting prosthesis has good anatomical authenticity and tissue contrast, and can effectively demonstrate the impact of parameter changes on the image and identify anatomical structures.
研究团队基于尸体影像数据构建了CT兼容的头颅仿生模型，通过3D打印技术实现鼻腔及: The research team built a CT-compatible skull bionic model based on cadaver imaging data, and used 3D printing technology to reproduce the fine anatomical structures of the nasal cavity and skull base. The model is close to real tissues in terms of radiodensity and mechanical properties. It is used for neurosurgery training and preoperative planning, and can effectively simulate endonasal skull base surgery and brain biopsy operations.
研究团队基于迭代共形映射理论，构建了多极微流控系统中质量传输的预测模型，通过3D: Based on the iterative conformal mapping theory, the research team constructed a prediction model for mass transport in a multipolar microfluidic system, and verified it through experiments with a 3D printing device, achieving dynamic control of time-varying reagent flow surface treatment and multi-step immune analysis.
研究团队对四种医用级压力敏感粘合剂进行了表征，比较了其结构精度、物理光学特性及生: The research team characterized four medical-grade pressure-sensitive adhesives and compared their structural accuracy, physical and optical properties, and biocompatibility. They found that there were significant differences in cutting behavior, glass and polymer bonding strength, and gas permeability. The fabricated microdevices can be designed and manufactured within 1 hour, operate stably for weeks, and can maintain cell monolayers and 3D culture systems.
研究团队将学术设计实验室转型为生产个人防护装备的场所，通过3D打印和激光切割技术: The research team transformed an academic design laboratory into a site for the production of personal protective equipment. Through 3D printing and laser cutting technology, it met Rio de Janeiro's urgent need for protective equipment during the peak of the epidemic, and explored the role of the design profession in responding to complex social issues.
研究团队开发了一套快速、低成本的防护面罩测试方案，利用现成及3D打印组件对多种商: The research team developed a rapid and low-cost protective mask testing program, using off-the-shelf and 3D printed components to test the filtration performance of a variety of commercial protective masks. The results were consistent with traditional methods, confirming that this program can effectively evaluate the protective performance of masks in the absence of conventional equipment.
研究团队开发了一款柔性软机器人系统F3DB，通过内窥镜操作在活体内部直接进行多层: The research team developed a flexible soft robot system F3DB, which can directly 3D print multi-layer biomaterials inside the living body through endoscopic operation, and verified its endoscopic surgical capabilities on pig tissue, achieving precise construction and surgical operation of in vivo tissues.
研究团队开发了可调轴向压缩的3D打印多路注射阀，对比两种打印工艺和六种密封结构，: The research team developed a 3D printed multi-injection valve with adjustable axial compression, compared two printing processes and six sealing structures, and evaluated the sealing performance through optical observation, weighing and fluid measurement. The results showed that its sealing performance is equivalent to that of commercial valves, with dynamic leakage below 0.5%. It can be automatically switched and is easy to scale up and migrate to other materials and processes.
研究团队开发并制造了一种可重复使用的半面罩呼吸器，通过9次迭代优化，采用3D打印: The research team developed and manufactured a reusable half-mask respirator, optimized through 9 iterations, using 3D printing and silicone casting processes. After user seal inspection and quantitative testing, the 8 versions all achieved good sealing effects, with an average sealing factor of 1662. The unit cost is about 15 Canadian dollars in materials and 20 minutes of labor, which preliminarily verified its feasibility under the epidemic.
研究团队开发并评估了3D打印的仿生神经血管组织模型，其在形态和光学特性上真实模拟: The research team developed and evaluated a 3D printed bionic neurovascular tissue model, which truly simulates the cerebral blood vessel structure in terms of morphology and optical properties, can effectively reproduce near-infrared fluorescence imaging scenes, and provides a reliable tool for the development and training of fluorescence imaging technology.
研究团队开发并验证了3D打印鼻咽拭子作为新冠检测的临时替代方案，描述了其使用流程: The research team developed and verified 3D printed nasopharyngeal swabs as a temporary alternative for COVID-19 testing, and described its use process and preliminary clinical application, including multi-center trial design.
研究团队开发并验证了一种可重复使用的N95临时过滤面罩，其在定量密合性测试中整体: The research team developed and verified a reusable N95 temporary filter mask. Its overall harmonic mean filtration efficiency in the quantitative fit test is significantly higher than that of commercial N95 masks that have passed the qualitative fit test, and the pass rate is higher.
研究团队快速开发并验证了多种3D打印鼻咽拭子，22天内完成首个原型的验证，研究人: The research team quickly developed and verified a variety of 3D printed nasopharyngeal swabs, completing the verification of the first prototype within 22 days. Researchers and staff all preferred one of the prototypes, and overall preferred the standard swab.
研究团队联合多方，在22天内设计并临床验证了4种3D打印鼻咽拭子原型，对276名: The research team joined forces with multiple parties to design and clinically verify four 3D printed nasopharyngeal swab prototypes within 22 days. They conducted comparative tests on 276 suspected COVID-19 patients. The results showed that they were highly consistent with standard swabs in terms of test results and Ct values, and were generally preferred by researchers.
研究团队联合设计并制造了耐用的AJFlex防护面罩，通过注塑和3D打印技术实现大: The research team jointly designed and manufactured durable AJFlex protective masks, achieved mass production through injection molding and 3D printing technology, and worked with industry and community partners to complete the distribution of approximately 33,000 masks, meeting the urgent needs of medical institutions in the Philadelphia area.
研究团队设计了一种3D打印的N95口罩适配器，通过连接四分之一N95面罩，实现单: The research team designed a 3D printed N95 mask adapter that can achieve four times the use of a single N95 mask by connecting a quarter N95 mask. It has been verified to be effective by computerized fit testing and can immediately expand the supply of N95 masks for medical personnel.
研究团队设计并制造了一种低成本、兼容显微镜的力学测试装置，通过3D打印和简易组装: The research team designed and manufactured a low-cost, microscope-compatible mechanical testing device. Through 3D printing and simple assembly, it can monitor the deformation of the sample during the loading process, and combine it with video analysis to automatically calculate stress and strain. The device shows an accuracy comparable to commercial equipment in a variety of soft materials, and is suitable for a variety of microscope systems.
研究团队设计并开发了一款基于表面肌电图控制、低成本的仿生机械臂，通过FDM 3D: The research team designed and developed a low-cost bionic robotic arm based on surface electromyography control. It achieves six degrees of freedom operation through FDM 3D printing and artificial tendon drive structure. It is driven by a servo motor and controlled by user electromyographic signals. After optimization, it improves signal processing and wireless communication capabilities, improving control intuitiveness and system integration.
研究团队运用人本设计原则，为腕部功能完整但手部缺失的儿童设计并制作了具备增强抓握: Using humanistic design principles, the research team designed and produced a 3D printed prosthetic limb with enhanced grip function for children with intact wrist functions but missing hands. Multiple sets of tests have shown that it is significantly better than standard prostheses in specific usage scenarios.
研究团队通过3D打印技术制作面屏，基于舒适性、耗材和打印时间优化模型，依ANVI: The research team used 3D printing technology to produce visors, optimizing the model based on comfort, consumables and printing time. They produced 223 units in accordance with ANVISA regulations and donated them to local medical institutions to deal with the shortage of protection for medical staff during the COVID-19 epidemic.
研究团队通过3D打印技术，结合高分辨率眼图与位移映射、UV映射，实现纹理化虹膜和: The research team used 3D printing technology, combined with high-resolution eye diagrams, displacement mapping, and UV mapping, to achieve a single printing of textured iris and sclera, and prepared a bionic eye prosthesis with a realistic texture. The process took less than 4 hours, shortening the labor time of traditional methods.
研究团队通过3D打印结合手工缠绕尼龙纤维，开发并验证了一种鼻咽拭子，该拭子可经高: The research team developed and verified a nasopharyngeal swab through 3D printing combined with hand-wound nylon fiber. The swab can be sterilized by high temperature and is suitable for the detection of COVID-19 and other respiratory viruses. It can be used in conjunction with the virus transport fluid recommended by the CDC.
研究团队通过与重症监护一线医护人员开展焦点小组讨论，总结了在开发3D打印折纸呼吸: Through focus group discussions with front-line critical care medical staff, the research team summarized five key points of collaboration in the development of the 3D printed origami ventilator prototype, including frequent early involvement of clinical personnel, analysis of actual needs, and prototype-led development, emphasizing the importance of the participation of front-line clinical personnel in multidisciplinary collaboration.
研究团队通过立体光刻3D打印制备微流控探针，并与玻璃或硅微加工探针性能对比，结果: The research team prepared microfluidic probes through stereolithography 3D printing, and compared the performance with glass or silicon micromachined probes. The results showed that the printed probes performed well in most applications and could achieve cell processing and concentration gradient generation. They were easy to operate and low-cost, and are expected to promote the popularization of this technology.
研究团队采用3D打印与激光微加工层压相结合的方法，制备了具有集成流道和多层结构的: The research team used a method that combined 3D printing and laser micromachining lamination to prepare an independent microfluidic device with integrated flow channels and multi-layer structures, achieving three-dimensional complex design, multi-directional microflow control and high transparency, and solving the limitations of traditional methods in terms of design complexity, surface smoothness and fluid behavior control.
研究团队采用3D打印模具结合软光刻和旋涂技术，制备了具有真实人眼视网膜光学特性的: The research team used 3D printing molds combined with soft lithography and spin coating technologies to prepare a multi-vessel network multi-layer bionic model with real optical properties of the human eye retina, which was used to objectively evaluate the performance of OCTA and confocal ophthalmoscopes.
研究团队采用SLA 3D打印模板，结合软光刻工艺，快速制备热塑性微流控器件，验证: The research team used SLA 3D printing templates, combined with soft lithography technology, to quickly prepare thermoplastic microfluidic devices, verified the feasibility of self-driven capillary circuits in protein quantitative detection, and achieved efficient iteration and low-cost production of microfluidic devices.
研究团队采用多学科方法，结合3D打印技术，设计并制造了一种可重复使用的 ergo: The research team used a multidisciplinary approach, combined with 3D printing technology, to design and manufacture a reusable ergonomic mask to meet respiratory protection needs, taking into account ergonomics and environmental protection. The prototype was compared with the NIOSH-certified 3M™ 6200 respirator to verify its structural feasibility.
研究团队采用符合USP类VI标准的聚丙烯共聚物，通过融合丝打印技术，在大学医院疫: The research team used polypropylene copolymers that met USP Class VI standards and integrated silk printing technology to prepare personal protective equipment during the epidemic in university hospitals. The material has chemical stability, steam sterilization resistance and high purity. Combined with digital process optimization and verification, it achieved decentralized and personalized production of desktop 3D printers in medical scenarios.
研究固态药物颗粒在SSE墨水中的影响，发现药物负载量和颗粒大小显著改变低剪切速率: Studying the effect of solid drug particles in SSE ink, it was found that drug loading and particle size significantly changed the viscosity at low shear rates, but the printing quality was not clearly related to the low shear viscosity, but was strongly related to the dynamic oscillatory rheology parameters of the ink, and the reduction in particle size had no obvious impact on the oscillatory rheology.
研究在10名参与者中测试了带3D打印定制框架的三级和二级医用口罩，结果显示该框架: The study tested Level 3 and Level 2 medical masks with a 3D printed custom frame on 10 participants, and the results showed that the frame significantly improved the edge sealing of both types of masks, bringing them up to the quantitative sealing standards of N95 masks.
研究在3D打印微流控平台上构建模块化共代谢途径，通过创新芯片设计、酶固定及辅因子: The study constructs a modular co-metabolism pathway on a 3D printing microfluidic platform.
