研究在PMMA义齿基质中添加各类纤维和填料以改善其力学性能和放射不透明性，重点评: Research on adding various types of fibers and fillers to PMMA denture matrix to improve its mechanical properties and radiopacity, focusing on evaluating the impact of silane coupling-treated nanofillers on filler dispersion and material properties.
研究在两名参与者身上通过3D打印 间隙层和钢杆制造特定尺寸间隙，使用OSHA定量: The study used 3D printing of gap layers and steel rods to create a gap of a specific size on two participants. It was measured using the OSHA quantitative fit test method. When the gap area reached 1.5 to 3 mm square, the protective performance of the N95 mask was impaired.
研究在健康成人中开展临床试验，比较了点-of-care 3D打印西地那非片与市售: The study conducted clinical trials in healthy adults to compare the bioequivalence of point-of-care 3D printed sildenafil tablets and the commercially available original drug. The results showed that the 90% confidence intervals of AUC0-t and Cmax ratios were both within the range of 80.00–125.0 and 80.00–125.00%, confirming that the 3D printed preparation is consistent with the original drug in terms of bioequivalence.
研究在医院环境中，利用半固态挤出增材制造技术，将商用美托洛尔片定制为5 mg剂量: The study was carried out in a hospital environment using semi-solid extrusion additive manufacturing technology to customize commercial metoprolol tablets into 5 mg dose tablets. The five batches of products all met the standards in terms of quality, content and release characteristics. Compared with external compound capsules, SSE tablets are smaller, release more evenly and have more stable content.
研究在小鼠丘脑底核植入3D打印多模态光遗传神经探针，集成微流体管实现病毒载体递送: The study implanted a 3D printed multi-modal optogenetic neural probe in the subthalamic nucleus of mice, integrated microfluidic tubes to achieve viral vector delivery and light stimulation, and completed it in a single operation. Behavioral experiments showed that light stimulation improved exercise performance, and immunohistochemistry confirmed ChR2 expression, reduced glial cell activation and good neuron survival.
研究在微流控芯片内直接三维构筑蜘蛛结构纺丝器，利用多光子光刻技术实现高精度微结构: The study directly constructs a three-dimensional spider structure spinner in a microfluidic chip, uses multi-photon lithography technology to achieve high-precision microstructure manufacturing, and successfully achieves wet spinning of single-micron fibers through water layer-induced co-condensation of polyacrylonitrile, demonstrating the integration capabilities of complex structures and microfluidic platforms.
研究在感染大鼠和终止生长迷你猪模型中，比较了含万古霉素的胶原/羟基磷灰石涂层（C: The study compared the effects of vancomycin-containing collagen/hydroxyapatite coating (COLHA+V) and vancomycin-free coating (COLHA+S. epidermidis) on bone infection destruction and osseointegration in infected rats and terminated growth mini-pig models. The results showed that COLHA+V significantly reduced bone destruction and promoted osseointegration, and the systemic drug load was extremely low.
研究在打印电极基底上整合膜材料，完成: Research on integrating membrane materials on printed electrode substrates, completed
研究基于170种配方、78种材料的组成及FT-IR、XRPD、DSC数据，构建机: The study built a machine learning model to predict the printability of selective laser sintering pharmaceutical products based on 170 formulas, 78 material compositions, and FT-IR, XRPD, and DSC data. The F1 score of the multimodal data fusion model reached 88.9%, confirming that multimodal data improves prediction accuracy.
研究基于2004–2019年科学论文和专利数据，采用回归分析与 hype 周期模: The study is based on scientific papers and patent data from 2004 to 2019, using regression analysis and hype cycle models to evaluate the technological evolution of additive manufacturing in drug delivery products. The results show that the technology is still in its early stages and needs to be strengthened to lay the foundation for commercialization.
研究基于200个健康颅骨的CT数据，通过在健康颅骨上人工制造缺陷生成训练对，利用: Based on CT data of 200 healthy skulls, the study generated training pairs by artificially manufacturing defects on healthy skulls, and used data-driven methods such as deep learning to achieve automatic repair of skull defects and implant generation. The results were quantitatively evaluated through Dice similarity scores and Hausdorff distance.
研究基于20例患者高分辨率CT数据，制作了生命大小的C1-C2骨性结构3D打印模: Based on high-resolution CT data of 20 patients, the study produced a life-sized 3D printed model of the C1-C2 bony structure to simulate various screw fixation techniques. The results showed that all screw angles and lengths were within safe anatomical ranges, and the model can be used as a practical auxiliary tool for preoperative planning.
研究基于24名患者CT数据，通过制造240个人工颅骨缺损并配对生成相应植入物，构: Based on CT data of 24 patients, the study created 240 artificial cranial defects and paired them to generate corresponding implants, building a data set to train the automatic design and manufacturing process, and realizing the rapid and automated generation of personalized craniofacial implants.
研究基于3D打印与组织等效材料构建个性化胸腔仿生 体模，通过离子室测量与TPS蒙: The study constructed a personalized thoracic bionic phantom based on 3D printing and tissue-equivalent materials, and compared it with ion chamber measurement and TPS Monte Carlo algorithm to verify its accuracy of radiation dose in tumors and normal tissues. The results showed that its tissue attenuation characteristics and anatomical structure are highly consistent with those of the human body and can be effectively used for radiation dose verification.
研究基于3D打印心脏假体，利用双平面X线荧光成像结合深度学习技术，通过嵌入式标志: The research is based on a 3D printed cardiac prosthesis, using bi-plane X-ray fluorescence imaging combined with deep learning technology to achieve continuous tracking of the three-dimensional position of the catheter tip through embedded markers, providing quantitative analysis for percutaneous surgical training.
研究基于3D打印技术制作防护面罩，响应新冠疫情下的公众防护需求。: Research on the production of protective masks based on 3D printing technology to respond to public protection needs under the new coronavirus epidemic.
研究基于3D打印技术制备了具有均质和异质放射密度的肺肿瘤仿体，其密度范围（-21: The study prepared a lung tumor phantom with homogeneous and heterogeneous radiodensity based on 3D printing technology. Its density range (-217 to 226 HU) is consistent with the real lung tumor tissue. The morphology and internal heterogeneity are close to clinical data, and no heterogeneity was found to have an impact on the accuracy and robustness of the image registration algorithm.
研究基于3D打印技术，设计并比较了三种微流控单向阀及其组成的泵，通过压力-流量关: Based on 3D printing technology, the research designed and compared three types of microfluidic one-way valves and the pumps composed of them. Their working characteristics were analyzed through the pressure-flow relationship, and it was verified that this type of pump can achieve microfluidic mixing with only one pneumatic input.
研究基于3D打印技术，针对个性化药物制剂的制备，通过实现多剂量、控释及多药联合等: The research is based on 3D printing technology and aims at the preparation of personalized pharmaceutical preparations. By realizing complex formulas such as multi-dose, controlled release and multi-drug combination, it improves the precise control of drug dosage and efficacy, and provides safer and more effective treatment options for specific patient groups.
研究基于3D打印颅骨模型，评估颅骨厚度、密度及松质骨比例对聚焦超声能量传输的影响: The study was based on a 3D printed skull model to evaluate the impact of skull thickness, density and cancellous bone ratio on focused ultrasound energy transmission. The results showed that the cancellous bone ratio has the strongest correlation with actual energy delivery, and clinical data supports that this factor has more guiding significance in FUS treatment.
研究基于3岁患儿的3D扫描数据，自动设计并制造了上肢定制假肢套筒，比较了刚性PL: Based on the 3D scanning data of a 3-year-old child, the study automatically designed and manufactured a customized upper limb prosthetic sleeve, and compared the performance of rigid PLA and elastic TPE materials. By adjusting the 3D printing process parameters, the stability, fit, strength and surface roughness of the sleeve were evaluated. The results showed that most products met the strength requirements, but some did not meet the comfort standards. Based on this, the material and process parameters were determined and applied to the production of prostheses for other patients.
研究基于50名受试者采集的鼻部和耳部形态及皮肤细节，构建三维数字数据库，结合SL: Based on the nose and ear morphology and skin details collected by 50 subjects, the study constructed a three-dimensional digital database, combined with SLA and DLP printing technology, to evaluate the reproduction of skin wrinkles on the bionic mask. The results showed that the contour distortion rate of wrinkles at different depths ranged from 4.5% to 40%.
研究基于5例冠状动脉粥样硬化患者CTA数据，利用多材料3D打印构建患者特异性冠状: Based on the CTA data of 5 patients with coronary atherosclerosis, the study used multi-material 3D printing to construct a patient-specific coronary artery model, and simulated blood flow changes under resting and exercise conditions through adjustable physiological parameters. The blood flow results were highly correlated with the Windkessel equivalent model and invasive measurement data.
研究基于8例肺癌患者CT数据，通过3D打印制作具有真实形态和密度的肺部假体，嵌入: Based on the CT data of 8 lung cancer patients, the study used 3D printing to produce a lung prosthesis with realistic shape and density, which was embedded in a dynamic thoracic prosthesis to test the tracking accuracy of Radixact Synchrony under respiratory motion. The results showed that it can achieve tracking within 1mm under both normal and abnormal breathing and can suspend treatment.
研究基于ATOM参考 体模，采用PLA模拟软组织、石膏盐水混合物模拟颅骨，通过H: The study was based on the ATOM reference phantom, using PLA to simulate soft tissue and a plaster-saline mixture to simulate the skull. Its uniformity and compatibility were verified through HU evaluation. The results showed that the material was uniform and compatible with ATOM. The constructed 3D printed eye model can be used for radiation therapy dose assessment in the eye area.
研究基于CBCT与激光扫描图像叠加，结合CAD和3D打印技术，制作个性化牙科微型: The research is based on the superposition of CBCT and laser scanning images, combined with CAD and 3D printing technology, to produce a personalized dental micro-screw surgical template. The gap between the oral mucosa and the template is less than 0.5mm, which verifies that the template fits well and is implanted safely.
研究基于CBCT和口内扫描数据制作患者特异性颌骨3D打印模拟模型，通过云到云距离: The study produced a patient-specific jaw 3D printing simulation model based on CBCT and intraoral scan data, and verified its accuracy through cloud-to-cloud distance analysis. During periodontal and oral surgery training, it was found that students' facial and content validity of the model was significantly higher than that of experienced periodontists, especially in terms of soft tissue touch.
研究基于CBCT图像与CAD系统，结合有限元分析，针对磨牙内陷手术设计个性化模板: Based on CBCT images and CAD systems, combined with finite element analysis, the study designed a personalized template for molar invagination surgery and compared the mechanical performance of micro-screws implanted at different inclination angles (60° or 15°) on the buccal and palatal sides. The results showed that the 60° inclination model was better in terms of micro-movement of the screw-bone interface and screw head displacement, and the bone strain was lower than the critical value, improving implant stability.
研究基于CT扫描与3D打印技术，构建包含颈椎、气管、颈动脉等结构的颈部仿真模型，: The research is based on CT scanning and 3D printing technology to build a neck simulation model including cervical vertebrae, trachea, carotid arteries and other structures. The agar mixture is used to simulate tissue echoes, and its ultrasound images are comparable to real tissues. It provides high-fidelity, low-cost training and verification tools for testing new ENT equipment and artificial intelligence-guided operations.
研究基于CT扫描数据，利用3D打印技术制作了具有骨等效材料的异质小鼠类人形模型，: Based on CT scan data, the research used 3D printing technology to create a heterogeneous mouse humanoid model with bone-equivalent materials. By comparing it with real mouse CT images, the accuracy of its geometric structure and X-ray attenuation was verified, and the reproduction of anatomical structures with high spatial resolution was achieved.
研究基于CT数据三维重建患者颅面结构，通过计算机模拟设计并3D打印CAD/CAM: Based on the three-dimensional reconstruction of the patient's craniofacial structure based on CT data, the study designed and 3D printed a CAD/CAM surgical guide through computer simulation to guide the mandibular osteotomy and movement to achieve the predetermined genioplasty operation, verifying the feasibility and accuracy of the guide in actual surgery.
研究基于FDM工艺使用开源3D打印机打印的PLA材料，通过三点弯曲试验测定其弯曲: The PLA material printed using an open source 3D printer based on the FDM process was studied. Its bending strength and elastic modulus were measured through a three-point bending test. It was found that the printing speed, deposition angle and nozzle temperature affect its mechanical properties. A response surface model was established and the optimal parameters were determined. Finite element analysis verified the experimental results.
研究基于Ti-6Al-4V和Ti-Al-V-Zr钛合金粉末，采用改进的PNN-S: The study is based on Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-Al-V-Zr titanium alloy powders and uses an improved PNN-SVM model to intelligently evaluate the alloy microstructure, phase composition and properties. The results show that this method is significantly better than a single classifier and other machine learning methods in terms of classification accuracy.
研究基于Voronoi图的交互式生成设计，为颅骨缺损患者定制仿生钛制植入物，通过: The study uses interactive generative design based on Voronoi diagrams to customize bionic titanium implants for patients with skull defects, and verifies the manufacturability of its nearly self-supporting structure through selective laser melting technology.
研究基于ZrSiO4-玻璃复合材料通过间接增材制造制备陶瓷牙科修复体，考察了温度: The study prepared ceramic dental restorations through indirect additive manufacturing based on ZrSiO4-glass composite materials. The effects of temperature, time, heating and cooling rates on shrinkage, bending strength and process feasibility were investigated. The results showed that the bending strength was between 25 and 85 MPa, and the shrinkage was between 10 and 25%.
研究基于“Moynihan hump”胆囊动脉变异，采用3D打印模具注 sili: The research is based on the "Moynihan hump" cystic artery variation, using a 3D printed mold injected with silicone and treated with dopamine coating, making the model high-fidelity and electrotherapeutic. After evaluation by three surgeons, realistic simulation training for cholecystectomy was successfully achieved.
研究基于一名乳腺切除患者的临床CT数据，将其分割为十一层2.5厘米厚的矢状切片，: The study was based on the clinical CT data of a mastectomy patient, which was divided into eleven sagittal slices with a thickness of 2.5 cm. A full-size patient-specific radiotherapy prosthesis was prepared layer by layer using 3D printing technology. Each slice was printed with 100% filling and the air cavity was retained. After assembly, the registration display was highly consistent with the original patient's CT image, with an overall deviation of about 2%.
研究基于三重周期极小曲面的Ti6Al4V三维打印多孔结构，通过改变等值参数比较不: The Ti6Al4V three-dimensional printed porous structure based on triple periodic minimal surfaces was studied. By changing the equivalent parameters to compare the mechanical properties of different structures, it was found that the equivalent parameters significantly affect the mechanical properties and are related to the porosity. Different structures show different strengths and failure mechanisms at high or low relative densities.
研究基于临床残肢模具，通过3D扫描与CAD重建，制备了1:3比例的PLA-SCF: Based on the clinical residual limb mold, the study prepared a 1:3 ratio PLA-SCF additive manufacturing prosthetic sleeve through 3D scanning and CAD reconstruction. Experiments showed that its compressive strength reached 1.072 MPa. In the fatigue test, crack initiation occurred within 90-100 cycles. Interface debonding was the failure mechanism. The surface roughness slightly met clinical standards. The finite element analysis results were in good agreement with the experiment.
研究基于五名志愿者的3D面部数据，比较四种采集方法，发现智能手机深度传感器在成本: Based on the 3D facial data of five volunteers, the study compared four acquisition methods and found that the smartphone depth sensor has the optimal balance between cost, time and accuracy. It then established a three-step automated design process that can generate a high-precision customized respirator mask CAD model for each volunteer in a few minutes.
研究基于人类CT扫描，结合3D打印颅骨与牛脑组织，构建含肿瘤模型的实体模拟系统，: The study was based on human CT scans, combined with 3D printed skulls and bovine brain tissue, to build a physical simulation system containing tumor models. After 29 participants completed the training, evaluation showed that the visual and sensory realism of the skull and brain tissue was good, the sensory and visual realism of the tumor model was good, and the overall satisfaction and applicability of equipment training were "very good". However, the small size of the brain tissue, short shelf life, and inability to simulate bleeding were limitations.
研究基于人类肱骨头三维扫描数据，通过CAD建模与布尔运算重塑骨头并装配定制植入物: The research is based on three-dimensional scanning data of the human humeral head. It uses CAD modeling and Boolean operations to reshape the bone and assemble customized implants. It combines 3D printing technology to achieve personalized manufacturing of proximal humeral head implants. Compared with traditional processes, this method simplifies the geometric modeling and implant preparation process of complex bone structures.
研究基于仙人掌刺的微结构，通过3D打印和飞秒激光制备仿生微针，发现50μm沟槽设: Based on the microstructure of cactus spines, the study prepared bionic microneedles through 3D printing and femtosecond laser. It was found that the 50μm groove design has the highest insertion force, the collagen microneedles have the best mechanical strength, and the hyaluronic acid microneedles have the best overall transdermal potential.
研究基于低成本3D打印假手，通过上臂表面sEMG信号经神经网络识别，实现手势控制: The research is based on a low-cost 3D printed prosthetic hand. The sEMG signal on the upper arm surface is recognized by a neural network to achieve gesture control. The recognition accuracy of the RNN-type model reaches 85%, but it requires continuous force application and changes in the sensor position will affect the performance. The system is not yet suitable for real scenes.
研究基于健康及宫颈癌患者宫颈阴道液样本，通过原位形成金纳米颗粒的比色法检测宫颈癌: Based on the cervicovaginal fluid samples of healthy and cervical cancer patients, the research uses a colorimetric method to form gold nanoparticles in situ to detect cervical cancer, evaluate its detection performance with biopsy or Pap smear, and analyze the relationship between nanoparticle aggregation coefficient and size, protein and lipid concentration and malignant degree. CerviSelf, a self-sampling device, is proposed to achieve rapid and frequent family screening.
研究基于光学微机电系统扫描器和可调透镜，构建了占地20×28×13 cm³的微型: Based on an optical MEMS scanner and an adjustable lens, the research built a miniature light-sheet microscope covering an area of 20×28×13 cm³, achieving imaging of a volume of 435×232×60 µm³, with a resolution of 1.0 µm (lateral) and 3.8 µm (axial). It supports an open top structure and can be integrated with microfluidic devices for biomedical research and preclinical applications.
研究基于兔头CT和CBCT影像，采用聚jet技术3D打印具有生物力学特性和放射密: The study is based on rabbit head CT and CBCT images and uses polyjet technology to 3D print a rabbit airway bionic model with biomechanical properties and radiodensity. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations show that its shape and visual realism are good, and it can effectively assist veterinary nasotracheal intubation training.
研究基于内镜经鼻神经外科手术需求，设计了具有人体解剖特征的头模，经外科医生评估，: Based on the needs of endoscopic transnasal neurosurgery, the research designed a headform with human anatomical characteristics. After evaluation by the surgeon, the nasal cavity, sphenoid sinus, sellar area and pituitary gland structures were realistic. It was believed that the headform was helpful for surgical planning, education and training, and could be used for neuronavigation system testing.
研究基于加州海狮CT影像，通过DICOM数据分割和多层建模，结合3D打印与医用凝: The research is based on CT images of California sea lions, through DICOM data segmentation and multi-layer modeling, combined with 3D printing and medical gel matching, to create an expandable bionic prosthesis with mechanical and anatomical properties of bone and soft tissue for veterinary blood collection training.
研究基于医学影像与3D建模，结合多材料打印技术，为患者定制仿生耳假体，通过数字设: The research is based on medical imaging and 3D modeling, combined with multi-material printing technology, to customize bionic ear prostheses for patients. Through digital design, skin color and tissue touch can be accurately reproduced, improving the anatomical authenticity and clinical applicability of the prosthesis.
研究基于医院3D打印的个性化器械在全膝关节置换术中的应用准确性。: Study the application accuracy of personalized instruments based on hospital 3D printing in total knee replacement surgery.
研究基于参考MRI切片，利用CAD软件设计膝关节解剖结构，3D打印并填充组织模拟: The study is based on reference MRI slices, using CAD software to design the knee joint anatomy, 3D printing and filling tissue simulation gel, and verifying it through MRI imaging. The resulting image has high anatomical fidelity and clinically realistic signal contrast, and is suitable for MRI sequence optimization and hardware comparison.
研究基于可购得材料与3D打印技术构建具有脉动特性的颈动脉仿生模型，通过MATLA: The study built a carotid artery bionic model with pulsating characteristics based on commercially available materials and 3D printing technology. It developed a 4D reconstruction algorithm through MATLAB to realize three-dimensional dynamic visualization of blood vessel wall movement, and obtained structural parameters such as lumen area and wall thickness for identifying vascular stenosis.
研究基于回收电池和塑料材料，制备了用于人唾液中SARS-CoV-2标签自由检测的: Based on recycled batteries and plastic materials, the research has prepared a magnetoelectric biosensor for free detection of SARS-CoV-2 tags in human saliva. Its performance is 95% correlated with RT-PCR detection results, costs only US$0.2, and is fast response, reusable and widely applicable.
研究基于增材制造技术设计了一种N95衍生呼吸器，与现有口罩模型相比，在制造成本和: The study designed an N95-derived respirator based on additive manufacturing technology. Compared with existing mask models, it is superior in manufacturing cost and function. The cost is reduced to 7₺, the durability is tripled, and it has replaceable filters and sterilization processes, achieving more economical and safer protection.
研究基于复杂盆腔肿瘤CT数据，3D打印了含动脉、静脉及肿瘤腔的可注射对比剂仿生模: Based on complex pelvic tumor CT data, the study 3D printed an injectable contrast agent bionic model containing arteries, veins and tumor cavities. Different tissue simulations were achieved by adjusting the contrast agent concentration. The CT attenuation value was positively correlated with the concentration change. Although it deviated greatly from the target value, the relative attenuation relationship between each phase was in line with expectations.
研究基于头颅CT与T1加权MRI数据，采用聚乳酸与碳酸钙制作颅骨、水基混合物加聚: Based on cranial CT and T1-weighted MRI data, the study used polylactic acid and calcium carbonate to make the skull, and a water-based mixture with polyvinyl alcohol and barium sulfate to cast the brain tissue. It has been verified by neurosurgeons in simulations such as endonasal approach surgery, brain biopsy, and external ventricular drainage to meet the needs of neurosurgery training.
研究基于应力依赖设计算法，优化了定制化梯度多孔股骨柄的参数，结合临床需求与增材制: Based on the stress-dependent design algorithm, the research optimized the parameters of the customized gradient porous femoral stem, combined with clinical needs and additive manufacturing capabilities, to achieve an implant design with a minimum bone loss of 2.4%, improving the balance between bone ingrowth and mechanical safety.
研究基于引文网络分析，追踪组织工程领域内3D生物打印技术的发展，发现临床应用相关: Based on citation network analysis, the study tracked the development of 3D bioprinting technology in the field of tissue engineering and found that the clustering of clinical application-related papers was independent of printing equipment. By analyzing the literature from 2019 to 2021, it identified basic technology trends such as microfluidics and electrospinning, indicating that this method can be effectively used to scan cutting-edge technologies in interdisciplinary fields.
研究基于患者CT图像，采用 石膏与PLA粉末混合3D打印异质性头模，通过调节PL: Based on patient CT images, the study used gypsum and PLA powder to 3D print a heterogeneous head phantom. By adjusting the PLA filling rate and proportion, the soft tissue and bone tissue CT values ​​were close to the Rando phantom respectively, achieving patient-specific quality assurance.
研究基于患者CT数据制作3D打印乳腺假体，配离子室和放射染料薄膜，通过与商用胸廓: The study produced a 3D printed breast prosthesis based on patient CT data, equipped with an ion chamber and a radioactive dye film, and connected it to a commercial thoracic prosthesis for end-to-end testing of a whole-breast intensity-modulated arc treatment plan. 研究基于患者CT数据设计了加工商Ti–6Al–4V颈椎椎体切除笼，结合拓扑优化核: The study designed a processor Ti–6Al–4V cervical corpectomy cage based on patient CT data. It combined the topology optimization core with the bionic honeycomb interface and determined the structure through finite element analysis. Experiments showed that its axial stiffness and yield load were both higher than the ISO standard, and its fatigue resistance was excellent. The interface stiffness reached 1.85 times the ISO standard, and the metabolic activity of cells on the honeycomb surface was higher.
研究基于患者CT数据，利用3D打印技术制备可吸收聚合物定制骨植入物，应用于颅颌面: Based on patient CT data, the study used 3D printing technology to prepare absorbable polymer customized bone implants, which were used in craniofacial surgery to achieve precise manufacturing of bone plates, orbital floor fracture implants, alveolar bone repair mesh and bone scaffolds. The printed parts have a uniform surface, a wall thickness of up to 0.8 mm, and good fit.
研究基于患者CT数据，利用增材制造技术在钛合金中设计并制作颞下颌关节定制植入物，: Based on patient CT data, the research uses additive manufacturing technology to design and produce customized implants for the temporomandibular joint in titanium alloy. It simulates chewing stress distribution through computers, analyzes its fatigue performance in combination with traditional design, and verifies the physical coupling of the implant and the mandible through three-dimensional printing.
研究基于患者DICOM影像设计定制颅骨网状植入物，采用电子束熔融增材制造技术成型: The study designed a customized cranial mesh implant based on the patient's DICOM image and used electron beam melting additive manufacturing technology. The results showed that it has a regular pore structure, connected channels, is light in weight, has an elastic modulus close to bone tissue, has good bone ingrowth performance and mechanical strength, effectively reduces stress shielding, and improves surgical accuracy and aesthetic effects.
研究基于患者个体解剖结构，利用三维打印技术制作定制化脊柱与颅面植入物及手术器械，: The research uses three-dimensional printing technology to produce customized spinal and craniofacial implants and surgical instruments based on the patient's individual anatomy, and achieves precise matching through imaging and computer-aided design to improve surgical accuracy and functional recovery.
研究基于患者内耳圆窗凹陷解剖结构，采用3D打印技术制备了聚己内酯微粒增强海藻酸盐: Based on the anatomy of the round window recess of the patient's inner ear, the study used 3D printing technology to prepare a polycaprolactone particle-reinforced alginate hydrogel drug-loaded implant. The material has good printability, mechanical strength and biocompatibility, enabling personalized local drug delivery and providing a feasible solution for targeted treatment of inner ear diseases.
研究基于患者口腔3D扫描制作个性化模具，制备含利多卡因的黏膜黏附贴剂，F19配方: The study made a personalized mold based on 3D scanning of the patient's oral cavity to prepare a mucoadhesive patch containing lidocaine. The F19 formula releases about 50% of the drug within 15 minutes and continues to release it for 30 minutes, achieving targeted oral local anesthesia.
研究基于患者头颅CT扫描数据，利用3D打印技术制作含鼻窦结构的个性化头 体模，其: Based on the patient's head CT scan data, the study used 3D printing technology to produce a personalized head phantom containing sinus structures. Its shape and CT value were close to the actual head phantom, and the dose difference was less than 2%, which verified the feasibility of this printed phantom for artificial internal and external dose measurement in radiotherapy quality assurance.
研究基于患者影像提取几何数据，采用3D打印制作可填充的左心室心肌假体，其在“空气: The study extracted geometric data based on patient images and used 3D printing to produce a fillable left ventricular myocardial prosthesis. It showed good repeatability and compatibility in both "air" and "body" states. Polar coordinate analysis showed that significant distribution deviation areas existed, and the deviations in other areas did not exceed 12.4%. The apical area values were consistent, making it suitable for SPECT imaging quality assessment.
研究基于患者影像数据，通过明确的图像处理流程设计定制化颅骨修补植入物，经三维打印: Based on patient imaging data, the study designed a customized skull repair implant through a clear image processing process. After verification by 3D printing and biomechanical simulation, the load response and morphological matching of the implant met the actual application requirements.
研究基于患者特定CTA数据制作了可模拟血流的胸主动脉夹层仿生模型，通过脉动血流循: Based on patient-specific CTA data, the study produced a bionic model of thoracic aortic dissection that can simulate blood flow and achieve physiological pressure and flow through a pulsatile blood circulation system, verifying the feasibility of stent placement during TEVAR surgery and the difference in blood flow velocity between the true lumen and the false lumen.
研究基于患者特定颅骨植入物，采用Arburg APF技术以PCU材料3D打印，通: The research is based on patient-specific skull implants, using Arburg APF technology to 3D print PCU materials. Its mechanical properties are evaluated through finite element analysis and three-point bending tests. The results show that PCU has good biocompatibility and has smaller stress concentration than PEEK. However, the mechanical properties of the material have declined. Further research is needed on the impact of 3D printing on the finite element model.
研究基于患者特异性肝脏模型，通过计算流体动力学模拟和实验验证，发现注射位置、粒子: Based on a patient-specific liver model, the study found through computational fluid dynamics simulation and experimental verification that the injection location, particle size density and tumor load affect the distribution of microparticles in the liver. The injection location can guide the microparticles toward the tumor tissue, but when the tumor load increases, the guiding effect weakens, and the distribution is still significantly affected by individual anatomy.
研究基于患者肺部CT扫描数据制作的3D打印肺模型，用于评估深度学习CT重建算法在: A 3D printed lung model based on patient lung CT scan data was studied to evaluate the performance of the deep learning CT reconstruction algorithm under different radiation doses. The results showed that the algorithm was superior to traditional methods in multiple indicators and could reduce the dose by 25% to 83% in small and medium-sized patient models without affecting image quality.
研究基于患者腿部三维扫描，利用逆向工程与增材制造技术设计并制作个性化踝足矫形器，: The research is based on three-dimensional scans of patients' legs, using reverse engineering and additive manufacturing technology to design and produce personalized ankle-foot orthoses, which have been assembled and tested to show good results.
研究基于患者颈部CT图像，通过数字插入低对比度病灶生成解剖结构真实的幻影，经3D: Based on CT images of the patient's neck, the study digitally inserted low-contrast lesions to generate a realistic phantom of the anatomical structure, which was 3D printed and used in detection experiments. The results showed that as the contrast of the lesions increased, the radiologist's detection accuracy and confidence significantly improved.
研究基于患者颌骨与牙齿解剖结构，利用开源软件建模与3D打印技术定制牙科种植导板，: Based on the patient's jaw and tooth anatomy, the research uses open source software modeling and 3D printing technology to customize dental implant guides to improve the accuracy and personalization of implant placement.
研究基于教学需求，设计并制作了三维度打印的三叉神经与下呼吸道解剖模型，通过师生反: Based on the teaching needs, the research designed and produced a three-dimensional printed anatomical model of the trigeminal nerve and lower respiratory tract. Its practicability in anatomy teaching was evaluated through feedback from teachers and students. The results showed that the model was well evaluated in terms of usability, design and learning support, and can be used as a supplementary teaching tool.
研究基于早产儿胸腔解剖结构，通过CT分割后3D打印各器官并制作负模，以硅胶基质混: The research is based on the anatomy of the thoracic cavity of premature infants. After CT segmentation, each organ is 3D printed and a negative model is made. A bionic thoracic tissue model is constructed using a silicone matrix mixed with black ink and silica microspheres, and the "transdermal" gas absorption spectrum monitoring of oxygen content in the lung cavity is successfully achieved.
研究基于智能手机摄影测量，开发低成本三维打印定制膝关节支具，通过患者自行扫描获取: The research is based on smartphone photogrammetry to develop low-cost three-dimensional printed customized knee braces. Data is obtained through patients' self-scans, simplifying the process and improving accessibility, achieving more efficient and low-cost brace manufacturing.
研究基于机械相似性原理，通过缩放原型测试验证了3D打印假足的力学性能，其力-位移: Based on the principle of mechanical similarity, the research verified the mechanical properties of the 3D printed prosthetic foot through scaled prototype testing. The force-displacement ratio remained consistent across different scales with an error of 3.6% and met the ISO 10328 standard, achieving a low-cost and accessible prosthetic foot design.
研究基于植物结构设计多腔胶囊，利用胶原蛋白、淀粉和海藻酸盐生物墨水通过3D打印制: The study designed multi-cavity capsules based on plant structures and prepared them through 3D printing using collagen, starch and alginate bioinks to achieve drug loading in chambers of different volumes. The drug was released through staged dissolution and release, significantly extending the release time. Compared with traditional single-cavity capsules, it achieved controllable and combined drug release.
研究基于正常受试者T1 MRI数据，通过3D打印制作具有真实CT衰减特性的类人头: Based on T1 MRI data of normal subjects, the study used 3D printing to produce a human-like head model with real CT attenuation characteristics. Combining CT scans with SPM12 segmentation, it verified the accuracy of CT image segmentation using the MRI development algorithm. The results showed that the segmentation results were highly consistent with the source data.
研究基于氢化可的松制剂M3DICORT，构建了医院药房场景下3D打印单片药成本的: Based on the hydrocortisone preparation M3DICORT, the study constructed an evaluation framework for the cost of 3D printing a single tablet in a hospital pharmacy scenario. Through cost classification in the three stages of pre-printing, printing, and post-processing, it was concluded that the manufacturing cost of a single tablet ranges from 1.97 to 3.11 euros (best to worst case), and 1.58 to 2.26 euros in large-scale production. The cost differences in different scenarios are clearly compared.
研究基于活体和尸体的CTA及MRI数据，结合CAD设计与3D打印技术，构建了包含: Based on CTA and MRI data of living subjects and cadavers, combined with CAD design and 3D printing technology, the study constructed a high-precision simulation model containing the key anatomical structures of middle artery aneurysm, with an anatomical accuracy of 90.2%–99.0%, and was used for neurosurgery simulation training.
研究基于海藻酸钠与抗菌锌氧化物四面体的3D打印水凝胶，通过高含量t-ZnO（达1: The study is based on a 3D printed hydrogel of sodium alginate and antibacterial zinc oxide tetrahedrons, and uses a high content of t-ZnO (up to 15 wt.%) to construct a wound dressing with an open porous structure, verifying its protein adsorption capacity and compatibility with cells and skin. The results show that the open porous structure is antibacterial and does not affect the skin, making it suitable as a carrier platform for active drugs in wound treatment.
研究基于狗颅骨CT扫描，采用3D打印制作了动物专用狗颅骨水模体，结合蒙特卡洛模拟: Based on dog skull CT scans, the study used 3D printing to create an animal-specific dog skull water phantom. Combining Monte Carlo simulation and actual measurement, it verified that positron X-ray therapy has an anode effect in the shallow layer, the intraosseous dose accounts for more than 40%, and is different from linear accelerator therapy, achieving quality assurance for animal-specific radiotherapy.
研究基于猴上颌尖牙模型，采用激光粉末床融合技术制造3D打印钛牙科种植体，结果显示: The study was based on a monkey maxillary canine model and used laser powder bed fusion technology to manufacture 3D printed titanium dental implants. The results showed that the geometric accuracy was 68.70% ± 5.63%, with the main error located at the tooth tip, while the accuracy of the laser PBF process itself reached 90.59% ± 4.75%.
研究基于电子打印的理性配方方法，针对制药领域溶剂型墨水，通过毛细数和韦伯数评估可: Research on rational formulation methods based on electronic printing. For solvent-based inks in the pharmaceutical field, the printability is evaluated through capillary number and Weber number. It is found that the addition of different polymers will reduce the printable space, and the ink performance is affected by the polymer type and concentration. A more process-oriented ink design method is proposed.
研究基于糖尿病患者足部需求，利用3D打印技术结合有限元分析，为志愿者设计定制化踝: Based on the foot needs of diabetic patients, the study used 3D printing technology combined with finite element analysis to design customized ankle fixed orthotics for volunteers. Stress tests at each stage of gait showed that its stresses were lower than the TPE 85A yield strength, and thermal imaging showed that its heat dissipation was better than traditional orthotics.
研究基于系统文献回顾，比较了物理信息神经网络与传统数据驱动模型在预测Ti–6Al: Based on a systematic literature review, the study compared the accuracy of physical information neural networks and traditional data-driven models in predicting microstructure and thermal history in Ti–6Al–4V alloy additive manufacturing. The results showed that the former improved by 10–12%, and that explainable AI is a key direction to meet clinical regulatory requirements.
研究基于羊和猪标本，利用机器人CBCT图像生成颈椎和胸椎的3D打印椎弓根螺钉及椎: Based on sheep and pig specimens, the study used robot CBCT images to generate 3D printed pedicle screws and lamin drill guides for the cervical and thoracic spine. The results showed that it has good reliability in measuring axial and sagittal angles and laminar thickness, and no laminar perforation was found.
研究基于肺部解剖胸 体模 的 CT 数据，利用 3D 打印技术制作了心脏专用插入: Based on the CT data of the lung anatomy chest phantom, the study used 3D printing technology to create a heart-specific insertion simulator with a built-in replaceable cavity and filled with contrast agent and other materials. Its attenuation value is comparable to that of real patients and Catphan® 500 shadow data.
研究基于自组装鸟苷衍生水凝胶，结合葡萄糖氧化酶构建了响应过氧化氢的化学发光体系，: The research is based on a self-assembled guanosine-derived hydrogel, combined with glucose oxidase, to construct a chemiluminescence system that responds to hydrogen peroxide. A portable glucose detection sensor for a smartphone was developed through 3D printing technology, which can accurately measure glucose in serum with a detection limit of 120 µmol L⁻¹.
研究基于葡萄牙3D打印专家的焦点小组讨论，分析了半固态挤出3D打印在制药应用中的: Based on a focus group discussion among Portuguese 3D printing experts, the study analyzed the potential and challenges of semi-solid extrusion 3D printing in pharmaceutical applications. It pointed out that experts generally recognized its prospects, but had doubts about materials, processes, quality control, etc., and emphasized the need to strengthen multi-material research, automation and AI applications, and standardized quality control.
研究基于计算机设计模型，采用选择性激光烧结技术，通过高精度制造具有独特工程与功能: The research is based on computer design models and uses selective laser sintering technology to manufacture personalized drugs with unique engineering and functional properties with high precision, focusing on exploring their material selection, process parameters and application in drug manufacturing.
研究增材制造拓扑结构材料在骨科植入物中的疲劳寿命特性。: Investigate the fatigue life characteristics of additively manufactured topological materials in orthopedic implants.
研究增材制造钴铬钼钨合金牙植入物后处理技术对其微观结构、力学性能、表面特性和电化: Study the effects of post-processing technology on the microstructure, mechanical properties, surface properties and electrochemical behavior of additively manufactured cobalt-chromium-molybdenum-tungsten alloy dental implants.
研究多孔可膨胀且可溶性固体制剂中孔隙率对药物释放动力学的影响。: Study the effect of porosity on drug release kinetics in porous swellable and soluble solid formulations.
研究实际SLA打印牙修复丙烯酸树脂材料，与热聚合冷聚合组分离，非仅泛称医疗潜力: Research on actual SLA printed dental repair acrylic resin material, separated from hot polymerization and cold polymerization group, not only general medical potential
研究实际使用作者既往开发的点环电晕等离子装置用于医疗物品病毒灭活，正文把该系列设: The research actually uses the point ring corona plasma device previously developed by the author for virus inactivation of medical items. The text clearly identifies this series of equipment as a 3D printing device and links the details of the same device in the method; the printing materials and processes are not repeated in this article, and the U is retained.
研究对3D打印钛颅骨植入物分别施加HA和PEEK涂层，通过大气等离子喷涂优化参数: The study applied HA and PEEK coatings to 3D printed titanium skull implants, optimized parameters through atmospheric plasma spraying, and measured its microstructure, surface roughness, adhesion strength and thermal diffusivity. The results show that the HA coating has stronger adhesion, the PEEK coating has better thermal insulation, and the increase in coating thickness improves the thermal insulation effect. Both improve thermal conductivity, but there is a trade-off between thermal insulation and mechanical reliability.
研究对7名成人志愿者佩戴的5种开源N95替代品与商业N95口罩进行定量密合性及过: The study conducted quantitative tightness, filtration efficiency, and air resistance tests on 5 open source N95 substitutes and commercial N95 masks worn by 7 adult volunteers. The results showed that only 1 alternative passed the tightness test, and the remaining 4 filtration efficiencies were lower than 95% and the air resistance exceeded the standard, indicating that their protective performance was insufficient.
研究对七种口罩经10次氢气雾化过氧化氢消毒后，采用自制空气导管评估其过滤效率，结: The study used a self-made air duct to evaluate the filtration efficiency of seven types of masks after 10 times of hydrogen atomization and hydrogen peroxide disinfection. The results showed that the filtration efficiency of 3M-N95 and Benehal-N95 masks at 0.3-1 μm fine particles was significantly lower than that of other types (80.4%-91.8% vs ≥98.1%), and the stability was poor at 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7 μm, and only maintained high stability at 5 μm.
研究对三维网状纯钛植入物采用蚀刻清洁、浸涂法优化纳米羟基磷灰石与聚乳酸复合涂层，: The study used etching cleaning and dip-coating methods to optimize the composite coating of nanohydroxyapatite and polylactic acid on three-dimensional mesh pure titanium implants, and prepared the silk fibroin coating through electrodeposition. The results showed that the 70:30 PLA:nHA and silk fibroin coatings were crack-free and had good biocompatibility.
研究对前牙氧化锆冠在不同临时或永久充填材料下，经根管入口制备后保留力的影响，结果: A study was conducted on the impact of the retention power of anterior zirconia crowns prepared with different temporary or permanent filling materials through the root canal entrance. The results showed that the use of composite resin restorations can increase the retention power by about 150%.
研究对打印装置进行跌落和高压蒸汽处理，并在模拟患者与可变顺应性模型中评价性能。它: The printed device was subjected to drop and high-pressure steam treatment, and performance was evaluated in simulated patients and variable compliance models. It extends prototype validation from a normal run to transportation, handling and load changes
研究对既有文献分层，其中独立3D打印/生物打印主题明确模型、植入、支架与递送系统: The study stratifies the existing literature. Among them, the independent 3D printing/bioprinting topic clearly covers models, implants, stents, and delivery systems, which are not manufactured by the author. There is no specific correspondence between the printing method and materials, and they are not supplemented from the full non-AM total material list.
研究对比了100个3D打印牙科手术导板在不同消毒灭菌方式下的机械性能与几何变化，: The study compared the mechanical properties and geometric changes of 100 3D printed dental surgical guides under different disinfection and sterilization methods. The results showed that high-pressure sterilization at 121°C and 134°C affected their mechanical properties, while 70% alcohol sterilization can better maintain the size and structural integrity of the guides.
研究对比了121°C湿热灭菌与未灭菌的3D打印手术导板，发现灭菌后导板的角向和线: The study compared 121°C moist heat sterilization and non-sterilized 3D printed surgical guides. It was found that the angular and linear deviations of the guide plates after sterilization were within the acceptable range and there was no significant difference, indicating that this sterilization method does not reduce the positioning accuracy of the guide plates.
研究对比了121℃、134℃高压灭菌及70%酒精消毒对3D打印LCD手术导板尺寸: The study compared the effects of high-pressure sterilization at 121°C, 134°C and 70% alcohol disinfection on the size and mechanical properties of 3D printed LCD surgical guides. The results showed that high-temperature sterilization will change the geometric and mechanical properties of the guide plates, while 70% alcohol disinfection has less impact on the guide plates.
研究对比了3D打印与商用Micro Deluxe成像幻影在CT和PET扫描中的表: The study compared the performance of 3D printing and commercial Micro Deluxe imaging phantoms in CT and PET scans. The results showed that the differences in size, activity and attenuation coefficient between the two were within the measurement uncertainty range. The 3D printing phantom can achieve high-resolution imaging and successfully identify small structures, and has functionality comparable to commercial products.
研究对比了3D打印与烧结工艺制备义齿在不同方向的收缩率，通过测量截面拟合度，发现: The study compared the shrinkage rates of dentures prepared by 3D printing and sintering processes in different directions. By measuring the cross-sectional fit, it was found that the bottom shrinkage is crucial to the fit of the denture. The results can be used to optimize the denture model to improve the fit with the standard mold.
研究对比了3D打印全冠临时修复体在120°与180°打印方向下，经热循环和机械循: The study compared the fracture strength of 3D printed full crown temporary restorations in the 120° and 180° printing directions after thermal and mechanical cycle aging. The results showed that the fracture strength of the restorations printed in the 120° direction was significantly higher than that in the 180° direction, and the non-aging group>thermal aging group>thermo-mechanical aging group.
研究对比了3D打印和铣削制备的临时牙冠材料的耐磨性，发现3D打印材料磨损程度显著: The study compared the wear resistance of temporary crown materials prepared by 3D printing and milling. It was found that the wear degree of 3D printing materials was significantly lower than that of milling materials, and the wear resistance of optimized post-processed printing materials was better. Microhardness and nano-roughness are the key factors affecting wear.
研究对比了3D打印多孔钛合金牙植入体与传统加工牙植入体，经喷砂、酸蚀及碱蚀表面处: The study compared 3D printed porous titanium alloy dental implants with traditional processed dental implants. After sandblasting, acid etching and alkali etching surface treatment, the porous implants were better than the untreated group in terms of bioactivity and osteogenic ability, and the bioactivity of the 3D printing group was higher than that of the traditional group.
研究对比了3D打印淀粉基硅胶与纯硅胶制成的面部假体在拉伸强度、撕裂强度和延伸率方: The study compared the mechanical properties of facial prostheses made of 3D printed starch-based silicone and pure silicone in terms of tensile strength, tear strength and elongation. The results showed that the former was significantly lower than the latter.
研究对比了3D打印生物玻璃瓷熔附金属修复体的三种制备方法，结果显示SLM技术在抗: The study compared three preparation methods of 3D printed bioglass-ceramic fused-to-metal restorations. The results showed that SLM technology was the best in terms of tensile strength and mechanical properties, and the casting method had the largest marginal difference. Each step of sintering resulted in changes in edge gaps, and the edge differences during the sintering process were statistically significant.
研究对比了3D打印鼻咽拭子与传统绒毛头拭子在样本保留及舒适度方面的表现，发现3D: The study compared the performance of 3D printed nasopharyngeal swabs and traditional fluff-head swabs in terms of sample retention and comfort. It was found that 3D printed swabs were better in sample retention, especially in the corkscrew shape and negative Poisson's ratio design. The head end structure and stem design were verified by artificial mucus models and are suitable for a variety of viscosity environments.
研究对比了50μm氧化铝和30μm硅包颗粒喷砂对金属核表面粗糙度及修复后断裂强度: The study compared the effects of sandblasting with 50μm alumina and 30μm silicon-coated particles on the surface roughness of the metal core and the fracture strength after repair. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the surface roughness between the two sandblasting methods, and the fracture strength after repair was higher than the clinical acceptance limit.
研究对比了CAD/CAM与传统方法制作的可摘局部义齿和全口义齿，发现CAD/CA: The study compared removable partial dentures and complete dentures made by CAD/CAM and traditional methods and found that CAD/CAM dentures were superior to traditional dentures in terms of accuracy, patient satisfaction, and clinical results, despite problems such as high cost, software errors, and insufficient functional relationships.
研究对比了CAD/CAM全瓷冠在轴向与偏轴就位对边缘密合度及内部密合的影响，结果: The study compared the effects of axial and off-axis placement of CAD/CAM all-ceramic crowns on edge tightness and internal tightness. The results showed that the marginal gap under the 100 μm gap was the smallest when the axial placement was in place, and the maximum gap reached 117 μm when the off-axis placement was on the opposite side of the pressure.
研究对比了DMLS与SLA技术在制作可摘局部义齿支架中的准确性，通过三维分析软件: The study compared the accuracy of DMLS and SLA technology in making removable partial denture brackets. Three-dimensional analysis software was used to measure the gap distance and RMS value in five key areas. The results showed that there was no significant difference between the two technologies in each area, and DMLS was slightly better at the right mesial plate.
研究对比了PEEK、PEKK和PPSU三种高分子材料打印颅骨植入物的力学性能与尺: The study compared the mechanical properties and dimensional accuracy of skull implants printed with three polymer materials: PEEK, PEKK and PPSU. The results showed that PEKK and PPSU can be used as effective substitutes for PEEK in terms of mechanical properties, and have good isotropy and clinically acceptable dimensional accuracy in the vertical printing direction.
研究对比了SS316L材料通过选择性激光熔融制造的Gyroid与Diamond三: The study compared the Gyroid and Diamond triple periodic minimum curved lattice structures manufactured by SS316L material through selective laser melting. The results showed that the Diamond structure is superior to the Gyroid structure in terms of dimensional accuracy, and the surface roughness of both is in the range of 10 to 20 μm, which is conducive to bone tissue interaction.
研究对比了α'马氏体与β相TiTa晶格的机械性能，发现二者在拉伸、压缩及高周疲劳: The study compared the mechanical properties of α' martensite and β phase TiTa lattice and found that the two are equivalent in tensile, compression and high cycle fatigue properties, and their mechanical properties are better than those of Ti-6Al-4V alloy lattice.
研究对比了三种3D打印树脂在不同层厚和建模角度下制作可摘局部义齿框架的准确性，发: The study compared the accuracy of three 3D printing resins in making removable partial denture frames under different layer thicknesses and modeling angles. It was found that a combination of 45° modeling angle, median printing position and specific layer thickness can achieve clinically acceptable accuracy, with the largest difference in the posterior teeth clasp area and the smallest difference in palatal straps.
研究对比了三种不同临时粘接剂对3D打印临时冠即时及长期脱粘强度的影响，结果显示玻: The study compared the effects of three different temporary adhesives on the immediate and long-term debonding strength of 3D printed temporary crowns. The results showed that glass ionomer cement had the highest instant tensile strength, and thermal cycles significantly reduced the bonding strength of all adhesives.
研究对比了三种基于增材制造技术生产的牙科手术导板，通过Gom Inspect软件: The study compared three types of dental surgical guides produced based on additive manufacturing technology, and compared them with STL files through Gom Inspect software to evaluate the shape accuracy of the printed objects, aiming to establish a production method for 3D printed surgical guides that takes shape accuracy into consideration.
研究对比了三类先天性心脏病模型与CT图像及STL文件在10个解剖位置的测量，结果: The study compared the measurements of three types of congenital heart disease models with CT images and STL files at 10 anatomical positions. The results showed that the correlation between the three types reached 0.99, with excellent consistency, proving that the 3D printed model is highly accurate in anatomical reproduction.
研究对比了下肢截肢患者手动与数字设计假肢套筒的几何形态、舒适度及体验，结果显示两: The study compared the geometry, comfort and experience of manually and digitally designed prosthetic sleeves for patients with lower limb amputation. The results showed that there was no significant difference in geometric structure and comfort between the two, and the patient experience was similar. The feasibility of the study was successful, laying the foundation for subsequent randomized controlled trials.
研究对比了不同3D打印表面拓扑结构在合成骨材料中受不同正向力作用下的脱出阻力，发: The study compared the prolapse resistance of different 3D printed surface topologies in synthetic bone materials under different normal forces. It was found that the surface structure and normal force affect the prolapse force. A specific structure can increase the prolapse resistance by 10 times, and the prolapse resistance shows a non-linear relationship with the change of load, and there is a load-dependent performance turning point.
研究对比了不同厚度（2、3、4 mm）、拱型（部分拱和全拱）及储存时间对3D打印: The study compared the effects of different thicknesses (2, 3, 4 mm), arch types (partial arch and full arch) and storage time on the dimensional stability and placement accuracy of 3D printed implant surgery guides. The results showed that the deformation of the 2 mm thick partial arch guide plates increased significantly on the 7th day, while the 3 mm and 4 mm thickness and full arch guide plates were more stable, and it is recommended to be stable for at least 24 hours before clinical use.
研究对比了不同喷砂压力下铝氧化物对3D打印牙科树脂粘接强度的影响，结果显示铝氧化: The study compared the effect of aluminum oxide on the bonding strength of 3D printed dental resin under different sandblasting pressures. The results showed that aluminum oxide sandblasting significantly improved the bonding strength, and the bonding strength increased with the increase of pressure, but higher pressure led to an increase in the fracture rate of the substrate.
研究对比了不同打印参数下PEEK颅骨植入物的机械性能与表面质量，发现水平打印（1: The study compared the mechanical properties and surface quality of PEEK skull implants under different printing parameters and found that horizontal printing (180°) combined with 210°C airflow temperature and other parameters can improve the mechanical strength, but the surface quality is not good and the support structure needs to be optimized.
研究对比了不同打印方向和后固化时间对3D打印丙烯酸树脂牙托基材物理机械性能的影响: The study compared the effects of different printing directions and post-curing time on the physical and mechanical properties of 3D printed acrylic resin dental tray base materials. The results showed that vertical printing (90°) and 30 minutes of post-curing can achieve the best performance, and there was no significant improvement in extending the curing time.
研究对比了不同打印方向（0°、30°、90°）下全口覆盖咬合垫在口腔内的贴合度，: The study compared the fit of the full-mouth bite pad in the oral cavity in different printing directions (0°, 30°, and 90°). The results showed that the fit in the 90° direction was the worst.
研究对比了不同打印方向（0°、45°、90°）对上颌和下颌义齿基托尺寸精度的影响: The study compared the effects of different printing directions (0°, 45°, 90°) on the dimensional accuracy of the maxillary and mandibular denture bases. It was found that the dimensional accuracy of the maxillary base was best in the 90° direction, while the differences in the various directions of the mandibular base were not significant, and the accuracy variation in the 90° direction was greater.
研究对比了不同打印角度下3D打印临时牙冠的准确性与精密度，结果显示90°角度在内: The study compared the accuracy and precision of 3D printed temporary crowns at different printing angles. The results showed that the 90° angle was better in terms of internal fit, the custom angle performed better on the occlusal surface, and the custom angle was better than other angles in terms of internal fit accuracy. The 135° angle was not ideal in all aspects.
研究对比了不同抗锯齿水平和像素偏移设置对全瓷冠边缘适应性、内部贴合及表面特性的影: The study compared the effects of different anti-aliasing levels and pixel offset settings on the edge adaptability, internal fit and surface properties of all-ceramic crowns. The results showed that medium anti-aliasing and +1 pixel offset optimized axial fit, -1 pixel offset optimized occlusal fit, and high anti-aliasing combined with -1 pixel offset performed the best in various indicators.
研究对比了不同梯度方式对增材制造牙种植体周围骨应力的影响，发现基于环形结构的局部: The study compared the effects of different gradient methods on bone stress around additively manufactured dental implants, and found that the local gradient design based on annular structures can most effectively reduce the stress peak, reducing the maximum principal stress by 22% and the minimum principal stress by 6% compared with uniform materials.
研究对比了不同清洁方法对3D打印三单位固定义齿的变形影响，结果显示超声处理与酒精: The study compared the effects of different cleaning methods on the deformation of 3D printed three-unit fixed dentures. The results showed that the angular and longitudinal deformation trends were more significant when ultrasonic treatment was combined with alcohol, indicating that the choice of cleaning solution has an important impact on the morphological stability of the crown.
研究对比了不同激光扫描速度下3D打印安慰剂片在人体内的崩解时间，发现高扫描速度组: The study compared the disintegration time of 3D printed placebo tablets in the human body under different laser scanning speeds. It was found that the disintegration time of the high scanning speed group was shorter, and there was no clear correlation between the in vitro test results and the in vivo performance.
研究对比了不同生物材料（金属与非金属）及不同结构（实心与孔状）定制颅骨植入物在动: The study compared the mechanical behavior of customized skull implants of different biomaterials (metal and non-metal) and different structures (solid and porous) under dynamic stress. It was found that PMMA material implants are more effective in isolating stress than metal materials. Although the porous structure reduces the stiffness of the implant, it also reduces the stress on the surrounding tissue.
研究对比了不同表面处理及临时冠材料对3D打印PEEK支托剪切结合强度的影响，结果: The study compared the effects of different surface treatments and temporary crown materials on the shear bonding strength of 3D printed PEEK supports. The results showed that the use of artificial tooth resin and sandblasting or sandpaper polishing can significantly improve the bonding strength.
研究对比了不同表面粗糙度和聚电解质多层涂层对钛基材料上人正常成骨细胞黏附及人血清: The study compared the effects of different surface roughness and polyelectrolyte multilayer coatings on the adhesion of normal human osteoblasts and adsorption of human serum albumin on titanium-based materials. The results showed that amino-rich coatings significantly improved protein adsorption and cell adhesion, and the chemical composition of the surface had a more significant impact on cell behavior than roughness.
研究对比了不同连接尺寸和材料对3D打印后牙固定桥断裂强度的影响，结果显示连接尺寸: The study compared the effects of different connection sizes and materials on the fracture strength of 3D printed posterior fixed bridges. The results showed that the larger the connection size and using Temp printing resin, the higher the fracture strength, and reached more than 1500 N at a 5×5 mm connection size.
研究对比了两种3D打印机打印的聚合物模型与手术导板在26项参数上的准确性，发现线: The study compared the accuracy of 26 parameters between polymer models printed by two 3D printers and surgical guides. It was found that the accuracy of linear parameters is higher. The accuracy of the X-Y axis and model B is better than that of model A. The surgical guide polymer (NextDent™ SG) has the highest accuracy, and the accuracy is affected by the design.
研究对比了两种光引发剂添加型3D打印牙科树脂在力学性能和生物相容性方面的差异，通: The study compared the differences in mechanical properties and biocompatibility of two photoinitiator-added 3D printing dental resins. Samples were prepared through molds and cured with double-sided LED light. The bending strength and modulus were measured, and the biocompatibility was evaluated with MTT experiments. The results showed that different photoinitiators have different effects on performance.
研究对比了两种牙科种植手术导板的设计：自动建模的通用模板与人工修改的强化模板，在: The study compared two designs of guide plates for dental implant surgery: an automatically modeled universal template and a manually modified strengthened template. Under a drilling force of 30N, the manually modified strengthened template performed better in displacement and stress. The stress values of the templates made of the two materials were the same, and the displacement difference was 7-8%.
研究对比了两种设计的钙磷-钛复合颅骨植入物在准静态与冲击载荷下的力学响应，结果显: The study compared the mechanical response of two designs of calcium-phosphorus-titanium composite skull implants under quasi-static and impact loads. The results showed that the two designs were similar in peak load and had higher hardness under impact. The titanium structure broke under quasi-static conditions but not under impact. D2 had a larger displacement under impact. The quasi-static compressive strength of the composite material was higher than that of reported ceramic-based implants.
研究对比了临床复制法与数字注册法在评估选择性激光熔融制作的可摘局部义齿框架贴合度: This study compared the differences between the clinical replication method and the digital registration method in assessing the fit of removable partial denture frames made by selective laser melting. The results showed that the gaps measured by both methods were below the clinical acceptable limit, and there were significant differences between each marked point, but there was no significant difference between frames.
研究对比了人工智能设计与手动CAD流程在单冠设计中的时间、边缘密合度、牙体形态及: The study compared the time, edge fit, tooth shape and contact point differences between artificial intelligence design and manual CAD process in single crown design. The results showed that the artificial intelligence process significantly shortened the design time. There was a significant difference only in the mesial adjacent contact point. There was no significant difference in other contact points and edge fit.
研究对比了使用DLP与LCD 3D打印技术制作的上颌义齿基托的尺寸精度，结果显示: The study compared the dimensional accuracy of maxillary denture bases produced using DLP and LCD 3D printing technology. The results showed that the root mean square deviation of the LCD group was significantly lower than that of the DLP group, and the surface consistency was better, indicating that LCD technology has higher geometric accuracy and stability in denture production.
研究对比了使用粉末床融合（PBF）和熔融沉积（FFF）技术制造的聚醚醚酮颅骨植入: The study compared polyether ether ketone skull implants manufactured using powder bed fusion (PBF) and fused deposition (FFF) technology. The results showed that implants prepared by FFF absorbed more energy, deformed more significantly, and fractured more concentratedly during compression and impact tests, while PBF samples caused overall fracture due to high brittleness.
研究对比了六种表面处理方式对3D打印义齿基托与人工牙间剪切结合强度的影响，结果显: The study compared the effects of six surface treatment methods on the shear bonding strength between 3D printed denture bases and artificial teeth. The results showed that the combined sandblasting and adhesive pretreatment group had the highest bonding strength, which was 134.6% higher than the control group.
研究对比了加工程微纹理对增材制造树脂复合冠界面粘附性的影响，发现pin和氟石纹理: The study compared the effect of processing micro-texture on the interface adhesion of additively manufactured resin composite crowns. It was found that pin and fluorite textures significantly improved the interface strength and reliability, achieving a transition from adhesive fracture to mixed and cohesive fracture, which was better than traditional sandblasting.
研究对比了医疗学生在妇科盆腔检查培训中使用3D打印模型与传统教学方式，结果显示使: The study compared the use of 3D printed models and traditional teaching methods in gynecological pelvic examination training for medical students. The results showed that the model group was significantly better than the control group in terms of satisfaction, knowledge mastery and recognition of the model.
研究对比了十例尸检基底动脉健康与斑块病变段的剪切力学行为，发现斑块区域需更高剪切: The study compared the shear mechanical behavior of healthy and plaque-affected basilar arteries in ten autopsy cases and found that plaque areas require higher shear forces, and that none of the six 3D printing models could truly simulate the biomechanical response of the artery.
研究对比了含氯消毒液及含皂刷牙对3D打印义齿基台树脂表面生物膜的控制效果，结果显: The study compared the control effects of chlorine-containing disinfectant and soap-containing tooth brushing on biofilm on the surface of 3D printed denture abutment resin. The results showed that infiltration of 0.25% sodium hypochlorite and 2% chlorhexidine can effectively reduce biofilm and metabolic activity. Sodium hypochlorite is more effective when brushing teeth with chlorhexidine combined with soap.
研究对比了含碳纤维复合材料与纯3D打印材料在踝足矫形器中的力学性能，发现碳纤维复: The study compared the mechanical properties of carbon fiber composite materials and pure 3D printing materials in ankle and foot orthotics and found that carbon fiber composite materials have better strength, but the preparation takes longer and the process is unstable.
研究对比了商业肠溶胶囊与含羟丙基甲基纤维素乙酸酯等聚合物的3D打印肠溶胶囊，前者: The study compared commercial enteric-coated capsules with 3D printed enteric-coated capsules containing polymers such as hydroxypropyl methylcellulose acetate. The former released drugs rapidly in intestinal fluid, while the latter achieved sustained and gradual release, and a high proportion of HPMC-AS significantly extended the release time.
研究对比了四种制造路径的可摘局部义齿在机械测试中的表现，通过可靠性、耐久性和顺应: The study compared the performance of four manufacturing routes of removable partial dentures in mechanical testing, ranking them by reliability, durability and compliance criteria, combined with the AHP-VIKOR method and finite element simulation. The results showed that additive manufacturing technology is competitive and cost-effective.
研究对比了垂直与水平方向构建的Ti-6Al-4V增材制造试样，经热等静压、喷砂、: The study compared vertically and horizontally constructed Ti-6Al-4V additive manufacturing samples, which were subjected to different post-processing methods such as hot isostatic pressing, sandblasting, polishing and chemical etching. It was found that the strength of the vertically constructed samples was superior to that of horizontal ones. After hot isostatic pressing and chemical etching, the fatigue performance and cell affinity were improved, among which the chemical etching post-processing effect was the best.
研究对比了增材制造Co-Cr-Mo合金在未处理、等离子体离子注入及钛涂层后离子注: The study compared the osseointegration of additively manufactured Co-Cr-Mo alloys under three conditions: unprocessed, plasma ion implantation, and titanium coating followed by ion implantation. The results showed that the titanium-coated samples had the best bone growth, and the medullary cavity and pores were completely filled with new bone, and the osseointegration effect was optimal.
研究对比了增材制造用于下颌手术及颞下颌关节植入物患者特异性手术导板和植入物的临床: The study compared the clinical performance of additive manufacturing of patient-specific surgical guides and implants for mandibular surgery and temporomandibular joint implants. It was found that the existing literature lacked a comprehensive evaluation of clinical outcomes, and complete data on time management, cost, clinical outcomes, placement accuracy, and complications need to be supplemented to verify actual benefits.
研究对比了增材制造脊柱融合器在骨接触面积和压力分布上的表现，发现网状核心植入物在: The study compared the performance of additively manufactured spinal fusion cages in terms of bone contact area and pressure distribution, and found that the mesh core implant was superior to the solid core in terms of surface fit and pressure distribution, providing preliminary support that additive manufacturing can match the geometry of the implant and the vertebral body end plate.
研究对比了多种3D打印塑料在不同辐射能量下的衰减特性及CT值，结果表明同类型塑料: The study compared the attenuation characteristics and CT values of various 3D printing plastics under different radiation energies. The results showed that the same type of plastics are different due to manufacturing differences. It is recommended that medical phantoms must be printed using the same printer, parameters and materials as the test samples.
研究对比了多种家用缝制口罩及标准口罩在佩戴时侧边、底部和鼻部缝隙处的气溶胶分布，: The study compared the aerosol distribution at the sides, bottom and nose gaps of a variety of household sewn masks and standard masks when worn. It was found that all masks significantly reduced front aerosols, but the aerosol concentration at the gaps increased and the particle size distribution changed. Among them, household masks with coffee filters performed best. Social distance is crucial in reducing aerosol transmission.
研究对比了截肢者与健康志愿者对上肢仿生假手不同人机接口的使用感受，通过统一3D打: The study compared the experience of amputees and healthy volunteers using different human-machine interfaces for upper limb bionic prosthetic hands, and evaluated the impact of the interface on the user's workload through a unified 3D printing terminal device to clarify the differences in user-friendliness of different interface solutions.
研究对比了手部假肢座传统层压设计与新型3D打印设计的机械性能，通过冲击加载和软件: The study compared the mechanical properties of the traditional laminated design of the hand prosthetic base with the new 3D printing design, and evaluated its durability and fatigue characteristics through impact loading and software simulation. The results showed that the 3D printing design has advantages in production efficiency and mechanical performance.
研究对比了拓扑优化和TPMS晶格结构对牙科种植体应力屏蔽的减少效果，结果显示前者: The study compared the effects of topology optimization and TPMS lattice structure on reducing the stress shielding of dental implants. The results showed that the former reduced the stress shielding by 20% and the latter reduced the stress shielding by 15%, and met the standard requirements in terms of fatigue performance.
研究对比了文本仪与旋转 rheometer 对羟基凝胶流变数据的测定，发现两者通: The study compared the measurement of rheological data of hydroxyl gel by textometer and rotary rheometer, and found that the difference in parameters obtained by fitting the power law model between the two was not significant. In the regression prediction model established based on rheological properties and printability, the prediction accuracy of capillary flow parameters reached 96.62%.
研究对比了新型注塑鼻咽拭子（IM2）与Copan FLOQSwab在检测SARS: The study compared the performance of the new injection molded nasopharyngeal swab (IM2) and Copan FLOQSwab in detecting SARS-CoV-2. The results showed that the two were generally consistent, with positive coincidence rates of 96.0% and 94.9% respectively. There was no significant difference in cycle thresholds, and there was no significant difference in safety and patient pain.
研究对比了机加工与选择性激光熔融（SLM）制备的Ti–6Al–4V牙科植入体经酸: The study compared the surface morphology and corrosion resistance of Ti–6Al–4V dental implants prepared by machining and selective laser melting (SLM) before and after acid etching. The results showed that there were unfused particles on the surface of the SLM sample, which reduced the corrosion resistance. After hydrofluoric acid etching, the corrosion resistance increased and the surface roughness decreased. After sanding, the corrosion resistance of the two types of samples was similar in fluorine-containing and non-fluorine salt solutions.
研究对比了添加不同含量纳米二氧化硅对3D打印义齿基质和牙体材料在加速化学老化下的: The study compared the bending properties and surface wettability changes of 3D printed denture matrix and tooth materials under accelerated chemical aging by adding different contents of nano-silica. The results showed that 20 wt.% silica increased the initial stiffness and strength of the matrix, and aging in an acidic environment led to a decrease in performance. The surface wettability changes are related to the bending properties and can be used as a non-destructive indicator to evaluate the degree of material aging.
研究对比了添加生物活性玻璃涂层与掺杂的3D打印钛合金植入物，发现涂层组在早期愈合: The study compared adding bioactive glass coating with doped 3D printed titanium alloy implants and found that the coating group had more significant osseointegration and bone density improvement in the early healing stage, but the effect was no longer significant after 12 weeks.
研究对比了添加银、铜、锌纳米颗粒的增材制造钛合金 多孔 Ti6Al44V imp: The study compared the surfaces of additively manufactured titanium alloy porous Ti6Al44V implants with silver, copper, and zinc nanoparticles added. It was found that surfaces containing silver or a combination of silver and copper or zinc have strong antibacterial properties against MRSA. They can completely remove surface and non-adherent bacteria within 24 hours and prevent biofilm formation.
研究对比了用于个性化植入系统的不同原材料，通过有限元分析和动态疲劳测试发现，钴铬: The study compared different raw materials used for personalized implant systems. Through finite element analysis and dynamic fatigue testing, it was found that cobalt-chromium alloy showed the highest fracture value and number of cycles in static and dynamic tests, and the parts manufactured by subtractive materials were more durable.
研究对比了由选择性激光烧结制成的多孔结构冠与无孔铸造冠的内部配合度，结果显示多孔: The study compared the internal fit of porous structural crowns made by selective laser sintering and non-porous cast crowns. The results showed that the internal gaps of porous structural crowns were significantly smaller than non-porous crowns, indicating that their internal fits were better.
研究对比了电子注射器沉积与盘涂法对FDM打印PLA片剂的药物装载效果，结果显示盘: The study compared the drug loading effects of electronic syringe deposition and disk coating methods on FDM printed PLA tablets. The results showed that the drug utilization rate of the disk coating method was as high as 88%, the drug loading capacity reached 10.14%, and the release was rapid; the electronic syringe method had a drug loading capacity of 4.8%, slower release, but higher precision. Both methods comply with USP standards and maintain the crystalline state of the drug.
研究对比了立体光固化（SLA）与蜡型（LW）制作的三单位固定修复体，测量其边缘及: The study compared three-unit fixed restorations made by stereolithography (SLA) and wax-up (LW), and measured the edge and internal gaps. The results showed that the total gap in the SLA group (98.6 µm) was significantly larger than that in the LW group (66.6 µm).
研究对比了立方与仿生gyroid结构PLA支架在体外生理条件下的降解行为，发现立: The study compared the degradation behavior of cubic and biomimetic gyroid structure PLA stents under physiological conditions in vitro. It was found that the initial mechanical properties of cubic stents were better than those of gyroid stents, and the structural stability was better during the degradation process. However, the high porosity of gyroid stents led to faster degradation and a more obvious decline in mechanical properties.
研究对比了线弹性各向同性与非线性各向异性材料在脊柱重建中的生物力学表现，发现非线: The study compared the biomechanical performance of linear elastic isotropic and nonlinear anisotropic materials in spinal reconstruction and found that the stress, displacement, and strain predicted by the nonlinear anisotropic model were lower than those of the isotropic model, indicating that the isotropic assumption may underestimate safety and overestimate stability and bone growth capacity.
研究对比了经CNC车床加工后直径减小的窄径钛种植体与未处理种植体的抗压强度，结果: The study compared the compressive strength of narrow-diameter titanium implants with reduced diameters processed by CNC lathes and untreated implants. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the maximum compressive force between the two, indicating that implant modification did not significantly reduce its fracture resistance.
研究对比了经阳极氧化和嵌入磷酸钙纳米颗粒处理的选区激光熔融钛表面，发现AOC样品: The study compared selective laser melted titanium surfaces treated with anodization and embedded calcium phosphate nanoparticles. It was found that the AOC sample was significantly better than the AO and untreated groups in terms of adhesion, proliferation and adhesion-related gene expression of human gingival epithelial cells and gingival fibroblasts, and the effect was comparable to the mechanical polishing group.
研究对比了连续与脉冲激光扫描对Ti6Al4V蜂窝结构微观组织及疲劳性能的影响，发: The study compared the effects of continuous and pulsed laser scanning on the microstructure and fatigue performance of the Ti6Al4V honeycomb structure. It was found that continuous laser scanning had fewer defects, better fatigue performance, and the pulsed laser structure was more uniform; the optimized combination of hot isostatic pressing, sandblasting and chemical etching can improve fatigue life.
研究对比了选择性激光熔融与电子束熔融制备的Ti-6Al-4V髋关节植入物经热处理: The study compared the microstructure, mechanical properties, corrosion resistance and biocompatibility of Ti-6Al-4V hip implants prepared by selective laser melting and electron beam melting after heat treatment and hot isostatic pressing. The results showed that the heat-treated samples have better corrosion resistance and biocompatibility, and the HA coating improves cell metabolic activity.
研究对比了选择性激光熔融（SLM）与传统失蜡铸造制作钴铬可摘局部义齿框架的贴合度: The study compared the fit and retention of cobalt-chromium removable partial denture frames made by selective laser melting (SLM) and traditional lost-wax casting.
