研究对比了通过减材和增材制造技术制作的3单位固定修复体的边缘及内部间隙差异，结果: The study compared the differences in the edges and internal gaps of 3-unit fixed restorations produced by subtractive and additive manufacturing technologies. The results showed that the two technologies had different performances in terms of edges and internal gaps.
研究对比了采用传统与数字印模技术制作的三单位氧化锆固定桥在三维方向上的密合度，结: The study compared the three-dimensional tightness of three-unit zirconia fixed bridges made using traditional and digital impression technology. The results showed that the fixed bridge made with traditional impression technology was further apart at some measurement points, but there was no significant difference in edge tightness between the two groups.
研究对比了钴铬钼合金在精密铸造和选择性激光熔融（SLM）加工后的微观结构与力学性: The study compared the microstructure and mechanical properties of cobalt-chromium-molybdenum alloys after precision casting and selective laser melting (SLM) processing. The results showed that the alloy prepared by SLM has a finer cellular structure and higher strength, and its yield strength and tensile strength are both better than those of cast samples.
研究对比了钴铬钼钨合金牙科修复体采用精密铸造与选择性激光熔融（SLM）成型的表面: The study compared the surface roughness and microstructure of cobalt-chromium-molybdenum-tungsten alloy dental restorations molded by precision casting and selective laser melting (SLM). The results showed that SLM products have a rougher surface but higher hardness and dense structure. Although the process cost is high, the overall manufacturing time is shorter, the cost is lower, and the quality is more stable.
研究对比了铸造、3D打印模具铸造及选择性激光熔融技术制备的钴铬四部分牙桥的边缘与: The study compared the edge and internal fit accuracy of a cobalt-chromium four-part dental bridge prepared by casting, 3D printing mold casting, and selective laser melting technology. The results showed that the fitting accuracy of the bridge using 3D printing mold casting and SLM technology was the highest, better than traditional casting, and the edge fit was within the clinically acceptable range.
研究对比了铸造钴铬合金与3D打印激光熔融-烧结钴铬合金在 可摘局部义齿框架中的微: The study compared the microstructure and mechanical properties of cast cobalt-chromium alloy and 3D printed laser melting-sintered cobalt-chromium alloy in removable partial denture frames. The results showed that 3D printed samples had higher yield strength and tensile strength, slightly lower elongation, and the microstructure showed typical characteristics of additive technology.
研究对比了镍铬和钴铬合金经选择性激光熔融（SLM）与传统铸造工艺制成的牙科修复体: The study compared the mechanical properties and micro-surface characteristics of dental restorations made of nickel-chromium and cobalt-chromium alloys through selective laser melting (SLM) and traditional casting processes at different processing stages. It was found that the SLM process was superior to traditional casting in some mechanical properties, and the degree of post-processing of the SLM restoration significantly affected its micro-roughness. There was no significant difference in surface roughness between different processes under the same treatment.
研究对比五家知名公司生产的假肢美容罩设计元素，通过Pugh矩阵分析，发现新型设计: The study compared the design elements of prosthetic beauty covers produced by five well-known companies. Through Pugh matrix analysis, it was found that the new design was superior to the existing solutions in terms of fit, ease of installation and practicality, and a more personalized customized design direction was proposed.
研究对比钛和碳纤维增强聚醚醚酮（CFR-PEEK）脊柱植入物在立体定向体部放疗中: The study compared the image and dose performance of titanium and carbon fiber reinforced polyetheretherketone (CFR-PEEK) spinal implants in stereotactic body radiotherapy. The results showed that CFR-PEEK implants reduce image artifacts, improve dose distribution, and can achieve clinically acceptable dose accuracy without metal artifact correction, while titanium implants rely on metal artifact correction.
研究对自制3D打印聚醚醚酮（PEEK）定制颅骨植入物在蒸汽灭菌后的尺寸准确性进行: The study evaluated the dimensional accuracy of homemade 3D printed polyetheretherketone (PEEK) customized skull implants after steam sterilization. The results showed that the deviations were less than 1.00 mm, and sterilization did not significantly affect the dimensional accuracy of the implants.
研究对象为一名24岁女性患者，因上前牙小而发黄寻求美学改善，经院内美白、数字化微: The subject of the study was a 24-year-old female patient who sought aesthetic improvement due to small and yellow upper front teeth. She underwent in-hospital whitening, digital smile design, intraoral simulation, and 3D printing indirect resin veneer treatment. Two-year follow-up showed that the aesthetic results were satisfactory and clinically stable.
研究对象包括改变原有表面的酸热处理、阳极氧化和紫外功能化，也包括增加羟基磷灰石等: Research objects include acid heat treatment, anodization and UV functionalization to change the original surface, as well as coatings that add bioactive ingredients such as hydroxyapatite. Two questions need to be answered simultaneously during the evaluation: whether the treatment improves the interface bioresponse, and whether the actual implant after treatment still retains the desired pores and structural properties.
研究对象明确3D打印钛合金融合笼及其抗菌涂层，GelMA/SF和银载体是后涂层；: The research object is clearly 3D printed titanium alloy fusion cage and its antibacterial coating. GelMA/SF and silver carrier are the post-coatings; printing materials will not be expanded. The specific printing process has not been determined.
研究对象正在从导板扩展到更丰富的操作支持器械，验证方法也由形态展示延伸到持续载荷: The research objects are expanding from guide plates to richer operating support devices, and the verification methods are also extended from morphological display to continuous load, image compatibility and functional testing under human anatomy conditions.
研究导板本体是铣削，但两组试验牙列模型同STL同打印机树脂实际制造，医疗实验AM: The main body of the research guide is milled, but the two sets of experimental dentition models are actually manufactured with STL and printer resin, and the AM phantom for medical experiments is enough to be included; the printing purpose is P6, not the fake P4 guide, and the exact process is not given.
研究将 hinokitiol 载入 phytosome 并制成 3D 打印口服片: The study loaded hinokitiol into phytosome and made it into 3D printed oral tablets. Compared with pure tablets, the results showed that the drug-loaded phytosome tablets performed better in terms of in vitro dissolution and pharmacokinetics, with more complete drug release and higher blood drug concentration.
研究将3D打印微流体通道集成至含硅氮化物光子波导的可植入神经探针，实现神经探针的: The research integrates 3D printed microfluidic channels into implantable neural probes containing silicon nitride photonic waveguides to realize the optogenetic stimulation and neurochemical injection sampling functions of the neural probe. The fluorescein injection and photolysis verification are completed in agarose gel and fixed brain tissue.
研究将3D打印的新生儿唇腭裂头模融入本科正畸课程，对比发现该教学方法提升了学生对: The study integrated 3D printed neonatal cleft lip and palate head molds into undergraduate orthodontic courses, and found that this teaching method improved students' understanding of the anatomical structure of cleft lip and palate.
研究将3D打印的聚氨酯-丙烯酸酯软义齿衬里应用于大鼠颊黏膜，通过组织学和免疫组化: The study applied 3D printed polyurethane-acrylate soft denture lining to the buccal mucosa of rats. Histological and immunohistochemical tests found that the material had no cytotoxicity in the body and did not cause epithelial damage or inflammatory reactions. Mucosal integrity and differentiation markers remained stable, and inflammatory markers returned to normal after a brief increase.
研究将3D打印聚丙烯酸基微流体平台与光学纳米多孔适配体传感器集成，通过紫外胶层连: The study integrated a 3D printed polyacrylic acid-based microfluidic platform with an optical nanoporous aptamer sensor and connected it through a UV glue layer to achieve real-time detection of his-tagged proteins. Its detection limit (0.04 μM) was better than that of non-microfluidic platforms (2.7 μM) and better than that of PDMS-based microfluidic platforms.
研究将3D生物打印的患者特异性组织与微流控系统结合，构建多器官模型，以更准确模拟: The research combines 3D bioprinted patient-specific tissues with microfluidic systems to build multi-organ models to more accurately simulate the human physiological environment, achieve accurate evaluation of drug screening and personalized treatment, and replace animal experiments.
研究将56名医护人员使用改装的全脸 snorkel 面罩与标准FFP3口罩加护目: The study compared the use of modified full-face snorkel masks with standard FFP3 masks and goggles by 56 medical staff. The results showed that the snorkel mask was superior to the standard PPE combination in terms of filtration testing and droplet deposition protection.
研究将CBD或CBG纳米颗粒嵌入海藻酸钠3D打印薄膜，评估其体外伤口愈合效果，结: Studies have embedded CBD or CBG nanoparticles into sodium alginate 3D printing films to evaluate their in vitro wound healing effects. The results show that the nanoparticles promote healing in the first 6 hours, but have adverse effects in the subsequent 6 hours. Cell viability is good within 24 hours at a concentration of 0.1 mg/mL. CBG nanoparticles are still safe at 48 hours, but cell viability decreases significantly at high concentrations and after 24 hours.
研究将COST参考等离子体喷嘴与3D打印微流控装置结合，通过调控毛细作用实现等离: The study combined the COST reference plasma nozzle with a 3D printed microfluidic device to achieve the transport of reactive species at the plasma-liquid interface by regulating capillary action. The hydrogen peroxide colorimetric method was used to detect its generation and transport, revealing two operating modes and their advantages, and providing a new tool for standardized research on plasma-liquid interactions.
研究将DMAHDM和/或MPC添加至热聚合与3D打印义齿基质中，检测其对弯曲强度: This study added DMAHDM and/or MPC to thermally polymerized and 3D printed denture matrices to examine their effects on bending strength and surface hardness. The results showed that the addition concentration needs to be optimized to maintain the mechanical properties of the material.
研究将DMAHDM和MPC添加至热聚合和3D打印义齿基质中，发现1.5% DMA: The study added DMAHDM and MPC to thermally polymerized and 3D printed denture matrices, and found that 1.5% DMAHDM combined with 3% MPC significantly reduced microbial attachment, and the cell survival rate in each group was higher than 70%, showing good biocompatibility.
研究将MPC和DDAM添加至3D打印义齿基质中，评估其抗真菌性能及热循环后机械强: The study added MPC and DDAM to the 3D printed denture matrix to evaluate its antifungal performance and changes in mechanical strength after thermal cycling. The results showed that thermal cycling led to a decrease in antifungal effect, especially in the DDAM group, while the MPC group and the combination group performed better in maintaining antifungal activity and strength.
研究将PC12细胞固定于电纺聚苯乙烯纤维三维支架中，结合3D打印微流控装置，实现: The study fixed PC12 cells in a three-dimensional electrospun polystyrene fiber scaffold, combined with a 3D printed microfluidic device, to achieve real-time electrochemical detection of multiple types of neurotransmitters released after cell stimulation.
研究将α-银钨矿微晶功能化于义齿基托树脂中，保持其结构，表面自由能升高，抗压强度: In this study, α-silver tungsten ore microcrystals were functionalized into denture base resin, maintaining its structure, increasing surface free energy, and slightly decreasing compressive strength. It showed anti-adhesion and anti-biofilm effects on Candida albicans, Staphylococcus aureus, and Escherichia coli, without affecting the biocompatibility and inflammatory response of the material.
研究将三维打印脊柱植入物应用于脊柱手术，通过放射影像构建个性化植入物，实现解剖匹: Research has applied three-dimensional printed spinal implants to spinal surgeries to construct personalized implants through radiographic imaging to achieve anatomical matching and improve surgical strategies and patient recovery. However, due to high cost, unclear long-term human response, and lack of longitudinal studies, its safety and effectiveness still need to be verified by prospective studies.

研究将二氧化锆、银和二氧化钛纳米颗粒以不同浓度添加至3D打印义齿树脂中，比较其对: The study added zirconium dioxide, silver and titanium dioxide nanoparticles to 3D printed denture resin at different concentrations to compare their antibacterial effects against Streptococcus, Staphylococcus aureus and Candida albicans. The results showed that adding nanoparticles significantly reduced the number of bacteria, and the higher the concentration, the stronger the antibacterial activity. There was no significant difference in the antibacterial effects among the three types of nanoparticles.
研究将五种多孔拓扑结构和三种表面特征尺寸应用于3D打印的PEEK结构件表面，再进: In this study, five porous topological structures and three surface feature sizes were applied to the surface of 3D printed PEEK structural parts, and then UHMWPE coating was performed. The measured separation force was 1.97–3.86 kN, which is better than traditional metal backplane components. The porous structure and surface feature size affect the mechanical properties and failure mechanism.
研究将减法制造中回收的生物陶瓷粉末与树脂混合，经间接混料策略制备陶瓷胶体，用于3: The study mixed bioceramic powder recovered from subtractive manufacturing with resin, and prepared ceramic colloid through an indirect mixing strategy for 3D printing of dental crowns. The resulting parts have good uniformity and layer thickness control, and the cost is lower than traditional subtractive manufacturing of crowns.
研究将医院打印用于临床试验制剂生产，综合考虑联合药物、每小时产出和长期储存。规模: Study the use of hospital printing for clinical trial formulation production, taking into account drug combinations, throughput per hour, and long-term storage. Scale here is reflected in meeting the complete chemical supply task, rather than increasing the speed of the nozzle alone
研究将可聚合丙烯酰胺加入商用光敏树脂，使3D打印微流控器件表面具备可功能化特性，: The study added polymerizable acrylamide to commercial photosensitive resin to make the surface of 3D printed microfluidic devices functional. It successfully achieved the fixation of bovine hemoglobin and bovine serum albumin through glutaraldehyde cross-linking, verifying its specific binding ability.
研究将含双氯芬酸的可注射水凝胶嵌入3D打印多孔聚乳酸支架，并结合超声调控药物释放: The study embedded an injectable hydrogel containing diclofenac into a 3D printed porous polylactic acid scaffold and combined it with ultrasound to control drug release. The results showed that ultrasound significantly improved the drug release efficiency, increasing the 8-hour cumulative release rate from 26.0% to 46.8%, effectively relieving edema and pain in an arthritis rat model.
研究将含多柔比星的Spanlastics囊泡整合至FRESH打印的海藻酸盐水凝胶: The study integrated doxorubicin-containing Spanlastics vesicles into FRESH-printed alginate hydrogels to achieve sustained release of the drug. This system showed better release performance than suspension and an inhibitory effect on MCF7 breast cancer cells in vitro.
研究将含奈替德尼和左氧氟沙星的生物可降解3D打印气道支架应用于兔气管，证实其可局: The study applied a biodegradable 3D printed airway stent containing netidinib and levofloxacin to the trachea of ​​rabbits, and confirmed that it can locally release the drug, inhibit bacterial colonization, reduce IL8 expression, and effectively alleviate the inflammatory response.
研究将含植物精油微胶囊的3D打印义齿基质树脂，比较了不同浓度微胶囊对弯曲强度、模: The study used 3D printed denture matrix resin containing plant essential oil microcapsules, and compared the effects of different concentrations of microcapsules on bending strength, modulus, hardness and surface roughness. The results showed that as the concentration of microcapsules increased, the bending strength decreased and the surface roughness increased, but the modulus and hardness did not change much, and most indicators still met clinical standards.
研究将含氢化可的松药液的3D打印小剂量批次进行在线质量检测，通过内置分析天平实时: The study carried out online quality inspection of 3D printed small-dose batches containing hydrocortisone solution, and recorded the weight of each tablet in real time through a built-in analytical balance. It was found that only one tablet in the first batch of printing had an abnormal weight, and the results were not significantly different from the external balance detection, achieving automated and real-time monitoring of the quality of the printed batches.
研究将含硫热响应聚合物引入氧化透明质酸微球体系，通过硫醇-醛动态共价键实现微球自: In this study, a sulfur-containing thermoresponsive polymer was introduced into the oxidized hyaluronic acid microsphere system. Microsphere self-assembly, shear thinning and self-healing were achieved through thiol-aldehyde dynamic covalent bonds. Combined with the thermoresponsive phase change and secondary cross-linking at body temperature, an injectable, shape-stable and drug-sustained granular hydrogel with no post-processing was obtained, which is suitable for cell delivery and 3D printing.
研究将含自修复聚脲甲醛微胶囊的3D打印义齿基树脂，通过不同含量（0、5、15、2: The study added 3D printed denture-based resin containing self-healing polyurea formaldehyde microcapsules at different contents (0, 5, 15, 25 wt%) to evaluate its fracture toughness and self-healing efficiency. The results showed that increasing the microcapsule content significantly improved the fracture toughness and self-healing performance.
研究将含芬氟拉明的非乳化脂质基配方制成油水乳液，协同使用硬脂酸和二氧化硅纳米颗粒: The study made a non-emulsifying lipid-based formula containing fenfluramine into an oil-water emulsion, which was stabilized by stearic acid and silica nanoparticles. Cellulose biopolymer was then added to form a gel, which was 3D printed into tablets through semi-solid extrusion. The gel has higher viscosity, yield stress and storage modulus than traditional self-emulsifying lipid-based emulsion gels, enabling rapid digestion and release of lipid drugs in the small intestine.
研究将四烷基甲基丙烯酰氧基硅烷（QAMS）浸润于3D打印脲烷二甲基丙烯酸酯义齿基: The study infiltrated tetraalkylmethacryloyloxysilane (QAMS) into the 3D printed urethane dimethacrylate denture matrix and found that the K7 group (approximately 21 wt% QAMS) achieved the best balance between antibacterial activity and mechanical properties, forming a silicon-rich layer on the surface, with enhanced antibacterial effect and unchanged hardness.
研究将四种磺胺类化合物以10–50 wt.%负载于个性化3D打印口服制剂中，通过: The study loaded four sulfonamide compounds into personalized 3D printed oral preparations at 10–50 wt.%, which was realized through hot melt extrusion and fused deposition modeling. The results showed that the printed tablets successfully achieved drug amorphization, and their in vitro dissolution performance was better than or equivalent to traditional tablets, which has the potential to improve the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
研究将地塞米松载入聚乳酸电纺纤维，并将其集成至聚四亚甲基碳酸酯光交联树脂中，制备: The study loaded dexamethasone into polylactic acid electrospun fibers and integrated them into polytetramethylene carbonate photo-cross-linked resin to prepare hybrid films, which verified the advantages of this system in terms of mechanical properties and drug protection, and dexamethasone still maintains biological activity under light conditions.
研究将多执行器软机器人通过原位直接激光写入技术3D微打印在可访问的3D打印微流体: The study 3D micro-printed a multi-actuator soft robot on an accessible 3D printed microfluidic device through in-situ direct laser writing technology, and achieved fluid sealing; the experiment showed that the fluorescent liquid had no leakage and remained intact after 100 500 kPa pressure cycles, proving the effectiveness of this method in realizing micro-scale fluid-driven soft robots.
研究将天然抗菌剂totarol涂层应用于3D打印PEEK表面，通过不同浓度处理，: The study applied the natural antibacterial agent totarol coating to the 3D printed PEEK surface. 研究将姜辣素封装于脂质纳米颗粒并结合3D打印三钙磷酸盐支架，实现骨缺损部位的靶向: The study encapsulated gingerol in lipid nanoparticles and combined it with 3D printed tricalcium phosphate scaffolds to achieve targeted delivery to bone defect sites. The results showed that it increased osteoblast viability, enhanced toxicity to osteosarcoma cells, and effectively inhibited the growth of Staphylococcus aureus.
研究将姜黄素负载PLGA纳米颗粒嵌入海藻酸钠/明胶3D打印支架，体外显示其可控释: The study embedded curcumin-loaded PLGA nanoparticles into a sodium alginate/gelatin 3D printed scaffold, which was shown in vitro to have controlled release and no significant toxicity to SH-SY5Y cells. PCR detection showed that the scaffold can regulate the Wnt/β-catenin and PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β pathways, showing neuroprotective potential.
研究将废弃医用一次性口罩中的聚丙烯塑料经机械回收，与不同比例植物油混合并添加引发: In this study, the polypropylene plastic in discarded medical disposable masks was mechanically recycled, mixed with vegetable oil in different proportions, and added with initiators to significantly improve its tensile strength and toughness. The resulting composite material is superior to the raw material in tensile strength and impact performance, and has the potential to be used in applications such as sheet molding and 3D printing.
研究将废弃的三层外科口罩和丁腈手套经灭菌后，用于制作基于摩擦电的纳米发电机，将其: The study uses sterilized discarded three-layer surgical masks and nitrile gloves to make triboelectric-based nanogenerators, convert them into electrical energy and drive hand disinfectant dispensers, and achieve remote control through the Internet of Things and cloud systems.
研究将患者特定几何形状的组织直接生物打印至定制3D打印生物反应器中，实现细胞培养: The study directly bioprinted patients' tissues with specific geometric shapes into a custom 3D printed bioreactor to achieve cell culture and adipogenic differentiation, verifying the system's ability to maintain and direct differentiation of C2C12 cells and human mesenchymal stem cells.
研究将打印柔性结构、运动控制和数字成像组合成开放显微系统。柔性机构把复杂定位功能: Research combines printing flexible structures, motion control and digital imaging into open microscopy systems. Flexible mechanisms integrate complex positioning functions into manufacturable parts, reducing reliance on traditional precision machining
研究将打印结构用于气路分配和流量限制，并在两只猪的实验中展示概念。该工作揭示分支: The study uses printed structures for air distribution and flow restriction and demonstrates the concept in an experiment with two pigs. This work reveals the relationship between branch load and control, and belongs to prototype verification under special resource scenarios.

The results showed that BPL combined with β=400 has the highest image accuracy and confidence, and β=100 is more sensitive to small tumors.
研究构建了模拟脑颅结构的头 体模，集成血管循环系统，实现动脉血压和颅内压的可控变: The study constructed a head and phantom that simulates the brain structure and integrated the vascular circulation system to achieve controllable changes in arterial blood pressure and intracranial pressure, and successfully obtained pulsating optical signals of cerebral arteries to explore the relationship between cerebral hemodynamics and changes in intracranial pressure.
研究检索与正文明确覆盖AM结构影响免疫和骨结合，SLM可确认覆盖；该片段没有打印: The research search and text clearly cover the AM structure that affects immunity and osseointegration, and SLM can confirm the coverage; there is no corresponding evidence of printed raw materials for this fragment, and the material is retained as U.
研究正在从“热或光是否损伤药物”的笼统问题，转为具体配方的作用机制。温度、暴露时: Research is shifting from the general question of whether heat or light damages drugs to the mechanism of action of specific formulations. Temperature, exposure time, drug status and excipient combination determine outcome
研究正在从单病例可视化，推进到可测量的规划流程。几何误差、模型处理和术后配准使数: Research is advancing from single-case visualization to measurable planning processes. Geometric errors, model processing and postoperative registration enable digital designs to be verified; soft tissue applications introduce body position and deformation issues
研究正在将材料试样、整体器械和功能结果连接。早期细胞与材料试验说明处理阶段的重要: Research is linking material specimens, overall devices, and functional outcomes. Early cell and material experiments illustrate the importance of the processing stage, and subsequent guide loading and true geometry evaluation move closer to clinical use
研究正在由“打印材料是否耐腐蚀”转向“最终器械的哪些区域、在什么条件下保持稳定: Research is shifting from “whether printed materials are corrosion-resistant” to “which areas of the final device remain stable and under what conditions?”
研究正在由一次处理效果扩展到重复循环和整机功能。结构设计也从单纯减重转向减少难清: Research is expanding from one-time processing effects to repeated cycles and complete machine functions. The structural design has also shifted from simple weight reduction to reducing difficult-to-clean areas and improving inspection convenience.
研究正在由单次静态测量扩展到模拟步态和可穿戴形式。要继续推进，需要观察运动、出汗: Research is extending beyond single static measurements to simulated gait and wearable forms. To move forward, we need to observe performance during exercise, sweating, wearing and taking off, and volume changes, bringing the data closer to everyday environments.
研究正在由经验筛选进入材料: Research is filtering into material by experience
研究正由单个平均误差转向分阶段、分方向分析。三坐标测量和三维配准使自由端变形、就: Research is shifting from a single average error to staged and directional analysis. Three-dimensional coordinate measurement and three-dimensional registration enable free end deformation, in-place rotation and operating deviation to be discussed separately
研究正由满意度走向过程指标和结构化评分。经验分层、盲法评价与传感反馈逐步补充主观: Research is moving from satisfaction to process indicators and structured ratings. Experience stratification, blind evaluation and sensory feedback gradually supplement subjective evaluation, enabling the model to serve training and assessment.
研究比较不同像素偏移设置，使用三次扫描分析适配及表面偏差。参数改变会同时影响外形: The study compares different pixel offset settings, using three scans to analyze fit and surface deviations. Parameter changes will affect both the appearance and internal clearance, and optimal surface restoration and optimal in-place adaptation do not necessarily correspond to the same setting. Therefore compensation needs to be determined around the target area and usage tasks
研究比较了 铣削 和 3D 打印技术制备的单冠边缘及内部间隙精度，结果显示铣削组: The study compared the edge and internal gap accuracy of single crowns prepared by milling and 3D printing technology. The results showed that the edge gap of the milling group was significantly smaller than that of the 3D printing group, and the adaptability differences in multiple internal areas were obvious.
研究比较了0.25%、0.5%和1%茶树油浸润对热凝丙烯酸树脂及3D打印丙烯酸树: The study compared the inhibitory effects of 0.25%, 0.5% and 1% tea tree oil on Candida albicans on thermosetting acrylic resin and 3D printing acrylic resin. The results showed that tea tree oil in each concentration group was better than 0.5% sodium hypochlorite and distilled water.
研究比较了0.4毫米和0.9毫米壁厚的3D打印聚乙烯醇胶囊与传统硬胶胶囊在膨胀、: The study compared the performance of 0.4 mm and 0.9 mm wall thickness 3D printed polyvinyl alcohol capsules with traditional hard gel capsules in terms of swelling, erosion, disintegration and stability. The results showed that 0.4 mm wall thickness capsules are more prone to disintegration, release quickly and have good stability, while the structure and release performance of 0.9 mm wall thickness capsules are affected under accelerated storage.
研究比较了0.5%次氯酸钠和次氯酸钙凝胶对热聚合及3D打印丙烯酸树脂基托上真菌和: The study compared the sterilization effects of 0.5% sodium hypochlorite and calcium hypochlorite gels on fungal and bacterial biofilms on thermally polymerized and 3D printed acrylic resin bases. It was found that gels containing calcium hypochlorite and 3D printed bases had better antibacterial effects under the toothbrushing plus residual contact regimen and could effectively remove biofilms.
研究比较了0°、45°、90°打印方向对三种3D打印树脂完全义齿基托精度及真度的: The study compared the effects of 0°, 45°, and 90° printing directions on the accuracy and authenticity of three 3D printed resin complete denture bases. The results showed that the 45° printing direction provides the best clinical fit. Different printing directions significantly affect the authenticity and accuracy of each material, and thermal aging has a significant impact on the accuracy of some materials.
研究比较了100%椰子油、2%戊二醛和70%乙醇对3D打印手术导板的消毒效果，结: The study compared the disinfection effects of 100% coconut oil, 2% glutaraldehyde and 70% ethanol on 3D printed surgical guides. The results showed that coconut oil was equivalent to glutaraldehyde and ethanol in inhibiting oral microorganisms, and was significantly better than the control group.
研究比较了20、40、60微米三种牙托垫厚度对氧化锆冠边缘密合度的影响，结果显示: The study compared the effects of three tray pad thicknesses of 20, 40, and 60 microns on the edge fit of zirconia crowns. The results showed that the 40-micron tray pad provided the best edge fit and contact accuracy in both traditional and 3D printed models.
研究比较了34.4μm像素LCD与40μm像素DLP 3D打印机在微流控通道精度: The study compared the performance of 34.4 μm pixel LCD and 40 μm pixel DLP 3D printers in terms of microfluidic channel accuracy. The results showed that the channel width errors of the LCD printer were 15.4% and 5.35% respectively under optimized resin conditions, which were better than the 2.11% of the DLP printer, and performed well in terms of surface roughness, verticality and fluid control.
研究比较了35个三单位后牙固定修复体在不同制造方式下的精度与适配性，结果显示增材: The study compared the accuracy and fit of 35 three-unit posterior fixed restorations under different manufacturing methods. The results showed that the surface deviation of the additively manufactured restoration was the largest but the gap was the smallest. Although the fit was clinically acceptable, the accuracy was lower than that of the strength gradient subtractive manufacturing restoration.
研究比较了3D打印PMMA树脂与传统热凝树脂牙托基质的抗弯强度、表面性质、吸水率: The study compared the flexural strength, surface properties, water absorption and solubility of 3D printed PMMA resin and traditional thermosetting resin dental tray matrix. The results showed that the thermosetting resin has higher flexural strength and is within the clinically acceptable range. The 3D printing material has higher water absorption. Thermal cycle has different effects on the water absorption of the two, and there is no significant difference in solubility.
研究比较了3D打印、CAD/CAM和传统方法制备临时修复体在抗弯强度、微硬度、表: The study compared the differences in flexural strength, microhardness, surface roughness and color stability of temporary restorations prepared by 3D printing, CAD/CAM and traditional methods. The results showed that the 3D printing 15° group had the highest flexural strength, the traditional resin had the highest microhardness, and the CAD/CAM low-speed group had the best color stability. There are significant differences in mechanical and aesthetic properties between different methods.
研究比较了3D打印、CAD/CAM铣削和传统灌注义齿树脂的细菌附着、颜色及尺寸稳: The study compared the bacterial adhesion, color and dimensional stability of 3D printing, CAD/CAM milling and traditional infused denture resin. The results showed that 3D printing resin had the least bacterial adhesion, minimal dimensional changes, good biocompatibility and stability, and was superior to traditional methods.
研究比较了3D打印、CAD/CAM铣削和传统热聚合义齿基质在热循环下的弯曲强度，: The study compared the flexural strength of 3D printing, CAD/CAM milling and traditional thermal polymerization denture matrix under thermal cycling. The results showed that the 3D printing matrix had the highest strength, and thermal cycling significantly reduced the strength of the first two but did not affect the traditional thermal polymerization matrix.
研究比较了3D打印、模压和铣削制备的全口义齿基托在24小时及6个月时的精度与尺寸: The study compared the accuracy and dimensional stability of complete denture bases prepared by 3D printing, molding and milling at 24 hours and 6 months. The results showed that the 3D printing "Temp printing" group had the best accuracy at 24 hours, the "Temp printing" group had the best stability at 6 months, and the overall stability of the milling bases was the best. All bases were within the clinically acceptable range.
研究比较了3D打印、热凝和冷凝丙烯酸树脂在体外的硬度、冲击强度、弯曲强度、抗拉强: The study compared the mechanical properties of 3D printing, thermal setting and condensing acrylic resin in vitro such as hardness, impact strength, flexural strength, tensile strength and density. The results showed that 3D printing acrylic resin performed best in terms of impact, bending and tensile strength and density. The thermal setting acrylic resin had the highest hardness and the condensing acrylic resin had the lowest indicators (except impact strength).
研究比较了3D打印、热熔挤出和物理混合制备的片剂的溶出行为，结果显示3D打印和热: The study compared the dissolution behavior of tablets prepared by 3D printing, hot melt extrusion and physical mixing. The results showed that the Korsmeyer-Peppas index of 3D printing and hot melt extrusion tablets was higher than that of physical mixing tablets, and the use of hydrophobic EC polymers can improve the dissolution stability in fed and fasting states.
研究比较了3D打印、热熔挤出和物理混合制备的茶碱片，发现尽管3D打印片硬度最高，: The study compared theophylline tablets prepared by 3D printing, hot melt extrusion and physical mixing and found that although the 3D printed tablets had the highest hardness, some formulations showed faster dissolution rates, and their high porosity and low true density may promote water and drug diffusion, indicating that the printing process does not always delay drug release.
研究比较了3D打印、铣削和传统工艺制备的PMMA义齿牙在耐磨性和颜色稳定性方面的: The study compared the differences in wear resistance and color stability of PMMA denture teeth prepared by 3D printing, milling and traditional processes. The results showed that milled teeth were better than 3D printed teeth, and the wear resistance of 3D printed teeth was equivalent to that of milled teeth, and the color stability was equivalent to that of traditional teeth.
研究比较了3D打印、铣削和传统工艺制成的义齿基质材料上链球菌属细菌的生物膜形成情: The study compared the biofilm formation of Streptococcus bacteria on denture matrix materials made by 3D printing, milling and traditional processes. The results showed that milling materials more significantly inhibited the accumulation of Streptococcus biofilm, and the overall biofilm formation of Streptococcus was significantly more than that of Streptococcus mutans.
研究比较了3D打印、铣削和传统方法制备的义齿基托树脂的机械性能，结果显示3D打印: The study compared the mechanical properties of denture base resin prepared by 3D printing, milling and traditional methods. The results showed that the 3D printing group was significantly better than the other two groups in terms of flexural strength, modulus and deformation resistance, and the fracture surface was tear-shaped.
研究比较了3D打印与CAD-CAM铣削牙托基材料在2000次热循环后的表面粗糙度: The study compared the surface roughness, hardness and fracture toughness of 3D printed and CAD-CAM milled dental tray base materials after 2000 thermal cycles. The results showed that the surface of 3D printed materials was rougher and the hardness and fracture toughness were significantly reduced after thermal cycles. However, the milled materials were better than the 3D printed materials in all indicators, and the thermal cycles did not affect the water absorption and dissolution rate of the materials.
研究比较了3D打印与传统PMMA牙托基质的吸水性和溶出性，结果显示两者均因吸水导: The study compared the water absorption and dissolution properties of 3D printing and traditional PMMA dental tray matrices. The results showed that both caused volume changes and internal stress due to water absorption, which affected the long-term performance of the dental tray.
研究比较了3D打印与传统义齿基托材料在人工唾液浸泡后的变形、张力和应力变化，结果: The study compared the deformation, tension and stress changes of 3D printing and traditional denture base materials after soaking in artificial saliva. The results showed that there were differences in the mechanical responses of the two materials under physiological environments.
研究比较了3D打印与传统加工的种植体基台表面，发现3D打印材料导致龈成纤维细胞黏: The study compared the surfaces of 3D printed and traditionally processed implant abutments and found that 3D printed materials led to a decrease in the adhesion, metabolic activity and proliferation of gingival fibroblasts, while the traditional processed surfaces and the zirconia control group performed better, indicating that the 3D printed surface is not conducive to soft tissue integration.
研究比较了3D打印与传统热聚合丙烯酸树脂在老化、机械刷刷及染色介质浸泡后的颜色稳: The study compared the color stability of 3D printing and traditional thermally polymerized acrylic resin after aging, mechanical brushing and soaking in dyeing media. The results showed that the color change of 3D printing resin was lower than that of traditional PMMA, and the color change was significantly reduced over time.
研究比较了3D打印与传统等离子喷涂钛表面对人成骨细胞的生物学响应，结果显示3D打: The study compared the biological responses of 3D printed and traditional plasma sprayed titanium surfaces to human osteoblasts. The results showed that the 3D printed surface promoted early cell proliferation and had a higher calcium production trend than the plasma sprayed surface, and the hydroxyapatite coating did not significantly improve the effect.
研究比较了3D打印与传统鸡胸肉、琼脂凝胶乳腺假体在超声穿透性、组织模拟准确性及可: The study compared the differences in ultrasound penetration, tissue simulation accuracy, and repeatability between 3D printing and traditional chicken breast and agar gel breast prostheses. The results showed that the 3D printing prosthesis was better than the traditional prosthesis in terms of anatomical accuracy, but it was not visible under ultrasound. While the chicken breast prosthesis had the best overall image quality, the agar prosthesis was too soft and had poor tissue simulation.
研究比较了3D打印与注塑工艺制备的PLDLA生物可降解颅面植入物在体外加速条件下: The study compared the degradation characteristics of PLDLA biodegradable craniofacial implants prepared by 3D printing and injection molding under accelerated conditions in vitro. The results showed that the degradation tendency of implants prepared by injection molding was lower than that of 3D printed products.
研究比较了3D打印与注塑工艺在下颌全口义齿基托表面忠实度上的差异，发现3D打印基: The study compared the differences in surface fidelity of mandibular complete denture bases between 3D printing and injection molding processes. It was found that 3D printing bases had better adaptability in the edge sealing area, but both methods had clinically acceptable fit, and there was a significant difference in overall surface fidelity between the two methods.
研究比较了3D打印与热聚合PMMA义齿材料在长期浸入消毒剂后的物理和生物性能，结: The study compared the physical and biological properties of 3D printing and thermally polymerized PMMA denture materials after long-term immersion in disinfectants. The results showed that 3D printing resin has better physical properties, PMMA has lower fungal colonization, chlorhexidine has the best effect on inhibiting fungal biofilm, and Lifebuoy® is a non-cytotoxic alternative.
研究比较了3D打印与热聚合及自聚合型义齿基托材料的弯曲强度等力学性能，结果显示3: The study compared the bending strength and other mechanical properties of 3D printing with thermal polymerization and self-polymerizing denture base materials. The results showed that the bending strength and other indicators of 3D printing materials were lower than those of thermal polymerization materials. Increasing the post-curing temperature can improve the mechanical properties of 3D printing resin.
研究比较了3D打印与生物材料仿生 体模 在磁共振成像中提取放射组学特征的重复性与: The study compared the repeatability and reliability of 3D printing and biomaterial bionic phantoms in extracting radiomic features in magnetic resonance imaging. The results showed that the repeatability of 3D printing bionic phantoms at 1.5T was better than that of 3T, and was highly consistent with the biomaterial results. The QR code reading effect was better at 1mm resolution.
研究比较了3D打印与磨削制备的单层氧化锆冠在真度和精度上的差异，结果显示磨削冠在: The study compared the differences in authenticity and accuracy between single-layer zirconia crowns prepared by 3D printing and grinding. The results showed that the grinding crowns were significantly better than the 3D printed crowns in terms of overall, edge and occlusal surface accuracy, but there was no significant difference in clinical accuracy between the two.
研究比较了3D打印与铣削制作的手术导板的重复性与精度，结果显示铣削导板在与母模重: The study compared the repeatability and accuracy of surgical guides made by 3D printing and milling. The results showed that the deviation of the milling guide when coinciding with the master mold was smaller, while the coefficient of variation of the 3D printing guide was higher.
研究比较了3D打印与铣削制备的三层单位后牙固定修复体的边缘及内部密合度，结果显示: The study compared the edge and internal adhesion of three-layer unit posterior tooth fixed restorations prepared by 3D printing and milling. The results showed that the edge adhesion of milled restorations was better. The edge adhesion of 3D printed restorations improved after using reinforced brackets. Especially when the wall thickness is 0.6mm, brackets are needed to achieve good adhesion.
研究比较了3D打印与铣削制备的全瓷冠在真度和精密度上的差异，结果显示铣削冠真度更: The study compared the differences in accuracy and precision between all-ceramic crowns prepared by 3D printing and milling. The results showed that the accuracy of the milled crown was higher and the accuracy of the printed crown was better, both within the clinically acceptable error range.
研究比较了3D打印与铣削牙冠结合三种粘接剂对3D打印基托粘接强度的影响，结果显示: The study compared the effects of 3D printing and milling crowns combined with three adhesives on the bonding strength of the 3D printing base. The results showed that the combination of milled teeth and Unifast Trad has the highest bonding strength, and the combination of 3D printing teeth and Super-Bond has the best effect.
研究比较了3D打印与预制义齿在不同染色剂浸泡后颜色稳定性，结果显示浸泡7天时颜色: The study compared the color stability of 3D printed and prefabricated dentures after soaking in different dyes. The results showed that the color change after soaking for 7 days was significantly greater than that for 21 days. The color change of prefabricated dentures was the largest in red wine, and the color of 3D printed dentures was the smallest in artificial saliva.
研究比较了3D打印临时修复材料与传统自固化树脂对成纤维细胞的影响，结果显示3D打: The study compared the effects of 3D printing temporary repair materials and traditional self-curing resin on fibroblasts. The results showed that the 3D printing material group had better cell adhesion, more uniform distribution of filamentous protrusions, and significantly higher cell proliferation than the traditional material group.
研究比较了3D打印临时冠桥修复材料与丙烯酸树脂、双酚A丙烯酸树脂在表面粗糙度、颜: The study compared the differences in surface roughness, color stability, and microhardness between 3D printed temporary crown and bridge repair materials, acrylic resin, and bisphenol A acrylic resin. The results showed that 3D printing resin had the highest microhardness, acrylic resin had the lowest, and bisphenol A acrylic was equivalent.
研究比较了3D打印临时固定桥在不同层厚（25、50、100 µm）下的边缘与内部: The study compared the edge and internal adaptability of 3D printed temporary fixed bridges at different layer thicknesses (25, 50, and 100 µm). The results showed that the 50 µm layer thickness group had the smallest edge and internal gaps.
研究比较了3D打印义齿基台树脂与传统自聚合树脂在不同酸性环境下的力学性能、显色稳: The study compared the mechanical properties, color stability and surface properties of 3D printed denture abutment resin and traditional self-polymerizing resin under different acidic environments. The results showed that 3D printed resin showed better mechanical properties under acidic conditions.
研究比较了3D打印义齿基托树脂不同堆叠角度（0°、30°、60°、90°）对白色: The study compared the effects of different stacking angles (0°, 30°, 60°, 90°) of 3D printed denture base resin on the adhesion of Candida albicans. The results showed that there was no significant difference in surface roughness and colony forming units among each group, indicating that the stacking angle does not affect bacterial adhesion and that accuracy or strength should be given priority rather than surface roughness.
研究比较了3D打印义齿基质材料在模拟刷牙和热循环后的表面粗糙度与颜色稳定性，结果: The study compared the surface roughness and color stability of 3D printed denture matrix materials after simulated brushing and thermal cycling. The results showed that the surface roughness of each material was within the acceptable range, and the color of ND printing resin was affected by brushing and thermal cycling. The color stability of the other materials met the standard.
研究比较了3D打印义齿基质树脂不同表面特性对细胞毒性及生物膜形成的影响，结果显示: The study compared the effects of different surface properties of 3D printed denture matrix resin on cytotoxicity and biofilm formation. The results showed that the 3D group had the smoothest surface, the least biofilm formation, and no cytotoxicity, indicating that it has good biocompatibility and antimicrobial adhesion ability in denture production.
研究比较了3D打印切削引导器与通用可重复使用骨切削夹具在胫骨移植切削中的精度，结: The study compared the accuracy of 3D printed cutting guides and universal reusable bone cutting fixtures in tibial transplant cutting. The results showed that the clinical effects of the two were equivalent, but the 3D printed guides were more cost-effective.
研究比较了3D打印多孔钛牙科种植体与传统加工表面，结果显示其表面具有高度互联孔隙: The study compared 3D printed porous titanium dental implants with traditional processed surfaces. The results showed that the surface has a highly interconnected pore structure, which can significantly promote osteoblast proliferation and osseointegration marker expression, enhance the vascular and osteogenic differentiation tendency of mesenchymal stem cells, and induce the transformation of monocytes into an anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype.
研究比较了3D打印树脂NextDent冠与预成氧化锆冠在修复乳磨牙时的应力分布，: The study compared the stress distribution of 3D printed resin NextDent crowns and prefabricated zirconia crowns when repairing deciduous molars. The results showed that the maximum von Mises stress of the resin crowns (383.2 MPa) was higher than that of the zirconia crowns (351.12 MPa).
研究比较了3D打印树脂与传统化学和热激活丙烯酸树脂在热循环下的弯曲强度，结果显示: The study compared the flexural strength of 3D printing resins with traditional chemical and heat-activated acrylic resins under thermal cycling. The results showed that 3D printing resins had the lowest bending resistance, especially after thermal cycling.
研究比较了3D打印树脂与传统树脂在完全义齿基底和牙体上的表面粗糙度、润湿性及多物: The study compared the surface roughness, wettability and multi-species biofilm adhesion of 3D printing resin and traditional resin on complete denture bases and teeth. The results showed that the surface of 3D printing resin was smoother and more hydrophilic, and the adhesion of Streptococcus and Staphylococcus aureus was significantly reduced.
研究比较了3D打印树脂人工牙与Major Super Lux、Ivostar S: The study compared the differences in fracture resistance between 3D printed resin artificial teeth and Major Super Lux, Ivostar Shade and SpofaDent Plus. The results showed that the fracture strength of 3D printed resin teeth was better than the former two but lower than SpofaDent Plus. The structure was stable under local stress and the fracture mode was consistent.
研究比较了3D打印氧化锆与复合树脂前牙部分覆盖冠及传统铣削氧化锆冠的抗折强度，结: The study compared the flexural strength of 3D printed zirconia and composite resin anterior partial coverage crowns and traditional milled zirconia crowns. The results showed that 3D printed zirconia crowns have the best fracture resistance, and the structural design close to the tooth body improves their fracture resistance.
研究比较了3D打印淀粉基硅胶面部假体与传统硅胶假体在自然及加速老化条件下的力学性: The study compared the mechanical properties of 3D printed starch-based silicone facial prostheses and traditional silicone prostheses under natural and accelerated aging conditions. The results showed that the tensile strength of traditional silicone prostheses significantly decreased after 4 months of natural aging, while the mechanical properties of 3D printed prostheses significantly deteriorated under accelerated aging, especially after 6 weeks of exposure.
研究比较了3D打印牙托基树脂（NextDent、FormLabs、Asiga）与: The study compared the differences in water absorption, dissolution rate and light transmittance between 3D printed dental tray base resin (NextDent, FormLabs, Asiga) and traditional thermally polymerized acrylic resin. The results showed that the water absorption rate and dissolution rate of 3D printed resin were significantly higher than that of traditional resin, while the light transmittance was significantly reduced, and thermal cycles led to the deterioration of various properties.
研究比较了3D打印钛合金Titanflex®与传统钴铬合金在可摘局部义齿基托中的: The study compared the mechanical properties of 3D printed titanium alloy Titanflex® and traditional cobalt-chromium alloy in removable partial denture bases. The results showed that titanium alloy is superior to traditional materials in terms of strength and plasticity. Among them, Ti45 has both good strength and flexibility, while cobalt-chromium alloy is harder.
研究比较了3D打印钛合金表面经阳极氧化和高温氢化处理后，对人龈成纤维细胞早期黏附: The study compared the effects of anodizing and high-temperature hydrogenation treatment on the 3D printed titanium alloy surface on the early adhesion and proliferation of human gingival fibroblasts and the expression of cell adhesion-related genes and fibronectin. The results showed that surface treatment can promote cell behavior.
研究比较了3D打印（AM）与传统加工（SM）树脂材料对人成纤维细胞的初始细胞毒性: The study compared the initial cytotoxicity of 3D printed (AM) and conventionally processed (SM) resin materials on human fibroblasts. The results showed that the cell survival rate of AM resin materials was significantly lower than that of SM resin materials under 72 hours of indirect and direct exposure.
研究比较了3D打印（SLM）和传统铸造（CON）及树脂打印后铸造（RPC）制作的: The study compared the accuracy of mandibular removable partial denture frames made by 3D printing (SLM) with traditional casting (CON) and resin printing and casting (RPC). It was found that SLM and CON were equivalent in accuracy, and the RPC group had significantly greater differences at rest and tissue contact, and all frames were clinically acceptable.
研究比较了5种临时冠材料在热循环前后的抗弯强度、表面粗糙度、孔隙率及真菌附着情况: The study compared the flexural strength, surface roughness, porosity and fungal adhesion of five temporary crown materials before and after thermal cycles. The results showed that the flexural strength of 3D printing resin significantly increased after thermal cycles, while the strength of other materials decreased, and its fungal adhesion and porosity performance was better than that of most materials.
研究比较了8种不同硬度柔性聚合物与猪主动脉及牛心包组织的缝合强度、拉伸强度和爆破: The study compared the suture strength, tensile strength and bursting pressure of 8 flexible polymers with different hardness and porcine aorta and bovine pericardial tissue. It was found that polymers with a hardness of 30-50 are not inferior to tissues in various mechanical properties and are suitable for 3D printing aorta phantoms.
研究比较了9种牙膏在硅橡胶与PMMA或3D光固化树脂表面的剪切、拉伸和剥离强度，: The study compared the shear, tensile and peel strength of nine toothpastes on the surface of silicone rubber and PMMA or 3D light-cured resin. The results showed that "Whiteberg" and "PresiDENT" toothpastes performed well in various tests, among which "Maximum fixation + comfort" and "Extra-strong fixation" performed best in shear and tear tests.
研究比较了APF DDM与FDM打印的ibuprofen负载PLGA网状植入物，: The study compared ibuprofen-loaded PLGA mesh implants printed with APF DDM and FDM and found that the implants prepared by FDM had larger pores and the drug was released quickly within 4 days, while the implants prepared by APF DDM were curved and dense due to the filamentous structure, and the drug release lasted for more than 2 weeks.
研究比较了CAD-CAM铣削、3D打印和传统压模制作的完全义齿基托在热循环前后的: The study compared the accuracy and precision of complete denture bases made by CAD-CAM milling, 3D printing and traditional stamping before and after thermal cycles. The results showed that the accuracy of CAD-CAM milling bases was the best, and the stamping bases were most significantly affected by thermal cycles. The precision of all types of bases decreased significantly.
研究比较了CAD-CAM铣削、3D打印和注塑制成的全口义齿基托在复制过程中的贴合: The study compared the fitting accuracy of complete denture bases made by CAD-CAM milling, 3D printing and injection molding during the replication process. The results showed that the fitting accuracy of CAD-CAM milling technology was significantly better than that of 3D printing and injection molding technology.
研究比较了CAD-CAM陶瓷冠与3D打印树脂冠的耐磨性及表面粗糙度，结果显示陶瓷: The study compared the wear resistance and surface roughness of CAD-CAM ceramic crowns and 3D printed resin crowns. The results showed that ceramic crowns had less wear and smaller changes in surface roughness, which were better than resin crowns.
研究比较了CAD/CAM、自固化和3D打印树脂基复合材料的残余单体释放及转化率，: The study compared the residual monomer release and conversion rate of CAD/CAM, self-curing and 3D printing resin-based composite materials. The results showed that 3D printing composite materials have less residual monomer release and higher conversion rate, which is better than self-curing materials, and performs better in terms of monomer release compared with CAD/CAM blank samples.
研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削、3D打印和传统热聚合义齿基托树脂的弯曲强度和维氏硬: The study compared the flexural strength and Vickers hardness of CAD/CAM milling, 3D printing and traditional thermal polymerization denture base resin. The results showed that milling resin was significantly better than traditional thermal polymerization resin and 3D printing resin in both indicators.
研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削、3D打印和聚酰胺义齿基托树脂的表面粗糙度、冲击强度: The study compared the surface roughness, impact strength and hardness of CAD/CAM milling, 3D printing and polyamide denture base resin. The results showed that CAD/CAM milling resin has the smoothest surface, its impact strength is higher than 3D printing resin, and its hardness is higher than polyamide resin.
研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削与3D打印临时PMMA冠桥的抗折强度、颜色稳定性和表: The study compared the flexural strength, color stability and surface roughness of CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing temporary PMMA crowns and bridges. The results showed that milled PMMA was significantly better than 3D printing PMMA in terms of flexural strength and color stability, and there was not much difference in surface roughness between the two.
研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削与3D打印工艺制备的3单位临时固定修复体在热机械老化: The study compared the mechanical properties of 3-unit temporary fixed restorations prepared by CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing processes after thermomechanical aging. The results showed that the milled restorations were superior to other materials in terms of bending strength, hardness and elastic modulus. The 3D printed SLA ND group had the lowest elastic modulus.
研究比较了CAD/CAM铣削与3D打印结合热压成型的锂硅玻璃陶瓷单冠在适应性和疲: The study compared the differences in adaptability and fatigue performance between CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing combined with hot-pressed lithium-silicon glass-ceramic single crowns. The results showed that the 3D-printed/hot-pressed crowns had smaller gaps in the occlusal area, similar fatigue failure probabilities, and the main failure mode was radial cracks.
研究比较了DLP和LCD 3D打印牙托基台在60°C和80°C后固化温度下的表面: The study compared the surface hardness of DLP and LCD 3D printed dental tray abutments at post-curing temperatures of 60°C and 80°C. The results showed that increasing temperature significantly increased the hardness. The DLP group was better than the LCD group at both temperatures, with the DLP group having the highest hardness at 80°C.
研究比较了Delta TT、Trident II Tritanium和Mpact: The study compared the surface structure and pore characteristics of three 3D printed acetabular cups: Delta TT, Trident II Tritanium and Mpact 3D Metal. It was found that the surface titanium beads of the Trident II cup are smaller, the porosity is lower, and the wall layer is thinner, while the solid wall of the Mpact cup is thicker. The internal surface morphology of the three is similar.
研究比较了Dentca三维打印义齿牙与四种传统义齿牙在浸入红染剂、咖啡、可乐和蒸: The study compared the color changes of Dentca 3D printed denture teeth and four traditional denture teeth after being immersed in red dye, coffee, cola and distilled water. The results showed that the color change of Dentca in some dyes was greater than that of traditional denture teeth, but the maximum color change value was still within the clinically acceptable range.
研究比较了FDM技术制备的PEEK可摘局部义齿在机械性能和适配性方面的表现，结果: The study compared the mechanical properties and adaptability of PEEK removable partial dentures prepared by FDM technology. The results showed that its compressive strength was better than that of injection molded samples, the stress was lower than the material yield strength, and the tissue gap met clinical requirements.
研究比较了LCD与DLP打印系统及空气与氮气后固化氛围对增材制造咬合垫材料微磨耗: The study compared the effects of LCD and DLP printing systems and air and nitrogen post-curing atmospheres on micro-wear and nano-wear of additively manufactured bite pad materials. The results showed that DLP printing combined with nitrogen post-curing significantly improved the micro-wear resistance of hard materials.
研究比较了PCL与β-TCP网格、蜂窝和格雷德结构支架，发现PCL纳米纤维膜因纳: The study compared PCL with β-TCP mesh, honeycomb and Grade structural scaffolds and found that PCL nanofiber membranes promote cell proliferation and stretching due to their nanotopological structure, while PCL-Grade and β-TCP-Grade enhance cell spreading and three-dimensional colonization due to continuous curved and micro-rough surfaces. Early osteogenesis is determined by nanostructure, curvature-induced strain and ceramic chemistry, rather than pure stiffness.
研究比较了PEEK、实心3D打印Ti6Al4V及网状3D打印Ti6Al4V椎间融: The study compared PEEK, solid 3D printed Ti6Al4V and mesh 3D printed Ti6Al4V intervertebral fusion cages. The results showed that the mesh Ti6Al4V fusion cage was less prone to load-induced subsidence than PEEK and was significantly better than PEEK in terms of bioactivity, osteoconductivity and osteoblast adhesion.
研究比较了PEEK（BioHPP）、氧化锆和金属三种extra-coronal附: The study compared the strain performance of three extra-coronal accessory materials, PEEK (BioHPP), zirconia and metal, in mandibular Kennedy Class I metal removable partial dentures after one year of clinical simulation. The results showed that the PEEK (BioHPP) group had the lowest strain and was better than the zirconia and metal groups.
研究比较了PLA/PHA与MED610材料打印的牙科手术导板在蒸汽灭菌前后的精度: The study compared the accuracy of dental surgical guides printed with PLA/PHA and MED610 materials before and after steam sterilization. The results showed that the angle and three-dimensional deflection of the PLA/PHA guides increased significantly after sterilization, while there was no significant difference for the MED610 guides.
研究比较了PLA、PCL、FF、FD和GelMA五种生物材料打印支架的可打印性、: The study compared the printability, mechanical properties and cytocompatibility of five biomaterial printed scaffolds: PLA, PCL, FF, FD and GelMA. The results showed that thermoplastic materials had better printing resolution and shape fidelity, and GelMA had a higher cell survival rate in vitro. All materials showed connective tissue surrounding and some inflammatory cell responses in vivo.
研究比较了PLA、PETG和PHA三种材料用于3D打印防护面罩框架的机械性能、几: The study compared the mechanical properties, geometric accuracy, weight, printing time and environmental impact of three materials: PLA, PETG and PHA for 3D printing of protective mask frames. Through multi-objective optimization, it was found that PHA was the best in terms of environmental sustainability and was determined to be the most suitable material.
研究比较了RBM、SLA及增材制造钛表面在不同二极管激光参数下的热响应，结果显示: The study compared the thermal responses of RBM, SLA and additively manufactured titanium surfaces under different diode laser parameters. The results showed that the RBM surface has the strongest thermal response, and the SLA surface has the weakest. The pulse mode and longer irradiation time significantly increase the temperature. Different surface types have obvious differences in the response to laser thermal effects.
研究比较了SLA、DLP和LCD三种 vat聚合技术打印NextDent义齿基托: The study compared the mechanical and biological properties of NextDent denture bases printed by three vat polymerization technologies, SLA, DLP and LCD. The results showed that the SLA group had the highest bending strength, the DLP group had significantly higher water absorption and solubility than other groups, and the SLA group had the highest amount of fungal attachment.
研究比较了SLA与DLP 3D打印在牙科种植导板中的精度、速度和树脂用量，结果显: The study compared the accuracy, speed and resin consumption of SLA and DLP 3D printing in dental implant guides. The results showed that SLA was slightly superior in accuracy and material efficiency, while DLP printing time was shorter, and the printing direction significantly affected the final accuracy and resource consumption.
研究比较了SLA和DLP三维打印与铣削工艺制作的临时固定修复体，发现3D打印修复: The study compared temporary fixed restorations made by SLA and DLP 3D printing and milling processes, and found that 3D printed restorations had smaller edge and internal gaps than milling restorations at different spans, and the edge gaps of all digital restorations were within the clinically acceptable range.
研究比较了SLA和DLP打印的光滑与未光滑手术导板的抗拉强度，结果显示光滑样品的: The study compared the tensile strength of smooth and unsmooth surgical guides printed by SLA and DLP. The results showed that the tensile strength of smooth samples was lower than that of unsmooth samples, but the difference was not statistically significant.
研究比较了SLA和DLP打印的牙科手术导板经4% Gigasept消毒及121°: The study compared the mechanical properties of SLA and DLP printed dental surgical guides after sterilization with 4% Gigasept and high-temperature sterilization at 121°C and 134°C. The results showed that sterilization was applicable to both guides, and both high-temperature sterilizations significantly changed their mechanical properties.
研究比较了TiO2纳米颗粒添加量及后固化时间对3D打印义齿基台树脂弯曲性能和硬度: The study compared the effects of TiO2 nanoparticle addition and post-curing time on the bending properties and hardness of 3D printed denture abutment resin. The results showed that both concentrations of nanoparticles increased the bending strength, but the 2% concentration reduced the elastic modulus and hardness, and extending the post-curing time improved the bending strength and hardness.
研究比较了一种全金属一体化3D打印矫治器与传统瓷冠及天然牙的抗剪强度，结果显示一: The study compared the shear strength of an all-metal integrated 3D printed appliance with traditional porcelain crowns and natural teeth. The results showed that the integrated design had higher shear resistance, and the structural strength was better than traditional methods, and was not significantly different from natural teeth, indicating that removing the bonding interface can improve structural stability.
研究比较了三种3D打印PMMA材料与传统丙烯酸材料在不同灭菌方式下的抗冲击性能，: The study compared the impact resistance of three 3D printed PMMA materials and traditional acrylic materials under different sterilization methods. The results showed that the impact resistance of traditional acrylic materials was significantly higher than that of 3D printed materials. Among them, the performance of Nextdent material was not affected after sterilization by high-pressure steam or ethylene oxide, making it suitable for clinical applications.
研究比较了三种3D打印技术在牙科种植体模型精度上的差异，结果显示DLP打印机比S: A study comparing the accuracy of dental implant models between three 3D printing technologies showed that DLP printers were more accurate than SLA printers, with one DLP system having the smallest error and the SLA system having the largest error in multiple directions.
研究比较了三种3D打印机在不同层厚下打印的咬合垫材料的机械性能，结果显示AnyC: The study compared the mechanical properties of bite pad materials printed by three 3D printers at different layer thicknesses. The results showed that the AnyCubic Mono X printer with a 20-micron layer thickness sample has more stable mechanical properties.
研究比较了三种3D打印树脂制成的义齿牙齿在准确性与精确性上的差异，结果显示Nex: The study compared the accuracy and precision of three types of denture teeth made of 3D printing resin. The results showed that NextDent had the highest tooth authenticity and ASIGA had the lowest. FormLabs and NextDent were significantly different in occlusal surface accuracy, while ASIGA and NextDent had no significant difference. The accuracy of each group was similar.
研究比较了三种3D打印牙科树脂在不同表面处理（如抛光、釉面处理）及不同环境下的颜: The study compared the color changes of three types of 3D printing dental resins under different surface treatments (such as polishing, glazing treatments) and different environments. The results showed that glazing treatment has the most significant improvement in long-term color stability.
研究比较了三种3D打印牙科树脂对人成纤维细胞的体外细胞毒性，结果显示牙科专用树脂: The study compared the in vitro cytotoxicity of three 3D printing dental resins on human fibroblasts. The results showed that the dental-specific resin TEMP printing had the best cytocompatibility, V-printing was in the middle, and the general-purpose resin ANYCUBIC had the most obvious reaction, suggesting that the dental-specific resin is safer than the general-purpose type.
研究比较了三种CAD软件设计的低成本3D打印单冠，结果显示不同软件在三维精度、微: The study compared low-cost 3D printed single crowns designed by three CAD software. The results showed that there was no significant difference between different software in terms of three-dimensional accuracy, micro-gap and adjacency. The TRIOS design took significantly longer than the EXOCAD and ZZ groups, while the design of experienced technicians was better than that of novices. High-precision milling crowns were better than 3D printed crowns in all indicators.
研究比较了三种LCD 3D打印机打印的SG01树脂手术导板在不同存储时间和蒸汽灭: The study compared the dimensional stability of SG01 resin surgical guides printed by three LCD 3D printers after different storage times and steam sterilization. The results showed that the dimensional stability of AccuFab printed samples was better than that of Elegoo and Zortrax samples.
研究比较了三种不同制造工艺的义齿基托对硅胶软衬材料的拉伸粘接强度，发现减法制造的: The study compared the tensile bonding strength of denture bases with three different manufacturing processes to silicone soft lining materials. It was found that the base made by subtractive manufacturing has the highest bonding strength after grinding with alumina, while the base made by additive manufacturing has the lowest. There is a significant difference between subtractive and additive manufacturing. Grinding has an improvement effect on the base made by subtractive manufacturing, but has no significant impact on additive manufacturing.
研究比较了三种不同增材制造技术及传统减材制造的三单位固定修复体在耐磨性、断裂强度: The study compared the differences in wear resistance, fracture strength and reliability of three-unit fixed restorations made by three different additive manufacturing technologies and traditional subtractive manufacturing. The results showed that the traditional subtractive manufacturing restoration had the best wear resistance and the highest fracture strength. Among additive manufacturing, digital light processing technology has the smallest volume loss, and low-force display technology has better load resistance than liquid crystal display technology.
研究比较了三种不同树脂材料制成的增材制造义齿基托，在四种清洁剂处理下的制造精度与: The study compared the manufacturing accuracy and fit of additively manufactured denture bases made of three different resin materials under four cleaning agents. The results showed that the free printing (FD) base had the highest accuracy, while the dental technology (DT) base had the worst fit. Alcohol-free cleaners had less impact on accuracy and were superior.
研究比较了三种临时修复材料在3D打印、铣削和传统工艺下的机械、化学及表面性能，结: The study compared the mechanical, chemical and surface properties of three temporary repair materials under 3D printing, milling and traditional processes. The results showed that the milling group was superior to the other two groups in surface roughness, gloss, conversion rate, hardness and flexural strength. The 3D printing group was significantly different from the traditional group.
研究比较了三种临时固定义齿材料在人工老化后的抗折强度，结果显示增材制造光聚合物树: The study compared the flexural strength of three temporary fixed denture materials after artificial aging. The results showed that the additive manufacturing photopolymer resin (475.06±171.96 N) had the highest flexural strength. Thermal cycles only reduced the flexural strength of milled PMMA, and the interaction between material and aging was significant.
研究比较了三种制备方法的PMMA义齿基托树脂的弯曲和冲击强度，结果显示3D打印组: The study compared the bending and impact strength of PMMA denture base resin prepared by three preparation methods. The results showed that the 3D printing group had the highest impact strength, significantly better than the other two groups, while the CAD/CAM milling group had the highest bending strength.
研究比较了三种制备方法（直接压片、热熔挤出、3D打印）对PEO基片剂热稳定性及药: The study compared the effects of three preparation methods (direct compression, hot melt extrusion, and 3D printing) on the thermal stability and drug release of PEO-based tablets. The results showed that the dissolution efficiency of 3D printing and hot melt extrusion tablets in the PEO/HPC system was higher than that of direct compression, while the dissolution efficiency of 3D printed tablets in the PEO/EC system was reduced.
研究比较了三种制造工艺下丙烯酸树脂制作的完全可摘局部义齿的抗压强度和断裂能，结果: The study compared the compressive strength and fracture energy of complete removable partial dentures made of acrylic resin under three manufacturing processes. The results showed that the mechanical properties of injection molded dentures were significantly better than those of the other two processes, while the difference between thermal polymerization and additive manufacturing was not statistically significant.
研究比较了三种制造工艺（传统铸造、铣削、选择性激光熔融）制成的钴铬金属框架在金属: The study compared the chemical, thermochemical and mechanical compatibility of cobalt-chromium metal frames at the metal-ceramic interface made by three manufacturing processes (traditional casting, milling, selective laser melting). Through composition analysis, microstructure and mechanical property testing, the impact of different processes on the metal-ceramic bonding properties was clarified.
研究比较了三种单位后牙钴铬固定修复体不同制造方法的边缘、内部及咬合差异，结果显示: The study compared the marginal, internal and occlusal differences between different manufacturing methods of cobalt-chromium fixed restorations for three units of posterior teeth. The results showed that the DMLS method was superior to other methods in terms of alveolar fit, especially in the molar alveoli.
研究比较了三种唾液替代品在常规、高抗冲击及3D打印丙烯酸义齿基托材料上的润湿性，: The study compared the wettability of three saliva substitutes on conventional, high-impact and 3D printed acrylic denture base materials. The results showed that the 3D printed acrylic material had the best wettability, and the E-saliva substitute performed better. The differences between the three groups were statistically significant.
研究比较了三种商用PMMA材料在相同3D打印工艺下的综合性能，采用扩展VIKOR: The study compared the comprehensive performance of three commercial PMMA materials under the same 3D printing process, and used the extended VIKOR method to evaluate multiple factors such as mechanical, frictional, microbial and economic factors to optimize the material selection for removable partial dentures.
研究比较了三种商用可及的假手与三种开源3D打印假手在抓握功能上的表现，采用AHA: The study compared the performance of three commercially available prosthetic hands and three open source 3D printed prosthetic hands in terms of grasping functions. The AHAP protocol was used to evaluate the performance. The results showed that the performance of the 3D printed prosthetic hand was inferior to that of the commercial prosthetic hand in various grasping tasks. The difference was mainly due to the design or manufacturing quality.
研究比较了三种增材制造技术及传统减法工艺制作的后牙树脂固定桥，结果显示增材制造中: The study compared posterior resin-fixed bridges made by three additive manufacturing technologies and the traditional subtractive process. The results showed that AM-LFD in additive manufacturing had the smallest external deviation, and AM-LCD had the largest edge deviation. All additive pontic gaps exceeded the clinical threshold, while the subtractive pontic edge deviation was the largest but the clinical fit was acceptable.
研究比较了三种树脂、两层厚度和三种打印方向对3D打印咬合垫表面及力学性能的影响，: The study compared the effects of three resins, two layer thicknesses and three printing directions on the surface and mechanical properties of 3D printed bite pads. The results showed that the resin type and printing direction significantly affect various properties. Among them, KeySplint resin has the smoothest surface, Freeprint resin has the highest microhardness and elastic modulus, and the 45° printing direction increases bending strength and improves performance balance.
研究比较了三种牙托基树脂和两种人工牙树脂在咖啡、红葡萄酒等饮品浸泡3、6、12个: The study compared the coloring stability of three dental tray base resins and two artificial tooth resins after soaking in coffee, red wine and other beverages for 3, 6, and 12 months. The results showed that the Cosmos Denture dental tray base resin was the most severely stained in coffee and red wine, the NextDent and Lucitone were similar and acceptable in coloring, and the Cosmos Temp artificial teeth were significantly and unacceptable in coffee and red wine.
研究比较了三种牙托基质材料（传统热压、3D打印、铣削）与硅基软衬层的拉伸粘接强度: The study compared the tensile bonding strength of three types of dental tray matrix materials (traditional hot pressing, 3D printing, milling) and silicon-based soft lining. The results showed that the milled matrix had the strongest bonding, and surface treatment with Er,Cr:YSGG laser or acetone could significantly improve the bonding strength.
研究比较了三种牙科修复树脂在不同3D打印机打印下的表面粗糙度和显微硬度，结果显示: The study compared the surface roughness and microhardness of three types of dental restorative resins when printed with different 3D printers. The results showed that the type of printer affected the surface roughness and hardness of the resin, and there were significant differences in the surface properties of different resin materials under the same printer.
研究比较了三种用于临时桥的牙科树脂在抛光前后的表面粗糙度及机械强度，结果显示抛光: The study compared the surface roughness and mechanical strength of three dental resins used for temporary bridges before and after polishing. The results showed that polishing significantly increased the surface roughness, and there were significant differences between different resin types, with the milling material showing the greatest decrease in roughness.
研究比较了三种自定义树脂在3D打印圆柱样件中的弯曲强度，结果显示含较高比例模型树: The study compared the flexural strength of three custom resins in 3D printed cylindrical samples. The results showed that the samples containing a higher proportion of model resin and dental LT clear resin had higher flexural strength and were suitable for multi-unit temporary restorations, while those with a high proportion of white resin were suitable for single-unit temporary restorations of anterior teeth.
研究比较了三种葡萄糖检测装置在实验室和商业化生产中的全生命周期环境影响，结果显示: The study compared the full life cycle environmental impact of three glucose detection devices in laboratory and commercial production. The results showed that paper-based equipment has the lowest environmental impact at the laboratory scale, PLA equipment performs best at the commercial scale by switching to the injection molding process, and PDMS equipment has the worst environmental impact. Material and energy consumption are the main contributing factors.
研究比较了三种表面处理方式对3D打印牙科修复体颜色稳定性的影响，结果显示未抛光样: The study compared the effects of three surface treatment methods on the color stability of 3D printed dental restorations. The results showed that the color of unpolished samples changed the most in red wine solution. Samples coated with light-curing sealant showed delamination and dye penetration. Sufficient polishing can effectively reduce staining, and applying sealant is a temporary measure.
研究比较了三种钛基多孔结构对骨髓间充质干细胞的吸附与渗透性能，结果显示TPMS固: The study compared the adsorption and penetration properties of three titanium-based porous structures for bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells. The results showed that the TPMS solid gyroid structure was the best in terms of manufacturing accuracy, pore uniformity and cell adhesion, and the cell RNA expression and penetration behavior were better than other structures.
研究比较了三种鼻喷装置对丙戊酸纳米结构脂质载体的嗅部沉积效果，发现预装式装置在特: The study compared the olfactory deposition effects of three nasal spray devices on valproic acid nanostructured lipid carriers. It was found that the pre-assembled device can achieve a deposition rate of over 50% when inserted at a specific angle and depth, which is better than other devices and is not affected by differences in nasal cavity models.
研究比较了不同 粘接 协议下3D打印义齿牙与基托的粘接强度及耐磨性，结果显示使用: The study compared the bonding strength and wear resistance of 3D printed denture teeth and bases under different bonding protocols. The results showed that the Formlabs base using the Ivoclar Ivotion system had the highest bonding strength, but its wear resistance was poor and it was easy to break, indicating significant differences in material properties.
研究比较了不同3D打印方式和加工工艺下钻套套筒位置对种植体手术导板精度的影响，结: The study compared the impact of drill sleeve sleeve position on the accuracy of implant surgical guides under different 3D printing methods and processing techniques. The results showed that DLP printed guides have the highest accuracy, and all types of equipment can produce clinically acceptable guides.
研究比较了不同3D打印机类型及保护气体使用对软义齿材料物理性能的影响，结果表明气: The study compared the effects of different 3D printer types and the use of protective gases on the physical properties of soft denture materials. The results showed that atmosphere treatment significantly improved most properties. In addition to water absorption, microlayer structure and fracture toughness, the printing method and post-curing method significantly affected the mechanical and surface properties of the material.
研究比较了不同3D打印系统在临时牙修复体中的精度，结果显示DLP打印机在短单位修: The study compared the accuracy of different 3D printing systems in temporary dental restorations. The results showed that the DLP printer showed smaller overall deviation and shrinkage in short unit restorations, and the directional deviation was more consistent, better than the LCD printer.
研究比较了不同3D打印钛表面类型、颗粒大小及酸蚀处理对蛋白质吸附、细胞黏附、增殖: The study compared the effects of different 3D printed titanium surface types, particle sizes and acid etching treatments on protein adsorption, cell adhesion, proliferation and osteogenic differentiation. The results showed that the surface where particles were removed by acid etching treatment was more conducive to osteogenic differentiation.
研究比较了不同TPO浓度（1%、2%、3%）对3D打印牙科临时修复树脂的机械性能: The study compared the mechanical properties, conversion rate and biological safety of 3D printed dental temporary restoration resin with different TPO concentrations (1%, 2%, 3%). The results showed that the 3% TPO group was better in mechanical properties and conversion rate, but the color changed significantly. The 1% TPO group performed well overall after 30 minutes of UV curing.
研究比较了不同XY方向偏移参数下3D打印氧化锆冠的边缘与内部配合，结果显示-70: The study compared the edge and internal fit of 3D printed zirconia crowns under different XY direction offset parameters. The results showed that the edges and internal gaps of the -70 μm offset group were significantly smaller than the 0 μm group.
研究比较了不同修复材料对3D打印义齿基台树脂力学性能的影响，结果显示厚玻璃纤维增: The study compared the effects of different repair materials on the mechanical properties of 3D printed denture abutment resin. The results showed that the thick glass fiber reinforced repair group still maintained high bending strength and modulus after thermal cycling, which was close to the level of the unrepaired sample and was better than other repair methods.
研究比较了不同冲洗时间下，使用数字光处理打印机制作临时冠的三维适应性，结果显示冲: The study compared the three-dimensional adaptability of temporary crowns produced using digital light processing printers under different flushing times. The results showed that flushing time affects the degree of three-dimensional matching.
研究比较了不同制造工艺和表面处理对修复体在模拟胃酸暴露下表面光泽、硬度和粗糙度的: The study compared the effects of different manufacturing processes and surface treatments on the surface gloss, hardness and roughness of restorations under simulated gastric acid exposure. The results showed that the additive manufacturing group had the worst acid resistance. Surface sealant treatment can significantly improve surface properties and is better than traditional polishing.
研究比较了不同制造工艺的氧化锆冠在模拟咀嚼下的内冠精度、对颌磨损和断裂载荷，结果: The study compared the inner crown accuracy, jaw wear and fracture load of zirconia crowns made with different manufacturing processes under simulated chewing. The results showed that the additively manufactured 3Y-TZP crown was superior to the subtractively manufactured 4Y or 5Y-PSZ crown in various indicators.
研究比较了不同制造方式的咬合垫材料的力学性能，结果显示3D打印材料的弯曲强度和表: The study compared the mechanical properties of bite pad materials made by different manufacturing methods. The results showed that the bending strength and surface hardness of 3D printing materials are lower than milling or cold polymerization materials.
