Most of the 3D printing resins are still inferior to the latter in both indicators.
研究比较了不同加工工艺获得的丙烯酸树脂在相同抛光协议下的表面粗糙度，结果显示手动: The study compared the surface roughness of acrylic resins obtained by different processing techniques under the same polishing protocol. The results showed that manual polishing was generally better than mechanical polishing, and there were significant differences between different resins. There were also significant differences between self-curing and thermal polymerization resins under mechanical polishing, and between self-curing and 3D printing resins.
The study compared the compressive strength of PMMA dentures prepared by different processing technologies. The results showed that injection molding technology was the highest (17.92 kN), 3D printing was the lowest (1.51 kN), milling and traditional compression molding reached 5.9 kN and 4.54 kN respectively. The injection molding group had the highest strength but poor stability, and the milling group had the best and stable performance.
研究比较了不同加强杆设计对纯钛选择性激光熔融制造的Kennedy I类可摘局部义: The study compared the effects of different reinforcing rod designs on the molding accuracy of Kennedy Class I removable partial denture frames manufactured by selective laser melting of pure titanium. The results showed that adding reinforcing rods significantly improved the overall accuracy. Among them, connecting a single transverse rod to the tongue rod or adding a reinforcing rod at the distal end significantly improved the molding accuracy of the RPI clasp, bracket and distal end.
研究比较了不同厚度、后固化时间和温度对3D打印义齿基托材料的弯曲强度和颜色稳定性: The study compared the flexural strength and color stability of 3D printed denture base materials with different thicknesses, post-curing times and temperatures. The results showed that extending the post-curing time and increasing the temperature can improve the flexural strength, and the 2 mm thickness group achieved a better balance between strength and color stability.
研究比较了不同后聚合处理对三种3D打印牙科树脂材料聚合深度、转化率、硬度、抗弯强: The study compared the effects of different post-polymerization treatments on the polymerization depth, conversion rate, hardness, flexural strength and elastic modulus of three 3D printing dental resin materials. The results showed that the PP5 treatment performed the best in most indicators, especially at a depth of 0 mm, while the 460 nm wavelength treatment had poorer effects.
研究比较了不同后聚合方法及聚合单元对增材制造牙冠尺寸精度的影响，结果显示使用甘油: The study compared the effects of different post-polymerization methods and polymerization units on the dimensional accuracy of additively manufactured crowns. The results showed that using glycerol as an inert medium can improve the accuracy, while subtractive manufacturing of crowns is more accurate on the inner crown and marginal surfaces, and there is no significant difference between the two in the adjacent areas.
研究比较了不同唾液pH对CAD/CAM磨制与3D打印义齿基台树脂的弯曲强度、硬度: The study compared the effects of different saliva pH on the bending strength, hardness and surface roughness of CAD/CAM ground and 3D printed denture abutment resins. The results showed that the ground resin performed better than the 3D printing resin in different pH saliva, especially in bending strength and hardness, and had lower surface roughness.
研究比较了不同固化时间对3D打印树脂基托冲击强度的影响，结果显示5.0秒固化组冲: The study compared the effects of different curing times on the impact strength of 3D printing resin bases. The results showed that the 5.0-second curing group had the highest impact strength, but was lower than thermally polymerized acrylic resin. The average value of the latter was significantly higher.
研究比较了不同增材制造技术及树脂材料制成的3单位临时修复体与铣削和手工制作修复体: The study compared the accuracy of 3-unit temporary restorations made of different additive manufacturing technologies and resin materials with milled and hand-made restorations in terms of edge, axial, occlusal and overall adaptability. The results showed that the non-verification printing mode was superior to other methods in terms of edge space control and was comparable to milled restorations, especially in the marginal area.
研究比较了不同孔隙结构和双扫描工艺对激光选区熔融Ti–6Al–4V颅骨植入物微观: The study compared the effects of different pore structures and double-scanning processes on the microstructure and mechanical properties of laser selectively melted Ti–6Al–4V skull implants. The results showed that the uniform pore structure had the largest deformation work, and the dense specimen prepared by double-scanning had higher tensile modulus and strength, but it was not confirmed that it is equivalent to the skull stiffness or has clinical verification.
研究比较了不同层厚增材制造和减材制造义齿基台树脂在咖啡热循环下的表面粗糙度、显微: The study compared the surface roughness, microhardness and colorability of additive manufacturing and subtractive manufacturing denture abutment resins with different layer thicknesses under coffee thermal cycling. The results showed that the microhardness of additive manufacturing resin was affected by layer thickness and material-dependent. The overall microhardness of subtractive manufacturing resin was higher and the hardness of non-reinforced materials decreased after thermal cycling. The colorability of all materials met the clinical threshold.
研究比较了不同层厚（25、50、100 µm）3D打印临时冠的边缘与内部密合度，: The study compared the edge and internal adhesion of 3D printed temporary crowns with different layer thicknesses (25, 50, and 100 µm). The results showed that the 50 µm layer thickness group had the best edge and internal adhesion, while the 100 µm group had a significantly larger edge gap.
研究比较了不同层厚（50μm和100μm）增材制造与传统热凝丙烯酸树脂制作的义齿: The study compared the surface roughness and morphology of denture bases made with additive manufacturing and traditional thermosetting acrylic resin with different layer thicknesses (50μm and 100μm). The results showed that the 50μm layer thickness group had the smoothest surface, while the 100μm group had the highest roughness and more pit defects.
研究比较了不同工艺制备的义齿基托上，牙科清洁片、肉桂醇及其联合使用对白色念珠菌生: The study compared the inhibitory effects of dental cleaning tablets, cinnamon alcohol and their combined use on Candida albicans biofilm on denture bases prepared by different processes. It was found that the use alone or in combination significantly reduced the amount of biofilm, but the combined use did not show a synergistic effect, and the inhibitory effect on 3D printed bases was poor.
研究比较了不同建模方向及舌侧翼板是否添加支架对下颌完全义齿采用数字光投影技术成型: The study compared the effects of different modeling directions and whether brackets are added to the lingual wing on the molding accuracy of mandibular complete dentures using digital light projection technology. The results showed that the overall and inner surface accuracy of the denture was optimal in the 270° modeling direction, and adding brackets can significantly improve the accuracy (except for the inner surface in the 0° direction).
研究比较了不同建模方向（0°、30°、45°、90°）下上颌牙列铸件在制备后1个: The study compared the dimensional changes of lower maxillary dentition casts with different modeling directions (0°, 30°, 45°, 90°) at 1 month and 3 months after preparation. The results showed that the modeling direction and time point significantly affected the root mean square deviation of the casts in the fixed bridge area.
研究比较了不同建模角度（0°、45°、90°）下3D打印全口义齿在托盘内表面、边: The study compared the adaptability of 3D printed complete dentures at different modeling angles (0°, 45°, 90°) on the inner surface of the tray, the edge/palatal sealing area and the main load-bearing area. The results showed that the 90° angle had the best adaptability in the edge sealing area, and the adaptability of the 45° and 90° angles in the main load-bearing area was significantly better than the 0° angle. There was no significant difference in the overall inner surface adaptability.
研究比较了不同打印层厚（20μm、50μm、100μm）的增材制造与减材制造3单: The study compared the accuracy of 3-unit temporary fixed bridges made by additive manufacturing and subtractive manufacturing with different printing layer thicknesses (20 μm, 50 μm, 100 μm). The results showed that the accuracy of the additive bridge with a layer thickness of 100 μm was the worst, while the subtractive manufacturing bridge performed best on all surfaces, and changes in layer thickness had a significant impact on the accuracy of the additive bridge.
研究比较了不同打印方向下3单位临时固定义齿采用立体光刻（SLA）和数字光处理（D: The study compared the differences in edge tightness and internal gaps between 3-unit temporary fixed dentures using stereolithography (SLA) and digital light processing (DLP) 3D printing technology and milling technology under different printing directions. The results showed that 3D printing technology was better than milling technology in both edge tightness and internal gaps.
研究比较了不同打印方向下增材制造莫氏氧化锆冠与传统铣削冠在真度及边缘表面粗糙度上: The study compared the differences in accuracy and edge surface roughness between additively manufactured Mohs zirconia crowns and traditional milled crowns in different printing directions. The results showed that there was no significant difference in accuracy between crowns manufactured by industrial printers in the 45° direction and milled crowns, and the surface roughness of the edge area was within the clinically acceptable range.
研究比较了不同打印方向下添加4毫米圆柱形支杆对下颌全口义齿基托精度的影响，结果显: The study compared the impact of adding 4 mm cylindrical struts on the accuracy of the mandibular complete denture base in different printing directions. The results showed that the 15° direction had the highest accuracy, and 45° had the worst. The struts significantly improved the accuracy of each area, especially in the posterior area.
研究比较了不同打印方向下聚jet 3D打印义齿基托材料的弯曲强度和断裂延伸率，结: The study compared the bending strength and fracture elongation of polyjet 3D printed denture base materials in different printing directions. The results showed that the bending strength was highest in the 0-degree direction and the lowest in the 90-degree direction. The printing groups with better than standard values were all higher than the ground samples.
研究比较了不同打印方向和后固化时间对3D打印义齿基托树脂力学性能的影响，发现水平: The study compared the effects of different printing directions and post-curing time on the mechanical properties of 3D printed denture base resin. It was found that horizontal printing can significantly improve the bending strength, while post-curing time has no significant effect on the bending strength. However, the microhardness continues to increase over time, and the 0° printing direction obtains the strongest performance.
研究比较了不同打印方向（0°、45°、90°）和后处理方式（UV、热处理、组合）: The study compared the effects of different printing directions (0°, 45°, 90°) and post-processing methods (UV, heat treatment, combination) on the mechanical and surface properties of 3D printed denture bases. The results showed that the 90° printing direction can significantly improve the bending strength, and UV combined heat treatment can effectively increase the strength, improve wettability and reduce stiffness.
研究比较了不同打印角度和层厚下3D打印义齿基托树脂的弯曲强度，结果显示90°打印: The study compared the bending strength of 3D printed denture base resin at different printing angles and layer thicknesses. The results showed that FL printed at 90° and VC and PP printed at 0° both reached the ISO standard 65 MPa threshold, indicating that the printing angle has an impact on the bending strength of the material.
研究比较了不同支撑数量对3D打印义齿精度的影响，结果显示70个支撑组在准确性和精: The study compared the impact of different support numbers on the accuracy of 3D printed dentures. The results showed that 70 support groups were better than 40 and 55 support groups in terms of accuracy and precision, and the support structure should be focused on overhang and thin-walled areas to improve printing accuracy.
研究比较了不同数字制造技术制备的覆盖义齿框架在种植体附件连接处的密合度及螺丝预紧: The study compared the tightness and screw pre-tightening force of overdenture frames prepared by different digital manufacturing technologies at the implant attachment connection. The results showed that the pre-tightening force of the passive fit frame decreased the least after cyclic loading, while the digital casting and 3D printing frames had acceptable tightness, but the pre-tightening force stability of 3D printing was poor under high load.
研究比较了不同无创呼吸支持方法下呼出气雾滴的扩散距离，结果显示NHFT、CPAP: The study compared the diffusion distance of exhaled aerosol droplets under different non-invasive respiratory support methods. The results showed that the droplet diffusion distance of NHFT, CPAP and BiPAP can reach 34cm, 57cm and 69cm, which is higher than other devices, and all non-filter therapies have the risk of continuous aerosol transmission.
研究比较了不同曝光时间（4.5、5、5.5秒）对开放式3D打印牙托基托尺寸精度和: The study compared the effects of different exposure times (4.5, 5, 5.5 seconds) on the dimensional accuracy and bending strength of the open 3D printed dental tray base. The results showed that the exposure time significantly affected both, with the length accuracy at 5.5 seconds being the highest, the bending strength at 4.5 seconds being the highest, and the bending strength of the closed system being better than other groups.
研究比较了不同材料3D打印假肢套筒与传统套筒的强度，发现通过在远端加装支撑结构，: The study compared the strength of 3D printed prosthetic sleeves of different materials with traditional sleeves and found that by adding a support structure at the distal end, the strength of 3D printed sleeves made of polycarbonate and polypropylene could reach the level of traditional thermoplastic sleeves, while the polyethylene terephthalate material showed no improvement.
研究比较了不同树脂制成的3D打印单冠在热机械老化后的磨损和抗折性能，结果显示VS: The study compared the wear and flexural properties of 3D printed single crowns made of different resins after thermomechanical aging. The results showed that the VSC group had the lowest wear, the GR group had the strongest flexural resistance, and the PC group performed the worst. The agreement between finite element analysis and experimental data reached 87%.
研究比较了不同模量树脂模和天然牙冠的氧化锆冠断裂载荷，结果显示三种模量树脂模及天: The study compared the fracture loads of zirconia crowns on resin molds with different modulus and natural crowns. The results showed that no clear differences were observed in the fracture loads of zirconia crowns on resin molds with three modulus and natural crowns.
研究比较了不同比例的异戊基氰丙基酯与3D打印树脂粘接剂对3D打印义齿基托与牙齿的: The study compared the shear strength and fracture modes of different proportions of isopentyl cyanopropyl ester and 3D printing resin adhesives on 3D printed denture bases and teeth. The results showed that the 50% isopentyl cyanopropyl ester group had the highest shear strength, and the fractures were mainly mixed and cohesive types, indicating that the 50:50 ratio can significantly improve the bonding performance.
研究比较了不同浓度铈氧化物纳米颗粒对3D打印义齿基台树脂的尺寸精度、弯曲强度和表: The study compared the effects of different concentrations of cerium oxide nanoparticles on the dimensional accuracy, bending strength and surface roughness of 3D printed denture abutment resin. The results showed that there was a significant deviation in the length and width dimensions of the 1% cerium oxide group, the bending strength was slightly improved, and the difference in surface roughness was not significant after polishing.
研究比较了不同牙齿（铣削、3D打印、预制）与基托（铣削、3D打印、压铸）及粘接方: The study compared the survival rate and fracture force of restorations under thermomechanical load with different combinations of teeth (milling, 3D printing, prefabrication) and bases (milling, 3D printing, die-casting) and bonding methods. The results showed that the survival period and fracture force of the combination of milling, die-casting, and prefabrication were significantly better than other combinations.
研究比较了不同种植体位置及附件类型对种植体保留超牙合架的支撑与固位作用，结果显示: The study compared the support and retention effects of different implant positions and attachment types on implant-retained super-articulators. The results showed that positioner attachments were better than magnetic attachments in retention in the vertical, oblique, and anterior-posterior directions and under unilateral and bilateral stresses.
研究比较了不同粘合剂对三种义齿基质材料表面粗糙度和硬度的影响，结果显示粘合剂种类: The study compared the effects of different adhesives on the surface roughness and hardness of three denture matrix materials. The results showed that the type of adhesive and the matrix material itself significantly affect its physical and mechanical properties. Among them, Elgydium Fix increased the roughness and decreased the hardness of the thermosetting resin.
研究比较了不同纹理的聚丙烯假肢套筒在被动吸力和主动真空两种悬挂条件下的纵向位移，: The study compared the longitudinal displacement of polypropylene prosthetic sleeves with different textures under two suspension conditions, passive suction and active vacuum. The results showed that the textured sleeve significantly reduced the displacement, but compared with the original OSS sleeve, there was no significant difference under passive suction.
研究比较了不同经验水平外科医生在使用3D打印硅胶肾肿瘤模型进行机器人辅助部分肾切: The study compared the performance of surgeons with different experience levels in training robot-assisted partial nephrectomy using 3D printed silicone renal tumor models. The results showed that the surgical performance of the experienced group was significantly better than that of the beginner group, and the model was highly praised for its realism, practicality and difficulty.
研究比较了不同表面处理及修复材料对CAD/CAM临时修复体剪切结合强度和断裂韧性: The study compared the effects of different surface treatments and repair materials on the shear bond strength and fracture toughness of CAD/CAM temporary restorations. The results showed that the corresponding surface treatment and repair materials need to be selected according to the material type. CAD/CAM materials have better mechanical properties than traditional materials.
研究比较了不同表面处理和粘接剂条件下，增材制造PEEK与自聚合丙烯酸树脂的剪切结: The study compared the shear bonding strength of additively manufactured PEEK and self-polymerizing acrylic resin under different surface treatments and adhesive conditions. The results showed that air sandblasting has the best effect, and the use of adhesives can significantly improve the bonding strength. Thermal cycling causes a significant decrease in bonding strength.
研究比较了不同表面处理对3D打印义齿基托与修复树脂剪切结合强度及断裂模式的影响，: The study compared the effects of different surface treatments on the shear bonding strength and fracture mode of 3D printed denture base and repair resin. The results showed that the sandblasting treatment combined with monomer application group had the highest bonding strength, and the fractures were mainly adhesive type. This method significantly improved the bonding strength and is recommended for denture repair.
研究比较了不同表面处理对3D打印义齿基质树脂与衬里材料之间粘接强度、表面粗糙度和: The study compared the effects of different surface treatments on the bonding strength, surface roughness and wettability between 3D printed denture matrix resin and lining material. The results showed that M treatment increased the bonding strength of the two resins and reduced the contact angle, while AP treatment made the bonding strength of 3D resin close to that of traditional HT resin.
研究比较了不同表面处理对自聚合修复树脂与热压、CAD-CAM铣削及3D打印义齿基: The study compared the effects of different surface treatments on the shear bonding strength between self-polymerizing repair resin and hot pressing, CAD-CAM milling and 3D printed denture matrix materials. The results showed that milling materials have the highest bonding strength and 3D printing materials have the lowest. Air sandblasting or 180-grit sandpaper polishing can improve the bonding strength of 3D printing materials.
研究比较了不同表面处理方式下3D打印义齿基托与椅旁重衬材料的剪切结合强度，结果显: The study compared the shear bonding strength of 3D printed denture base and chairside relining materials under different surface treatment methods. The results showed that the PPS group had the highest bonding strength, and the P and PA groups were significantly higher than the control group. However, there was no significant difference between the PS and A groups and the control group, and bonding failure mainly occurred in the C and A groups.
研究比较了不同表面处理方式对3D打印PMMA义齿基托与树脂人工牙之间剪切结合强度: The study compared the effects of different surface treatment methods on the shear bonding strength between 3D printed PMMA denture bases and resin artificial teeth. The results showed that the monomer treatment group had the highest bonding strength, and interface mixed fractures were common. The difference in surface morphology is related to the bonding performance.
研究比较了不同表面处理方式对三种类型义齿牙与3D打印基托树脂之间剪切结合强度的影: The study compared the effects of different surface treatment methods on the shear bonding strength between three types of denture teeth and 3D printing base resin. The results showed that air sandblasting and methylene chloride treatment significantly improved the bonding strength, while the type of denture teeth itself did not affect the bonding strength.
研究比较了不同角度3D打印与铣削制备的混合陶瓷冠，结果显示铣削冠内部间隙更大、外: The study compared hybrid ceramic crowns prepared by 3D printing and milling at different angles. The results showed that the internal gap of the milled crown was larger and the external gap was smaller. The 90-degree angle group of the 3D printed crown had the smallest internal and external gaps. Both methods achieved clinically acceptable accuracy and repeatability.
研究比较了不同酸性唾液pH值下传统及CAD/CAM加工义齿基托材料的单体渗出和表: The study compared the monomer exudation and surface roughness of traditional and CAD/CAM processed denture base materials under different acidic saliva pH values. The results showed that traditional materials had the highest monomer exudation at pH=4.5 and the lowest at pH=3.5; 3D printing materials had the highest and lowest exudation at pH=5.5 and pH=3.5 respectively; under all pH conditions, the surface roughness of traditional materials was the lowest and that of 3D printing materials was the highest.
研究比较了不同预备方式、扫描方法和加工工艺对锂硅酸盐冠桥适应性与断裂载荷的影响，: The study compared the effects of different preparation methods, scanning methods and processing techniques on the adaptability and fracture load of lithium silicate crowns and bridges. The results showed that the combination of chamfer preparation, additional oral scanning and die-casting processes can achieve the best adaptability and fracture load.
研究比较了不同高度（10mm或15mm）加减法制造的锆瓷冠-基台复合体在循环载荷: The study compared the load-bearing capacity of zirconium-ceramic crown-abutment composites manufactured by additive and subtractive methods of different heights (10mm or 15mm) after cyclic loading. The results showed that no crown fracture occurred in the composite regardless of the manufacturing method or crown height. The maximum load-bearing capacity was between 3292 and 3810N, with no statistical difference.
研究比较了不含金属套筒与含金属套筒的3D打印导板在种植手术中的应用，结果显示无金: The study compared the application of 3D printed guide plates without metal sleeves and those with metal sleeves in implant surgery. The results showed that the metal sleeve-free guide plate can achieve precise implantation without exhausting the guide plate holes, and is suitable for fully guided implant surgery.
研究比较了两种3D打印与两种传统工艺生产的义齿基托树脂的显微硬度和弯曲强度，结果: The study compared the microhardness and bending strength of denture base resins produced by two types of 3D printing and two traditional processes. The results showed that the microhardness of the printed resin was lower than that of traditional resin, but there was no significant difference in the bending strength of each resin.
研究比较了两种3D打印义齿树脂与传统树脂表面特性及白色念珠菌的附着和生物膜形成，: The study compared the surface properties of two 3D printed denture resins with traditional resins and the attachment and biofilm formation of Candida albicans. The results showed that 3D printed resins are more susceptible to colonization by Candida, and their surface free energy is related to the degree of colonization.
研究比较了两种3D打印义齿树脂在5年模拟使用后的机械与物理性能，结果显示其微硬度: The study compared the mechanical and physical properties of two 3D printed denture resins after five years of simulated use. The results showed that their microhardness was lower, their surface roughness was higher, their flexural strength was worse, and their color changes were more obvious. Compared with traditional resins, the recommended use period is no more than three years.
研究比较了两种3D打印支架（聚合物/羟基磷灰石与烧结羟基磷灰石）引发的异物反应差: The study compared the differences in foreign body reactions triggered by two 3D printed scaffolds (polymer/hydroxyapatite and sintered hydroxyapatite) and found that the polymer/hydroxyapatite scaffold triggered a stronger foreign body reaction, accompanied by more macrophages and fibrous tissue, and there was no osseointegration in the foreign body reaction area, while the osseointegration of the sintered hydroxyapatite scaffold was more obvious.
研究比较了两种3D打印树脂在不同消毒灭菌方法下的性能，结果显示MED625FLX: The study compared the performance of two 3D printing resins under different sterilization and sterilization methods. The results showed that MED625FLX maintains material integrity and flexibility during various treatments, while Bioflex A80 MB is only suitable for low-temperature sterilization. High-temperature treatment causes surface cracking. Neither is suitable for low-temperature conditions.
研究比较了两种不同粒径的脂质体环丙沙星吸入制剂与游离环丙沙星溶液在雾化特性、生物: The study compared the differences in aerosolization characteristics, biofilm clearance effect and drug release behavior between liposome ciprofloxacin inhalation preparations with different particle sizes and free ciprofloxacin solution. The results showed that the small particle size liposome ciprofloxacin released more slowly and showed different drug delivery characteristics in the lung epithelial cell model, which has potential therapeutic value.
研究比较了两种光固化3D打印树脂（Kulzer和SprintRay）在不同后聚合: The study compared the mechanical properties, surface hardness, wear resistance and dimensional changes of two light-cured 3D printing resins (Kulzer and SprintRay) under different post-polymerization times and artificial aging. The results show that the flexural strength and surface hardness of the Kulzer material after double post-polymerization are close to those of traditional acrylic resins, and the wear resistance is the best. Artificial aging has no effect on the mechanical properties but reduces the surface hardness. Double post-polymerization has a negative impact on the flexural strength of SprintRay.
研究比较了两种商业3D打印纳米多孔丝材LAY-FOMM和LAY-FELT在骨组织: The study compared the printability of two commercial 3D printed nanoporous filaments, LAY-FOMM and LAY-FELT, in bone tissue engineering and the sustained release performance of tetracycline. The results showed that both can stably release tetracycline for more than 3 days and are non-cytotoxic to human fibroblasts. They are suitable for local antibiotic delivery to prevent infection in bone repair surgery.
研究比较了两种实验性γMPTS偶联剂对3D打印树脂复合材料粘接强度的影响，结果表: The study compared the effects of two experimental γMPTS coupling agents on the bonding strength of 3D printing resin composites. The results showed that the experimental compound of γMPTS mixed with acetic acid or 10-MDP can significantly improve the bonding strength, which is better than 3M™ RelyX™ Ceramic Primer, and there is no significant difference in bonding strength between different 3D-RBCs.
研究比较了两种表面处理对3D打印义齿材料力学性能和颜色稳定性的影响，结果显示抛光: The study compared the effects of two surface treatments on the mechanical properties and color stability of 3D printed denture materials. The results showed that the polished group was superior to the glazed treatment in terms of mechanical strength and hardness, and could maintain good surface roughness and anti-discoloration properties.
研究比较了乙基、正丁基和异戊基氰乙基胶在3D打印义齿基托与牙齿间粘接的剪切强度，: The study compared the shear strength of ethyl, n-butyl and isopentyl cyanoethyl glue in bonding between 3D printed denture bases and teeth. The results showed that isopentyl cyanoethyl glue had the highest bonding strength, significantly better than traditional resin and ethyl glue, and mostly showed mixed or copolymerization fractures, indicating that its bonding performance was better.
研究比较了五种制造技术对上颌前牙三个单位固定修复体基台的贴合影响，结果显示选择性: The study compared the effects of five manufacturing technologies on the fit of three unit fixed restoration abutments of the maxillary anterior teeth. The results showed that the overall fit of selective laser melting (SLM) was better than the traditional lost wax method, and direct metal laser sintering (DMLS) was also a feasible alternative. However, 3D printing polymer technology performed poorly on multiple indicators.
研究比较了五种尿素丙烯酸酯基3D打印义齿基托树脂与商业牙托基树脂在不同紫外曝光时: The study compared the mechanical properties and cytotoxicity of five urea acrylate-based 3D printed denture base resins with commercial denture base resins under different UV exposure times. The results showed that the mechanical properties are adjustable and there is no cytotoxicity.
研究比较了五种牙科清洁剂对传统及CAD/CAM加工义齿基托树脂表面微生物附着和表: The study compared the effects of five dental cleaners on the microbial adhesion and surface topology of traditional and CAD/CAM processed denture base resin surfaces. The results showed that 2% chlorhexidine glucoside achieved zero colony growth for both bacterial species, and the 3D printed denture base resin had the highest microbial adhesion and the largest surface roughness.
研究比较了传统、CAD/CAM铣削和3D打印制作的临时修复体的断裂强度，结果显示: The study compared the fracture strength of temporary restorations made by traditional, CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing. The results showed that the impact of material type was greater than the manufacturing method, and there were significant differences in fracture strength between different materials.
研究比较了传统、增材和减材工艺制作的义齿在模拟口腔老化后的粘接强度和疲劳寿命，结: The study compared the bonding strength and fatigue life of dentures made by traditional, additive and subtractive processes after simulating oral aging. The results showed that the traditional process has the highest bonding strength and the best durability, the additive process has reduced strength but a higher survival rate, and the subtractive process has significant strength loss and bonding failure.
研究比较了传统、铣削和3D打印义齿基托材料在不同厚度下的透光性及对金属背景的遮色: The study compared the light transmittance and shading ability of traditional, milled and 3D printed denture base materials at different thicknesses against the metal background. The results showed that thick bases significantly improved the shading effect. At 1-2 mm, the thermal polymer resin had low light transmittance but good color shading. At 3 mm, the milling resin performed better. Except for P-Lucitone, the other 3D printing materials had poor color shading ability.
研究比较了传统、铣削和3D打印技术制备的完全义齿基托在蒸馏水和唾液替代液中的润湿: The study compared the wettability of complete denture bases prepared by traditional, milling and 3D printing technologies in distilled water and saliva substitute solutions. The results showed that the milling group had the smallest contact angle and the best wettability in water and saliva substitute solutions.
研究比较了传统、铣磨和3D打印制备的咬合垫材料在弯曲强度、单体释放和耐磨性方面的: The study compared the performance of bite pad materials prepared by traditional, milling and 3D printing in terms of bending strength, monomer release and wear resistance. The results showed that milled PMMA had the highest bending strength, the least monomer release, and the best wear resistance. 3D printing resin performed poorly in various indicators, and the printing angle affects the bending strength but not the wear resistance.
研究比较了传统与3D打印硅胶与钛磁扣的粘接强度，结果显示90°角度下拉出力显著高: The study compared the bonding strength between traditional and 3D printed silicone and titanium magnetic buckles. The results showed that the pull-out force at an angle of 90° was significantly higher than that of 45°. A304 Primer performed better than G611 in traditional silicone. There was no significant difference between the two primers in 3D printed silicone.
研究比较了传统压铸、CAD/CAM铣削和3D打印技术制备的义齿基托材料，发现3D: The study compared denture base materials prepared by traditional die-casting, CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing technology. It was found that the 3D printing material has the roughest surface, increased fungal adhesion, and patients are more likely to develop Candida-related denture stomatitis.
研究比较了传统压铸、铣削和3D打印制作临时冠在使用半永久树脂粘接剂后颜色变化，结: The study compared the color change of temporary crowns made by traditional die-casting, milling and 3D printing after using semi-permanent resin adhesive. The results showed that the color change of the 3D printing group was the largest, the milling group was the smallest, and there was no significant difference in the traditional die-casting group.
研究比较了传统及数字方法制作的临时冠在循环老化前后与托槽的剪切结合强度，结果显示: The study compared the shear bonding strength of temporary crowns made by traditional and digital methods with brackets before and after cyclic aging. The results showed that the surface roughness of traditional and milled temporary crowns increased significantly, and the bonding strength of 3D printed temporary crowns was insufficient after aging.
研究比较了传统热聚合、CAD/CAM铣削和3D打印PMMA义齿基托的表面粗糙度、: The study compared the surface roughness, wettability and hardness of traditional thermal polymerization, CAD/CAM milling and 3D printed PMMA denture bases. The results showed that the CAD/CAM base had the smoothest surface and the highest hardness, while the 3D printed base was the most hydrophobic.
研究比较了传统热聚合与3D打印义齿基托树脂的弯曲强度和表面粗糙度，结果表明传统树: The study compared the bending strength and surface roughness of traditional thermal polymerization and 3D printing denture base resin. The results showed that traditional resin has higher strength and smoother surface. Low-pressure plasma treatment can significantly improve the bending strength of both resins, but only significantly increases the surface roughness of traditional resin.
研究比较了传统铸造、传统印模数字加工及口内扫描数字加工三种流程制备的可摘局部义齿: The study compared the adaptability and deformation of removable partial denture frames prepared by three processes: traditional casting, traditional impression digital processing, and intraoral scanning digital processing. The results showed that the traditional casting and digital casting groups had no difference in component adaptability and were better than the intraoral scanning group. The frame deformation of the traditional casting and digital casting groups was smaller, while the intraoral scanning group had poor component adaptability and a narrower frame.
研究比较了传统铸造、选择性激光烧结和CAD/CAM制作的钴铬钼金属冠边缘间隙，结: The study compared the edge gaps of cobalt-chromium-molybdenum metal crowns produced by traditional casting, selective laser sintering and CAD/CAM. The results showed that there were significant differences in the edge gaps of crowns prepared by traditional methods and digital technology, with the traditional method having the smallest gap.
研究比较了低成本3D打印聚酯头鼻咽拭子与商用拭子检测SARS-CoV-2的性能，: The study compared the performance of low-cost 3D printed polyester head and nasopharyngeal swabs with commercial swabs in detecting SARS-CoV-2. The results showed that the prototype swab has higher sensitivity, good overall consistency, and lower cost, making it suitable for areas where commercial swabs are in short supply.
研究比较了体积光固化与数字光处理打印在制备水凝胶缓释药物器件方面的性能，结果显示: The study compared the performance of volumetric photocuring and digital light processing printing in preparing hydrogel sustained-release drug devices. The results showed that volumetric photocuring printing can prepare deformable devices with drug release, swelling and water absorption properties that are equivalent to or even better than DLP printing in 7.5 seconds.
研究比较了使用3D打印手术模板与标准植入技术，结果显示模板组手术时间缩短40%、: The study compared the use of 3D printed surgical templates with standard implantation technology. The results showed that the template group shortened the operation time by 40%, the gingival incision area by 90%, the implant position was accurate, and the postoperative complications were reduced by 70%, while 35% of patients in the standard group experienced implant deviation.
研究比较了使用SLA、DLP 3D打印与铣削技术制作临时牙冠的表面精度，结果显示: The study compared the surface accuracy of temporary crowns produced using SLA and DLP 3D printing and milling technologies. The results showed that 3D printing technology was superior to milling technology, and the manufacturing accuracy was better and more uniform.
研究比较了健康与糖尿病患者来源的人类原代成骨细胞在高、低葡萄糖环境下于3D打印钛: The study compared the phenotypic responses of primary human osteoblasts derived from healthy and diabetic patients on 3D printed titanium surfaces under high and low glucose environments. It was found that diabetic osteoblasts did not respond to glucose changes, while healthy osteoblasts showed stronger bone formation function and enhanced gene expression under high glucose.
研究比较了全 晶格 与混合 gyroid 三重周期最小曲面结构牙植入体，结果显示: The study compared full lattice and hybrid gyroid triple periodic minimum curved surface structure dental implants. The results showed that the hybrid structure (especially HI_222) can effectively reduce bone-implant interface fretting and improve stress distribution, which is better than traditional designs.
研究比较了六款商用3D打印机在打印临床相关骨科解剖模型时的打印时间和成本，结果表: The study compared the printing time and cost of six commercial 3D printers when printing clinically relevant orthopedic anatomical models. The results showed that the printing time is closely related to the model orientation and the selected equipment and parameters, and the difference between different printers can reach an order of magnitude.
研究比较了六种不同基底材料对预染多层氧化锆牙冠颜色准确性的影响，结果显示PEKK: The study compared the effects of six different base materials on the color accuracy of pre-stained multi-layer zirconia crowns. The results showed that PEKK and PEEK could achieve good color accuracy, with cobalt-chromium alloy having the largest color deviation, while the ΔE values of composite resin, PEEK and PEKK were in line with clinical standards.
研究比较了六种不同晶格形状钛合金植入物在羊股骨髁中的骨长入情况，发现gyroid: The study compared the bone ingrowth of six titanium alloy implants with different lattice shapes in sheep femoral condyle and found that the bone ingrowth efficiency of gyroid, double pyramidal and cubic lattice was the highest, and the rankings were consistent at 8 weeks and 12 weeks.
研究比较了六种可打印的双甲基丙烯酸酯基材料与两种可铣削的聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯基材料，: The study compared the mechanical properties, surface roughness and optical properties of six printable dimethacrylate-based materials and two millable polymethylmethacrylate-based materials before and after simulated aging for one year. The results showed that the initial hardness and stiffness of the printable materials were higher, but the hardness decreased and the surface roughness increased after aging, while the millable PMMA material has better long-term stability.
研究比较了六种陶瓷材料在不同厚度下CAD/CAM制作冠的断裂强度，结果显示厚度为: The study compared the fracture strength of CAD/CAM crowns made of six ceramic materials at different thicknesses. The results showed that when the thickness was 1.5 mm, all materials passed the fatigue test. At 1.0 mm, only the e.max CAD and Suprinity survival rates were 100%. At 0.5 mm, the Suprinity survival rate was the highest (37.5%), and there were significant differences in the maximum fracture load at each thickness.
研究比较了冻干与3D打印制备的HAp/PLGA/CS支架，发现3D打印支架细胞活: The study compared HAp/PLGA/CS scaffolds prepared by freeze-drying and 3D printing. It was found that the cell viability of the 3D-printed scaffold was significantly higher than that of the freeze-dried scaffold, and the 70% filled group showed better osteogenic potential. Both have suitable degradation characteristics, but their effectiveness in in vivo regeneration needs to be further verified.
研究比较了加工商制钛铝钒合金植入物经不同激光处理后的表面拓扑结构对人骨髓间充质干: The study compared the effects of the surface topography of manufacturer-made titanium-aluminum-vanadium alloy implants after different laser treatments on the differentiation of human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells into osteoblasts. The results showed that the surfaces of AM Ns and AM Ns+Fs have unique micro-nano rough structures, which can enhance the osteogenic phenotype differentiation of stem cells.
研究比较了医院环境中手动分割25 mg美托洛尔片制成6.25 mg和12.5 m: The study compared manual segmentation of 25 mg metoprolol tablets in a hospital setting to produce 6.25 mg and 12.5 mg doses with low-dose tablets prepared by 3D printing. The results showed that manual segmentation had poor dose accuracy and uneven content, while 3D printed tablets had accurate doses and uniform content.
研究比较了十种3D打印材料在经医院灭菌后尺寸变化，发现PETG、PC和PETG-: The study compared the dimensional changes of ten kinds of 3D printing materials after sterilization in the hospital. It was found that PETG, PC and PETG-CF maintained good accuracy after cold plasma sterilization, while PLA, PLA-HP and PA materials deformed significantly. The directionality of deformation after sterilization and the adaptation margin need to be considered in the design.
研究比较了双层与粘接3D打印义齿基托材料的力学性能，结果显示双层打印在弯曲强度和: The study compared the mechanical properties of double-layer and bonded 3D printed denture base materials. The results showed that double-layer printing was superior to the bonded group in terms of bending strength and fracture toughness, while the bonded group had higher impact strength.
研究比较了含80微米代型间隙涂料与无代型间隙涂料的单臂树脂粘接固定桥在边缘密合度: The study compared the differences in edge adhesion and maximum load to failure between single-arm resin-bonded fixed bridges with 80 micron generation gap coating and no generation gap coating. The results showed that there was no significant difference in edge adhesion and maximum load to failure between the two.
研究比较了含高比例无机填料的3D打印树脂（RCP、RZP）与CAD-CAM纳米复: The study compared the performance of 3D printing resins (RCP, RZP) containing a high proportion of inorganic fillers with CAD-CAM nanocomposite ceramic resin (RCM) and unfilled resin (RP) in terms of flexural strength, hardness, water absorption and solubility. The results showed that RZP has the highest strength, RCP and RCM are better than RP, RZP has high strength but large variability, and RCM has higher reliability.
研究比较了四年级牙科学生使用3D打印唇腭裂模型与传统讲授对解剖知识掌握及满意度的: This study compared the impact of using 3D printed cleft lip and palate models with traditional lectures on anatomical knowledge mastery and satisfaction among fourth-year dental students. The results showed that hands-on models are better than traditional lectures in improving learning effects.
研究比较了四种3D打印义齿基质树脂在热机械老化后的弯曲强度、弯曲模量、维氏硬度及: The study compared the flexural strength, flexural modulus, Vickers hardness and fracture surface morphology of four 3D printed denture matrix resins after thermomechanical aging. The results showed that the high-impact materials DT and PT were superior to other materials in terms of flexural strength and hardness, and all indicators dropped significantly after aging.
研究比较了四种3D打印工艺与传统铣削工艺制成的3Y-TZP固定桥在老化前后的承载: The study compared the load-bearing capacity of 3Y-TZP fixed bridges made by four 3D printing processes and traditional milling processes before and after aging. The results showed that the 3D printing process showed more fractures and load drops after dynamic loading and thermal aging. In particular, the aSLA process performed worse, while the milling process still maintained a higher load after aging.
研究比较了四种3D打印技术制备模具的表面粗糙度，发现光聚合墨水喷射和立体光刻打印: The study compared the surface roughness of molds prepared by four 3D printing technologies and found that the molds printed by photopolymerization ink jetting and stereolithography are suitable for replicating non-planar microchannels with different heights, and their replication accuracy and transparency are better.
研究比较了四种3D打印技术在不同方向及经蒸汽灭菌后手术导板的尺寸准确性，结果显示: The study compared the dimensional accuracy of surgical guides in four 3D printing technologies in different directions and after steam sterilization. The results showed that the FFF guide deformed significantly after sterilization and was not clinically usable. The CLIP guide deformation was more obvious than that of SLA, but it was still within the clinically acceptable range.
研究比较了四种3D打印树脂材料在不同保存条件下的机械性能，结果显示，人工唾液和C: The study compared the mechanical properties of four 3D printing resin materials under different storage conditions. The results showed that artificial saliva and Corega sheet storage can partially improve the mechanical properties of the bite pad. Among them, the performance of PriZma 3D Bio Splint dropped significantly after 30 days, and the strength of NightGuard Firm was significantly higher than other materials after 24 hours.
研究比较了四种3D打印牙托牙材料与一种CAD/CAM铣削材料在抗弯强度、断裂韧性: The study compared the performance of four 3D printed dental denture materials and one CAD/CAM milled material in terms of flexural strength, fracture toughness, volumetric wear and color stability. The results showed that the flexural strength of 3D printed materials is better than that of milled materials, but the color stability is poor. The overall mechanical and optical properties are good, providing a lower-cost and more efficient alternative for dental denture manufacturing.
研究比较了四种3D打印牙科树脂在单体释放、聚合效率、机械性能和细胞相容性方面的差: The study compared the differences in monomer release, polymerization efficiency, mechanical properties and cell compatibility of four 3D printed dental resins. The results showed that the temporary crown resin had the highest monomer release and the lowest cell viability, while the permanent material was superior in nanohardness and elastic modulus, and the dental tray base material was superior to the permanent dental tray base material in bending strength.
研究比较了四种CAD-CAM导板在可摘局部义齿引导面制备中的准确性，结果显示钴铬: The study compared the accuracy of four CAD-CAM guides in the preparation of guide surfaces for removable partial dentures. The results showed that the cobalt-chromium alloy three-constrained guide was superior to other types of guides and hand-made in terms of three-dimensional accuracy and direction accuracy.
研究比较了四种CAD-CAM方法制备纯钛可摘局部义齿框架的形状精度、表面粗糙度、: The study compared the shape accuracy, surface roughness, microstructure and internal pores of pure titanium removable partial denture frames prepared by four CAD-CAM methods. The results showed that direct milling and selective laser melting were superior to casting methods in terms of accuracy and defect control.
研究比较了四种CAD-CAM材料制成的前牙3单位固定修复体在尺寸精度和内部密合度: The study compared the performance of anterior 3-unit fixed restorations made of four CAD-CAM materials in terms of dimensional accuracy and internal fit. The results showed that the dimensional accuracy of the additively manufactured urethane acrylate-based polymer was significantly better than that of the subtractively manufactured material in the internal and marginal areas, but it had the largest internal gaps, while the subtractively manufactured high-impact polymer composite had the best internal fit.
The study compared the flexural strength of four CAD/CAM materials in vitro. Among them, lithium silicate ceramic (IPS e.max CAD) is the highest and polymer composite material (Vita Enamic) is the lowest. The flexural strength of the new 3D printing resin (Ceramic Crown) is in between, with no significant difference from the polymer composite material, and the fracture surface morphology shows that its mechanical properties are comparable to grinding composite materials.
研究比较了四种不同3D打印牙托基树脂与传统热聚合树脂在打印精度和弯曲性能上的差异: The study compared the differences in printing accuracy and bending performance between four different 3D printing dental tray base resins and traditional thermal polymerization resins. The results showed that the printing accuracy and bending strength of 3D printing resin were lower than those of traditional resins, while the elastic modulus had no significant difference.
研究比较了四种不同材料制成的咬合垫在热机械老化后的断裂强度，结果显示铣磨制咬合垫: The study compared the fracture strength of bite pads made of four different materials after thermomechanical aging. The results showed that the fracture strength of milled bite pads was the highest, which was significantly higher than 3D printing and traditional thermosetting acrylic resin products.
研究比较了四种临时修复材料在数字加工、传统工艺及3D打印方法下的表面粗糙度、单体: The study compared the surface roughness, monomer release and cytotoxicity of four temporary repair materials under digital processing, traditional technology and 3D printing methods. The results showed that the cytotoxicity of 3D printing materials was significantly higher than that of other materials at all time points, while digital processing and PT materials had better biocompatibility and lower surface roughness than traditional technology materials.
研究比较了四种临时冠材料的物理和机械性能，结果显示数字减法和加法工艺制备的冠表面: The study compared the physical and mechanical properties of four temporary crown materials. The results showed that the crowns prepared by digital subtraction and additive processes have smoother surfaces and higher bending strength. Among them, the subtractive resin prepared by the NextDent system performed best.
研究比较了四种实验性3D打印义齿基质树脂与商用树脂（T0）在物理力学性能和生物相: The study compared the differences in physical and mechanical properties and biocompatibility between four experimental 3D printed denture matrix resins and commercial resin (T0). The results showed that the experimental resin T3 had a lower viscosity and higher elastic modulus than the commercial resin, but there was no significant difference in flexural strength and biocompatibility.
研究比较了四种机械脱污染方法在三种骨内缺损模型中对植入物表面的清洁效果，结果显示: The study compared the cleaning effects of four mechanical decontamination methods on implant surfaces in three intraosseous defect models. The results showed that the cleaning effect of airflow polishing and titanium brushes was better than that of ultrasonic devices in all defect configurations, and the titanium brushes had the best effect when the inner wall of the bone was present. The cleaning effect of the root thread area decreased with the type of device.
研究比较了四种牙托基台制造技术与五种硬重衬树脂对即刻临时混合义齿与钛柱连接强度的: The study compared the effects of four dental tray abutment manufacturing technologies and five hard relining resins on the connection strength between immediate temporary hybrid dentures and titanium posts. The results showed that different manufacturing processes and resin materials had a significant impact on the push-off force. The thermal polymerization process performed the most stable, while milling and 3D printing required careful selection of resin materials.
研究比较了四种牙托基质材料在不同表面处理（抛光与釉面）及模拟刷牙后的表面硬度、粗: The study compared the surface hardness, roughness, gloss and wear of four types of dental tray matrix materials under different surface treatments (polished and glazed) and after simulated tooth brushing. The results showed that the glazed treatment significantly reduced wear. Among them, the milled material had the highest gloss and the lowest roughness after simulated tooth brushing, and the 3D printing material showed the least wear under polishing treatment.
研究比较了四种牙科修复材料的力学性能，结果显示3D打印树脂与CAD/CAM复合块: The study compared the mechanical properties of four dental restoration materials. The results showed that 3D printing resin and CAD/CAM composite blocks were equivalent in bending strength, and TC-80DP had the best toughness, but the latter was significantly better than 3D printing resin in surface hardness and wear resistance.
研究比较了四种用于临时固定义齿的树脂材料，包括两种3D打印树脂和两种传统树脂，在: The study compared four resin materials used for temporary fixed dentures, including two 3D printing resins and two traditional resins. In compression and three-point bending tests, the 3D printing resin showed higher elastic modulus and bending strength, and a more uniform structure.
研究比较了四种立体光刻常用材料对小鼠成纤维细胞长期存活及增殖的影响，发现经灭菌处: The study compared the effects of four commonly used stereolithography materials on the long-term survival and proliferation of mouse fibroblasts. It was found that after sterilization, the dental SG material supported good cell adhesion and survival under a shear force of 3-8 dyne/cm², and could be used for the culture of human hepatocytes and human induced pluripotent stem cells.
研究比较了四种附件拾取材料在传统热凝、减材和增材制造牙托基底上的推挤力，结果显示: The study compared the pushing force of four accessory pick-up materials on traditional thermal coagulation, subtractive and additive manufacturing dental tray bases. The results showed that the combination of 3D printed dental tray bases and resin composites plus adhesives had the highest pushing force. For thermal coagulation and milling dental tray bases, self-setting acrylic resin pick-up materials were more preferred.
研究比较了四种陶瓷材料在CAD-CAM、压制和3D打印三种工艺下的微硬度与表面粗: The study compared the microhardness and surface roughness of four ceramic materials under three processes: CAD-CAM, pressing and 3D printing. The results showed that the CAD-CAM and pressing processes had the highest microhardness, and the pressing IPS e. Max had the lowest surface roughness. Zirconium-ceramic reinforced lithium silicon ceramics performed best in both indicators.
研究比较了在生理葡萄糖浓度与高葡萄糖浓度储存条件下红细胞的特性，发现规范血糖储存: The study compared the characteristics of red blood cells under storage conditions of physiological glucose concentration and high glucose concentration. It was found that standardized blood glucose storage can reduce red blood cell hemolysis and hemoglobin glycosylation, and single-cell pressure conductance mapping showed that its elasticity increased, and microfluidic testing showed that its cell-derived ATP release increased.
研究比较了在铸造全口义齿框架中，不同设置条件的加强棒对AM-Cast和SLS工艺: The study compared the effects of reinforcing rods with different setting conditions on the accuracy of AM-Cast and SLS processes in cast complete denture frames. The results showed that the setting of reinforcing rods significantly affected the accuracy of the lingual side rails in the AM-Cast process, but had no effect on the central region displacement in the SLS process.
研究比较了均匀与梯度钴铬合金蜂窝结构在体外的机械性能和生物行为，结果显示梯度结构: The study compared the mechanical properties and biological behavior of uniform and gradient cobalt-chromium alloy honeycomb structures in vitro. The results showed that the gradient structure was better than the uniform structure in terms of stress distribution, and promoted bone cell activity and bone formation-related gene expression better.
研究比较了增材制造树脂与减材制造蜡模在铸造或压铸固定桥模型中的准确性，结果显示减: The study compared the accuracy of additive manufacturing resin and subtractive manufacturing wax models in cast or die-cast fixed bridge models. The results showed that the yellow wax and blue wax models produced by subtractive manufacturing were better than the additive manufacturing resin models in terms of accuracy, and the blue wax model had smaller edge and inner surface deviations and better accuracy.
研究比较了多种3D打印机与 铣削 机制作临时冠的精度，结果显示DLP方法的精度高: The study compared the accuracy of temporary crowns made by various 3D printers and milling machines. The results showed that the accuracy of the DLP method was higher than that of the SLA method. Among the regional differences, the occlusal area and anti-rotation depression area were the largest, and the edge area was the smallest. The difference values of W11, Imes-icore 250i, Zenith D, and Zenith U increased in order.
研究比较了孔隙宽度为150μm和200μm的聚乳酸3D支架对人牙髓干细胞神经分化: The study compared the inducing effect of polylactic acid 3D scaffolds with pore widths of 150 μm and 200 μm on the neural differentiation of human dental pulp stem cells. It was found that the 150 μm pore scaffold was easier to guide cells to directional arrangement, and the cell adhesion could be improved after alcohol treatment or poly-L-lysine coating.
研究比较了层厚为20、50和100μm的3D打印复合树脂冠与铣磨冠在真度和边缘质: The study compared the differences in accuracy and edge quality between 3D printed composite resin crowns and milled crowns with layer thicknesses of 20, 50 and 100 μm. The results showed that the milled crowns were more accurate on the medial and occlusal surfaces than the 100 μm layer thickness crowns, and had the highest edge quality, while the edge quality of the 20 μm and 100 μm layer thickness crowns was the lowest, and the quality varied with the edge position.
研究比较了常规CT与锥形束CT生成的立体光刻手术导板在牙种植术前规划及植入中的应: This study compared the application of stereolithography surgical guides generated by conventional CT and cone-beam CT in preoperative planning and implantation of dental implants. The results showed that the two methods are comparable in terms of surgical guidance.
研究比较了常规、CAD-CAM预聚物及3D打印义齿基托树脂在不同表面处理、老化条: The study compared the water absorption and dissolution rates of conventional, CAD-CAM prepolymers and 3D printed denture base resins under different surface treatments, aging conditions and curing parameters. The results showed that the 3D printing material had the lowest water absorption rate, and the dissolution rate showed differences under different aging conditions. Enamel treatment significantly reduced water absorption and dissolution, and glycerol curing could reduce the dissolution rate, but curing time had no significant effect on water absorption.
研究比较了常规与3D打印义齿基质材料经氟钛酸修饰后，对真菌的抑制效果及其表面性质: The study compared the fungal inhibitory effect and surface properties of conventional and 3D printed denture matrix materials modified with fluorotitanic acid. The results showed that the material concentration affects the antifungal activity and surface properties of both.
研究比较了常规热压、3D打印和CAD-CAM铣削制备的义齿基托与微波固化硅基软衬: The study compared the tensile bonding strength of denture bases prepared by conventional hot pressing, 3D printing and CAD-CAM milling and microwave-cured silicone-based soft lining. The results showed that the CAD-CAM base had the highest bonding strength, and the bonding strength was significantly improved after surface treatment with Er:YSGG laser or acetone.
研究比较了手塑、铣削和3D打印工艺制备的3单位种植体固定桥的边缘密合度，发现3D: The study compared the edge tightness of 3-unit implant-fixed bridges prepared by hand molding, milling and 3D printing processes. It was found that the edge gap was significantly smaller in the 3D printing group, and only the edge gap in the milling group increased significantly after multiple sinterings. All processes achieved clinically acceptable edge tightness.
研究比较了抛光单独处理与抛光后施釉对单色多色3D打印义齿树脂的颜色稳定性、光泽、: The study compared the effects of polishing alone and polishing followed by glazing on the color stability, gloss, roughness and wettability of single-color multi-color 3D printed denture resin. The results showed that there are differences in various properties between the two surface treatment methods.
研究比较了数字与传统印模制作的单冠及三单位固定修复体的边缘密合度，结果显示传统印: The study compared the marginal fit of single crowns and three-unit fixed restorations made from digital and traditional impressions. The results showed that there were significant differences between traditional impressions and specific digital scanning methods. Among them, polyether and Carestream 3600 obtained the best marginal fit for single crowns and three-unit restorations respectively.
研究比较了数字工作流程与传统方法在完全义齿牙齿排列中的应用，结果显示数字技术在精: The study compared the application of digital workflow and traditional methods in complete denture tooth arrangement. The results showed that digital technology is superior to traditional methods in terms of accuracy, repeatability and patient satisfaction. However, due to cost and training requirements, the most practical solution currently is a hybrid solution that combines digital and traditional methods.
研究比较了方形、buttress及三角形螺纹设计对牙植入体周围骨微应变的影响，发: The study compared the effects of square, buttress and triangular thread designs on bone microstrain around dental implants. It was found that the square thread has the largest bone contact area, and combined threads can increase microstrain in the middle or root. Different thread design combinations are suitable for patients in different age groups.
研究比较了未处理、喷砂和微弧氧化处理的种植体附件对铸造冠 Cement 附着强度: The study compared the effects of untreated, sandblasted and micro-arc oxidation treated implant attachments on the adhesion strength of cast crown Cement. The results showed that the micro-arc oxidation treatment group had the highest adhesion strength, which was significantly higher than the sandblasting group and better than the untreated group.
研究比较了机器人弯制与人工弯制可摘局部义齿卡环的效率、适应性及可重复性，结果显示: The study compared the efficiency, adaptability and repeatability of robotic bending and manual bending of removable partial denture clasps. The results showed that robotic bending significantly shortened the operation time and improved the fit and consistency of clasps and teeth, while the initial retention force was not significantly different from manual bending.
研究比较了机械（喷砂）和化学（四氢呋喃、Vitacoll）表面处理对铣削及3D打: The study compared the effects of mechanical (sandblasting) and chemical (tetrahydrofuran, Vitacoll) surface treatment on the bonding strength of milled and 3D printed denture bases and self-polymerizing acrylic resin. The results showed that sandblasting significantly improved the shear strength and surface roughness of all base materials. Tetrahydrofuran could increase the bonding strength of hot-pressed bases and 3D-printed bases to the level of sandblasting, while Vitacoll only improved the bonding of hot-pressed bases and both reduced the base hardness.
研究比较了欧盟、美国和澳大利亚在新冠疫情中通过3D打印应对医疗设备短缺的做法，指: The study compares the European Union, the United States and Australia's approach to responding to the shortage of medical equipment through 3D printing during the COVID-19 epidemic, pointing out the tension between intellectual property rights and repair rights, emphasizing that open licensing helps collaboration, but the right to repair medical equipment needs to be strengthened to respond to the public health crisis and support the Sustainable Development Goals.
研究比较了氧化铝和玻璃珠喷砂对3D打印树脂复合材料及磨削材料表面形貌、粗糙度、弯: The study compared the effects of alumina and glass bead blasting on the surface morphology, roughness, bending strength and bonding strength of 3D printing resin composites and grinding materials. The results showed that alumina sandblasting significantly increased surface roughness and reduced bending strength, while glass bead blasting could increase roughness without reducing strength under a pressure of 3 bar, and both improved the bonding between the material and the substrate.
研究比较了氮气与空气后固化对3D打印义齿基托材料表面硬度、生物相容性及机械性能的: The study compared the effects of nitrogen and air post-curing on the surface hardness, biocompatibility and mechanical properties of 3D printed denture base materials. The results showed that nitrogen post-curing can improve the surface hardness and biocompatibility of the material and reduce cytotoxicity without affecting its mechanical properties.
研究比较了沿XY和YX方向打印的PDMS基微流控通道表面粗糙度及流体动力学稳定性: The study compared the surface roughness and hydrodynamic stability of PDMS-based microfluidic channels printed along the XY and YX directions. It was found that the channels along the XY direction (Dev-1) were smoother, had better geometric consistency, and were more sensitive to changes in flow rate, while the channel width in the YX direction (Dev-2) was slightly narrower, the surface was more irregular, the flow rate was higher, but the flow rate resolution was poor.
研究比较了注射成型、CAD/CAM铣削和快速成型法制作义齿基托的精度，结果显示铣: The study compared the accuracy of injection molding, CAD/CAM milling and rapid prototyping methods for making denture bases. The results showed that the overall accuracy of milling and rapid prototyping methods was higher than that of injection molding methods, but the injection molding method was superior to the first two methods in terms of detail reproduction.
研究比较了添加不同浓度纳米沸石对3D打印义齿基台树脂的尺寸精度、断裂韧性、双轴弯: The study compared the effects of adding different concentrations of nanozeolite on the dimensional accuracy, fracture toughness, biaxial bending strength and surface roughness of 3D printed denture abutment resin. The results showed that the dimensional error in the thickness direction of the 0.5% nanozeolite group significantly increased, while the 0.25% group performed best in fracture toughness and bending strength, and the surface roughness changed significantly with the filler content.
研究比较了添加苯乙烯丁二烯单体的GC Temp 打印与传统及CAD-CAM制备的: The study compared GC Temp printing with styrene butadiene monomer and temporary crown and bridge materials prepared by traditional and CAD-CAM. The results showed that the experimental material significantly improved the bending strength and fracture toughness of the material, which was better than conventional materials.
研究比较了溶剂浇铸与粉末混合两种方法对聚己内酯载体中庆大霉素分布及释放的影响，结: The study compared the effects of solvent casting and powder mixing on the distribution and release of gentamicin in polycaprolactone carriers. The results showed that the solvent casting method improved the uniformity of the drug in the matrix and enhanced the antibacterial effect, while there was no difference in thermal and mechanical properties between the methods.
研究比较了热凝丙烯酸树脂、铣削PMMA树脂和3D打印PMMA树脂在颜色稳定性、弯: The study compared the performance of thermosetting acrylic resin, milling PMMA resin and 3D printing PMMA resin in terms of color stability, bending strength and surface roughness. The results showed that the surface roughness and color changes of 3D printing resin were minimal, and the impact of aging on its mechanical properties was negligible.
研究比较了热凝和3D打印义齿树脂在长期使用不同清洁剂后的颜色稳定性、粗糙度和硬度: The study compared the color stability, roughness and hardness changes of thermosetting and 3D printed denture resins after long-term use of different detergents. The results showed that after 2 years of toothpaste scrubbing, both types of resins showed color changes, increased roughness and decreased hardness, while the disinfectant soap group had the smallest change.
研究比较了热压PMMA、CAD/CAM铣磨树脂和3D打印树脂基托的表面粗糙度与微: The study compared the surface roughness and microbial adhesion of hot-pressed PMMA, CAD/CAM milling resin and 3D printing resin base. The results showed that CAD/CAM milling resin has the smoothest surface and the least microbial adhesion, which is better than the other two types of materials.
研究比较了热压、CAD-CAM铣削和DLP打印三种PMMA义齿基质在模拟刷牙作用: The study compared the surface roughness and weight changes of three PMMA denture matrices, namely hot pressing, CAD-CAM milling and DLP printing, under simulated tooth brushing. The results showed that hot pressing materials are the most durable, while DLP printing materials are the most susceptible to deterioration. Material processing methods have a more significant impact on surface changes than toothpaste selection.
研究比较了热压、冷压丙烯酸树脂、CAD/CAM铣削PMMA、FDM打印PMMA及: The study compared hot-pressed and cold-pressed acrylic resin, CAD/CAM milled PMMA, FDM printed PMMA and SLA printed methacrylate resin. It was found that the FDM printed dental tray base material complies with ISO standards in terms of mechanical properties, water absorption and solubility, but the bonding performance of the tooth surface is insufficient, the surface is rough and easy to cause microbial adhesion, and the fitting accuracy is lower than that of traditional materials.
研究比较了热聚合、CAD/CAM铣削和3D打印PMMA基义齿材料在模拟胃酸老化下: The study compared the changes in mechanical parameters such as Martens hardness of thermal polymerization, CAD/CAM milling and 3D printing PMMA-based denture materials under simulated gastric acid aging. The results showed that different process materials responded differently. Gastric acid exposure significantly reduced the Martens parameters, especially at 96 hours, the changes in milling materials were most obvious, and 3D printing materials were less affected by solvents.
研究比较了热聚合、CAD铣削和3D打印PMMA基托的弯曲性能及表面粗糙度，结果显: The study compared the bending properties and surface roughness of thermal polymerization, CAD milling and 3D printed PMMA bases. The results showed that the CAD group had the best bending strength and hardness, the lowest surface roughness, and the most bacterial adhesion at 90 minutes. After polishing and 16 hours, no clear differences were observed in the surface roughness and bacterial adhesion of each group.
研究比较了热聚合、冷聚合和3D打印义齿基质树脂在热循环前后的剪切结合强度、弯曲强: The study compared the shear bonding strength, flexural strength and color stability of thermal polymerization, cold polymerization and 3D printing denture matrix resin before and after thermal cycling. The results showed that although the mechanical properties of 3D printing resin were equivalent to thermal polymerization resin, the color change was significantly greater than the former, and the flexural strength decreased significantly after thermal cycling, and the aesthetic durability was limited.
研究比较了热聚合与3D打印义齿基托树脂在老化后的力学性能和颜色稳定性，结果显示3: The study compared the mechanical properties and color stability of thermal polymerization and 3D printing denture base resin after aging. The results showed that 3D printing resin was superior to traditional resin in terms of compressive strength, hardness and color stability, but aging significantly reduced its bending strength, tensile strength and hardness.
研究比较了用于可摘局部义齿基托的冷聚合甲基丙烯酸甲酯树脂（Vertex Cast: The study compared the water absorption and solubility of cold polymerized methyl methacrylate resin (Vertex Castapress) and 3D printing photopolymerized resin (Next Dent Base) used for removable partial denture bases. The results showed that Next Dent Base has better water absorption and solubility than Vertex Castapress, indicating that it has stronger saliva resistance and wear resistance.
研究比较了用于活动义齿的钛合金（Ti6Al4V）与钴铬合金（Co-Cr）在三支弯: The study compared the differences in the three-branch bending strength and microhardness of titanium alloy (Ti6Al4V) and cobalt-chromium alloy (Co-Cr) used for removable dentures. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the bending strength between the two, but the titanium alloy showed lower microhardness and lower elastic modulus.
研究比较了由减材铣削和增材制造生产的三单位树脂固定修复体在表面精度、内部贴合和边: The study compared the differences in surface accuracy, internal fit and marginal adaptation between three-unit resin-fixed restorations produced by subtractive milling and additive manufacturing. The results showed that the milling group was better than 3D-2 in marginal adaptation and overall surface deviation, and 3D-1 was wider in marginal and axial clearance.
研究比较了电子束熔融和激光束熔融制造的Ti-6Al-4V合金表面与传统铸造表面及: The study compared the accumulation of Streptococcus biofilm on the surface of Ti-6Al-4V alloy manufactured by electron beam melting and laser beam melting, traditional casting surface and polytetrafluoroethylene. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the amount of biofilm accumulation on the surface of different manufacturing methods.
研究比较了直接能量沉积（DED）涂层与等离子喷涂（TPS）和粉末床融合（PBF）: The study compared the performance of direct energy deposition (DED) coating with plasma spraying (TPS) and powder bed fusion (PBF) technology on joint implants. The results showed that DED coating has higher porosity, better cell adhesion, proliferation and activity, and in vivo experiments showed better bone-implant contact and new bone formation, and the osseointegration performance is stable and long-lasting.
研究比较了直接金属制造（DMF）与等离子喷涂（TPS）在钴铬合金上镀钛表面的生物: The study compared the biological and mechanical properties of titanium-plated surfaces on cobalt-chromium alloys using direct metal manufacturing (DMF) and plasma spraying (TPS). The results showed that the titanium coating prepared by DMF was equivalent to TPS in terms of cell morphology, proliferation and bone integration rate in vivo, and the surface quality was acceptable and comparable.
研究比较了直接金属激光熔融（DMLS）和选择性激光熔融（SLM）制造钴铬材料上颌: The study compared the fitting accuracy, surface roughness and microstructure of maxillary removable partial denture frames made of cobalt-chromium materials using direct metal laser melting (DMLS) and selective laser melting (SLM). The results showed that the DMLS frame was superior to SLM and traditional casting technology in terms of overall fit and support adaptability, and the surface roughness was also significantly lower.
研究比较了砂喷和酸蚀对增材制造与机械加工钛表面性质的影响，发现酸蚀后所有表面初始: The study compared the effects of sandblasting and acid etching on the surface properties of additive manufacturing and machined titanium. It was found that after acid etching, all surfaces were initially highly hydrophilic, but air storage led to a decrease in hydrophilicity, while NaCl storage could maintain hydrophilicity and slightly improve biocompatibility. Cell adhesion and morphology were optimal under no storage conditions.
研究比较了磨削与3D打印冠材料在不同咬合厚度下的断裂强度，结果显示磨削材料随厚度: The study compared the fracture strength of ground and 3D printed crown materials at different occlusal thicknesses. The results showed that the fracture strength of ground materials increased as the thickness increased, while the strength of 3D printed P1 materials decreased as thickness increased. The strength of P2 materials was significantly different between 0.5 and 1.5 mm thickness, and the hardness of ground materials was significantly higher than the other two types of materials.
研究比较了立体光刻（SLA）与CAD/CAM铣削技术制作的全瓷锆瓷冠在准确性与适: The study compared the accuracy and fit of all-ceramic zirconium crowns produced by stereolithography (SLA) and CAD/CAM milling technology. The results showed that there was no significant difference in accuracy and edge fit between the two groups, and the accuracy of the SLA group was better than that of the milling group.
研究比较了紫外光聚合树脂与3D打印义齿材料的剪切结合强度，发现后聚合处理显著降低: The study compared the shear bonding strength of UV polymerized resin and 3D printed denture materials, and found that post-polymerization treatment significantly reduced the bonding strength; in surface treatment, 50 μm and 110 μm sandblasting and three-body chemical silicon coating could improve the bonding strength and remained stable after thermal cycling, while the bonding strength of the ethyl acetate treatment group decreased significantly.
研究比较了纳米颗粒对CAD-CAM铣削、3D打印及传统工艺制备的义齿基质树脂与硬: The study compared the effect of nanoparticles on the shear bonding strength between denture matrix resin and hard lining prepared by CAD-CAM milling, 3D printing and traditional processes. The results showed that nanoparticles reduced the bonding strength of CAD-CAM milling resin, but had no effect on the bonding strength of 3D printing and traditional resin.
研究比较了茶、咖啡和人工唾液对传统及数字牙托基质颜色稳定性与表面粗糙度的影响，发: The study compared the effects of tea, coffee, and artificial saliva on the color stability and surface roughness of traditional and digital dental tray matrices. It was found that 3D printing and cold polymerization materials were more prone to coloration and roughness, while thermal polymerization and CAD/CAM milling materials were more stable, and Corega cleaner was more effective than sodium hypochlorite in reducing discoloration.
研究比较了薄荷油和Polident清洁剂对3D打印PMMA义齿基托经15天浸泡后: The study compared the effects of peppermint oil and Polident detergent on the surface roughness, hardness and transverse strength of 3D printed PMMA denture bases after 15 days of immersion. The results showed that the Polident group had the highest surface roughness and hardness, while the peppermint oil group had the lowest transverse strength.
研究比较了过印与过模两种混合制造工艺对双层片剂微结构及药物释放的影响，结果显示过: The study compared the effects of two hybrid manufacturing processes, overprinting and overmolding, on the microstructure and drug release of double-layer tablets. The results showed that the overprinted tablet maintained a porous structure and exhibited Fickian diffusion release, which was affected by drug loading; the overmolded tablet had a dense structure due to polymer penetration, and the release mechanism shifted to non-Fickian diffusion-relaxation control, with drug loading dominating the performance.
研究比较了连续与传统批次FDM打印制备的芬氟拉明载药打印件，发现连续打印在低填充: The study compared fenfluramine-loaded printed parts prepared by continuous and traditional batch FDM printing. It was found that continuous printing significantly affects the fracture strength and in vitro release at low filling density, and the difference decreases as the filling density increases.
研究比较了选择性激光熔融制备的钴铬与钛合金与义齿树脂在不同 粘接 方法下的剪切结: The study compared the shear bonding strength of cobalt-chromium and titanium alloys prepared by selective laser melting and denture resin under different bonding methods. The results showed that the compression molding method was significantly better than the 4-META/MMA-TBB resin method under no thermal cycle conditions, and was better than the casting method in titanium alloys, suggesting that the compression molding method has potential.
研究比较了通过三喷技术打印的树脂与传统PMMA在正畸咬合垫制造中的力学性能，结果: The study compared the mechanical properties of resin printed by three-jet technology and traditional PMMA in the manufacture of orthodontic bite pads. The results showed that 3D printing materials are superior to traditional PMMA in performance and have clinical application potential.
研究比较了通过减材和增材制造方法制成的锆瓷冠在贴合度、硬度及表面特性方面的差异，: The study compared the differences in fit, hardness and surface properties of zirconium ceramic crowns made by subtractive and additive manufacturing methods. The results showed that both methods achieved clinically acceptable fit. The hardness and shear strength of some additive manufacturing groups were better than those of subtractive manufacturing. The surface showed a granular structure after sandblasting.
研究比较了通过增材制造生产的两种临时冠材料在不同饮品浸泡后的颜色变化，结果显示D: The study compared the color changes of two temporary crown materials produced through additive manufacturing after being soaked in different drinks. The results showed that the DentaFab material had worse color stability than the Formlabs material, especially in grape juice.
研究比较了通过热熔挤出结合3D打印制备的巴氯芬胃漂浮制剂，发现将HME制备的缓释: The study compared gastric floating preparations of baclofen prepared by hot melt extrusion combined with 3D printing. It was found that the formulation of sustained-release tablets prepared by HME embedded in the 3D printed gastric floating device was more reliable than the gastric floating tablets directly printed with low filling rate and could continue to float for more than 12 hours, which was confirmed by rabbit X-ray imaging.
研究比较了通过热熔挤出（HME）和浸渍（IMP）法加载吲哚美辛的丝材，发现IMP: The study compared wires loaded with indomethacin through hot melt extrusion (HME) and impregnation (IMP) methods. It was found that the IMP method wires have low drug content and release quickly, the HME method low-content wires also release quickly, and the high-content HME wires extend the release to 24 hours due to the swelling-erosion process. The drug loading method significantly affects the drug release behavior.
研究比较了采用增材制造和热固化工艺制成的义齿基托在形状精度和固位力方面的差异，结: The study compared the differences in shape accuracy and retention of denture bases made using additive manufacturing and thermal curing processes. The results showed that the additive manufacturing base was superior to the thermal curing base in terms of accuracy and retention.
研究比较了采用选择性激光熔融（SLM）技术与传统铸造法制作的钴铬合金卡环在不同牙: The study compared the fitting accuracy and retention force of cobalt-chromium alloy clasps made by selective laser melting (SLM) technology and traditional casting methods on different alveolar models. The results showed that there was no significant difference in fitting accuracy and initial retention force between the two methods. The residual retention force of the SLM clasp was higher after 7200 insertion and withdrawal cycles.
研究比较了铣削、3D打印和传统工艺制作的临时冠，结果显示3D打印临时冠在边缘密合: The study compared temporary crowns made by milling, 3D printing and traditional processes, and the results showed that 3D printed temporary crowns performed best in terms of edge adhesion and color stability.
研究比较了铣削一体式义齿牙与基托、3D打印义齿牙与基托及传统义齿牙与基托的粘接强: The study compared the bonding strength of milled one-piece denture teeth and base, 3D printed denture teeth and base, and traditional denture teeth and base. The results showed that the bonding strength of the milling group before and after thermal cycle was significantly higher than that of the traditional group, and there was no significant difference between the three groups after thermal cycle. The bonding strength of the traditional group decreased significantly.
