研究比较了铣削与3D打印两种工艺制备的三种复合牙冠材料在不同咬合厚度下的边缘适应: The study compared the edge adaptability and fracture resistance of three composite crown materials prepared by milling and 3D printing processes under different occlusal thicknesses. The results showed that 3D printed crowns were superior to milling materials in edge adaptability and could still withstand normal occlusal forces at an occlusal thickness of 0.8 mm.
研究比较了铣削与3D打印临时树脂的弯曲强度和维卡硬度，结果显示铣削树脂的弯曲强度: The study compared the flexural strength and Vicat hardness of milling and 3D printing temporary resins. The results showed that the flexural strength of milling resin was significantly higher than that of 3D printing resin, and its Vicat hardness was better than that of 3D printing resin, while 3D printing resin was inferior to both indicators in both indicators.
研究比较了铣削与3D打印技术制作的种植手术导板在三维精度上的差异，结果显示铣削技: The study compared the difference in three-dimensional accuracy of implant surgery guides produced by milling and 3D printing technology. The results showed that milling technology was slightly better than 3D printing, and the average surface distance and axial and linear deviations were smaller.
研究比较了铣削和3D打印牙科树脂表面C. albicans生物膜形成情况，结果显: The study compared the formation of C. albicans biofilm on the surfaces of milled and 3D printed dental resins. The results showed that the amount of biofilm in the milled resin group was significantly higher than that in the control group, while the 3D printing group was in between. More fungal pseudohyphae appeared on the 3D printed surface, suggesting that it is potentially more pathogenic.
研究比较了银纳米颗粒、骨生成因子、氧化锌和磷酸钙纳米颗粒四种添加剂对3D打印PC: The study compared the effects of four additives, silver nanoparticles, osteogenesis factors, zinc oxide and calcium phosphate nanoparticles, on the mechanical properties and osteoblast biocompatibility of 3D printed PCL scaffolds. The results showed that zinc oxide significantly improved the mechanical properties and supported cell survival, and calcium phosphate nanoparticles performed best in terms of early cell survival, providing a basis for material selection in different bone regeneration application scenarios.
研究比较了铸造、硬金属铣削、软金属铣削、选择性激光熔融和选择性激光烧结等CAD/: The study compared the edge, axial and occlusal fit differences of cobalt-chromium crowns prepared by CAD/CAM technologies such as casting, hard metal milling, soft metal milling, selective laser melting and selective laser sintering before and after firing. The results showed that the fit improved after firing, and the fit of selective laser sintering and soft metal milling methods was better than other methods.
研究比较了阿托伐他汀在聚己内酯（PCL）和聚乳酸（PLA）基质中的释放行为，通过: The study compared the release behavior of atorvastatin in polycaprolactone (PCL) and polylactic acid (PLA) matrices. The filaments were prepared and characterized by hot melt extrusion. The results showed that the release amount of PCL-atorvastatin filaments at 8 hours was 12% higher than that of PLA-atorvastatin filaments, and the release process conformed to the Korsmeyer-Peppas model.
研究比较单药和双药系统。含两种抗生素的水凝胶对实验中的耐药金黄色葡萄球菌有效，而: Studies comparing single-drug and two-drug systems. The hydrogel containing two antibiotics was effective against drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in the experiment, while the rifampin-alone system showed resistance selection. As a result, release design must consider both drug combination and microbiota response.
研究比较术前设计和实际植入位置，并追踪一年迁移。研究将设计目标从“填补空缺”转化: The study compared preoperative design and actual implant location and followed migration for one year. Research transforms design goals from “filling a gap” to testable position and stability
研究比较构建方向及热等静压、喷砂、抛光、化学蚀刻的组合，发现延性、疲劳和细胞表现: The study compared build orientation and combinations of hot isostatic pressing, sandblasting, polishing, and chemical etching and found that ductility, fatigue, and cell behavior changed with processing. Post-processing doesn't just improve the appearance, it redefines the material and surface condition. The research chain therefore needs to extend from printing parameters to final processing combinations
研究比较连续与脉冲激光扫描，以及热等静压、喷砂和化学蚀刻的组合。连续扫描在所研究: Studies comparing continuous versus pulsed laser scanning, as well as combinations of hot isostatic pressing, sand blasting, and chemical etching. Continuous scanning has fewer defects and higher fatigue resistance under the studied conditions, and pulse scanning forms a more uniform microstructure; the optimized post-processing combination further improves fatigue performance
研究氮气后固化及打印机类型对3D打印硬咬合垫材料机械性能和表面光滑度的影响，结果: Studying the effects of nitrogen post-curing and printer type on the mechanical properties and surface smoothness of 3D printed hard bite pad materials, the results show that nitrogen environment and LCD printer can improve the mechanical properties and surface smoothness of the material.
研究测试了多种消毒方法对四种3D打印医疗外科口罩材料的病毒灭活效果，结果显示含氯: The study tested the virus inactivation effect of various disinfection methods on four 3D printed medical surgical mask materials. The results showed that chlorine bleach, quaternary ammonium salts, hydrogen peroxide and 70°C dry heat for 30 minutes can completely inactivate SARS-CoV-2 and a variety of RNA and DNA viruses, while 70% isopropyl alcohol is less effective, and all methods do not damage the material structure.
研究深化的关键在于连续评价。短期细胞活性或抗菌表现能够筛选材料，持续的创面闭合、: The key to further research lies in continuous evaluation. Short-term cell activity or antibacterial performance can screen materials, while sustained wound closure, tissue quality and recurrence determine the significance of treatment.
研究深度也由拟合准确度扩展到实际使用条件：模型在不同批次、设备和场所是否保持表现: The depth of research also extends from fitting accuracy to actual use conditions: whether the model maintains performance in different batches, equipment and locations, and how to take action when abnormalities occur
研究深度正在向缺损环境推进：细胞可进入不等于完整缺损能够稳定修复，组织进入还受到: The depth of research is advancing into the defect environment: cell entry does not mean that the complete defect can be stably repaired. Tissue entry is also affected by fixation, periosteum, blood supply and soft tissue closure. Complications in large animal models illustrate that further optimization cannot just change the ceramic content or porosity, but also requires the simultaneous design of the connection method between the surgery and the stent.
研究深度正由“能否打印成一体”推进到“哪些误差被消除、哪些问题转移到其他环节”。: The depth of research is advancing from "whether printing can be integrated" to "which errors are eliminated and which problems are transferred to other links." Monolithic manufacturing reduces assembly variables while placing more control requirements on print materials, supports, curing and final finishing
研究混合形式如何影响不同知识任务: Investigate how hybrid formats impact different knowledge tasks
研究演变表现为抗菌功能逐渐嵌入打印结构和修复流程: Research evolution shows that antibacterial functions are gradually embedded into printed structures and repair processes
研究激光粉末床融合工艺制备的钴铬钼和钛合金牙科植入物，通过不同方向成型并检测力学: Research on cobalt-chromium-molybdenum and titanium alloy dental implants prepared by laser powder bed fusion process, molding in different directions and testing the mechanical properties and microstructure. The results show that the two alloys have high strength, good ductility, density and no significant secondary anisotropy. The performance is consistent with the data table value, regardless of the molding direction.
研究激光粉末床融合技术制造的钴铬合金可摘局部义齿的设计验证，重点确立义齿与牙体的: Study the design verification of cobalt-chromium alloy removable partial dentures manufactured by laser powder bed fusion technology, focusing on establishing the matching requirements between dentures and teeth to ensure patient comfort and product reliability.
研究激光选区熔融制备的Zn-0.8Cu合金，发现垂直方向样品因CuZn4析出更密: Studying the Zn-0.8Cu alloy prepared by laser selective melting, it was found that the vertical sample has higher strength due to denser CuZn4 precipitation, but is more corrosive; the horizontal sample has smaller corrosion due to finer grains and reduced precipitation, and shows good cell proliferation ability.
研究热老化对实验3D打印义齿基台树脂复合材料物理力学性能及自修复能力的影响。: Study the effect of thermal aging on the physical and mechanical properties and self-healing ability of experimental 3D printed denture abutment resin composite materials.
研究焦点从设计一种尖针，转向控制实际针尖、材料和阵列的共同表现。打印方向、固化和: The research focus shifts from designing a sharp needle to controlling how the actual needle tip, material, and array behave together. Print orientation, curing, and replication errors all begin to affect interpretation of results
研究焦点由单一设备的分辨率，转向支撑、导板设计与操作的系统关系。体外制造评价和临: The focus of research has shifted from the resolution of a single device to the systematic relationship between support, guide plate design and operation. In vitro manufacturing evaluation and clinical site evaluation begin to be compared in the same process
研究焦点由疫情初期的快速替代，转向解释整机为何成功或失败。个体化扫描、人体适配测: The focus of research has shifted from rapid replacement in the early stages of the epidemic to explaining why the entire machine succeeds or fails. Personalized scanning, human body fit testing and bench airflow testing gradually form complementary links
研究用产品支持基础评价的重复性: Research products support reproducibility of basic assessments
研究用手机提供照明和图像采集，通过打印适配器连接商用光学与可调透镜，演示荧光微球: A research mobile phone provides illumination and image acquisition, and a printed adapter connects commercial optics and adjustable lenses to demonstrate optical sectioning of fluorescent microspheres. Printing assumes the assembly interface, and optical slicing comes from the entire optical path and method combination.
研究由“儿童是否喜欢打印药物”，发展为“特定治疗中如何可靠地服用合适剂量”。实际: The study evolved from "whether children like printed medications" to "how to reliably take the appropriate dose for a specific treatment." Actual swallowing, rare disease metabolic control, dosing times and tube feeding dispersion become different research paths
研究由低成本机械替代发展为可扩展成像平台，随后进入制造维护和任务评价。开放文件使: Research progressed from low-cost mechanical replacement to scalable imaging platforms and subsequently into manufacturing maintenance and mission evaluation. Open documentation makes technology dissemination easier, but practical use requires reliable software, documentation and calibration processes
研究由便携采集扩展到采集、处理和辅助判断的一体化。手机不仅是相机，也逐渐成为计算: Research has expanded from portable collection to the integration of collection, processing and assisted judgment. Mobile phones are not only cameras, but also increasingly computing and communication nodes
研究由几何主导的单芯片演示，延伸到材料、泵送和传感协同。提高通量与维持均一性成为: Research into geometry-led single-chip demonstrations extends to materials, pumping and sensing collaboration. Improving throughput and maintaining uniformity become two sides of the same design problem
研究由单个小型传感器，发展为采样、流动、反应与读出的连续流程。被动驱动和手机读出: Research has evolved from a single small sensor to a continuous process of sampling, flow, reaction and readout. Passive driving and mobile phone readout respectively reduce the need for different external devices, and both also introduce new issues of material stability and configuration consistency.
研究由单功能检测走向前处理、反应和读出的连续集成，目标也从模型分子扩展到患者样本: Research has moved from single-function detection to continuous integration of pre-processing, reaction and readout, and the target has also expanded from model molecules to patient samples or microbial responses.
研究由单机自动动作发展为跨设备流程，打印定制接口与开放软件共同降低集成门槛。在线: Research has evolved from stand-alone automatic actions to cross-device processes. Print customization interfaces and open software jointly lower the integration threshold. Online sensing further connects execution with observation
研究由单纯改变药物载入，发展到结构、保护、输注或溶解的系统协同。主动中空系统强调: Research has progressed from simply changing drug loading to systemic synergies of structure, protection, infusion or dissolution. Active hollow systems emphasize flow and control, soluble microneedles emphasize material and drug-loaded distribution, and coating routes emphasize stability and surface release.
研究由单纯选择酸碱敏感材料，发展到多材料结构、活性保护和混合制造。胃滞留与肠道定: Research has evolved from simply selecting acid-base sensitive materials to multi-material structures, active protection and hybrid manufacturing. Gastric retention and intestinal localization are advancing in parallel, but they require different in vivo evaluation methods
研究由原型可灭菌逐步转向处理后尺寸、适配与机械性能的联合评价。定制器械形态更复杂: Research has gradually shifted from prototype sterilization to joint evaluation of post-process size, fit and mechanical properties. As the shapes of customized instruments become more complex, it is no longer possible to cover local thin walls, guide holes, and load-bearing connections by testing only standard test strips.
研究由开放零件图纸推进到开放实验系统。控制软件、操作协议、校准和维护知识逐步与硬: Research advances from open part drawings to open experimental systems. Control software, operating protocols, calibration and maintenance knowledge gradually become the outcome along with the hardware
研究由患者形态可制造，推进到特定物理条件和完整流程验证。静态、动态、外照射及核医: Research proceeds from patient-form manufacturability to specific physical conditions and complete process validation. Static, dynamic, external radiation and nuclear medicine tasks form different technical branches
研究由整体外形复制转向任务相关的内部结构表达，并开始结合动态功能。教学与规划资料: Research shifted from overall appearance replication to task-related internal structural expression, and began to incorporate dynamic functions. Teaching and planning materials show that the effective amount of information in a model depends on layering, windowing and interactivity, not just printing accuracy.
研究由样机功能展示发展为多层次验证：材料和结构、物理输出、分析结果、实际任务依次: The research has developed from prototype functional demonstration to multi-level verification: materials and structures, physical output, analysis results, and actual tasks are connected in sequence. Open design helps with reconstruction, independent reference and configuration records help explain differences
研究由疫情初期的快速原型转向更系统的性能描述，台架条件、耐久和动物验证逐渐得到重: Research has shifted from rapid prototyping in the early stages of the epidemic to more systematic performance description, and bench conditions, durability and animal verification have gradually received attention. Different solutions use different driving and pneumatic circuit principles, and the maturity should be compared according to the verification steps.
研究的发展有两条相交路径：一条从开源结构进入主动驱动和精细抓握；另一条从单件定制: The development of research has two intersecting paths: one from open source architecture into active drive and fine grasping; the other from single-piece customization into the collection, design and delivery process in the hospital. The former broadens functionality, while the latter determines whether the service can reach users.
研究的变化不是单纯增加生物活性成分，而是把细胞反应放入空间与时间之中。结构优化改: The changes studied are not simply adding bioactive ingredients, but putting cellular responses into space and time. Structural optimization improves the locations accessible to cells, microspheres and hydrogels change the timing of signal emergence, cellular and molecular analysis explains reaction pathways, and animal defects further examine tissue formation.
研究的评价对象由单次打印结果扩展为制造链。直接打印需要控制曝光、清洗和固化，复制: The evaluation object of the study is expanded from single printing results to manufacturing chain. Direct printing needs to control exposure, cleaning and curing, and the replication route also needs to handle filling, demoulding and material shrinkage.
研究直接金属激光烧结Ti-6Al-4V植入物，通过不同后处理（如高温热等静压）改: Research on direct metal laser sintering Ti-6Al-4V implants and improving their corrosion behavior through different post-processing (such as high-temperature hot isostatic pressing). The results show that after hot isostatic pressing at 799°C, the corrosion resistivity of the sample increased and the corrosion behavior was significantly improved.
研究真实打印牙修复混合材料比较胶粘策略，复合材料为打印试验组而非铣削对照；工艺局: Study the comparative adhesion strategy of mixed materials for real printed tooth restorations. The composite materials are the printing test group rather than the milling control; the process is not clear
研究立体光刻3D打印片剂几何形状对其药物释放特性的影响。: Study the effect of stereolithography 3D printed tablet geometry on its drug release characteristics.
研究粘接系统对3D打印聚合物临时固定义齿修复体长期性能的影响。: To study the effect of bonding systems on the long-term performance of 3D printed polymer temporary fixed denture restorations.
研究系统筛选了156种光聚合物配方，评估了光引发剂用量、聚合物分子量及液态填料类: The research systematically screened 156 photopolymer formulations and evaluated the effects of photoinitiator dosage, polymer molecular weight, and liquid filler type and dosage on the printability of SLA 3D printing drugs. It was clearly shown that these formula factors affect the printing quality of the final formulation.
研究纯氧化铝与氧化锆粉末的选区激光熔融，通过高温CO₂激光预热避免裂纹，制得致密: Study the selective laser melting of pure alumina and zirconia powder, avoid cracks through high-temperature CO₂ laser preheating, and produce dense net-shape ceramics with a fracture strength of over 500 MPa, which can meet the load of more than 1000 N required for all-ceramic tooth restoration frames.
研究结果应以原论文为准，公告只作企业参与与流程证据。: The research results should be based on the original paper, and the announcement is only used as evidence of corporate participation and process.
研究考察了不同药物负载和羟丙基甲基纤维素分子量对含泼尼松与HPMC二元混合物3D: The study examined the effects of different drug loads and molecular weights of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose on the three-dimensional structure of 3D printed tablets containing a binary mixture of prednisone and HPMC. The results showed that the tablets in the HPMC 15LV group had lower total porosity, smaller pore diameter, and the structure was closer to the design model. The drug load had less impact on the porosity.
研究者为应对新冠疫情下出车环境中的气溶胶传播风险，设计并测试了患者粒子 cont: In order to deal with the risk of aerosol transmission in the car environment during the COVID-19 epidemic, researchers designed and tested the patient particle containment chamber (PPCC). The device is made of common materials and can effectively intercept 99% of spray paint particles. It is portable, easy to clean, and compatible with emergency stretchers.
研究者为解决耳鼻喉科医生在使用头灯进行检查时面屏不兼容的问题，设计并试用了一种可: In order to solve the problem of visor incompatibility when otolaryngologists use headlights for examinations, researchers designed and tried out a 3D-printable headlight visor adapter. The device can stably install a transparent protective sheet. It has performed well after testing with 7 types of headlights. During use, doctors believe that it can effectively protect against droplets, blood and other liquids, and improve the safety of diagnosis and treatment.
研究者使用优化的可重复使用的3D打印胆总管囊模型，评估不同经验水平外科医生在腹腔: Researchers used an optimized reusable 3D printed common bile duct sac model to evaluate the operating time and scores of surgeons with different experience levels in laparoscopic and robotic cholangiojejunostomy. The results showed that there was a significant difference in experience. Repeated training can significantly shorten the operating time and improve scores, and the performance of the robotic platform is basically consistent with laparoscopic skills.
研究者利用 vat 多材料 3D 打印技术构建集成微流控网络的细胞培养装置，用于: Researchers use vat multi-material 3D printing technology to build a cell culture device integrated with a microfluidic network to support precise control of the cell culture environment.
研究者利用3D打印和压缩弯曲等微加工技术，构建微流控与生物电子三维接口，实现对器: Researchers use micro-machining technologies such as 3D printing and compression bending to build a three-dimensional interface between microfluidics and bioelectronics to achieve non-invasive manipulation and monitoring of organ tissue models and improve their culture stability and reproducibility.
研究者利用3D打印技术制作了模拟主动脉狭窄和二尖瓣反流的心脏解剖模型，通过CAD: The researchers used 3D printing technology to create a heart anatomy model that simulates aortic stenosis and mitral regurgitation. It was designed and printed using CAD software to accurately present the morphological and functional changes of heart valve diseases and provide intuitive and accurate teaching aids for medical morphophysiology teaching.
研究者利用3D打印技术制作亚马逊地区三种常用药用植物（Andiroba、Buri: Researchers used 3D printing technology to create seed and fruit models of three commonly used medicinal plants in the Amazon (Andiroba, Buriti, and Tucumã) as teaching tools to help students understand the relationship between plant morphology and medicinal value by visualizing their anatomical structures and enhance their interest in learning traditional knowledge.
研究者利用3D打印技术制备了微结构对齐的微流控装置，成功在该平台上诱导C2C12: The researchers used 3D printing technology to prepare a microfluidic device with microstructure alignment, and successfully induced the directional differentiation of C2C12 mouse muscle cells into aligned myotubes on this platform, and observed an increase in myotube maturity under electrical pulse stimulation.
研究者利用3D打印技术定制药物剂型，通过聚合物屏障实现物理不相容药物的共载，实现: Researchers use 3D printing technology to customize pharmaceutical dosage forms and achieve co-loading of physically incompatible drugs through polymer barriers to achieve personalized drug delivery and improve the accuracy and customizability of pharmaceutical preparations.
研究者利用3D打印技术开发了具有复杂三维流道的皮肤贴附微流体装置“sweatai: Researchers used 3D printing technology to develop a skin-attached microfluidic device "sweatainer" with complex three-dimensional flow channels, which can achieve multiple independent sweat collections through multiple sampling methods and support in-situ analysis of biomarkers in sweat on site.
研究者利用3D打印技术，自行制作实验室常用设备，通过开放共享的设计蓝图和简易工具: Researchers use 3D printing technology to make their own commonly used laboratory equipment. Through open and shared design blueprints and simple tools, they can quickly build basic laboratory equipment at low cost and improve laboratory start-up efficiency.
研究者利用3D打印热塑性材料和现成部件，构建了具备压力反馈控制的低成本微流控注射: The researchers used 3D printed thermoplastic materials and ready-made components to build a low-cost microfluidic syringe pump system with pressure feedback control, achieving high-precision adjustment of the injection pressure of the microfluidic device through programmed control.
研究者利用3D打印的CT模拟物，验证和比较不同系统中放射组学特征的稳定性与可重复: Researchers used 3D printed CT simulators to verify and compare the stability and reproducibility of radiomic features in different systems to evaluate their reliability in clinical applications.
研究者利用3D打印胸腔模型，指导医学生学习胸腔解剖及各结构的空间关系，结果显示该: Researchers used 3D printed chest models to guide medical students in learning the anatomy of the chest and the spatial relationships of various structures. The results showed that this teaching method effectively improved students' understanding and mastery of the anatomy of the chest and its spatial relationships.
研究者利用3D生物打印与微流控芯片构建三维肝细胞培养平台，实现肝组织的连续灌注，: Researchers used 3D bioprinting and microfluidic chips to build a three-dimensional liver cell culture platform to achieve continuous perfusion of liver tissue to test drug responses more closely to the physiological state of the human body and provide a more reliable model for drug screening and inter-organ interaction research.
研究者利用三维打印技术制作低成本中耳训练模型，包含外耳道、锤骨模拟弹簧及镫骨底板: Researchers used 3D printing technology to create a low-cost middle ear training model, which includes the external auditory canal, malleus simulated spring and stapes base plate. The force exerted on the malleus was calculated through video recording and Hooke's law. Forces in the range of 1.2 to 5200 mN can be detected to achieve quantifiable operational training.
研究者利用两光子聚合技术制备了基于聚-N-丙烯酰基甘氨酸胺（PNAGA）的温敏水: The researchers used two-photon polymerization technology to prepare a thermosensitive hydrogel microrobot based on poly-N-acryloylglycinamine (PNAGA). PNAGA-100 showed the fastest expansion rate and drug release at 45°C, and could move along a predetermined path when driven by magnetic force, showing good biocompatibility and tumor treatment potential.
研究者利用人工智能、智能制造和量子计算技术，开发环保型金属有机框架（MOFs）用: Researchers use artificial intelligence, smart manufacturing and quantum computing technology to develop environmentally friendly metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) for drug delivery. By regulating their pore size and functional groups, they achieve targeted release, improve treatment accuracy, and reduce environmental impact.
研究者利用低成本3D打印微流控装置，对5例类风湿关节炎患者分离的滑膜组织进行单细: The researchers used a low-cost 3D printed microfluidic device to perform single-cell RNA sequencing on synovial tissue isolated from 5 patients with rheumatoid arthritis and identified 13 transcriptome clusters, including undescribed fibroblast subpopulations and their spatial distribution in the synovium.
研究者利用低成本高分辨率LCD 3D打印技术，制作了基于PLInk的器官芯片装置: The researchers used low-cost, high-resolution LCD 3D printing technology to create an organ-on-chip device based on PLINk, which was used to co-culture two spherical cell clusters and observe phenomena such as endothelial cell sprouting, cell rearrangement and migration.
研究者利用免费软件和面部扫描数据，为个体定制3D打印带P3滤材的口罩，通过Ble: The researchers used free software and facial scan data to customize 3D printed masks with P3 filter material for individuals. They modified the My Face Mask plug-in through Blender software to achieve a perfect fit between the mask and the face. Preliminary results show that the mask is comfortable to wear and adapts well.
研究者利用医学扫描与3D打印技术制作了模拟上肢骨骼和滑膜结构的定制化训练假体，由: The researchers used medical scanning and 3D printing technology to create a customized training prosthesis that simulates the upper limb bone and synovial structure. The resident trainees completed the traction reduction of distal radius fractures under the guidance of the residents. The results showed that the trainees could effectively complete the operation and recognized the feasibility of the prosthesis to replace the traditional cadaver model.
研究者利用家用设备和自制工具，通过喷墨打印光罩暴露干膜光刻胶，实现微流控通道的低: The researchers used household equipment and homemade tools to expose dry film photoresist through inkjet printing masks to achieve low-cost and rapid preparation of microfluidic channels. The resolution of the resulting rectangular and spiral channels is better than that of SLA 3D printing, and can be used for the assembly of multi-layer microfluidic devices.
研究者利用开源CAD-CAM软件，基于三维骨缺损模型设计并3D打印个性化钛网，用: The researchers used open source CAD-CAM software to design and 3D print a personalized titanium mesh based on a three-dimensional bone defect model to guide bone regeneration. After being covered with autologous and allogeneic bone grafts and membranes, the titanium mesh achieved bone regeneration and implant stability without any mesh exposure.
研究者利用开源CAD软件结合3D打印技术，基于患者口扫数据设计并制作可堆叠的最终: The researchers used open source CAD software combined with 3D printing technology to design and produce a stackable final cast and model system based on the patient's oral scan data to add a new crown to the existing removable partial denture. This can be completed without the patient having to remove the denture, which is low-cost and easy to operate.
研究者利用消费级3D打印机和低成本旋涂装置制备了多种 planoconvex 镜: Researchers used consumer-grade 3D printers and low-cost spin-coating devices to prepare a variety of planoconvex lenses, and compared them with commercial glass lenses. Through high-resolution interference reflection microscopy and optical transmission tests, they found that the curvature and optical performance of 3D printed lenses are equivalent, and can be used in bright-field transmission microscopy to achieve subcellular structure imaging.
研究者利用锥形束CT与移动设备获取的面部扫描数据，结合现有牙科种植软件模拟颞下颌: The researchers used facial scan data acquired by cone beam CT and mobile devices, combined with existing dental implant software to simulate the temporomandibular joint and lateral pterygoid muscle injection points, to design and 3D print additional oral templates to achieve precise injection positioning of specific anatomical structures.
研究者利用高精度3D打印技术，将香蕉叶与牙线纤维结合，并添加塑料回收物，制成具有: Researchers used high-precision 3D printing technology to combine banana leaves with dental floss fibers, and added plastic recycling to create a biodegradable mask TRespirator with similar protective properties to N95. Its fiber degradation process can accelerate the decomposition of microplastics.
研究者制备了54种钛合金TPMS蜂窝结构，通过压缩测试发现其力学性能随壁厚和单元: The researchers prepared 54 types of titanium alloy TPMS honeycomb structures. Through compression tests, they found that their mechanical properties change with wall thickness and unit size. Different topological structures have differences in energy absorption and deformation stability, and deviate from the Gibson-Ashby scale when the relative density is higher than 0.45. A framework integrating multi-criteria decision-making methods is proposed to guide patient-specific implant design.
研究者制备了不同涂层浓度与体积的Dipyridamole包被3D打印β-TCP支: The researchers prepared Dipyridamole-coated 3D printed β-TCP scaffolds with different coating concentrations and volumes, and systematically evaluated their drug release behavior. They found that release could only be measured at a concentration of 1000 µM, and the release of porous scaffolds was significantly affected by volume. The release of solid scaffolds was limited to the surface, and the drug release showed biphasic characteristics. The hydrophilicity of the scaffold surface did not change significantly, and the cell viability changed with the change of coating volume.
研究者回顾发现，纳米颗粒与微针结合系统虽能有效将药物递送至皮肤真皮层，但受限于监: Researchers reviewed and found that although the combination of nanoparticles and microneedles can effectively deliver drugs to the dermis layer of the skin, its clinical translation is still limited due to regulatory frameworks; 3D printing and microfluidic technology are expected to accelerate its clinical application.
研究者在新冠疫情背景下，利用3D打印技术在家自行制作面罩，以ABS材料通过Gtm: In the context of the COVID-19 epidemic, researchers used 3D printing technology to make face masks at home, using ABS materials through a Gtmax3D Core H5 printer. It took a total of 3 hours and 44 minutes, proving that this method is feasible and low-cost.
研究者在模拟颅内血管模型的假体中，对比了高分辨率成像模式与常规模式下对脑动脉瘤介: The researchers compared the visualization effect of the cerebral aneurysm interventional treatment device under high-resolution imaging mode and conventional mode in a prosthesis that simulated an intracranial blood vessel model. Both blind evaluation experts believed that the high-resolution mode image was clearer, better, and consistent.
研究者基于3D打印技术构建了具有解剖真实几何结构和连续可变颅骨电阻分布的头模，通: Based on 3D printing technology, the researchers constructed a head model with an anatomically realistic geometric structure and a continuously variable skull resistance distribution. By layering different resistance materials to print different resistance materials, the skull resistance simulation was achieved. The resistance value of this head model is close to and stable with human tissue, effectively supporting experimental research on electrical brain impedance imaging.
研究者基于3D打印组件和摄像头构建了一款便携式低成本荧光显微镜，具备明场和荧光成: Researchers built a portable, low-cost fluorescence microscope based on 3D printed components and cameras. It has brightfield and fluorescence imaging capabilities. Its performance is comparable to that of a laboratory-grade microscope. It can be used for meat product authenticity detection, showing its application potential in resource-constrained environments and remote medicine.
研究者基于CT影像数据，通过图像分割、网格优化和3D打印流程，制作了肋骨、肝脏和: Based on CT image data, the researchers created patient-specific anatomical models of ribs, liver and lungs through image segmentation, mesh optimization and 3D printing processes, demonstrating the feasibility of this process to achieve efficient and low-cost model production without expert knowledge.
研究者基于CT数据制作了5例髋臼骨折的3D打印模型，比较了不同打印方法在骨折碎片: The researchers produced 3D printing models of 5 cases of acetabular fractures based on CT data, and compared the differences in fracture fragment representation and overall accuracy between different printing methods. The results showed that the high-cost resin printer model performed more accurately in the fracture area, while the low-cost method model had lower accuracy.
研究者基于HiLo技术，设计了一款集成智能手机的低成本光学分层显微镜，通过3D打: Based on HiLo technology, the researchers designed a low-cost optical layered microscope that integrates a smartphone. It connects the mobile phone's light source and lens through a 3D printed adapter, uses an electrically adjustable lens to achieve axial scanning, and obtains an axial resolution of 11.7 microns. It successfully achieves high-contrast imaging and multi-layer structure observation of fluorescent microspheres. The cost of this system is lower than that of the traditional HiLo system.
研究者基于OpenFlexure组件和非无穷校正物镜，构建了低成本、开源的3D打: Based on OpenFlexure components and non-infinity corrected objective lenses, researchers built a low-cost, open-source 3D printed open Fourier spectroscopy microscope OpenFPM, which achieves resolution improvement from 870nm to 388nm and supports six imaging modes.
研究者基于放射学数据制作了6个胸腰段患者特异性脊柱假体，由住院医师在训练中完成5: The researchers produced 6 thoracolumbar patient-specific spinal prostheses based on radiological data, and residents completed the implantation of 57 pedicle screws during training. The results showed that the implantation time tended to be stable, and evaluation by experts and trainees confirmed that it had good validity and learning effects during training.
研究者基于活字印刷理念，开发了3D自由组装模块化微流控系统，通过模块化模具组合实: Based on the concept of movable type printing, the researchers developed a 3D free-assembly modular microfluidic system. They achieved double-layer structure manufacturing through modular mold combinations and integrated functional modules such as fluid control, droplet operation, and cell capture. They supported the on-demand installation of valves, light sources, and microscope cameras. They successfully constructed systems such as concentration gradient generation, droplet microfluidics, and drug screening, achieving rapid prototyping and small-batch production of microfluidic platforms.
研究者基于犬第五至第七腰椎、骶骨和骨盆的三维扫描与3D打印，制作了用于教学的三维: The researchers created a three-dimensional anatomical model for teaching based on three-dimensional scanning and 3D printing of the fifth to seventh lumbar vertebrae, sacrum and pelvis of dogs. After watching the video, 20 veterinary students were divided into groups for training. The model group was trained before clinical operations. The results showed that the model group was significantly less difficult to perform lumbosacral epidural anesthesia than the control group.
研究者基于贻贝粘附特性，制备了含羧甲基纤维素与多巴胺的PVA水凝胶微针，并结合3: Based on the adhesion properties of mussels, researchers prepared PVA hydrogel microneedles containing carboxymethyl cellulose and dopamine, combined with 3D printed polyurethane mesh, to repair full-thickness abdominal wall defects in rats. The results showed that the hydrogel mesh had good mechanical properties and adhesion, promoted the growth of granulation tissue and inhibited inflammatory reactions.
研究者基于鱼类来源明胶开发新型光响应生物树脂，通过光刻3D打印制备高分辨率含复杂: The researchers developed a new type of light-responsive bioresin based on fish-derived gelatin and prepared a high-resolution hydrogel structure containing complex microchannels through photolithographic 3D printing, achieving single-pixel resolution (about 50 μm) and cell-friendly printing. They successfully constructed a perfusable microchannel structure with a three-dimensional branch network, which is superior to traditional extrusion printing technology.
研究者审查了2020至2024年间采用增材制造技术的骨科手术植入物临床研究，重点: The researchers reviewed clinical studies of orthopedic surgical implants using additive manufacturing technology between 2020 and 2024, focusing on evaluating the application of patient-specific design and finite element analysis to virtually predict implant performance, as well as implant response in actual use.
研究者对多种全脸呼吸器面具进行定量测试，通过3D打印适配器安装商用颗粒滤材，一种: The researchers conducted quantitative tests on a variety of full-face respirator masks and installed commercial particulate filter media through 3D printed adapters. An improved design met the U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration's full-face respirator standards.
研究者对比了六种3D打印材料和工艺制作的颌骨模型，由五名经验丰富的颌面外科医生评: The researchers compared the jaw models produced by six 3D printing materials and processes, and had five experienced maxillofacial surgeons evaluate their tactile feedback. The results showed that the model based on material injection technology and acrylic resin had the best tactile feedback, and the other models could not fully simulate the touch of real bone tissue.
研究者对比了增强现实可视化与传统导航系统在口腔颌面手术中的应用，发现增强现实可使: Researchers compared the application of augmented reality visualization and traditional navigation systems in oral and maxillofacial surgery and found that augmented reality can shorten the navigation task completion time by 1.71 times and significantly improve the accuracy.
研究者对比传统显微镜与低成本3D打印显微镜对食管活检样本的检测效果，两名病理医生: The researchers compared the detection effects of traditional microscopes and low-cost 3D printed microscopes on esophageal biopsy samples. Two pathologists used physical slices and digital images obtained by the 3D printed microscope to evaluate. The results showed that the sensitivity and negative predictive value of both devices reached 100%, but there were differences in specificity and positive predictive value, and the observer who only viewed digital images had a lower predictive value.
研究者将数字光处理（DLP）3D打印与原子力显微镜结合，实时表征单个打印voxe: The researchers combined digital light processing (DLP) 3D printing with atomic force microscopy to characterize the mechanical heterogeneity of a single printed voxel during the molding process in real time. The mechanical properties, in-situ curing depth and local rheological changes of the resin were measured through three modes.
研究者将碳纳米管分散于聚合物中，制备具有电导性和机械强度的纳米复合支架，用于促进: Researchers dispersed carbon nanotubes in polymers to prepare nanocomposite scaffolds with electrical conductivity and mechanical strength to promote the differentiation of nerve, cardiac muscle, and bone cells. They also explored its potential in targeted cancer therapy, focusing on its cytotoxicity and electromagnetic stimulation response properties.
研究者开发了3D打印多孔微晶格鼻咽拭子，相比传统拭子，其样本释放更高效、浓度更高: Researchers have developed a 3D printed porous microlattice nasopharyngeal swab. Compared with traditional swabs, its sample release is more efficient, the concentration is higher, and the recovery rate is close to 100%, improving the sensitivity and accuracy of antibody detection.
研究者开发了一种低成本、便携式、开源的3D打印离心机（Mobilefuge），用: Researchers have developed a low-cost, portable, open-source 3D printed centrifuge (Mobilefuge) for LAMP detection of SARS-CoV-2 in saliva samples. The device can be built without professional skills, can be driven by common power sources such as mobile phones, and is suitable for resource-constrained areas.
研究者开发了一种可替换卵圆窝组件的仿人形假体，用于模拟经隔膜穿刺训练，四位资深心: The researchers developed a humanoid prosthesis with replaceable fossa ovale components to simulate transseptal puncture training. Four senior cardiologists and one fellow cardiologist performed the operation under X-ray and ultrasound guidance. The results showed that the more experienced, the more puncture points were concentrated in highly isotropic areas. Participants generally believed that its anatomical authenticity and image visualization effects were good.
研究者开发了一种可重复使用的自制腕关节超声模拟训练模型，采用3D打印骨骼与凝胶混: Researchers have developed a reusable homemade wrist joint ultrasound simulation training model, which is made of a mixture of 3D printed bone and gel. It has good ultrasound compatibility and can effectively help doctors identify key anatomical landmarks. It is suitable for clinical simulation environments with limited resources.
研究者开发了一种无需洁净室、由激光切割 丙烯酸树脂 和胶带构成的可重构微流控平台: The researchers developed a reconfigurable microfluidic platform that does not require a clean room and is composed of laser-cut acrylic resin and tape. It controls the capillary flow rate by adjusting the channel height, uses reversible sealing to achieve multi-functional switching of a single device, and supports different pump types to achieve two-phase flow and droplet generation.
研究者开发了一种集成BSA-Au纳米团簇探针的接触镜传感器，通过荧光检测泪液中抗: The researchers developed a contact lens sensor integrated with a BSA-Au nanocluster probe that detects ascorbic acid levels in tears through fluorescence to achieve real-time monitoring of ocular surface inflammation. The sensor has the advantages of high sensitivity, reusability, and portable detection.
研究者开发了低成本、模块化且快速3D打印的患者特异性解剖模型，通过磁性连接件实现: The researchers developed a low-cost, modular and fast 3D printed patient-specific anatomical model. The model is deployed in sections through magnetic connectors, which not only maintains the overall structural integrity but also intuitively displays the internal anatomy. Compared with existing solutions, the cost and efficiency are significantly improved, and the efficacy is equivalent.
研究者开发了可现场即时3D打印的鼻咽拭子，该设备采用生物相容性材料制成，能与现有: Researchers have developed a nasopharyngeal swab that can be 3D printed on-site. The device is made of biocompatible materials and can be seamlessly integrated with existing laboratory processes. Its test results are consistent with commercial nasopharyngeal swabs and can be effectively used for SARS-CoV-2 clinical sample detection.
研究者开发了基于羟丙基甲基纤维素的半固体3D打印墨水，通过添加PVP和SiO2及: The researchers developed a semi-solid 3D printing ink based on hydroxypropyl methylcellulose. By adding PVP, SiO2 and acetaminophen, they explored its impact on the rheological behavior and molding conformability of the ink, and verified the feasibility of the ink in layered printing.
研究者开发并评估了一种集成纺织压力传感单元的假肢套袜，通过硅胶仿生残肢测试，证实: The researchers developed and evaluated a prosthetic sock with an integrated textile pressure sensing unit. Through the silicone bionic residual limb test, it was confirmed that it can detect 5% of the maximum load change, has high repeatability, small drift, and can identify changes in pressure distribution during simulated gait. The results are similar to commonly used sensors.
研究者探讨了不同组成PHA在药物缓释、组织工程支架、神经修复导引及缝合材料中的应: The researchers explored the application of PHA with different compositions in drug sustained release, tissue engineering scaffolds, nerve repair guides and suture materials. High-purity PHA was prepared through microbial fermentation and combined with melt spinning, electrospinning and other technologies to achieve practical applications in the medical field.
研究者探讨了微流体与纳流体系统中受限流动的科学现象，回顾了从光刻到3D打印的制备: The researchers discussed the scientific phenomenon of restricted flow in microfluidic and nanofluidic systems, reviewed the preparation technology from photolithography to 3D printing, and used laboratory examples to demonstrate the application of microfluidics and microplasma in miniaturized analysis, clarifying their size limitations, ignition voltage and analysis feasibility. It is predicted that in the future, portable intelligent analysis equipment will integrate artificial intelligence and Internet of Things technology to realize chemical analysis of field samples.
研究者构建了一种低成本、可定制的3D打印灌注生物反应器，用于维持厘米级血管化组织: The researchers constructed a low-cost, customizable 3D-printed perfusion bioreactor to maintain centimeter-scale vascularized tissue in static or perfusion culture for several weeks. It achieved intermittent in vivo imaging and media sampling through reproducible PDMS components and glass coverslips, verifying its feasibility in vascularized hydrogel tissue culture.
研究者构建了受贻贝粘附机制启发的HA@TA-CS/SA三维打印支架，负载姜黄素纳: The researchers constructed a HA@TA-CS/SA three-dimensional printed scaffold inspired by the adhesion mechanism of mussels and loaded with curcumin nanoparticles. The scaffold showed efficient antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli in vitro. It has excellent mechanical properties, good degradation, mineralization and biocompatibility, and is suitable for bone defect repair.
研究者测试了多种商业 snorkel 面罩作为个人防护设备的贴合性、呼吸安全性和: Researchers tested the fit, respiratory safety, and practicality of a variety of commercial snorkel masks as personal protective equipment and found that they can provide protection similar to N95/FFP2 under appropriate size and filter material conditions, and can effectively control carbon dioxide accumulation, but attention must be paid to filter material selection and 3D adapter quality.
研究者结合三维锥束CT与CAD-CAM技术，通过虚拟规划和立体光刻模型，制作面部: Researchers combined three-dimensional cone beam CT and CAD-CAM technology to create digital guides and customized titanium plates for facial orthognathic surgery through virtual planning and stereolithography models to achieve precise osteotomy and fixation of the mandible, maxilla and chin in minimally invasive surgery.
研究者综述了3D生物打印技术构建多细胞器官芯片平台的方法、优势与局限，重点阐述其: The researchers reviewed the methods, advantages and limitations of 3D bioprinting technology to construct multi-cell organ-on-a-chip platforms, focusing on its application progress and prospects in simulating the structure and function of human organs and evaluating drug efficacy and toxicity.
研究者设计了N-末端八烷基修饰的肽类仿生水凝胶，通过疏水相互作用形成高度有序纳米: The researchers designed an N-terminal octalkyl-modified peptide biomimetic hydrogel to form a highly ordered nanosheet network through hydrophobic interactions to achieve biocompatibility, 3D printability and protease resistance. It supports the attachment, spreading and proliferation of NIH-3T3 fibroblasts, and maintains structural integrity and sustained drug release in a protease-rich environment.
研究者设计了一种仿生可打印关节，应用于单步3D打印的假手，该假手具备九个手指关节: The researchers designed a bionic printable joint for use in a single-step 3D printed prosthetic hand. The prosthetic hand has nine finger joints to achieve precise movements. It weighs about 255 grams, costs about $500, and takes about 6 minutes to assemble. It can complete basic grasping tasks for daily activities.
研究者设计并制备了集成生物相容性碳纤维电极的三维打印微流控底栖微生物燃料电池，通: The researchers designed and prepared a three-dimensional printed microfluidic benthic microbial fuel cell integrating biocompatible carbon fiber electrodes. By changing the microbial matrix, they evaluated its impact on power generation performance and verified the feasibility of the device in improving power output and scalability.
研究者设计并实现了GlasVent应急呼吸机，基于3D打印部件和常见材料，结合简: Researchers designed and implemented the GlasVent emergency ventilator, which is based on 3D printed parts and common materials, combined with simple electronic components. It can be operated by hand or leg without professional training, and is suitable for areas with limited resources and sudden respiratory support needs.
研究者设计并比较了柔性 fractal cut 微针贴片，通过DLP 3D打印实: The researchers designed and compared flexible fractal cut microneedle patches, which were manufactured with high precision and low cost through DLP 3D printing, and verified that their good fit, uniform penetration and skin coverage capabilities on complex skin geometries are superior to traditional rigid and continuous flexible patches.
研究者设计并测试了6种不同结构的3D打印抗病毒滤芯，与原商业滤芯对比，所有滤芯在: The researchers designed and tested 6 3D printed anti-viral filter elements with different structures. Compared with the original commercial filter elements, all filter elements met the requirements for ventilator use in terms of air leakage, compliance, peak inspiratory pressure and integrity, and the materials can be obtained from daily stores.
研究者设计并验证了一台全3D打印的低成本光学显微镜，采用3D打印支架与光学组件，: The researchers designed and verified a fully 3D printed low-cost optical microscope, using 3D printed brackets and optical components, combined with Raspberry Pi-controlled LED lighting, and using a single 3D printed objective lens with 2.9x magnification and a numerical aperture of 0.07 to image Giemsa-stained blood smears and hematoxylin-eosin-stained mouse kidney tissue sections, achieving subcellular resolution, demonstrating its feasibility and customizable potential in histological imaging.
研究者设计并验证了一种3D打印的骨软骨生物反应器，通过优化内部流道结构，实现单孔: The researchers designed and verified a 3D printed osteochondral bioreactor. By optimizing the internal flow channel structure, it can achieve efficient nutrition or drug delivery within a single-hole platform and ensure real-time observable drug exposure of cells.
研究者设计并验证了一种3D打印鼻咽拭子，其在新冠患者中与Copan FLOQSw: Researchers designed and verified a 3D printed nasopharyngeal swab, which has a good correlation with RT-PCR cycle thresholds in COVID-19 patients compared with Copan FLOQSwab, with overall positive and negative compliance rates of 90.6% and 100% respectively.
研究者设计并验证了一种无需外部仪器、可实现多组分顺序释放的π型扩散自由毛细阀，通: The researchers designed and verified a π-type diffusion-free capillary valve that can achieve sequential release of multiple components without external instruments. The two fluids are separated by a 3D structure and cavity, effectively avoiding cross-contamination and diffusion, and successfully achieving pre-programmed, diffusion-free release of three solutions in the microfluidic chip.
研究者评估了3D打印模型在解剖教学中的应用，发现学生普遍满意且评价良好，尽管各子: Researchers evaluated the application of 3D printed models in anatomy teaching and found that students were generally satisfied and rated it well. Although there was no statistical difference in the test scores of each subgroup, there are still challenges in terms of cost, materials, authenticity, and durability of the models.
研究者通过在ABS材料中掺入不同浓度的铋（1.2–2.7 g/cm³），制备出具: Researchers prepared radio-opaque 3D printing materials by incorporating different concentrations of bismuth (1.2–2.7 g/cm³) into ABS materials. They found that 1.2 g/cm³ bismuth can simulate the X-ray density of bone tissue, and 2.7 g/cm³ bismuth can attenuate 50% of technetium-99m gamma rays at a wall thickness of 2.0 mm. It has been successfully used to make craniofacial anatomy prostheses and shielding experimental stands.
研究者通过密度泛函理论和分子动力学计算，分析3D打印微流体器件的打印材料，以优化: Researchers used density functional theory and molecular dynamics calculations to analyze the printing materials of 3D printed microfluidic devices to optimize their performance in sweat analysis and improve the device's manufacturability, cost-effectiveness and analysis efficiency.
研究者通过微流控模拟与实验验证，考察了200μm covarine微珠在先进美白: Through microfluidic simulation and experimental verification, the researchers examined the behavior of 200 μm covarine microbeads when mixed with artificial and real saliva in advanced whitening toothpaste. Combining optical profilometer and electrical impedance spectroscopy analysis, they clarified the dynamic process of microfilm formation on the enamel surface.
研究者通过集成特征化设计软件的3D打印与软光刻结合方法，构建微流控器件，利用参数: The researchers built microfluidic devices by integrating 3D printing and soft lithography with characterization design software. They used parametric module design and single-step printing, and used bridge structures to span planar channels to achieve rapid and accurate manufacturing of microfluidic architectures.
研究者采用3D打印制备了PCL-PLGA复合材料圆柱支架，通过静态与动态条件下的: The researchers used 3D printing to prepare a PCL-PLGA composite cylindrical stent. They evaluated its degradation behavior through in vitro hydrolysis experiments under static and dynamic conditions, combined with XPS, GPC, SEM and other methods. The results showed that the dynamic fluid environment significantly accelerated the hydrolytic degradation of the stent.
研究者采用3D打印技术制作了MRI兼容的男性骨盆假体，模拟前列腺和股骨头，用于测: The researchers used 3D printing technology to create an MRI-compatible male pelvic prosthesis, simulating the prostate and femoral head, for testing scans and evaluating the impact of magnetic resonance scan noise on the reproducibility of radiomics features.
研究者采用3D打印技术制备微流控芯片，包括X型、Y型及侧向流动芯片，实现与生物传: Researchers use 3D printing technology to prepare microfluidic chips, including X-shaped, Y-shaped and lateral flow chips, to achieve integration with biosensors, replacing traditional methods and overcoming problems such as high cost, complex operations, and long time consumption.
研究者采用3D打印技术构建了基于石墨烯纳米复合材料的COVID-19免疫传感器，: The researchers used 3D printing technology to construct a COVID-19 immunosensor based on graphene nanocomposite materials. The recombinant new coronavirus protein was covalently anchored on the electrode surface through surface engineering, and impedance was used to detect its competition with monoclonal antibodies to achieve electronic readout. The sensor showed good linear response and low detection limit in both buffer and human serum.
研究者采用3D打印显微镜结合单分子计数技术，检测帕金森病患者脑脊液中的α-突触核: Researchers used 3D printing microscopes combined with single-molecule counting technology to detect α-synuclein aggregates in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients with Parkinson's disease, clarify their differences between patients and controls, and achieve precise characterization of aggregate size and reactivity and individual-specific fingerprint identification.
研究者采用3D打印解剖模型替代尸体标本，用于医学教学，结果显示该模型相比二维图像: Researchers used 3D printed anatomical models to replace cadaver specimens for medical teaching. The results showed that the model can improve the learning experience compared to two-dimensional images.
研究者采用个性化3D打印生物相容性模板，结合术前体积分析，指导自体骨移植以实现鼻: The researchers used personalized 3D printed biocompatible templates, combined with preoperative volume analysis, to guide autologous bone grafting to achieve accurate reconstruction of nasal and alveolar defects, ensuring that the volume and shape of the bone graft were in line with expectations.
研究者采用高频低压空气等离子体处理封闭圆柱微通道PDMS芯片内壁，实现均匀表面改: The researchers used high-frequency and low-pressure air plasma to treat the inner wall of the closed cylindrical microchannel PDMS chip to achieve uniform surface modification. Combined with the type IV collagen coating, it promoted the attachment of vascular endothelial cells and long-term culture stability. The cells survived well and showed physiological behaviors.
研究者针对癌症治疗开发了具有三维多孔结构的纳米海绵，通过调控聚合物、交联剂及药物: Researchers have developed nanosponges with a three-dimensional porous structure for cancer treatment. By regulating parameters such as polymers, cross-linking agents, and drug types, they have optimized their drug loading and release behavior. They have focused on evaluating the performance and challenges of cyclodextrin, DNase, and ethylcellulose-based nanosponges in targeted delivery.
研究者验证了3D打印防护面罩在病理诊断实验室中的适用性，该产品用于提升实验室安全: Researchers have verified the applicability of 3D printed protective masks in pathological diagnostic laboratories. This product is used to improve laboratory safety protection.
研究聚合物共混物在药用固体制剂3D打印中的可打印性提升及药物释放调控作用。: Study the printability improvement and drug release regulation of polymer blends in 3D printing of pharmaceutical solid dosage forms.
研究脊柱外科医师对打印解剖模型临床使用的态度并含实际分割打印模型，主体为医疗AM: Study the attitude of spine surgeons towards the clinical use of printed anatomical models, including actual segmentation of printed models, and the main body is the evaluation of medical AM use.
研究虚拟设计的3D打印手术夹板在上颌复位中的准确性。: To study the accuracy of virtually designed 3D printed surgical splints in maxillary reduction.
研究设计了13种含硫烯和含硫炔的3D打印材料，通过数字光处理技术打印，实现机械性: Thirteen kinds of sulfur-containing and thioacetylene-containing 3D printing materials were researched and designed. They were printed through digital light processing technology to achieve adjustable mechanical properties and degradation rates. The materials are completely degraded and stable under physiological conditions, and have potential biomedical application value.
研究设计了一种3D打印的模块化可调节前臂假肢套筒（MAPS），与定制负压套筒在单: The study designed a 3D printed modular adjustable forearm prosthetic sleeve (MAPS) and compared it with a custom-made negative pressure sleeve in a single amputee. The results showed that the two were equivalent in mechanical properties, functional performance and user feedback, indicating that MAPS can effectively support the evaluation of myoelectric control strategies.
研究设计了一种轻量化、无需额外组件组装的医疗面屏，通过增材制造技术在45分钟内完: We researched and designed a lightweight medical visor that does not require additional components to be assembled. It can be produced within 45 minutes using additive manufacturing technology. The amount of material used in a single frame is less than 10 grams. It has been verified by structural simulation that it has good operability and practicality.
研究设计了基于有限元分析的3D打印假足趾关节结构，通过优化曲率、弯折空间等几何参: The study designed a 3D printed prosthetic toe joint structure based on finite element analysis. By optimizing geometric parameters such as curvature and bending space, it achieved mechanical behavior similar to the nonlinear stiffness characteristics of human toes, simulated the mechanical response during the toe-off stage during walking, and verified that it was consistent with human walking data.
研究设计了融合宏观拓扑优化与微孔蜂窝结构的楔形内固定器，通过有限元分析和生物力学: The study designed a wedge-shaped internal fixator that combines macrotopology optimization and microporous honeycomb structure. Finite element analysis and biomechanical fatigue testing showed that compared with commercial T-shaped steel plates, this internal fixator reduces the displacement and stress of the bone and implant, showing better stability and osseointegration environment.
研究设计并3D打印了三种根模拟牙植入体，包括实心体、均质格构体及功能梯度格构体，: The study designed and 3D printed three types of root simulated dental implants, including solid body, homogeneous lattice body and functional gradient lattice body. The stress distribution was improved through topology optimization. Experimental verification showed that the functional gradient implant increased the strain energy density by 22%, which was better than other types.
研究设计并制备了两种具有相同内部几何结构的门静脉流动仿生模型，分别采用固态透明硅: Two portal vein flow bionic models with the same internal geometric structure were designed and prepared, using solid transparent silicone and thin-walled latex tubing respectively, for testing of ultrasound and imaging systems such as MRI, CT, PET or SPECT, and both passed durability evaluation.
研究设计并制造了模拟骨盆病变的仿生假体，通过评估不同格构密度与厚度，筛选出能有效: The study designed and manufactured a bionic prosthesis that simulates pelvic lesions. By evaluating different lattice densities and thicknesses, a structure that can effectively reproduce the puncture touch and bone cement diffusion was selected to train medical students to complete bone cement injection operations in the pelvic area under fluorescence and CT guidance.
研究设计并实验验证了一种集成阿基米德螺旋桨的被动式微流控混合器，通过优化螺杆长度: The research designed and experimentally verified a passive microfluidic mixer integrating Archimedes propeller. By optimizing the screw length, pitch and gap parameters, it was found that the combination of 0.5 mm screw length, 0.23409 mm pitch and 0.004 mm gap has the best mixing performance at low Reynolds number, with a mixing index of 98.47% and a performance index of 20. Compared with traditional designs, this structure performs better at low Reynolds numbers.
研究设计并验证了一种新型扩散-free毛细管阀（π-valve），通过3D结构与: The research designed and verified a new type of diffusion-free capillary valve (π-valve), which separates two fluids through a 3D structure and cavity to avoid direct contact and achieve precise control of liquids without the need for external instruments. Compared with traditional valves, it reduces mixing and diffusion and increases fluorescence intensity in immunoassays by 40%.
研究评估了14种滤材及8种组合在3D打印外科口罩中的过滤效率与呼吸阻力，结果显示: The study evaluated the filtration efficiency and respiratory resistance of 14 types of filter materials and 8 combinations in 3D printed surgical masks. The results showed that the filtration efficiency ranged from 3.9% to 98.8%, and the respiratory resistance ranged from 10.8 to >637 Pa. When used in 3D printed masks, the efficiency dropped by an average of 13% and the respiratory resistance increased by 4 times. Dry heat disinfection had little impact on the filtration efficiency, while 10 times of 59% hydrogen peroxide vapor treatment significantly reduced the filtration efficiency.
研究评估了30种不同3D打印材料和设备对呼吸机分流器与节流器的性能，发现其流阻因: The study evaluated the performance of 30 different 3D printing materials and equipment on ventilator diverters and restrictors, and found that their flow resistance significantly deviated from the calculation model due to differences in printer type and materials, posing safety risks in clinical use. However, the tidal volume can be calibrated by adjusting the ventilator's inspiratory time.
研究评估了3D打印CRISIS呼吸机的耐久性与灭菌性能，结果显示其经灭菌和跌落处: The study evaluated the durability and sterilization performance of the 3D printed CRISIS ventilator. The results showed that it can still maintain stable ventilation after sterilization and drop treatment. The respiratory frequency has an inverse relationship under different tidal volumes, and it can achieve ventilation volumes of 4.1 to 12.2 L/min under various lung compliance simulations, which is equivalent to traditional equipment.
研究评估了4至12岁儿童对不同尺寸3D打印安慰剂片的可吞咽性及可接受性，结果显示: The study evaluated the swallowability and acceptability of 3D printed placebo tablets of different sizes in children aged 4 to 12 years old. The results showed that 87% of the children successfully swallowed the tablets, and most of them scored well in terms of texture, taste, water consumption, and overall acceptance. 77% expressed their willingness to take it daily, and most believed that the taste of the 3D printed tablets was equivalent to that of traditional film-coated tablets.
研究评估了SLA 3D打印手术导板在121°C和134°C蒸汽灭菌及70%异丙醇: The study evaluated the dimensional stability of SLA 3D printed surgical guides after steam sterilization at 121°C and 134°C and 70% isopropyl alcohol sterilization. The results showed that steam sterilization at 134°C caused significant dimensional changes, while 121°C sterilization and isopropyl alcohol sterilization did not cause significant changes.
研究评估了七家医疗设备公司使用选择性激光熔融技术制造钛合金个性化骨盆植入物的质量: The study evaluated the quality of titanium alloy personalized pelvic implants manufactured by seven medical device companies using selective laser melting technology. The results showed that the implants prepared by two companies were defect-free, while the products of the remaining companies had problems such as geometric deviations, uneven grains, structural fractures, and internal surface defects.
研究评估了不同3D打印参数对防护面罩头带强度和打印时间的影响，结果显示填充密度、: The study evaluated the impact of different 3D printing parameters on the strength and printing time of the protective mask headband. The results showed that increasing the filling density, shell thickness and line width can improve the strength, while the layer height has no effect. Increasing the line width and layer height can significantly shorten the printing time.
研究评估了不同安装位置和引导设计对桡骨3D打印手术导板定位误差的影响，结果显示中: The study evaluated the impact of different installation positions and guide designs on the positioning error of the radius 3D printed surgical guide. The results showed that the mid-section position error was larger, and the extended design significantly improved the positioning accuracy in the distal and proximal areas, but the mid-section position led to an increase in rotation error.
研究评估了不同打印方向（0°、10°、20°）和外壳厚度（2mm、4mm）对DL: The study evaluated the impact of different printing directions (0°, 10°, 20°) and shell thickness (2mm, 4mm) on the accuracy of maxillary hollow models printed with DLP technology. The results showed that the printing direction and shell thickness had no significant impact on the overall accuracy, but the 2mm shell showed better accuracy at some points.
研究评估了不同溶液浸泡、表面处理及修复材料对老化3D打印临时修复材料与修复材料之: The study evaluated the effects of different solution soaking, surface treatment and repair materials on the shear bond strength between aging 3D printed temporary repair materials and repair materials. The results showed that sandpaper and sandblasting significantly improved the bond strength, and the effect was better when using bis-acrylic resin for repair.
研究评估了不同热循环时长对3D打印树脂基永久陶瓷固定修复体断裂强度的影响，结果显: The study evaluated the effect of different thermal cycle times on the fracture strength of 3D printed resin-based permanent ceramic fixed restorations. The results showed that as the thermal cycle time increased, the fracture strength showed a significant downward trend, although the difference between the groups was not statistically significant.
研究评估了人工唾液、碳酸橙汁和咖啡对3D打印临时冠材料表面粗糙度和颜色稳定性的影: The study evaluated the effects of artificial saliva, carbonated orange juice and coffee on the surface roughness and color stability of 3D printed temporary crown materials. The results showed that the coffee group had the most significant color changes and surface roughness, while the artificial saliva group had the smallest changes. The differences between the three were statistically significant.
研究评估了含二氧化钛3D打印义齿基质在不同时间点的可打印性、颜色差异、透光性和表: The study evaluated the printability, color difference, light transmittance and surface roughness of titanium dioxide-containing 3D printed denture matrix at different time points, and compared its performance over time.
研究评估了含海藻酸钠、HPC、HPMC等聚合物的墨水在压力辅助微注射3D打印中的: The study evaluated the rheological properties of inks containing polymers such as sodium alginate, HPC, HPMC, etc. in pressure-assisted microinjection 3D printing. It was found that only 0.8% sodium alginate ink has good printing formability. Its success is due to specific rheological properties, indicating that the printing performance depends on the rheological behavior of the ink rather than the dosage form.
研究评估了基于3D打印技术的半面罩、安全护目镜和防护面屏，比较了Fused Fi: The study evaluated half masks, safety goggles and protective visors based on 3D printing technology, and compared the differences in material use, cost and production time between Fused Filament manufacturing (FFF) and selective laser sintering (SLS) processes. It was found that TAED disinfection does not affect the stability of the polymer structure and that 3D printed PPE can be reused, but open source models need to be used with caution.
研究评估了增材制造面罩的贴合性能，通过虚拟穿戴模拟分析不同尺寸和加装泡沫密封圈对: The study evaluated the fit performance of additively manufactured masks, and analyzed the impact of different sizes and the addition of foam seals on the sealing gap and leakage area through virtual wearing simulation. The results showed that a proper size and matching of sealing rings can achieve a good fit, but a lack of sealing or improper size can easily create a large gap, affecting the protective effect.
研究评估了多种口罩的过滤效率与密合性，发现N95/KN95口罩过滤效率高于95%: The study evaluated the filtration efficiency and tightness of various masks and found that N95/KN95 masks had a filtration efficiency higher than 95% and passed the tightness test, while the 3D printed montague masks and homemade duckbill masks had a filtration efficiency lower than 95% and failed the tightness test regardless of the material, indicating that good filter materials need to be combined with appropriate designs for effective protection.
研究评估了新型个人防护装备（如3D打印面屏）在新冠疫情中的安全性和有效性，重点考: The study evaluated the safety and effectiveness of new personal protective equipment (such as 3D printed visors) in the COVID-19 epidemic, focusing on whether it complied with regulatory requirements. It found that there was a lack of unified standards and emphasized the need to establish clinical evaluation protocols to ensure safe use.
研究评估了热循环及三种表面处理对聚Jet 3D打印牙科义齿材料的弯曲强度和表面硬: The study evaluated the effects of thermal cycle and three surface treatments on the bending strength and surface hardness of PolyJet 3D printed dental denture materials. The results showed that thermal cycle reduced the bending strength of all groups, and the Optiglaze group was significantly higher than the other groups. In terms of surface hardness, the Optiglaze group was always significantly higher than the Pumice and Polycril groups, and the hardness of the Polycril and Pumice groups decreased significantly after thermal cycling.
研究评估了用于口腔种植手术导板制造的生物可降解聚酯（BE）和聚丙烯（PP）以及甲: The study evaluated the cytotoxicity of biodegradable polyester (BE) and polypropylene (PP) and methacrylate resin (ME) used in the manufacture of guides for oral implant surgery. The results showed that BE and PP had good biocompatibility in short-term use in vitro, while ME caused the upregulation of inflammation and apoptosis genes in human gingival fibroblasts after 72 hours, suggesting that long-term exposure may trigger (pro)inflammatory or apoptotic responses.
研究调查了沙特阿拉伯1299名不同年龄和教育背景人群对3D打印药物的认知、偏好及: The study investigated the cognition, preference and trust factors of 1,299 people of different ages and educational backgrounds in Saudi Arabia about 3D printed drugs. It was found that the public is most concerned about personalized dosage, compound preparations and regulatory approval. Among them, regulatory approval and scientific verification are the strongest predictors of acceptance. Users prefer easy-to-use appearance and medication reminder design.
研究趋势从制造一个载药形状，转向同时调整形状、柔性与释放。阴道环沿长时、多药和个: Research trends are moving away from creating a drug-laden shape to simultaneously tailoring shape, flexibility and release. Vaginal rings are advancing along the lines of long-lasting, multi-drug, and personalized design, and eye preparations are advancing along the lines of miniaturization, degradability, and tissue permeability.
研究路线从单独分离向多步骤集成延伸，目标是减少样本转移并提高送入检测环节的有效浓: The research route extends from individual separation to multi-step integration, with the goal of reducing sample transfer and increasing the effective concentration sent to the detection link. The combination of material identification and flow channel structure enables printing from container manufacturing to analysis process design
研究连续纤维增强跨膝假肢座的形状与性能协同设计及增材制造。: Study the shape and performance co-design and additive manufacturing of continuous fiber-reinforced cross-knee prosthetic bases.
研究通过RAFT聚合3D打印技术，制备具有精确几何结构和药物装载量的个性化药物递: Research uses RAFT polymerization 3D printing technology to prepare personalized drug delivery systems with precise geometry and drug loading. By regulating the ratio of polyethylene glycol and acrylate in the cross-linking agent, the drug release performance is optimized to achieve on-demand customized delivery paths, replacing the traditional "one-size-fits-all" medical model.
研究通过三维打印手术导板，比较了后牙咬合面沟槽密封及内表面偏移对种植体内部贴合与: The study used 3D printed surgical guides to compare the effects of groove sealing and inner surface offset on the occlusal surface of posterior teeth on the internal fit and accuracy of implants. The results showed that the degree of inner surface offset affects accuracy, suggesting that sealing the grooves or adjusting the offset before guide plate manufacturing can improve surgical accuracy.
研究通过优化DLP 3D打印中的像素偏移设置，改善氧化锆冠的表面精度与贴合度，不: The study improves the surface accuracy and fit of zirconia crowns by optimizing the pixel offset settings in DLP 3D printing. Improper settings will increase edge differences and surface errors, affecting the accuracy of the restoration.
研究通过功能梯度增材制造技术，结合长石瓷与YAG:Ce材料，优化配方并验证了其在: The study used functional gradient additive manufacturing technology, combined with feldspathic porcelain and YAG:Ce materials, to optimize the formula and verify its feasibility in simulating natural tooth color. The results showed that the color gradient was clear and the bending strength reached the standard, and the CIEDE2000 calculation confirmed the color difference between different areas.
研究通过可修改光学与自动控制实现多模态成像。模块化的意义是保留可复用基础，同时允: Research on realizing multi-modal imaging through modifiable optics and automatic control. The meaning of modularity is to retain a reusable foundation while allowing researchers to adjust configurations for samples without having to remake the entire device.
研究通过多元线性回归分析，关联3D打印片剂的力学与流变学丝状物特性与可加工性及质: The study used multiple linear regression analysis to correlate the mechanical and rheological filament properties of 3D printed tablets with processability and quality, and established a prediction model that can be applied across studies to clarify the impact of each parameter on tablet width uniformity, drug release uniformity, disintegration time uniformity and disintegration incidence.
研究通过局部递送调节肿瘤相关巨噬细胞环境，并将早期抑制不利肿瘤微环境与后续骨再生: The study modulates the tumor-associated macrophage environment through local delivery, and examines the early suppression of adverse tumor microenvironment and subsequent bone regeneration in stages. The research includes evaluation of tumor models and bone repair, and proposes a sequential treatment logic: first deal with the pathological environment that hinders repair, and then let the material continue to take on the task of tissue regeneration.
研究通过改变3D打印片剂的表面积与体积比（SA/V），探究其对药物释放特性的影响: The study explored its impact on drug release characteristics by changing the surface area to volume ratio (SA/V) of 3D printed tablets. It was found that the surface area to volume ratio can accurately predict the average dissolution time and release curve of the drug, and the deviation between the prediction results and the actual data does not exceed 5 minutes. It is suitable for drugs with different bioavailability classifications.
研究通过液膜引导溶液包覆法，调控阿司匹林和椭icine纳米薄膜的厚度与形貌，实现: The study uses a liquid film-guided solution coating method to regulate the thickness and morphology of aspirin and ellipsoidal nanofilms to achieve the construction of multi-layer nanocomposites, successfully obtain new crystal forms and control their formation, demonstrating the potential of multi-drug personalized preparations.
研究通过生物打印技术实现集成型器官芯片的制备，一次性打印微流控芯片、活细胞微组织: The study uses bioprinting technology to realize the preparation of integrated organ chips, printing microfluidic chips, living cell microtissues, stimulation components and sensing elements in one go to achieve fully integrated construction without assembly.
研究通过结合3D打印与软光刻技术，放大了微流控芯片中气动膜阀的尺寸，实现了对鼠成: By combining 3D printing and soft lithography technology, the research enlarged the size of the pneumatic membrane valve in the microfluidic chip, achieved 3D culture of mouse fibroblasts, human induced pluripotent stem cells and human adipose-derived adult stem cells, and successfully completed the parallel formation, culture, capture, recovery and fusion of cells.
研究通过调整FDM工艺参数，探讨其对PEEK牙科种植体机械与热性能的影响，发现喷: By adjusting FDM process parameters, the study explored its impact on the mechanical and thermal properties of PEEK dental implants. It was found that the nozzle temperature affects the resolution, the cavity temperature determines the crystallinity, the printing speed and layer height significantly affect the strength and dimensional accuracy, and printing in specific directions can meet FDA durability requirements.
研究通过调整壁厚、材料和喷嘴直径三个参数，利用Taguchi方法优化膝下假肢套筒: The study used the Taguchi method to optimize the 3D printing time of the below-knee prosthetic sleeve by adjusting three parameters: wall thickness, material and nozzle diameter. The results show that the nozzle diameter has the greatest impact on the printing time. The combination of 1mm wall thickness, PLA material and 0.8mm nozzle can reduce the printing time by an average of 24%.
研究通过调节3D打印片剂表面曲率（b值变化），构建不同形状的片剂，发现表面曲率越: The study constructed tablets of different shapes by adjusting the surface curvature of 3D printed tablets (change in b value). It was found that the greater the surface curvature, the faster the drug release. The T5 group completed the release within 4 hours, and the T1 and T2 groups took about 6 hours. The surface area is positively correlated with the release rate.
研究采用 Tilapia 皮肤胶原蛋白与 Poloxamer 407 构成二元聚: The study used Tilapia skin collagen and Poloxamer 407 to form a binary polymer system. The temperature, concentration and component ratio were optimized through response surface methodology. It was found that the system has shear thinning and thixotropy. The CP12 system performed best in local application. The CP2, CP8, pCP2, and pCP8 systems have the structural recovery capabilities required for 3D printing, and the microstructure matches the mechanical properties.
研究采用 epitaxial graphene 传感器结合3D打印微流控芯片检测: The study uses an epitaxial graphene sensor combined with a 3D printed microfluidic chip to detect heavy metals. The results show that the sensor responds better to lead than cadmium, and the ions preferentially bind to graphene.
研究采用 vat 光聚合 3D 打印技术制备 ZrO2(3Y)/Al2O3 生物: The research uses vat photopolymerization 3D printing technology to prepare ZrO2(3Y)/Al2O3 bioceramics. After optimizing the sintering process, its density reaches 98.79%, with good mechanics and wear resistance. Artificial saliva can improve its wear resistance, is non-cytotoxic, promotes cell proliferation, has moderate surface roughness and good wettability.
研究采用10个合成半骨盆模型，对比患者特异性植入物与常规七孔板植入物在后壁髋臼骨: The study used 10 synthetic hemipelvis models to compare the mechanical properties of patient-specific implants and conventional seven-hole plate implants in posterior wall acetabular fractures. The results showed that there was no significant difference in stiffness, cyclic loading stability, and fracture gap between the two implants, and both implants could provide stable fixation.
研究采用12例人类耳廓及其血管蒂，通过表面活性剂/极性溶剂渗透脱细胞化处理，成功: The study used 12 cases of human auricles and their vascular pedicles, and successfully removed cells and antigens through surfactant/polar solvent infiltration decellularization, while retaining the complex structure and vascular network of the ear. It was well tolerated after implantation in rats, and colonization of adipose-derived stem cells and human aortic endothelial cells was achieved.
研究采用150μm层厚的粉末床融合激光束加工Ti–20Nb–6Ta和Ti–35N: The study used a 150 μm layer thickness powder bed fusion laser beam to process Ti–20Nb–6Ta and Ti–35Nb–6Ta alloys. It was found that thick layers promote heat accumulation and phase change path changes. The former forms an α+β structure to enhance strength, while the latter maintains β phase with higher ductility and lower modulus. Both develop a ⟨001　 texture parallel to the forming direction and reduce the elastic modulus.
研究采用18月龄牛胸骨的23个10毫米高骨芯，在3D打印MED610TM生物反应: The study used 23 10 mm high bone cores from 18-month-old bovine sternums and cultured them in a 3D printed MED610TM bioreactor for 21 days. The bone cores were grouped according to the initial elastic modulus. A sinusoidal strain of -1000 to -5000 με was applied to the loading group five times a week. The results showed that the elastic modulus of the loading group increased significantly higher than that of the control group within 21 days.
研究采用2D μPIV结合CFD模型，测定3D多孔支架内流体速度场，结果显示中心: The study used 2D μPIV combined with the CFD model to measure the fluid velocity field in the 3D porous scaffold. The results showed that the velocity at the central hole was consistent, but there were significant differences near the scaffold base due to the influence of brightness, indicating that μPIV could only partially verify the CFD model. The combination of the two can effectively describe the velocity distribution within the scaffold.
研究采用3D CT扫描与图像处理软件，对比加工商脊柱植入物设计与实际制造几何差异: The study uses 3D CT scanning and image processing software to compare the geometric differences between the manufacturer's spinal implant design and actual manufacturing, and analyzes its performance impact through simulation to clarify the difference between design and manufacturing deviations on the performance of the spinal implant.
研究采用3D DLP打印制备了含CBD的微针贴剂，通过体外渗透和体内药代动力学实: The study used 3D DLP printing to prepare a microneedle patch containing CBD. Through in vitro penetration and in vivo pharmacokinetic experiments, it was found that the microneedle patch significantly improved the bioavailability of CBD compared with the subcutaneous injection control group, and the microneedle shape was stable and had superior permeability.
