研究采用3D打印20%明胶/5%海藻酸盐水凝胶支架，培养人HaCaT角质细胞7天: The study used a 3D printed 20% gelatin/5% alginate hydrogel scaffold to culture human HaCaT keratinocytes for 7 days. The results showed that the cells formed a spherical structure within 47% of the pores, showing an irregular interconnected shape, and the scaffold structure was stable and degradable, providing a feasible solution for three-dimensional culture of keratinocytes.
研究采用3D打印Cu-bearing钛合金Ti6Al4V6Cu，对比传统不锈钢冠: The study used 3D printing Cu-bearing titanium alloy Ti6Al4V6Cu to compare with traditional stainless steel crowns to evaluate its mechanical properties, corrosion resistance, biocompatibility and antibacterial effect. The results showed that its surface hardness and compressive strength were better, and its biocompatibility was good. It significantly inhibited the growth of Streptococcus mutans, and its internal fit was better than traditional stainless steel crowns.
研究采用3D打印HA/CMCS/PDA/TFRD支架，应用于大鼠胫骨段缺损模型，: The study used a 3D printed HA/CMCS/PDA/TFRD scaffold and applied it to a rat tibial segment defect model. The results showed that the scaffold was anti-infective, degradable and promoted angiogenesis, and could effectively promote bone regeneration and increase the maximum bearing capacity of new bone.
研究采用3D打印OpenFlexure显微镜与商用显微镜扫描275例宫颈活检标本: The study used 3D printed OpenFlexure microscopes and commercial microscopes to scan 275 cervical biopsy specimens. After image standardization, open source software was used to build 5 AI models to classify high-risk and low-risk lesions. The results showed that the image quality generated by the two devices can support AI-assisted screening, but there was no significant difference in the performance indicators of each model.
研究采用3D打印PCL/丝素蛋白复合支架，结合L7肽增强间充质干细胞招募，其在2: The study used a 3D printed PCL/silk fibroin composite scaffold combined with L7 peptide to enhance the recruitment of mesenchymal stem cells. After 24 weeks of implantation, it showed better tissue repair and cartilage protection effects than the traditional group, and had good biomechanical properties and structural functions.
研究采用3D打印PLA微流控生物反应器，结合电场作用，观察了金黄色葡萄球菌、粪肠: The study used a 3D printed PLA microfluidic bioreactor, combined with the action of electric fields, to observe the preference of four bacteria, including Staphylococcus aureus and Enterococcus faecalis, to form biofilms in high electric field gradient areas. The results showed that each bacteria showed positive dielectrophoretic behavior, and biofilms grew preferentially in areas with strong electric field gradients.
研究采用3D打印PLGA/SA支架修复大鼠膝关节软骨缺损，结果显示实验组骨组织评: The study used 3D printed PLGA/SA scaffolds to repair cartilage defects in rat knee joints. The results showed that the bone tissue score of the experimental group was higher than that of the control group, and the expression of BMP2 was significantly increased, indicating that the scaffold can promote bone formation and improve cartilage damage.
研究采用3D打印PLLA或钛支架嵌入磷酸钙复合结构，对比其在模拟体液中降解行为，: The study used 3D printed PLLA or titanium scaffolds embedded in calcium phosphate composite structures, and compared their degradation behavior in simulated body fluids. The results showed that thick layers of PLLA enhanced mechanical properties, which were comparable to titanium, and had no mutual interference, indicating that PLLA can be used as a degradable titanium alternative material for skull repair.
研究采用3D打印mPCL支架，通过物理结合人血清白蛋白（HSA）并经鞣酸（TA）: The study used 3D printed mPCL scaffolds, which were physically combined with human serum albumin (HSA) and cross-linked with tannic acid (TA) to reduce the colonization of Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa on the stent surface. The inhibition rates of 1% HSA/10% TA and 5% HSA/1% TA coatings against Staphylococcus aureus reached 99.8% and 98.8% respectively, which were better than the uncoated control group.
研究采用3D打印与树脂浸渗法制作单轴假足原型，通过有限元模拟分析其在0-64%步: The study used 3D printing and resin infiltration methods to create a uniaxial prosthetic foot prototype, and analyzed its mechanical properties in the key stages of the 0-64% gait cycle through finite element simulation. The results showed that the prosthetic foot can withstand loads of 60kg, 80kg, and 100kg, has a mass of 657 grams, a hardness of 55.5HA, and remains stable after 50,000 fatigue tests.
研究采用3D打印与注塑技术，在透明PDMS生物反应器中制备多层预血管化水凝胶，构: The research uses 3D printing and injection molding technology to prepare multi-layered pre-vascularized hydrogels in transparent PDMS bioreactors to build a layered structure containing mesenchymal stem cells, umbilical vein endothelial cells and smooth muscle cells to achieve continuous delivery of cell type functionalized tissues and nutrients, forming a multi-layered vascular model that can be directly connected to a continuous perfusion system.
研究采用3D打印义齿基台树脂，比较硅藻复合物（DA、DM）与对照组（NC）对生物: The study used 3D printed denture abutment resin to compare the biofilm removal effects of diatom complexes (DA, DM) and the control group (NC). The results showed that the DM group and the DA group had the most significant removal effects, and there was no significant difference. There were no significant changes in the physical and mechanical properties and cytotoxicity of the materials.
研究采用3D打印人头假人模型，检测眼与脑在头部撞击中的被动响应，结果显示眼与脑加: The study used a 3D printed human head dummy model to detect the passive response of the eyes and brain in a head impact. The results showed a strong correlation between eye and brain acceleration, indicating that real-time eye movement monitoring based on MEMS inertial measurement units can potentially be used for non-invasive early warning of on-site concussion.
研究采用3D打印人头模型 体模，填充人工脑组织和脑脊液，测定其在Cs-137辐射: The study used a 3D printed human head model phantom, filled with artificial brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid, to measure its angular response and absorbed dose under Cs-137 radiation. The results showed that its calibration factor was between 0.82 and 1, and the differences in absorbed dose and linear attenuation coefficient from the standard phantom were 2.52% and 3.78% respectively, indicating that this model can be used as a feasible alternative for eye lens dosimeter TLD calibration.
研究采用3D打印仿人手臂模型，结合稳定共聚物-油基材料与优化染料，构建具有五级血: The study used a 3D printed human arm model, combined with stable copolymer-oil-based materials and optimized dyes, to construct a tissue bionic prosthesis with five levels of blood oxygen saturation (0%–100%). Verification through reflection hyperspectral imaging and photoacoustic imaging showed that the correlation between its absorption spectrum and measurement data reached more than 0.8, and linear spectral unmixing can effectively quantify the blood oxygen saturation assessment error.
研究采用3D打印仿根状多孔PEEK植入物，经APTES修饰提升表面活性，增强骨整: The research uses 3D printed root-like porous PEEK implants, which are modified with APTES to increase surface activity, enhance osseointegration and soft tissue sealing, and are superior to traditional titanium and zirconia implants to achieve good mechanical matching and cellular response.
研究采用3D打印仿生介质，设置不同深度通道，评估了三种SERS标签在785 nm: The study used 3D printed bionic media and set up channels with different depths to evaluate the detection performance of three SERS tags in turbid media under 785 nm laser excitation. It was found that the SERS intensity in the solution cannot reliably predict its detection ability in tissue.
研究采用3D打印低密度 体模，结合EBT3薄膜测量，验证了Acuros XB算法: The study used a 3D printed low-density phantom, combined with EBT3 film measurement, to verify the accuracy of the dose calculation of the Acuros XB algorithm for Ono and adjacent low-density media under 6MV, 6FFF and 15MV beams. The results showed that the dose difference in the high-dose area was less than 3%, and there was a large deviation in the pencil-shaped area. The difference between the percentage depth dose and the film measurement in the multi-layer structure was within 5%, and the Gamma index reached an average of 98%.
研究采用3D打印低成本压力传感系统，在翻滚模拟器上测量截肢残肢与假肢套筒界面压力: The study used a 3D printed low-cost pressure sensing system to measure the interface pressure between the amputation residual limb and the prosthetic sleeve on a tumbling simulator, and compared the predicted values from finite element analysis with experimental data. The results showed that under the condition of accurately describing the geometric shape of the residual limb, the average absolute error of the predicted pressure was 12 kPa.
研究采用3D打印假体孪生模型，结合动态超声成像技术，通过同步多探头记录健康大腿软: The study used a 3D printed prosthetic twin model, combined with dynamic ultrasound imaging technology, to record the depth changes of the healthy thigh soft tissue and bone interface through simultaneous multiple probes, verifying the feasibility of this technology to achieve precise dynamic monitoring of tissue interfaces in individuals with lower limb disabilities.
研究采用3D打印假体，利用非刚性图像配准将CT影像与MR影像对齐，通过控制点位置: The study used 3D printed prostheses, used non-rigid image registration to align CT images with MR images, and evaluated the geometric accuracy of 12 MR scanners through control point position differences. The results showed that the average deviation under optimized parameters was 0.17 mm, and the maximum displacements under correction by different manufacturers were 0.50 to 1.35 mm and 0.89 to 2.30 mm respectively.
研究采用3D打印光学组件，结合高分辨率打印的品红色卡模型，通过RGB色彩值与反射: The research uses 3D printed optical components, combined with high-resolution printed magenta card models, to establish a mathematical model through the relationship between RGB color values and reflection spectra to achieve quantitative detection of paper immunochromatography test paper results.
研究采用3D打印光聚合微流控芯片，以牛血清白蛋白为尿液蛋白代表，PBS为清洗液，: The study used a 3D printed photopolymerized microfluidic chip, with bovine serum albumin as the representative urine protein and PBS as the cleaning solution. The CBQCA fluorescence method was used to evaluate protein cross-contamination and chip adsorption, verifying its reusability, and confirming its effectiveness in processing real urine samples through commercial test strip testing.
研究采用3D打印全身体 体模，模拟旋转式全皮肤电子治疗，通过Gafchromic: The study used a 3D printed full-body phantom to simulate rotating full-skin electronic therapy, and measured the body surface dose distribution through Gafchromic film. The results showed that the dose in each part was consistent with the literature, with specific differences in the hands, scalp and other locations. The dose in the soles of the feet, perineum and other areas was lower than 80%, and the dose deviation in 90% of the pixel areas was within 10%, which verified the effectiveness of this phantom in TSET dose assessment.
研究采用3D打印冠状动脉模型，比较OCT、IVUS和HD-IVUS对血管腔面积及: The study used a 3D printed coronary artery model to compare the measurement of vascular lumen area and diameter by OCT, IVUS and HD-IVUS. The results showed that OCT significantly underestimated the size, and there were systematic errors in automatic calibration. After the introduction of guide catheter reference correction, there was no significant difference between OCT measurement values and IVUS and HD-IVUS.
研究采用3D打印制作40 mL小型厌氧消化器，与400 mL商用搅拌反应器对比，: The study used 3D printing to produce a 40 mL small anaerobic digester. Compared with a 400 mL commercial stirred reactor, it was found that its stability and conversion efficiency were similar, but its gas production rate and methane content were low, and it still has the potential to be used as a screening tool for anaerobic digestion processes.
研究采用3D打印制备PCL及PCL/Ag双层支架，结果显示Ag涂层显著提升支架亲: The study used 3D printing to prepare PCL and PCL/Ag double-layer scaffolds. The results showed that the Ag coating significantly improved the hydrophilicity and water absorption of the scaffolds, and promoted the spindle-shaped growth of L929 cells, which was superior to the round cell morphology of the PCL scaffold, indicating that the PCL/Ag scaffold was more conducive to cell attachment and interaction.
研究采用3D打印制备PEKK/生物玻璃复合支架SPBC，相比未处理PEKK，其表: The study used 3D printing to prepare PEKK/bioglass composite scaffold SPBC. Compared with untreated PEKK, its surface is more hydrophilic and rough, which enhances the adsorption of fibronectin and glassin, improves cell adhesion and spreading, promotes macrophage polarization to M2 and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, and significantly improves anti-inflammatory and osseointegration capabilities.
研究采用3D打印制备了九种孔结构的钛合金支架，通过酸碱热处理形成表面微纳米结构，: The study used 3D printing to prepare titanium alloy scaffolds with nine kinds of pore structures. The surface micro-nano structures were formed through acid-base heat treatment. It was found that the pore geometry affects cell density and invasion depth. The micro-nano structures promote the osteogenic differentiation of human mesenchymal stem cells. In particular, the diamond lattice macroporous structure combined with the surface micro-nano structures significantly improves collagen and calcium deposition.
研究采用3D打印制备了梯度结构钛合金牙科植入物，比较G40、G50与NG50组的: The study used 3D printing to prepare gradient structure titanium alloy dental implants, and compared the mechanical properties and osseointegration effects of the G40, G50 and NG50 groups. The results showed that the G50 group was superior to other groups in terms of mechanical compatibility, bone volume and bone density, and the area of new bone and collagen increased significantly.
研究采用3D打印制备了滑盖密封式MAP-box，用于储存溶解型微阵列贴片，结果显: The study used 3D printing to prepare a sliding-lid sealed MAP-box for storing dissolvable microarray patches. The results showed that it can protect the patches for 30 days under conditions of 5°C, 25°C/65% humidity and 40°C/75% humidity. The drug loading, mechanical and insertion performance are no different from unpackaged patches.
研究采用3D打印制备了高孔隙率的异烟肼快速溶解片lets，其在体外和体内表现出与: The study used 3D printing to prepare high-porosity isoniazid fast-dissolving tablets, which showed similar bioavailability to traditional tablets in vitro and in vivo, and were stable under high temperature and high humidity conditions without significant content or dissolution changes.
研究采用3D打印制备具有增强黏膜黏附结构的放射造影微器件，通过体外黏附力测试和体: The study used 3D printing to prepare radiography microdevices with enhanced mucosal adhesion structures. Through in vitro adhesion testing and in vivo imaging analysis, it was confirmed that they have stronger mucosal adhesion and gastrointestinal retention capabilities than flat designs.
研究采用3D打印制备具有定制几何形状的惰性核心，经流化床包衣后负载布洛芬钠，并通: The study used 3D printing to prepare inert cores with customized geometries, loaded them with ibuprofen sodium after fluidized bed coating, and coated them with Eudragit RS 30D films of different thicknesses. The resulting microparticles showed consistent performance in morphology, composition and release properties, verifying the feasibility of the 3D printed core as a personalized carrier in multi-particulate formulations.
研究采用3D打印制备含介孔氧化铁纳米 raspberry 的磁响应透皮微针，装载: The study used 3D printing to prepare magnetically responsive transdermal microneedles containing mesoporous iron oxide nano-raspberries, which were loaded with minoxidil to treat androgenic alopecia. The microneedle puncture broke through the stratum corneum and controlled the release of the drug. It combined with the magnetocaloric effect to promote hair follicle expansion and drug penetration. Compared with untreated mice, the hair density increased by 800% 10 days after treatment.
研究采用3D打印制备含导电聚合物的微针传感器，用于实时连续监测活体皮肤内温度，结: The study used 3D printing to prepare microneedle sensors containing conductive polymers for real-time and continuous monitoring of skin temperature in vivo. The results showed that it has high sensitivity and good repeatability, which is consistent with the measurement results of commercial optical probes, verifying its reliability in accurate continuous monitoring.
研究采用3D打印制备含普萘洛尔盐的胶原-聚乙烯吡咯烷酮和胶原-聚乙烯醇颊部贴片，: The study used 3D printing to prepare collagen-polyvinylpyrrolidone and collagen-polyvinyl alcohol buccal patches containing propranolol salt. Comparison found that the collagen-polyvinylpyrrolidone patch has better mechanical properties and slower drug release. In vitro simulations show that it has higher bioavailability and smaller individual differences, which can reduce dosage and improve patient compliance.
研究采用3D打印制备含甲硝唑的聚乙烯醇水凝胶盘，评估不同塑化剂对甲硝唑抗菌活性的: The study used 3D printing to prepare polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel disks containing metronidazole, and evaluated the effects of different plasticizers on the antibacterial activity of metronidazole. The results showed that all types of plasticizers did not reduce its antibacterial effect, and the printed disks had good repeatability and MET content accuracy.
研究采用3D打印制备基于 gyroid 三重周期最小曲面的轻质机械超材料牙科植入: The study used 3D printing to prepare a lightweight mechanical metamaterial dental implant based on the gyroid triple periodic minimum surface. Its mechanical properties were verified through experiments and finite element simulations. The results showed that increasing the number of units can increase the stiffness and energy absorption but reduce the instability displacement. Thickening the wall layer simultaneously increases the stiffness, peak load, energy absorption and instability displacement. The structure with 11 units and 2.7 mm wall thickness has the best performance.
研究采用3D打印制备多孔钛杆，负载载万古霉素的 mPEG750-b-PCL250: The study used 3D printing to prepare porous titanium rods, loaded with vancomycin-loaded mPEG750-b-PCL2500 hydrogel and covered with a PCL film. It was verified by a rabbit Staphylococcus aureus infection model that the composite coating effectively prevented the premature release of vancomycin in a sterile state. After contact with bacterial lipase, the PCL film rapidly degraded and released antibiotics, significantly inhibiting bacterial biofilm formation and achieving intelligent antibacterial.
研究采用3D打印制备石墨/聚乳酸复合电极，负载氧化铋纳米颗粒，用于增强对扑热息痛: The study used 3D printing to prepare a graphite/polylactic acid composite electrode loaded with bismuth oxide nanoparticles to enhance the detection of paracetamol. The results showed that it has a wide linear range, low detection limit and good reproducibility. It can also detect lead ions, showing good selectivity and practicality.
研究采用3D打印制备蜂窝几何结构的微透镜阵列，与高端玻璃和低成本商用微透镜阵列对: The research uses 3D printing to prepare microlens arrays with honeycomb geometry. Compared with high-end glass and low-cost commercial microlens arrays, the imaging uniformity and lateral resolution are comparable, achieving super-resolution fluorescence imaging with a resolution of 151±12 nm and a cost as low as 0.5 pounds.
研究采用3D打印制备负载二甲双胍的GelMA-纳米黏土水凝胶支架，用于治疗糖尿病: The study used 3D printing to prepare metformin-loaded GelMA-nanoclay hydrogel scaffold for the treatment of diabetic bone defects. The results showed that the scaffold can effectively enhance osteogenesis, angiogenesis and immune regulation, and significantly promote bone regeneration in diabetic bone defects.
研究采用3D打印制备适配磁 levitation平台的微流控芯片，经树脂处理提升: Research uses 3D printing to prepare microfluidic chips adapted to magnetic levitation platforms. The optical properties are improved through resin treatment to achieve rapid and low-cost analysis and density sorting of particle density.
研究采用3D打印制模结合旋涂硅胶工艺，制备具有柔韧性和透明度的空心脑血管仿生模型: The study used 3D printing molding combined with spin-coating silicone technology to prepare a hollow cerebral blood vessel bionic model with flexibility and transparency, which was used to evaluate the mechanical behavior and blood flow measurement of the interventional device, verifying the applicability of this method in idealized and patient-specific cases.
研究采用3D打印半可重复模具，以PLA制外模、PVA制内核，注入Sylgard: The research uses a 3D printed semi-repeatable mold, with an outer mold made of PLA and an inner core made of PVA. Sylgard 184 silica gel is injected and the inner core is dissolved to create an elastic and transparent bionic structure that simulates aneurysm blood vessels and is used for macroscopic blood flow visualization. The cost is lower than previous methods and supports repeated preparation.
研究采用3D打印双室肾脏模型，比较不同SPECT/CT重建参数与PVC方法，发现: The study used a 3D printed dual-chamber kidney model to compare different SPECT/CT reconstruction parameters and PVC methods. It was found that unsmoothed reconstruction combined with low-dose CT recovery coefficients has the best effect, suggesting that the existing sphere-based volume-dependent recovery coefficient table should be replaced with a recovery coefficient that is more consistent with the kidney geometry.
研究采用3D打印双层简化圆柱形足跟骨仿生模型，结合六根微带天线的微波成像原型，测: The study used a 3D printed double-layer simplified cylindrical heel bone bionic model, combined with a microwave imaging prototype with six microstrip antennas, to measure the scattering signal of the bone bionic model, evaluate the sensitivity of the system to microwave measurements, and provide a test platform for preclinical evaluation of heel bone microwave imaging.
研究采用3D打印含硅钙碱磷酸盐生物陶瓷支架，结合灌注培养间充质干细胞及动脉静脉束: The study used 3D printed silicon-containing calcium alkali phosphate bioceramic scaffolds, combined with perfusion cultured mesenchymal stem cells and arterial and venous bundle implantation, to repair segmental bone defects in a rat model. The results showed that the bone area, blood vessel volume and density of the RP scaffold group containing cells and blood vessel bundles were significantly higher than those of other groups at 3 and 6 months.
研究采用3D打印固态氯离子选择性电极，对人汗液中的氯离子进行检测，该传感器在15: The study uses a 3D printed solid-state chloride ion selective electrode to detect chloride ions in human sweat. The sensor exhibits a Nestor response within the chloride ion concentration range of 15.6–250 mM, has little interference with common sweat anions, and accurately quantifies chloride ions within a clinically relevant concentration range, making it suitable for cystic fibrosis screening.
研究采用3D打印培养平台结合刺激拉曼散射显微镜，对活细胞进行无标记、连续时间序列: The research uses a 3D printing culture platform combined with stimulated Raman scattering microscopy to conduct label-free, continuous time series imaging of living cells, monitor the chemical and morphological changes of single cells under drug treatment in real time, and reveal the heterogeneous dynamic response trajectories in the cell population.
研究采用3D打印塔状微针系统，装载含维生素A的百合属囊泡，通过在大鼠和兔耳伤口模: The study used a 3D printed tower-shaped microneedle system loaded with lily vesicles containing vitamin A to promote scar-free healing by achieving staged intervention in inflammation regulation and collagen remodeling in rat and rabbit ear wound models.
研究采用3D打印外支架结合去细胞化羊软骨异体移植物，构建全尺寸人耳结构，小动物体: The study used a 3D printed external scaffold combined with decellularized sheep cartilage allograft to construct a full-scale human ear structure. In vivo experiments in small animals showed that the auricle maintained the scaffold shape at 6 months, the tissue continued to grow, the structure was flexible, and it had good biomechanical properties.
研究采用3D打印多孔支架实现局部多柔比星递送，对前列腺癌细胞系LAPC4及患者来: The study used 3D printed porous scaffolds to achieve local delivery of doxorubicin, which significantly inhibited the proliferation, migration and metabolic activity of prostate cancer cell line LAPC4 and patient-derived spinal metastasis cells, releasing 60%-75% of the drug within 7 days, effectively reducing cell activity, and the unloaded scaffold had no effect.
研究采用3D打印多孔羟基磷灰石支架，表面负载胶原包被的rhBMP-2微球，实现r: The study used 3D printed porous hydroxyapatite scaffolds with collagen-coated rhBMP-2 microspheres loaded on the surface to achieve biphasic sustained release of rhBMP-2 and promote osteogenic differentiation of human mesenchymal stem cells in vitro. In vivo experiments show that it has good bone regeneration ability.
研究采用3D打印多材料技术制备微流控比例阀，通过结合刚性与柔性材料，实现对流体变: The study uses 3D printing multi-material technology to prepare microfluidic proportional valves. By combining rigid and flexible materials, it achieves spatial constraints on fluid deformation. Compared with traditional single-material valves, it improves structural complexity and functional gradient, and supports precise control of fluids in applications such as DNA assembly, continuous sampling, and soft robots.
研究采用3D打印头颅假体和OSL探测器，对比Varian Eclipse中AAA: The study used 3D printed cranial prosthesis and OSL detector to compare the dose calculations of the AAA and Acuros XB algorithms in Varian Eclipse in the VMAT plan for multiple brain metastases. The results showed that Acuros XB dose calculation was more accurate, and the coincidence rate between experimental and calculated results exceeded 96.0%.
研究采用3D打印婴儿头模型，匹配成人头模型的图像质量，基于成人CT协议优化扫描参: The study uses a 3D printed infant head model to match the image quality of the adult head model, and optimizes the scanning parameters based on the adult CT protocol to reduce the dose of children's CT examinations and achieve standard image quality.
研究采用3D打印对乙酰氨基酚缓释片，利用便携式近红外光谱和拉曼共聚焦显微镜实现非: The study used 3D printed acetaminophen sustained-release tablets and used portable near-infrared spectroscopy and Raman confocal microscopy to achieve non-destructive dose verification. The results showed that it maintains high accuracy in different geometric shapes, dosage forms and polymer systems, and can accurately detect drug distribution morphology.
研究采用3D打印工具结合液滴固化制备低成本非传统透镜，并通过傅里叶ptychog: The research uses 3D printing tools combined with droplet solidification to prepare low-cost non-traditional lenses, and realizes digital correction of optical aberrations through Fourier ptychography technology, verifying the high-resolution imaging potential of mold-less lenses in the full field of view.
研究采用3D打印带有机械固位结构（如条状、隧道和钉孔）的人工牙，通过雕刻基托内表: The research uses 3D printing of artificial teeth with mechanical retention structures (such as strips, tunnels and nail holes). By carving the inner surface of the base, the material flows into these structures, which significantly improves the fracture resistance of the artificial teeth and has better retention performance than traditional prefabricated artificial teeth.
研究采用3D打印弹性水凝胶导管，负载7,8-二羟基黄酮前药，用于大鼠坐骨神经12: The study used a 3D printed elastic hydrogel catheter loaded with 7,8-dihydroxyflavone prodrug and used it in a 12mm sciatic nerve defect model in rats. The results showed that the catheter can promote axon regeneration, remyelination and functional recovery.
研究采用3D打印微孔通道生物材料，在犬模型中验证其在牙槽骨高度维持中的作用，通过: The study used 3D printed microporous channel biomaterials to verify its role in maintaining alveolar bone height in a canine model. By simulating the mechanical stimulation of natural teeth, it promotes bone cell proliferation and differentiation, achieves a mechanical response similar to natural teeth, and effectively inhibits marginal bone resorption.
研究采用3D打印微流控平台，大规模制备具有可控孔结构和形态的多孔纳米纤维微球，通: The study used a 3D printing microfluidic platform to prepare porous nanofiber microspheres with controllable pore structure and shape on a large scale, and loaded bioactive molecules through UV cross-linking to achieve osteogenesis, pro-angiogenesis and anti-inflammatory effects on human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, human umbilical vein endothelial cells and macrophages, and achieved cell infiltration and tissue integration within 14 days after subcutaneous implantation in rats.
研究采用3D打印微流控平台，模拟CPAP治疗下鼻黏膜细胞在气流压力（0–20 c: The study used a 3D printing microfluidic platform to simulate the response of nasal mucosal cells under airflow pressure (0–20 cm H₂O) under CPAP treatment. It was found that nasal epithelial cells showed reduced barrier integrity, morphological changes, increased cell death, and increased secretion of inflammatory factors and ATP under airflow stimulation, suggesting that airflow pressure can trigger structural and metabolic changes in the nasal mucosa, which may be related to nasal side effects of CPAP treatment.
研究采用3D打印微流控技术制备载18β-甘草酸乙酯的乙基、甘油和甘乙基脂质体，通: The study used 3D printing microfluidic technology to prepare ethyl, glycerol and glycoethyl liposomes loaded with 18β-ethyl glycyrrhizate. The key parameters were determined through design experiments to achieve uniform particle size, high encapsulation efficiency and stable nanocarriers. Combined with alginate gel to improve skin contact and controlled release, ex vivo results show that it can significantly regulate drug skin distribution, delay rapid diffusion and promote controlled release. The release rate becomes the rate-limiting step for drug accumulation in the skin layer.
研究采用3D打印微流控芯片控制硫胺嘧啶与4-氨基水杨酸cocrystal的晶体形: The study uses a 3D printed microfluidic chip to control the crystal morphology and purity of thiamine and 4-aminosalicylic acid cocrystal. Adding PVP can achieve high purity and inhibit the growth of needle-shaped crystals. The microfluidic chip is combined with a fluidized bed to achieve continuous manufacturing of cocrystal during the mixing, coating and drying processes.
研究采用3D打印微流控芯片结合喷雾干燥，连续制备尼费地平负载纳米颗粒并嵌入海藻糖: The study used 3D printing microfluidic chips combined with spray drying to continuously prepare nifedipine-loaded nanoparticles and embed trehalose particles to obtain a nanoparticle system of about 10 μm, which showed a three-fold increase in permeability and a three-fold reduction in lag time in the porcine intestinal membrane model, and the release was in a sustained zero-order mode.
研究采用3D打印微流控芯片，通过立体光刻（SLA）和熔融沉积建模（FDM）技术制: The study used 3D printed microfluidic chips to prepare nifedipine polylactic acid nanoparticles through stereolithography (SLA) and fused deposition modeling (FDM) technologies. The SLA chip has finer channels and smoother surfaces. The resulting nanoparticles have a particle size of 50–100 nm, a high encapsulation rate, and more stable release in acidic environments, which is better than the FDM chip.
研究采用3D打印微流控装置，结合丝素蛋白基质纤维尺寸（1280 nm vs 51: The study used a 3D printed microfluidic device, combined with the silk fibroin matrix fiber size (1280 nm vs 512 nm), to explore the release dynamics of nitrate and its aconate during macrophage polarization, and found that large fiber size significantly increased the production of two key markers.
研究采用3D打印微纤维增强的脊髓基质水凝胶载有氧化苦参碱，通过体外细胞实验和体内: The study used 3D printed microfiber-reinforced spinal cord matrix hydrogel loaded with oxymatrine. In vitro cell experiments and in vivo animal models showed that the material can promote the differentiation of neural stem cells into neurons, inhibit glial scar formation and improve motor function recovery.
研究采用3D打印微针结合等温扩增与试纸条检测，对比聚乙烯醇与植物树脂微针，发现3: The study used 3D printed microneedles combined with isothermal amplification and test strip detection, and compared polyvinyl alcohol and plant resin microneedles. It was found that 3D printed microneedles have better mechanical strength and higher DNA yield, and can effectively achieve accurate distinction between healthy and infected plants.
研究采用3D打印微针载体，在CD无毛鼠中比较不同几何设计对间质液提取效率的影响，: The study used 3D printed microneedle carriers to compare the effects of different geometric designs on interstitial fluid extraction efficiency in CD hairless mice. The results showed that the concave tip design has the highest extraction efficiency and is better than other designs.
研究采用3D打印心房瓣膜仿生装置，通过脉动流系统模拟心室血流，结合压力测量、MR: The study used a 3D printed atrial valve bionic device to simulate ventricular blood flow through a pulsatile flow system, and combined pressure measurement, MRI and ultrasound imaging to obtain pressure, velocity and valve opening and closing data. The results showed that the valve velocity and pressure difference increased when cardiac output increased, and the flow field distribution was consistent with 4D phase contrast MRI. A multi-modal experimental data set was constructed to verify the cardiac valve fluid-structure coupling model.
研究采用3D打印心脏插入件置于胸腔模体中，以16排CT扫描不同管电流（300、2: The study used a 3D printed cardiac insert placed in a chest phantom, and used 16-row CT scanning with different tube currents (300, 20 and 100, 50 mA) and combined filtered back projection and three iterative reconstruction algorithms to evaluate image noise, signal-to-noise ratio and contrast-to-noise ratio. The results showed that iterative reconstruction significantly reduced noise and improved signal-to-noise ratio and contrast-to-noise ratio.
研究采用3D打印心脏模型对医学生进行小班教学、形成性评估及课后复习，通过问卷和焦: The study used a 3D printed heart model to conduct small class teaching, formative assessment and after-class review for medical students. Through questionnaires and focus group surveys, it was found that 89% of students and 91% of teachers believed that the model was acceptable for assessment. Both parties believed that the model was realistic, consistent and had broad application potential.
研究采用3D打印截肢假肢套筒，内置三个气囊并配合微型泵阀系统，通过预设按键控制气: The study used a 3D printed amputation prosthetic sleeve with three built-in air bags and a micro-pump valve system. The air bags were inflated and deflated through preset buttons to control the inflation and deflation of the air bags. Under the simulated load of the standing phase, the residual limb interface pressure was dynamically adjusted. The results showed that the pressure in the posterior and medial areas was significantly reduced, with the pressure in the proximal area of the posterior area decreasing by 6.81%.
研究采用3D打印手术导板，集成灌溉通道，比较其在牙科种植手术中的温度控制效果，结: The study used a 3D printed surgical guide with integrated irrigation channels to compare its temperature control effect in dental implant surgery. The results showed that the built-in irrigation guide can more accurately control the intraosseous temperature, with peak temperature rises below 10°C and the narrowest temperature distribution.
研究采用3D打印技术为儿科患者制备呋塞米和西地那非片剂，所得片剂重量均一、含量均: This study uses 3D printing technology to prepare furosemide and sildenafil tablets for pediatric patients. The obtained tablets have uniform weight, content uniformity and dissolution behavior that meet the requirements of the European Pharmacopoeia. However, due to the interlayer structure and small batch production, it is recommended to additionally adjust the friability and compressive strength testing.
研究采用3D打印技术制作了5cm厚胸腔模拟体，以聚乳酸材料模拟组织密度并加入硫酸: The study used 3D printing technology to create a 5cm thick chest simulator, using polylactic acid material to simulate tissue density and adding barium sulfate to simulate bone density. A Gafchromic film was inserted to measure the dose distribution of the stereotactic radiotherapy plan in the lung and bone target areas. The results showed that the γ evaluation of the dose distribution in the lungs and bones were both ≥95% and about 85%, verifying the feasibility of this low-cost, tissue heterogeneity-simulating 3D printed body in radiotherapy quality control.
研究采用3D打印技术制作孕妇腹部实体模型，通过热释光剂量仪测量并对比两种CT协议: The study used 3D printing technology to make a solid model of the abdomen of pregnant women. The thermoluminescence dosimeter was used to measure and compare the actual measured and Monte Carlo simulated organ doses under the two CT protocols. The results showed that the dose difference of most organs was less than 20%, and the fetal head dose deviated by 50% under the 80kV protocol. The overall measurement and simulation results were consistent, verifying the applicability of the 3D printed model in the assessment of radiation dose to pregnant women.
研究采用3D打印技术制作患者特异性头模型，用于头部IMRT治疗的质控，结果显示其: The study used 3D printing technology to produce a patient-specific head model for quality control of head IMRT treatment. The results showed that its gamma pass rate in dose measurement and calculation comparison was 95.97% and 4.03% respectively, which is slightly lower than the standard method, but overall it is still highly feasible.
研究采用3D打印技术制作手术导板，实现无翻瓣微创冠状缝合切口，用于加速正畸牙移动: The study used 3D printing technology to produce surgical guides to achieve a flap-free minimally invasive coronal suture incision to accelerate orthodontic tooth movement. This technology avoids the flap operation of traditional coronal suture incisions, and no discomfort or complications were observed.
研究采用3D打印技术制作聚乳酸（PLA）假肢套筒，依据BS EN ISO 103: The research uses 3D printing technology to produce polylactic acid (PLA) prosthetic sleeves, and tests its tensile strength according to the BS EN ISO 10328 standard, combined with finite element analysis to optimize the design. The results show that the new sleeve is better than the traditional design in terms of load-bearing capacity and can withstand a load of more than 5000N. The material properties are inconsistent, so careful selection is required.
研究采用3D打印技术制作软质硅胶ERCP训练模型，通过模块化设计实现多种胆道操作: The study uses 3D printing technology to produce a soft silicone ERCP training model, which enables a variety of biliary operation training through modular design. The model can be used repeatedly and successfully complete operations such as bile duct intubation, stone removal, and balloon dilation under real-time fluorescence and endoscopic observation. The structure is stable and durable, and has good practicability and repeatability.
研究采用3D打印技术制备pH响应性肠靶向片剂，核心为含N-乙酰葡萄糖胺的甲基纤维: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare pH-responsive intestinal-targeted tablets. The core is methylcellulose gel containing N-acetylglucosamine. By optimizing the ratio of Eudragit® FS100 and PLA and the gel concentration, controllable drug release is achieved. The preparation has good printability, release performance and non-cytotoxicity, and supports personalized intestinal drug delivery.
研究采用3D打印技术制备不同浓度 ethosuximide 药物负载的海藻酸钠/: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare ethosuximide drug-loaded sodium alginate/polyethylene oxide scaffolds with different concentrations. The sustained-release performance was optimized by regulating the pore size and polymer concentration. The drug was continuously released for 2 hours in vitro, and the metabolic activity of nerve cells reached 130%, providing a feasible solution for local precise drug delivery in epilepsy.
研究采用3D打印技术制备不同组分和尺寸的纤维素乙酸酯壳层，包裹立即释普萘洛尔片，: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare cellulose acetate shells of different components and sizes, and wrapped them in immediate-release propranolol tablets. By adjusting the shell composition and structure, the drug release rate can be controlled and adjusted. The release process conforms to the Korsmeyer-Peppas non-Fickian diffusion model.
研究采用3D打印技术制备个性化药片，根据患者需求定制不同尺寸与形状的剂量形式，实: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare personalized tablets, and customize dosage forms of different sizes and shapes according to patient needs to achieve individualized drug delivery.
研究采用3D打印技术制备个性化药物，包括舌下、口溶和速溶制剂及缓释、多层环状片等: Research uses 3D printing technology to prepare personalized drugs, including complex dosage forms such as sublingual, orally dissolving and instant-dissolving preparations and sustained-release, multi-layer annular tablets, to achieve dose customization and on-demand production. However, there are problems such as uneven shape and porous structure. Current cost and regulatory adaptability are still the main factors limiting its widespread application.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了具备UV成像能力的扩散细胞，以实时观察布洛芬凝胶透过硅: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare diffusion cells with UV imaging capabilities to observe the penetration process of ibuprofen gel through the silica gel membrane in real time. The results confirmed that the device can achieve UV imaging and replace traditional HPLC detection, but attention must be paid to the interaction between the drug and PLA filament.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了具有可调释药特性的lornoxicam自纳米乳化药物递: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare lornoxicam self-nanoemulsifying drug delivery system (SNEDDS) encapsulated shells with adjustable drug release characteristics. By changing the shell geometry (such as opening mode and number of release windows), the drug release behavior was successfully controlled. The single-window shell achieved only 46% release within 3 hours, and the double-window and four-window shells achieved 66% and 82% release respectively.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了具有空心结构的零级缓释浮泡片，通过调节外壳厚度实现药物: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare zero-order sustained-release floating tablets with a hollow structure. By adjusting the shell thickness, the drug release was delayed and the floating time was prolonged. When the shell thickness was 0.5 mm (up and down) and 1.5 mm (lateral), the tablet showed no holes in the dissolution test, the floating time reached 540 minutes, and it continued to show near zero-order release for 720 minutes.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了具有缓释效果的氢氯噻嗪片剂，通过非典型半固态挤出与光固: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare hydrochlorothiazide tablets with sustained-release effects. The molding properties and in vitro release behavior of four formulations were compared through atypical semi-solid extrusion and light-curing processes. The results showed that F1SSE and F1DLP performed better in the SSE and DLP processes. All formulations met the European Pharmacopoeia single-dose formulation uniformity requirements, and showed sustained-release properties in hydrochloric acid and phosphate buffers.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了含普瑞巴林的浮泡缓释片，通过调节填充率和结构设计，发现: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare floating sustained-release tablets containing pregabalin. By adjusting the filling rate and structural design, it was found that high filling rates in closed systems can achieve zero-order drug release, while low filling rates in open systems release faster. The optimized formula F6 showed ideal sustained-release performance.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了新型“钻石状”微流控装置，用于生产载溶菌酶的PEG化脂: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a new "diamond-shaped" microfluidic device, which was used to produce PEGylated liposomes loaded with lysozyme to obtain liposomes with uniform particle sizes. In vitro release showed that 93% of the drug could be released, confirming that the combination of microfluidics and 3D printing has a good synergistic effect in the preparation of liposomes.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了柱状、环状及多层环状INH/PLLA缓释植入物，比较其: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare cylindrical, annular and multi-layer annular INH/PLLA sustained-release implants, and compared their in vitro drug release characteristics. The results showed that the multi-layer annular implant had the most stable release, with an initial burst release and then a stable concentration, and the remaining two groups gradually decreased, and the implant had good biocompatibility.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了用于诊断的侧向流动微流控芯片，将其集成至光学传感器，通: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a lateral flow microfluidic chip for diagnosis, integrated it into an optical sensor, and verified the performance of the chip in diagnostic experiments by real-time monitoring of the transmission intensity during the binding of HIV-1 oligonucleotide probes to the gold surface.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了羟基磷灰石/胶原/聚己内酯复合支架（HGSC），负载姜: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a hydroxyapatite/collagen/polycaprolactone composite scaffold (HGSC), loaded with curcumin, and used it to repair skull defects in rats. The results showed that the scaffold significantly promoted angiogenesis and bone regeneration.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了负载万古霉素的ZIF-8@GMP支架，通过原位生长ZI: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a vancomycin-loaded ZIF-8@GMP scaffold. By growing ZIF-8 nanoparticles in situ and modifying the gelatin matrix, it achieved sustained antibacterial, anti-inflammatory and osteoinductive functions. It showed 100% inhibition rate against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli, and significantly improved the proliferation and mineralization capabilities of MC3T3-E1 cells.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了载有200或400 µg华法林的个性化口服剂型，通过体: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare personalized oral dosage forms containing 200 or 400 µg of warfarin. Through in vitro and in vivo experiments, it was found that compared with liquid preparations, 3D printing dosage forms can release warfarin more smoothly, reduce the peak concentration, extend the peak time, and can achieve an increase in blood drug exposure equivalent to that of liquid preparations when the dose is doubled.
研究采用3D打印技术制备了酮胺盐控释浮泡片，通过热熔挤出和压力辅助注射成型，实现: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare ketoamine salt controlled-release floating tablets. Through hot-melt extrusion and pressure-assisted injection molding, the drug was slowly released in the shell layer, which complied with USP standards and showed complete release within 12 hours with a smooth and uniform surface, no component interference, and unchanged crystallinity.
研究采用3D打印技术制备伊曲康唑缓释片，对比不同填充密度对药物溶解性能的影响，发: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare itraconazole sustained-release tablets, and compared the effects of different filling densities on drug dissolution properties. It was found that low filling density promoted drug dissolution but reduced the reproducibility of printed parts.
研究采用3D打印技术制备伊维菌素缓释片，实现特定释放曲线的定制，验证了该技术在控: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare ivermectin sustained-release tablets to achieve customization of specific release curves, verifying the feasibility and flexibility of this technology in controlling drug release.
研究采用3D打印技术制备儿童用卡维地洛片，通过体外消化渗透、猪模型体内暴露及分子: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare carvedilol tablets for children. Through in vitro digestion and penetration, in vivo exposure in pig models and molecular dynamics simulations, it was shown that its permeability in the artificial lipid membrane was significantly higher than that of commercially available products, and the in vivo exposure was slightly higher but there was no statistical difference. The liposome component promotes drug penetration, verifying the feasibility of the absorption properties of 3D printed children's tablets.
研究采用3D打印技术制备具有不同散射和吸收特性的肿瘤仿生模型，嵌入固定浓度近红外: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare tumor bionic models with different scattering and absorption characteristics, embedded fixed concentrations of near-infrared fluorescent dyes and different non-specific fluorescent substances, and evaluated the variability of image quantification indicators in fluorescence imaging analysis through two imaging systems and two segmentation methods. The results showed that the bionic model can effectively demonstrate differences in tumor visualization sensitivity.
研究采用3D打印技术制备具有不同蜂窝结构数和通道长度的微流控阵列，通过调节总流量: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare microfluidic arrays with different numbers of honeycomb structures and channel lengths, and explored its impact on the formation of liposome nanoparticles by adjusting the total flow rate and flow ratio. The results showed that particle size was affected by flow parameters, changes in the number of honeycomb structures had no significant impact, and the size of the resulting liposomes was stable.
研究采用3D打印技术制备具有定制释药模式的多药胶囊，通过同心或并行结构设计实现多: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare multi-drug capsules with customized drug release modes, and achieves flexible combination and phased release of multiple drugs through concentric or parallel structural design, verifying the feasibility of its modular design in adapting to different treatment options.
研究采用3D打印技术制备具有精确光学性质的组织等效假体，构建基于MRI数据的早产: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare tissue-equivalent prostheses with precise optical properties, and constructs a premature infant cranial prosthesis based on MRI data. Its internal cavity is filled with scattering solution, and diffuse optical imaging is achieved by inserting a high-contrast target.
研究采用3D打印技术制备双室茶碱与泼尼松龙组合片，分别考察两药在不同剂量下的溶出: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare dual-chamber theophylline and prednisolone combination tablets, and examined the dissolution behavior of the two drugs at different doses. The results showed that the sustained release of theophylline was not affected by the second chamber, and the prednisolone release rate was related to the surface area to volume ratio. The dual-chamber design can achieve individualized doses and maintain similar release curves.
研究采用3D打印技术制备双层含多塞平盐口服膜，用于化疗所致口腔黏膜炎动物模型，结: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a double-layer oral film containing doxepin salt, which was used in an animal model of oral mucositis caused by chemotherapy. The results showed that the preparation can promote ulcer healing and achieve efficacy by reducing oxidative stress and excessive inflammatory response. It has the advantage of local sustained release compared with traditional methods.
研究采用3D打印技术制备可分离片剂，比较FDM与BJ工艺，通过不同刻度设计评估分: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare separable tablets, compared the FDM and BJ processes, and evaluated the dose uniformity, friability and porosity after splitting through different scale designs. The results showed that the quality of FDM tablets was more stable, and the quality variation after splitting was less than 2%, while the performance of BJ tablets after scale optimization and saline treatment was acceptable, which overall verified the potential of 3D printing in achieving precise dosage.
研究采用3D打印技术制备可咀嚼的阿莫西林软糖片，以玉米淀粉与蜂蜜凝胶为基质，获得: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare chewable amoxicillin gummy tablets, using corn starch and honey gel as the matrix to obtain a preparation with attractive appearance, good mechanical properties and almost complete drug release within 2 hours. Compared with existing dosage forms, it is more acceptable to children.
研究采用3D打印技术制备可定制化三联结构植入物，通过调节网络结构改变曲安奈德释放: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a customizable triple structure implant, and changed the release performance of triamcinolone acetonide by adjusting the network structure. The release amount under different structures ranged from 8.58 to 21.93 mg. The Higuchi model based on the first 15 days of data can effectively predict the 90-day release. The release characteristics vary with structural changes.
研究采用3D打印技术制备可降解微针，并通过深度学习模型预测其几何特征，基于十种设: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare degradable microneedles, and used a deep learning model to predict its geometric characteristics. A data set was constructed based on ten designs and different etching doses to achieve accurate prediction of microneedle characteristics under new preparation parameters.
研究采用3D打印技术制备可降解皮下植入物，针对甲基蓝、布洛芬钠和布洛芬酸等模型药: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare degradable subcutaneous implants. For model drugs such as methyl blue, ibuprofen sodium and ibuprofen acid, the impact of different designs on the drug release rate was evaluated in an in vitro model. The results showed that the release rate was affected by the implant design and drug properties. Adding a controlled release film can further delay the release, suggesting its potential in the treatment of chronic diseases.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含PEGylated liposomal doxorub: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare fish gelatin-carboxymethyl cellulose-based hydrogel patches containing PEGylated liposomal doxorubicin. By adjusting the formula and shape, local sustained release of nanomedicines was achieved. The results showed that drug release was affected by the patch morphology and UV-LED exposure time.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含咪康唑的舌下薄膜，其在体外显示80%药物在2小时内缓慢: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a sublingual film containing miconazole. In vitro, it showed that 80% of the drug was slowly released within 2 hours. It has good adhesion, has better permeability than commercially available oral gels, and has good physical and chemical stability. It provides a feasible topical administration solution for children with oral candidiasis.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含布洛芬的非晶固体分散体（ASD）tablet，通过改变: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare amorphous solid dispersion (ASD) tablets containing ibuprofen, and adjusted the dissolution behavior by changing the tablet size. Compared with pure ibuprofen tablets, the dissolution rate of ASD tablets was significantly increased, and the dissolution rate was increased by 35%.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含槲皮素的介孔钙硅酸盐/硫酸钙/聚ε-己内酯复合支架，比: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare mesoporous calcium silicate/calcium sulfate/poly-epsilon-caprolactone composite scaffold containing quercetin, and compared its cell viability, odontoblast protein expression and mineralization behavior of human dental pulp stem cells with pure mesoporous calcium silicate/calcium sulfate scaffold. The results showed that the MSCSQ scaffold significantly improved cell viability and odontoblast-related protein expression, and promoted dentin regeneration.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含氨氯地平和利血平的多药聚印片，利用便携式近红外光谱结合: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare multi-drug polyprints containing amlodipine and reserpine, and used portable near-infrared spectroscopy combined with partial least squares method to establish a calibration model to achieve non-destructive detection of the dosage of the two drugs, verifying the linearity, accuracy and specificity of the method.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含甲硝唑的阴道装置，通过改变聚己内酯比例和形状，评估其对: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a vaginal device containing metronidazole. By changing the proportion and shape of polycaprolactone, it evaluated its effect on metronidazole release and inhibiting the growth of Gardnerella. The results showed that the device can achieve sustained drug release, and the mesh structure releases faster, and discs can effectively inhibit the growth of Gardnerella.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含硼酸和5-氟尿嘧啶的聚乳酸复合材料，考察其机械性能、热: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare polylactic acid composite materials containing boric acid and 5-fluorouracil, and examined its mechanical properties, thermal stability and drug release behavior. The results showed that boric acid significantly improved the strength and ductility of the material, achieved sustained drug release for 15 days, and showed significant cytotoxicity in breast cancer cells.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含碱性磷酸酶的肠靶向片剂，通过优化层间距提升孔隙率，经P: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare intestinal-targeted tablets containing alkaline phosphatase. The porosity is increased by optimizing the layer spacing. After being coated with PEG1500, intestinal segmented release is achieved. The terminal ileum release is less than 8%, the colon is rapidly released, and the enzyme activity is stable, providing a personalized treatment plan for ulcerative colitis.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含缓释巴氯芬片的胃滞留浮漂装置，通过热熔挤出法制备缓释片: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a gastric retention floating device containing sustained-release baclofen tablets. The sustained-release tablets were prepared through hot-melt extrusion and packed into a PLA capsule with a double air chamber and four-window structure. In in vitro testing, the device continued to float in gastric juice and fully released the drug within 12 hours, achieving long-acting gastric drug delivery.
研究采用3D打印技术制备含芬氟拉明或辛可尼嗪的固态自微乳化药物递送系统，通过改变: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a solid self-microemulsifying drug delivery system containing fenfluramine or cinchonizine. The surface area to volume ratio was adjusted by changing the geometry. The dispersion kinetics of different shapes and traditional handmade cubes were compared. The results showed that the initial geometry affects the dispersion rate of the drug in the digestive medium.
研究采用3D打印技术制备多腔室异质肿瘤模拟物，各腔室填充不同活性的18F-FDG: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare multi-chamber heterogeneous tumor simulators. Each chamber was filled with 18F-FDG with different activities, and PET/CT was scanned after being embedded in a water bath. The results showed that the image can effectively separate and quantify the radioactivity of each chamber, but it is difficult to detect when it is less than 100 μCi.
研究采用3D打印技术制备多腔室聚合物胶囊，通过空间布局不同聚合物实现pH响应性，: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare multi-chamber polymer capsules, and realizes pH responsiveness through spatial layout of different polymers, achieving targeted drug release in the small intestine and colon, and achieving adjustable and precise local drug release control.
研究采用3D打印技术制备多面体微型片剂，通过调整其几何形状改变药物剂量，同时保持: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare polyhedral microtablets, and changes the drug dosage by adjusting their geometric shape while maintaining drug release kinetic characteristics.
研究采用3D打印技术制备微尺度PLA/MWCNT微电极，对比不同材料与尺寸电极，: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare microscale PLA/MWCNT microelectrodes. Comparing electrodes of different materials and sizes, it was found that the current density is higher and the background noise is lower. When used to detect cardiac troponin I, the detection limit in undiluted human serum reaches 7.4 pg mL⁻¹, which is about 19 times higher than that of macro electrodes.
研究采用3D打印技术制备微流控芯片，对比微流控与批量法制备的多柔比星微球，后者封: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare microfluidic chips, and compares doxorubicin microspheres prepared by microfluidics and batch methods. The latter has higher encapsulation efficiency and drug content, and the "V"-shaped partition structure release curve is consistent with the dialysis bag test. The chip has good biocompatibility and reuse stability.
研究采用3D打印技术制备微纳米结构钛合金牙植入物，经电化学纳米化和羟基磷灰石涂层: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare micro-nanostructured titanium alloy dental implants. After electrochemical nanonization and hydroxyapatite coating treatment, the results showed that it significantly improved protein adsorption, cell adhesion and spreading, and promoted osteoblast maturation and mineralization, indicating that this method can effectively improve osseointegration performance.
研究采用3D打印技术制备患者特异性多孔高密度聚乙烯颅面修复植入物，与现有临床标准: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare patient-specific porous high-density polyethylene craniofacial repair implants. Compared with existing clinical standard implants, its structure and material properties are better, and it shows good soft tissue and blood vessel regeneration capabilities in small animal models.
研究采用3D打印技术制备新型微阵列贴片，实现可调几何结构的微针阵列，可精准递送固: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare a new type of microarray patch to achieve a microneedle array with an adjustable geometry, which can accurately deliver solid and liquid loads and collect interstitial fluid on the body surface, improving the scalability and design flexibility of the microneedle patch.
研究采用3D打印技术制备浮罩装置，将硝苯地平渗透泵片与胃滞留浮罩结合，使药物在犬: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a floating cover device, and combined the nifedipine osmotic pump tablet with the gastric retention floating cover to allow the drug to remain in the stomach of dogs for more than 24 hours, improving its bioavailability and increasing the AUC from 10.20 to 26.54 ng/mL·h.
研究采用3D打印技术制备电极，通过电化学活化后表面修饰MXene（Ti3C2），: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare electrodes, and surface-modifies MXene (Ti3C2) after electrochemical activation to increase the specific capacitance of the electrode to nearly three times the original performance, providing a new path for optimizing the performance of 3D printed electrochemical capacitors.
研究采用3D打印技术制备罗匹尼罗缓释片，结合PBPK模型进行虚拟生物等效性试验，: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare ropinirole sustained-release tablets, combined with the PBPK model to conduct a virtual bioequivalence test, using Polpix as the reference preparation, inputting the model through Weibull fitting dissolution curve, and using parallel design simulation. 125 subjects could achieve 80% testing efficacy, confirming the virtual bioequivalence of the new preparation and the reference preparation.
研究采用3D打印技术制备羟丙基甲基纤维素基茶多酚负载凝胶薄膜，通过调整HPMC浓: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare hydroxypropyl methylcellulose-based tea polyphenol-loaded gel films. The viscosity was controlled by adjusting the HPMC concentration. Air drying and freeze-drying methods were compared. It was found that increasing the HPMC content delayed drug release. The preparation of films of different shapes enabled personalized and on-demand drug delivery, verifying the feasibility of semi-solid extrusion 3D printers in the preparation of film preparations.
研究采用3D打印技术制备聚乙烯吡咯烷酮与聚乙烯醇微针贴片，实现快速溶解并穿透动物: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare polyvinylpyrrolidone and polyvinyl alcohol microneedle patches, which can quickly dissolve and penetrate animal skin, and can be used to treat gum disease in cats and dogs. The patch size is adjustable and can be prepared and applied in a veterinary clinic in a short time.
研究采用3D打印技术制备聚乙烯醇基片剂，发现挤出速率和打印温度影响片剂成型及姜黄: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare polyvinyl alcohol-based tablets and found that extrusion rate and printing temperature affected tablet molding and curcumin release. Low filling density tablets floated in water and curcumin dissolved faster.
研究采用3D打印技术制备聚乳酸（PLLA）支架，其孔隙率为73%、平均孔径450: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare a polylactic acid (PLLA) scaffold with a porosity of 73%, an average pore diameter of 450 µm, a compressive modulus of 244 MPa, and a piezoelectric effect. After being coated with fibrinogen, it can promote the attachment and proliferation of MG63 osteoblasts and degrade slowly, showing good biocompatibility and bone regeneration potential.
研究采用3D打印技术制备聚醚醚酮（PEEK）患者特异性植入物，验证了其在重建手术: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare polyetheretherketone (PEEK) patient-specific implants, which verified its feasibility in reconstructing surgical defects and achieved a "bionic" design close to anatomical structures.
研究采用3D打印技术制备胃滞留浮泡片，以PLA丝材制成的双室装置实现长效浮游与缓: The study uses 3D printing technology to prepare gastric retention floating tablets. The dual-chamber device made of PLA filament achieves long-term floating and sustained release. By adjusting the size of the drug window and material properties, a sustained drug release of 10 hours is obtained, and the floating time exceeds 24 hours.
研究采用3D打印技术制备负载抗生素环丙沙星或抗炎药地塞米松的聚ε-己内酯（PCL: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare polyε-caprolactone (PCL) scaffolds loaded with the antibiotic ciprofloxacin or the anti-inflammatory drug dexamethasone. The results showed that the drugs maintained biological activity in the scaffolds and could effectively inhibit the growth of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and reduce the inflammatory response, and the drug release was dominated by diffusion.
研究采用3D打印技术制备透明光聚合物微流控传感器，通过表面修饰提升光传输效率，器: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare transparent photopolymer microfluidic sensors. The light transmission efficiency is improved through surface modification. The device does not contain autofluorescence and can achieve fluorescence measurement.

研究采用3D打印支架嵌入组织模拟凝胶制备无壁血管流动仿生模型，通过压痕测试和超声: The study used a 3D printed scaffold embedded in tissue simulation gel to prepare a wall-free vascular flow bionic model. 研究采用3D打印支架构建类似“夹心”结构的微流控装置，建立动态三维细胞培养微环境: The study uses 3D printed scaffolds to construct microfluidic devices with a "sandwich" structure to establish a dynamic three-dimensional cell culture microenvironment for cell research, tissue engineering and drug screening related to tumor treatment.
研究采用3D打印术前模板，将阻生第三磨牙自体移植至同侧严重损伤的磨牙位，通过树脂: The study used a 3D printed preoperative template to autotransplant the impacted third molar to the severely damaged molar position on the same side. The tooth shape was copied with resin to adjust the recipient socket. After 7 days, the affected tooth was extracted and immediately implanted. Periodontal healing was observed 6 months after the operation. The transplantation time was less than 5 seconds, and periodontal ligament cells were effectively preserved.
研究采用3D打印构建仿生异质多孔结构钛合金骨植入物，通过拓扑分析和有限元模拟显示: The study used 3D printing to construct a biomimetic heterogeneous porous structure titanium alloy bone implant. The digital image correlation method was used to measure the maximum equivalent strain of the implant neck reaching 0.7%, and the displacement was 0.466 mm. The results showed that the implant geometry affects the strain and displacement of the surrounding structures.

The channel and electrode structure were designed through multi-physics simulation. The microfluidic chip was prepared using PDMS and integrated with a 9-pole comb electrode. It was driven by a voltage of ±12 V and 75 kHz to achieve effective separation of 3 μm and 10 μm polystyrene particles.
研究采用3D打印模具结合多阶段成型，制备轻质复合材料手指，其在刚度和重量上优于3: The research uses 3D printing molds combined with multi-stage molding to prepare lightweight composite fingers, which are superior to 3D printing and aluminum fingers in terms of stiffness and weight, and are both customizable and low-cost.
研究采用3D打印模具通过微注塑成型制备了载药（10 wt%地塞米松）的豚鼠圆窗窝: The study used 3D printing molds to prepare drug-loaded (10 wt% dexamethasone) guinea pig round window implants through micro-injection molding. 研究采用3D打印牙科树脂修复体，分别用异丙醇和三丙二醇单甲醚溶液在3、5、10、: The study used 3D printed dental resin restorations, which were cleaned with isopropyl alcohol and tripropylene glycol monomethyl ether solutions at different times of 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, and 90 minutes. The results showed that extending the cleaning time increased cell viability and reduced cytotoxicity, but the flexural modulus of the 90-minute group was significantly lower than the other groups, and decreased as the cleaning time increased.

The results showed that the peak blood flow velocity and pressure gradient increased after surgery, and the simulation results were highly consistent with the MRI data.
研究采用3D打印生物反应器，通过迭代优化流速、细胞密度和灌注特性，实现骨替代支架: The study used a 3D printed bioreactor to achieve uniform distribution of cells in the bone replacement scaffold (uniformity coefficient 0.24) by iteratively optimizing flow rate, cell density and perfusion characteristics. 研究采用3D打印生物基PLA材料制作截肢者假肢套筒，通过数值模拟对比其在着地和推: The study used 3D printed bio-based PLA materials to make prosthetic sleeves for amputees, and compared the stress and deformation during the landing and push-off stages through numerical simulation. The results showed that the PLA sleeve was equivalent to traditional composite sleeves in terms of stress and deformation, and had the same stability.
研究采用3D打印的Derenzo、改良Hoffman及 quadrant bar: The study used 3D printed Derenzo, modified Hoffman and quadrant bar shadow models to compare the quality of Tc-99m planar gamma images under different energy windows (122, 140, 159 keV). The results showed that the 140 keV energy window was the best in terms of contrast, noise and structural similarity, and was better than other windows.
研究采用3D打印的V-打印 dentbase材料，通过不同表面处理方式修复后，发: The study used 3D printed V-printed dentbase material and repaired it through different surface treatment methods. It was found that the repair fracture strength of the 180-grit sandpaper plus silane treatment group was the highest, which was significantly better than the untreated group. There was no significant improvement in other treatment methods.
研究采用3D打印的乳牙根管治疗模型，比较不同直径和高度的氧化锆桩对冠根断裂强度的: The study used a 3D printed deciduous tooth root canal treatment model to compare the effects of zirconia posts of different diameters and heights on crown and root fracture strength. The results showed that the 1.5 mm diameter and 5.0 mm height post group had the highest fracture strength, and the 5.0 mm height was better than the 3.0 mm and 4.0 mm heights. The 2.0 mm diameter was better than the 1.5 mm diameter at the 3.0 mm and 4.0 mm heights.
研究采用3D打印的互联微通道支架，快速构建聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）微流控装置，: The study used 3D printed interconnected microchannel scaffolds to quickly construct polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) microfluidic devices, and achieved low-cost, customizable microfluidic system preparation through embedded molding, verifying its effective performance in fluid mixing and microsphere droplet generation.

研究采用3D打印的双层磁性心外膜贴片，利用磁力实现快速血管重建与靶向药物递送，该: The study uses a 3D printed double-layer magnetic epicardial patch to use magnetism to achieve rapid vascular reconstruction and targeted drug delivery. 研究采用3D打印的双药递送纳米粒子负载水凝胶，用于预防植入物相关由耐药细菌引起的: The study uses 3D printed dual-drug delivery nanoparticle-loaded hydrogels to prevent implant-related infections caused by drug-resistant bacteria.
研究采用3D打印的器官模型，基于SPECT/CT数据建立针对锝-99m和镥-17: The study used 3D printed organ models to establish organ-specific calibration factors for technetium-99m and lutetium-177 based on SPECT/CT data. 研究采用3D打印的头颅类异质假体，结合成像面板测定高剂量率 brachyther: The study used a 3D printed cranial heterogeneous prosthesis, combined with an imaging panel to measure the dwell time and source position in high dose rate brachytherapy, to achieve treatment verification, and to detect common errors such as catheter exchange, displacement and postloader error. The results showed that the thermal distribution simulated by the software was highly consistent with the experimental data, and the absolute errors in each area were less than 0.5°C.
研究采用3D打印的无泵微流控芯片，利用智能手机摄像记录羊血样本流动，通过计算机视: The study uses a 3D printed pump-free microfluidic chip, uses a smartphone camera to record the flow of sheep blood samples, and estimates cell concentration through computer vision, verifying that gravity-driven flow is feasible. The chip design affects the video quality, and the system can achieve cell counting and concentration estimation.
研究采用3D打印的标准化卵形根管模型，比较了三种根管充填技术的密封效果，结果显示: The study used a 3D printed standardized oval root canal model to compare the sealing effects of three root canal filling technologies. The results showed that the void volume of the single cone technology (SP-SC) was significantly lower than the other two technologies throughout the entire root canal length and was not affected by morphological changes, while the sealing effect of the continuous wave vertical compaction technology (AHP-CWC) in the apical 1/3 was significantly affected by the root canal morphology.
研究采用3D打印的生理型和骨质疏松样多孔支架，将SAOS-2和U2OS人成骨样细: The study used 3D printed physiological and osteoporosis-like porous scaffolds to culture SAOS-2 and U2OS human osteoblast-like cells under static and dynamic simulated microgravity conditions. The results showed that the high-porosity scaffold promoted cell adhesion and proliferation under dynamic conditions, and the cell metabolic activity continued to increase. The system has good biocompatibility.
研究采用3D打印的类似遮阳棚结构支架，负载根尖乳头干细胞（SCAPs）及BMP9: The study used a 3D-printed scaffold with a similar sunshade structure, loaded with apical papilla stem cells (SCAPs) and BMP9 or VEGF, and implanted it under the skin of nude mice. The results showed that SCAPs combined with BMP9 can promote new bone formation, but there was no significant improvement with the addition of VEGF. No new bone formation was seen in the blank scaffold and SCAPs plus GFP groups.
研究采用3D打印的聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）骨-韧带-骨（BLB）支架，通过: The study used a 3D printed polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bone-ligament-bone (BLB) scaffold to achieve mechanical stability between the severed scaphoid and lunate bone by injecting a gelatin methacrylate solution containing human mesenchymal stem cells or inoculating tendon-derived stem cells and performing cyclic deformation, and promoted cell migration and fibrin expression, providing a potential solution for SLIL repair.
研究采用3D打印空心微针经耳后手术途径穿刺大鼠耳蜗圆窗膜，安全、可靠地获取1μL: The study used a 3D printed hollow microneedle to puncture the round window membrane of the rat cochlea through a retroauricular surgical approach, and safely and reliably obtained 1 μL of cochlear fluid. Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry detected 620 proteins, including cochlin, a recognized cochlear fluid marker. There was no permanent damage to hearing after puncture, and the membrane healed completely within 72 hours.
研究采用3D打印结合机器学习和机器视觉技术，通过直接墨水书写制备厚度小于100: The research uses 3D printing combined with machine learning and machine vision technology to prepare orally disintegrating tablets with a thickness less than 100 µm through direct ink writing. Near-infrared spectroscopy and linear discriminant analysis are used to achieve 100% accurate classification of active ingredients. Partial least squares method is used to verify the dosage, with a coefficient of 0.96 to 0.99, showing that this technology can achieve rapid production and quality control.
研究采用3D打印结合浸渍加载法制备含双氯芬酸钠的口腔薄膜，系统考察浸渍时间、图案: The study used 3D printing combined with dipping loading method to prepare oral films containing diclofenac sodium. The effects of dipping time, pattern design and drug amount on drug loading and in vitro diffusion were systematically investigated. The results showed that the striped filling pattern film significantly increased the drug diffusion rate compared with the flat pattern, and the release rates of F4 and F6 films at 8 hours were 41.3% and 52.7% respectively, which was much lower than the 78.1% of the solution group.
研究采用3D打印结合熔融挤出技术制备核心-壳结构缓释片，对比直接压片，发现3D打: The study used 3D printing combined with melt extrusion technology to prepare core-shell structure sustained-release tablets. Compared with direct compression, it was found that the 3D-printed tablets released faster initially and had smooth subsequent release, achieving rapid onset and long-term maintenance.
研究采用3D打印聚乳酸支架，结合光聚合细胞载凝胶，实现MC3T3-E1前成骨细胞: The study used 3D printed polylactic acid scaffolds, combined with photopolymerized cell-laden gel, to achieve efficient and uniform seeding of MC3T3-E1 pre-osteoblast cells, constructing a hybrid tissue engineering scaffold that combines the advantages of rigid structure and soft matrix to support cell survival and proliferation.
研究采用3D打印聚乳酸材料制成含蜡填充的测试模型，内置铝片以评估平面X射线成像系: The study uses 3D printed polylactic acid material to make a wax-filled test model with built-in aluminum sheets to evaluate the spatial resolution, contrast, contrast-to-noise ratio and signal-to-noise ratio of the planar X-ray imaging system. The results show that the resolution is 1.57 and 1.80 lp/mm respectively. The contrast changes with the thickness. The CNR reaches 24.90 at 28mm and remains unchanged after 16mm. The signal-to-noise ratio remains above 5. This model can be used as an alternative to commercial phantoms in low-resource areas.
研究采用3D打印聚乳酸（PLA）制备定制化骨支架、药物缓释装置及诊断电极、假肢、: The research uses 3D printing polylactic acid (PLA) to prepare customized bone scaffolds, drug sustained release devices, diagnostic electrodes, prostheses, surgical instruments, etc., which are used in tissue engineering, drug delivery, and clinical diagnosis and treatment, demonstrating its wide application and practical value in the biomedical field.
研究采用3D打印聚己内酯框架作为机械支撑，填充 tragacanth gum-4: The study used a 3D printed polycaprolactone frame as a mechanical support and filled tragacanth gum-45S5 bioglass as an osteoinductive component to construct a multi-chamber scaffold. The results showed that it has good biological activity, mechanical properties, cell adhesion, proliferation and osteogenesis capabilities, and significantly improved the osteoinductive effect.
研究采用3D打印聚己内酯框架复合羟基磷灰石和β-磷酸三钙颗粒，构建具有高孔隙率和: The study used 3D printed polycaprolactone framework composite hydroxyapatite and β-tricalcium phosphate particles to construct a hybrid scaffold with high porosity and good microstructural connectivity. Compared with pure PCL framework and ceramic particle-free scaffolds, it showed better cell proliferation and alkaline phosphatase activity in vitro, and had good bone conduction properties.
研究采用3D打印胰腺和肾脏假体，模拟人体情况，比较不同重建参数对111In-ex: The study used 3D printed pancreas and kidney prostheses to simulate the human body and compared the effects of different reconstruction parameters on the quantitative uptake of 111In-exendin in the pancreas. The results showed that the Hybrid Recon software had the best reconstruction effect under 6 iterations and 16 subsets.
研究采用3D打印胰腺和肾脏假体，模拟人体胰岛素细胞显像中胰腺与肾脏摄取差异，通过: The study used 3D printed pancreas and kidney prostheses to simulate the difference in pancreas and kidney uptake in human insulin cell imaging. By comparing the reconstruction parameters of the two softwares, it was found that Hybrid Recon combined with 6 iterations and 16 subsets can optimally achieve pancreatic uptake quantification.
研究采用3D打印血流模型，验证4D流体心血管磁共振在TIPS支架内的测量准确性，: The study used a 3D printed blood flow model to verify the measurement accuracy of 4D fluid cardiovascular magnetic resonance in the TIPS stent. The results showed that it was highly correlated with the measurement values of the flow sensor and two-dimensional phase contrast magnetic resonance, and had good consistency among different observers.
研究采用3D打印装置在离体猪眼球模型中比较periocular给药的药物横向扩散: The study used a 3D printed device to compare the lateral diffusion of drugs administered periocularly in an isolated porcine eyeball model. The device is superior to Franz cells and can effectively preserve the structural integrity of the eyeball and enable assessment of drug diffusion in the inner wall of the eye.
研究采用3D打印解剖真实鼠模型，比较了FLASH与常规剂量率电子照射在不同鼠体区: The study used 3D printed anatomical real mouse models to compare the dose distribution differences between FLASH and conventional dose rate electron irradiation in different mouse body areas. The results showed that the dose difference and deviation from the prescribed dose between FLASH and CONV irradiation were reduced, and the repeatability between institutions was good.
研究采用3D打印超锐微针，在体外对豚鼠耳蜗的圆窗膜进行穿刺，微针尖端半径500: The study used 3D printed ultra-sharp microneedles to puncture the round window membrane of the guinea pig cochlea in vitro. The microneedle tip radius was 500 nm, the needle shaft radius was 50 μm, and the puncture was achieved with a force of 1.19 mN. An oval hole was formed with a length of about the diameter of the needle shaft and a width of about 25%. The direction of the hole was consistent with the direction of the fibers in the membrane. During the puncture process, the fibers separated rather than torn, indicating that the puncture damage was small and self-healing.
研究采用3D打印通风面罩和鼻腔插管两种方式，在内镜颅底手术中实现气密屏障，前者在: The study uses two methods, 3D printed ventilation mask and nasal intubation, to achieve an airtight barrier in endoscopic skull base surgery. The former is more flexible during anterior surgery, while the latter has better sealing during posterior surgery. Both of them reduce the generation of aerosols.
研究采用3D打印钙磷酸骨支架，内置姜和蒜提取物，通过双模孔结构实现药物缓释，结果: The study used a 3D printed calcium phosphate bone scaffold with built-in ginger and garlic extracts to achieve sustained drug release through a dual-mode pore structure. The results showed that it significantly promoted bone formation, enhanced early osteoid tissue formation and bone mineralization, and inhibited osteoclast activity.
研究采用3D打印钻引导器，辅助在骨质疏松股骨近端锯骨模型中准确放置导丝，针对三种: The study used a 3D printed drill guide to assist in the accurate placement of guide wires in the osteoporotic proximal femoral saw bone model, and achieved guide wire positioning for three implant systems. CT image analysis showed that the guide wire positions of each system deviated little from the ideal model, and the guide wire may be displaced when multiple guide wires are placed.
研究采用3D打印鼻拭子与标准鼻咽拭子对比，分别采集医院工作人员及确诊患者样本，结: The study compared 3D printed nasal swabs with standard nasopharyngeal swabs, collecting samples from hospital staff and confirmed patients respectively. The results showed that the two swabs were completely consistent in virus detection and cell material recovery, indicating that 3D printed swabs are feasible and acceptable.
研究采用3D扫描、CAD设计和增材制造技术，针对截肢患者定制胫骨假肢套筒，提出一: The study uses 3D scanning, CAD design and additive manufacturing technology to customize tibial prosthetic sleeves for amputee patients, and proposes a low-cost individualized design and production method to achieve the design and production of customized sleeves with optimized functions.
