研究采用3D激光扫描结合快速成型技术，基于患者解剖数据定制踝足矫形器，其在步态功: The study uses 3D laser scanning combined with rapid prototyping technology to customize ankle and foot orthoses based on patient anatomy data. Its gait function is equivalent to prefabricated polypropylene orthoses and has a better fit.
研究采用3D生物打印技术制备了不同设计的含左氟沙星抗菌支架，用于糖尿病足溃疡治疗: The study used 3D bioprinting technology to prepare levofloxacin-containing antibacterial stents of different designs for the treatment of diabetic foot ulcers. The stents have excellent mechanical properties and can achieve sustained drug release for 4 weeks, proving the innovative potential of bioprinting in the treatment of diabetic foot ulcers.
研究采用3D生物打印技术开发基于HPMC的安慰剂水凝胶基质系统，用于制备透皮给药: The study uses 3D bioprinting technology to develop a placebo hydrogel matrix system based on HPMC for the preparation of transdermal drug delivery patches, aiming to achieve personalized drug delivery for wound healing and explore its application potential in transdermal drug delivery systems.
研究采用3D生物打印技术构建含多种水凝胶墨水的微流控平台，成功在芯片上培养多药耐: The study used 3D bioprinting technology to construct a microfluidic platform containing a variety of hydrogel inks, and successfully cultured the multidrug-resistant lung cancer cell line H69AR on the chip. The cell viability of the 3% sodium alginate + 7% gelatin + 90% 0.9% NaCl group was the highest, reaching 127.2% and 105.4% of the control group at 24 hours and 48 hours respectively.
研究采用3D纤维沉积技术，制备了含10 wt%β-磷酸三钙的Ti6Al4V混合多: The study used 3D fiber deposition technology to prepare a Ti6Al4V hybrid porous scaffold containing 10 wt% β-tricalcium phosphate. By optimizing the powder ratio and process parameters, a controllable pore structure was achieved. The scaffold has both the mechanical properties of bone tissue and surface bioactivity. It has been initially shown that the addition of TCP can improve the bioactivity of metal alloys.
研究采用42例患者特异性3D打印神经血管模型，模拟急性大血管闭塞卒中下的机械取栓: The study used 42 patient-specific 3D printed neurovascular models to simulate the mechanical thrombectomy process under acute large vessel occlusion stroke, and found that the degree of thrombus torsion in the MCA region has the most significant impact on the success of thrombectomy.
研究采用45度层间角FDM技术打印PLA基牙冠，对比天然牙釉质，评估其抗拉、抗压: The study used 45-degree interlayer angle FDM technology to print PLA-based crowns, and compared it with natural enamel to evaluate its tensile strength, compressive strength, hardness and saliva absorption properties. The results showed that PLA-based crowns are feasible in terms of mechanical properties and can be used as an alternative to traditional crown materials.
研究采用4D打印技术制备了自组装的聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯（PEGDA）微支架，通过模: The study used 4D printing technology to prepare self-assembled polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) microscaffolds. The coverage effect of different designed scaffolds was evaluated through an in vitro model simulating articular cartilage damage. It was found that the hexagonal microscaffold (750 μm × 30) and methylcellulose solution injected into the model cartilage defect had a coverage rate of 73.3%, and achieved successful anchoring and survival of chondrocytes, verifying the feasibility of this technology in osteochondral tissue engineering.
研究采用5具人骨标本，通过定制3D打印钻引导器辅助完成颈椎及上胸椎横突和椎体螺钉: The study used 5 human bone specimens, and used customized 3D printed drill guides to assist in drilling cervical and upper thoracic transverse processes and vertebral body screws. The minimization and optimization designs were compared. The results showed that the optimized design was better in terms of entry point and three-dimensional angle accuracy, and the drill guide design improved the accuracy of screw positioning.
研究采用72个上颌空心模型，分别测试不同外壳厚度（2mm、4mm）和打印方向（0: The study used 72 maxillary hollow models to test the effects of different shell thicknesses (2mm, 4mm) and printing directions (0°, 10°, 20°) on the accuracy of SLA printing molds. The results showed that there was no significant difference in the accuracy of printing molds under various conditions.
研究采用88 wt.%水基浆料通过 robocasting 3D打印制备氧化锆牙: The research uses 88 wt.% water-based slurry to prepare zirconia dental restorations through robocasting 3D printing. After sintering, the density reaches 97% of the theoretical value. Compared with the real extracted teeth, the structural shape of the obtained prototype teeth can be effectively matched.
研究采用AQbD方法，建立并验证了用于3D打印制剂中氰钴胺（B12）测定的稳定性: The study used the AQbD method to establish and verify a stability-indicating HPLC method for the determination of cyanocobalamin (B12) in 3D printed preparations. Key parameters were determined through forced degradation experiments and risk assessments, and the buffer pH, initial methanol content and gradient slope were optimized to achieve the robustness and predictability of the method. It was successfully applied to impurity analysis, drug loading determination and in vitro release research.
研究采用Affinisol™ HPMC HME 15LV与硝苯地平制备FDM 3: The study used Affinisol™ HPMC HME 15LV and nifedipine to prepare FDM 3D printed tablets. Combining rheological studies, Flory-Huggins theory and phase diagram prediction, the printing temperature, drug loading and filling density were optimized. Long-term physical stability was evaluated through XRD, DSC and polarizing microscopy. The results showed that this method can effectively improve the physical stability of printed tablets and achieve efficient screening and process optimization without complete material characterization.
研究采用CAD技术设计了新型膝上假肢的3D模型，通过SolidWorks构建液压: The study used CAD technology to design a 3D model of a new type of above-the-knee prosthetic limb. SolidWorks was used to build the hydraulic cylinder component and conduct static analysis to verify that it could bear a load of 120 kilograms. 3D printing and assembly were then completed to optimize the prosthetic limb structure.
研究采用CBCT与CAD-CAM软件设计制作聚乳酸3D打印手术导板，用于无咬合接: The study uses CBCT and CAD-CAM software to design and produce polylactic acid 3D printed surgical guides for minimally invasive implantation of dental implants without occlusal contact, and to clarify its application method in implant surgery.
研究采用DLP 3D打印技术制备不同PEEK含量（0%、5%、10%）的聚乙基丙: The study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare polyethyl acrylate composite materials with different PEEK contents (0%, 5%, 10%). Through dry sliding wear tests and surface analysis, it was found that the 10% PEEK group was the best in terms of microstructural integrity, element uniformity and wear resistance, and was superior to other groups.
研究采用DLP 3D打印技术制备了含不同固含量硅纳米填料的牙科纳米复合树脂，结果: The study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare dental nanocomposite resins containing silicon nanofillers with different solid contents. The results showed that the 19% wt solid content group was the best in terms of mechanical properties and biocompatibility, and has the potential to be used in crown and bridge repairs.
研究采用DLP 3D打印技术制备含气动端口的基底和PDMS模具，优化对称微流道结: The study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare the substrate and PDMS mold containing pneumatic ports, optimized the symmetrical microfluidic structure parameters, verified the printing accuracy of the slope structure, and demonstrated the fluid control function of the integrated microfluidic device through dye solution. The results showed that the device operated as expected.
研究采用DLP 3D打印技术制备酮洛芬控释片，通过热分析、FTIR、NMR确认药: The study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare ketoprofen controlled-release tablets. Thermal analysis, FTIR, and NMR were used to confirm that the drug was stable in the polymer matrix. The in vitro release showed that the release amount was less than 20% within 24 hours and the shape was uniform. Caco-2 cell experiments showed that it has good biocompatibility and no cytotoxicity.
研究采用DLP 3D打印技术，以含不同比例原子oxetine盐的光敏悬浮液制备个: The study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare personalized tablets from photosensitive suspensions containing different proportions of atomic oxetine salts, with dosages ranging from 12.21 to 40.07 mg. All tablets achieved sustained release for 8 hours. Only the high-content group showed significant differences in mechanical strength, and no drug-polymer interaction was seen.
研究采用DLP 3D打印技术，制备了不同活性成分和聚合物体系的光敏分散体及表片，: The study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare photosensitive dispersions and tablets with different active ingredients and polymer systems. The effects of the molecular weight of PEGDA and the DPPO/RT system on the dissolution behavior and structure of the tablets were compared. The results showed that different formulas can control the dissolution rate and physical properties of the tablets to achieve personalized dosage design.
研究采用DLP打印技术制备全弓临时义齿，分析不同后固化处理方式对义齿变形的影响，: The study used DLP printing technology to prepare full-arch temporary dentures, and analyzed the effects of different post-curing treatment methods on denture deformation. The results showed that different post-curing treatment methods lead to differences in the degree of denture deformation.
研究采用DLP技术直接打印个性化微流控芯片，通过开放通道设计结合透明胶带密封，解: The research uses DLP technology to directly print personalized microfluidic chips, and uses open channel design combined with transparent tape sealing to solve the problem of easy clogging of printed microchannels and achieve rapid manufacturing of complex microstructures.
研究采用DMLS工艺制备Ti-6Al-4V合金样品，通过不同压力和介质的喷丸处理: The study used the DMLS process to prepare Ti-6Al-4V alloy samples. Through shot peening with different pressures and media, it was found that shot peening improved the corrosion behavior of the alloy in Ringer solution.
研究采用Dowsil 732材料，通过优化直接墨水书写方法，建立高效精准的3D打: The study used Dowsil 732 material and optimized the direct ink writing method to establish an efficient and accurate 3D printing microfluidic device preparation process. The model accuracy exceeded 95%. Micromixers, concentration gradient generators and droplet generators were successfully prepared, verifying the functional feasibility of this method.
研究采用EPC材料制成肾 体模，嵌入PA-GF肾结石材料，分别在80、100、1: The study used EPC material to make a kidney phantom, embedded it with PA-GF kidney stone material, and tested it under 80, 100, and 120 kV exposure respectively. The results showed that its density, CT value, electron density, and effective dose were all consistent with the literature, and the minimum detectable stone size was 2 mm.
The study used FDM 3D printing technology to prepare gastric retention buoyancy tablet shells containing metronidazole, and optimized different pore sizes. The resulting 0.5 mm pore size sample floated in 0.1 N HCl for more than 345 minutes and achieved zero-order drug release, indicating that 3D printing technology can effectively construct gastric retention buoyancy tablet shells.
研究采用FDM 3D打印技术，利用热熔挤出法制备酮洛芬载丝，分别制备即释和缓释片: The study used FDM 3D printing technology and hot-melt extrusion to prepare ketoprofen-loaded filaments, and prepared immediate-release and sustained-release tablets respectively. The results showed that Kollicoat® IR-based filaments are suitable for immediate-release tablets, and HPMC-based filaments are suitable for sustained-release tablets. Both achieved uniform structure and stable release. The in vitro dissolution complied with USP standards, and the simulation predictions were consistent with the actual data.
研究采用FDM 3D打印技术，将酮洛芬制成聚乙烯醇胶囊，通过调节壳体几何结构和内: The study used FDM 3D printing technology to make ketoprofen into polyvinyl alcohol capsules. By adjusting the shell geometry and internal density, immediate-release, sustained-release and delayed-release designs were achieved. Combined with in vitro dissolution, micro-CT and in vitro pharmacokinetic simulation, it was confirmed that the shell structure and density can regulate the release behavior. The similarity factor f2≥50 of immediate-release and sustained-release capsules simulated and predicted the pharmacokinetic characteristics of different release types.
研究采用FDM技术制备含不同格栅结构的3D打印片，通过水溶性PVA丝材构建，比较: The study used FDM technology to prepare 3D printed sheets containing different grid structures, which were constructed with water-soluble PVA filaments, and compared their dissolution rates. The results showed that the specific surface area of the grid structure was positively correlated with the mass loss rate, and the diamond-shaped structure had the highest dissolution activity.
研究采用FFF 3D打印PEEK植入物，经氩或氧等离子体表面处理，结果显示氧等离: The study used FFF 3D printed PEEK implants, which were surface treated with argon or oxygen plasma. The results showed that oxygen plasma treatment significantly improved the hydrophilicity of the PEEK surface and the adhesion, proliferation and differentiation of SAOS-2 osteoblasts, and its biological activity was better than that of argon plasma treatment.
研究采用FFF三维打印制造微流控微混合器，通过实验设计考察工艺参数对混合性能的影: The study uses FFF three-dimensional printing to manufacture microfluidic micromixers, and examines the impact of process parameters on mixing performance through experimental design. The results show that the geometric features in the printed microchannels can be used as corrugated structures, which can improve the mixing effect without additional complex design.
研究采用FFF技术制备CF/PEEK支架，系统考察了打印角度、碳纤维含量及热处理: The study used FFF technology to prepare CF/PEEK scaffolds. The effects of printing angle, carbon fiber content and heat treatment on bending properties were systematically investigated. It was found that 45° printing angle combined with 5% carbon fiber content can optimize mechanical properties and fracture toughness, and this combination establishes a predictable relationship between different parameters.
研究采用FRESH 3D打印技术制备模仿骨小梁结构的胶原支架，与二维胶原涂层及聚: The study used FRESH 3D printing technology to prepare a collagen scaffold that mimics the structure of trabecular bone. Compared with two-dimensional collagen coating and polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) scaffold, the results showed that it has a complex three-dimensional network structure, excellent mechanical properties and osteoinductive ability, which is better than two-dimensional collagen and comparable to PEGDA.
研究采用GPU加速的蒙特卡洛模拟框架，结合3D打印固体仿生体，实验验证了不同荧光: The research uses a GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo simulation framework, combined with 3D printed solid bionic bodies, to experimentally verify the fluorescence signals under different fluorescence concentrations, absorption and scattering parameters, and geometric structures. The results show that the simulation is highly consistent with the experiment, accurately reflecting phenomena such as nonlinear quenching, intensity changes with volume, and depth attenuation.
研究采用HEK293细胞测试了3D打印聚乳酸（PLA）摇瓶，结果显示其可替代现有: The study used HEK293 cells to test 3D printed polylactic acid (PLA) shake flasks, and the results showed that it can replace the existing single-use plastic shake flasks, and is low-cost and independent in supply, while other low-cost materials cannot support cell growth due to cytotoxicity or VOC issues.
研究采用Kennedy II类1型缺牙下颌模型，通过选择性激光熔融技术制备可摘局: The study used a Kennedy Class II type 1 edentulous mandibular model, and used selective laser melting technology to prepare a removable partial denture frame. The effects of 0°, 45° and -45° forming angles on the frame deformation, the number of supporting structures and internal defects were compared. The results showed that the deformation was the smallest under the 0° condition, the 45° and -45° groups had many internal defects, and the -45° group had the lowest surface roughness.
研究采用LCD 3D打印技术结合实验设计，优化层高和曝光时间等关键参数，制备聚乙: The research uses LCD 3D printing technology combined with experimental design to optimize key parameters such as layer height and exposure time to prepare polyvinyl alcohol microneedle molds. It successfully achieves precise customization of microneedles of various geometric shapes, and the skin penetration performance can be controlled by adjusting the microneedle structure.
研究采用LCD基3D打印技术制备PDMS微流控装置模具，评估多种树脂的细胞相容性: The study used LCD-based 3D printing technology to prepare PDMS microfluidic device molds, evaluated the cytocompatibility of various resins, optimized printing parameters and determined the minimum feature size, verifying the cellular response of the microfluidic platform in chemotherapy and targeted therapy and the migration behavior of cancer cells and fibroblasts in a 3D environment.
研究采用NIR和拉曼光谱法对SLS 3D打印的固体制剂进行无损检测，结果显示两种: The study used NIR and Raman spectroscopy to conduct non-destructive testing of SLS 3D printed solid formulations. The results showed that the two methods have high accuracy and reliability in predicting crystallinity and quantitative analysis, and can effectively evaluate amorphous content.
研究采用PAM基3D打印技术制备了二甲双胍丙二醇单水合物自纳米乳化片，该片剂在接: The study used PAM-based 3D printing technology to prepare metformin propylene glycol monohydrate self-nanoemulsifying tablets. The tablets formed a nanoemulsion with a particle size of 104.7±3.36 nm after contact with gastrointestinal fluid, showing immediate release characteristics, and the drug molecules were dispersed in the solid matrix and completely embedded in the tablet structure.
研究采用PLA、cHAP和rGO构建复合支架，通过nTopology软件设计Gy: The study used PLA, cHAP and rGO to build a composite scaffold, and used nTopology software to design a Gyroid lattice structure and 3D print it. The results showed that its energy absorption capacity was 20% higher than the traditional structure, and its thermal stability was improved by 15%. However, there was a slight unevenness in the wire diameter during the printing process.
研究采用PLA与聚乙烯醇-硝苯地平复合物制备表面面积恒定的3D打印片剂，比较圆、: The study used PLA and polyvinyl alcohol-nifedipine complex to prepare 3D printed tablets with constant surface area, and compared the effects of four inner cavity geometries of circle, hexagon, square, and triangle on the release of nifedipine. The results showed that the triangular and hexagonal structures released the slowest, and the circular and square structures completed the release within 12 hours, and the increase in the inner cavity volume can accelerate the release rate.
研究采用PLA丝材3D打印制备PDMS模具，经氯仿蒸气处理后表面光滑，用于铸造P: The study used PLA filament 3D printing to prepare PDMS molds. After treatment with chloroform vapor, the surface was smooth and used to cast PDMS micropores. The resulting PDMS-glass micropore structure had no leakage and supported the culture of monocyte-derived dendritic cells. The cell morphology and secreted factors were normal.
研究采用PLA材料3D打印制备了直径200 mm的组织等效 体模，其密度和线性衰: The study used PLA material 3D printing to prepare a tissue-equivalent phantom with a diameter of 200 mm. Its density and linear attenuation coefficient are close to muscles, soft tissues and water. The HU value is within the soft tissue range and is equivalent to the RW3 standard phantom. It is suitable for dose measurement of cobalt-60 HDR intracavitary radiotherapy.
研究采用Polyjet 3D打印技术，通过复合层设计调节材料硬度与压缩模量，构建: The research uses Polyjet 3D printing technology to adjust the material hardness and compression modulus through composite layer design to build an anatomical model with tissue bionic performance. It uses neural networks and genetic algorithms to optimize design parameters to achieve precise control of the hardness of the target tissue.
研究采用QbD指导的3D打印技术，通过响应面法优化温度、层厚和密度参数，制备了缓: The study used QbD-guided 3D printing technology and optimized temperature, layer thickness and density parameters through response surface methodology to prepare sustained-release metformin tablets, which formed homogeneous amorphous dispersion inside, achieving zero-order release kinetics and releasing 90% within 12 hours. The release behavior is similar to Glucophage® XR, which is mainly released through simple diffusion.
研究采用SSE 3D打印制备多层口腔速溶薄膜，通过添加孔形成剂构建多孔结构，证实: The study used SSE 3D printing to prepare multi-layer oral instant films, and added pore formers to build a porous structure. It was confirmed that the pore former content is related to mechanical properties. The resulting film has good disintegration properties and can be used as a base for inkjet printing.
研究采用SSE 3D打印技术，以对乙酰氨基酚和塞来昔布为模型药物，制备了剂量灵活: The study used SSE 3D printing technology and used acetaminophen and celecoxib as model drugs to prepare flexible-dose crystalline solid dispersion oral tablets, which verified that it can achieve rapid small-batch production of multiple dosage ranges at room temperature, while maintaining the crystalline state and immediate release characteristics of the active ingredients.
研究采用VAT光聚合3D打印技术制备含利培酮的长效皮下植入物，比较不同聚合物体系: The study used VAT photopolymerization 3D printing technology to prepare long-acting subcutaneous implants containing risperidone, and compared the release properties of different polymer systems. Among them, R2L2P76 and R2P78 implants showed drug release capabilities of up to 300 days and 100 days in vitro, and showed good biocompatibility in 3T3 cells.
研究采用Voronoi拓扑结构设计，对比了梯度厚度（STG）与梯度种子间距（SS: The study adopted Voronoi topology design and compared bionic bone implants with gradient thickness (STG) and gradient seed spacing (SSG) strategies and uniform pore structure (UNI). The results showed that the SSG strategy was superior to STG in terms of elastic modulus, fatigue performance and fluid transmission, and the energy absorption and yield strength were equivalent to UNI. The fluid properties in its core region were more conducive to bone tissue differentiation.
研究采用X射线μCT结合流动细胞溶解装置，实时可视化多孔缓释3D打印片在溶解过程: The study used X-ray μCT combined with a flow cell dissolution device to visualize in real time the internal structural changes and solvent intrusion dynamics of porous sustained-release 3D printed tablets during the dissolution process, and to examine the impact of flow rate on drug release. 16 mL/min was the appropriate flow rate, and the data obtained were consistent with the results of the standard in vitro dissolution test (f2=77%).
研究采用mSLA技术制作膝关节解剖模型与手术导板，通过ITK-SNAP和Siem: The study used mSLA technology to produce knee joint anatomical models and surgical guides. ITK-SNAP and Siemens NX were used to achieve segmentation and modeling. They were molded using an Anycubic Photon Mono 4K printer and tested using MCA II and TalyScan 150. The results showed that the geometric accuracy reached ±0.3 mm and the surface roughness Sa ranged from 2 to 2.5 µm.
研究采用三种商用UV固化树脂，通过立体光刻技术制备模拟动脉粥样硬化血管的模型，结: The study used three commercial UV-curable resins and used stereolithography technology to prepare a model that simulates atherosclerotic blood vessels. The results show that PBS soaking can improve the dynamic mechanical stability of the material, and UV-C irradiation can adjust the material hardness quickly and at low cost. After treatment with PBS, the material used can effectively simulate the mechanical properties of atherosclerotic blood vessels.
研究采用三种方法将万古霉素负载于3D打印的PLA-羟基磷灰石支架中，结果显示所有: The study used three methods to load vancomycin into 3D printed PLA-hydroxyapatite scaffolds. The results showed that all methods had significant antibacterial effects and cytocompatibility. Among them, the dipping and drop-coating methods showed a rapid release of 80-90% in the first 60 minutes, and the 3D printing method achieved sustained release lasting more than 7 days.
研究采用三种聚乳酸与导电碳材料制成的3D打印电极，通过不同有机溶剂（丙酮、二氯甲: The research uses 3D printed electrodes made of three types of polylactic acid and conductive carbon materials, which are activated by soaking in different organic solvents (acetone, methylene chloride, etc.) for different times. Combining surface wettability, scanning electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy analysis and voltammetry detection, it is found that the combination of specific solvents and activation time can significantly improve the electrode performance, and it performs best when detecting ferricyanomethanol.
研究采用三维分析对比标准钛网与患者特制“混合”植入物在眶底骨折修复中的效果，结果: The study used three-dimensional analysis to compare the effects of standard titanium mesh and patient-specific "hybrid" implants in repairing orbital floor fractures. The results showed that 3D printed orbital models can improve reconstruction accuracy and shorten operation time.
研究采用三维打印与真空微模塑技术制备气体驱动溶解微针，通过优化模具与配方，实现药: The study uses three-dimensional printing and vacuum micro-molding technology to prepare gas-driven dissolving microneedles. By optimizing the mold and formula, the drug loading capacity and transdermal efficiency are significantly improved. The microneedle integrity rate and drug release performance are superior to traditional microneedles.
研究采用三维打印技术制作个性化假牙模型，将设计好的假牙与托盘模型叠加，设定200: The research uses 3D printing technology to make personalized denture models. The designed dentures and tray models are superimposed. After setting a gap of 200 μm, the dental tray mold is printed, and then traditional artificial teeth are embedded and resin filling and polishing are completed according to conventional methods, forming a new method of digital denture production that can replace traditional processes.
研究采用三维打印技术制备个性化牙科麻醉贴片，装载利多卡因，可精准贴合患牙并持续释: The research uses 3D printing technology to prepare personalized dental anesthesia patches, loaded with lidocaine, which can accurately fit the affected teeth and continuously release the drug for more than 1 hour. The drug release can be controlled by adjusting the shape of the patch, and drug testing can be achieved using 3D dental models.
研究采用三维打印技术制备载抗生素的钙磷酸骨替代物，用于治疗骨科植入物相关骨感染，: The study uses three-dimensional printing technology to prepare antibiotic-loaded calcium phosphate bone substitutes for the treatment of bone infections related to orthopedic implants. Compared with PMMA loaded with vancomycin, this scaffold can significantly reduce bacterial load and reduce bone destruction, especially when combined with rifampicin release.
研究采用三维打印技术设计全脸口罩，通过贴合度、过滤效果及临床安全性测试，验证其在: The study used 3D printing technology to design a full-face mask, and verified its practicability in preventing aerosol transmission through fit, filtration effect and clinical safety tests. The results showed that it is comfortable to wear, has clear vision, has no obvious adverse reactions, and can effectively block the spread of aerosols.
研究采用三维数值模型模拟激光熔覆生物活性玻璃涂层在超细晶纯钛基体上的过程，通过有: The study uses a three-dimensional numerical model to simulate the process of laser cladding of bioactive glass coating on ultra-fine-grained pure titanium substrate. The finite element method is used to calculate the temperature field and stress distribution to achieve the optimal design of multi-layer structural materials.
研究采用不同VA含量的EVA共聚物结合直接粉末挤出技术，制备个性化透皮贴剂，通过: The study used EVA copolymers with different VA contents combined with direct powder extrusion technology to prepare personalized transdermal patches. Through thermal analysis and drug release evaluation, it was found that the choice of EVA grade affects the drug release behavior, and drugs with different melting points can achieve customized transdermal treatment while maintaining thermal stability.
研究采用不同倾斜角度（0°–60°）3D打印制备微针阵列，发现45°倾斜角可使穿: The study used 3D printing at different tilt angles (0°–60°) to prepare microneedle arrays. It was found that a 45° tilt angle could reduce the puncture force by 38%, and a 120° needle tip angle further minimized the puncture force and significantly improved the skin penetration ability of the 3D printed microneedle array.
研究采用不同分子量聚氨酯-丙烯酸酯共聚物混合物，通过3D打印制备软义齿衬里，发现: The study used polyurethane-acrylate copolymer mixtures of different molecular weights to prepare soft denture linings through 3D printing. It was found that increasing the proportion of 2K components can improve the mechanical properties. Among them, the performance of the GR-C group is comparable to that of traditional silicone linings, with good elasticity, hardness and dimensional stability, and no cytotoxicity.
研究采用不同厚度和药载量的3D打印圆柱形片剂，通过调节药物装载和尺寸实现即释与缓: The study used 3D printed cylindrical tablets with different thicknesses and drug loads to adjust the immediate-release and sustained-release properties by adjusting the drug loading and size. It confirmed that the tablet release rate can be customized as needed, and that ATH remains crystalline in the preparation and has no interaction with the polymer.
研究采用不同孔径的3D打印聚乳酸支架，在新西兰白兔颅骨外板处实施牵拉成骨，结果显: The study used 3D printed polylactic acid scaffolds with different pore sizes to perform distraction osteogenesis on the outer plate of New Zealand white rabbit skulls. The results showed that the larger the pore size, the higher the quantity and quality of new bone and the degree of vascularization.
研究采用不同孔径的I型胶原/丝素蛋白支架，评估其对人牙髓细胞增殖与分化的促进作用: The study used type I collagen/silk fibroin scaffolds with different pore sizes to evaluate their promoting effect on the proliferation and differentiation of human dental pulp cells. The results showed that the increase in pore size led to an increase in porosity. The alkaline phosphatase activity of the CSF1 group was significantly higher than that of the CSF3 group. Cells grew in multiple layers within the scaffold, indicating that this type of scaffold can effectively enhance cell adhesion and early differentiation.
研究采用不同形态的DMLS制造钛合金牙植入体，通过纵向3D打印加厚结构提升机械强: The study used different forms of DMLS to manufacture titanium alloy dental implants, and the mechanical strength was improved through longitudinal 3D printing of thickened structures. The results showed that 60% porosity can maximize the expression of cellular alkaline phosphatase, and the implants have good osseointegration and enhanced pull-out force, achieving a balance between biological and mechanical needs.
研究采用不同水溶性NSAIDs作为模型药物，探究其在海藻酸盐基墨水中的物理化学特: The study used different water-soluble NSAIDs as model drugs to explore the impact of their physical and chemical properties in alginate-based inks on printing performance. The results showed that increasing drug concentration would change the gel entanglement structure, causing matrix leakage in some samples, but all inks were able to achieve high encapsulation efficiency and good printing consistency.
研究采用不同浓度石墨烯增强的3D打印聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯牙科树脂，评估其对白色念珠菌: The study used 3D printed polymethylmethacrylate dental resin reinforced with graphene at different concentrations to evaluate its antibacterial and biofilm adhesion effects on Candida albicans and Streptococcus mutans. The results showed that graphene can effectively inhibit the growth and adhesion of strains, and the surface roughness increases as the concentration increases.
研究采用不同浓度羧甲基纤维素水凝胶3D打印含食用色素胶囊，对比干燥与未干燥样品在: The study used carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogels of different concentrations to 3D print capsules containing food pigments, and compared the dissolution behavior of dried and undried samples in the USP II device. The results showed that the dissolution efficiency of freeze-dried capsules was consistent at different CMC concentrations and was better than that of undried samples.
研究采用不同溶性形式的地塞米松（DEX、DEX-A、DEX-P）制备3D打印矩阵: The study used different soluble forms of dexamethasone (DEX, DEX-A, DEX-P) to prepare 3D printed matrix solid preparations. It was found that the release rate of DEX-P was about 50% (10 hours) in two sizes, and that of DEX and DEX-A was about 9%. The release curves of preparations of different sizes in the same drug form almost overlapped, indicating that dose customization can be achieved by adjusting the size of the preparation without changing the controlled release behavior.
研究采用不同等级的聚氧乙烯（PEO）与聚氧丙烯（F68、F87、F108）混合物: The study used different grades of polyoxyethylene (PEO) and polyoxypropylene (F68, F87, F108) mixtures as carriers to prepare semi-solid extrusion 3D printing preparations prepared from aspirin carriers. The results showed that the high viscosity gel formed by the combination of F108 and PEO was the most suitable for printing, and the drug release rate was F87>F68>F108.
研究采用两光子聚合3D打印技术制备了多种微针阵列模板，通过不同针高、形状、基底宽: The study used two-photon polymerization 3D printing technology to prepare a variety of microneedle array templates. Through different needle heights, shapes, base widths and spacing designs, a clustered microneedle array that can be inserted into the skin model was successfully prepared. Among them, the pointed conical and pyramidal microneedles have the highest insertion depth and have shown better drug delivery effects in in vitro and in vitro experiments.
研究采用两光子聚合制备微尺度3D支架，并结合透明质酸与聚赖氨酸涂层负载成纤维细胞: The study used two-photon polymerization to prepare microscale 3D scaffolds, and combined hyaluronic acid and polylysine coatings to load fibroblast growth factors and BMP2/4. The study compared the adhesion, proliferation and signaling responses of human pancreatic PANC1 and PAN092 cells under the action of different hardness substrates and BMPs. It was found that PANC1 had a dose-dependent response to BMPs, while PAN092 had no response to BMPs, and a microscale pancreatic tumor tissue model could be constructed.
研究采用两种具有抗真菌活性的植物化学物质（phytoncide A和B）制备微胶: The study used two phytochemicals with antifungal activity (phytoncide A and B) to prepare microcapsules and added them to the 3D printed denture matrix to compare the antifungal effect, microhardness, flexural strength and dimensional accuracy of the materials at different concentrations. The results showed that the phytoncide A-containing microcapsule group performed well in terms of antifungal activity, dimensional accuracy and flexural strength and was clinically acceptable; while the phytoncide B group had a significantly reduced flexural strength.
研究采用乙醇/甲醇/水（8:1:1）溶剂体系，通过溶剂固化法提升FDM 3D打印: The study used an ethanol/methanol/water (8:1:1) solvent system to increase the drug loading capacity of the high-dose, highly water-soluble drug glibenclamide in FDM 3D printed tablets through a solvent curing method, achieving a maximum drug loading rate of 91.9% w/w. The process is scalable and time-consuming, which is better than the dipping method.
研究采用五种亲水性高分子作为原料，通过注射式3D打印制备口腔分散片，发现羧甲基纤: The study used five hydrophilic polymers as raw materials to prepare orodispersible tablets through injection 3D printing. It was found that sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (5% w/v) had good printing resolution, accurate size, and completely disintegrated within 3 seconds. However, the tablets were highly brittle and required special packaging.
研究采用仿贻贝原理，通过聚多巴胺（PDA）修饰3D打印聚乳酸（PLA）支架并负载: The study used the mussel-like principle to modify 3D printed polylactic acid (PLA) scaffolds with polydopamine (PDA) and load nanohydroxyapatite (nHA). Scanning electron microscopy and energy spectroscopy confirmed that nHA was successfully loaded and the surface microstructure and porosity remained unchanged. The surface hydrophilicity was enhanced, mechanical properties were maintained, surface roughness was improved, and in vitro degradation was accelerated. nHA released Ca²⁺ and neutralized the local acidic environment, promoting osteoblast differentiation and mineralization.
研究采用低成本3D打印仿心模型，模拟真实心脏CT图像噪声与衰减特性，验证了自动左: The study used a low-cost 3D printed heart-like model to simulate the noise and attenuation characteristics of real cardiac CT images, and verified the reliability of automatic left ventricular segmentation volume measurement. The results showed that the volume measurement deviation was less than 2ml, and was positively correlated with image noise and moderately correlated with the contrast-to-noise ratio.
研究采用低成本3D打印光学元件，用于叶类样本的明场和荧光显微镜观察，实现了亚细胞: The research uses low-cost 3D printed optical components for brightfield and fluorescence microscopy observation of leaf samples, achieving subcellular resolution imaging.
研究采用低成本3D打印机打印多孔聚己内酯（PCL）支架，与ABS和PLA对比显示: The study used a low-cost 3D printer to print porous polycaprolactone (PCL) scaffolds. Comparison with ABS and PLA showed that the accuracy was equivalent at 10mm side length and 0.67mm pore diameter. There was no difference in cell survival rate, adhesion and proliferation between homemade PCL scaffolds and commercial scaffolds. Patient-customized ear models can achieve good solid molding, but the porous shape accuracy is limited. The manufacturing costs are respectively 0.04 euros per culture scaffold and 0.90 euros (0.56 euros) per solid/porous ear model.
研究采用低成本3D打印蜂窝结构微透镜阵列，与高端玻璃及低成本商用微透镜阵列对比，: The research uses a low-cost 3D printed honeycomb structure microlens array. Compared with high-end glass and low-cost commercial microlens arrays, it achieves 134 nm lateral resolution in a multi-focus structured illumination microscope, and has better background suppression than traditional designs, achieving super-resolution imaging effects.
研究采用低成本3D打印设备，将六份拭子样本混合后检测SARS-CoV-2核衣壳蛋: The study used low-cost 3D printing equipment to mix six swab samples to detect the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein antigen. The results showed that 5 to 6 times the mixed pool could still maintain detection sensitivity, and no false positives occurred in the laboratory pilot. This method confirmed that this method can effectively reduce detection costs and is suitable for routine screening in schools and other institutions.
研究采用低成本立体光刻3D打印技术，制备了模块化锁扣式微流控混合器，优化打印方向: The study used low-cost stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare a modular lock-type microfluidic mixer, optimizing the printing direction and post-processing to achieve structures of 850 μm and 550 μm size. Compared with traditional methods, the cost is lower and the efficiency is higher. It is suitable for reproducible, low-cost, high-throughput microfluidic platforms in clinical biosensing.
研究采用低温度直接颗粒挤出3D打印技术，以卡维地洛粉末或碎屑片为原料，制备直径不: The research uses low-temperature direct particle extrusion 3D printing technology, using carvedilol powder or chip tablets as raw materials, to prepare children's mini-tablets with a diameter of no more than 2 mm. The weight variation is less than 1.48%, the drug content uniformity is within ±5%, and it meets the dissolution requirements of the British Pharmacopoeia.
研究采用体外实验，检测PMMA树脂对牙龈成纤维细胞的细胞活力、代谢及自噬影响，结: The study used in vitro experiments to detect the effects of PMMA resin on the cell viability, metabolism and autophagy of gingival fibroblasts. The results showed that the cell viability significantly decreased after exposure, and the levels of lactate dehydrogenase and nitric oxide increased, suggesting that autophagy was activated, possibly as a cellular stress response.
研究采用体外灌注生物反应器系统，对羊骨膜组织进行长期保存，通过模拟生理条件持续输: The study used an in vitro perfusion bioreactor system to preserve sheep periosteum for a long time, continuously delivering nutrients and oxygen by simulating physiological conditions to maintain its cell vitality and metabolism. The results showed that the tissue cells remained active after nearly four weeks of perfusion, providing feasibility for the application of autologous periosteum in bone repair.
研究采用体积打印技术制备了含华法林的水溶性3D打印片剂，通过近红外光谱非破坏性验: The study used volume printing technology to prepare water-soluble 3D printed tablets containing warfarin, and non-destructively verified its drug loading through near-infrared spectroscopy. The results showed that the drug was fully released and the prediction model had good linearity and high accuracy.
研究采用先进3D打印技术，将光响应材料嵌入光学器件，实现对光信号的响应控制，器件: The research uses advanced 3D printing technology to embed light-responsive materials into optical devices to achieve response control of light signals. The devices can achieve switching responses within 1 to 10 seconds under stimulation by ultraviolet and visible light.
研究采用光刻结合微生物转谷氨酰胺酶酶交联的方法，对gelMA水凝胶进行双重交联，: The research uses a method of photolithography combined with microbial transglutaminase enzyme cross-linking to double-cross-link gelMA hydrogel. Compared with single photo-cross-linking or enzymatic cross-linking, this method improves the stiffness and rheological properties of the hydrogel while maintaining cell viability and the integrity of the photolithography pattern.
研究采用光学相干断层扫描技术，对3D打印牙模上牙冠在咬合、角部、轴向和边缘四个关: The study used optical coherence tomography technology to conduct non-ionizing, high-resolution measurements of the internal and edge matching differences of the crowns on the 3D printed dental model at four key positions: occlusion, corner, axial and edge, to achieve a qualitative and quantitative assessment of the fit between the crown and the abutment.
研究采用光学相干断层扫描结合图像处理算法，评估了不同铺层方式和建模角度下3D打印: The study used optical coherence tomography combined with image processing algorithms to evaluate the inner surface roughness of 3D printed crowns under different lay-up methods and modeling angles. The results showed that cross-laying with a 90° modeling angle can effectively improve surface smoothness.
研究采用光学相干断层扫描（OCT）结合紫外-可见光谱，实时观察了 ritonav: The study used optical coherence tomography (OCT) combined with UV-visible spectroscopy to observe the dissolution process of ritonavir-Soluplus® hot-melt extrusion amorphous solid preparation in real time. It was found that when the drug loading exceeds 14%, delayed release onset, prolonged swelling phase and reduced release efficiency occur, and the structural evolution is correlated with the release kinetics.
研究采用光聚合技术，优化含聚乙二醇和核黄素的树脂配方，并调整打印参数，验证了含甲: The study used photopolymerization technology to optimize the resin formula containing polyethylene glycol and riboflavin, and adjusted the printing parameters. It verified that the drug sustained-release tablets containing methoxycinnamate can achieve an 80% release rate, and the uncured resin can be reused, and the volume has a linear relationship with the drug content.
研究采用免费CAD软件设计并3D打印手术导板，对12例模型手术进行虚拟模拟与实际: The study used free CAD software to design and 3D print surgical guides, and conducted virtual simulations and actual operations on 12 model surgeries. The results showed that the mandibular osteotomy deviation was approximately 1.3 mm, the fibula osteotomy deviation was less than 1 mm, and the jaw reconstruction deviation was within 2.4 mm, proving that low-cost guide plates can achieve higher-precision mandibular reconstruction.
研究采用全尺寸三维打印肝模型，对比传统二维CT影像，对不同性别、经验水平的医学生: The study used a full-size three-dimensional printed liver model, compared with traditional two-dimensional CT images, to conduct teaching evaluations on medical students of different genders and experience levels. The results showed that the use of 3D models significantly improved students' understanding and confidence in liver tumors and surgical operations, with males showing more significant improvements in intraoperative understanding and cooperation.
研究采用全激光工艺，在3D打印钛植入物表面构建分层拓扑结构并程序化沉积银纳米颗粒: The study uses an all-laser process to build a layered topology on the surface of 3D printed titanium implants and programmatically deposit silver nanoparticles. Through laser polishing and femtosecond laser-induced periodic surface structure, it can achieve directional cell growth and sustained antibacterial, reduce the formation of Porphyromonas gingivalis biofilm, increase the bone-implant contact rate, and improve osseointegration and inflammatory response.
研究采用共挤出直接墨水书写3D打印技术制备316L-钙钛硅酸盐核心-壳层生物支架: The study used co-extrusion direct ink writing 3D printing technology to prepare a 316L-perovskite silicate core-shell biological scaffold. Its metal core increases the strain energy density under compression and makes fracture more gradual. Compared with the all-ceramic scaffold, the strain energy density is four times higher, while maintaining about 70% porosity. In vitro, it shows its biological activity and low metal ion release, and the cell survival rate is higher than 70%.
研究采用兼具真实感的3D打印肝假体，结合胶原铸造与传感器反馈系统，对肝外科手术培: The research uses a realistic 3D printed liver prosthesis, combined with collagen casting and sensor feedback system, to simulate liver surgery training and improve the training effect through real-time performance evaluation.
研究采用凝胶蜡与3D打印模具制备了神经血管、心房及胎盘超声仿真模型，通过调节玻璃: The study used gel wax and 3D printing molds to prepare ultrasound simulation models of neurovascular, atrium and placenta. By adjusting the concentration of glass spheres, various acoustic echoes were achieved. The gel wax maintained structural integrity under 60% compression deformation and its elastic modulus was 17.4±1.4 kPa, which can simulate the ultrasound performance of a variety of clinical scenarios.
研究采用分层结构3D打印技术，结合热熔挤出，制备了实现双阶段释放的双层布洛芬钠片: The study used layered structure 3D printing technology, combined with hot melt extrusion, to prepare double-layer ibuprofen sodium tablets that achieve dual-stage release. The honeycomb structure achieves rapid drug release, and the fully-filled structure achieves sustained release. Polyvinyl alcohol serves as a double-layer carrier to improve the practicability of the preparation.
研究采用分层网格设计，通过熔融沉积成型制备儿童适用的即释3D打印片，以难溶性药物: The study adopted a layered grid design and prepared immediate-release 3D printed tablets suitable for children through fused deposition molding. Using the poorly soluble drug lumefantrine as a model, it was found that 65% filling density can achieve rapid release, while 80% and 100% filling density dissolve slowly. Morphological characteristics such as structural porosity and specific surface area are significantly related to the dissolution rate. The drug exists in an amorphous form and is stable.
研究采用分层自组装技术制备包覆于磁控微机器人表面的水凝胶微系统，通过调控水凝胶层: The research uses layered self-assembly technology to prepare hydrogel microsystems coated on the surface of magnetically controlled microrobots. By regulating the thickness of the hydrogel layer, the drug release rate is optimized, the burst release phenomenon is suppressed, and precise control of drug release is achieved.
研究采用创新热熔挤出设计，以药物负载聚合物颗粒为原料进行制药3D打印，通过振荡流: The research adopts an innovative hot-melt extrusion design and uses drug-loaded polymer particles as raw materials for pharmaceutical 3D printing. The rheological behavior of the material is evaluated through oscillatory rheology. The printability of metoprolol sustained-release formulations of two carrier polymers is compared. The miscibility and thermal stability of the ingredients are analyzed by combining DSC and TGA. The weight and dose uniformity of the printed products are tested according to European Pharmacopoeia standards.
研究采用加工商法制造的YMR晶格钛植入物，通过界面拉伸粘结测试发现其骨-植入物结: The YMR lattice titanium implant manufactured by the processor method was studied. Through the interface tensile bonding test, it was found that the bone-implant bonding force and strength were significantly higher than that of the DU lattice, and there was no displacement after implantation in the rabbit femur, indicating that the lattice structure is conducive to bone cell growth and interface bonding.
研究采用半固态挤出3D打印技术制备了含槲皮素的聚乙烯氧化物-聚氧乙烯/聚氧丙烯胶: The study used semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare a polyethylene oxide-polyoxyethylene/polyoxypropylene glue system containing quercetin. The results showed that Tween 80 or Pluronic® F-68 could reduce the viscosity, improve uniformity, and increase the release rate of quercetin. The release rate of the F-68 group reached 95% within 60 minutes.
研究采用半固态挤出3D打印技术制备双药加载的异烟肼-吡哆醇软糖，通过调整明胶、卡: The research uses semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare double-drug-loaded isoniazid-pyridoxine gummies. By adjusting the proportion of gelatin, carrageenan and xylitol, personalized dosage customization is achieved, and a preparation with good printability, rapid drug release (80% of the drug is released within 30 minutes) and stability is obtained. It is suitable for patients of different ages and improves medication compliance.
研究采用半固态挤出3D打印技术制备含咖啡因的口崩片，比较四种水溶性聚合物单用或复: The study used semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare orally disintegrating tablets containing caffeine, and compared the performance of four water-soluble polymers alone or in combination. The results showed that MDX and PVA-PEG alone had poor printability, while other systems could achieve stable deposition. The SA substrate had the lowest porosity and hygroscopicity, and the HPC tablet had good mechanical strength. All samples disintegrated quickly and released the drug completely.
研究采用半固态挤出3D打印技术，制备不同几何形状、药物负载和交联剂浓度的厄贝沙坦: The study used semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare irbesartan potassium tablets with different geometric shapes, drug loads and cross-linking agent concentrations. The results showed that the printed tablets were accurate in size, controllable in dissolution behavior, and had good adjustability and consistency.
研究采用半固态挤出技术制备个性化昂丹司琼片，通过拉曼光谱结合PLS分析实现非破坏: The research uses semi-solid extrusion technology to prepare personalized ondansetron tablets, and uses Raman spectroscopy combined with PLS analysis to achieve non-destructive quality control. The results show that the drug content is highly uniform, the dissolution meets the standards, and the quality prediction is highly consistent with the HPLC results.
研究采用单螺杆挤出法制备含降糖药格列本脲和Affinisol™ 15LV的丝材，: The study used a single-screw extrusion method to prepare filaments containing the antidiabetic drugs glyburide and Affinisol™ 15LV, and examined the extrusion performance and printing suitability of the filaments under different drug loading rates. The results showed that there is a critical critical point between 30% and 40% of the drug loading rate, at which time the filament has good printing performance.
研究采用压力浸渍和3D打印制备Ti–Mg复合材料，通过调整孔隙率改善钛合金的机械: The study used pressure impregnation and 3D printing to prepare Ti–Mg composite materials. The mechanical properties and biological activity of the titanium alloy were improved by adjusting the porosity. The results showed that its compressive strength and yield strength were significantly improved, and the release of Mg ions promoted osteoblast adhesion and differentiation.
研究采用压力辅助微注射3D打印技术，制备了基于聚氧乙烯-聚氧丙烯-聚氧乙烯（Pl: The study used pressure-assisted microinjection 3D printing technology to prepare a temperature-sensitive granisetron hydrogel based on polyoxyethylene-polyoxypropylene-polyoxyethylene (Pluronic F127) and hyaluronic acid. Controlled release was achieved by adjusting the molecular weight ratio of hyaluronic acid. The results showed that the system had repeatable temperature-dependent release behavior, and the release process conformed to zero-order kinetic characteristics.
研究采用压力辅助微注射式3D打印机，在室温下制备含布洛芬/利多卡因离子液体与Eu: The study used a pressure-assisted microinjection 3D printer to prepare personalized oral films containing ibuprofen/lidocaine ionic liquid and Eudragit polymer at room temperature. Through surface tension, viscosity and in vitro dissolution tests, the effects of different Eudragit polymers on the release rate of ionic liquid were compared. The results showed that Eudragit L100 > ionic liquid used alone > Eudragit EPO > Eudragit RSPO.
研究采用原代大鼠成骨细胞或骨髓间充质干细胞，种植于3D打印的双相磷酸钙支架，比较: The study used primary rat osteoblasts or bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and planted them on a 3D printed biphasic calcium phosphate scaffold to compare cell survival and osteogenic differentiation abilities under static and dynamic culture conditions. The results showed that dynamic culture could reverse the decrease in cell number under static conditions and maintain their differentiation potential.
研究采用双光子直接激光写入3D打印技术，制备了由瓶状壳、液态核心和可降解壳帽组成: The study used two-photon direct laser writing 3D printing technology to prepare a microcarrier composed of a bottle-shaped shell, a liquid core and a degradable shell cap. The degradation time of the shell cap is related to the thickness, which can achieve controlled release of the core drug. The microfluidic structure design effectively prevents the penetration of liquid materials and improves core retention.
研究采用双喷嘴3D打印技术制备了具有缓释和速释阶段的个体化口服复方制剂，通过微C: The study used dual-nozzle 3D printing technology to prepare individualized oral compound preparations with sustained-release and immediate-release stages. Micro-CT analysis revealed microstructural defects between the two layers. The dissolution test confirmed the expected release curve. A model was built based on single-material shape data to predict the release behavior of the compound preparation.
研究采用双喷嘴熔融沉积成型技术，制备了兼具外圆柱和内螺旋腔的三维打印双室给药装置: The study used dual-nozzle fused deposition modeling technology to prepare a three-dimensional printed dual-chamber drug delivery device with both an outer cylinder and an inner spiral cavity. In vitro release tests showed that it exhibits phased release characteristics under different pH conditions, achieving colon-targeted delivery of 5-ASA.
研究采用双材料3D打印技术制作了具有真实触感的光学追踪假手模型，通过优化结构单元: The study used dual-material 3D printing technology to produce an optically tracked prosthetic hand model with real touch. By optimizing the structural unit to increase the proportion of supporting materials, and combining the displacement of the skin layer to simulate soft tissue characteristics, young surgeons can intuitively perceive bony protrusions and achieve tactile feedback and real-time position tracking in minimally invasive drilling training.
研究采用双螺杆挤出技术，通过调节混合元件组合，实现难溶药物的固体制剂制造及新型制: The study uses twin-screw extrusion technology to realize solid preparation manufacturing and new preparation design of poorly soluble drugs by adjusting the combination of mixing elements. It focuses on the application and challenges of this technology in continuous manufacturing, process analysis and scale-up.
研究采用双螺杆热熔造粒与选择性激光熔融技术，结合乙酰氨基酚和甘油硬脂酸酯，优化工: The study used twin-screw hot-melt granulation and selective laser melting technology, combined with acetaminophen and glyceryl stearate, to optimize process parameters to prepare high-dose sustained-release 3D printed tablets. The results showed that the printed tablets have high mechanical strength and dense structure, and the lipid content is negatively correlated with the drug release rate, consistent with the Korsmeyer-Peppas model.
研究采用可扩展的水相Massart法合成磁性Fe3O4纳米簇，并电静学组装金纳米: The research uses a scalable aqueous Massart method to synthesize magnetic Fe3O4 nanoclusters and electrostatically assemble gold nanoparticles to build a multifunctional nanoplatform with both magnetic response and surface-enhanced Raman signals to achieve efficient sorting and sensitive detection of target cell subpopulations in complex biological media.
研究采用可调功能化的聚酯平台，通过3D打印制备骨再生支架，其中HP5GP支架经点: The study used an adjustable functionalized polyester platform to prepare bone regeneration scaffolds through 3D printing. The HP5GP scaffold was modified with click chemistry and combined with bone morphogenetic protein 2 (BMP-2) to significantly enhance the osteogenic differentiation of human mesenchymal stem cells, which was better than the direct incubation group with the unmodified scaffold.
研究采用可降解PCL支架结合负载泼尼松和酮洛酸的PLGA纳米纤维，用于手指关节重: The study used a degradable PCL scaffold combined with PLGA nanofibers loaded with prednisone and ketorolac for finger joint reconstruction. The results showed that the scaffold had excellent mechanical properties and sustained drug release for more than 30 days in vitro and more than 42 days in in vivo testing. The rabbit model receiving the scaffold had the highest mobility.
研究采用可降解多孔硅载体实现BMP-2的持续释放，比较物理吸附与共价结合两种负载: The study used degradable porous silicon carriers to achieve sustained release of BMP-2, and compared the two loading methods of physical adsorption and covalent bonding. The results showed that BMP-2 could maintain biological activity after loading, increase the alkaline phosphatase activity of rabbit bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, and the degradation product of the empty carrier could also induce partial differentiation. The carrier has been integrated into patient-specific PCL 3D printed bone implants.
研究采用合成股骨模型，通过三维打印钻引导装置，结合CT扫描与图像处理，验证了其在: The study used a synthetic femur model and a three-dimensional printed drill guide device, combined with CT scanning and image processing, to verify its feasibility in guiding the drill bit during core decompression surgery. The results showed that the drill guide device had an average displacement of 1.440mm and an angular deviation of 1.093° from the preset trajectory.
研究采用含不同含量ACNC的PLA复合材料制备3D打印牙冠原型，结果显示0.5: The study used PLA composite materials containing different contents of ACNC to prepare 3D printed dental crown prototypes. The results showed that 0.5 wt% ACNC increased the tensile strength, and 1 wt% ACNC significantly enhanced the tensile and compressive strength (increased by 11% and 40% respectively). However, the compressive strength decreased under the 90° orientation, and the bending strength first decreased and then increased. ACNC improved thermal stability and reduced solubility, and the surface roughness increased and the wear resistance decreased.
研究采用含包埋和游离纤维素酶的纤维素纳米纤维/壳聚糖水凝胶墨水进行3D打印，发现: The study used cellulose nanofiber/chitosan hydrogel ink containing embedded and free cellulase for 3D printing. It was found that the embedded enzyme group still maintained about 65% activity within 14 days, which was better than the 55% of the free enzyme group. The hydrogel supported the attachment and proliferation of fibroblasts, achieving simultaneous cell growth and cellulose nanofiber degradation.
研究采用含对乙酰氨基酚的土豆淀粉与羟丙基纤维素混合物，经85°C热熔挤出处理，结: The study used a mixture of potato starch and hydroxypropyl cellulose containing acetaminophen, which was processed by hot melt extrusion at 85°C. The results showed that the drug was released smoothly, the moisture content affected the recovery rate, and the release rate slowed down after aging. This powder mixture can be used to 3D print personalized tablets of different sizes and shapes.
研究采用含氢氯噻嗪的糊状配方，制备五支3D打印墨水 cartridge，考察0至: The study used a paste formula containing hydrochlorothiazide to prepare five 3D printing ink cartridges, and examined its extrudability, stability and printability under storage conditions of 0 to 72 hours. It was verified that orally disintegrating tablets with a dosage of 6 to 24 mg can be stably produced under the same printing process, and the content and chemical stability are reliable.
研究采用含氯己定释放的钛-二氧化硅复合植入物，通过体外实验评估其对多物种口腔生物: The study used titanium-silica composite implants containing chlorhexidine release and evaluated its inhibitory effect on multi-species oral biofilm through in vitro experiments. The results showed that compared with the control group, the system significantly reduced bacterial activity, inhibited acid metabolism and changed the morphology of the bacteria, confirming its feasibility in preventing and treating peri-implantitis.
研究采用含灰黄霉素的丝材，通过FDM 3D打印制备了多孔结构片剂，融合辅助法使药: The study used filaments containing griseofulvin and prepared porous structure tablets through FDM 3D printing. The fusion-assisted method made the drug supersaturation reach 153% to 293%. The larger the surface area, the higher the supersaturation, and the release conforms to Fick-type diffusion.
研究采用含硒聚己内酯3D打印支架，通过体外和体内实验显示，相比纯PCL支架，该支: The study used a selenium-containing polycaprolactone 3D printed scaffold. In vitro and in vivo experiments showed that compared with pure PCL scaffolds, the scaffold significantly improved the osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and bone regeneration of critical-sized femoral defects in rats, promoting new bone formation.
研究采用含纳米二氧化硅的环氧悬浮液，通过嵌入式3D打印技术制备环氧基微流控器件，: The study used an epoxy suspension containing nanosilica to prepare epoxy-based microfluidic devices through embedded 3D printing technology. The customized manufacturing of two typical devices was successfully achieved, which verified the feasibility of this material system in the preparation of microfluidic devices.
研究采用含羧甲基纤维素和果胶的新型墨水，将介孔二氧化硅载药，3D打印制备生物黏附: The study used a new ink containing carboxymethyl cellulose and pectin to load mesoporous silica with drugs and 3D printed it to prepare a bioadhesive skin drug delivery film. The results showed that the film has high tensile strength, uniform drug loading and complete release, and pectin improves skin adhesion.
研究采用含麦芽糖醇的聚乙烯醇体系，通过熔融沉积成型制备快速溶散口服制剂，环形制剂: The study used a polyvinyl alcohol system containing maltitol to prepare a fast-dissolving oral preparation through fused deposition molding. The release rate of the ring-shaped preparation exceeded 85% within 15 minutes. Its absorption in dogs is equivalent to traditional fast-dissolving tablets, and the release characteristics can be easily controlled through 3D design.
研究采用商业硝苯地平片为内核，通过FDM 3D打印技术制备外壳，调整丝材组成、结: The research uses commercial nifedipine tablets as the core, and uses FDM 3D printing technology to prepare the shell. The composition, structure and thickness of the filament are adjusted to obtain a pulsating tablet with a delayed release of 4 to 8 hours to achieve personalized drug delivery.
研究采用喷雾喷射成型技术，制备了银纳米线、石墨烯和PEDOT:PSS等材料的表面: The research used spray injection molding technology to prepare surface acoustic wave microfluidic devices made of silver nanowires, graphene, PEDOT:PSS and other materials. Its acoustic driving performance was tested by a scanning laser Doppler vibrometer. Compared with the devices prepared in a clean room, the performance was comparable. Acoustic flow driving and particle concentration experiments were successfully achieved.
研究采用喷雾涂覆乙醇溶液并经紫外照射和退火处理，实现PMMA与ABS材料的溶剂键: The research uses spray coating of ethanol solution and UV irradiation and annealing treatment to achieve solvent bonding of PMMA and ABS materials, and prepare optically transparent 3D printed microfluidic devices. The effectiveness of this method in constructing S-shaped microchannels, passive micromixers, and double-emulsion droplet generation microchips is verified, and at least eight strong bonding strips are obtained.
研究采用喷雾涂覆法在3D打印316L不锈钢植入物上制备meloxicam-PLG: The study used spray coating method to prepare meloxicam-PLGA multi-layer coating on 3D printed 316L stainless steel implants. The results showed that it has better cell adhesion and proliferation, lower bacterial attachment and biofilm formation than uncoated implants, and has good biocompatibility and corrosion resistance.
研究采用回收的PLA丝材与混合碳材料制备生物传感器，相比商用丝材，其电极表现出更: The study used recycled PLA wire and mixed carbon materials to prepare biosensors. Compared with commercial wires, the electrodes showed better conductivity and electrochemical properties, achieving sensitive detection of monkeypox virus DNA and distinguishing between serum and throat swab samples, with a recovery rate of 94.7%–106%.
研究采用圆、三角、五边形几何结构的生物医学植入物，通过Taguchi方法分析材料: The research uses biomedical implants with circular, triangular, and pentagonal geometric structures. The Taguchi method is used to analyze the impact of five parameters such as material type, layer thickness, and filling density on dimensional accuracy and surface quality. It is found that material type and layer thickness are the main influencing factors. The correlation between prediction results and experimental values based on the ANN model exceeds 0.96, achieving accurate prediction and optimization of FDM manufacturing parameters.
研究采用坐标测量机对5种3D打印手术模板进行自动化几何分析，结果显示不同树脂对尺: The study used a coordinate measuring machine to conduct automated geometric analysis on five types of 3D printed surgical templates. The results showed that different resins had no significant impact on dimensional accuracy. The templates deformed slightly after 2 weeks, with a z-axis displacement of only about 10 μm, and the overall dimensional stability was reliable.
研究采用基于PEG-DA-250的透明3D打印树脂制备生物相容性微流控装置，实现: The research uses transparent 3D printing resin based on PEG-DA-250 to prepare biocompatible microfluidic devices to achieve high transparency and cell culture, solving the problems of poor biocompatibility and low transparency of traditional 3D printing microfluidic devices.
研究采用基于透明质酸的动态水凝胶，结合共价交联与肽折叠介导的可调功能化，通过模块: The research uses dynamic hydrogels based on hyaluronic acid, which combines covalent cross-linking and peptide folding-mediated tunable functionalization, and achieves dynamic performance control of 3D printed structures through modular design, which can accurately regulate cell-hydrogel interactions and enzymatic mineralization processes.
研究采用基于阿伏苯宗的生物相容性树脂，通过光谱匹配实现高分辨率3D打印微流控器件: The study used avobenzone-based biocompatible resin to achieve high-resolution 3D printed microfluidic devices through spectral matching, successfully prepared 15 μm square pillars (spacing 7.7 μm, 5 μm layer thickness), and achieved reliable operation of integrated valves and pumps. Both devices showed cell chemotactic migration, and the migration effect of the integrated device was comparable to that of an external pump device.
研究采用塑料粉末与氧化锆材料通过3D打印技术制备牙冠原型，经退火处理提升PLA基: The research uses plastic powder and zirconia materials to prepare dental crown prototypes through 3D printing technology. After annealing, the crystallinity of the PLA matrix is increased, thereby enhancing the thermal stability of the dental crown prototype.
研究采用增材制造制备Ti6Al4V-PCL互穿相复合材料，通过熔融PCL浸入具有: The research uses additive manufacturing to prepare Ti6Al4V-PCL interpenetrating phase composite materials. By immersing molten PCL into the Ti6Al4 structure with the smallest surface area, the two-phase interaction and stress transfer are improved, so that the Gyroid structure performs optimally in terms of mechanical properties and improves energy absorption capabilities.
研究采用增材制造技术制备个性化颅面植入物，通过EBSD、光学显微镜、XRD、ES: The study used additive manufacturing technology to prepare personalized craniofacial implants, and systematically analyzed its microstructure, mechanical properties and residual stress distribution through EBSD, optical microscopy, XRD, ESPI and microhardness testing.
研究采用增材制造技术在钛合金医疗植入物表面制备抗污水凝胶涂层，以实现免疫调节效果: The study uses additive manufacturing technology to prepare an anti-sewage gel coating on the surface of titanium alloy medical implants to achieve an immunomodulatory effect and aims to reduce the host's fibrous capsule formation on the implant.
研究采用增材制造技术开发个性化生物医用金属植入物，涵盖承重与可降解合金，并结合人: The research uses additive manufacturing technology to develop personalized biomedical metal implants, covering load-bearing and degradable alloys, and combines artificial intelligence and 4D printing to improve material performance and explore its application potential in multiple medical fields.
研究采用增材制造技术打印β-磷酸三钙支架，比较四种内部几何模型，通过体外细胞培养: The study used additive manufacturing technology to print β-tricalcium phosphate scaffolds and compared four internal geometric models. Through in vitro cell culture and in vivo and in vitro observations, it was found that the pores of the model A scaffold were more connected, and the combined membrane group had better bone regeneration than other groups, showing good potential.
研究采用增材制造技术构建基于三重周期极小曲面（TPMS）的髋关节植入物，对比传统: The study used additive manufacturing technology to construct a hip implant based on triple periodic minimal surfaces (TPMS). Compared with the traditional truss structure, it was found that the H2 structure has the lowest von Mises stress (354 MPa) under a 1000N compressive load, which is better than the Schwarz Primitive and Gyroid structures.
研究采用增材制造技术，以LCD光固化法3D打印用于胰岛素输送的空心微针，比较不同: The study used additive manufacturing technology and used LCD light-curing method to 3D print hollow microneedles for insulin delivery. Comparing different geometric shapes and process parameters, it was found that the bevel structure microneedle tips are finer and the microchannels are less likely to be blocked. The optimal parameters are a height of 900 μm, a printing angle of -45°, curing of each layer for 10 seconds, and a layer height of 30 μm.
研究采用增材制造技术，结合CT扫描与有限元分析，设计定制化钛合金牙科植入物，精准: The research uses additive manufacturing technology, combined with CT scanning and finite element analysis, to design customized titanium alloy dental implants that accurately fit the patient's bone surface to reduce the total volume of the titanium material and minimize the implant volume.
研究采用多喷嘴3D打印技术，以商业材料喷射设备制备微流控芯片中的复杂微通道，结果: The research uses multi-nozzle 3D printing technology and commercial material jetting equipment to prepare complex microchannels in microfluidic chips. The results show that this method can efficiently achieve precise manufacturing of microscale structures and has good application prospects.
研究采用多喷射融合技术打印PA-12材料，评估其对L929成纤维细胞和MC3T3: The study used multi-jet fusion technology to print PA-12 material and evaluated its proliferation and osteogenic ability of L929 fibroblasts and MC3T3e1 osteoblasts. The results showed that material exudation did not inhibit cell growth and the cells could adhere and proliferate. However, the proliferation ability of MC3T3e1 cells decreased significantly after passage, while L929 cells still maintained good growth after being transferred to traditional culture plates, and the material supported E. coli culture.
研究采用多材料挤出3D打印技术制备硅胶仿生模型，通过调节填充密度改变其CT辐射密: The research uses multi-material extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare silicone bionic models, and adjusts the filling density to change its CT radiation density. The resulting silicone phantom has a HU value that is highly consistent with the Gammex tissue standard phantom and abdominal CT tissue target values, achieving imaging matching of soft tissue materials.

The research uses multi-material extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare silicone bionic models, and changes its CT radiation density by adjusting the filling density. The HU value of the obtained silicone material ranges from -639 to +780, which is similar to the equivalent material range of Gammex tissue. In the abdominal CT model, it is highly consistent with the HU value of the target tissue, showing good repeatability.
研究采用多种3D打印技术，如选择性激光烧结、喷墨打印等，利用聚合物丝和水凝胶作为: The research uses a variety of 3D printing technologies, such as selective laser sintering, inkjet printing, etc., using polymer filaments and hydrogels as carriers to achieve drug release control through customized geometric structures, accurately prepare dosages according to individual prescriptions, meet specific patient needs, and provide a new path for personalized medicine and pharmacy transformation.
研究采用多阶段微CT分析了基于Voronoi结构的患者特异性颅骨植入物，比较了未: The study used multi-stage micro-CT to analyze patient-specific skull implants based on the Voronoi structure, and compared the geometric deviations of the unpolished and polished implants from the virtual design. The results showed that polishing significantly reduced surface roughness and reduced forward deviation, and the overall structural continuity was preserved.
研究采用大气空气等离子体在5秒内激活3D打印PLA/碳黑电极，相比传统DMF和N: The research uses atmospheric air plasma to activate 3D printed PLA/carbon black electrodes within 5 seconds. Compared with traditional DMF and NaOH chemical activation, the processing time is significantly shortened and there is no harmful solvent. It improves the electrode surface wettability and electrochemical performance, and was successfully used for the electrochemical detection of amlodipine.
研究采用天然脱出的上颌乳前牙，比较3D打印树脂、磨削混合陶瓷、磨削PMMA及预成: The study used naturally prolapsed maxillary primary anterior teeth to compare the flexural strength and color stability of 3D printed resin, ground hybrid ceramics, ground PMMA and preformed zirconia crowns. The results showed that the flexural strength of 3D printed resin was the lowest, which was significantly different from that of zirconia crowns. There was no significant difference between the other groups, and the color change of the resin was the most obvious.
研究采用天然蒙脱石纳米棒与聚乙烯醇制备3D生物打印多孔纳米蒙脱石支架，经体外细胞: The study used natural montmorillonite nanorods and polyvinyl alcohol to prepare a 3D bioprinted porous nano-montmorillonite scaffold. In vitro cell experiments and rat skull defect models showed that the scaffold can promote human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell osteogenesis and induce direct osteogenesis, accompanied by blood vessel formation, to achieve good bone regeneration.
研究采用定制3D打印机制造约30微米尺度的微流控结构，通过光学剂量控制实现微通道: The research uses a custom 3D printer to manufacture a microfluidic structure with a scale of about 30 microns, achieves precise shaping of positive and negative features in the microchannel through optical dose control, successfully captures 25 micron polymer beads, and iteratively optimizes the particle trap design.
研究采用定制形状的微针阵列，在小鼠模型中实现特定区域的精准毛发生长，该阵列通过静: The study used a custom-shaped microneedle array to achieve precise hair growth in a specific area in a mouse model. The array was prepared in seconds using static optical projection lithography technology. It can recruit local macrophages and activate hair follicle stem cells to promote hair growth. At the same time, upregulation of the Wnt/β-catenin pathway and the expression of Hgf, Igf1, and Tnf-α was observed.
研究采用定制钛合金3D打印导板，提高了膝关节旁原发肿瘤根治性切除的精准度，并实现: The study used a customized titanium alloy 3D printed guide plate to improve the accuracy of radical resection of primary tumors near the knee joint and achieve matching of allografts.
研究采用定量密合测试，评估3D打印框架搭配两种ASTM一级外科口罩的密合性能，结: The study used quantitative fit testing to evaluate the fit performance of the 3D printed frame with two ASTM Level 1 surgical masks. The results showed that the frame significantly improved the protective effect of the surgical mask, with a fit factor of up to 100, which is equivalent to N95 masks.
研究采用实时原位超声监测技术，分析了藻酸盐-明胶水凝胶3D打印过程中薄膜形成、层: The study used real-time in-situ ultrasonic monitoring technology to analyze parameters such as film formation, interlayer bonding, elastic constants and surface roughness during the 3D printing process of alginate-gelatin hydrogel, achieving real-time observation of printing behavior at sub-wavelength resolution, and optimizing the cross-linking time to balance hardness improvement and geometric deformation.
研究采用室温下半固态挤出技术，将含难溶性药物芬氟拉明的乳化脂质基质制成三维打印固: The research uses semi-solid extrusion technology at room temperature to make three-dimensional printed solid lipid tablets from an emulsified lipid matrix containing the poorly soluble drug fenfluramine. The tablets are well formed and disintegrate quickly. The size of the oil droplets after digestion is equivalent to that of traditional liquid lipid matrices, making them suitable for personalized dosage preparation.
研究采用室温滚筒印刷成型技术，大规模制造基于聚二甲基硅氧烷的离心微流控芯片，实现: The research uses room temperature drum printing and molding technology to mass-produce centrifugal microfluidic chips based on polydimethylsiloxane to achieve on-site isolation of RNA from whole blood samples. By integrating multi-layer structures and efficient mixing channels, 99% replication accuracy is achieved, significantly reducing energy consumption and overcoming the economic and environmental limitations of traditional processes.
研究采用层状浆料沉积技术制造feldspar玻璃陶瓷牙科修复体，与商用参考材料相: The study uses layered slurry deposition technology to manufacture feldspar glass ceramic dental restorations. Compared with commercial reference materials, there are significant differences in fracture strength, fracture toughness and martensitic parameters. The printing direction affects the shrinkage and fracture strength, but does not affect the fracture toughness and martensitic parameters, indicating that this technology can prepare dental restorations that meet the requirements of DIN EN ISO 6871:2019-01 Class A.
研究采用嵌入式3D打印技术，将对乙酰氨基酚与布洛芬以特定图案嵌入凝胶基质中，制备: The study used embedded 3D printing technology to embed acetaminophen and ibuprofen in a gel matrix with specific patterns to prepare chewable personalized dose bricks. The dosage was linearly controlled by printing pattern proportions, which verified the feasibility and customizability of this method in pediatric medication.
研究采用常见药用溶剂和辅料，通过Z值理论和墨滴喷射观测平台评估不同配方墨水的可打: The study used common medicinal solvents and excipients, and evaluated the printability of different formulations of inks through Z-value theory and droplet jet observation platforms. It was found that the addition ratio of isopropyl alcohol does not exceed 40%, the higher the molecular weight of PVP, the lower the tolerance concentration, and the jetting efficiency is highest when the glycerin ratio is 10%. Finally, a high-quality ink formula of 40% isopropyl alcohol plus 0.1% PVP K30 and 4% glycerin was obtained, which was used to prepare dispersible tablets of Leiteamide to achieve smooth printing, good appearance, good mechanical properties and rapid release.
研究采用开源3D建模软件，对牙科手术模板的关键区域进行局部设计强化，以提升模板的: The study uses open source 3D modeling software to locally design and strengthen key areas of the dental surgical template to improve the structural integrity of the template, reduce manufacturing failures, and improve its clinical performance.
研究采用开源设计和3D打印技术制作呼吸器，搭配N95滤材并通过定量密合测试，验证: The research uses open source design and 3D printing technology to make respirators, and uses N95 filter media to pass quantitative fit tests to verify its protective performance. Filter materials not specifically designed for respiratory protection do not meet the N95 standard. When using them, the differences and risks between them and commercial respirators must be clearly understood, and quantitative fit tests and correct wearing training must be carried out.
研究采用微CT扫描 cadaveric 颞骨生成3D模型，经透明光聚合物3D打印: The study used micro-CT scanning of the cadaveric temporal bone to generate a 3D model, which was 3D printed with transparent photopolymer to make a middle ear prosthesis model. Ten otolaryngology surgeons and ten residents evaluated its feasibility through simulated surgical operations. The results showed that the anatomical landmarks of the model were clear and the operation felt realistic. Although the tactile feedback of drilling and scraping was insufficient, participants generally recognized its potential as a training tool.
研究采用微尺度模块化多孔基底，结合光学、扫描电镜和透射电镜，非侵入性观察人真皮成: The study used a micro-scale modular porous substrate, combined with optical, scanning electron microscopy and transmission electron microscopy, to non-invasively observe the dynamic colonization process of human dermal fibroblasts in a three-dimensional printed bioreactor, revealing the bridging and segmentation behavior of single cells and colony cells in the porous structure and the microscopic mechanism of cell-matrix interaction.
研究采用微流体辅助3D打印制备含MXene的多孔纤维支架，通过近红外光触发聚NI: The study uses microfluidic-assisted 3D printing to prepare porous fibrous scaffolds containing MXene. Near-infrared light triggers the contraction-swelling behavior of the polyNIPAM hydrogel to achieve cell penetration. Combined with the controlled release of VEGF, it promotes the proliferation and migration of vascular endothelial cells and improves skin flap survival rate.
研究采用微立体光刻3D打印制备微流控芯片支架，通过集成O型圈实现流体密封、弹簧探: The research uses microstereolithography 3D printing to prepare a microfluidic chip holder, which integrates O-rings to achieve fluid sealing and spring probes to achieve electrical connections. It also uses polyimide coating to solve biocompatibility issues, achieve reliable connection between the chip and the outside world, and support accurate processing and rapid replacement of samples in biological analysis.
研究采用快速冷冻成型技术制备含载脂蛋白A-I的海藻酸盐/明胶3D支架，评估其机械: The study used rapid freezing molding technology to prepare an alginate/gelatin 3D scaffold containing apolipoprotein A-I, and evaluated its mechanical properties and cell metabolic behavior. The results showed that the scaffold structure is stable, non-cytotoxic, can achieve controlled release of apoA-I, and has potential for vascular applications.
研究采用患者头颅CT数据，通过3D建模和硅橡胶模具制备PMMA颅面植入物，并添加: The study used patient head CT data, prepared PMMA craniofacial implants through 3D modeling and silicone rubber molds, and added 5% hydroxyapatite and 10% carboxymethylcellulose to enhance biological activity. VERO cell experiments showed that this combination was significantly better than unmodified PMMA, while adding carboxymethylcellulose alone inhibited cell growth.
