研究采用患者来源的脂肪组织间充质干细胞， seeded into 甲基丙烯酰化明: The study used patient-derived adipose tissue mesenchymal stem cells, seeded into methacrylated gelatin hydrogel and cultured in a 3D printed bioreactor. The results showed that the cells survived well within 28 days and had the ability to differentiate into fat. Both gene and protein levels showed an upregulation of key markers of fat differentiation.
研究采用患者特定影像数据制作了5个相同的3D打印主动脉模型，其中2个经灭菌、2个: The study used patient-specific imaging data to produce five identical 3D printed aortic models, of which two were sterilized, two were disinfected, and one was unprocessed. All models were subject to internal quality control and third-party testing. The results showed that sterilization and disinfection did not cause changes in the material structure, and no pathogens were detected, indicating that they can be used for the production of customized stents in emergency aortic interventional surgeries.
研究采用患者特异性颅内分叉和侧壁动脉瘤模型，通过计算流体动力学模拟与多普勒超声在: The study used patient-specific intracranial bifurcation and lateral wall aneurysm models, and compared computational fluid dynamics simulation with Doppler ultrasound in the bionic model to verify the reduction of blood flow in the aneurysm after treatment with the flow shunt device, and the simulation and ultrasound results were highly consistent.
研究采用手持3D笔结合半固态挤出技术，精准制备不同剂量的精氨酸含片，通过调节打印: The research uses a handheld 3D pen combined with semi-solid extrusion technology to accurately prepare different dosages of arginine lozenges. The dosage is personalized by adjusting the printing time and area. The printed product has accurate dosage, good dissolution and stable formula. It is suitable for instant personalized drug production in limited resources or remote areas.
研究采用改性桉树提取物与聚乙烯氧化物（PEO）制备水溶性凝胶，通过半固态挤出3D: The study used modified eucalyptus extract and polyethylene oxide (PEO) to prepare a water-soluble gel, which was 3D printed through semi-solid extrusion. The resulting product dissolved quickly and had good printing quality and water solubility, showing its feasibility in oral immediate release applications.
研究采用改进的阶梯法进行3D打印Ti6Al4V骨科内固定板的疲劳实验，并结合有限: The research uses an improved ladder method to conduct fatigue experiments on 3D printed Ti6Al4V orthopedic internal fixation plates, and combines finite element simulation to predict its fatigue limit. The experimental and numerical results are highly consistent. The linear elastic model can estimate the fatigue limit, and the elastic-plastic model can accurately predict the fatigue behavior throughout the life cycle.
研究采用放射性标记的利培酮鼻腔植入物，在大鼠体内通过非侵入性微SPECT/CT成: The study used radioactively labeled risperidone nasal implants and monitored its release process in rats through non-invasive micro-SPECT/CT imaging. The results showed that the drug stabilized after rapid release in the first 5 days, which was consistent with in vitro experimental data, and the implant could last for one month in the nasal cavity.
研究采用数字光处理3D打印技术制备甲基丙烯酸酯寡聚物膦氧化物临时修复体，对五例三: The study used digital light processing 3D printing technology to prepare methacrylate oligomer phosphine oxide temporary restorations. The edge tightness of five cases of three-unit temporary bridges was measured at six points. The results showed that the edge tightness was 46.37 μm, which was equivalent to polyethylene methacrylate and polyether ether ketone temporary restorations.
研究采用数字光处理3D打印技术，制备含PLGA-胰岛素纳米颗粒的多孔PET-RA: The study used digital light processing 3D printing technology to prepare a porous PET-RAFT scaffold containing PLGA-insulin nanoparticles to achieve structural support and sustained insulin release. Its porous structure is connectable, has uniform pore size, and has good cell compatibility. It promotes osteoblast adhesion and RUNX2 expression under dynamic culture, demonstrating bone tissue regeneration potential.
研究采用数字光处理3D打印技术，首次制备了含对乙酰氨基酚的水溶性药片，通过调控电: The research used digital light processing 3D printing technology to prepare water-soluble tablets containing acetaminophen for the first time. By adjusting the ratio of electrolyte acrylate and NVP monomer, the water-soluble structure was formed. The drug was completely released within 45 minutes to 5 hours, and no tissue damage was seen in vivo or in vitro.
研究采用数字光处理和半固态挤出打印技术制备了负载多奈哌齐的微针贴片，通过体外渗透: The study used digital light processing and semi-solid extrusion printing technology to prepare microneedle patches loaded with donepezil. In vitro penetration and cell experiments confirmed that it significantly improved the drug's transdermal efficiency, achieved sustained release within the skin layer and showed good biocompatibility.
研究采用数字光处理技术3D打印含碳纳米管和氧化锆陶瓷颗粒的牙科树脂复合材料，比较: The study used digital light processing technology to 3D print dental resin composites containing carbon nanotubes and zirconia ceramic particles. The comparison found that the 0.5 wt.% YSZ group performed best in terms of hardness and flexural strength, and had good oral rinse stability.
研究采用数字光处理技术制备ZrO₂-20 wt% HA复合陶瓷，通过调节HA含量: The study used digital light processing technology to prepare ZrO₂-20 wt% HA composite ceramics. By adjusting the HA content and sintering temperature, a ceramic with a hardness of 3.83 GPa and a flexural strength of 128 MPa was obtained. Its performance is better than that of traditional zirconia, and it has good biocompatibility and can effectively reduce wear on adjacent teeth.
研究采用数字光处理技术制备的义齿基托，分别添加或不添加5wt%植物化学物质微胶囊: A study was conducted on denture bases prepared using digital light processing technology, with or without the addition of 5wt% phytochemical microcapsules. After being inoculated with Candida albicans and subjected to different disinfection treatments, the results showed that the microcapsules significantly reduced bacterial colony attachment and reproduction, and the effect was not affected by the disinfection method.
研究采用数字光处理技术制备羟基磷灰石gyroid支架，通过淀粉和微纤维素引入工程: The study used digital light processing technology to prepare hydroxyapatite gyroid scaffolds, introduced engineered surface roughness through starch and microcellulose, and compared the impact of pore structure on the fracture mechanism. The results showed that the scaffold supported cell adhesion, and high concentrations of starch significantly promoted cell proliferation. Although the compressive strength decreased slightly with porosity, it still met the physiological load requirements.
研究采用数字光处理技术制造5mol%钇稳定氧化锆牙冠，通过优化颗粒分布、悬浮液配: The study uses digital light processing technology to manufacture 5mol% yttrium-stabilized zirconia crowns. By optimizing particle distribution, suspension formula and degreasing process, it achieves high density (99.03%), high cubic phase content and good optical transmittance, and obtains high bending strength and excellent dimensional accuracy.
研究采用数字光处理（DLP）三维打印技术，制作上颌临时冠修复体，通过逐层光照固化: The study uses digital light processing (DLP) three-dimensional printing technology to produce maxillary temporary crown restorations. The resin is cured layer by layer to achieve complex structural manufacturing. The resulting temporary restoration meets aesthetic and functional requirements, significantly shortens clinical and laboratory processes, and improves operational convenience and accuracy.
研究采用数字光处理（DLP）和立体光刻（SLA）技术，以0°、45°、90°不同: The study used digital light processing (DLP) and stereolithography (SLA) technologies to print single crowns at different modeling angles of 0°, 45°, and 90°. The results showed that the modeling angle significantly affected the edge tightness of the crown, with the edge gap at the 0° angle being the smallest. The edge tightness of SLA technology was better than that of DLP technology.
研究采用数字光处理（DLP）技术制备掺杂稀土氧化物的天然色氧化锆义齿，结果显示其: The research uses digital light processing (DLP) technology to prepare natural-colored zirconia dentures doped with rare earth oxides. The results show that the color can cover the Vita 3D color plate, the color difference is less than 1.5 NBS, the molding accuracy reaches 67.7 μm, and the bending strength meets the requirements of the crown, achieving accurate reproduction of natural tooth color.
研究采用数字化光处理结合氧化锆掺杂，制备不同含量氧化锆的锂硅玻璃陶瓷，结果显示L: The research uses digital light processing combined with zirconium oxide doping to prepare lithium-silicon glass ceramics with different contents of zirconium oxide. The results show that LDGC4Z performs best in terms of mechanical properties, light transmittance, wear resistance and biocompatibility, and its comprehensive performance is significantly improved.
研究采用数字化工作流程，利用多功能诊断义齿设计并制作单颌完全义齿，通过三维打印实: The study adopted a digital workflow and used multifunctional diagnostic dentures to design and produce a single-jaw complete denture. Three-dimensional printing was used to realize molar guidance and jaw relationship recording of the opposing teeth. It was combined with milling of artificial teeth and titanium alloy bases. It was completed within three clinical visits, which improved production efficiency and operational convenience.
研究采用数字印模、设计软件和3D打印技术制作手术导板，用于引导下颌骨修整，以提升: The study uses digital impressions, design software and 3D printing technology to produce surgical guides to guide mandibular modification to improve surgical predictability and repair adaptability of immediate denture implantation.
研究采用数字印模结合CAD/CAM与3D打印技术，对部分缺牙患者制作可摘局部义齿: The study used digital impressions combined with CAD/CAM and 3D printing technology to make removable partial dentures for partially edentulous patients. The brackets, artificial teeth and bases were manufactured separately and then assembled. The fully digital process was successfully completed without clinical complications.
研究采用数字孪生 workflow，对比传统与三重周期最小曲面（TPMS）结构的: The study used digital twin workflow to compare traditional and triple periodic minimum surface (TPMS) structures of children's proximal femoral osteotomy implants. The results showed that the TPMS design increased the strain energy density of distal bone tissue, improved bone-implant mechanical matching, and reduced the risk of bone tissue stress shielding.
研究采用文献数据补充热力学与流变学参数，通过Solidworks Plastic: The study used literature data to supplement thermodynamic and rheological parameters, simulated the polycaprolactone filament injection molding process through Solidworks Plastics software, and analyzed the effects of melt temperature, injection time and pressure on the filament geometry. The results showed that simulation can optimize process parameters and verified the feasibility of simulation in developing polycaprolactone implant precursors.
研究采用新型3D打印假手IMMA，结合六根肌腱驱动装置，通过24种物体的八类抓取: The study used a new 3D printed prosthetic hand IMMA, combined with six tendon drive devices, to evaluate the two subjects' grasping ability of the prosthetic hand and coordinated finger movements through eight types of grasping action tests on 24 objects. The results showed that the finger movement coordination of the two was similar, and the movements of the middle finger and ring finger were highly correlated in most grasps.
研究采用新型丝束-free熔融挤出3D打印技术，成功制备了原本不可打印的Solu: The study used new tow-free melt extrusion 3D printing technology to successfully prepare Soluplus®-based brittle sustained-release formulations that were originally unprintable, achieving uniform molding and consistent immediate-release dissolution performance of 250 mg mefenamic acid tablets, and achieving target release behavior through microstructure control.
研究采用新型可挤出聚合物PETOx，制备含右美沙芬和氢氯噻嗪的3D打印片剂，通过: The study used the new extrudable polymer PETOx to prepare 3D printed tablets containing dextromethorphan and hydrochlorothiazide. The drug release was affected by adjusting the number of layer shells. The results showed that the release rate of single-layer tablets exceeded 80% within 60 minutes, and the release rate of five-layer tablets exceeded 60%.
研究采用新型立体光刻法3D打印含六种药物的多层复方制剂，通过不同几何结构和材料组: The study used a new stereolithography method to 3D print a multi-layered compound preparation containing six drugs. The layered layout of the drugs was achieved through different geometric structures and material compositions. Raman microscopy showed that some drugs diffused between layers, and the dissolution test showed that each drug showed differential release. The feasibility of this technology in the production of personalized multi-drug preparations was verified for the first time.
研究采用旋转体打印技术，同时在12至32秒内制备两种形状的对乙酰氨基酚负载打印片: The research uses rotating body printing technology to simultaneously prepare two shapes of acetaminophen-loaded printed tablets within 12 to 32 seconds, achieving simultaneous rapid prototyping of multiple tablets and demonstrating sustained drug release characteristics.
研究采用无丝材的3D打印系统，成功打印了传统丝材打印机无法成型的含30%对乙酰氨: The research uses a filament-free 3D printing system to successfully print an oral solid dosage form containing 30% acetaminophen/HPMC that cannot be molded by traditional filament printers. The formula space is expanded, and the printed product has uniform size, controllable structure, and the ability to design personalized dosage.
研究采用智能手机摄影测量法对经胫骨截肢患者的假肢套筒进行三维数字化，通过360度: The study used smartphone photogrammetry to three-dimensionally digitize the prosthetic sleeve of patients with transtibial amputation. Through 360-degree shooting and algorithm processing, the accuracy of the sleeve wall volume, surface area, and height were measured to be 61.63%, 99.61%, and 99.90% respectively. The proximal wall thickness was different from the standard model, and the accuracy of the base inner wall was insufficient. However, assuming uniform wall thickness, the scan results can meet the needs of clinical use.
研究采用柔性传感器手套控制器，结合3D打印技术，实现对五指独立运动的无线控制，为: The research uses a flexible sensor glove controller, combined with 3D printing technology, to achieve wireless control of the independent movement of the five fingers, providing amputees with a low-cost, easy-to-use bionic prosthetic hand to restore hand function and improve independent living abilities.
研究采用标准化生物力学测试，评估了3D打印聚醚醚酮植入物经生物活性玻璃功能化后的: The study used standardized biomechanical testing to evaluate the impact resistance of 3D printed polyetheretherketone implants functionalized with bioactive glass. The results showed that it can withstand more than 100 Newtons of pressure at 2 mm displacement, absorb energy in excess of 1000 millijoules at 6 mm displacement, and has a complete structure at 10 mm displacement, showing good impact resistance.
研究采用核心-壳3D打印技术制备钙磷酸盐-海藻酸盐可降解支架，通过不同后处理及体: The study uses core-shell 3D printing technology to prepare calcium phosphate-alginate degradable scaffolds. Different post-processing and in vitro tests show that the alginate-coated scaffold exhibits a Young's modulus of approximately 1.71 MPa under 20% load and a compressive strength of more than 2000 N, which is better than the strength of cancellous bone and has potential for bone regeneration and drug release applications.
研究采用梁有限元模型优化3D打印连续纤维增强复合材料假足，通过几何参数化实现重量: The study used a beam finite element model to optimize the 3D printed continuous fiber reinforced composite prosthetic foot. It minimized the weight and matched three static stiffnesses through geometric parameterization, verified the C-shaped and J-shaped structural design, successfully reproduced the stiffness characteristics of the laminated prosthetic foot, and identified the source of errors between the beam model and the plane stress model.
研究采用模板成型法制作聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA）患者特异性颅面植入物，将其与原: The study used a template molding method to produce polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) patient-specific craniofacial implants, and compared them with the original 3D printed templates. The results showed that the root mean square errors of the implants for both defect types were within the acceptable range, proving that this process can copy the original templates with high precision and achieve accurate transformation from virtual planning to physical implants.
研究采用气溶胶喷墨打印技术，快速制备具有复杂几何结构的微流控器件，并在微流道内精: The research uses aerosol inkjet printing technology to quickly prepare microfluidic devices with complex geometric structures, and accurately implements functionalized coatings in microfluidic channels to achieve surface functionalization in specific areas and improve the customization and application flexibility of microfluidic devices.
研究采用水-有机共溶剂法制备重组蜘蛛丝水凝胶，通过调节有机溶剂种类实现对水不溶性: The research uses a water-organic co-solvent method to prepare recombinant spider silk hydrogel. By adjusting the type of organic solvent, water-insoluble drugs (such as 6-mercaptopurine) can be loaded. The resulting gel has shear thinning properties, can be injected and used as a drug sustained release Depot, and supports the construction of 3D printed biological scaffolds.
研究采用水溶性聚乙烯醇（PVA）3D打印制作颌面义齿原型，通过测定弯曲强度和模量: The study used water-soluble polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) 3D printing to produce a maxillofacial denture prototype. By measuring the bending strength and modulus, the anisotropy of its mechanical properties was verified, providing a feasible solution for the conversion from scanned data to denture molds in the digital workflow.
研究采用水溶性载体聚-4-丙烯酰氧基吗啉与不溶性单体共打印，通过墨水喷射3D打印: The study uses water-soluble carrier poly-4-acryloyloxymorpholine and insoluble monomers to co-print, and uses ink jet 3D printing technology to achieve precise preparation of personalized tablets. A dissolution curve from slow to fast and multi-stage release is obtained, verifying its feasibility in controlling drug release.
研究采用注射式3D打印技术制备了含苯妥英的口崩片，比较了HPMC E5与E15作: The study used injection 3D printing technology to prepare orally disintegrating tablets containing phenytoin, and compared the effects of HPMC E5 and E15 as film-forming agents. The results showed that the orally disintegrating tablets prepared by HPMC E15 had shorter disintegration time, rapid dissolution, uniform drug content, and excellent mechanical properties, which were superior to E5 films.
研究采用注射成型和3D打印技术制备含氟尿嘧啶、硫酸铜和银硫代硫酸钠的多药宫内装置: The study used injection molding and 3D printing technology to prepare a multi-drug intrauterine device containing fluorouracil, copper sulfate and silver sodium thiosulfate. The drug load was verified through FTIR and DSC, which showed that the drug release showed biphasic kinetics, with both mechanical strength and controllable release characteristics. It provides a long-acting local treatment platform for gynecological infections and precancerous lesions.
研究采用注射成型模拟与实验验证，考察不同多壁碳纳米管含量（0.5%、5%、10%: The study used injection molding simulation and experimental verification to examine the impact of different multi-walled carbon nanotube contents (0.5%, 5%, 10%) on the molding properties of polycaprolactone-based nanocomposites. The results showed that the 0.5% content group had stable filling, complete filling, and fewer defects, which was better than the high-content group.
研究采用消费级3D打印技术，利用PLA、PXA、PHA及PHA/PLA共混物制备: The research uses consumer-grade 3D printing technology to prepare cell culture dishes using PLA, PXA, PHA and PHA/PLA blends, and obtains optically clear 0.1mm coverslips through hot-pressing post-processing. PHA and PHA/PLA can withstand high temperature sterilization and have no effect on cell proliferation, which is better than PLA and PXA.
研究采用消费级3D打印机和低成本旋涂装置制备各类 planoconvex 镜片，: The research uses consumer-grade 3D printers and low-cost spin coating devices to prepare various types of planoconvex lenses, and detects their surface quality and curvature through mechanical and optical methods. The results show that the curvature and optical performance of 3D printed lenses are equivalent to commercial glass lenses, and can be used in bright-field transmission microscopy to achieve subcellular structure imaging.
研究采用消费者级3D打印机制作单层硬化微流控芯片，结合新型气流拦截式主动控流机制: The research uses a consumer-grade 3D printer to produce a single-layer hardened microfluidic chip, combined with a new airflow interception active flow control mechanism, to achieve portable automatic microfluidic operation without additional equipment. This system can block, guide and transmit fluids, and its performance is comparable to traditional systems.
研究采用液晶显示（LCD）3D打印技术，以PEGDA为树脂、TPO为引发剂、塔塔: The study used liquid crystal display (LCD) 3D printing technology to prepare mucosal drug delivery oral films using PEGDA as resin, TPO as initiator, Tata azine as light absorber, PEG 300 as additive, and HPMC as adhesive. The effects of formula and parameters on printing molding and performance were systematically explored. The results showed that PEG 300 improves film flexibility and drug release rate, while HPMC enhances adhesion but excess will increase viscosity and reduce printability. Under optimized conditions, a double-layer oral film with stable structure, good mechanical properties, strong adhesion, suitable drug release and in vivo efficacy was successfully prepared.
研究采用淀粉1500®、麦芽糖和海藻酸钠制成的药用聚合物水凝胶，通过半固态挤出3: The research uses pharmaceutical polymer hydrogels made of starch 1500®, maltose and sodium alginate to prepare skin tissue engineering scaffolds and oral drug sustained-release tablets through semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology. The results show that it has good printing performance, cell compatibility and controlled release characteristics.
研究采用深度学习与网格型3D建模技术，为甲状腺手术患者制作个性化3D打印模型，用: The study uses deep learning and grid-based 3D modeling technology to create personalized 3D printed models for thyroid surgery patients to enhance their understanding and satisfaction with the surgical process. The results show that the model effectively improves patient awareness and satisfaction during the informed consent process.
研究采用温度响应性自折叠材料通过SSE介导3D打印制备4D打印结构，经50°C编: The study used temperature-responsive self-folding materials to prepare 4D printed structures through SSE-mediated 3D printing. After programming at 50°C and fixing at 4°C, the shape was restored at 37°C. Combined with machine learning optimization, a deformation recovery rate of 97.41% was obtained, achieving efficient encapsulation of acetaminophen (98.11%) and nearly 100% release within 4 hours at gastric pH.
研究采用湿球磨法制备吲哚美辛纳米晶，结合半固态挤出3D打印技术，以羟丙基甲基纤维: The study used a wet ball milling method to prepare indomethacin nanocrystals, combined with semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology, using hydroxypropyl methylcellulose as a film-forming agent and glycerol as a plasticizer. After optimizing the HPMC concentration and stabilizer, a flexible and uniform 3D printed film was produced that disintegrated within 1-2.5 minutes and released the drug within 2-3 minutes. The nanocrystal size was maintained at 300-500 nm, which is similar to traditional cast film sheets in terms of physical and chemical properties and efficacy.
研究采用溶液挤出3D打印技术制备载药聚己内酯/纳米羟基磷灰石纳米复合材料，发现其: The study used solution extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare drug-loaded polycaprolactone/nano-hydroxyapatite nanocomposites. It was found that its mechanical properties increased with the increase in the ratio of PCL/nHA to methylene chloride, filling density and printing direction, but decreased with the increase in printing speed. The printed drug-loaded screws continued to release high concentrations of vancomycin and ceftazidime within 14 days.
研究采用激光3D打印制备含铜钛合金多孔支架，相比纯钛支架，其显著增强兔骨髓间充质: The study used laser 3D printing to prepare copper-containing titanium alloy porous scaffolds. Compared with pure titanium scaffolds, it significantly enhanced the osteogenic differentiation of rabbit bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and promoted osseointegration in vivo. It also effectively inhibited the biofilm formation of Staphylococcus aureus, Staphylococcus epidermidis and Escherichia coli.
研究采用激光粉末床熔融技术制备锌改性NiTi形状记忆合金植入物，将其抗菌性能与超: The study used laser powder bed fusion technology to prepare zinc-modified NiTi shape memory alloy implants, combining its antibacterial properties with superelasticity. The results showed that the material had good antibacterial effects against Staphylococcus aureus, and the addition of zinc did not inhibit its martensitic phase transformation and maintained superelastic recovery capabilities.
研究采用激光粉末床融合工艺制造近β型Ti-13Nb-13Zr合金，通过优化工艺参: The study uses a laser powder bed fusion process to manufacture near-β-type Ti-13Nb-13Zr alloy. By optimizing process parameters and heat treatment strategies (including supercritical and subcritical annealing and different quenching media), the microstructure is controlled to obtain implants with high density, excellent mechanical properties and good corrosion resistance.
研究采用激光粉末床融合技术制备316L不锈钢重入型仿生蜂窝结构，经热处理后进行静: The study used laser powder bed fusion technology to prepare a 316L stainless steel reentrant bionic honeycomb structure. After heat treatment, statics and fatigue tests were conducted. The results showed that the structure can significantly reduce stiffness and maintain load-bearing capacity. Heat treatment improves toughness and fatigue performance, but there is a trade-off between stiffness and strength.
研究采用激光粉末床融合技术制备了具有梯度密度和混合泊松比的钛合金蜂窝结构，通过四: The study used laser powder bed fusion technology to prepare a titanium alloy honeycomb structure with gradient density and mixed Poisson's ratio, and evaluated its bending performance through a four-point bending test. The results showed that the gradient density mixed Poisson's ratio structure performed the best in terms of energy absorption, 78.7% higher than the positive Poisson's ratio structure.
研究采用激光粉末床融合技术制备了具有蜂窝和格构几何结构的多孔材料，通过实体分析与: The study used laser powder bed fusion technology to prepare porous materials with honeycomb and lattice geometric structures. Through solid analysis and finite element simulation, it was found that the dimensional accuracy of the parts was within the range of ±50 μm, the pore corners were naturally rounded, there were molten powder fragments inside, and the porous structure showed stress concentration when stressed.
研究采用激光粉末床融合技术制备了超弹性Ti–Zr–Nb合金的三种开孔蜂窝结构，通: The study used laser powder bed fusion technology to prepare three open-cell honeycomb structures of superelastic Ti–Zr–Nb alloys. Through the optimization process, the functional porosity was 65–80%, the strut thickness was 200–400 μm, the geometric accuracy was high, the defect porosity was less than 0.2%, and its fatigue performance was better than the Ti-6Al-4V benchmark material.
研究采用激光诱导原位合成技术，在激光选区熔融制备的Zr-2.5Nb合金表面制备陶: The study used laser-induced in-situ synthesis technology to prepare ceramic coatings on the surface of Zr-2.5Nb alloy prepared by laser selective melting. The effect of laser energy density on the microstructure, hardness and surface integrity of the coating was systematically investigated. It was found that the coating hardness reached 1177 HV under 80 W power and 80 mm/s scanning speed, and the coating was thin and dense at low energy density. Although it became thicker at high energy density, transverse cracks at the interface and vertical solidification cracks within the layer appeared.
研究采用激光选区熔融3D打印技术制备孔径为200、350和500μm的Ti6Al: The study used laser selective melting 3D printing technology to prepare Ti6Al4V porous dental implants with pore sizes of 200, 350 and 500 μm. The stress distribution was analyzed through photoelastic imaging and finite element simulation. In vitro experiments showed that the 350 μm pore implant was superior to other groups in terms of cell growth, migration and osteogenic gene expression, showing better biocompatibility and osteoinduction potential.
研究采用激光选区熔融技术制备了10种Ti–Nb–Fe–Sn合金，通过调控工艺参数: The study used laser selective melting technology to prepare 10 types of Ti–Nb–Fe–Sn alloys. A uniform structure was obtained by adjusting process parameters. It was found that an equiaxed crystal structure was achieved under a scanning speed of 100 mm/s and a laser power of 100 W. The elastic modulus of the alloy varied with the composition between 60–100 GPa, and the addition of Fe increased the hardness to 250–320 HV, indicating that this process can achieve gradient mechanical property matching and is suitable for hip joint prosthesis design.
研究采用激光选区熔融技术制备钛钽合金仿生格构体，保留结构拓扑，其强度模量比与传统: The research uses laser selective melting technology to prepare titanium-tantalum alloy bionic lattice, which retains the structural topology. Its strength-to-modulus ratio is equivalent to that of traditional Ti-6Al-4V, with higher ductility and biocompatibility. The lattice shows better elastic strain and cell response in bone implants.
研究采用激光选区熔融技术制造了Ti6Al4V材料的患者特异性开放多孔钛结构，通过: The study used laser selective melting technology to create a patient-specific open porous titanium structure of Ti6Al4V material. By statically culturing Saos-2 cells, the effects of pore size and pore shape on cell morphology, metabolic activity and alkaline phosphatase activity were investigated. The results showed that the cell response had nothing to do with pore size and pore shape, and the mechanical properties of the structure were between cortical bone and cancellous bone.
研究采用激光选区熔融技术，将石墨添加至β Ti-42Nb合金中，通过调控石墨含量: The study uses laser selective melting technology to add graphite to β Ti-42Nb alloy. By controlling the graphite content, the TiC reinforcement phase is generated in situ, and a β-type titanium-based composite material with uniform microstructure, improved hardness and elastic modulus is obtained. Its elastic modulus is still significantly lower than that of Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
研究采用点对点3D打印技术，为颅面患者定制制造碳纤维增强、硫酸钡填充及磷酸钙填充: The research uses point-to-point 3D printing technology to customize carbon fiber-reinforced, barium sulfate-filled and calcium phosphate-filled PEEK composite implants for craniofacial patients to achieve optimization of mechanical strength, image visibility and biological activity. All materials are 100% successfully manufactured, with good dimensional accuracy and interlayer bonding, and dimensional stability after sterilization.
研究采用热滴基3D打印技术制备了含对乙酰氨基酚和尼莫地平的双药载体制剂，实现同步: The study used hot drop-based 3D printing technology to prepare a dual-drug carrier formulation containing acetaminophen and nimodipine to achieve simultaneous and delayed drug release. However, the pulse release effect was unclear, indicating that soluble and erodible materials have limitations in achieving pulse release.
研究采用热熔挤出与三维打印技术制备了含有茶碱的胃滞留浮泡片，通过调节填充率和壳层: The study used hot melt extrusion and three-dimensional printing technology to prepare gastric retention buoyant tablets containing theophylline. By adjusting the filling rate and shell thickness, the floating and zero-order release of the drug was achieved within 10 hours. The release behavior conformed to the Fick-type diffusion and swelling mechanism, and the crystallinity of the drug did not change.
研究采用热熔挤出制备伊布uprofen的固态分散体，结合3D打印技术，通过调节填: The study used hot melt extrusion to prepare solid dispersions of Ibrahimovic uprofen, combined with 3D printing technology, to control drug release by adjusting filler density (20%–80%). Experiments show that the higher the filler density, the slower the release, and the release behavior is significantly correlated with density.
研究采用热熔挤出和熔融沉积建模技术，制备Diclofenac Sodium三维打: The study used hot melt extrusion and fused deposition modeling technology to prepare three-dimensional printed cylindrical and tubular tablets of Diclofenac Sodium. The results showed that crospovidone increased the dissolution rate, while croscarmellose sodium decreased the dissolution rate.
研究采用热熔挤出技术结合纳米技术、3D打印和共挤出，优化聚合物配方以提升药物递送: The research uses hot melt extrusion technology combined with nanotechnology, 3D printing and co-extrusion to optimize the polymer formula to improve the functionality and safety of the drug delivery system. The results show that this technology has broad application prospects in the pharmaceutical field, but the problems of high temperature, high shear force and high energy consumption still need to be improved.
研究采用热熔挤出法制备不同 Naproxen 药物负载（10–30% w/w）的: The study used a hot melt extrusion method to prepare amorphous solid formulations with different Naproxen drug loads (10–30% w/w) and molded them through 3D printing. The results showed that the 20% and 30% drug-loaded groups remained amorphous after 23 weeks of storage at room temperature and high humidity, indicating that optimizing the drug ratio can improve printing performance without affecting solid-state stability.
研究采用热熔挤出法制备不同黏度乙基纤维素（EC）等级的盐酸布普洛尔缓释片，经球形: The study used hot melt extrusion to prepare ethylcellulose (EC) grade sustained-release tablets of different viscosity ethylcellulose (EC), which were spheroidized and used for screw 3D printing. The results showed that the higher the EC viscosity, the harder the tablet, the smaller the swelling, the lower the porosity after dissolution, and the slower the drug release. The morphology and pore structure affect the release behavior.
研究采用热熔挤出法制备了30mg巴氯芬缓释片，结合3D打印构建了具有不同释放窗面: The study used hot-melt extrusion to prepare 30 mg baclofen sustained-release tablets, and combined with 3D printing to construct gastric floating devices with different release window areas (4, 10, 20, 40mm²). The results showed that reducing the release window area can significantly reduce the dissolution rate of baclofen. Among them, the 40mm² double-window device (D) achieved complete release and sustained floating for 12 hours under the F3 formula.
研究采用热熔挤出法将二吡啶胺或茶碱与聚乙烯吡咯烷酮混合制成丝材，通过3D打印制备: The research uses hot melt extrusion to mix dipyridylamine or theophylline and polyvinylpyrrolidone to make filaments, and prepare personalized immediate-release tablets through 3D printing. The drug integrity is retained at low temperature (110°C), and the printed tablets have good mechanical properties and immediate-release characteristics.
研究采用热熔挤出结合3D打印技术制备含120mg和60mg尼福替莫的片剂，结果显: The study used hot melt extrusion combined with 3D printing technology to prepare tablets containing 120 mg and 60 mg of niformimol. The results showed that its dissolution rate was significantly better than that of commercial tablets, with a dissolution efficiency of 2.8 times. Its anti-parasitic effect in mice was better than that of the pure drug, and it was equivalent to the effect of hydrazine benzoate in reducing parasites in plasma.
研究采用热熔挤出结合FDM 3D打印制备了不同填充图案的白藜芦醇载体制剂，结果表: The study used hot melt extrusion combined with FDM 3D printing to prepare resveratrol carrier formulations with different filling patterns. The results showed that the filling patterns affected the mechanical properties and in vitro drug release behavior of the tablets, and complex filling patterns led to slower drug release.
研究采用热熔气动挤出法，通过3D打印直接制备含难溶性药物奥兰zapine的口崩片: The study used a hot-melt pneumatic extrusion method to directly prepare orally disintegrating tablets containing the poorly soluble drug Oranzapine through 3D printing. The ratio of polymers and plasticizers was optimized to achieve rapid dissolution of the drug. The dissolution rate reached 88% within 5 minutes, and the tablets disintegrated within 22 seconds, showing good absorption potential.
研究采用熔融固化打印工艺制备含尼卡唑纳米晶的3D打印胃滞留片，实现胃内缓释，显微: The study used a melt solidification printing process to prepare 3D printed gastric retention tablets containing nicazole nanocrystals to achieve sustained release in the stomach. Microscopic observation confirmed that the nanocrystals can be redispersed in simulated gastric juice and have no effect on the vitality of GES-1 cells. The gastric retention time in dogs reaches 180 minutes.
研究采用熔融拉伸法制造可定制化多层聚乳酸-ε-己内酯纤维管状支架，通过调节拉伸速: The research uses a melt stretching method to manufacture a customizable multi-layer polylactic acid-ε-caprolactone fiber tubular scaffold. The fiber diameter and mechanical properties are controlled by adjusting the stretching speed and layer thickness. The surface of the scaffold is highly oriented and adjustable. In vitro experiments show that myogenic cells and fibroblasts proliferate well, and human mesenchymal stem cells can differentiate into the smooth muscle lineage without inducing factors.
研究采用熔融挤出3D打印技术，对难溶模型化合物制备为固态分散体，溶水溶性提升至6: The research uses melt extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare insoluble model compounds into solid dispersions, with the water solubility increased to 60 μg/mL, achieving structured release control of immediate release, sustained release and slow-delayed release.
研究采用熔融沉积建模技术制备含双氯芬酸钠的可植入药物递送系统，通过体外溶出和细胞: The study used fused deposition modeling technology to prepare an implantable drug delivery system containing diclofenac sodium, and evaluated its performance through in vitro dissolution and cytotoxicity tests. The results showed that the sample was non-toxic and the dissolution characteristics were affected by the material, diameter and filling rate.
研究采用熔融沉积成型技术制备个性化对乙酰氨基酚口服用制剂，通过调整数字设计和内部: The study used fused deposition modeling technology to prepare personalized oral acetaminophen preparations. Dosage adjustment and drug release control were achieved by adjusting digital design and internal filling density. The results showed that filling density affects the drug release rate. Low-filling structures release quickly, and high-filling structures release matrix-type, indicating that this technology has the potential for personalized dose adjustment.
研究采用熔融沉积成型技术，首次实现透明聚苯乙烯材料微流控芯片的快速原型制造，成功: The study used fused deposition modeling technology to achieve rapid prototyping of transparent polystyrene material microfluidic chips for the first time, successfully preparing 300 µm-wide microfluidic channels and functional chips. Cell culture showed high survival rate, good attachment and proliferation, verifying the feasibility of this method in the early development of biomedical microfluidic devices.
研究采用牛椎骨和影像仿生体，通过不同CT层厚重建（0.1、0.3、0.5、1 m: The study used bovine vertebrae and imaging bionic bodies, reconstructed data with different CT layer thicknesses (0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1 mm) and measured them after FDM printing. It was found that the layer thickness affects the spatial replication accuracy of the 3D printed model. The accuracy is optimal when the layer thickness matches the original data resolution or printer capability.
研究采用甘草次酸-芹菜素喷雾干燥固体分散体，结合PVA丝基3D打印技术制备了AP: The study used glycyrrhetinic acid-apigenin spray-dried solid dispersion, combined with PVA silk-based 3D printing technology, to prepare three preparations of APN1-APN3. Among them, APN2 showed better fluidity and solubility properties, with a dissolution efficiency of 19.2%. It was superior to commercially available apigenin preparations in terms of in vitro release rate and antioxidant and anti-tumor activity, and had good stability.
研究采用生物模拟涂层将BMP-2与纤维连接蛋白复合包覆于3D打印多孔PEEK支架: The study used a biomimetic coating to compositely coat BMP-2 and fibronectin on the surface of 3D printed porous PEEK scaffolds. Through in vitro cell co-culture and in vivo experiments, it was found that the coating can synergistically promote angiogenesis and bone regeneration, and its effect is due to the interaction and sustained release properties of the two factor signaling pathways.
研究采用电子舌结合实验设计，优化3D打印左乙拉西坦即释片的赋形剂配比，发现2%三: The study used an electronic tongue combined with experimental design to optimize the excipient ratio of 3D printed levetiracetam immediate-release tablets. It was found that 2% sucralose and 0.5% peppermint flavor can effectively mask the bitter taste and taste similar to the placebo. The human taste test results are consistent with the electronic tongue evaluation.
研究采用电纺丝结合3D打印技术制备聚己内酯与丝素蛋白（4:6）纳米纤维支架，比较: The study used electrospinning combined with 3D printing technology to prepare polycaprolactone and silk fibroin (4:6) nanofiber scaffolds, and compared their physical and chemical properties and biocompatibility. The results showed that cells can penetrate the scaffolds and achieve orderly growth in vitro and in animal models, achieving the purpose of urinary catheter repair.
研究采用电纺制备的93±51 µm长、1.6±0.3 µm直径的羟基凝胶微纤维，: The study used hydroxyl gel microfibers with a length of 93±51 µm and a diameter of 1.6±0.3 µm prepared by electrospinning to construct a dense microfiber hydrogel (PHM), which has excellent mechanical stability and strain response characteristics. After 3D printing, it can induce cell alignment and promote cell spreading, providing a dynamic and printable biomaterial scaffold for tissue engineering.
研究采用电纺和3D打印技术，将聚乳酸（PLA）支架结构与PLA纳米纤维网结合，制: The study used electrospinning and 3D printing technology to combine the polylactic acid (PLA) scaffold structure with the PLA nanofiber network to prepare a transparent degradable mask filter layer with a layered structure. The effect of nozzle temperature on the optical, mechanical, morphological and filtration performance of the filter layer was investigated.
研究采用电脑皮层信号控制低成本机械臂，结合机器学习识别物体形状，配备触觉反馈系统: The study used computer cortex signals to control a low-cost robotic arm, combined with machine learning to recognize object shapes, and equipped with a tactile feedback system. Tests were conducted on amputees, showing that the average success rate in a variety of tasks reached 86.67%, and the average object recognition accuracy rate reached 70%.
研究采用直径5毫米、多孔的3D打印钙磷酸盐水泥（CPC）支架，以5-氟尿嘧啶（5: The study used a 5 mm diameter, porous 3D printed calcium phosphate cement (CPC) scaffold, using 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) as a model anti-cancer drug, and evenly coated it with Soluplus, PEG or a combination of the two solutions. The results showed that the drug was almost completely released within 2 hours, and significantly inhibited cell growth in human kidney cells and osteosarcoma cells.
研究采用直接粉末挤出3D打印技术，对比粉末、颗粒和粒状聚羟基丁酸酯（PHB）的可: The study used direct powder extrusion 3D printing technology to compare the processability of powder, granular and granular polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB), and successfully prepared a PHB-based dental drug device with immediate and sustained dual release functions. Its controlled drug release and biological activity were verified through in vitro release and antibacterial testing.
研究采用直接粉末挤出3D打印技术，将它唑康唑与四种不同等级的羟丙基纤维素制成打印: The study used direct powder extrusion 3D printing technology to make printed tablets from trazoconazole and four different grades of hydroxypropyl cellulose. All samples had good physical properties and sustained-release characteristics. Among them, the ultra-low molecular grade HPC group released faster because the drug existed in a higher proportion as an amorphous solid dispersion.
研究采用直接粉末挤出3D打印技术，将阿托伐他汀钙制备为即时释放片，通过优化工艺参: The study used direct powder extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare atorvastatin calcium into immediate-release tablets. The drug was amorphous by optimizing process parameters. The resulting tablets released approximately 86% within 30 minutes in pH 6.8 phosphate buffer, which complied with USP standards, and remained amorphous and had good dissolution properties after accelerated stability testing.
研究采用直接粉末挤出技术制备了含20mg硝苯地平的微型片剂，其重量小于100mg: The study used direct powder extrusion technology to prepare micro-tablets containing 20 mg of nifedipine, which weigh less than 100 mg and have a drug load of 25%. They are molded with excipients such as polyethylene glycol to achieve 24-hour controlled release, avoiding hypotension caused by immediate release, and can be packed into No. 0 capsules for easy compounding.
研究采用直接粉末挤出（DPE）技术制备了适用于 rodents 体内试验的3D打: The study used direct powder extrusion (DPE) technology to prepare 3D printed micro-tablets suitable for in vivo testing of rodents, using hydroxypropyl cellulose and hydroxypropyl methylcellulose as the matrix, containing 10% w/w model drug, optimizing the rheological and extrusion properties, and successfully printed micro-tablets with a size of 8.6 × 1.8 × 1.8 mm. Its physical and mechanical properties are good, and the release behavior is comparable to traditional capsules.
研究采用相同3D打印机，对比常规SSE-3DP与模板基墨水沉积（TID）法制造茶: The study used the same 3D printer to compare conventional SSE-3DP and template-based ink deposition (TID) methods to manufacture theophylline sustained-release gummy tablets. The TID method shortened the deposition time to 2-6 seconds, which is 7 times faster than the traditional method. The finished product complies with pharmacopoeia standards and has different release characteristics but good stability.
研究采用硅基仿生体和健康志愿者肾脏，比较不同振动频率、取向及后处理算法对肾僵硬度: The study used silicon-based bionic bodies and kidneys of healthy volunteers to compare the accuracy and repeatability of kidney stiffness measurement with different vibration frequencies, orientations and post-processing algorithms. The results showed that the 120 Hz frequency and LFE algorithm performed best in the full range of bionic bodies, and 60 Hz was more suitable for low hardness values and in vivo applications. Post-processing significantly affected the results, and orientation had a smaller impact.
研究采用碘掺杂3D打印钛合金植入物，针对骨科植入物相关细菌感染，结果显示其具备抗: The study used iodine-doped 3D printed titanium alloy implants to target bacterial infections related to orthopedic implants. The results showed that it has antibacterial properties, indicating that the combination of iodine doping and 3D printing has the potential to treat postoperative infections.
研究采用立体光刻3D打印技术制备具有患者真实形态和多密度的分实肺结节模型，经17: The study used stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare a solid pulmonary nodule model with the patient's true shape and multiple densities. After blind evaluation by 17 radiologists, 47.5% of the models were misjudged as real nodules, and the average recognition accuracy was 53.5%, confirming its clinical relevance and customizability in CT imaging research.
研究采用立体光刻3D打印技术制备含左氧氟沙星的耳部药物植入物，通过体外释放试验和: The study used stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare ear drug implants containing levofloxacin. In vitro release tests and antibacterial tests showed that the drug was completely dissolved in the carrier, with a release rate of 50% within 3 weeks, and its antibacterial activity against Escherichia coli was higher than Staphylococcus aureus.
研究采用立体光刻3D打印技术制备锥形和沟槽微针阵列，在猪皮离体模型中验证其穿透力: The study used stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare tapered and grooved microneedle arrays, and verified its penetration and drug release performance in an in vitro pig skin model. The grooved microneedle only required 2.2 N to be fully inserted at a sharp angle of 18.92° and released 4.8 μg of drug within 2 hours, demonstrating its superior performance in transdermal drug delivery.
研究采用立体光刻3D打印技术，制备了与真实解剖尺寸相似的柔性颅内动脉瘤仿生模型，: The study used stereolithography 3D printing technology to prepare a flexible intracranial aneurysm bionic model with similar anatomical dimensions. Its feasibility in multi-modal flow dynamics visualization and measurement was verified through ultrasound and high-speed photography combined with particle image velocimetry technology.
研究采用立体光刻技术制备了包覆含原卟啉IX羟凝胶的金字塔形微针，其中以双层聚氧乙: The study used stereolithography technology to prepare pyramidal microneedles coated with protoporphyrin IX hydroxyl gel. Among them, the double-layer polyoxyethylene gel performed best. The release of PPIX stabilized after an initial increase. The four-hour release amount was 0.2569±0.0683 mg/cm², and the acute toxicity was low.
研究采用立体光刻技术制备了氧化铝与玻璃复合陶瓷牙冠模型，通过脱蜡烧结处理，所得氧: The study used stereolithography technology to prepare an alumina and glass composite ceramic crown model. Through dewaxing and sintering, the bending strength of the obtained alumina ceramic reached 400 MPa, and the surface was coated with a glass layer to seal micro-cracks.
研究采用立体光刻技术制备了负载黄酮类营养素巴比妥的纳米复合药丸，通过光聚合形成高: The study used stereolithography technology to prepare nanocomposite pills loaded with the flavonoid nutrient barbiturate. It formed a high-fidelity monomer structure through photopolymerization and successfully encapsulated the barbiturate nanoparticles in the pill. It expanded in an acidic environment and achieved 50.39% rapid drug release. The release process matched the gastrointestinal transit time.
研究采用立体光刻技术（SLA）制造临时冠桥，通过调整虚拟模型的尺寸系数和支撑数量: The study uses stereolithography technology (SLA) to manufacture temporary crowns and bridges. By adjusting the size coefficient and number of supports of the virtual model, and aligning the tooth axis with the printing direction, the dimensional accuracy and surface smoothness of the temporary restoration are improved.
研究采用立体光刻技术，以不同PEGDA与聚己内酯三醇比例的新型光敏树脂，制备含对: The study used stereolithography technology and used new photosensitive resins with different ratios of PEGDA and polycaprolactone triol to prepare oral preparations containing two concentrations of acetaminophen and aspirin, achieving precise printing of personalized doses. The results showed that both drugs showed sustained release within 24 hours, and there was a statistical difference between the size of the printed parts and the target value, suggesting that the process needs to be optimized.
研究采用立体光刻（SLA）3D打印技术，结合简便后处理流程，制备高精度微流控模具: The research uses stereolithography (SLA) 3D printing technology, combined with a simple post-processing process, to prepare high-precision microfluidic molds, and successfully achieves rapid prototyping of polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) microfluidic chips at the 75 μm scale, significantly reducing surface roughness and maintaining design dimensional accuracy, and is used for the construction and optimization of exosome exchange platforms.
研究采用立方体与CT基解剖模型的兔头假体，通过CT扫描获取三维结构，利用电磁仿真: The study used a rabbit head prosthesis based on cubes and CT-based anatomical models. The three-dimensional structure was obtained through CT scanning. Electromagnetic simulation software was used to simulate EEG and compare the measurement data. It verified the accuracy of the software in forward modeling of rat EEG and provided support for the optimization of brain stimulation protocols and electrode placement.
研究采用第四代氧化锆（4Y-TZP）制成的三单位单冠固定桥，通过增材制造新型聚合: The study uses a three-unit single crown fixed bridge made of fourth-generation zirconia (4Y-TZP). Through additive manufacturing of a new polymer substrate, combined with analytical, finite element and experimental methods, it is verified that the design can effectively reduce the impact of the substrate on the stress of the connector, improve the experimental repeatability and reliability, and clarify its load-bearing capacity.
研究采用等离子体生成臭氧并通入外科口罩纤维，通过流动配置实现快速灭活大肠杆菌和牛: The research uses plasma to generate ozone and pass it through the fibers of surgical masks. It achieves rapid inactivation of E. coli and vaccinia virus through flow configuration, significantly shortening the sterilization time without damaging the mask structure and filtration efficiency. This method can be achieved using common equipment, and the effect is comparable to expensive equipment.
研究采用简化半固态挤出法制备了丙丙醇、螺内酯和泼尼松龙的个性化儿童片剂，经质量控: The study used a simplified semi-solid extrusion method to prepare personalized children's tablets of propyl alcohol, spironolactone and prednisolone. Quality control showed that the quality was uniform and stable, and the dissolution complied with USP standards. The drug loss rate after administration through nasogastric tube was 4% to 36%.
研究采用简单安全的无机化学氧化法在选择性激光熔融Ti-6Al-4V牙科种植体表面: The study used a simple and safe inorganic chemical oxidation method to construct a hierarchical micro-nano topological structure on the surface of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V dental implants. The results showed that this structure can improve osteoblast activity and early osseointegration quality. The initial bone-implant contact is richer in mineralized bone, and the later osseointegration degree is equivalent to untreated and commercially available implants.
研究采用粉末床喷墨增材制造技术，结合粉末冶金制备多孔钛植入物，通过调控工艺参数控: The research uses powder bed inkjet additive manufacturing technology, combined with powder metallurgy, to prepare porous titanium implants, and controls its porosity and mechanical properties by regulating process parameters. The resulting sample has a porosity of 12-43%, a compressive strength of 56-1000 MPa, a shear strength reduction of 24-30%, and the vertical channel structure achieves isotropic shrinkage.
研究采用紫外辅助同轴打印直接制备微流控连接器，无需额外组件，通过外流速调控内通道: The research uses UV-assisted coaxial printing to directly prepare microfluidic connectors without additional components. The internal channel size is controlled by the external flow rate to achieve a minimum inner diameter of approximately 120 µm and a pressure resistance of over 450 kPa, effectively solving problems such as misalignment, clogging, and large volume in traditional connection methods.
研究采用纤维素纳米纤丝-海藻酸盐-球形木质素纳米颗粒复合水凝胶，通过3D打印制备: The study used cellulose nanofibrils-alginate-spherical lignin nanoparticles composite hydrogel to prepare a scaffold with high water retention and good shape stability through 3D printing. The scaffold still maintains structural integrity after being stored in Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ solutions for 7 days, and is non-toxic to liver cancer HepG2 cells. Cells can grow on the surface and inside the scaffold.
研究采用编号式3D打印金属微反应器，通过串联组装实现对三种芳香族药物骨架的快速合: The research uses numbered 3D printed metal microreactors to achieve rapid synthesis of three aromatic drug skeletons through series assembly. A single microreactor completes the rapid exchange and subsequent reactions of halogenated aromatic hydrocarbons and lithium intermediates. After 4-fold and 16-fold modular amplification, a high-yield continuous synthesis with a yield of 20 grams per 10 minutes is achieved.
研究采用羟丙基甲基纤维素和甲基纤维素制成的水凝胶，通过半固态挤出3D打印技术制备: The study used hydrogels made of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose and methylcellulose to prepare theophylline-containing sustained-release tablets and degradable support structures through semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology. The results showed that it has good printing performance and mechanical strength, the release process conforms to non-Fickian diffusion characteristics, and drug delivery can be achieved through diffusion and dissolution mechanisms.
研究采用羟丙基甲基纤维素基半固态挤出3D打印技术，制备了不同HPMC浓度和填充率: The study used hydroxypropyl methylcellulose-based semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology to prepare gastric floating famotidine tablets with different HPMC concentrations and filling rates. The results showed that they could achieve floating within 10 hours, and the drug release was consistent with a non-Fick-type mechanism, and the crystallinity remained unchanged.
研究采用聚ε-己内酯与含锶羟基磷灰石构建三维打印复合支架，评估其在骨再生中的细胞: The study used polyε-caprolactone and strontium-containing hydroxyapatite to construct a three-dimensional printed composite scaffold, and evaluated its cytocompatibility and osteogenic potential in bone regeneration. The results showed that the scaffold has good osteogenic ability and is suitable for osteoporosis treatment scenarios.
研究采用聚丙烯单壁空心设计的3D打印个人防护装备，经大肠杆菌污染后，通过化学或热: Research on 3D printed personal protective equipment using a polypropylene single-wall hollow design was sterilized by chemical or thermal methods after being contaminated by E. coli. The results showed that both polylactic acid and thermoplastic polyurethane materials showed significant bacterial growth after re-sterilization, while the polypropylene design remained sterile after disinfection and had the ability to be re-sterilized.
研究采用聚乙二醇32-硬脂酸为基质，结合负载 tacrolimus 的固分散体，: The study used polyethylene glycol 32-stearic acid as the matrix, combined with the solid dispersion loaded with tacrolimus, and prepared four sizes of surface patches through semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology. It successfully achieved stable loading of the amorphous state of the drug. The resulting preparation has good mechanical properties, dissolution behavior and stability.
研究采用聚乙烯基丁基涂层硅胶粉末，通过喷雾干燥和压力-真空浸渗工艺，实现个性化颌: The study used polyvinyl butyl-coated silica gel powder to achieve direct 3D printing of personalized maxillofacial dentures through spray drying and pressure-vacuum impregnation processes, verifying the feasibility of this method in the manufacturing process and its impact on material properties.
研究采用聚乙烯醇与对乙酰氨基酚或羟丙基纤维素与氢氯噻嗪混合物，通过0.4mm和0: The study used a mixture of polyvinyl alcohol and acetaminophen or hydroxypropyl cellulose and hydrochlorothiazide to print 30 tablets individually or in batches on two devices through 0.4mm and 0.7mm nozzles, and tested the quality, content, density, dissolution behavior, and thermal and spectral characteristics. The results showed that the tablets printed in batches had no significant difference from single-piece printing in most indicators, and the quality variation was small, but the drug content deviation reached 35%.
研究采用聚乙烯醇基药载丝，通过热熔挤出制备，打印单层、双层和三层酮洛芬片，改变剂: The research uses polyvinyl alcohol-based drug-carrying filament, prepared by hot-melt extrusion, to print single-layer, double-layer and three-layer ketoprofen tablets, and changes the dosage, filling density and internal structure to achieve immediate and sustained-release tablets with different release characteristics, proving that a single drug-carrying filament can produce tablets with diverse release characteristics.
研究采用聚二甲基硅氧烷制成的3D螺旋微流体混合器，通过线状模板法快速制备，对比传: The research uses a 3D spiral microfluidic mixer made of polydimethylsiloxane, which is quickly prepared through a linear template method. Compared with the traditional T-shaped system, it is found that it can achieve more efficient mixing and faster chemical reactions at the micro scale, thanks to the flow folding effect of small channel diffusion mixing and the three-dimensional spiral structure.
研究采用聚二甲基硅氧烷微流控装置结合衰减全反射傅里叶变换红外光谱成像，观察了布洛: The study used a polydimethylsiloxane microfluidic device combined with attenuated total reflection Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy imaging to observe the dissolution and crystallization behavior of ibuprofen microformulations at different pHs. It was found that the drug changed from a dissolved state to a crystallized state under acidic conditions. This method can efficiently analyze the release behavior of microformulations.
研究采用胶原蛋白甲基丙烯酸酯与瓜尔胶甲基丙烯酸酯及其混合物制备3D打印手术模型，: The study used collagen methacrylate, guar gum methacrylate and their mixtures to prepare 3D printed surgical models. Through mechanical properties and cutting feel tests, it was found that the mixed system containing guar gum or guar gum methacrylate can effectively simulate the cutting feel of real tissue and has good tissue biomimetic properties.
研究采用自乳化体系开发多室3D打印片剂，通过筛选设计获得滴径94.43±3.55: The study used a self-emulsifying system to develop multi-chamber 3D printed tablets, and obtained the optimal formula with a drop diameter of 94.43±3.55 nm through screening design. The comparison showed that the drug release of SNEDDS-based tablets was better than that of non-SNEDDS tablets, and the relative bioavailability of GLMP and RSV reached 159.50% and 245.16% respectively.
研究采用自制聚酯-聚氨酯丝材，通过Fused Filament 制造 3D打印制: The research uses self-made polyester-polyurethane filaments and 3D printing using Fused Filament to prepare elastic porous structures. The results show that they are mineralizable, biocompatible and have good mechanical properties in simulated body fluids, and have the potential to be used as a candidate material for cancellous bone tissue engineering.
研究采用自动化半固态挤出3D打印技术，为儿科患者定制不同浓度的昂丹司琼氢氯酸盐剂: The research uses automated semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology to customize ondansetron hydrochloride dosage forms of different concentrations for pediatric patients. All three dosage forms meet USP quality standards. Among them, the orally dispersible film tablet dissolves quickly and is suitable for use by children, achieving personalized, repeatable and precise drug delivery.
研究采用自动化半固态挤出技术，制备了含不同剂量普萘洛尔盐酸盐的可咀嚼凝胶片，结果: The study used automated semi-solid extrusion technology to prepare chewable gel tablets containing different doses of propranolol hydrochloride. The results showed that they were elastic and chewable, with more than 85% of the drug released within 15-20 minutes. The mechanical properties were related to the formula, confirming that this technology can realize the customized preparation of personalized oral gel tablets.
研究采用自建SSE挤出机，将卡托普利负载的紫外固化墨水用于3D打印软凝胶剂型，打: The study used a self-built SSE extruder to use captopril-loaded UV curing ink for 3D printing of soft gel dosage forms. The printed donut-shaped tablets had a release rate of more than 80% within 30 minutes, and the polymerization reaction of the drug ingredients was enhanced by the thiol group of captopril.
研究采用藻酸盐基3D水凝胶贴片，通过掺入预胶化淀粉调节其物理化学性质与释药动力学: The study used an alginate-based 3D hydrogel patch, and adjusted its physical and chemical properties and drug release kinetics by incorporating pregelatinized starch. The results showed that the starch content significantly affected the pore structure and release behavior, showing an initial rapid drug release and then sustained controlled release, and the viscoelasticity, printing accuracy and drug release rate could be adjusted.
研究采用被动扩散法将尼费地平加载至3D打印丝材，结合HSP参数与丝材刚度优化药物: The study used a passive diffusion method to load niferdipine onto 3D printing filaments, and combined HSP parameters and filament stiffness to optimize the drug loading, achieving a drug loading capacity close to 3% w/w. The resulting oral tablets exhibit sustained release and long-term chemical stability, and are suitable for clinical personalized drug preparation.
研究采用解剖结构准确的3D打印小鼠模型，通过MPI成像结合阈值算法分析，比较不同: The study used a 3D printed mouse model with accurate anatomical structure, and used MPI imaging combined with threshold algorithm analysis to compare the signals of different iron labeling masses in the tumor and liver areas. The results showed that the tracer mass estimation was accurate, and the increase in iron mass in the liver cavity would reduce the detection sensitivity in the tumor area.
研究采用计算机辅助湿纺技术制备透明质酸/壳聚糖多电荷复合水凝胶3D支架，通过PM: The study uses computer-assisted wet spinning technology to prepare a hyaluronic acid/chitosan multi-charged composite hydrogel 3D scaffold, and uses PMVEMA chemical cross-linking to improve its structural stability. The results show that the cross-linking concentration affects the water content and stability in PBS. In vitro experiments show that the scaffold can promote cell colonization and is suitable for long-term cell culture.
研究采用超声处理优化3D打印聚乳酸-乙醇酸共聚物牙科种植体支架，20%功率和30: The study uses ultrasonic treatment to optimize 3D printing of polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer dental implant brackets. 20% power and 30 minutes can significantly improve the fracture strength, strain and toughness, but do not affect the stiffness. The ultrasonic energy is enough to destroy the van der Waals force between PVA and PLGA without affecting the covalent bonds within PLGA. PVA can be partially removed to alleviate subsequent heat sterilization and degradation problems.
研究采用超声辅助压制成型和3D打印半固态挤出技术，制备基于新型可生物降解脂族共聚: The study used ultrasound-assisted compression molding and 3D printing semi-solid extrusion technology to prepare a sustained-release system based on a new biodegradable aliphatic copolyester, using metronidazole as the model drug. The results showed that both technologies can achieve sustained release for more than 20 days. The SSE device has a faster release rate due to its larger porous structure.
研究采用选择性激光烧结3D打印技术制备了可调剂量的二甲胺四环素微粒，针对儿童患者: The study used selective laser sintering 3D printing technology to prepare adjustable-dose minocycline microparticles for pediatric patients. Through in vitro release, stability and rat pharmacokinetic evaluation, the results showed that there was no significant difference in hardness, dissolution, stability and pharmacokinetic parameters between the printed microparticles and traditional tablets. The EC50 and EC90 values are similar, and the two can be used interchangeably in clinical practice.
研究采用选择性激光烧结3D打印技术制备含昂丹司琼的口崩片，两种不同填充量的配方均: The study used selective laser sintering 3D printing technology to prepare orally disintegrating tablets containing ondansetron. Two formulas with different filling amounts disintegrated within 15 seconds and released more than 90% of the drug within 5 minutes. The performance was equivalent to commercially available products.
研究采用选择性激光烧结3D打印技术，制备了含efavirenz的可分散片lets: The study used selective laser sintering 3D printing technology to prepare dispersible tablets containing efavirenz for nasogastric tube administration to children with HIV. P500, K500, and K1000 completely disintegrated within 230 seconds in 20 mL of water at 25±1°C, and P1000 partially disintegrated, indicating that this strategy can improve the accuracy and feasibility of nasogastric tube administration.
研究采用选择性激光烧结3D打印技术，制备了含对乙酰氨基酚的1mm和2mm直径迷你: The study used selective laser sintering 3D printing technology to prepare 1 mm and 2 mm diameter mini-particles containing acetaminophen. The ethylcellulose-based particles exhibit sustained drug release characteristics and can achieve a dual-drug combination of acetaminophen and ibuprofen. The immediate and sustained release of different drugs can be achieved by adjusting the polymer.
研究采用选择性激光烧结3D打印技术，通过调节粉末配方（如PVP/VA或PVA与活: The study used selective laser sintering 3D printing technology to prepare drug-containing and blank tablets by adjusting the powder formula (such as PVP/VA or PVA and activated carbon) and laser energy input. It was found that increasing the activated carbon concentration and energy input can improve the quality and mechanical strength of the tablets, and achieve in-situ amorphization of naloxone during the printing process, obtaining tablets with a quality loss of less than 1%.
研究采用选择性激光烧结技术制造口腔固体制剂，通过原位热成像分析获取每层表面状态数: The study uses selective laser sintering technology to manufacture oral solid preparations, and obtains surface state data of each layer through in-situ thermal imaging analysis for non-destructive quality control, clarifying the value of thermal imaging data in preparation quality monitoring.
研究采用选择性激光烧结技术制造含拉米夫定的药片，在打印过程中集成近红外探头实时采: The study uses selective laser sintering technology to manufacture tablets containing lamivudine. During the printing process, a near-infrared probe is integrated to collect the spectra of each layer in real time, and the lamivudine content of each layer is predicted through a chemometric model. The results show that the real-time prediction value is 101.5%, which is consistent with the 98% accuracy predicted by the offline method and the 99.8% accuracy of the final detection, confirming the feasibility of real-time quality control.
研究采用选择性激光烧结技术，以不同层高和短玻璃纤维体积分数制备三维复合义齿基托，: The study used selective laser sintering technology to prepare three-dimensional composite denture bases with different layer heights and short glass fiber volume fractions. The results showed that the combination of 0° X-Y plane, low layer height and high fiber content significantly improved the mechanical properties and surface quality, with uniform fiber distribution and good interface bonding.
研究采用选择性激光烧结法制备PCL/氟尿嘧啶可植入片，不同激光功率下制得的片剂中: The study used selective laser sintering to prepare PCL/fluorouracil implantable tablets. In the tablets produced under different laser powers, fluorouracil was evenly dispersed in the porous PCL matrix. The 7 W laser power group had the highest flexibility and showed a two-stage release characteristic of rapid drug release followed by sustained controlled release, making it suitable for the treatment of cartilage cancer.
研究采用选择性激光烧结（SLS）技术制备阿托西汀片，与传统压片法比较，通过调节激: The study uses selective laser sintering (SLS) technology to prepare atomoxetine tablets. Compared with the traditional tableting method, the release characteristics are controlled by adjusting the laser scanning speed. The SLS tablets are comparable to traditional tableting in terms of physical properties, dissolution and crystallinity, and can achieve personalized dosage forms.
研究采用选择性激光熔融3D打印技术制备含窄治疗指数药物的片剂，通过傅里叶变换近红: The study uses selective laser melting 3D printing technology to prepare tablets containing narrow therapeutic index drugs, and uses Fourier transform near-infrared spectroscopy to achieve non-destructive prediction of tablet density and drug release.
研究采用选择性激光熔融技术制备Ti-6Al-4V拓扑有序多孔钛植入物，通过等离子: The study used selective laser melting technology to prepare Ti-6Al-4V topologically ordered porous titanium implants, achieved surface biofunctionalization through plasma electrolytic oxidation, and simultaneously released strontium and silver ions as well as hydroxyapatite. It verified its strong bactericidal effect on drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus in vitro and in animal models and had better osteogenic activity than the control group. It was also found that strontium and silver ions have a synergistic antibacterial effect.
研究采用选择性激光熔融技术制备七种轻质结构，通过ASTM E8和F382标准进行: The study used selective laser melting technology to prepare seven lightweight structures, and conducted tensile and four-point bending tests according to ASTM E8 and F382 standards to evaluate their effective Young's modulus and bending stiffness.
研究采用选择性激光熔融技术制造固定修复体，对比发现SLM钴铬合金在机械性能、抗磨: The study used selective laser melting technology to manufacture fixed restorations. Comparison found that SLM cobalt-chromium alloy is superior to traditional cast alloys in terms of mechanical properties, abrasion resistance and ceramic layer bonding strength. It is especially suitable for cermet and polymer/composite covered restorations in high-load areas.
研究采用选择性激光熔融技术打印立方体 晶格 结构，通过调节补偿参数，实现1.15: The study uses selective laser melting technology to print cubic lattice structures. By adjusting compensation parameters, stable preparation of target apertures at unit sizes of 1.15, 1.5, and 2.0 mm is achieved. The actual apertures are 257.9, 406.2, and 633.6 μm respectively, and the porosity is 62%, 70%, and 80% respectively. The uniformity of the aperture is less than 10%, and the structure has no breakage or obvious deformation. 1.5 The target pore size and porosity can be stably obtained under the mm unit size.
研究采用选择性激光熔融技术，在钛合金医疗植入物表面制造具有骨整合特性的镂空结构，: The study uses selective laser melting technology to create a hollow structure with osseointegration properties on the surface of titanium alloy medical implants, and ensures the dimensional accuracy of the curved structure by optimizing the process constraints of a single beam.
研究采用选择性激光熔融（SLM）技术制造牙科植入体，检测其硬度、尺寸精度、强度及: The study used selective laser melting (SLM) technology to manufacture dental implants and tested their hardness, dimensional accuracy, strength and surface properties. The results showed that their hardness was equivalent to that of machined samples, their dimensions were in line with standards, and their strength reached 700 MPa. Surface pores may promote osseointegration, but the thread structure still needs to be optimized.
研究采用通用刚性机械臂，结合力感知末端执行器与顺应控制，对3D打印鼻腔假体进行鼻: The study used a general rigid manipulator, combined with a force-sensing end effector and compliance control, to conduct a nasopharyngeal swab insertion experiment on a 3D printed nasal prosthesis. The results showed that compliance control is better than position control and has potential for human use, but the initial alignment and head motion compensation still need to be improved.
研究采用酮诺孕酮模型制剂，通过响应面法优化打印参数，发现饱和度1和层高150µm: The study used ketonorgestrel model formulation and optimized the printing parameters through response surface methodology. It was found that saturation of 1 and layer height of 150µm can improve the mechanical strength of the tablets, while the ink composition has a small impact. After recycling the powder to prepare 27 batches of tablets, the ketonorgestrel content decreased slightly, but the reuse of the powder is still feasible.
研究采用酸蚀结合水热处理对3D打印Ti-6Al-4V植入物表面进行改性，构建微纳: The study used acid etching combined with hydrothermal treatment to modify the surface of 3D printed Ti-6Al-4V implants to construct micro-nano structures. The results showed that the structure significantly improved the hydrophilicity of the material and enhanced MC3T3 cell adhesion and proliferation, which was better than the polished control group.
研究采用锥形束CT扫描六颗拔除的正畸牙及3D打印个性化种植体，通过Geomagi: The study used cone beam CT to scan six extracted orthodontic teeth and 3D printed personalized implants. Geomagic software was used to compare the deviations of the three-dimensional models. The results showed that the mean deviations between the 3D printed implants and real teeth were 0.19 mm and -0.16 mm respectively, which was not statistically different from the difference between in vitro teeth and real teeth.
研究采用锥束CT、虚拟治疗规划软件和立体光固化手术导板，对种植体的位置、尺寸及放: The study uses cone beam CT, virtual treatment planning software and stereolithography surgical guides to accurately position the position, size and placement of implants in three dimensions. Compared with traditional two-dimensional images and physical guides, it improves the accuracy of the anatomy and repair parameters of implants.
研究采用间接3D打印结合热诱导相分离技术，制备具有“刚度记忆”功能的纳米杂化弹性: The research uses indirect 3D printing combined with thermally induced phase separation technology to prepare a nanohybrid elastomer scaffold with "stiffness memory" function, which softens over time in vitro and promotes the growth of fibroblasts, achieving biological responsiveness matching with surrounding tissues.
研究采用集成加热功能的芯片平台，实现HLA-B*15:02基因扩增，通过微流控系: The research uses a chip platform with integrated heating function to achieve HLA-B*15:02 gene amplification, and completes sample processing and reaction through a microfluidic system. The detection results are completely consistent with the tubular LAMP method, enabling rapid and accurate HLA-B allele screening.
研究采用非破坏性传输拉曼光谱结合偏最小二乘回归，对不同尺寸的缓释3D打印药片进行: The study used non-destructive transmission Raman spectroscopy combined with partial least squares regression to quickly detect the drug content of sustained-release 3D printed tablets of different sizes. The results showed that this method can accurately predict the tablet content, with no significant difference from the standard method, and is suitable for quality control in a decentralized manufacturing environment.
研究采用飞秒激光直接在聚二甲基硅氧烷中一步制备微流控通道，通过调节激光功率实现微: The research uses femtosecond laser to directly prepare microfluidic channels in polydimethylsiloxane in one step. By adjusting the laser power, micron-level precision channel shaping is achieved. Compared with traditional methods, the process is simplified, the cost is reduced, and the risk of contamination is reduced.
研究采用食品级聚合物通过3D打印技术制作口罩原型，对比显示其机械性能与工业级口罩: The research uses food-grade polymers to produce mask prototypes through 3D printing technology. Comparison shows that its mechanical properties are equivalent to industrial-grade masks. It still maintains biological safety and controllable surface roughness after cleaning and disinfection, and can achieve a perfect fit through customized shapes.
研究采用高分辨率3D打印技术，结合定制树脂，快速迭代设计并制备了17个血浆分离微: The research used high-resolution 3D printing technology, combined with customized resin, to rapidly and iteratively design and prepare 17 plasma separation microfluidic device prototypes. The final device was verified by colorimetric analysis and achieved effective separation of plasma and blood cells in whole blood.
研究采用高度氟化的PFPE甲基丙烯酸酯开发了可3D打印的透明微流控芯片，通过光固: The research uses highly fluorinated PFPE methacrylate to develop a 3D printable transparent microfluidic chip. It is realized in commercial stereolithography equipment through light-curing resin. The minimum cross-section of the printing channel reaches 60 and 200 microns. The material has a light transmittance of over 70% in the 520-900 nm band. It has high chemical resistance to organic solvents and a variety of microfluidic mixer structures have been successfully prepared.
研究采用高精度3D打印技术制备带刺微针，用于慢性伤口阻抗监测与药物递送，通过感知: The research uses high-precision 3D printing technology to prepare barbed microneedles for chronic wound impedance monitoring and drug delivery, achieving closed-loop feedback-driven precision treatment by sensing wound status.
研究采用高精度数字光处理3D打印技术制备羟基丙基甲基纤维素微针，通过优化曝光时间: The study used high-precision digital light processing 3D printing technology to prepare hydroxypropyl methylcellulose microneedles. By optimizing the exposure time to balance precision and stiffness, it achieved drug injection and detection functions, verifying its biocompatibility and multi-tasking capabilities.
研究采用黑种油自纳米乳化药物传递系统，制备了glimepiride的液体制粒、直: The study used a black seed oil self-nanoemulsifying drug delivery system to prepare liquid granulation, direct compression tablets and 3D printing tablets of glimepiride. The in vitro release and in vivo bioavailability were compared. The results showed that the relative bioavailability of liquid granulation and 3D printing tablets reached 113.86% and 121.68% respectively, which was better than commercial products.
研究采用鼠源和人源巨噬细胞，检测含0.3 g AgNPs/L的PEO改性钛植入物: The study used mouse and human macrophages to detect the effect of PEO-modified titanium implants containing 0.3 g AgNPs/L on cell viability and inflammatory factor expression. The results showed that it did not interfere with macrophage function, and could effectively inhibit E. coli colonization and had no effect on Staphylococcus aureus, while preventing bacterial surface colonization.
研究重心从“打印能够补缺”转向“怎样组织打印才能补缺”。制造、验证、装配和物流构: The focus of research has shifted from "printing can fill gaps" to "how to organize printing to fill gaps". Manufacturing, verification, assembly and logistics form a continuous chain, and any link may limit output.
研究重心正在由局部参数优化转向全过程约束。后处理研究证明性能由多个步骤共同形成；: The research focus is shifting from local parameter optimization to full process constraints. Post-processing studies demonstrate that performance is the result of multiple steps; raw material studies take reuse history into account; real-world geometry studies connect inspection and longevity; and cleaning studies take internal accessibility back to the design stage
研究重心由“能否打印小通道”扩展到“能否稳定完成特定实验”。透明性、润湿性、残留: The focus of research has expanded from "whether small channels can be printed" to "whether specific experiments can be stably completed." Transparency, wettability, residue removal, and cytocompatibility increasingly parallel resolution
研究重心由导电材料成形转向有效界面与流程集成。后处理、功能化及采样结构越来越多地: The research focus shifts from conductive material forming to effective interface and process integration. Post-processing, functionalization and sampling structures are increasingly co-occurring, demonstrating that electrode fabrication has become embedded in complete sensing systems
研究重点正在从“材料是否有利于成骨”延伸到“材料如何组织修复过程”。异物反应研究: The focus of research is extending from "whether materials are conducive to bone formation" to "how materials organize the repair process." Foreign body response research reveals that interface formation is influenced by multi-cell participation; staged delivery separates disease control and regeneration; composite materials research connects ion release, adhesion and immune response
研究重点正在由扩大接触面，转向理解接触区域的几何特征和受力条件。骨面、黏膜与复杂: The focus of research is shifting from expanding the contact surface to understanding the geometric characteristics and stress conditions of the contact area. Bone surfaces, mucous membranes and complex narrow areas pose different design issues
研究重点由增加层数，转向使载药、支撑和时间控制相对独立。混合制造和模块组合是明显: The focus of research has shifted from increasing the number of layers to making drug loading, support and time control relatively independent. Hybrid manufacturing and modular assembly are obvious development paths, as different components and structures are not always suitable for the same process
研究针对 transfemoral 义肢套筒，通过CAD-FEA分析不同晶格结构: The study focused on the transfemoral prosthetic sleeve and used CAD-FEA to analyze the mechanical properties of different lattice structures (BCC, FCC, diamond) at different densities (20–50%). It was found that the BCC lattice has the optimal balance between stress distribution and flexibility. The lattice integration reduces the weight of the sleeve by 6–14% without causing plastic deformation.
