研究针对249名牙科学生，通过问卷调查和13周实际训练，评估了3D打印模型在牙科: The study focused on 249 dental students and evaluated the application of 3D printing models in dental teaching through questionnaires and 13 weeks of practical training. The results showed that students were highly interested in digital technology, the models had deficiencies in mechanical operation, and they believed that digital tools would be helpful for future career development.
研究针对3D打印个人防护装备（PPE）中存在的孔隙大小、可重复性、消毒兼容性及佩: The study focused on issues such as pore size, repeatability, sterilization compatibility, and wearing fit in 3D printed personal protective equipment (PPE). By adjusting printing parameters and using 3D scanning to achieve personalized design, it was found that the pore size may exceed virus-transmitting particles, and ventilation and skin irritation protection need to be paid attention to.
研究针对3D打印微流体器件中成型引起的表面粗糙度对流体流动的影响，通过建模与实验: The study focused on the impact of surface roughness caused by molding on fluid flow in 3D printed microfluidic devices. Through modeling and experimental verification, valveless micropumps made of glass and ABS materials were optimized and realized. The water flow rates reached 210 μl min⁻¹ and 140 μl min⁻¹ respectively, and the maximum back pressure reached 978 Pa. It proved that additive manufacturing can realize high-performance functional microfluidic devices.
研究针对3D打印微流控芯片中内外层牺牲材料的去除，提出热油浴法可高效去除外层材料: The study focuses on the removal of inner and outer sacrificial materials in 3D printed microfluidic chips. It is proposed that the hot oil bath method can effectively remove the outer layer material (removal rate 89.9% ± 0.1%). Injecting oil at 70°C for 720 minutes can achieve high transmittance and no deformation of the inner layer material, and the cost-effective solution is 10 minutes. This provides a scalable engineering removal technology for microfluidic applications.
研究针对7例先天性颅面畸形患者，利用术前CT数据制作个性化3D打印模型，由同组住: The study focused on 7 patients with congenital craniofacial malformations, using preoperative CT data to create personalized 3D printing models. Residents and attending physicians in the same group formulated and marked surgical plans respectively. The results showed that the completeness of surgical steps was improved, the plan completion time was shortened, and the residents' craniofacial surgery milestone score was improved by an average of 1.875 levels.
研究针对7种病理解剖模型，通过模拟不同朝向、层高、支撑密度和支撑尖端尺寸，优化打: The study focused on 7 pathological anatomical models and optimized the printing time and material usage by simulating different orientations, layer heights, support densities and support tip sizes. The results showed that a layer height of 0.1mm was optimal. The layer height had the greatest impact on the printing time, while the support settings had little impact. Hollow models require a larger support volume.
研究针对COVID-19疫情期间早期轻症呼吸衰竭患者，设计了一种新型双路无创通气: For patients with early mild respiratory failure during the COVID-19 epidemic, the study designed a new dual-path non-invasive ventilation CPAP circuit. Through 3D printing of shunts and mask joints, exhaled breath can be discharged through the virus filter, avoiding aerosol transmission of traditional devices, increasing non-invasive ventilation capacity and reducing the risk of infection.
研究针对Ti6Al4V材料增材制造的患者特制医疗植入物，通过实施ISO 1348: The study focused on patient-specific medical implants made of Ti6Al4V material additively. Through the implementation of the ISO 13485:2016 quality management system, the reliability of the design, development and production processes was verified, and it was confirmed that the process can meet the requirements of international standards for material and mechanical properties.
研究针对Xolography生物墨水，系统评估了pH、渗透压和溶酶体压力对细胞存: The study systematically evaluated the effects of pH, osmotic pressure, and lysosomal pressure on cell survival and function for Xolography bioinks. It was found that BisTris, as a co-initiator, can maintain cell survival rates of over 90% under strict control without damaging metabolic activity and differentiation ability. It is better than triethanolamine and enables efficient and high-fidelity bioprinting of multiple types of cells under unsupported conditions.
研究针对一种上肢假肢的设计，通过屈曲、疲劳磨损和拉伸测试评估其机械性能，提出可比: This study focuses on the design of an upper limb prosthesis, evaluates its mechanical properties through flexion, fatigue wear, and tensile testing, and proposes comparable testing procedures and recommendations to generate reliable data for comparison of different prosthetic limb designs.
研究针对上肢截肢患者及健康受试者，采用基于肌群协同的运动识别与阻抗模型的生物模仿: The study focused on patients with upper limb amputations and healthy subjects. It used biomimetic control of motion recognition and impedance models based on muscle group synergy, combined with 3D printing technology, to achieve high-precision EMG signal classification of single-finger and unlearned combination movements, and verified the smoothness and intuitiveness of its control in actual operations.
研究针对上肢截肢者，开发了一款基于EEG的低成本3D打印思维控制义肢，通过Ras: For upper limb amputees, the research developed a low-cost 3D printed thought-controlled prosthetic arm based on EEG, which uses a Raspberry Pi 4 to drive a stepper motor to achieve opening and closing movements. The experiment verified its feasibility and provided a path for subsequent connection with the amputation stump.
研究针对下肢假肢座的3D打印，使用回收聚酰胺粉末（PA2200）制成，通过拉伸和: The study focused on 3D printing of the lower limb prosthetic base, which was made using recycled polyamide powder (PA2200). Its mechanical properties were evaluated through tensile and bending tests, and the results showed no significant difference. The gait and posture of patients with poor prosthetic fit were analyzed and it was found that there were differences between the lower limbs on the healthy side and the lower limbs on the healthy side.
研究针对个体化给药需求，探讨通过3D打印技术实现个性化剂量和组合的可行性，以克服: The study aims at the needs of personalized drug delivery and explores the feasibility of realizing personalized dosage and combination through 3D printing technology to overcome problems such as uneven dosage, changes in release characteristics and coating damage caused by the rigid manufacturing process of traditional oral solid dosage forms and fragmentation.
研究针对个体遗传、代谢及疾病差异，通过3D打印、智能高分子和纳米技术定制口服药物: The study focuses on individual genetic, metabolic and disease differences and uses 3D printing, smart polymers and nanotechnology to customize oral drug release systems to adjust dosage and release timing on demand, improve efficacy and improve patient medication compliance.
研究针对乳铁蛋白生物标志物，优化了多孔硅纳米结构并结合微流控系统，通过调整孔径、: For the lactoferrin biomarker, the study optimized the porous silicon nanostructure and combined it with a microfluidic system. By adjusting the pore size, layer thickness, and probe density, and combining stagnation and active micromixers, the detection sensitivity was significantly improved, and the lowest detection limit was reduced to 50 nM, an order of magnitude higher than the previous solution.

研究针对佩戴3D打印手假肢的儿童，通过三轮德尔菲法，结合12名儿科与骨科职业治疗: The study focused on children wearing 3D printed hand prostheses. 研究针对便秘、精神类、心血管及抗感染药物，探讨3D打印个性化剂型中活性成分的调整: The study focused on constipation, psychiatric, cardiovascular and anti-infective drugs to explore the adjustment of active ingredients in 3D printed personalized dosage forms, and found that the successful introduction of drug formulas requires a balance between technical, economic and social factors.
研究针对儿科患者开发了3D打印可咀嚼环磷酰胺“printlet”，基于医院处方设: The study developed a 3D printed chewable cyclophosphamide "printlet" for pediatric patients. 研究针对医护人员因佩戴口罩引发的皮肤问题，开发了可定制化3D打印明胶/鞣酸凝胶贴: In order to address the skin problems caused by medical staff wearing masks, a customizable 3D printed gelatin/tannic acid gel patch was developed, containing metronidazole or salicylic acid. 研究针对医护人员在应对气溶胶传播病毒时的防护需求，开发了一种基于开源组件、可3D: The study focuses on the protection needs of medical staff when dealing with aerosol-borne viruses. Its protective effect is better than that of N95 masks, and the internal environment is cleaner than the external environment when operated by personnel.
研究针对医护人员长期佩戴传统口罩难以实现良好密封的问题，结合3D扫描、有限元分析: The study addresses the problem of difficulty in achieving a good seal after long-term wearing of traditional masks by medical staff. 研究针对十名参与者，采用3D打印技术结合力、压强和温度传感器，通过振动与电触觉反: The study focused on ten participants, using 3D printing technology combined with force, pressure and temperature sensors to achieve sensory interaction through vibration and electrotactile feedback. 研究针对十名神经外科住院医师，基于面部数据定制3D打印个性化眼护具，通过有限元分: The study focused on ten neurosurgery residents, customized 3D printed personalized eye protection based on facial data, and verified its fit through finite element analysis. The simulated microsurgical operation showed that the visual field was reduced by only 10.93%, and the average user satisfaction was 7.6, with no discomfort.
研究针对可定制手术导引装置的参数优化，通过物理模拟与遗传算法自动确定最佳配置，相: The study focused on parameter optimization of customizable surgical guidance devices, automatically determining the optimal configuration through physical simulation and genetic algorithms. Compared with manual optimization, it achieved alignment within 1.2 mm displacement and specified rotation error on nine femoral models, and was superior to manual settings in all bone geometries.
研究针对含300–600μm宏观孔的复杂晶格结构，比较超声清洗与振动去除粉末效果: The study focused on a complex lattice structure containing macroscopic pores of 300–600 μm, compared the effects of ultrasonic cleaning and vibration on powder removal, and found that vibration is more effective for small pore structures (300 μm); for a dental implant prototype, it was found that the internal structure of a 280 μm pore needs design modifications to improve powder removal, but such modifications may affect its mechanical properties, and its failure risk under physiological loads needs to be evaluated through simulation.
研究针对复方制剂的3D打印技术，通过熔融挤出法将药物丝材转化为个性化剂量，实现多: Research on 3D printing technology for compound preparations, converting drug filaments into personalized dosages through melt extrusion, to achieve customized medication in the form of multi-component, adjustable-release drugs, requires collaborative promotion by pharmaceutical companies and pharmacies to improve equipment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
研究针对失明患者定制的眼罩，采用3D扫描建模、光固化3D打印和亚limation: Research on eye patches customized for blind patients, using 3D scanning modeling, light-curing 3D printing and sub-limation transfer printing technology to achieve accurate reproduction of iris and blood vessel images. The process is semi-automatic, the material is non-cytotoxic, and the production time and skill requirements are reduced.
研究针对完全可摘局部义齿基托加强，比较了工厂制造石英网架与个性化3D打印聚合物网: The study compared the clinical, economic and socioeconomic performance of factory-made quartz mesh frames and personalized 3D printed polymer mesh frames for the reinforcement of completely removable partial denture bases. The results showed that 3D printed polymer mesh frames were superior to quartz mesh frames and metal mesh frames in all indicators, reducing the number of patient follow-up visits, improving economic benefits and reducing public health losses.
研究针对定制矫形器的制造，采用数控机床与增材制造技术，通过替代传统手工工艺，提升: The study focuses on the manufacturing of customized orthotics, using CNC machine tools and additive manufacturing technology to improve production efficiency, reduce labor costs and production time, and improve the production environment by replacing traditional manual processes.
研究针对小尺寸3D打印多孔构造，比较了切片设定填密度与实际测得填密度的差异，建立: The study focused on small-size 3D printed porous structures, compared the difference between the set filling density of slices and the actual measured filling density, and established a mathematical model to predict the filling density. The results showed that the error between the model prediction value and the measured value was only 3.5%, which was better than the slice value, and the distribution ratio of the material between the bead and the connecting part was clear.
研究针对工业及疫情防护场景中个人防护口罩的适配性与可重复使用问题，通过用户面部照: The study focuses on the adaptability and reusability of personal protective masks in industrial and epidemic protection scenarios. Through user facial photo modeling and 3D printing technology, a customized silicone mask that fits the face, has no air leakage and is resistant to disinfection is designed to achieve good wearing comfort and durability.
研究针对微针阵列在皮肤给药中的应用，提出根据患者人口学特征定制微针设计，以提升药: The study focuses on the application of microneedle arrays in skin drug delivery and proposes customizing microneedle designs based on patient demographic characteristics to improve drug delivery efficiency and shorten healing time, emphasizing the advantages of personalized designs over universal designs.
研究针对患者特异性3D打印颅骨植入物，通过有限元分析确定最优固定点数量为4至5个: The study focused on patient-specific 3D printed skull implants and determined through finite element analysis that the optimal number of fixation points is 4 to 5. The curvature distances are approximately 40 mm (small implants) and 60 mm (large implants). The fixation points are far away from the center and arranged symmetrically to reduce deformation and improve stability.
研究针对截肢者设计了一种紧凑型表面肌电传感器，通过对比干电极与传统Ag/AgCl: The study designed a compact surface electromyography sensor for amputees. It has been successfully used to control 3D printed prosthetic hands to achieve precise grasping.
研究针对手部缺失者，设计开发了一款基于无线手势控制的义手，通过佩戴智能手套采集手: The research aims at designing and developing a prosthetic hand based on wireless gesture control for people with missing hands. The gesture signals are collected by wearing smart gloves, transmitted to the prosthetic hand via Wi-Fi, and the servo motor is driven to achieve grasping movements to assist in daily activities.
研究针对接受3D打印牙科修复体的患者，通过个性化设计提升口腔健康评分19.5点，: The study focused on patients who received 3D printed dental restorations and improved their oral health scores by 19.5 points through personalized design, showing improved implant integration, shortened surgery times, and improved patient-reported indicators in multiple medical fields, but material interface failure, production variation, and regulatory issues still exist.
研究针对改性纳米填充PMMA在牙科修复体制造中的应用，比较其与传统PMMA在生物: The study focused on the application of modified nano-filled PMMA in the manufacturing of dental restorations and compared its performance with traditional PMMA in biocompatibility and 3D printing technology. 研究针对新冠患者不同年龄群体的医疗需求，通过开放硬件设计与3D打印等数字制造技术: The study focuses on the medical needs of different age groups of COVID-19 patients, and realizes low-cost, reproducible production of medical equipment through open hardware design and digital manufacturing technologies such as 3D printing, verifying the feasibility and economic advantages of the open hardware model in responding to the epidemic and future public health events.
研究针对新冠疫情下个人防护装备短缺问题，探讨了3D打印技术在制造口罩和呼吸机方面: In response to the shortage of personal protective equipment during the COVID-19 epidemic, the study explored the application of 3D printing technology in manufacturing masks and ventilators, and analyzed its feasibility and technical challenges through numerical simulation.

研究针对无眼球窝及眼摘除后眶腔患者，采用PMMA制作外眼罩维持面部对称，结合生物: The study focuses on patients with an orbital socket and an orbital cavity after eye removal. PMMA is used to make an outer eye patch to maintain facial symmetry, and biograde silicone and 3D printing technology are combined to customize the orbital lining to improve appearance and quality of life. Pediatric patients need to regularly replace soft and plastic materials. The skills of eye craftsmen under multidisciplinary collaboration are crucial to restoring facial expressions.
研究针对激光粉末床融合制备的Ti-6Al-4V支架，联合化学蚀刻与电抛光处理，显: The study focused on the Ti-6Al-4V scaffold prepared by laser powder bed fusion, which was combined with chemical etching and electropolishing to significantly reduce surface roughness, enhance the uniformity of the TiO₂ layer and eliminate unmelted particles, allowing cells to form a single layer 15 days after contact, promoting tissue-like matrix production within 28 days, improving the expression of stem cell markers and osteodifferentiation indicators, and without oxidative stress.

Quantitative CT/finite element analysis showed that lower modulus porous structures can improve intraosseous stress distribution and reduce stress peaks, and the optimal overall modulus is about 3 to 10 GPa.
研究针对现有经胫关节假肢，通过功能分析识别出与地面接触界面的优化区域，采用增材制: The study focused on the existing transtibial joint prostheses, identified the optimized area of the contact interface with the ground through functional analysis, and used additive manufacturing technology to develop an integrated foot cover, which significantly improved its assistive performance when walking on deformed ground.
研究针对白鹳受伤后康复，采用3D打印技术制作仿生假肢，基于解剖测量设计环氧树脂、: The study focused on the recovery of white storks after injury. 3D printing technology was used to produce bionic prostheses. 研究针对经济状况较差的截肢患者，开发并验证了采用3D打印连续纤维复合材料制成的仿: For amputee patients with poor financial status, the research developed and verified a bionic prosthetic foot made of 3D printed continuous fiber composite materials. 研究针对脊柱手术中患者特异性植入物（PSIs）的应用，分析其在复杂病例中的潜在优: The study focuses on the application of patient-specific implants (PSIs) in spinal surgery, analyzes their potential advantages and limitations in complex cases, points out the current lack of long-term data and comparative studies, and emphasizes the need to conduct larger-scale controlled studies to clarify their clinical role while ensuring patient treatment.
研究针对脊柱植入物的生物材料，比较钛与钽等材料在生物相容性、弹性模量及骨融合促进: Research on biomaterials for spinal implants compared the performance of materials such as titanium and tantalum in terms of biocompatibility, elastic modulus, and bone fusion promotion. Its elastic modulus is lower than that of traditional Ti-6Al-4V alloys, and it has good formability and biocompatibility.
研究针对荷兰15名相关利益方开展访谈，探讨3D打印如何融入现有药剂配制体系，发现: The study conducted interviews with 15 relevant stakeholders in the Netherlands to discuss how 3D printing can be integrated into the existing pharmaceutical preparation system. It was found that although 3D printing has high flexibility and personalization potential, and is considered to improve the personalized treatment capabilities of community pharmacies, there are still regulatory gaps in the quality control of raw materials such as prefabricated cartridges, and policy incentives are needed to promote a return to community pharmacy practice.
研究针对足部病理患者，采用3D扫描与打印技术制作个性化足矫形器，对比传统石膏模型: The study used 3D scanning and printing technology to produce personalized foot orthoses for patients with foot pathology. Comparing the traditional plaster model with the 3D scanning model, it was found that the difference caused by changes in the patient's position was small, and all printing materials were more deformable and had lower yield stress than polycarbonate, but the printing process did not cause changes in material properties.
研究针对颅面缺损患者，利用影像与光学扫描构建三维虚拟模型，通过增材制造技术定制生: The research focuses on patients with craniofacial defects, using imaging and optical scanning to build a three-dimensional virtual model, and using additive manufacturing technology to customize and produce personalized skull implants to achieve accurate reconstruction of complex defects, shorten operation time and reduce patient discomfort.
研究针对颅面重建等复杂病例，利用3D打印技术根据患者个体解剖结构定制植入物，相比: The study focuses on complex cases such as craniofacial reconstruction, using 3D printing technology to customize implants according to the patient's individual anatomy. Compared with traditional standardized implants, it can achieve more accurate matching, reduce intraoperative adjustments, and improve surgical efficiency and applicability.
研究针对颅颌面畸形患者，通过术前虚拟设计结合个性化植入体（PSI），实现牙–颌骨: The study focuses on patients with craniomaxillofacial deformities, using preoperative virtual design combined with personalized implants (PSI) to achieve precise reduction and fixation of the tooth-maxillary complex. 研究针对马来西亚疫情期间10名不同背景的3D打印操作志愿者，采用思维外显法记录其: The study focused on 10 3D printing operation volunteers with different backgrounds during the Malaysian epidemic. 研究针对骨科植入物中的格构结构，通过建模设计具备与骨组织相近刚度的结构，结合患者: The study focuses on the lattice structure in orthopedic implants. It uses modeling to design a structure with a stiffness similar to that of bone tissue. It also considers the impact of manufacturing deviations on structural anisotropy.

It was found that high connectivity can improve fatigue strength and promote bone tissue maturation, and the rod structure with a thickness of 200–300 µm performs optimally in terms of mechanical properties and osteoinduction. Surface chemical treatment can enhance fatigue performance and promote bone formation.
研究针对髋关节植入物，开发了模仿骨组织特性的梯度增材制造Ti6Al4V蜂窝结构，: For hip joint implants, a gradient additively manufactured Ti6Al4V honeycomb structure that mimics the characteristics of bone tissue was developed. The simple cubic and body-centered cubic structures were compared through modeling and compression testing. The results showed that the body-centered cubic structure has better mechanical properties. When the optimal structural aperture is 400 µm, the elastic modulus is 15.7 GPa, the yield strength is 296 MPa, and the compressive strength is 530 MPa.
研究钛-20Nb-6Ta合金在激光粉末床融合过程中的微结构演变，通过调节激光功率: Studying the microstructural evolution of titanium-20Nb-6Ta alloy during the laser powder bed fusion process, by adjusting the laser power and scanning speed, it was found that a low-modulus, low-hardness α" + β + ω structure is obtained under low to medium energy input. High-energy input triggers in-situ aging to form a nano-α + β structure, and the hardness and modulus are improved.
研究钛合金Ti-6Al-4V增材制造件，通过调节热脱脂的温度、时间及气氛，发现双: Studying titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V additive manufacturing parts, by adjusting the temperature, time and atmosphere of thermal degreasing, it was found that two-stage degreasing (hydrogen 350°C and argon 550°C) can obtain the best mechanical properties, but the final carbon and oxygen content still exceeds biomedical standards.
研究钛合金Ti6Al4V在与3D打印PEEK针状物滑动摩擦及生理溶液环境下的tr: Studying the tribo-corrosion behavior of titanium alloy Ti6Al4V in sliding friction with 3D printed PEEK needles and in physiological solution environments, the results show that its corrosion resistance is enhanced under sliding conditions, the wear mechanism is a mixture of abrasive particles and adhesive, and it has excellent electrochemical stability and friction coefficient, indicating that 3D printed PEEK can be used as a feasible alternative material for biomedical implants.
研究钛牙科植入物在不同pH、温度、应力及化学环境下的腐蚀行为，通过电化学方法结合: Study the corrosion behavior of titanium dental implants under different pH, temperature, stress and chemical environments, evaluate their corrosion resistance through electrochemical methods combined with SEM, XRD and other technologies, and analyze the impact of surface treatment, additive manufacturing and other factors on corrosion to provide basis for clinical application.
研究链路从模型定位、尸体钻孔推进到临床轨迹，同时扩展到多隧道之间的关系。评价指标: Research links advance from model positioning and cadaver drilling to clinical trajectories, while extending to relationships between multiple tunnels. 研究链路由结构再现走向多细胞、动态环境和疾病相关信号。芯片不再只是缩小的培养皿，: Research links from structural reproduction to multicellular, dynamic environments and disease-relevant signaling. Chips are no longer just shrinking petri dishes, but experimental tools that can change conditions and observe system responses

The core of the change is the unit of evaluation: from whether a hand can move to whether a certain user can use it to complete specific actions.
研究问题随之具体化：哪些部位需要保留实体支撑，哪些区域可以降低刚度，新的载荷路径: The research questions then crystallized: where physical support needed to be retained, where stiffness could be reduced, and whether the new load paths transferred stress to thin rods or connecting interfaces. This avoids the need to interpret biological results based solely on the name of the treatment process.

硬件文件、装配说明和软件共同开放，使研究者能够重建系统并调整配置。这里降低的不只: Hardware documentation, assembly instructions, and software are made available together, allowing researchers to rebuild systems and adjust configurations.
