The drug content of the obtained tablets was in the range of 90–110%, the relative standard deviation of weight did not exceed 3%, and the solubility was stable, which is better than the traditional caffeine tablet segmentation method.
该研究利用3D打印技术制备了可实现肿瘤球体动态灌注捕获与分析的单体微流控装置，通: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a single microfluidic device that can realize dynamic perfusion capture and analysis of tumor spheroids. By optimizing the fluid dynamics design, it achieved the stable retention of high-precision structures and tumor spheroids in a continuous oxygen and nutrient environment.
该研究利用3D打印技术定制化制备聚乳酸材质的灌注生物反应器，实现人间充质干细胞在: This study used 3D printing technology to customize a perfusion bioreactor made of polylactic acid to achieve continuous culture of human mesenchymal stem cells on a collagen scaffold for two weeks. By adjusting the reactor structure, three-dimensional microenvironments of different sizes can be constructed, verifying its application potential in maintaining hematopoietic stem cell function and promoting the phenotypic expansion of blood cell progenitor cells.
该研究利用3D打印模具制备PDMS微流控装置，实现两种不同处理的内皮细胞共培养，: This study used 3D printing molds to prepare PDMS microfluidic devices to achieve co-culture of two different treatments of endothelial cells. The preferential adhesion of fluorescently labeled leukocytes to TNFα-activated endothelial cells was observed through fluid flow, confirming that the modular system can achieve simultaneous and symmetrical analysis of control and experimental conditions.
该研究利用3D打印模具制备微流控装置，生成体积小于100 pL的单分散液滴，并实: This study used 3D printing molds to prepare microfluidic devices, generate monodisperse droplets with a volume of less than 100 pL, and achieve the encapsulation of single dense beads. The resulting droplet volume is about 48 pL, and the proportion of more than one bead in a droplet is less than 2%.
该研究利用3D打印模型优化憩室病手术规划，实现个性化切除并改善术式设计，显示明确: This study uses 3D printing models to optimize surgical planning for diverticular disease, achieve personalized resection and improve surgical design, showing clear clinical and teaching value.
该研究利用3D打印的模块化免疫过滤柱，通过磁频率混合实现对单一体液样本中多种靶分: This study uses 3D printed modular immunofiltration columns to achieve independent detection of multiple target molecules in a single body fluid sample through magnetic frequency mixing. Experiments show that different target molecules can be identified separately, and the order of filter columns and negative controls do not affect the results.
该研究利用3D打印的模块化微流控装置，通过金纳米颗粒聚集的吸光度检测尿液中透明质: This study utilizes a 3D printed modular microfluidic device to detect hyaluronidase in urine through the absorbance of gold nanoparticle aggregation. Its performance is comparable to laboratory microplate technology and is competitive in terms of resources, operation and cost.
该研究利用3D打印的琼脂糖微模组实现鼠卵泡体外无支架培养，支持多层次级卵泡同步生: This study uses 3D printed agarose micromodules to achieve scaffold-free culture of mouse follicles in vitro, supporting the synchronous growth, ovulation and luteinization of multi-level follicles. Its ovulation structure and spatial polarity are superior to traditional three-dimensional packaging systems, and it can achieve continuous time monitoring and automated analysis.
该研究利用3D打印的螺旋微通道结合磁性纳米颗粒簇，通过尺寸分离实现牛奶中大肠杆菌: This study uses 3D printed spiral microchannels combined with magnetic nanoparticle clusters to detect E. coli in milk through size separation. Adding sheath flow can enhance the separation effect. The detection limits are 10 cfu/mL for buffer and 100 cfu/mL for milk.
该研究利用3D打印硝酸纤维素基微流控平台，对比传统PDMS芯片，实现了对斑马鱼Z: This study used a 3D printed nitrocellulose-based microfluidic platform and compared with traditional PDMS chips to achieve a multi-dimensional analysis of the response of zebrafish ZF4 cells under an oxygen gradient. It was found that hypoxia led to an increase in intracellular reactive oxygen species and the accumulation of HIF-1α, promoted VEGF transcription and induced cell cycle arrest.
该研究利用3D打印纳米材料平台，对17例新冠患者和3例非患者血浆样本进行超快速、: The study used a 3D printed nanomaterial platform to conduct ultra-rapid and quantitative testing of plasma samples from 17 COVID-19 patients and 3 non-patients. Picomole-level antibodies could be detected within 10-12 seconds. The results showed that the patient's antibody concentration against the spike protein (RBD and S1) was higher than the antibody concentration against the nucleocapsid protein (N).
该研究利用Arduino控制的微流体3D打印平台，为96孔板每列提供可定制的动态: This study uses an Arduino-controlled microfluidic 3D printing platform to provide customizable dynamic pressure waveforms for each column of a 96-well plate, successfully replicating clinical patient blood pressure and other physiological pressures in the body, proving that human umbilical vein endothelial cells can survive and proliferate in the range of 10 to 400 mm Hg, and that pathological and supraphysiological pressures do not inhibit their proliferation.
该研究利用CT或MRI影像数据，通过Materialise Mimics和Aut: This study uses CT or MRI image data to construct a patient-specific three-dimensional dental implant model through Materialise Mimics and Autodesk Meshmixer, and transfers it to a 3D printer for molding through Simplify 3D. The resulting prototype meets expectations in design, and the method can be promoted for the manufacture of other dental implants.
该研究利用DLP 3D打印技术制备生物相容性微流控芯片，实现酵母细胞在纳米升水滴: This study used DLP 3D printing technology to prepare a biocompatible microfluidic chip to achieve the encapsulation and real-time proliferation observation of yeast cells in nanoliter water droplets.
该研究利用GPT-4结合多组提示工程，从70篇制药喷墨打印文献中自动提取并计算2: This study used GPT-4 combined with multiple sets of prompt projects to automatically extract and calculate 23 key variables from 70 pharmaceutical inkjet printing documents to generate a structured data set with an accuracy of 0.942. The processing time for a single document was less than 3.5 minutes, reducing manual time and maintaining expert-level accuracy.
该研究利用低成本、开源的Dark-Pi系统，通过微流控装置实时监测血小板活化过程: This study uses the low-cost, open-source Dark-Pi system to monitor light scattering changes during platelet activation in real time through a microfluidic device, achieving label-free visualization of platelet aggregation. The results are consistent with traditional laboratory methods, providing a simple and repeatable detection method for large-scale platelet function research.
该研究利用增材制造技术原型设计N95口罩，以应对新冠疫情导致的个人防护装备短缺问: The study uses additive manufacturing technology to prototype N95 masks to deal with the shortage of personal protective equipment caused by the new coronavirus epidemic.
该研究利用增材制造技术开发新型口服给药系统，实现对上小肠的靶向药物递送，为吸收窗: This study uses additive manufacturing technology to develop a new oral drug delivery system to achieve targeted drug delivery to the upper small intestine, providing a potential alternative for drugs with narrow absorption windows.
该研究利用多西环素掺杂的高岭土纳米管，通过3D打印制备了缓释药物盘、珠和颗粒，证: This study used doxycycline-doped kaolin nanotubes to prepare sustained-release drug disks, beads, and particles through 3D printing, which confirmed that they were sustainable in releasing the model drug gentamicin, and that the release effect increased with increasing doping concentration, providing a feasible path for local combination antibacterial treatment.
该研究利用微流控流动聚焦芯片，制备了含磁性纳米颗粒的海藻酸盐微凝胶，通过流体速率: This study used a microfluidic flow focusing chip to prepare alginate microgels containing magnetic nanoparticles, and controlled the flow rate to achieve the generation of monodisperse or polydisperse droplets in the range of 20–120 μm. FT-IR confirmed the chemical combination of nanoparticles and gel, and the cell growth rate after 72 hours of culture was significantly better than that of the control group.
该研究利用智能手机结合色度传感器，检测牙菌斑中尿素酶活性以筛查幽门螺杆菌感染，结: This study used a smartphone combined with a colorimetric sensor to detect urease activity in dental plaque to screen for Helicobacter pylori infection. The results were highly consistent with the urea breath test and better than commercial test strips, with a sensitivity of 100%, a specificity of 95.5%, and an accuracy of 97.1%.
该研究利用柔性聚合物管构建可重构微流控平台，通过缠绕3D打印柱体形成螺旋通道实现: This study uses flexible polymer tubes to build a reconfigurable microfluidic platform. It winds a 3D printed column to form a spiral channel to achieve particle separation. It forms a tortuous path through knotting to enhance fluid mixing. The flow path can be flexibly adjusted without complex processing, making it suitable for particle separation and mixing operations.
该研究利用氧化锌结构的蛋白吸附能力，将承载蛋白与可打印性结合。研究从单纯覆盖创面: This study leverages the protein adsorption capacity of zinc oxide structures to combine protein-carrying with printability. Research has expanded from simply covering wounds to establishing a platform that can be loaded with functional ingredients. Subsequently, it is necessary to examine activity retention and release for specific proteins.
该研究利用深度学习模型，基于药物与聚合物材料的多种特征，预测药物负载制剂在选择性: This study uses a deep learning model to predict the printability of drug-loaded formulations in selective laser sintering 3D printing based on various characteristics of drugs and polymer materials, with an accuracy of 90%, and reveals materials that promote printability, providing an explainable optimization path for personalized drug manufacturing.
该研究利用生物打印基质构建三维脑脊液环境，通过控制流体条件观察脑膜细胞对流动变化: This study used a bioprinted matrix to construct a three-dimensional cerebrospinal fluid environment, and observed the response of meningeal cells to flow changes by controlling fluid conditions, and found that they sense mechanical stimulation through differential activation of focal adhesion kinase.
该研究利用硅嵌入氮掺杂碳点与磁提取的未扩增HCV RNA混合，通过荧光增强实现直: This study uses silicon-embedded nitrogen-doped carbon dots mixed with magnetically extracted unamplified HCV RNA to achieve direct detection through fluorescence enhancement. Combined with 3D printed microfluidic chips or conventional 96-well plates, the detection limits are 500 IU/ml and 1000 IU/ml respectively. The sensitivity and specificity are 96.47% and 98.79%, which is faster and easier than amplification technology.
该研究利用高分辨率3D打印微流控结构，将体积至100 pL的生物样本精准定位并固: This study uses high-resolution 3D printed microfluidic structures to accurately position and fix biological samples with volumes up to 100 pL in the most sensitive area of the NMR probe, achieving sub-nanoliter volume NMR detection of tiny organisms such as tardigrade eggs and C. elegans segments, achieving a sensitivity of 2.5×10¹³ spins/Hz¹/² and a resolution of 0.01–0.1 ppm.
该研究制备了可3D打印、机械性能可调的磁性水凝胶，通过调节丙烯酰胺与Fe3O4纳: This study prepared a 3D-printable magnetic hydrogel with adjustable mechanical properties. By adjusting the concentration of acrylamide and Fe3O4 nanoparticles, the elastic modulus was adjusted to 43–277 kPa, the tensile strength was 93–421 kPa, and the toughness was 243–1400 kJ/m³. It has both strong adhesion and magnetic responsiveness. Compared with existing magnetic hydrogels, it has better versatility and printability, and is suitable for magnetic drive and magnetic hyperthermia therapy.
该研究制备了含甲基丙烯酸化透明质酸、甲基丙烯酸化羧甲基壳聚糖和姜黄素的复合支架，: This study prepared a composite scaffold containing methacrylated hyaluronic acid, methacrylated carboxymethyl chitosan and curcumin, which was realized through 3D printing. It significantly promoted the proliferation and migration of MC3T3 osteoblasts in vitro, and up-regulated the expression of Vegfa, Tnc, and Pdgfb genes, which was better than the control group.
该研究制定了一项3D打印临时单冠的牙科技工艺协议，用于制作Next Dent C: This study developed a dental technology process protocol for 3D printing of temporary single crowns to produce temporary crowns made of Next Dent CB material, aiming to provide practical guidance for dental technology students to master modern dental restoration technology.
该研究同时观察形态、容积和临床表现，使“适配”成为可重复测量的结果: The study looks at morphology, volume and clinical manifestations simultaneously, making “fit” a reproducibly measurable outcome
该研究同步记录接受腔几何、舒适评分和患者体验，两种路线的舒适度相近，研究流程具有: This study simultaneously recorded socket geometry, comfort scores, and patient experience. The comfort levels of the two routes were similar, and the research process was executable. The next step can be to expand the sample and analyze whether the amount of modification in specific parts corresponds to pressure or discomfort.
该研究回顾了3D打印定制钛制椎体融合笼在颈椎和腰椎植入中的应用，通过个性化几何结: This study reviews the application of 3D printed customized titanium vertebral fusion cages in cervical and lumbar spine implants. It improves osseointegration and mechanical matching through personalized geometric structures and porous designs. It also comparatively analyzes the bioactivity and load-bearing requirements of different spinal segments, emphasizing its clinical value in precision surgery.
该研究回顾了3D打印技术在骨科植入物中的应用进展，聚焦于材料、工艺及临床效果，分: This study reviews the progress of the application of 3D printing technology in orthopedic implants, focusing on materials, processes and clinical effects, analyzing its potential in personalized matching, improving surgical results and improving implant compatibility, and points out challenges such as regulatory, biomechanical and long-term data.
该研究回顾了CT、微CT、MRI、小动物MRI和OCT等医学影像技术在组织工程和: This study reviews the application of medical imaging technologies such as CT, micro-CT, MRI, small animal MRI and OCT in tissue engineering and organ-on-a-chip, focusing on the role of imaging technology in the combination of 3D printing and organ-on-a-chip, and analyzes the application of deep learning in the analysis of three-dimensional tissue images of organ spheroids and organ-on-a-chip.
该研究回顾了利用3D打印技术将纳米药物制剂转化为口服和直肠用片剂及栓剂的最新进展: This study reviews the latest progress in using 3D printing technology to convert nanomedicine formulations into tablets and suppositories for oral and rectal use, focusing on the impact of the extrusion printing process on the performance of nanocapsules and self-nanoemulsifying system formulations.
该研究回顾了用于炎症性肠病治疗的新型口服靶向结肠药物技术，重点介绍多触发机制系统: This study reviews new oral colon-targeted drug technologies for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease, focusing on the multi-trigger mechanism system to cope with intestinal physiological variations, improve the precise release of drugs in the colon, especially promote the development of oral biologics, and points out that 3D printing can achieve drug personalization.
该研究回顾了镁基合金在骨科植入物中的生物相容性、力学性能及表面改性、合金化等优化: This study reviews the biocompatibility, mechanical properties, surface modification, alloying and other optimization methods of magnesium-based alloys in orthopedic implants, and discusses the application of additive manufacturing and porous structure design, aiming to provide a reference for improving the comprehensive performance of magnesium alloy implants.
该研究回顾性分析了30例口腔癌患者接受院内制造静态导板引导种植手术的临床经验，对: This study retrospectively analyzed the clinical experience of 30 oral cancer patients undergoing implant surgery guided by static guides manufactured in the hospital, and compared the differences with outsourcing and dynamic navigation methods. The results showed that all guides were designed and 3D printed in a clinical environment, with an average initial stability value of 79, allowing immediate or early loading, no major complications, and meeting sterilization and traceability standards.
该研究在11种常用药用聚合物3D打印片剂上编码二进制信息，通过纸张扫描检测，仅P: This study encoded binary information on 11 commonly used medicinal polymer 3D printed tablets. Through paper scanning and detection, only PVA, PLA, EC, EC+HPMC and EPO can achieve bit detection. Adding colorants or active ingredients can help detection. EVA and ERL cannot be detected due to rough surfaces or slow cooling.
该研究在3D打印微流控芯片中集成光响应阀，通过455 nmLED照射实现低功耗、: This research integrates light-responsive valves into 3D printed microfluidic chips to achieve low-power, non-contact fluid control through 455 nm LED irradiation. Multiple valves can be driven independently to achieve sequential filling and emptying of reaction chambers, supporting complex in-chip operations.
该研究在3D打印微流控装置上实现活菌与死菌的区分，通过原位丙碘单azine（PM: This study realizes the distinction between live and dead bacteria on a 3D printed microfluidic device. Through in-situ propaniodazine (PMA) pretreatment, it selectively enters the dead cell membrane and inhibits DNA amplification. Only live bacteria with intact membranes are detected. It was successfully applied to buffers and natural pool water samples.
该研究在3D打印的96孔板中，利用固定于各孔的CRISPR-Cas13a蛋白，通: This study used CRISPR-Cas13a protein fixed in each well of a 3D printed 96-well plate to detect three circulating blood miRNAs related to Alzheimer's disease (miRNA 34c-5p, 200c-3p and 30e-5p) through different crRNAs, achieving multiple, high-sensitivity, and non-amplification miRNA detection.
该研究在3D打印的假体模型上，对比了增强现实导航与传统自由操作在下颌骨牵引成骨术: This study compared the application of augmented reality navigation and traditional free operation in mandibular distraction osteogenesis on a 3D printed prosthetic model. The results showed that the AR group was significantly better than the traditional method in terms of angle and displacement errors, indicating its feasibility and accuracy in intraoperative navigation.
该研究在3D生物打印组织腔内，通过灌注方式促进多能干细胞扩增，获得厚度更优、功能: This study promotes the expansion of pluripotent stem cells through perfusion in 3D bioprinted tissue cavities to obtain multiple tissue types with better thickness and enhanced functions.
该研究在三具人干标本上对胫骨和股骨 shaft 多平面畸形进行矫正性骨切开，比较: This study performed corrective osteotomy on multi-plane deformities of the tibia and femoral shaft on three human stem specimens, and compared three methods: 3D virtual visualization, 3D guide guidance and patient-specific implant (PSI). The results showed that the PSI group had smaller errors in the sagittal plane, coronal plane, rotation angle and bone incision plane, and the correction was more accurate.
该研究在三种不同稠度材料中，通过调节流速、温度和喷嘴直径，集成压力传感器实时监测: In this study, in three materials of different consistencies, by adjusting the flow rate, temperature and nozzle diameter, integrated pressure sensors were used to monitor the semi-solid extrusion 3D printing process in real time, achieving online characterization of the ink rheological behavior for the first time, and providing process analysis technical support for quality by design.
该研究在健康受试者中比较了新型三维打印快速溶解的左乙拉西坦制剂与传统即释片在空腹: This study compared the bioequivalence of a new three-dimensional printed fast-dissolving levetiracetam formulation with traditional immediate-release tablets in healthy subjects in the fasting state. The results showed that the absorption rate and extent of the two were comparable, and the formulation dissolved rapidly. The absorption peak was reduced and the peak time was delayed after eating, but no clinically significant effects were seen.
该研究在兔前交叉韧带模型中，采用桌面3D打印技术快速制备了PLA/HA螺钉状支架: In this study, in a rabbit anterior cruciate ligament model, desktop 3D printing technology was used to quickly prepare a PLA/HA screw-shaped scaffold and loaded with mesenchymal stem cells wrapped in a gelatin matrix. In vitro and in vivo experiments showed that the implant could promote bone growth in the bone tunnel and the formation of the bone-graft interface.
该研究在兔模型中评估了3D定制导板和钛种植体的手术精度，发现下颌角间角度变化最敏: This study evaluated the surgical accuracy of 3D customized guides and titanium implants in a rabbit model and found that the angle between the mandibular angles is the most sensitive to changes, and the surgical accuracy is significantly related to the accuracy of the angle reproduction. The angle between the mandibular angles can be used as a sensitive evaluation index for the effect of reconstructive surgery.
该研究在前列腺癌手术后小鼠模型中，利用3D打印明胶甲基丙烯酸酯支架，原位培养骨髓: In this study, in a mouse model after prostate cancer surgery, a 3D printed gelatin methacrylate scaffold was used to in situ culture bone marrow mononuclear cells with tumor lysate and stimulating factors to promote their differentiation into dendritic cells and enhance anti-tumor immunity, significantly inhibit tumor growth and metastasis, and extend the median survival time.
该研究在加拿大医学院对医学生开展教学实验，将3D打印心脏模型融入先天性心脏病教学: This study carried out a teaching experiment with medical students at a Canadian medical school and integrated the 3D printed heart model into the teaching of congenital heart disease. The results showed that the students' satisfaction, understanding and practicality of the model were very high, and their knowledge mastery was significantly improved.
该研究在十具尸体股骨上验证了一种多功能患者特异性导板，通过三维打印实现骨切削与假: This study verified a multifunctional patient-specific guide on ten cadaveric femurs. It achieved precise integrated operation of bone cutting and prosthesis alignment through 3D printing. It achieved an average deviation of 0.4° in the coronal and sagittal planes, a cutting height deviation of 2.4mm, and 90% of the cases were within 6mm. No cross-propagation of errors was seen.
该研究在合成模型中评估了患者特异性的3D打印钛制下颌缺损修复装置，结合常规牙植入: This study evaluated a patient-specific 3D printed titanium mandibular defect repair device in a synthetic model, combined with conventional dental implants to achieve mechanical fixation and biological anchoring. The results showed that it did not suffer catastrophic failure or loosening under static and dynamic loads, and was structurally stable and mechanically feasible.
该研究在商业可用支架上通过选择性金属化形成电极，检测血栓形成时电阻抗的增加，显示: This study formed an electrode on a commercially available stent through selective metallization to detect the increase in electrical impedance during thrombus formation, showing that it can repeatedly sense different amounts of thrombus, and an impedance increase of 16% ± 3% (p = 0., etc.) can reliably identify thrombus.
该研究在复杂骨质患者中，采用视觉引导机器人系统进行牙槽外科手术，结合CBCT扫描: In this study, a vision-guided robotic system was used to perform alveolar surgery in patients with complex bone. It combined CBCT scanning and real-time visual feedback to achieve precise positioning of the implant. The accuracy of the implant position was significantly better than traditional manual operation.
该研究在多种生物打印平台中测试了柔性独特生成单元（FUGU），其通过硅胶膜与3D: This study tested the Flexible Unique Generation Unit (FUGU) in a variety of bioprinting platforms, which combines silicone membranes with 3D printed parts to achieve microneedle insertion and removal, volume adjustment and fluid management. It successfully constructed and cultured a 14.5 cm³ human colon cancer tissue model in a completely closed and sterile environment, achieving sterile bioprinting and culture of exchangeable gases.
该研究在大鼠和猕猴子宫内粘连模型中，采用微流控技术构建含富血小板血浆的热敏明胶微: In this study, in rat and macaque intrauterine adhesion models, microfluidic technology was used to construct a heat-sensitive gelatin microgel scaffold containing platelet-rich plasma to achieve the sequential and coordinated release of PRP and adipose-derived stem cells, effectively restoring the endometrial structure, reducing fibrosis and inflammation, and restoring fertility.
该研究在大鼠股骨缺损模型中，对比了1393@MBG支架负载BMP-2组与1393: This study compared the 1393@MBG scaffold-loaded BMP-2 group and the 1393 group in a rat femoral defect model. The results showed that the former was superior in bone formation ability and had the multiple drug delivery function of controlled release of BMP-2, DEX and DNA.
该研究在妊娠大鼠模型中，采用含黄体酮的自加热微针贴片，通过钙氧化物与活性炭混合物: In this study, a self-heating microneedle patch containing progesterone was used in a pregnant rat model to achieve self-heating (>60°C) through a mixture of calcium oxide and activated carbon, which improved the drug transdermal efficiency and duration. A single application can maintain therapeutic levels for more than 10 hours, improve fetal survival rate and reduce premature birth.
该研究在小鼠股骨植入相关骨髓炎模型中，比较了3D打印钙磷酸盐支架负载利福平和西他: This study compared the effects of 3D printed calcium phosphate scaffolds loaded with rifampin and sitafloxacin and polymethyl methacrylate loaded gentamicin in single-stage revision in a mouse femoral implant-related osteomyelitis model. The results showed that the calcium phosphate scaffold group had a lower bacterial colonization rate and more significant bone formation, which was better than the gentamicin loaded PMMA that required two stages of surgery.
该研究在小鼠脑内使用定制化颅形半球植入物（SHIELD），通过多次多探针插入实现: This study used a customized cranial hemisphere implant (SHIELD) in the mouse brain to achieve long-term electrophysiological recording of multiple brain regions through multiple multi-probe insertions. It successfully obtained large-scale neural activity data and revealed the organizational mechanism of alpha rhythm in the visual and motor network.
该研究在小鼠颅骨原位模型中，评估了由3D打印PLGA微球构成的支架对骨再生的促进: This study evaluated the promoting effect of scaffolds composed of 3D printed PLGA microspheres on bone regeneration in an orthotopic mouse skull model. The results showed that scaffolds with larger microsphere sizes can induce new bone formation more, and their unique geometric structures can achieve spontaneous bone induction, which is better than block-printed scaffolds.
该研究在尤卡坦迷你猪模型中，针对2厘米全层下颌骨缺损，采用3D打印生物可降解支架: This study used a 3D printed biodegradable scaffold combined with autologous fat-derived interstitial vascular component (SVF) for point-of-care treatment in the Yucatan mini-pig model for a 2-cm full-thickness mandibular defect. The results showed that the fracture resistance of the bone-stent interface in the SVF group was significantly higher than that of the control group, and the regeneration and repair of complex facial bone defects were achieved.
该研究在巴西圣卡塔琳娜州开展，采用3D打印装置结合纸基RNA提取与颜色反应RT-: The study was carried out in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. It used a 3D printing device combined with paper-based RNA extraction and color-reactive RT-LAMP detection to perform instant testing on nasopharyngeal/oral swabs and saliva samples. The results showed that the sensitivity of nasopharyngeal swabs was 95%, and the sensitivity of saliva was 85% and 69% respectively. The overall specificity was 98%. Results can be obtained within 45 minutes, making it suitable for large-scale screening in resource-limited areas.
该研究在巴黎癌症医院临床药房，利用3D打印技术开发并生产含他莫昔芬与抗抑郁药（文: This study uses 3D printing technology to develop and produce a personalized combination drug containing tamoxifen and an antidepressant (venlafaxine or duloxetine) in the clinical pharmacy of the Paris Cancer Hospital. It meets the productivity requirement of at least 200 doses per hour. The drug quality is stable and can be stored for one year to evaluate its acceptability and efficacy in breast cancer patients.
该研究在巴黎鲁什癌症中心医院药房，利用微型近红外和拉曼光谱仪，对通过3D打印制备: This study used miniature near-infrared and Raman spectrometers to conduct non-destructive quality control of drugs containing 30% tamoxifen citrate prepared by 3D printing in the pharmacy of the Rouch Cancer Center Hospital in Paris. It verified that the two devices can accurately quantify both open and sealed capsules, confirming their suitability for rapid detection of 3D printed drugs in hospital scenarios.
该研究在标准96孔板中通过高精度激光刻蚀制备微腔阵列，结合3D细胞培养物，实现对: This study prepared a microcavity array through high-precision laser etching in a standard 96-well plate, combined with 3D cell culture, to achieve real-time, label-free, parallel electrical impedance analysis of human melanoma and cardiomyocyte clusters, significantly improving the parallel analysis capabilities of 3D cell culture.
该研究在模拟模型上由九名神经外科医生测试，采用3D打印模板指导后颅窝开颅并植入定: The study was tested by nine neurosurgeons on a simulated model, using a 3D printed template to guide posterior fossa craniotomy and implantation of customized implants. The average gap was 2.11 mm, which was significantly better than the 5.52 mm of the current standard method.
该研究在类骨关节炎大鼠模型中，采用含Epimedin C的三维打印双相支架，相比: In this study, in a rat model of osteoarthritis, a three-dimensional printed biphasic scaffold containing Epimedin C was used. Compared with the simple OA-OCD group and the PTP group, it significantly promoted subchondral bone regeneration and inhibited synovial TNF-α expression. Epi C regulated the NF-κB pathway to reduce NLRP3 expression and IL-1β secretion.
该研究在药学硕士课程中，通过翻转课堂和问题导向的实验教学，结合数学模型解析3D打: In the Master of Pharmacy course, this study uses flipped classroom and problem-oriented experimental teaching, combined with mathematical models to analyze the relationship between 3D printing technology and performance, to help students master SSE-3DP technology and improve their technical literacy and problem-solving abilities.
该研究在颅面重建中实施了符合欧盟MDR法规的点对点制造框架，使用医疗级PEEK材: This study implemented a point-to-point manufacturing framework that complies with EU MDR regulations in craniofacial reconstruction, using medical-grade PEEK material to 3D print patient-specific implants. It takes 3–5 days from image acquisition to sterile delivery. The implants achieve precise anatomical matching without major complications. More than 40 cases have been produced and adopted by many European centers.
该研究基于200名医护人员的面部数据，利用机器学习和参数化设计，为3M 1863: This study is based on the facial data of 200 medical staff, using machine learning and parametric design to customize 3D printed patches for 3M 1863 and 3M 8833 respiratory masks. Through 2D image or 3D scanning input, an insert that fits the individual facial features is generated, and the fitting effect is verified through physical testing to improve the fit of the mask.
该研究基于2010–2026年Scopus数据，分析了3D打印与患者特异性器械在: Based on Scopus data from 2010 to 2026, this study analyzed the global research pattern of 3D printing and patient-specific devices in bone tumor resection, and found that early literature was highly cited, and research after 2020 focused on clinical applications such as osteosarcoma, reconstruction, and 3D printed implants, showing an evolution trend toward patient-oriented precision surgical solutions.
该研究基于2014至2024年Scopus数据库的405篇文献，通过RStudi: Based on 405 documents in the Scopus database from 2014 to 2024, the study analyzed the current research status of 3D printing in tablet preparation through RStudio and VOSviewer software. It was found that scholars such as Basit, Goyanes and Gaisford of the Department of Pharmacy, University College London, were the most active authors in the field, with the highest institutional and national output, indicating that 3D printed tablets have the potential to become an important means of personalized medicine.
该研究基于23年间的4120例患者特制颅颌面植入物数据，分析了PMMA、钛网和多: This study is based on the data of 4120 patients with customized craniofacial implants over a 23-year period. It analyzes the application of materials such as PMMA, titanium mesh, and porous high-density polyethylene. The results show that PMMA is mostly used in the skull, and pHDPE is used in the maxillofacial region. The implant "fit" and the incidence of adverse events are low, and the overall manufacturing process is safe and reliable.
该研究基于28篇文献综述，评估3D成像、CAD和3D打印在颌面赝复体制作中的应用: Based on 28 literature reviews, this study evaluates the application of 3D imaging, CAD and 3D printing in the production of maxillofacial prostheses, showing that it improves accuracy, functionality and personalization levels, but is limited by cost, biocompatibility and regulatory issues. Rural areas can improve accessibility through vehicle-mounted 3D printing.
该研究基于3D打印微流控平台，利用银纳米颗粒修饰的纸基阻抗免疫传感器实现对PHB: This study is based on a 3D printing microfluidic platform and uses a silver nanoparticle-modified paper-based impedance immunosensor to achieve sensitive, label-free detection of PHB2. Through in vitro, in vivo and computer simulation verification, it shows that it has high selectivity, good repeatability and stability in complex samples, and is suitable for early screening of leukemia.
该研究基于3D打印技术构建了一款微流控芯片，集成微混合器、气泡陷阱和电化学传感单: This study constructed a microfluidic chip based on 3D printing technology, integrating a micromixer, bubble trap and electrochemical sensing unit to achieve automated regulation and sensitive detection of dissolved oxygen. The detection limit is 11.9±0.3 μM, and the results are significantly correlated with the optical sensor.
该研究基于3D打印技术构建了微流控微带电磁带隙传感器，通过地平面缺陷结构提升灵敏: This study constructed a microfluidic microstrip electromagnetic bandgap sensor based on 3D printing technology. It improved the sensitivity through the ground plane defect structure and used the phase shift method to detect changes in the dielectric constant of the fluid in the microchannel at a frequency of 6 GHz. The measured dielectric constant from 1 to 80 resulted in a phase shift of nearly 90°, and it was successfully used to detect the toluene concentration in the methanol-toluene mixture.
该研究基于3D打印技术构建了集微孔与三电极于一体的电化学传感平台，通过miRNA: This study built an electrochemical sensing platform integrating micropores and three electrodes based on 3D printing technology. It detects lung cancer-related microRNA through the hybridization of miRNA and DNA probes, achieving sensitive detection of 0.001 to 40 and picomole levels, showing better sensitivity and selectivity than traditional screen-printed sensors.
该研究基于3D打印的芯片平台，用于电压门控离子通道TRPV1的化学刺激与并行功能: This study is based on a 3D printed chip platform for chemical stimulation and parallel functional analysis of the voltage-gated ion channel TRPV1, demonstrating its potential application value in other ion channel types and in vitro models.
该研究基于700项注册临床试验，分析了3D打印与生物打印技术在不同医学应用中的临: Based on 700 registered clinical trials, the study analyzed the clinical maturity of 3D printing and bioprinting technologies in different medical applications. The results showed that patient-specific anatomical models and auxiliary devices are the most widely used, implant and scaffold technology is developing rapidly, and disease models and regenerative structures based on bioprinting are still in their early stages.
该研究基于CT数据制作了一种可重复使用的3D打印训练模型，用于模拟未完全发育牙齿: This study produced a reusable 3D printing training model based on CT data to simulate root canal treatment operations after trauma to immature teeth, including processes such as apical induced regeneration activities, pulp cutting, reattachment of crown fragments, and apical embolization. The model can truly reflect the characteristics of open apical holes and thin-walled root canals, and simulate apical papilla bleeding through a pressure red fluid device.
该研究基于EN 14683:2019标准，设计了一种3D打印简易压力测试装置，结: Based on the EN 14683:2019 standard, this research designed a 3D printed simple pressure test device, which combined Python and MATLAB to achieve real-time measurement and analysis of the respiratory resistance of non-medical masks. The measured results were not significantly different from the traditional CDC method.
该研究基于H7N9禽流感病毒，结合纳米抗体、3D打印微流控芯片与智能手机检测，构: Based on the H7N9 avian influenza virus, this study combined nanobodies, 3D printed microfluidic chips and smartphone detection to build a portable, low-cost on-site detection system to achieve rapid and visual detection of the virus. The detection limit is equivalent to traditional ELISA, and the chip can be reused nine times.
该研究基于Web of Science数据库，对可摘戴义齿领域数字技术的文献进行: Based on the Web of Science database, this study conducted a quantitative analysis of literature on digital technology in the field of removable dentures and found that CAD/CAM and 3D printing are high-frequency keywords in this field. The study shows that attention in this direction continues to rise, and the technology application prospects are good.
该研究基于低成本纸基电化学发光传感器，结合智能手机与深度学习算法，实现乳酸的快速: This study is based on a low-cost paper-based electrochemical luminescence sensor, combined with a smartphone and a deep learning algorithm, to achieve rapid detection of lactic acid. Through real-time imaging and image analysis on a mobile phone, it achieves detection performance with a linear range of 50-2000 µM and a detection limit of 5.14 µM, and shows good stability and repeatability in actual environments.
该研究基于光学扫描获取的数字化牙模，通过样条曲线编辑、网格偏移、纹理映射及组件融: This study is based on digital dental models obtained by optical scanning, and uses key technologies such as spline editing, grid offset, texture mapping and component fusion to construct a removable partial denture frame model. Its clinical performance is equivalent to that of advanced commercial CAD systems. More than 30,000 cases of design have been successfully completed and meet the standards.
该研究基于多材料3D打印平台，构建了基于葡萄糖氧化酶的电化学传感器，对1 mM至: This study built an electrochemical sensor based on glucose oxidase based on a multi-material 3D printing platform. It detects 1 mM to 12 mM glucose in PBS buffer, showing good biomodification adaptability and verifying its potential in rapidly developing efficient, miniaturized, and integrated electrochemical biosensors.
该研究基于多聚合物电化学生物传感器，结合低成本3D打印PETG微流控芯片，实现对: This study is based on a multi-polymer electrochemical biosensor, combined with a low-cost 3D printed PETG microfluidic chip, to achieve continuous detection of lactic acid in untreated human serum. The results are highly correlated with two standard methods, verifying its reliability in real-time lactate monitoring.
该研究基于开源设计，利用SLA 3D打印与批量UV固化，开发出可模块化制造的鼻咽: This research is based on open source design and uses SLA 3D printing and batch UV curing to develop a modularly manufactured nasopharyngeal swab. Its structural optimization can shorten printing time and reduce consumable costs. Its clinical applicability has been verified through mechanical and absorption tests, and it has good performance potential compared with traditional swabs.
该研究基于微流控与比色原理，开发了一种点-of-护理葡萄糖检测平台，通过固定区域: This study developed a point-of-care glucose detection platform based on microfluidic and colorimetric principles. Through fixed area detection, image standardization preprocessing and random forest machine learning model, it can accurately identify glucose concentrations in the range of 50 to 200 mg/dL, with a cross-validation accuracy of 87.47%.
该研究基于患者CT扫描数据，利用CAD软件设计并经增材制造制作出符合肱骨外侧轮廓: Based on patient CT scan data, this study used CAD software to design and produce a personalized surgical guide that conforms to the lateral contour of the humerus through additive manufacturing to achieve precise osteotomy during surgery.
该研究基于文献综述，探讨了神经外科培训中高保真物理模拟的应用，通过整合神经解剖学: This study is based on a literature review and explores the application of high-fidelity physical simulation in neurosurgery training. By integrating neuroanatomy, biomaterials and data science, the learning curve is transferred from the operating room to the laboratory, effectively reducing the risk of complications such as cerebrospinal fluid leakage and ischemic injury.
该研究基于活动成本法，针对定制医疗植入物的增材制造过程，构建了包含预处理、主加工: Based on the activity cost method, this study constructed a cost estimation model including pre-processing, main processing and post-processing links for the additive manufacturing process of customized medical implants, and achieved an accurate assessment of the manufacturing cost of customized implants through case verification of finger bone metal implants.
该研究基于硅基3D微流体结构，通过垂直通孔与重分布层构建玻璃-硅-玻璃复合微流体: This study is based on a silicon-based 3D microfluidic structure, constructing a glass-silicon-glass composite microfluidic device through vertical through holes and redistribution layers, allowing multiple flow focusing joints to work in parallel. By adjusting the continuous phase and dispersed phase flow rates under a single source of liquid supply, it has been verified that multiple parallel joints can increase productivity without reducing droplet monodispersity.
该研究基于碳酸盐岩的断层数据，采用数字光处理3D打印技术制备透明微流控模型，通过: Based on fault data of carbonate rocks, this study used digital light processing 3D printing technology to prepare a transparent microfluidic model, and carried out single-phase and multi-phase tracing experiments through a reproducible microfluidic device. Compared with the CFD simulation results, the SSIM values exceeded 80%, which verified the reliability of this method in simulating fluid flow in rocks.
该研究基于等温扩增技术，设计并3D打印了一种电化学传感器，利用亚甲基蓝作为电化学: This study designed and 3D printed an electrochemical sensor based on isothermal amplification technology, using methylene blue as its electrochemical sensing capability to clearly distinguish positive and negative food samples.
该研究基于被子植物木质部气穴修复机制，提出一种生物启发的微通道气泡去除方法，能在: Based on the cavitation repair mechanism of angiosperm xylem, this study proposes a bio-inspired microchannel bubble removal method that can continuously dissolve bubbles and maintain stable and continuous fluids at different flow rates. It is effective for both Newtonian and non-Newtonian liquids, and is especially stable under high viscosity and low speed conditions.
该研究基于质量源于设计原理，通过正交实验探究了 binder 含量、层厚及层数等: This study is based on the quality-by-design principle and uses orthogonal experiments to explore the impact of parameters such as binder content, layer thickness, and number of layers on key quality attributes such as disintegration time, strength, and dimensional accuracy in drug carrier preparation printed products. It is found that binder content affects product integrity, and multiple factors work together to form microstructure.
该研究基于超高分辨率3D打印与硅胶模具，系统制备了75种以上聚丙烯酸微针阵列，通: Based on ultra-high-resolution 3D printing and silicone molds, this study systematically prepared more than 75 types of polyacrylic acid microneedle arrays. The impact of different shapes, lengths, diameters, and densities on the penetration effect was evaluated through an in vitro human skin model, and the relationship between design parameters and penetration efficiency was clarified.
该研究基于钕基金属有机框架构建了3D打印免标记免疫传感器，用于前列腺癌标志物PS: This study constructed a 3D printed label-free immunosensor based on a neodymium-based metal-organic framework for point-of-care detection of prostate cancer marker PSA. Its linear response in the range of 0.50–50.0 ng mL⁻¹ was verified by cyclic voltammetry, with a detection limit as low as 0.15 ng mL⁻¹, showing good repeatability and stability.
该研究对比了3D打印伺服电机控制微流控阀系统与传统移液操作在细胞培养中的性能，结: This study compared the performance of a 3D printed servo motor-controlled microfluidic valve system and traditional pipetting operations in cell culture. The results showed that there was no difference in performance between the two, confirming the feasibility of this system in achieving customizable, round-the-clock reagent control in 2D cell culture or organ-on-a-chip systems.
该研究对比了多树脂增材制造（MRAM）系统与CAD/CAM系统制作完整义齿的机械: This study compared the mechanical properties, material waste and production time of complete dentures produced by the multi-resin additive manufacturing (MRAM) system and the CAD/CAM system. The results showed that the MRAM system increased the preparation speed by 3 times, reduced material waste by 14 times, had a low accuracy of 35.08%, and increased the bending strength by 31.94% through the ten-wood connection structure.
该研究对比了铸造与3D打印钴铬合金金属框架在可摘局部义齿中的临床表现，结果显示3: This study compared the clinical performance of cast and 3D printed cobalt-chromium alloy metal frames in removable partial dentures. The results showed that 3D printed frames were equivalent to cast frames in terms of fit, patient satisfaction, and oral health-related quality of life, and had no surface pores.
该研究将 ceftizoxime 与 curcumin 共封装于纳米脂质体并嵌入: In this study, ceftizoxime and curcumin were co-encapsulated in nanoliposomes and embedded in a 3D printed gelatin-alginate scaffold to form Nio-CUR/CEF@SC, which showed significantly enhanced antibacterial activity against MRSA and CRKP. The MIC value was 64 times lower than that of the free drug. It also had strong anti-biofilm effects and significantly down-regulated the expression of pathogenic genes.
该研究将3D打印微流控装置与FDA批准的临床微透析探头集成，通过可拆卸的生物传感: This study integrated a 3D printed microfluidic device with an FDA-approved clinical microdialysis probe to monitor glucose and lactate levels in the cyclist's subcutaneous tissue in real time through a detachable biosensor. Optimizing the channel size improved the sensor response speed.
该研究将3D打印的胶体晶体水凝胶牙冠与机器学习集成的电阻应变传感器结合，通过实时: This study combines 3D printed colloidal crystal hydrogel crowns with machine learning-integrated resistance strain sensors to achieve prediction of bite force and adaptive calibration of crown fit by capturing multi-directional pressure data in real time and dynamically analyzing strain patterns.
该研究将NiTi形状记忆合金薄片与增材制造的Ti6Al4V锚固结构通过激光粉末床: This study combined NiTi shape memory alloy sheets with additively manufactured Ti6Al4V anchoring structures through laser powder bed fusion technology for vertebral screw implants, optimizing the anchoring stability. Although cracks appeared at the interface, the cracks did not expand and did not cause spalling during biomechanical testing, and the overall structure was feasible.
该研究将含WS2和HNT的电纺纤维素乙酸酯膜与3D打印的PLA/木薯纤维网结合，: This study combined an electrospun cellulose acetate film containing WS2 and HNT with a 3D printed PLA/cassava fiber mesh to create a double-layer wound dressing. Its mechanical strength and thermal stability are better than a single film layer, and it achieves more sustained metronidazole release within 48 hours and has a moderate inhibitory effect on Staphylococcus aureus.
该研究将含万古霉素水凝胶与微弧氧化三维打印多孔Ti6Al4V植入物结合，用于修复: This study combines vancomycin-containing hydrogel with micro-arc oxidation three-dimensional printed porous Ti6Al4V implants to repair infected bone defects and achieve sustained antibacterial, bone regeneration and osseointegration.
该研究将含单宁酸的可粘附PEG水凝胶局部施加于多孔钛植入物表面，通过调节BAS和: This study locally applied an adhesive PEG hydrogel containing tannic acid to the surface of a porous titanium implant, controlled its stability and degradation by adjusting the concentrations of BAS and tannic acid, achieved controlled release of strontium ranelate, and verified its good biocompatibility and bone cell regeneration support capabilities in vitro and in 3D printed titanium scaffolds.
该研究将含地塞米松的金纳米棒电纺丝集成至海藻酸钠与胶原蛋白凝胶中，通过近红外光激: In this study, dexamethasone-containing gold nanorods were electrospun into sodium alginate and collagen gels, and controlled drug release was achieved through near-infrared light activation, which significantly enhanced the antibacterial effect and promoted the healing of chronic wound infections. It also has good biocompatibility and tissue regeneration capabilities.
该研究将姜黄素与SDF-1负载微球通过海藻酸盐-壳聚糖双交联水凝胶固定于3D打印: In this study, curcumin and SDF-1 loaded microspheres were fixed in the pores of 3D printed porous titanium implants through alginate-chitosan double cross-linked hydrogel to achieve cell recruitment, macrophage M2 polarization and osteogenic differentiation, and improve the osseointegration ability of bone defects in patients with low bone mass.
该研究将微流控生成的类器官状软骨微球与3D生物打印结合，构建具有生物活性的复合支: This study combines microfluidic-generated organoid cartilage microspheres with 3D bioprinting to construct a bioactive composite scaffold. After implantation in immunodeficient mice, it promotes auricular cartilage regeneration and achieves a regeneration effect with morphological and histological characteristics close to native cartilage.
该研究将槲皮素-姜黄素-胡椒碱负载的PLGA纳米颗粒负载于3D打印多孔钽支架，通: This study loaded PLGA nanoparticles loaded with quercetin-curcumin-piperine onto a 3D printed porous tantalum scaffold. In vitro and in vivo experiments showed that it significantly promoted osteogenic differentiation and new bone formation in MC3T3-E1 cells, and has good biocompatibility and osteoinductive potential.
该研究将电磁追踪与个性化手术导板结合，用于小而精细骨结构的导航，结果显示在常见金: This study combines electromagnetic tracking with a personalized surgical guide for navigation of small and delicate bone structures. The results show that the electromagnetic tracking guide is significantly better than optical tracking under the interference of common metal surgical instruments, and its performance is equivalent to optical tracking in cadaver models.
该研究将疟原虫HRPII抗原从25至250μL血样中浓缩后，通过磁珠直接转移至疟: In this study, the Plasmodium HRPII antigen was concentrated from 25 to 250 μL blood samples and directly transferred to the malaria rapid detection test strip through magnetic beads, which increased the detection limit of Paracheck Pf RDT by 21 times to less than 1 parasites/μL, significantly improving the sensitivity.
该研究将负载纳普生的ZIF及kaolin@ZIF纳米载体嵌入3D打印的PLA-明: In this study, Naproxen-loaded ZIF and kaolin@ZIF nanocarriers were embedded into 3D printed PLA-gelatin hydrogels to achieve drug release through pH response. The Kao@ZIF system released more efficiently and lasted longer in an acidic environment, and its biocompatibility was better than that of the ZIF system.
该研究将钙泊三醇纳米悬浮液载入三层溶解微针贴片，用于治疗实验性银屑病，结果显示其: This study loaded calcipotriol nanosuspension into a three-layer dissolving microneedle patch for the treatment of experimental psoriasis. The results showed that its efficacy was equivalent to davosin ointment in a rat model, and it had good skin permeability and drug release properties.
该研究开发了3D打印微流控螺旋分离装置，通过调节进液和出液流速实现对CHO细胞的: This research developed a 3D printed microfluidic spiral separation device, which achieves continuous, pulsation-free and controllable retention of CHO cells by adjusting the inlet and outlet flow rates. It is combined with a micro-buffer device to effectively suppress pump pulsation. The overall system has a small dead volume and can be flexibly connected to bioreactors to achieve continuous and stable operation.
该研究开发了一套开源、可定制的智能手机集成系统，用于对即时检测中的层流试纸进行定: This research developed an open-source, customizable smartphone integrated system for quantitative analysis of laminar flow test strips in point-of-care testing. Image collection and analysis are achieved through 3D printed photoelectric boxes, mobile phone cameras and R Shiny software. The system is low-cost and suitable for areas with limited resources and epidemic response scenarios.
该研究开发了一款3D打印的开源智能显微镜OpenFlexure Delta St: This research has developed a 3D printed open source smart microscope, OpenFlexure Delta Stage, which supports multiple imaging modes and can realize automated experiments. It has been built and tested by researchers around the world and is suitable for researchers in low-income countries to improve the accessibility and repeatability of experiments.
该研究开发了一款基于智能手机的Krometriks装置，通过纳米颗粒检测miRN: This study developed a smartphone-based Krometriks device that detects miRNA through nanoparticles to achieve fast and simple colorimetric detection of miR-21. Its detection sensitivity is comparable to laboratory equipment and can be adapted to different smartphones, making it suitable for point-of-care diagnosis in low-resource environments.
该研究开发了一种3D打印个体化仿生 体模，用于头颈部癌症精准放疗中金属填充物引起: This study developed a 3D printed personalized bionic phantom for verification of dose distribution caused by metal fillers in precision radiotherapy for head and neck cancer. Its tissue equivalence and magnetic resonance imaging signal performance are good, and it can effectively support the formulation of individualized treatment plans.
该研究开发了一种3D打印便携式装置，用于在野外环境中安全操作含基因改造生物的活体: This research developed a 3D printed portable device for safe operation of living biosensors containing genetically modified organisms in the wild environment. The double-sealing design enables safe transfer from the laboratory to the field and biosafety protection during use.
该研究开发了一种3D打印动态胸廓假人模型，内置可压缩肺组织和肿瘤，模拟个性化呼吸: This study developed a 3D printed dynamic thoracic dummy model with built-in compressible lung tissue and tumors to simulate personalized breathing patterns. Its feasibility in reproducing respiratory motion and common artifacts was verified through 4DCT scanning, which showed that the tumor movement range near the diaphragm was greater than that of high-position lung tumors.
该研究开发了一种3D打印微流控混合探针，通过内置预混合网络和配对注吸孔阵列，生成: This study developed a 3D printed microfluidic mixing probe that generates multiple sets of flow dipoles with concentration changes from 0 to 100% through a built-in premixing network and paired injection and suction hole arrays to achieve precise and discrete concentration gradient delivery in cell culture and avoid cross-contamination.
该研究开发了一种3D打印微流控装置，用于实时在线检测脑脊液引流液中的谷氨酸、葡萄: This study developed a 3D printed microfluidic device for real-time online detection of glutamate, glucose and lactic acid concentration changes in cerebrospinal fluid drainage fluid. It achieved high time resolution by optimizing the structure and was successfully used in clinical monitoring of patients with brain injury.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的低场NMR兼容生物反应器，用于维持并分析3D细胞模型，: This study developed a 3D printed low-field NMR-compatible bioreactor to maintain and analyze 3D cell models. The culture solution was circulated through a microfluidic system. The verification showed that HeLa and HepG2 cells have more active metabolic activities in 3D culture than in 2D culture, and the metabolic profiles of different cell types can be clearly distinguished.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的多功能注册装置，用于记录种植体位置、软组织轮廓、前牙位: This study developed a 3D printed multifunctional registration device that is used to record implant position, soft tissue contour, anterior tooth position, vertical distance and centric relationship. The clinical operation takes 10 to 20 minutes, and the information can be transferred to the dental technician to continue making restorations.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的微型液态传感器，用于实时检测牛乳中的钙、铁、硝酸盐和磷: This study developed a 3D printed miniature liquid sensor for real-time detection of calcium, iron, nitrate and phosphate in milk. It is based on an all-solid-state electrode structure of polyoctylthiophene material, combined with a surface wrinkle design, to achieve high selectivity and sensitivity detection of target ions.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的微流控盘式装置，结合离心技术和增材制造，实现油水乳液滴: This study developed a 3D printed microfluidic disk device that combines centrifugal technology and additive manufacturing to achieve the generation of oil-water emulsion droplets. Compared with traditional subtractive manufacturing disk devices, it has the advantages of easier replication and flexible design, and is suitable for sample processing and biomarker detection in point-of-care scenarios.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的微流控芯片，用于快速检测猫冠状病毒，通过逆转录环介导等: This study developed a 3D printed microfluidic chip for rapid detection of feline coronavirus. It realized the detection of viral RNA through reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification technology and verified the application potential of the device in veterinary diagnosis.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的微流控装置，用于在30分钟内实现对猪流行性腹泻病毒、猪: This study developed a 3D printed microfluidic device to achieve multiple real-time detection of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus, porcine transmissible gastroenteritis virus and porcine delta coronavirus within 30 minutes. Its detection performance is equivalent to standard methods and can be quickly applied in grassroots laboratories and on-site.
该研究开发了一种3D打印的蛋白-聚合物水凝胶驱动器，基于内源性生化逻辑，在胃模拟: This study developed a 3D printed protein-polymer hydrogel actuator based on endogenous biochemical logic to achieve two-stage morphological changes and enzyme-triggered drug release in a gastric simulated environment. Through the synergistic effect of bovine serum albumin-PEGDA active layer and PEGDA passive layer, autonomous response without external intervention is achieved.
该研究开发了一种90 mL的3D打印单用生物反应器，集成pH和溶解氧传感器及磁力: This study developed a 90 mL 3D printed single-use bioreactor that integrates pH and dissolved oxygen sensors and a magnetic stirrer. By printing airways and sampling ports, it can achieve high-density culture of mammalian and microbial cells, verifying its mixing efficiency and oxygen transfer capabilities, and the online optical biomass signal is highly consistent with offline data.
该研究开发了一种低成本3D打印导电假体，用于EEG电极系统的标准化性能评估，其电: This study developed a low-cost 3D printed conductive prosthesis for standardized performance evaluation of EEG electrode systems. Its electrical characteristics are compatible with clinical EEG systems, which can effectively replace existing high-end technologies and achieve access to a wider research community.
该研究开发了一种低成本、便携式的3D打印电化学生物传感器，可在15分钟内以500: This study developed a low-cost, portable 3D-printed electrochemical biosensor that can detect four E. coli strains in 500 μL samples in 15 minutes, with a detection limit of 53 cfu and a quantitation limit of 270 cfu, with cross-reactivity to BL21 and JM109 strains.
该研究开发了一种低成本、可定制的3D打印转盘装置，结合3D细胞培养，用于渗透性检: This study developed a low-cost, customizable 3D printed turntable device combined with 3D cell culture for permeability testing, providing laboratories with an alternative that does not require customization.
该研究开发了一种低成本、开源的3D打印自动化光学显微镜原型，通过Arduino控: This research developed a low-cost, open-source 3D printed automated optical microscope prototype, which controlled the servo motor through Arduino to realize the X-Y translation and autofocus of the microscope. It combined a smartphone with a convolutional neural network for image diagnosis, which is suitable for laboratories in resource-poor areas.
该研究开发了一种低成本、微型荧光显微镜，用于在基层医疗环境中对全血样本经乙啶橙染: This study developed a low-cost, miniature fluorescence microscope for automatic identification of lymphocytes, monocytes, and granulocytes in whole blood samples stained with ethidium orange to achieve three-differentiation white blood cell counting in primary care settings.
该研究开发了一种低成本、无需仪器的微流控点-of-care装置，结合等温扩增技术: This study developed a low-cost, instrument-free microfluidic point-of-care device, combined with isothermal amplification technology, to achieve rapid and accurate detection of pertussis. The fluorescence results can be observed with the naked eye in about an hour, and no external power supply and centrifugation steps are required. It is suitable for low-resource environments such as medical clinics and schools.
该研究开发了一种低成本、模块化的活细胞显微成像腔室，采用3D打印技术结合可降解塑: This study developed a low-cost, modular live-cell microscopy imaging chamber that uses 3D printing technology combined with degradable plastics to achieve a single-use carrier and flexible design, significantly reducing annual laboratory expenditures, maintaining dimensional accuracy and reliability, and being able to be quickly customized to suit different experimental needs.
该研究开发了一种低成本、高效的抗坏血酸检测装置，通过集成印刷电极与手指操作的微流: This study developed a low-cost, efficient ascorbic acid detection device that integrates printed electrodes and a finger-operated microfluidic chip to achieve high-sensitivity detection in microliter sample volumes. Its sensitivity is 2.48 times that of off-chip detection, and it can achieve efficient mixing of samples and buffers, verifying its reliability and accuracy in point-of-care detection.
该研究开发了一种低黏度PDMS树脂，用于高分辨率3D打印弹性微流控器件，材料经乙: This study developed a low-viscosity PDMS resin for high-resolution 3D printing of elastic microfluidic devices. The material has high transparency after extraction with ethanol and can be used as an in vitro tissue culture substrate.
该研究开发了一种便携式、低成本的3D打印显微成像平台Brick-MIC，支持单分: This research developed a portable, low-cost 3D printed microscopy imaging platform Brick-MIC, which supports single-molecule fluorescence detection, correlated fluorescence spectroscopy, time-correlated single photon counting and super-resolution imaging (STORM and PAINT), enabling rapid switching and application of multiple fluorescence imaging technologies on a single platform.
该研究开发了一种便携式、低成本的3D打印电化学发光传感器，可同时检测血清中的葡萄: This study developed a portable, low-cost 3D printed electrochemiluminescence sensor that can simultaneously detect glucose and lactate in serum. By optimizing the voltage, fluorescent substance concentration, and pH, the detection of 0.1 mM glucose and 80 µM lactate is achieved with a recovery rate of 95–102%. It is combined with smartphone reading and is suitable for point-of-care scenarios.
该研究开发了一种便携式点-of-care原型系统，用于同时检测血清中三种轻型脑损: This study developed a portable point-of-care prototype system for the simultaneous detection of three mild brain injury biomarkers (GFAP, h-FABP, S100β) in serum, achieving pg/mL-level sensitivity detection in trace serum samples, and verified its feasibility in multi-marker joint detection.
该研究开发了一种便携式电泳侧向免疫层析装置，通过优化电动力学参数实现对血清中人乳: This study developed a portable electrophoretic lateral immunochromatography device that achieves ultra-sensitive detection of human lactate dehydrogenase in serum by optimizing electrodynamic parameters. The detection limit reaches 70 pg mL⁻¹, and the sensitivity is 367 times higher than that of traditional methods.
该研究开发了一种全3D打印的唾液尿酸电化学传感器，集成微孔、采样模块与三电极系统: This study developed a fully 3D printed salivary uric acid electrochemical sensor that integrates micropores, sampling modules and three-electrode systems to achieve non-invasive detection through uricase recognition. The detection limit reaches 0.09 μM (PBS) and 0 and 1 μM (dilute saliva). The results are consistent with high-performance liquid chromatography and superior to traditional methods.
该研究开发了一种可本地制作、成本低廉的膀胱阴道瘘修复训练假体，采用3D打印与硅胶: This study developed a locally produced, low-cost training prosthesis for vesicovaginal fistula repair, which uses 3D printing and silicone materials to simulate vaginal, bladder and urethra tissue. It has been verified by surgical operations that the bladder tissue simulation effect containing Slacker is the best and is watertight, making it suitable for training doctors in Africa to perform simple fistula repair through the transvaginal approach.
该研究开发了一种可组装的女性骨盆3D打印模型，结合商业触觉训练假体，通过同步触觉: This study developed an assembleable 3D printed model of the female pelvis, combined with a commercial tactile training prosthesis, to improve medical staff's intuitive understanding of pelvic anatomy and the practical teaching effect of gynecological examinations through synchronized tactile and visual feedback.
该研究开发了一种可规模化制备具有脉动释药特性的可降解微粒平台，通过3D打印与软光: This research has developed a degradable microparticle platform that can be prepared on a large scale with pulsatile drug release characteristics. A microstructure with an open chamber is formed through 3D printing and soft lithography. After filling the drug, it is sealed by contact heating to achieve drug release at set time intervals. It is suitable for a variety of drug forms and biological macromolecules, and the release is controllable and easy to operate.
该研究开发了一种基于3D打印流体系统的标签自由电化学DNA生物传感器，利用印刷金: This study developed a label-free electrochemical DNA biosensor based on a 3D printed fluidic system, which uses printed gold electrodes and controlled convection transport to achieve sensitive detection of DNA as low as 0.1 pM. It can effectively identify target sequences and distinguish single-base mismatches in complex biological matrices without the need for amplification.
该研究开发了一种基于3D打印的可穿戴微流控装置，结合可移除电化学传感器，用于灵敏: This study developed a wearable microfluidic device based on 3D printing, combined with a removable electrochemical sensor, for sensitive and selective detection of morphine in sweat, with a detection limit as low as 0.0092 ng mL⁻¹, which can achieve accurate determination in artificial and human sweat.
该研究开发了一种基于3D打印的可重复使用微流控织物传感器，通过模块化电极实现对尿: This research developed a reusable microfluidic fabric sensor based on 3D printing, which uses modular electrodes to achieve point-of-care detection of Na⁺ and K⁺ in urine, saliva and sweat. The detection results were verified by ion chromatography and have high precision, high selectivity and good repeatability.
该研究开发了一种基于3D打印的电化学发光酶生物传感器，利用葡萄糖氧化酶与鲁米诺/: This study developed an electrochemiluminescence enzyme biosensor based on 3D printing. It uses glucose oxidase and luminol/hydrogen peroxide system to preload reagents in agarose gel, and detects it through a smartphone camera to achieve glucose quantification without reagents, which is suitable for actual sample analysis.
该研究开发了一种基于RT-LAMP的点-of-care芯片装置，用于SARS-C: This study developed a point-of-care chip device based on RT-LAMP for SARS-CoV-2 detection, achieving result interpretation through color image recognition. In 22 clinical samples, the diagnostic accuracy was 86% compared with conventional PCR standard reactions.
该研究开发了一种基于TPU与PVC的3D打印柔性微流控装置，用于支持人源肌细胞、: This study developed a 3D printed flexible microfluidic device based on TPU and PVC to support the culture of human myocytes, endothelial cells and iPSC-derived visual organoids. The results showed that the cells survived well, differentiated effectively and had an orderly structure, which was better than traditional culture systems.
该研究开发了一种基于多通道光谱传感的微型化平台，用于在人血清中实现钠、钾、钙、镁: This study developed a miniaturized platform based on multi-channel spectral sensing to achieve multiple detection of electrolytes such as sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium, and phosphorus in human serum. Rapid detection without electrodes and without large instruments is achieved through absorption, turbidity and spectral changes. The results are highly consistent with commercial analyzers and have good repeatability.
该研究开发了一种基于开源模块的光学电传感器，利用LDR阵列和TSL2561光敏二: This research developed an optical electrical sensor based on an open source module, using LDR array and TSL2561 photodiode, combined with Arduino-Zero controller, to achieve real-time on-chip detection of droplet length, volume, speed and monodispersity without the need for high-speed cameras and external equipment, supporting the rapid prototyping of independent and portable microfluidic systems.
该研究开发了一种基于智能手机的AI算法，用于实时检测和计数血样中的锥虫，通过3D: This study developed a smartphone-based AI algorithm for real-time detection and counting of trypanosomes in blood samples. It was connected to a microscope through a 3D printing adapter and combined with SSD-MobileNetV2 and YOLOv8 models to achieve high-precision identification in human and mouse samples. The detection sensitivity of thin blood smears under actual measurement conditions reached 96.4%, which is better than the diagnostic method of traditional microscopes that rely on expert operation.
该研究开发了一种基于深度学习和智能手机集成的便携式化学发光葡萄糖检测平台，利用3: This study developed a portable chemiluminescence glucose detection platform based on deep learning and smartphone integration, using 3D printed micropads and paper-based substrates to construct micro-sensors. By comparing models such as random forest, SVM, InceptionV3, VGG16 and ResNet-50, the advantages of deep learning in improving the accuracy of chemiluminescence image analysis were verified. The platform has a detection range of 10–1000 µM and a detection limit of 8.68 µM.
该研究开发了一种基于芯片的点-of-care装置，用于平行检测哮喘或COPD加重: This study developed a chip-based point-of-care device for parallel detection of multiple biomarkers related to asthma or COPD exacerbation, including IL-6, IL-8, TNF-α, C-reactive protein, and Streptococcus pneumoniae. It achieved fast, low-cost, and highly sensitive detection through a 3D printed fluidic device, and verified its ability to detect endogenous and exogenous markers in patient samples.
该研究开发了一种基于表面等离子体共振原理的便携式设备，通过硫醇化学法在传感器芯片: This study developed a portable device based on the principle of surface plasmon resonance, functionally grafting polyethylene glycol chains on the sensor chip through thiol chemistry, for rapid detection of anti-PEG antibodies (IgG and IgM) in human plasma. The results are completed within 15 minutes and can be compared with standard methods to achieve detection of plasma from healthy people and hemophilia A patients receiving PEGylated FVIII treatment.
该研究开发了一种成本低于15美元、基于标准电子元件的便携式荧光检测器，用于在低资: This study developed a portable fluorescence detector that costs less than $15 and is based on standard electronic components to achieve specific detection of in vitro RNA transcription and target RNA in a low-resource environment, with detection limits of 6.8 nM and 3.7 nM respectively.
该研究开发了一种手握式离心微流控平台，用于在点-of-care条件下以低成本（约: This study developed a handheld centrifugal microfluidic platform for rapid detection of total urinary protein at low cost (approximately US$1.4/time) under point-of-care conditions. Its detection limit is as low as 3.49 μg/mL, which is highly consistent with laboratory standard methods and can accurately identify high-risk myocardial infarction patients.
该研究开发了一种电化学生物传感器，用于快速检测脂质纳米颗粒中封装的miR-218: This study developed an electrochemical biosensor for rapid detection of miR-218 encapsulated in lipid nanoparticles. It combined a gold electrode-modified DNA probe with a 3D printed cavity and Triton X-100 to achieve sensitive detection of miRNA. Its detection limit reaches 1 nM, and the results are consistent with traditional fluorescence methods.
该研究开发了一种集成3D打印微流控芯片的便携式双模传感器，通过碳点嵌入Eu³⁺金: This study developed a portable dual-mode sensor integrated with a 3D printed microfluidic chip. The ratiometric fluorescent probe formed by embedding carbon dots into a Eu³⁺ metal-organic framework achieves sensitive detection of DPA with a detection limit of 0.04 µM. It also uses its peroxidase-like activity to achieve colorimetric detection with a detection limit of 10.14 µM. When combined with smartphone operation, the detection limits are 0.33 µM and 12.27 respectively. µM, sample spike recoveries ranged from 85–104.6%.
该研究开发了一种集成式电子管盖，用于唾液样本中lambda DNA的快速检测，通: This study developed an integrated electronic tube cover for rapid detection of lambda DNA in saliva samples. DNA was extracted through FTA membrane and combined with isothermal amplification and label-free electrochemical pH sensing. 100 copies/ml of DNA could be detected within 30 minutes.
该研究开发了一种集成智能手机的便携式微流控平台，结合深度学习技术，通过微流控系统: This study developed a portable microfluidic platform integrated with a smartphone, combined with deep learning technology, processing samples through the microfluidic system and using mobile phone imaging and convolutional neural network analysis to achieve quantitative detection of liver function indicators such as bilirubin, ALT and AST. The detection range and repeatability meet clinical requirements, and can run stably between different mobile phones.
该研究开发了一种集成电化学检测的可编程磁性数字微流控平台，通过磁力非接触操控微滴: This study developed a programmable magnetic digital microfluidic platform with integrated electrochemical detection, which uses magnetic non-contact control of droplets to achieve automatic and accurate detection of glucose in sweat, with a wide linear range, low detection limit and high sensitivity.
该研究开发了一种集成高频鼻导管与药物气溶胶的组合装置，通过交替驱动雾化器，在成人: This study developed a combined device that integrates high-frequency nasal cannula and drug aerosol. By driving the atomizer alternately, it simultaneously provides heated and humidified high-frequency nasal cannula ventilation and drug aerosol during the inhalation cycle of adults. Experiments show that the new design has less than 5% aerosol deposition loss under cyclic operation, and the particles are reduced from 5.3 μm to about 1.0 μm, and it meets the thermodynamic conditions for high-frequency nasal cannula treatment.
该研究开发了含氟诺酮@ZIF-8纳米颗粒的3D打印水凝胶支架，通过κ-卡拉胶与康: This study developed a 3D printed hydrogel scaffold containing fluoronolone@ZIF-8 nanoparticles. The κ-carrageenan and congel gum are combined to form a double network structure to achieve stable mechanical properties and controlled drug release. It can continuously release zinc ions and fluoronolone in an acidic wound environment, significantly promoting the healing of infected wounds.
该研究开发了基于3D打印的扭矩驱动微流控诊断装置，通过内置螺纹结构实现手指操作驱: This study developed a torque-driven microfluidic diagnostic device based on 3D printing, which realizes microfluidic control driven by finger operation through a built-in thread structure without the need for external pumps or pressure sources. It was successfully applied to immunochromatography and immunofluorescence detection of clinical samples of chronic Chagas disease.
该研究开发了基于AI辅助3D打印的可降解水凝胶微针，负载黄体酮-固态脂质纳米颗粒: This study developed degradable hydrogel microneedles based on AI-assisted 3D printing, loaded with progesterone-solid lipid nanoparticles, for transdermal delivery, achieving efficient skin penetration, good mechanical strength, no neuronal cytotoxicity and physical and chemical stability within 3 months, verifying its feasibility in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
该研究开发了基于智能手机的化学发光检测系统，用于无创定量检测血清总胆固醇和口腔/: This study developed a smartphone-based chemiluminescence detection system for non-invasive quantitative detection of serum total cholesterol and oral/sweat lactic acid. It combined mobile phone imaging with a low-cost 3D printing device and compared its performance with laboratory instruments. A reflected light detection method based on color changes was also proposed to achieve simple measurement of lactic acid.
该研究把机械实验与数值预测校准连接起来，显示企业与研究机构可共同开发减少反复物理: This study connects mechanical experiments with numerical prediction calibration, showing that companies and research institutions can jointly develop verification methods that reduce repeated physical testing
该研究报道一例胫骨中间段牙源性腺瘤经根治性切除后，采用3D打印钛合金假体实现下肢: This study reported a case of odontogenic adenoma in the middle segment of the tibia that was radically resected and a 3D-printed titanium alloy prosthesis was used to achieve lower limb salvage. One-year follow-up showed that the prosthesis was in good position with no loosening, a functional score of 26 points, and a recovery rate of 86.7%. Bone tissue grew within the pores of the prosthesis, indicating good biological integration.
该研究报道了一例使用3D打印钛合金（Ti-6Al-4的可摘局部义齿金属支架，相比: This study reports a case of a removable partial denture metal bracket using 3D printed titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4). Compared with traditional cobalt-chromium alloy, it is lighter in weight and has a simpler manufacturing process, achieving good clinical results.
该研究报道了一例使用选择性激光熔融技术制作金属框架的可摘局部义齿临床病例，框架佩: This study reports a clinical case of a removable partial denture made of a metal frame using selective laser melting technology. The frame does not need to be adjusted after being worn, and it adapts well and is stable.
该研究探讨3-D打印在医学中的应用，包括为患者定制手术模型、植入物及生物组织打印: The study explores the application of 3-D printing in medicine, including customizing surgical models, implants and biological tissue printing for patients. It focuses on analyzing the progress of vascularized tissues and micro-organs, pointing out its potential in solving organ shortages and promoting personalized medicine.
该研究探讨3D打印在制药制造与药物递送中的应用，通过精准构建复杂结构和个性化药物: This study explores the application of 3D printing in pharmaceutical manufacturing and drug delivery. By accurately constructing complex structures and personalized pharmaceutical preparations, it can achieve controllable, delayed and triggered drug release, improving patient compliance and treatment effects.
该研究探讨3D打印在肿瘤领域应用，通过构建患者特异性的肿瘤模型和药物递送系统，实: This study explores the application of 3D printing in the field of cancer. By constructing patient-specific tumor models and drug delivery systems, precise treatment can be achieved and the predictability and personalization of anti-tumor drug research and development can be improved.
该研究探讨3D打印在药物递送中的应用，通过数字模板分层叠加制造复杂生物组织结构，: This study explores the application of 3D printing in drug delivery, manufacturing complex biological tissue structures through layered superposition of digital templates, and combining biological and material science to achieve tissue and organ construction in personalized medicine.
该研究探讨3D打印技术在药物制造中的应用，通过实现个性化用药、提升难溶药物生物利: This study explores the application of 3D printing technology in drug manufacturing to improve patient treatment compliance by realizing personalized medication, improving the bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs, and integrating multiple drugs into a single-piece preparation.
