该研究通过数字全息显微镜结合微流控技术与轻量浅层神经网络s-Net，实现了无需染: This study uses digital holographic microscopy combined with microfluidic technology and lightweight shallow neural network s-Net to achieve quantitative detection of tumor cells in blood samples without staining. Its accuracy, sensitivity and specificity are superior to existing convolutional neural network models, and has been successfully applied to the detection of breast cancer and ovarian cancer cells.
该研究通过有限元分析评估了新型上肢假手在肌腱、滑车和手掌部位的应力分布，验证了其: This study evaluated the stress distribution of the new upper limb prosthetic hand in the tendons, pulleys and palms through finite element analysis, and verified its structural design efficiency. The prosthetic hand was analyzed and confirmed to be safe under the condition of a maximum load-bearing capacity of 0.5 kg, and is suitable for 3D printing manufacturing.
该研究通过有限元分析，评估了3D打印膝关节置换植入物在典型载荷下的应力分布、变形: This study used finite element analysis to evaluate the stress distribution, deformation and residual stress of 3D printed knee replacement implants under typical loads, compared the differences in mechanical properties with traditional prefabricated implants, and verified the feasibility of patient-specific design.
该研究通过有限元模拟分析了3D打印跨胫假肢套筒在步态周期中的力学性能，发现PC材: This study analyzed the mechanical properties of 3D printed transtibial prosthetic sleeves during the gait cycle through finite element simulation and found that PC material has the highest safety factor, PET material has the best balance between strength and cost, and PA6 material has both strength and flexibility, providing a basis for clinical selection of printing materials.
该研究通过机器学习优化了基于熔融沉积成型的批量化和连续化3D打印药丸的工艺参数，: This study used machine learning to optimize the process parameters of batch and continuous 3D printing pills based on fused deposition modeling. It was found that flow rate has a significant impact on defect control. After prediction and verification by the algorithm, zero-defect printing can be achieved in different materials, with no defects on the surface and complete structure.
该研究通过机器学习预测药物3D打印用丝材特性及药效释放，模拟FDM制药流程，提升: This research uses machine learning to predict the properties and efficacy release of filaments for drug 3D printing, simulate the FDM pharmaceutical process, and improve the efficiency of formula development.
该研究通过柠檬酸基阳极氧化在固态和3D打印钛合金表面制备含镁碳磷灰石的氧化层，结: This study prepared an oxide layer of magnesium-containing carbon apatite on the surface of solid and 3D printed titanium alloys through citric acid-based anodization. The results showed that the coating has multi-scale roughness, is rich in calcium, phosphorus, and magnesium, and forms AB-type carbon apatite, showing sustained ion release and early biological activity.
该研究通过滴落沉积建模与注塑成型技术，针对咖啡因和对乙酰氨基酚制备个性化双层片，: This study used drop deposition modeling and injection molding technology to prepare personalized bilayer tablets for caffeine and acetaminophen. It was found that adjusting the filling rate in DDM can change the porosity and affect drug release, while injection molding can achieve smooth and slow release under high-density structures. Combining the two methods can overcome their respective limitations and achieve customizable drug release curves.
该研究通过滴落沉积建模技术，制备个性化阴道环，考察填充密度、滴落长宽比和排料率对: This study used dripping deposition modeling technology to prepare personalized vaginal rings, and examined the effects of filling density, dripping aspect ratio and discharge rate on product surface morphology, porosity, mechanical properties and in vitro drug release behavior. The results showed that increasing filling density and discharge rate can improve product performance and reduce porosity, while increasing dripping aspect ratio produces the opposite trend, and the drug release rate slows down as the filling density increases.
该研究通过空气中的微流体技术，以表面张力驱动方式操控微液滴，实现每秒10至100: This research uses microfluidic technology in the air to control microdroplets in a surface tension-driven manner, achieving a speed that is 10 to 100 times that of chip technology per second, quickly preparing monodispersed emulsions, particles and fibers with a diameter of 20 to 300 microns, and constructing three-dimensional multi-scale (biological) materials with customized microenvironments in one step, and being compatible with cells.
该研究通过立体光刻3D打印技术，首次实现微流体结构与微针的单步集成，制备出具有流: This study used stereolithography 3D printing technology to realize the single-step integration of microfluidic structures and microneedles for the first time, preparing hollow microneedles with fluid management functions to achieve dynamic mixing and drug delivery for skin drug delivery.
该研究通过立体光刻（SLA）技术制造300至1000μm宽的毛细管微通道，验证了: This study used stereolithography (SLA) technology to fabricate capillary microchannels with a width of 300 to 1000 μm. It verified the consistency and predictability of flow rate behavior under different geometric sizes, surface roughness and process parameters, and confirmed that SLA can achieve stable and controllable capillary-driven fluid behavior.
该研究通过系统优化螺旋微通道结构，比较不同圈数、长宽比、半径、流速、表面粗糙度和: This study systematically optimized the spiral microchannel structure and compared the effects of different number of turns, aspect ratio, radius, flow rate, surface roughness and particle size on the separation effect of circulating tumor cells and red blood cells. It was determined that the aspect ratio of 3.333, four turns, radius of 6-7mm, flow rate of 3mL/min, surface roughness of 1μm, and particle diameter of 24μm was the optimal configuration. The aspect ratio contributed the most to the separation effect.
该研究通过结合立体光刻制模与基于天然聚合物（如琼脂糖和海藻酸钠）的凝胶铸造，开发: This study developed an indirect additive manufacturing process for the fabrication of zirconia crowns with complex geometries by combining stereolithography modeling with gel casting based on natural polymers such as agarose and sodium alginate. It aimed to reduce processing waste and microcrack issues and clearly compared the molding properties and physicochemical behavior of different polymer systems.
该研究通过计算流体动力学设计和立体光刻打印，制备了三维并行化微流控液滴发生器，实: In this study, a three-dimensional parallel microfluidic droplet generator was prepared through computational fluid dynamics design and stereolithography printing to achieve multi-channel equal flow rate operation, successfully generate water-oil emulsion and polymer template droplets, and achieve controllable agglomeration and long-term survival of mesenchymal stem cells in hydrogel microcapsules.
该研究通过计算流体动力学设计并3D打印个性化多尺度支架，结合患者特异形状的灌注生: This study used computational fluid dynamics to design and 3D print a personalized multi-scale scaffold, combined with a patient-specific shaped perfusion bioreactor, to achieve long-term volumetric tissue growth and support the culture of bone tissue in the shape of the human calcaneus at a volume of 13 mL and a thickness of 1 cm.
该研究通过调节海藻酸钠与羧甲基壳聚糖的质量比，结合半固态挤出3D打印技术，制备出: This study prepared a pH-responsive gel drug carrier by adjusting the mass ratio of sodium alginate and carboxymethyl chitosan, combined with semi-solid extrusion 3D printing technology, to achieve gastric or intestinal targeted release, and controlled drug release can be achieved by adjusting the filling density.
该研究采用18F-FDG与打印树脂混合制成放射性树脂，成功打印出复杂数学模型，其: This study used 18F-FDG mixed with printing resin to make radioactive resin, and successfully printed a complex mathematical model. The dimensional accuracy was within 4% of the model size. The radioactivity was uniform and the boundary effect was small. However, there was trace leakage, and it was a single-use, non-hollow design.
该研究采用3D打印PLA/β-TCP支架，表面修饰聚多巴胺层并负载聚乙二醇载体携: This study uses a 3D printed PLA/β-TCP scaffold with a surface-modified polydopamine layer and a polyethylene glycol carrier loaded with neobavasin flavonoids, which significantly promotes the proliferation, migration and osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, reduces inflammation and oxidative stress, and enhances the polarization of M2 macrophages, thereby outperforming the control scaffold in the rat skull defect model and achieving a synergistic effect of immune regulation, antioxidant and osteogenesis induction.
该研究采用3D打印PLA支架构建低剪切生物反应器，培养骨髓来源的人间充质干细胞，: This study uses 3D printed PLA scaffolds to construct low-shear bioreactors to culture bone marrow-derived human mesenchymal stem cells, achieving cell yields comparable to traditional systems, maintaining high purity and survival rate, and maintaining differentiation potential.
该研究采用3D打印PMMA微针结合TSA-ELISA技术，实现对皮肤间质液中炎症: This study used 3D printed PMMA microneedles combined with TSA-ELISA technology to achieve non-invasive and highly sensitive detection of inflammatory markers in skin interstitial fluid. The results showed that the level of cytokines in eczema-lesioned skin (97.7 pg/mL) was significantly higher than that in healthy people (62.8 pg/mL).
该研究采用3D打印与CNC微铣结合方法，制备了具有不同深度（100–500 µm: This study uses a combination of 3D printing and CNC micro-milling to prepare large-scale microfluidic molds with micro-grooves of different depths (100–500 µm) for the formation of tumor spheroids. It is clear that the depth of micro-grooves affects fluid shear stress and nutrient diffusion.
该研究采用3D打印制备了含聚乙烯醇和胶原蛋白的多功能支架，嵌入还原氧化石墨烯以增: This study used 3D printing to prepare a multifunctional scaffold containing polyvinyl alcohol and collagen, embedded reduced graphene oxide to enhance conductivity, and loaded amoxicillin and ibuprofen to achieve sustained drug release. The conductivity of the scaffold reached 5.83×10⁻³ S/m, which showed antibacterial effects against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. It also has good biocompatibility and mechanical strength, which is better than traditional neural tissue engineering scaffolds.
该研究采用3D打印微流体模型模拟眼表真菌感染，验证了二聚体两性霉素B持续释放治疗: This study used a 3D printed microfluidic model to simulate ocular surface fungal infection, verified the feasibility of sustained release of dimeric amphotericin B to treat fungal keratitis, and provided a simple in vitro model for the development and testing of ophthalmic antibacterial drugs.
该研究采用3D打印微流控免疫阵列，对新冠患者血清中的IL-6、IFN-γ和CRP: This study used a 3D printed microfluidic immune array to simultaneously detect IL-6, IFN-γ and CRP in the serum of COVID-19 patients. The results showed that it is highly sensitive and easy to operate. The detection results are consistent with commercial kits, and IL-6 and CRP have good predictive value for disease severity.
该研究采用3D打印微流控平台，对血样中O157:H7菌进行预浓缩和DNA分离，相: This study uses a 3D printing microfluidic platform to pre-concentrate and separate DNA from O157:H7 bacteria in blood samples. Compared with PCR or quantitative PCR, it improves the feasibility of molecular detection of pathogens in blood samples.
该研究采用3D打印微流控渗透系统，对嵌入水凝胶中的小鼠成纤维细胞进行培养，结果显: This study used a 3D printed microfluidic osmosis system to culture mouse fibroblasts embedded in hydrogel. The results showed that their morphology, viability and growth were equivalent to those of a standard 96-well plate, verifying the feasibility and customizability of this device in 3D cell culture.
该研究采用3D打印微流控系统，通过油水交替流动防止金属离子在通道壁沉积，实现贵金: This study uses a 3D printing microfluidic system to prevent the deposition of metal ions on the channel wall through the alternating flow of oil and water to achieve in-situ synthesis of precious metal nanoparticles. The long drop-shaped structure is used to facilitate optical and X-ray detection and is used for machine learning optimization of the plasmon resonance frequency of silver nanoparticles.
该研究采用3D打印微流控腔室结合双流体灌注与机械压缩装置，构建可模拟骨修复过程的: This study uses a 3D printed microfluidic chamber combined with a dual-fluid perfusion and mechanical compression device to construct an in vitro model that can simulate the bone repair process. Through dynamic mechanical stimulation and dual perfusion, it improves cell survival and functional bone tissue formation, realizes the transition from inflammation to anti-inflammation, and improves nutrient supply and mechanical response.
该研究采用3D打印微流控装置，通过调控不同流速的培养液在肠组织两侧流动，实现对肠: This study uses a 3D printed microfluidic device to achieve a more realistic environmental simulation of intestinal tissue in vitro by regulating the flow of culture fluid at different flow rates on both sides of the intestinal tissue, thereby improving the ability of existing in vitro models to reproduce in vivo physiological conditions.
该研究采用3D打印微流控装置，高效制备直径小于90 nm、多分散性低、mRNA包: This study uses a 3D printed microfluidic device to efficiently prepare lipid nanoparticles with a diameter less than 90 nm, low polydispersity, and high mRNA encapsulation efficiency. Its performance is better than that of commercial micromixers, providing a low-cost, easy-to-operate high-throughput production solution.
该研究采用3D打印微针阵列贴片与真空管结合，从活兔耳皮下快速提取约18μL间质液: This study uses a 3D printed microneedle array patch combined with a vacuum tube to quickly extract about 18 μL of interstitial fluid from the skin of a live rabbit ear, which is completed within 5 minutes. Combined with instant detection by a personal blood glucose meter, it achieves minimally invasive and convenient interstitial fluid analysis without professional skills, and is suitable for personal health monitoring.
该研究采用3D打印技术制作不同长度（1.5–3.0 mm）的个性化中耳假体，基于: This study uses 3D printing technology to produce personalized middle ear prostheses of different lengths (1.5–3.0 mm). Based on the design of commercial titanium prostheses, its accuracy, repeatability and acoustic performance are evaluated through micro-CT and laser Doppler vibration measurement. The results show that the size of the printed prosthesis is accurate, the repeatability is good, and the acoustic performance is equivalent to that of commercial titanium prostheses. It is currently suitable for ear surgery training.
该研究采用3D打印技术制作类人解剖假体，通过混合多种材料实现毫米级结构和密度梯度: This study uses 3D printing technology to produce human-like anatomical prostheses, and achieves millimeter-level structures and density gradients by mixing multiple materials, so that it has a material specific radiation absorption coefficient similar to human tissue with the support of dual-energy CT to accurately simulate the impact of small geometric deviations on dose distribution in proton therapy.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备了用于DNA扩增的微孔反应器，通过筛选最优透明材料并结: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a microporous reactor for DNA amplification. By screening the optimal transparent material and combining it with LAMP technology, the CYP2C19*2 gene mutation was successfully detected in saliva samples, verifying its feasibility as a companion diagnostic tool.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备了立即释放型氢氯噻嗪片，通过调整填充密度、顶底厚度和喷: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare immediate-release hydrochlorothiazide tablets, and explored its impact on drug release characteristics by adjusting parameters such as filling density, top and bottom thickness, and nozzle size. The results showed that printing design affects drug release behavior.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备了负载抗微生物肽KSL-W的KSL-W@PLGA/胶原: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a KSL-W@PLGA/collagen/silk fibroin/nanohydroxyapatite (COL/SF/nHA) scaffold loaded with antimicrobial peptide KSL-W. The results showed that it has good biocompatibility, pore structure and osteoinductive ability, can effectively inhibit bacterial growth and promote bone tissue repair, and is suitable for repairing bone defects caused by apical periodontitis.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备了集成光纤对光操控的微流控芯片，通过优化光纤通道、透明: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a microfluidic chip with integrated fiber-optic light control. By optimizing the design of fiber optic channels, transparent windows and zig-zag-like channels, it achieved precise alignment and focusing of particles. It successfully completed a light stretching experiment on MCF-7 cells and observed changes in cell elasticity after treatment with piririchalazine H.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备了集成微流控通道与电化学检测单元的SARS-CoV-2: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a SARS-CoV-2 gene sensing device integrating a microfluidic channel and an electrochemical detection unit. It targeted the viral N gene sequence through an ssDNA probe and used the electrooxidation reaction of adenine to achieve RNA hybridization detection. After hybridization, the desorption of the probe resulted in a signal decrease, and the system showed high sensitivity and rapid response.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备单层和多层速溶口腔薄膜，通过分离味遮层与药层解决味掩剂: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare single-layer and multi-layer instant oral films, and solved the problem of adding taste masking agents by separating the taste masking layer and the drug layer. The thickness and disintegration time of the resulting films were in line with expectations, and the drug content was uniform.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备含铜离子和阿莫西林的羟基磷灰石复合支架，通过协同抗菌与: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a hydroxyapatite composite scaffold containing copper ions and amoxicillin, which significantly improved the vascularized bone regeneration ability of large bone defects through synergistic antibacterial, pro-vascularization and bone-promoting effects.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备微流控装置，用于批式层析纯化，通过显著降低死体积，在小: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a microfluidic device for batch chromatography purification. By significantly reducing the dead volume, it successfully achieved gradient elution and purification of albumin and IgG monoclonal antibodies under small sample conditions, verifying its feasibility and flexibility in laboratory-scale chromatography.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备流动池生物传感器，结合导电聚合物与特异性生物识别元件，: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare a flow cell biosensor, combined with conductive polymers and specific biorecognition elements, for real-time and continuous detection of pathogenic E. coli in water samples, verifying its feasibility in detecting samples of different concentrations.
该研究采用3D打印技术制备负载madecassoside的水凝胶微针贴片，通过体: This study used 3D printing technology to prepare hydrogel microneedle patches loaded with madecassoside. In vitro experiments showed that it promoted the proliferation of gingival fibroblasts and the expression of type I collagen. Animal experiments confirmed that it can effectively promote the regeneration of periodontal soft tissue in rabbits.
该研究采用3D打印技术嵌入导电聚苯胺结构，构建智能聚合物传感器阵列，用于检测骨科: This study used 3D printing technology to embed conductive polyaniline structures to construct an intelligent polymer sensor array for detecting contact load at the interface of orthopedic implants, verifying its stability and repeatability in continuous loading, cyclic loading and linear response.
该研究采用3D打印技术快速制备了一种低成本微流控自由流动电泳芯片，通过对比镜面与: This study used 3D printing technology to quickly prepare a low-cost microfluidic free-flow electrophoresis chip. By comparing mirror and matte surfaces, it was found that the mirror surface has an accuracy of 5% and can effectively achieve the separation and concentration control of micro- and nanoparticles. Its performance was verified by dynamic light scattering and ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy analysis.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建低成本可重复的脉动培养系统，对比静态培养，发现脉动培养: This study used 3D printing technology to construct a low-cost and reproducible pulsatile culture system. Compared with static culture, it was found that pulsatile culture could maintain endothelial coverage and structural integrity of large pig carotid arteries, and early remodeling characteristics of injured arteries could be observed. It also confirmed that undamaged blood vessels had normal diastolic function, while blood vessels expanded by balloons showed impaired diastolic function.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建可重构模块化微流控系统，通过螺纹连接实现模块间密封且耐: This study used 3D printing technology to construct a reconfigurable modular microfluidic system. Sealing between modules was achieved through threaded connections with a pressure resistance of 500 kPa. Sodium alginate gel microspheres were successfully prepared, demonstrating its application potential in biological detection and material synthesis.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建含门静脉和肝胆通道的肝组织工程装置，通过灌注培养实现肝: This study uses 3D printing technology to construct a liver tissue engineering device containing portal veins and hepatobiliary channels, and improves liver cell survival and function through perfusion culture. Both in vitro and in vivo experiments show that it supports liver cell activity and liver-specific functions, and can be expanded to larger-scale devices.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建多腔室聚合物-脂质杂合片，将难溶性脂溶性药物分隔装载，: This study uses 3D printing technology to construct a multi-chamber polymer-lipid hybrid sheet, and loads poorly soluble fat-soluble drugs separately, and achieves predictable dispersion and release by adjusting the surface area to volume ratio (SA:V). When SA:V is 0.8, 90–110% is dispersed and fully released, and when SA:V is 0, there is no dispersion and release. The results show that this design can achieve precise control of drug release.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建微流控装置，实现单细胞活力与膜泡活动的实时监测，验证了: This study used 3D printing technology to construct a microfluidic device to achieve real-time monitoring of single cell viability and membrane vesicle activity, verifying its feasibility in stably maintaining cell viability detection and observing the life cycle of cell membrane vesicles.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建标准化模块化微流控系统，通过调节相间流速实现单滴、交替: This research uses 3D printing technology to construct a standardized modular microfluidic system. By adjusting the flow rate between phases, it can achieve the flexible generation of single droplets, alternating drops, fused drops and Janus particles. It also uses UV curing modules to prevent droplets from merging, providing a scalable microfluidic platform for single cell culture, protein crystallization screening, etc.
该研究采用3D打印技术构建集成电化学传感器的转盘系统，通过柔性多孔膜实现细胞培养: This study used 3D printing technology to build a turntable system with integrated electrochemical sensors. Cell culture was achieved through a flexible porous membrane. The top electrode monitored impedance changes caused by cell attachment and growth in real time, and the bottom electrode directly detected cell secreted molecules. The results showed that the signal intensity on the membrane side was three orders of magnitude higher than that in the culture medium, achieving real-time, non-invasive monitoring of cell activities.
该研究采用3D打印技术结合无定形固体分散体，制备含硝苯地平和HPMC的胃滞留浮泡: This study used 3D printing technology combined with amorphous solid dispersions to prepare gastric retention floating tablets containing nifedipine and HPMC. The drug filaments and tablets were obtained through hot melt extrusion and fused deposition molding. Solubility parameters and molecular dynamics simulations were used to predict the drug-polymer interaction, confirming that nifedipine achieves amorphous dispersion in the polymer matrix. The low filling rate and closed structure endow the tablets with low density and full floating characteristics, achieving zero-order sustained release in a single polymer system.
该研究采用3D打印技术，利用HPMC-AS、PEG-4000和PVA等材料制备肠: The study used 3D printing technology to prepare enteric-coated capsules using materials such as HPMC-AS, PEG-4000 and PVA. The drug release characteristics were changed by adjusting the formula, and the feasibility of controlled release in a simulated gastrointestinal environment was verified.
该研究采用3D打印技术，将高分辨率DLP/SLA打印部件与PMMA板胶合，成功制: This study used 3D printing technology to glue high-resolution DLP/SLA printed parts with PMMA plates, and successfully prepared microfluidic devices with various cross-sections such as straight-through, spiral, and serpentine. It verified its separation function of particles and cells under a pressure of 150 psi and realized a right-angle triangular cross-section spiral microchannel that is difficult to achieve with traditional photolithography.
该研究采用3D打印构建了灵活且低成本的微流体系统，通过避免湍流实现了高细胞相容性: This study used 3D printing to construct a flexible and low-cost microfluidic system, which achieved high cell compatibility by avoiding turbulence and is suitable for microfluidic platforms in the field of regenerative medicine.
该研究采用3D打印模块化微流控装置，对血液中细菌进行富集和DNA纯化，使O157: This study uses a 3D printed modular microfluidic device to enrich and purify bacteria in blood, thereby improving the sensitivity of O157:H7 detection, achieving high purity and high concentration acquisition of pathogen DNA, and improving the detection limit of molecular diagnosis.
该研究采用3D打印流体拭子（3DPFS）进行鼻腔冲洗采样，相比棉拭子更高效且舒适: This study uses 3D printed fluid swabs (3DPFS) for nasal irrigation sampling, which is more efficient and comfortable than cotton swabs. It has higher detection sensitivity, better diagnostic performance than cotton swabs, and has better user feedback comfort.
该研究采用3D打印生物反应器培养骨细胞，评估其在长时间培养中维持骨细胞健康的效果: This study uses a 3D printed bioreactor to culture bone cells and evaluates its effectiveness in maintaining bone cell health during long-term culture. The results showed that the bioreactor effectively supported the health of bone cells during extended culture.
该研究采用3D打印生物反应器，结合电阻抗谱技术，实现Caco-2上皮细胞在流动条: This study used a 3D printed bioreactor, combined with electrical impedance spectroscopy technology, to achieve culture and online barrier monitoring of Caco-2 epithelial cells under flow conditions. The cell layer resistance and capacitance were obtained through equivalent circuit fitting, and the effects of ethylene glycol bis(2-aminoethyl) ether-N,N,N′,N′-tetraacetate and forskolin on the cell barrier were non-invasively evaluated.
该研究采用3D打印的可组合微流控装置，通过优化Cas12a浓度和探针，实现了对四: This study used a 3D-printed combinable microfluidic device to achieve highly sensitive, rapid, and multiplex detection of four waterborne pathogens by optimizing Cas12a concentration and probes, with a detection limit of fg mL⁻¹, which is suitable for resource-limited environments.
该研究采用3D打印的惯性微流控装置，从含白细胞、红细胞、上皮细胞及癌细胞的混合悬: This study uses a 3D printed inertial microfluidic device to quickly separate sperm from a mixed suspension containing white blood cells, red blood cells, epithelial cells and cancer cells, shortening sperm recovery time by 36 times and achieving a separation efficiency of over 96% without changing sperm vitality, motility, morphology or DNA integrity, improving the extraction efficiency of occult sperm.
该研究采用3D打印的碳黑/聚乳酸电极，通过吸附富集和伏安法测定药物秋水仙碱，优化: This study used a 3D printed carbon black/polylactic acid electrode to measure the drug colchicine through adsorption enrichment and voltammetry. It optimized accumulation time, potential, pH and other parameters to achieve quantitative detection in the range of 0.6–2.2 μmol/L, with a limit of 0.11 μmol/L. It performed well in tablets and urine samples, verifying its applicability in low-cost routine testing.
该研究采用3D打印的级联微流控芯片，结合ICP-MS技术，对全血中的循环肿瘤细胞: This study uses 3D printed cascade microfluidic chips, combined with ICP-MS technology, to achieve efficient separation and online detection of circulating tumor cells in whole blood without pretreatment or external driving. It achieves a CTC recovery rate of 98.90% and high-purity separation. The number of CTCs in clinical samples ranged from 34 to 164 cells/mL, and was not detected in healthy controls.
该研究采用3D打印的芯片装置，从未经处理的患者唾液中提取并浓缩SARS-CoV-: The study used a 3D printed chip device to extract and concentrate SARS-CoV-2 RNA from untreated patient saliva. It also used electrochemical sensing technology to detect viral RNA and host antibodies against three major viral antigens. The detection was completed in two hours, and the results were comparable to traditional laboratory methods.
该研究采用3D打印的表皮汗液微流控系统，集成微尺度光学比色池，实现对汗液中铜、氯: This study uses a 3D printed epidermal sweat microfluidic system and integrates a micro-scale optical colorimetric cell to achieve precise spectral and fluorescence detection of copper, chloride ions, glucose concentration and pH value in sweat, verifying its high sensitivity and accuracy in real scenarios.
该研究采用3D打印真空辅助装置，将人脂肪来源干细胞加载至MeHA-RGD/ PC: This study uses a 3D printing vacuum-assisted device to load human adipose-derived stem cells into the MeHA-RGD/PCL-TCP scaffold to construct a fully defined three-dimensional hybrid bone tissue engineering system. Under serum-free and animal component-free conditions, the system supports cell survival and osteogenic differentiation, and the effect is comparable to traditional fibrin glue.
该研究采用3D打印磁性数字微流控平台MDM Carba，对27株碳青霉烯类耐药肠: This study uses the 3D printed magnetic digital microfluidic platform MDM Carba to rapidly detect 27 strains of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae. Its sensitivity and specificity are comparable to the Carba NP test, which can achieve rapid diagnosis with less reagent consumption and easy operation.
该研究采用3D打印管架结合智能手机和笔记本屏幕，通过测量颜色吸收度对鸡粪样本中R: This study used a 3D printed tube holder combined with smartphone and notebook screens to conduct a semi-quantitative analysis of LAMP detection of Raillietina in chicken manure samples by measuring color absorbance. The equine-coupled LAMP method showed the highest sensitivity and specificity, with a detection limit of 10 fg/μL DNA. The results were highly consistent with microscopic examination and superior to PCR and morphological detection.
该研究采用3D打印纤维束荧光显微镜，实现单细胞对高功率射频场的实时响应成像，系统: This study uses a 3D printed fiber bundle fluorescence microscope to achieve real-time imaging of single cells' response to high-power radio frequency fields. The system maintains stable imaging under 2.8 GHz radio frequency exposure and maintains clear focus when the sample temperature exceeds 40°C, verifying its feasibility in strong radio frequency environments.
该研究采用3D打印结合热熔挤出技术，制备了含卡维地洛和辛伐他汀的空心心形双载药片: This study used 3D printing combined with hot melt extrusion technology to prepare hollow heart-shaped dual-loaded tablets containing carvedilol and simvastatin. The two drugs were spatially separated to achieve stable drug release, but the uniformity of the drug content needed to be optimized.
该研究采用3D打印聚乳酸流式反应器，经硫代杯芳烃功能化聚乳酸修饰，实现尿酸酶高效: This study uses a 3D printed polylactic acid flow reactor, modified with thiocalixarene-functionalized polylactic acid, to achieve efficient and stable embedding of uricase, improve enzyme immobilization efficiency and inhibit degradation. The constructed electrochemical sensor can achieve linear detection of uric acid from 10 nM to 30 μM, with a detection limit of 7 nM, and is suitable for artificial urine and synthetic plasma.
该研究采用3D打印聚己内酯支架，通过共价结合聚乳酸-乙醇酸共聚物微粒，实现rhB: This study uses 3D printed polycaprolactone scaffolds to achieve controlled local release of rhBMP-2 by covalently binding polylactic acid-co-glycolic acid particles to treat bone non-healing. It is safer and more effective than existing methods, significantly promotes bone regeneration and reduces drug dosage.
该研究采用3D打印辅助模具铸造的缩放微加工方法，制备了葡萄糖响应型透皮胰高血糖素: This study used a 3D printing-assisted mold casting scaled micromachining method to prepare a glucose-responsive transdermal glucagon microneedle patch, which controlled release dynamics through volume changes and effectively reversed hypoglycemia and reduced irritation caused by monomer residues in a type 1 diabetes mouse model.
该研究采用3D打印钙磷酸盐支架，负载纳米聚合物微球封装的姜黄素与胡椒碱，并在表面: This study uses a 3D printed calcium phosphate scaffold loaded with curcumin and piperine encapsulated in nanopolymer microspheres, and coated with a thymol coating on the surface to promote the proliferation, differentiation and blood vessel formation of human osteoblasts, while significantly inhibiting the activity of osteosarcoma cells and enhancing the antibacterial effect against Staphylococcus aureus.
该研究采用3D打印鼻咽腔模型，结合mucus-mimicking SISMA水凝: This study used a 3D printed nasopharyngeal cavity model, combined with mucus-mimicking SISMA hydrogel, to compare the sample collection and release performance of the Heicon type and traditional nylon brush swabs. The results showed that the Heicon brush swab was more efficient, and both showed lower Ct values in the tubular model, indicating better viral load recovery.
该研究采用3D粉末床打印技术，针对对乙酰氨基酚和双氯芬酸钠两种模型药物，利用乳糖: This study uses 3D powder bed printing technology to develop flexible platform preparations for clinical trials using conventional excipients such as lactose and starch for two model drugs, acetaminophen and diclofenac sodium, and optimizing key factors such as starch type, powder flowability and liquid phase permeability. According to the material properties, by adjusting the amount of printing ink, the drug load can be flexibly adjusted from 5% to 50% and the tablet weight from 50 to 500mg. The compressive strength of the obtained tablets is higher than 0.2MPa, and most can achieve immediate release of more than 80% within 30 minutes.
该研究采用3D纳米印刷微结构电极阵列，通过纳米石墨烯层包覆SARS-CoV-2核: This study uses a 3D nano-printed microstructured electrode array and coats the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein with a nanographene layer to construct an electrochemical sensor that achieves ultra-sensitive detection of antibodies within seconds, with a lower detection limit of 13 fm and can be regenerated 10 times.
该研究采用AMDD三维打印技术，以吲哚美辛和酮康唑为活性成分，聚乙烯醇为载体，成: This study used AMDD three-dimensional printing technology, using indomethacin and ketoconazole as the active ingredients and polyvinyl alcohol as the carrier, to successfully prepare oral solid dosage forms that meet quality standards. The drug release rate was controlled by adjusting the filling rate, achieving higher dissolution than the crystalline form, and confirmed that powders with a particle size of about 200 µm can be directly used in this process.
该研究采用CBCT与口内扫描获取数据，通过蜡基快速成型制作手术导板，再以牙科树脂: This study uses CBCT and intraoral scanning to obtain data, uses wax-based rapid prototyping to produce surgical guides, and then casts metal sleeves with dental resin to ultimately achieve precise implant placement and restoration production, with satisfactory clinical results.
该研究采用三维打印多腔胶囊系统，将常规即释片分置于不同隔室，通过调节隔墙厚度实现: This study uses a three-dimensional printed multi-cavity capsule system, which places conventional immediate-release tablets in different compartments. By adjusting the thickness of the partition wall, precise control of drug release time is achieved, so that esomeprazole is released immediately and naproxen is released delayed. Animal experiments show that the absorption time interval between the two is clear, enabling sequential administration.
该研究采用两光子增材制造技术构建了包含26,000根波导的紧凑型快照光谱成像系统: This study used two-photon additive manufacturing technology to build a compact snapshot spectrum imaging system containing 26,000 waveguides. It achieved high spatial-spectral sampling density through a waveguide array with 4 micron spacing and 2.5 micron core size, verified its spectral resolution, crosstalk and flux performance in biological micro-sample imaging, and demonstrated the feasibility of integrating snapshot spectroscopy technology in portable devices.
该研究采用两光子聚合3D打印技术制备了一款全三维微流控芯片，包含十个可独立回收的: This study used two-photon polymerization 3D printing technology to prepare a fully three-dimensional microfluidic chip, which contains ten independently recyclable cell sample holders, achieving sub-microliter flow transmission, cell culture and efficient recovery, and verifying its dynamic transport ability of culture fluid, dyes and biomolecules in cell culture.
该研究采用串联注射伏安系统结合生物反应器，实现细胞培养中葡萄糖的在线监测，通过自: This study uses a tandem injection voltammetry system combined with a bioreactor to realize online monitoring of glucose in cell culture. Through automatic sampling and dilution, and using modified screen-printed electrode detection, the results are comparable to traditional colorimetric methods and are suitable for cell culture experiments in high-glucose medium environments.
该研究采用低成本3D打印微流控生物反应器，支持脑类器官生长并提供活体成像环境，实: This study uses a low-cost 3D printed microfluidic bioreactor to support the growth of brain organoids and provide an in vivo imaging environment, achieving long-term real-time imaging of intact brain organoids during the growth process, and enabling clear observation of their self-organizing behavior.
该研究采用低成本3D打印技术结合光刻，设计了多通道微流控装置，通过大尺寸通道和抗: This study used low-cost 3D printing technology combined with photolithography to design a multi-channel microfluidic device, which achieves efficient removal of white blood cells in the blood through large-size channels and antibody-coated beads. Combining the spiral structure with an optical readout system, the white blood cell removal rate reached 91% and the cancer cell recovery rate reached 95%.
该研究采用低成本、3D打印的生物相容性流体装置，实现对四种囊性纤维化细胞模型在相: This study uses a low-cost, 3D-printed biocompatible fluid device to simultaneously conduct multi-channel time monitoring of four cystic fibrosis cell models in the same experiment, and uses a digital holographic microscope to observe their cellular responses stimulated by agonists, saving about four times the time compared to traditional methods.
该研究采用低成本、3D打印的芯片式装置，结合稳定试剂，实现血清或血浆中乙肝病毒R: This study uses a low-cost, 3D-printed chip device, combined with stabilizing reagents, to achieve on-site extraction and stabilization of hepatitis B virus RNA in serum or plasma. The operation is completed within 15 minutes. The results are comparable to commercial systems, and RNA can be stably stored for 7 to 30 days.
该研究采用低成本、开源且3D打印的流动室，结合定量相位数字全息显微镜，非侵入性测: This study uses a low-cost, open-source, and 3D-printed flow chamber, combined with a quantitative phase digital holographic microscope, to non-invasively measure the absolute cell volume, average cell thickness, and whole-cell refractive index of cultured cells under resting and osmotic pressure challenges, with an accuracy of 50 μm³, 100 nm, and 0.0006 respectively. The signal is stabilized through rapid elution and cell morphology changes are reduced.
该研究采用低成本光学模块，通过测量磁珠填充高度估算Lab-on-a-Chip中磁: This study uses a low-cost optical module to estimate the number of magnetic beads in Lab-on-a-Chip by measuring the magnetic bead filling height. Combining 3D printing microscopy and LED projection, compared with the results of traditional inverted microscopy, the difference between the three methods does not exceed 6.5%.
该研究采用全喷墨打印技术，实现低成本、快速三维微流控器件的制备，可在各类基底上直: This research uses full inkjet printing technology to achieve low-cost and rapid preparation of three-dimensional microfluidic devices. It can be printed directly on various substrates, has high plane and vertical resolution, and is suitable for a variety of electrical and sensing applications.
该研究采用半固态挤出技术，将负载难溶药 ibuprofen 的介孔镁碳酸盐与PE: This study uses semi-solid extrusion technology to mix mesoporous magnesium carbonate loaded with the insoluble drug ibuprofen and PEG 400 to form a non-aqueous paste. Oral tablets and rectal suppositories are prepared through 3D printing to increase the drug dissolution rate, the drug loading capacity reaches 15.3% w/w, and the shape is stable after printing.
该研究采用半自动化流程设计3D打印患者特异性下颌笼植入物，结合尸体模型和3例病例: This study used a semi-automated process to design a 3D printed patient-specific mandibular cage implant, combined with a cadaver model and retrospective analysis of 3 cases. Through finite element analysis and experimental verification, it was shown that the stress of the implant under high-intensity chewing conditions was lower than the yield strength of titanium alloy, and after being connected to the residual mandible, the local peak stress was reduced by 72.7%, and the mechanical properties were good.
该研究采用单步增材制造技术制备了多层多孔聚ε-己内酯与锶掺杂纳米羟基磷灰石复合支: This study used single-step additive manufacturing technology to prepare a multilayer porous polyε-caprolactone and strontium-doped nanohydroxyapatite composite scaffold. Its structure and mechanical properties meet the requirements of alveolar bone. In vitro experiments show that the ceramic phase contributes to bone mineralization, providing a feasible strategy for periodontal tissue regeneration.
该研究采用单管CRISPR/Cas12a技术，对肺炎支原体、肺炎衣原体、流感嗜血: This study uses single-tube CRISPR/Cas12a technology to achieve rapid detection of Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Chlamydia pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae and Streptococcus pneumoniae, which can be completed within 30 minutes. The detection limit is 50 copies/test. It is highly consistent with the results of next-generation sequencing and chest CT, and is clinically feasible.
该研究采用双喷嘴3D打印技术制备含药与安慰剂分段的黏膜黏附薄膜，与溶液浇铸法相比: This study used dual-nozzle 3D printing technology to prepare segmented mucoadhesive films containing drug and placebo. Compared with the solution casting method, the 3D printed film has higher tensile strength but worse flexibility. The mucoadhesive properties of the two are similar, and individualized drug delivery can be achieved by adjusting the drug-placebo ratio.
该研究采用双泵 同轴 针头挤出工艺，通过调节立即释放与缓释成分比例，成功制备出具: This research uses a dual-pump coaxial needle extrusion process to successfully prepare personalized drug capsules with controllable release characteristics by adjusting the ratio of immediate release and sustained release ingredients. The preparation time of each capsule is about 20 seconds, which is significantly faster than existing 3D printing methods.
该研究采用含左氧氟沙星与泼尼松龙的可溶解环形微针贴片，通过微模塑技术制备，实现对: This study uses a dissolvable annular microneedle patch containing levofloxacin and prednisolone, prepared through micro-molding technology, to treat bacterial conjunctivitis. Compared with eye drops, it significantly improves drug retention in anterior segment tissue, improves inflammation, and restores corneal transparency.
该研究采用商业可得的聚酯薄膜Microseal 'B'作为3D打印开放型微流控器: This study used commercially available polyester film Microseal 'B' as a transparent sealing cover for 3D printed open microfluidic devices, and verified its sealing, fluorescence detection compatibility and surface wettability through leakage tests, fluorescence tests and contact angle measurements. The results showed that it can withstand 2.7 atm pressure at a flow rate of 4 mL/min without leakage, and the fluorescence detection intensity to background ratio for 5μm and 15μm particles reaches 2.3 to 4.5, which is comparable to other sealing materials.
该研究采用喷墨绑定3D打印技术，成功制备了含水溶性与疏水性活性成分的个性化速溶片: This study used inkjet binding 3D printing technology to successfully prepare personalized instant tablets containing water-soluble and hydrophobic active ingredients, achieving uniform drug distribution, good mechanical properties and rapid dissolution. It is suitable for scenarios in early drug development where API dosage is limited and flexible formulation is required.
该研究采用增材制造技术构建了由重复1.8毫米单元格组成的 晶格 结构滤网，通过计: This study used additive manufacturing technology to construct a lattice structure filter composed of repeated 1.8 mm cells. Its flow characteristics and structural strength were evaluated through computational fluid dynamics and finite element analysis. The results showed that the pressure dropped slightly, the flow rate increased slightly, and the structure could withstand higher loads, indicating that this type of filter has application potential.
该研究采用微流体3D打印技术制备含Pt(IV)前药引发剂的Pt-GelMA支架，: This study uses microfluidic 3D printing technology to prepare Pt-GelMA scaffolds containing Pt(IV) prodrug initiators. Through photo-cross-linking, it achieves postoperative tumor cell killing and inhibition of local tumor growth and distant metastasis, while supporting normal cell attachment and proliferation and promoting tissue repair.
该研究采用微流控技术制备载姜黄素脂质体，结合 同轴 3D 打印构建双药负载水凝胶: This study used microfluidic technology to prepare curcumin-loaded liposomes, combined with coaxial 3D printing to construct a dual-drug-loaded hydrogel scaffold to achieve synergistic release of trimethin and resveratrol. The scaffold was compatible with human retinal endothelial cells in vitro and had good mechanical properties and sustained drug release characteristics.
该研究采用改性玻璃纤维纸与3D打印装置，结合阳离子等速电泳技术，实现了对人血清中: This study used modified glass fiber paper and 3D printing device, combined with cationic isotachophoresis technology, to achieve the simultaneous detection of cTnT and cTnI in human serum. By enriching and removing high-abundance proteins, the target protein concentration was increased by about 1300 times, and the detection limits reached 0.6 pmol/L, 1. and 1.5 pmol/L respectively.
该研究采用数字光处理3D打印技术，优化打印角度对微针阵列几何形状的影响，发现倾斜: This study used digital light processing 3D printing technology to optimize the effect of printing angle on the geometry of microneedle arrays. It was found that tilted printing was closer to CAD design, and the printed parts did not break but only bent under a force of 300 N, showing good mechanical strength and providing a feasible method for the rapid and efficient preparation of hollow microneedle arrays.
该研究采用数字化技术，结合氧化锆、PEEK及选择性激光熔融钛合金，分别制作上颌: This study used digital technology, combined with zirconia, PEEK and selective laser melting of titanium alloy, to produce maxillary telescopic crown-retained dentures and mandibular Kennedy Class I removable partial dentures respectively. Through traditional impression taking, digital modeling and processing processes, functional and aesthetic improvements were achieved, and the patient was satisfied with the one-year follow-up.
该研究采用新型3D打印技术制作种植体支持修复体的纤维增强结构，通过对比发现，该方: This study uses new 3D printing technology to produce fiber-reinforced structures for implant-supported restorations. Through comparison, it is found that the restorations produced by this method are lighter, have better adhesion between resin and reinforced structures, and have better appearance. The mechanical properties and aesthetic effects are better than traditional methods.
该研究采用新型GlioFlow3D微生理系统，结合3D生物打印与光固化技术，构建: This study uses a new GlioFlow3D microphysiological system, combined with 3D bioprinting and light curing technology, to construct a microchannel containing a collagen matrix to co-culture glioma cells and brain endothelial cells. Compared with PDMS materials, it reduces the absorption of small molecules and reveals the spatiotemporal mechanism of increased CD133 expression of glioma cells at the blood vessel interface and enhanced TMZ resistance.
该研究采用无需专业背景和复杂设备的3D打印技术，制备出尺寸为100 µm的生物相: This study uses 3D printing technology that does not require professional background and complex equipment to prepare biocompatible microfluidic components with a size of 100 µm. It realizes osteogenic differentiation detection and cytotoxicity screening of human mesenchymal stem cells. It completes treatment, long-term culture and analysis on a single chip for the first time, demonstrating its ease of use and application potential in biomedical research.
该研究采用温控溶剂辅助挤出法，利用65-100 °C温度和简短干燥步骤，以PVA: This study adopted a temperature-controlled solvent-assisted extrusion method, using a temperature of 65-100 °C and a short drying step, using water-soluble polymers such as PVA and PVP and fillers such as lactose as raw materials to successfully prepare patient-specific oral tablets with good weight uniformity, mechanical strength and in vitro drug release characteristics. Compared with other 3D printing technologies, this method is easier to operate and requires lower equipment.
该研究采用电纺聚合物支架与3D打印生物反应器构建三维肾组织工程模型，通过调控两侧: This study uses electrospun polymer scaffolds and 3D printed bioreactors to construct a three-dimensional renal tissue engineering model. By regulating the shear stress on both sides (18–21 mPa), the directional distribution of endothelial and epithelial cells in different environments is achieved, providing an effective tool for renal tubule simulation and dual-environment control applications.
该研究采用直接墨水书写3D打印技术，以二甲基黄作为模型药物，构建了核心-壳结构的: This study used direct ink writing 3D printing technology and used dimethyl yellow as a model drug to construct a water-soluble high-dose sustained-release preparation with a core-shell structure, achieving sustained drug release for more than 12 hours, reducing the volume by 25.8%, and improving mechanical strength.
该研究采用直接耦合的双螺杆挤出-3D打印系统，对四种材料（两种聚合物和两种脂质）: This study uses a directly coupled twin-screw extrusion-3D printing system to continuously print four materials (two polymers and two lipids) to achieve efficient preparation of solid preparations. The quality and content uniformity of the printed samples are superior to those of the semi-solid extrusion system, and the dissolution behavior of the lipid-based formula is more stable.
该研究采用离散元法（DEM）模拟3D打印制药片剂过程中粉末从料斗的排出行为，考察: This study uses the discrete element method (DEM) to simulate the discharge behavior of powder from the hopper during the 3D printing of pharmaceutical tablets, examines the impact of particle size, density and other attributes on the packing density of the powder bed, and verifies the accuracy of the model through experiments.
该研究采用立体光刻技术制备了六种不同长径比的聚丙烯酸酯微针阵列，每阵列含10×1: This study used stereolithography technology to prepare six types of polyacrylate microneedle arrays with different aspect ratios. Each array contained 10 × 10 tapered microneedles. The dimensional accuracy was evaluated through optical and scanning electron microscopy, combined with mechanical and skin equivalent penetration tests. It was found that microneedles with high aspect ratios had better deformation and deeper penetration, and microneedles with 0.3mm and 0.4mm base diameters showed consistent force-displacement characteristics during the penetration process.
该研究采用立体光刻技术制备了集成纳米纤维支架的3D打印微灌注培养装置，以Huh7: This study used stereolithography technology to prepare a 3D printed microperfusion culture device integrated with nanofiber scaffolds. Using Huh7.5 liver cancer cells as a model, it was found that compared with static culture, the expression of Albumin and CYP3A7 genes was significantly up-regulated, indicating that the device can more realistically simulate the physiological microenvironment of liver cells.
该研究采用纳米纤维自支撑增材制造（NSCAM）技术，通过电纺与电液喷射交替工艺，: This research uses nanofiber self-supporting additive manufacturing (NSCAM) technology, through alternating electrospinning and electrohydrojet processes, using porous polyimide nanofibers as support structures and fluid channels to achieve integrated manufacturing of 3D microfluidic chips. A microfluidic pressure gain valve with a narrow channel and a movable membrane was successfully prepared, which can be completely closed at a pressure of 45 kPa, with a dynamic response time of 52.6 ms.
该研究采用聚乙二醇二丙烯酸酯（PEGDA）为基础的光固化生物墨水，结合聚乙二醇和: This study uses polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PEGDA)-based photocurable bioink, combined with polyethylene glycol and photoinitiator, to achieve 3D inkjet printing of the insoluble drugs naproxen and ibuprofen through visible light irradiation. The results show that different PEGDA ratios can achieve differentiated sustained-release effects, and the ink has good structural and mechanical properties.
该研究采用选择性激光烧结技术，通过分别储存吲哚美辛和聚乙烯醇粉末，直接打印交替层: This study uses selective laser sintering technology to store indomethacin and polyvinyl alcohol powders separately and directly print alternating layers to prepare personalized multi-layer tablets. It successfully achieves separate sintering and layered structure of the indomethacin layer. EDS and DSC confirmed that the interlayer structure is clear and partially induced amorphization. The dissolution test shows that its dissolution rate is better than the raw material powder.
该研究采用锥束CT与植入体软件结合3D打印手术导板，对耳部外植体植入进行术前规划: This study used cone beam CT and implant software combined with 3D printed surgical guides to conduct preoperative planning for ear explant implantation. It successfully navigated the complex bone structure, avoided key tissues, optimized the osseointegration of the implant, and achieved stable prosthetic fixation.
该研究采用高分辨率聚丙烯酸3D打印材料构建细胞培养系统，经细胞活力、凋亡/坏死及: This study used high-resolution polyacrylic acid 3D printing materials to construct a cell culture system. After cell viability, apoptosis/necrosis, and surface properties were evaluated, it was confirmed that it has good biocompatibility, supports direct cell contact proliferation, and its transparent characteristics are conducive to optical online monitoring in a microfluidic environment.
该研究针对 topical 和 transdermal 药物递送，系统评估了不同: This study systematically evaluates the impact of different in vitro skin models and experimental conditions on drug permeation performance for topical and transdermal drug delivery, and clearly points out that optimizing the design of in vitro permeation experiments can obtain reliable and repeatable permeation data to accurately predict the kinetic behavior of drugs in the skin.
该研究针对17至54岁患者颅骨模型，基于CT扫描数据设计并3D打印了眶底修复导引: This study focused on the skull model of patients aged 17 to 54 years old, designed and 3D printed an orbital floor repair guide device based on CT scan data, and evaluated its fit in the left and right orbits through a scoring system. The results showed that the average scores on the left and right sides were 3.47 and 3.87 respectively, both close to full scores, indicating that the guide device has a good initial fit effect in people of different genders and ages and can assist in guiding implant placement.
该研究针对2亿糖尿病患者使用的现有胰岛素泵存在成本高、体积大、疼痛及管路易堵塞等: This study aims at the existing insulin pumps used by 200 million diabetic patients, which have problems such as high cost, large volume, pain, and easy tube blockage. A low-cost, wireless, and painless insulin delivery device was developed. It achieves 0.02–3.0 μL/min flow control through piezoelectric drive and uses a 3D printed microneedle module. The open microchannel design is more resistant to lateral force. The hollow microneedle can reach 90% penetration depth under 0.5N force, meeting the insertion force and size requirements.
该研究针对3D打印微流控器件中牺牲材料去除难题，提出利用离心力高效清除密布微结构: This study addresses the problem of sacrificial material removal in 3D printed microfluidic devices. It proposes to use centrifugal force to efficiently remove sacrificial materials in densely packed microstructure channels. Experimental comparisons show that it is superior to traditional liquid injection methods and achieves reliable post-processing of complex microfluidic structures.
该研究针对3D打印微流控器件中牺牲材料清除问题，提出一种实验验证的新技术，实现宽: This study aims at the problem of sacrificial material removal in 3D printed microfluidic devices and proposes a new experimentally verified new technology to achieve the removal of sacrificial materials in microchannels with a width of about 200 µm and above, with a stable removal rate between 40% and 75%.
该研究针对3D打印水凝胶在生物医学工程、软机器人和组织工程中的应用，探讨了定制化: This study focuses on the application of 3D printed hydrogels in biomedical engineering, soft robotics and tissue engineering. It explores key technologies such as customized scaffolds, bio-ink optimization and high-resolution multi-material printing, focusing on improving the cell migration environment and drug controlled release performance, and achieving bionic and functional integration of biological structures.
该研究针对3D打印药用丝材，通过优化挤出工艺并引入专用卷绕装置，发现螺杆转速升高: This study focused on 3D printing medicinal filaments. By optimizing the extrusion process and introducing a special winding device, it was found that increasing the screw speed will aggravate the fluctuation of the diameter of the filament, affecting its mechanical properties and the quality uniformity of the printed formulation. The specific feed amount is a key parameter to ensure diameter consistency.
该研究针对Crowe IV型发育性髋关节异常患者，开发并应用一种非患者特异的3D: This study focuses on patients with Crowe type IV developmental anomalies of the hip. A non-patient-specific 3D printed osteotomy guide is developed and used for transverse shortening osteotomy of the proximal femur during total hip replacement. It achieves a more precise osteotomy line, facilitates rotational adjustment, and shortens intraoperative implantation time.
该研究针对PMMA材料3D打印微流控芯片，通过有限元分析和正交实验优化参数，实现: This study focused on 3D printing microfluidic chips made of PMMA material. Through finite element analysis and orthogonal experiments, parameters were optimized to achieve non-clogging and leakage of 200 μm cross-section microchannels. The reaction experiment obtained copper hydroxide color data, verifying its feasibility in chemical reactions.
该研究针对SSE 3D打印半固体制剂干燥导致结构塌陷的问题，采用蜂蜡作为临时支撑: This study aims at the problem of structural collapse caused by drying of SSE 3D printed semi-solid preparations. Beeswax is used as a temporary support phase and Eudragit® RL pseudo-emulsion is thermally cured to achieve synergistic optimization of structural stability and sustained-release performance, and obtain sustained-release tablets with high geometric precision and strong mechanical strength.
该研究针对一名因新冠后曲霉病行单侧广泛上颌切除的年轻患者，采用定制化亚perio: This study focused on a young patient who underwent unilateral extensive maxillary resection due to post-COVID-19 aspergillosis. Customized subperiosteal titanium frame implants were used to repair the maxillary defect. Three months after the operation, fixed implants were made for repair to achieve the recovery of pronunciation, chewing and swallowing functions.
该研究针对三维结构空心微针阵列，采用模块化组装系统，将微针体与基座分离制造，通过: This study focuses on a three-dimensional structure of hollow microneedle arrays, using a modular assembly system to separate the microneedle body from the base. Through high-precision 3D printing and low-resolution printing or injection molding, combined with standard connection interfaces, rapid assembly can be achieved, production time and costs are reduced, energy consumption and carbon emissions are reduced, and its reliability is verified through mechanical and sealing tests.
该研究针对上肢截肢者，设计了一款模块化、可由非专业人士组装的仿生义肢，采用3D打: This study designed a modular bionic prosthesis for upper limb amputees that can be assembled by non-professionals. The finger joints and palms are made of 3D printed ABS or PLA materials. The operation is realized through myoelectric control and graphical interface, taking into account ergonomics, cost and environmental protection.
该研究针对上臂截肢者设计了采用四杆机构的3D打印仿生机械手，通过个体驱动五指、关: This study designed a 3D printed bionic manipulator using a four-bar mechanism for upper arm amputees. Through improvements such as individually driven five fingers, joint protection and detachable structures, it achieved a range of motion similar to that of actual fingers (70–98%) and structural durability under a load of 1.6kg, verifying its feasibility in daily use.
该研究针对上颌末端缺牙患者，采用3D打印彩色无边缘试牙托和定制解剖骨减量导板，结: This study focuses on patients with maxillary distal edentulous patients, using 3D printed color edgeless trial trays and customized anatomical bone reduction guides, combined with intraoral scanning, to achieve implant-guided surgery and immediate load-bearing, ensuring aesthetic safety, surgical accuracy, and treatment efficiency.
该研究针对下肢复杂重建病例，采用定制3D打印植入物解决多平面畸形及骨缺损问题，通: This study focuses on complex reconstruction cases of the lower limbs, using customized 3D printed implants to solve the problems of multi-plane deformity and bone defects. It achieves precise correction through personalized implants and surgical tools, improving clinical problems that are difficult to deal with with traditional surgeries.
该研究针对下肢残障者，通过逆向工程、质量功能展开（QFD）和3D打印技术，基于患: This study focuses on people with lower limb disabilities. Through reverse engineering, quality function deployment (QFD) and 3D printing technology, technical requirements were determined based on patient needs and prosthetists' discussions. The residual limb was three-dimensionally scanned and optimized for modeling. Finally, PLA+ material was used to print a customized prosthetic sleeve that fits the individual shape with a layer thickness of 0.2 mm and a temperature of 215°C, verifying the accuracy and feasibility of this method.
该研究针对个体化用药需求，采用3D打印技术定制药物递送系统，通过软件设计沉积含药: In response to the needs of individualized medication, this research uses 3D printing technology to customize a drug delivery system, and deposits medicated ink through software design to achieve precise shaping on demand. It is more flexible and accurate than traditional methods, improving the individualization and safety of treatment.
该研究针对个性化伤口管理需求，开发了一种基于 vat 光聚合3D打印的多功能水凝: In response to the needs of personalized wound management, this research developed a multifunctional hydrogel based on vat photopolymerization 3D printing, integrating diagnostic and therapeutic functions. The hydrogel is composed of polyacrylamide-hydroxyethylacrylamide and carboxymethylcellulose. It is cross-linked by light and embedded with bromocresol violet to achieve pH-responsive color changes, which can distinguish healthy and infected states. It is also loaded with levofloxacin and graphene oxide to achieve drug release under infection stimulation. The release amount is significantly higher in alkaline conditions than in acidic environments.
该研究针对临床样本，采用无需RNA提取的RT-LAMP法检测SARS-CoV-2: This study focuses on clinical samples and uses the RT-LAMP method without RNA extraction to detect SARS-CoV-2. Combined with a portable device, it can quickly identify the virus within 30 minutes. The results are consistent with RT-PCR and can be used as a point-of-care diagnostic solution that does not require laboratory infrastructure.
该研究针对传统义齿制作流程复杂、成本高、效率低的问题，构建并实施了基于集成3D打: This study aimed at the problems of complex, high cost, and low efficiency problems in the traditional denture manufacturing process. A denture manufacturing production system based on integrated 3D printing technology was constructed and implemented. The entire process covering design, printing, post-processing, and quality control was established through oral scanning and computer-aided design. The results showed that the system significantly improved manufacturing accuracy and efficiency, and reduced costs.
该研究针对传统假手控制不直观、适配性差的问题，设计集成EMG传感器与3D打印技术: This research addresses the problems of unintuitive control and poor adaptability of traditional prosthetic hands, and designs a new prosthetic hand that integrates EMG sensors and 3D printing technology. It achieves natural control through electromyographic signals and combines real-time feedback and adjustable grip to improve user interaction experience and functionality.
该研究针对传统制药过程高能耗、高废弃物及个性化治疗不足的问题，开发基于3D打印的: This research aims at the problems of high energy consumption, high waste and insufficient personalized treatment in the traditional pharmaceutical process. It develops a personalized drug delivery system based on 3D printing. By integrating environmentally friendly materials and additive manufacturing technology, it can achieve precise dosage customization of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and reduce resource consumption and carbon emissions.
该研究针对使用编码愈合附件的种植体修复，提出一种完全无需实体铸件的数字化流程，通: This study proposes a digital process that completely eliminates the need for physical castings for implant restoration using coded healing attachments. By integrating advanced digital technology, precise restoration production can be achieved within one hour, avoiding attachment disassembly and reconnection, and not relying on a specific implant system.
该研究针对儿童特殊用药需求，采用3D打印技术制造个性化药剂，改善剂量、辅料安全性: This study aims at the special medication needs of children and uses 3D printing technology to create personalized pharmaceuticals to improve issues such as dosage, excipient safety and taste. It covers mini tablets, chewable tablets and other forms, and focuses on evaluating the acceptance, design and bitter taste masking effect of the preparation, but the clinical efficacy still needs further research.
该研究针对儿童用药需求，开发了基于明胶与海藻酸钠1:3比例、浸入钙氯溶液60秒的: In response to the medication needs of children, this study developed a 3D printed chewing syrup containing propranolol based on a 1:3 ratio of gelatin and sodium alginate and immersed in a calcium chloride solution for 60 seconds. By adjusting the shape and immersion time, its physical form, dissolution performance and sensory characteristics were optimized.
该研究针对先天性耳畸形患者，采用3D打印个性化模板结合安卓平板增强现实技术，实现: This study focuses on patients with congenital ear malformations, using 3D printed personalized templates combined with Android tablet augmented reality technology to achieve objective and repeatable positioning of structures during the auricle reconstruction process. The position deviation between the reconstructed auricle and the contralateral ear during the operation was 2.7±2.4mm, and the length and width exceeded the ideal values by 3.1mm and 1.3mm respectively.
该研究针对分析微流控器件的制造，采用3D打印技术，通过CAD设计布局、分层切片并: This study aims to analyze the manufacturing of microfluidic devices, using 3D printing technology to achieve rapid prototyping of complex three-dimensional structures through CAD design layout, layered slicing and generation of G codes. Compared with traditional methods, it is simpler and has less material waste.
该研究针对创伤性手指截肢患者，采用3D打印关节模拟器提升手指假体的自然活动性，显: This study focuses on patients with traumatic finger amputations, using a 3D printed joint simulator to improve the natural mobility of the finger prosthesis and significantly enhance their functional ability to complete basic tasks such as daily grasping.
该研究针对包含下颌髁突的大型下颌骨缺损，采用基于CAD-CAM技术的患者特异性3: This study focuses on a large mandibular defect including the mandibular condyle, using patient-specific 3D printed titanium implants based on CAD-CAM technology for reconstruction. Through virtual surgical planning, the bone defect repair is consistent with the basic shape of the mandible, and excellent postoperative aesthetic and functional results are achieved.
该研究针对印度尼西亚苏拉巴亚地区截肢患者，通过测量残肢尺寸、3D设计打印、功能测: This study focuses on amputee patients in Surabaya, Indonesia. Through measuring the size of the residual limb, 3D design and printing, functional testing and usage guidance, a low-cost, customizable bionic prosthetic hand was produced to help them complete daily activities such as holding mobile phones and opening bottles, and improve self-efficacy.
该研究针对即刻完全义齿及种植体保留超义齿患者，采用四件式CAD-CAM手术导板，: This study focuses on patients with immediate complete dentures and implant-retained superdentures, using a four-piece CAD-CAM surgical guide, combined with dynamic computer-assisted implant surgery, to achieve incision-free tooth extraction, precise implant positioning and controlled bone reduction, avoid bone transplantation, improve aesthetic results and shorten healing time.
该研究针对口服片剂融合丝制造中使用Kollidon® VA64材料的问题，通过配: This study addresses the issue of using Kollidon® VA64 material in the manufacturing of oral tablet fusion filaments, improves its printability through formulation and melt mixing strategies, and clarifies the key parameters and pre-screening tools required for successful 3D printing.
该研究针对可摘局部义齿的制作，采用全蜡免工艺，结合快速成型与快速铣削技术，通过咬: This study focuses on the production of removable partial dentures, using a full wax-free process, combined with rapid prototyping and rapid milling technology, and determining the jaw position relationship and tooth arrangement through occlusal rims and trial fitting, and then milling the denture teeth and inserting them into the milled base.
该研究针对复杂手部创伤患者，采用带血管化股骨外髁游离皮瓣结合个体化3D打印模型进: This study focuses on patients with complex hand trauma, using a vascularized lateral femoral condyle free flap combined with a personalized 3D printed model to reconstruct the metacarpophalangeal joints, achieving anatomical reduction and good blood supply, and achieving significant functional improvement through systematic rehabilitation training after surgery.
该研究针对复杂眼眶面缺损患者，采用个性化3D打印PEEK与PDMS混合植入物，结: This study focuses on patients with complex orbital defects, using personalized 3D printed PEEK and PDMS hybrid implants, combined with CT segmentation and contralateral mirror design, to achieve structural stability and accurate facial volume contour reconstruction. Postoperative images show that the implant position is stable, facial symmetry is improved, and functional abnormalities need to be treated in stages.
该研究针对复杂骨折患者，通过优化分割协议保留骨碎片细节、手动添加支撑结构维持移位: For patients with complex fractures, this study improves the accuracy and production efficiency of 3D printing models by optimizing the segmentation protocol to retain the details of bone fragments, manually adding support structures to maintain the position of displaced fragments, using magnetic devices to separate multi-osseous structures and adjusting filling parameters, thus improving the visualization and accuracy of preoperative planning.
该研究针对多平面微流控器件中微阀的集成难题，设计并验证了垂直膜或垂直控制通道等新: This study aimed at the integration problem of microvalves in multi-planar microfluidic devices, designed and verified new microvalve structures such as vertical membranes or vertical control channels, and achieved stable pressure control and fluid regulation through computational fluid dynamics simulation and experimental testing.
该研究针对失语或行动不便者，设计并实现了一款基于语音激活的无线假手，通过语音指令: This study designed and implemented a voice-activated wireless prosthetic hand for people with aphasia or mobility impairments. Voice commands drive flexible sensors and servo motors to work together to achieve intuitive operations synchronized with human hand movements.
该研究针对完全义齿修复中上颌下颌软组织松弛问题，采用结合黏膜压缩与功能性的综合取: This study addresses the problem of maxillary and mandibular soft tissue laxity in complete denture repair, using a comprehensive impression-taking method that combines mucosal compression and functionality, supplemented by digital workflow and closed-mouth 3D printing models, to effectively improve denture stability, treatment efficiency and patient satisfaction.
该研究针对对乙酰氨基酚和咖啡因的同步电分析，通过表面处理与活化优化3D打印电化学: This study aimed at the simultaneous electrical analysis of acetaminophen and caffeine, optimizing 3D printed electrochemical sensors through surface treatment and activation, and verified the key role of surface treatment and activation in improving sensor performance.
该研究针对微流控器件制造中的成本高、通量低等问题，采用立体光刻3D打印制备基底，: This study aims at the problems of high cost and low throughput in the manufacturing of microfluidic devices. It uses stereolithography 3D printing to prepare the substrate, combines it with laser patterned adhesive layer and stacked assembly to achieve low-cost, high-throughput, small-footprint large-scale parallel manufacturing of complex microstructures.
该研究针对微流控器件原型制作，提出一种无需光罩、利用高性价比紫外激光直接在光刻胶: This study aims at prototyping microfluidic devices and proposes a design method that uses a cost-effective ultraviolet laser to write directly on the photoresist without a photomask, achieving flexibility and rapidity in design iteration modifications. The device produced performs well in particle separation.
该研究针对微流控器官芯片培养中泵的定制化与低成本需求，设计了一款用户友好的3D打: In response to the demand for customization and low cost of pumps in microfluidic organ-on-a-chip culture, this study designed a user-friendly 3D printed modular peristaltic pump. It combines programmable electronic modules with 3D printed peristaltic components to achieve flexible adjustment of multiple flow rates and flow patterns, and supports multiple pipelines in parallel to meet the diverse needs of different physiological condition simulations and drug testing.
该研究针对微流控芯片制造中三维通道复杂、工艺繁琐等问题，提出集成3D打印与聚合物: This study addresses the problems of complex three-dimensional channels and cumbersome processes in microfluidic chip manufacturing, and proposes a new manufacturing method that integrates 3D printing and polymer dissolution. By comparing microchannels prepared from PVA and HIPS materials, it is found that the quality of microchannels made from HIPS is significantly better than that of PVA.
该研究针对微流控芯片制造中分辨率低、多层结构难成型等问题，通过优化光聚合参数，实: This research addresses the problems of low resolution and difficult molding of multi-layer structures in microfluidic chip manufacturing. By optimizing photopolymerization parameters, it achieves precise printing of 20 μm × 20 μm high-resolution microchannels, significantly improving the manufacturing accuracy and scalability of microfluidic devices.
该研究针对微流控芯片的制造，比较了传统工艺与3D打印技术，结果显示3D打印技术可: This study compared traditional processes with 3D printing technology for the manufacturing of microfluidic chips. The results show that 3D printing technology can achieve rapid prototyping and mass production of microfluidic chips, with the advantages of low cost and high efficiency.
该研究针对微流控芯片，采用3D打印技术集成阀门、泵、传感器及混合器等功能性元件，: This research focuses on microfluidic chips and uses 3D printing technology to integrate functional components such as valves, pumps, sensors, and mixers to achieve precise control of microfluidics and real-time perception of environmental changes, and promote the development of microfluidic equipment toward intelligence and autonomy.
该研究针对心肌缺血瘢痕患者，基于CT与心脏MRI图像，通过3D打印技术制作个性化: This study focuses on patients with myocardial ischemic scars. Based on CT and cardiac MRI images, a personalized surgical guide is produced through 3D printing technology to achieve precise scar positioning and ablation. The guide performs accurately in terms of anatomical positioning, structural stability, and tool adaptability.
该研究针对慢性植入式微流体装置，开发了可自对齐的微流体连接器，通过增材制造将连接: This study developed a self-aligning microfluidic connector for chronically implantable microfluidic devices. The connector and wax layer were printed on the stent through additive manufacturing, and the connector was combined with the polymer nanocomposite probe using low-temperature thermal bonding. The measured tensile and shear strengths were both higher than the probe insertion force, and remained stable after 4 weeks of immersion.
该研究针对慢性肾病患者和健康人群血液样本，开发了一种集成纸基微流控免疫层析与智能: This study developed a CRP detection method that integrates paper-based microfluidic immunochromatography and smartphones for blood samples from chronic kidney disease patients and healthy people, achieving low-cost, highly reproducible CRP detection within 15 minutes. The results are consistent with standard ELISA, with a detection limit of 54 ng/mL and a linear range of 2 μg/mL.
该研究针对慢性骨髓炎，开发了一种基于PCL/海藻酸钠的3D打印双药释放支架，内部: For chronic osteomyelitis, this study developed a 3D printed dual-drug release stent based on PCL/sodium alginate, which internally releases cefazolin and externally releases rifampicin, which synergistically inhibits bacterial activity and biofilm formation without inhibiting osteoblast proliferation, effectively overcoming the limitations of a single drug.
该研究针对新冠疫情下 呼吸机 分裂需求，开发了一种3D打印的分流装置与电阻系统，: In response to the split needs of ventilators during the COVID-19 epidemic, this research developed a 3D printed shunt device and resistance system. Through replaceable airflow resistors, it can achieve precise shunting for patients with different lung compliance and ventilation needs. Combined with patient-specific airflow calculation models and pre-calculated simulations of more than 200 million scenarios, this technology can be quickly deployed in emergency situations and is suitable for patients with large differences in lung function.
该研究针对新冠疫情下医疗资源短缺问题，设计了一种基于3D打印的压控人工呼吸机，通: In response to the shortage of medical resources during the COVID-19 epidemic, this study designed a pressure-controlled artificial ventilator based on 3D printing. It achieved material reduction manufacturing and pressure control through structural topology optimization and PID control, which shortened production time without reducing performance.
该研究针对柑橘树黄龙病缺乏有效治疗手段的问题，提出一种微创三维打印微针阵列给药系: This study addresses the lack of effective treatments for citrus greening disease and proposes a minimally invasive three-dimensional printed microneedle array drug delivery system to deliver therapeutic agents to citrus leaf tissues, aiming to achieve a technically feasible, sustainable and environmentally safe treatment plan.
该研究针对植入物感染及新冠疫情防控，探讨3D打印技术在定制抗感染材料和医疗设备中: This study focuses on implant infection and COVID-19 prevention and control, exploring the application of 3D printing technology in customizing anti-infective materials and medical equipment. By integrating antibacterial agents and bioactive ingredients, precise intervention can be achieved and equipment adaptability and protection capabilities can be improved.
该研究针对楚氏锥虫病急性期样本，开发了一款基于智能手机的AI系统，结合3D打印显: This study developed a smartphone-based AI system for samples in the acute phase of Trypanosomiasis chuzi disease, combining a 3D printed microscope adapter and a lightweight AI model to achieve real-time detection and counting. In a real scenario, its detection accuracy for blood smear samples was 67.1% and the recall rate was 96.4%, showing high sensitivity and suitable for early diagnosis in resource-constrained areas.
该研究针对橄榄油样本，开发了一种3D打印的垂直微流控装置FieldNA，通过重力: For olive oil samples, this study developed a 3D printed vertical microfluidic device, FieldNA, which uses gravity-driven flow and magnetic-assisted washing separation to achieve nucleic acid extraction. Its extraction efficiency and quality are comparable to the CTAB-phenol-chloroform method and two commercial filter column methods, without the need for additional power sources or laboratory equipment.

针对Campanacci III或复发性远端桡骨巨细胞瘤患者，比较了骨科异体移植: For patients with Campanacci III or recurrent distal radius giant cell tumor, the clinical functional outcomes and complications of orthopedic allograft and three-dimensional printed prosthetic reconstruction were compared.
