针对Crowe III型发育性髋关节脱位患者，采用患者特异性三维打印定制髋臼假体: For patients with Crowe type III developmental hip dislocation, a patient-specific three-dimensional printed acetabular prosthesis was used to accurately reset the center of rotation and reconstruct the bone defect through preoperative simulation operations. Postoperative follow-up showed that the prosthesis matched well and had no looseness, the center of rotation was restored, and the Harris score improved.
针对Crowe II和III型髋发育不良患者，研究比较了3D打印集成髋臼假体与骨: For patients with Crowe type II and III hip dysplasia, the study compared the application of 3D printed integrated acetabular prosthesis and bone grafting in total hip replacement. The results showed that the intraoperative time, blood loss and weight-bearing time of the prosthesis group were better than those of the bone grafting group. The early postoperative HHS was higher. The radiological results of the two groups were similar, and the surgical safety of the prosthesis group was better.
针对Hoffa骨折，基于临床病例CT数据设计H形钛合金植入物，通过CAD/CAE: For Hoffa fracture, an H-shaped titanium alloy implant was designed based on CT data of clinical cases, and three-dimensional printing and mechanical testing were implemented through CAD/CAE/CAM technology. The results showed that the H-shaped plate showed better fixation stiffness and smaller relative displacement of the distal bone fragment than traditional methods in both finite element analysis and mechanical testing.
针对I+II+III型内半骨盆切除术后患者，采用3D打印定制假体结合骶骨托和腰骶: For patients after type I+II+III internal hemipelvic resection, a 3D printed custom prosthesis combined with a sacral support and lumbosacral screw rod system was used for reconstruction. Finite element analysis showed that the optimized design could reduce the peak stress of the sacral screw by 18.6%. Preliminary clinical results showed that 4 patients retained their walking ability, with an MSTS score of 19.5±2.9, and no serious complications occurred.
针对III、IV及II区3个无牙区，采用CBCT数据制作3D打印手术导板，实现种: For the three edentulous areas III, IV and II, CBCT data were used to produce 3D printed surgical guides to achieve precise positioning of implants and improve the accuracy of implant placement.
针对III类和IV类颅面缺损患者，采用FFF技术在院内制造个性化PEEK植入物，: For patients with Class III and Class IV craniofacial defects, FFF technology was used to manufacture personalized PEEK implants in the hospital. The parameters were optimized through the Taguchi experiment. The results showed that implants with Class III defects had larger size deviations, more obvious surface step effects and uneven crystallization. Implants with Class IV defects performed better, suggesting the need to optimize thermal management to ensure crystallization uniformity.
针对distal radius畸形患者，基于术前三维计划采用半自动方法设计患者特: For patients with distal radius deformity, a semi-automatic method is used to design patient-specific surgical guides and implants based on preoperative three-dimensional plans. Compared with standard and partially customized commercial software, the design time is shortened, operation input is reduced, and design efficiency is improved.
针对一位84岁男性膝关节翻修患者，基于其CT数据构建个性化有限元模型，通过3D打: For an 84-year-old male knee joint revision patient, a personalized finite element model was constructed based on his CT data. Porous tantalum parts with different pore diameters and wire diameters were 3D printed and the mechanical properties were measured. Combined with finite element analysis, it was determined that a personalized porous tantalum knee joint prosthesis with a pore diameter of 600 μm and a wire diameter of 900 μm was determined. Its mechanical properties meet the biomechanical needs of the tibia.
针对一位左手中指近端指间关节截肢的72岁男性患者，基于2D照片通过3D打印制作了: For a 72-year-old male patient who had an amputation of the proximal interphalangeal joint of his left middle finger, a body-moving partial finger prosthesis was made through 3D printing based on 2D photos, and compared with commercially available prostheses. The results showed that after using the prosthesis, the Box and Block test score improved to 22 blocks per minute, which was better than the state without the prosthesis (18 blocks/min), but the functional efficiency was still lower than that of the unaffected finger (30 blocks/min).
针对一例根管治疗中镍钛器械分离至上颌窦底的患者，采用数字3D打印手术导板辅助进行: For a patient whose nickel-titanium instrument was separated from the maxillary sinus floor during root canal treatment, a digital 3D printed surgical guide was used to assist in cutting-edge microsurgery. The instrument was successfully removed and the affected tooth was retained. Two years after the operation, images showed that periapical lesions were significantly improved and the thickening of the sinus wall mucosa was alleviated.
针对一只幼猫严重漏斗胸，基于胸廓铸模和3D扫描数据设计并制作了患者特异性的3D打: For a kitten with severe pectus excavatum, a patient-specific 3D printed external fixation brace was designed and produced based on the thoracic cast and 3D scan data. After removal two weeks after surgery, significant improvements in sternum position, dyspnea, and exercise tolerance were observed.
针对一只患前臂生长畸形的金毛犬，采用三维虚拟模拟与打印假骨模型进行术前规划，结合: For a golden retriever dog suffering from forearm growth deformity, three-dimensional virtual simulation and printed prosthetic bone models were used for preoperative planning, and precise osteotomy correction was performed with patient-specific instruments. Postoperative images showed that the deformity was accurately corrected, and follow-up showed that gait and bone healing were improved.
针对一名13岁女孩因恶性睫状体介导上皮瘤行部分眼眶切除术后，采用手持点阵三维扫描: After a partial orbital resection of a 13-year-old girl due to malignant ciliary body-mediated epithelioma, a handheld lattice 3D scan was used to obtain the facial contour, which was designed and 3D printed through 3D modeling software mirroring, and then silicone rubber casting and eyecup integration were used to create a facial prosthesis, which was fast, low-cost, and comfortable to wear.
针对一名15岁男性患者，因颈椎关节不稳定导致的I型基底侵入，采用定制3D打印C1: For a 15-year-old male patient who had Type I basilar intrusion due to cervical joint instability, a custom-made 3D printed C1-C2 joint space implant was used to achieve sufficient distraction, bone induction and stability. Postoperative neurological function remained intact. Imaging showed that basilar intrusion was improved, spinal canal stenosis was relieved, and the neurological status was stable at 6 weeks of follow-up.
针对一名18岁男性右肱骨上髁骨折后40°尺偏畸形患者，采用3D软件术前规划、3D: For an 18-year-old male patient with 40° ulnar deviation after right humeral epicondyle fracture, 3D software was used for preoperative planning and 3D printing to customize the bone resection guide to achieve precise correction. The surgical results were consistent with the preoperative plan, improving the predictability and accuracy of the surgery.
针对一名20岁女性下颌单发骨囊肿患者，采用定制3D打印手术导板进行微创钻孔治疗，: For a 20-year-old female patient with a single bone cyst in the mandible, a customized 3D printed surgical guide was used for minimally invasive drilling treatment to accurately locate and remove the contents of the cyst cavity. Complete bone remodeling was achieved 6 months after the operation, and the 2-year follow-up confirmed that the bone healed well.
针对一名31岁男性农村急性脊柱创伤患者，采用3D打印定制植入物，在三级医院紧急实: For a 31-year-old male patient with acute spinal trauma in a rural area, a customized 3D printed implant was used for emergency surgery in a tertiary hospital, achieving rapid virtual surgical planning and personalized implantation, demonstrating the immediate application potential of 3D printing in spinal trauma treatment.
针对一名38岁因交通事故导致右颞顶骨缺损的患者，采用CAD设计结合选择性激光熔融: For a 38-year-old patient with right temporoparietal bone defect caused by a traffic accident, CAD design combined with selective laser melting technology was used to produce a customized titanium alloy skull implant to achieve precise reconstruction, restore good appearance after surgery, and improve the patient's confidence in daily activities.
针对一名50岁男性肩部功能受限且肩胛骨畸形患者，基于CT三维模型设计患者专用导板: For a 50-year-old male patient with limited shoulder function and scapula deformity, a patient-specific guide was designed based on the CT three-dimensional model, and osteotomy and reduction were performed between the body of the scapula and the glenoid bone. The 12-month postoperative follow-up showed that the anatomy and function of the shoulder were improved.
针对一名59岁女性因远端肱骨非联合伴广泛骨缺损的复杂病例，采用患者特异性3D打印: For a complex case of a 59-year-old woman suffering from distal humeral non-union and extensive bone defect, a patient-specific 3D printed titanium alloy implant was used, combined with preoperative CT image matching and virtual planning, to achieve precise anatomical reconstruction, and achieve good functional recovery and bone healing after surgery. However, there was a risk of proximal implant displacement, suggesting the need for strict preoperative design and postoperative protection.
针对一名5岁男孩的先天性肝内门静脉分流，基于血管造影图像制作3D打印模型，用于术: Aiming at a 5-year-old boy's congenital intrahepatic portal vein shunt, a 3D printed model was made based on angiography images for preoperative surgical planning and communication between the team and his family. The shunt ligation was successfully completed without complications.
针对一名62岁女性右面部缺损患者，结合开源软件、快速成型系统与传统工艺制作定制面: For a 62-year-old female patient with right facial defect, open source software, rapid prototyping system and traditional technology were combined to produce a customized facial prosthesis, achieving good aesthetic results. This method is easy to operate, low cost, does not require special training, and effectively improves the limitations of traditional technology.
针对一名65岁男性胸壁软骨肉瘤患者，基于CT影像制作个性化3D打印模型，以增强其: For a 65-year-old male patient with chest wall chondrosarcoma, a personalized 3D printing model was produced based on CT images to enhance his understanding of complex cardiothoracic surgery conditions.
针对一名前臂截肢成人患者，采用3D扫描获取残肢数据，结合体表测量构建个性化假肢座: For an adult patient with forearm amputation, 3D scanning was used to obtain residual limb data, and a personalized prosthetic seat model was constructed based on body surface measurements. The optimal manufacturing process was finally selected through a comparison of three materials and process parameters.
针对一名年轻男性患者严重的双侧额颞顶骨缺损，采用三维打印技术制作定制化钛合金颅骨: Aiming at a young male patient with severe bilateral frontotemporal and parietal bone defects, 3D printing technology was used to produce a customized titanium alloy skull implant. The implant was constructed in stages and subjected to finite element and optical inspection to ensure accuracy, successfully achieving rapid and accurate skull reconstruction.
针对一名患有Ollier病的儿童，基于CT数据重建下肢形态，3D打印定制植入物并: For a child with Ollier's disease, the lower limb morphology was reconstructed based on CT data, customized implants were 3D printed and the surgical design was simulated. Good joint alignment was achieved during the operation. The child was pain-free and could squat and walk normally 18 months after the operation, proving that the feasible development of patient-specific implants can be achieved in areas with limited resources.
针对一名患有胸骨巨大细胞瘤的患者，采用CT数据进行三维打印定制Ti-6Al-4V: For a patient with giant cell tumor of the sternum, CT data was used to 3D print a customized Ti-6Al-4V sternal-rib implant to achieve stable reconstruction after near-total sternotomy, combined with double-layer polypropylene mesh and pectoral muscle coverage. The postoperative recovery was smooth. Pathological examination showed negative resection margins, lung function improved by about 20%, and the patient returned to work with mild pain at 6-month follow-up.
针对一名难治性良性前列腺增生患者，基于术前CT数据制作个性化3D打印前列腺动脉模: For a patient with refractory benign prostatic hyperplasia, a personalized 3D printed prostate artery model was created based on preoperative CT data to guide transvascular prostatic artery embolization. The operation was successful and the symptoms were significantly improved. The interventionalist believed that the model was helpful in selecting the embolization route.
针对一名需颅骨保护的患者，采用3D打印技术结合生物模型设计定制植入物，对比分析了: For a patient who needed skull protection, 3D printing technology was used in conjunction with a biological model to design a customized implant. A comparative analysis of the similarities in mechanical responses between PMMA and PEEK showed that PMMA has a more cost advantage while ensuring biomechanical safety.
针对一年级医学生，研究比较了使用3D打印骨折模型与传统干骨教学在提升临床推理能力: For first-year medical students, a study compared the effectiveness of using 3D printed fracture models with traditional bone teaching in improving clinical reasoning ability. The results showed that the score of the group using 3D models was significantly higher, and most students believed that this method was helpful in understanding the clinical relevance of fractures.
针对三阴性乳腺癌，研究通过微创植入具有程序性脉冲释放功能的3D打印装置，实现局部: For triple-negative breast cancer, research has implemented minimally invasive implantation of a 3D printed device with programmed pulse release function to achieve local high-density chemotherapy. Compared with intratumoral injection, this method shows stronger anti-tumor effects and lower toxicity at the same dose density, and effectively inhibits tumor growth and drug resistance protein expression.
针对三阴性炎性乳腺癌患者，基于PET/CT数据制作3D打印乳腺肿瘤模型，用于提升: For patients with triple-negative inflammatory breast cancer, 3D printed breast tumor models are produced based on PET/CT data to improve patients' understanding of the condition and treatment options, promote doctor-patient communication, support personalized treatment planning, and assist multidisciplinary training.
针对上肢截肢患者及普通人佩戴口罩困难的问题，研究基于表面肌电图（sEMG）信号设: In order to solve the problem of difficulty in wearing masks for patients with upper limb amputations and ordinary people, the study designed a portable automatic mask auxiliary device based on surface electromyography (sEMG) signals. Through 3D printing structure and carbon nanotube/PDMS electrodes, combined with feature extraction and Softmax classification neural network, the identification and control of wearing actions were realized on the STM32 controller, verifying its feasibility.
针对上肢截肢者，研究开发了一种低成本、由肌电信号控制的前臂假肢，通过表面肌电传感: For upper-limb amputees, a low-cost forearm prosthesis controlled by myoelectric signals has been researched and developed. It uses surface electromyographic sensors to capture muscle contraction signals of the residual limb, and combines 3D printed hands with closed-loop control to achieve precise grasping driven by the user's thoughts. Tests have shown that its grasping speed and precision are superior to traditional prostheses.
针对上肢截肢者，研究开发了基于主从抓握控制的欠驱动假手，通过SolidWorks: For upper-limb amputees, an underactuated prosthetic hand based on master-slave grasp control was researched and developed. It was designed and 3D printed through SolidWorks to achieve natural and coordinated grasping and release of fingers, verifying its functional performance in the manipulation of diverse objects.
针对上颈椎椎体螺钉置入，现有研究比较了3D打印钻引导器与传统荧光透视自由手技术，: For upper cervical vertebral body screw placement, existing studies have compared 3D printed drill guides with traditional fluoroscopic free-hand technology. The results show that 3D printed guides significantly improve the perfect placement rate, reduce the moderate and poor quality placement rate, shorten the operation time, blood loss and fluoroscopy use, while there is no significant difference in screw placement time, postoperative JOA and VAS scores.
针对上颌前牙根尖微手术，研究采用3D打印手术导板，对比传统方法，结果显示实验组根: For apical microsurgery of maxillary anterior teeth, the study used 3D printed surgical guides. Compared with traditional methods, the results showed that the apical resection length and angle deviation of the experimental group were significantly smaller than those of the control group, improving the accuracy of the surgery.
针对上颌左侧中央尖牙折断病例，采用增材制造导板植入牙种植体并即刻修复，通过骨与软: In the case of a fractured maxillary left central canine, an additive manufacturing guide was used to place a dental implant and immediately repair it. Through bone and soft tissue graft adaptation, immediate implantation and repair of the aesthetic area was achieved, achieving good appearance and functional results.
针对上颌牙槽嵴形态异常患者，综述了基于数字技术的牙槽嵴成形术与即刻可摘局部义齿修: For patients with abnormal maxillary alveolar ridge morphology, this article reviews the combined solution of alveolar ridge plasty and immediate removable partial denture repair based on digital technology. Precise bone reduction is achieved through virtual planning and 3D printing surgical guides. Combined with postoperative denture design, it ensures good fit and stability, and improves the predictability and clinical process efficiency of removable denture treatment in complex cases.
针对上颌癌复发需骨重建的复杂病例，采用虚拟手术规划技术实施双侧序贯腓骨瓣重建，实: For complex cases of maxillary cancer recurrence that require bone reconstruction, virtual surgical planning technology is used to perform bilateral sequential fibular flap reconstruction to achieve full tumor edge resection, precise positioning of fibular bone grafting, and immediate functional dental implant placement.
针对上颌第一磨牙根管内纤维桩阻塞的情况，采用CBCT与口内扫描数据，结合免费种植: In view of the fiber post obstruction in the root canal of the maxillary first molar, CBCT and intraoral scan data were used, combined with free implant planning software and a 3D printed resin guide, to achieve precise removal of the fiber post, obtain the buccal root canal entrance, and complete root canal retreatment.
针对下肢恶性骨肿瘤儿童，采用院内3D打印个性化手术导板进行肿瘤切除及异体骨移植匹: For children with malignant bone tumors of the lower limbs, in-hospital 3D printed personalized surgical guides are used to match tumor resection and allogeneic bone grafting to achieve precise resection and bone grafting. All resections reach R0 margins, and the bone healing rate reaches 92.9%. The fit between the bone grafting and the host bone is improved, reducing the risk of non-healing.
针对下肢截肢患者，基于CT影像通过三维建模与有限元仿真分析，优化定制化义肢套筒设: For patients with lower limb amputations, the customized prosthetic sleeve design is optimized through three-dimensional modeling and finite element simulation analysis based on CT images, and 3D printing technology is combined to predict pressure distribution under static and dynamic conditions to improve patient comfort and adaptability.
针对下肢截肢者，研究采用CT数据构建残肢生物力学模型，基于压力耐受区划分，在髌腱: For lower limb amputees, the study used CT data to construct a biomechanical model of the residual limb. Based on the division of pressure tolerance zones, a zero Poisson's ratio metamaterial was embedded in the patellar tendon area. After optimization by finite element analysis, a prosthetic sleeve was prepared by 3D printing. The results showed that the material reduced skin stress in the patellar tendon area by 14.4%, reduced walking peak pressure by 11.7%, increased the symmetry coefficient of the knee joint when squatting, and improved comfort and gait symmetry.
针对下肢截肢者，综述了从病因到心理社会影响的现有研究，涵盖假肢设计、控制策略、机: Focusing on lower limb amputees, this article reviews existing research from causes to psychosocial impacts, covering prosthetic design, control strategies, machine learning algorithms, and patent development trends. It points out that knee joint prostheses account for the highest proportion of patents, emphasizing the need to develop biocompatible, lightweight, and economical prostheses to improve the naturalness of walking, alleviate phantom limb pain, and improve users' quality of life.
针对下肢肌纤维肉瘤累及胫骨的罕见病例，综述了使用定制3D打印假体进行肿瘤切除后重: In view of the rare case of lower limb myofibrosarcoma involving the tibia, this article reviews the clinical application of using customized 3D printed prostheses for reconstruction after tumor resection. This method can effectively preserve the function of the knee and ankle joints and achieve limb preservation. Early follow-up shows good mechanical stability.
针对下膝截肢患者，研究设计并开发了采用ABS材料通过增材制造工艺制作的可打印假足: For patients with lower knee amputation, a printable prosthetic foot made of ABS material through additive manufacturing was researched, designed and developed. After stress and strain simulation and patient trials, the prototype was stable, durable and comfortable when standing and walking, indicating that this method can provide an economical and comfortable prosthetic foot solution.
针对下颌偏移患者，采用口内扫描获取数字模型，结合下颌关系记录与面部扫描数据，通过: For patients with mandibular deviation, intraoral scanning is used to obtain a digital model, combined with mandibular relationship records and facial scan data, artificial teeth are arranged and gingival margin shaping is performed through CAD programs, and full dentures are produced using SLA three-dimensional printing technology to achieve good retention, support and stability, and satisfactory function and appearance.
针对下颌前段骨切开术，研究采用三维快速成型手术模板指导17例下颌前突患者手术，通: For mandibular anterior segment osteotomy, the study used a three-dimensional rapid prototyping surgical template to guide the surgery of 17 patients with mandibular protrusion. Cephalometric measurements and three-dimensional overlap analysis showed that the actual surgical results were highly consistent with the computer simulation, with no complications. The linear and angular differences were both less than 1.32mm and 1.72°, and the overlap difference was less than 1.4mm.
针对下颌残余骨量严重不足的87岁男性患者，采用数字化流程结合传统技术，通过口内扫: For an 87-year-old male patient with severe residual bone loss in the mandible, a digital process combined with traditional technology was used to produce a full denture through intraoral scanning, CAD design and 3D printing. Functional impressions and boundary molding were used to ensure precise alignment. In the end, the retention of the denture was significantly improved after wearing.
针对下颌骨恶性肿瘤及骨体坏死患者，基于DICOM影像数据，采用CAD、逆向工程和: For patients with mandibular malignant tumors and osteonecrosis, based on DICOM image data, CAD, reverse engineering and 3D printing technology are used to produce surgical templates, which improves surgical accuracy and efficiency and shortens operation time.
针对下颌骨段缺损，研究将CT数据转化为功能梯度钛合金蜂窝支架，通过融合有限元模拟: For mandibular segment defects, the study transformed CT data into a functionally graded titanium alloy honeycomb stent. By integrating finite element simulation, artificial intelligence and uncertainty quantification, the porosity, screw layout and rod thickness were optimized, and finally a personalized stent with both mechanical safety and biological functions was achieved. When its porosity is 55-65%, the amount of titanium is reduced by 15% compared to the solid plate, and it meets the mechanical performance requirements under a 600N bite force.
针对下颌骨肿瘤切除后的重建，研究采用基于CT数据的个性化植入物、定制骨切导板及混: For the reconstruction after mandibular tumor resection, the study uses personalized implants based on CT data, customized bone cutting guides and mixed reality technology to achieve preoperative virtual planning and precise intraoperative operation. The postoperative bone surface error is controlled within 1 mm in 92.9% to 94.1% areas, and the function and appearance are restored well.
针对下颌骨骨病变患者，采用3D打印手术导板与自由操作方式分别实施活检，结果显示使: For patients with mandibular bone lesions, biopsies were performed using a 3D printed surgical guide and free operation. The results showed that the axial deviation of the biopsy using the guide was 1.3±0.6mm, which was significantly lower than the 3.9±1.1mm in the free operation group.
针对不同下颌连续性缺损（C、B、A+B段），结合有限元分析与加权拓扑优化，设计了: For different mandibular continuity defects (segments C, B, A+B), a personalized lightweight implant was designed based on finite element analysis and weighted topology optimization. It was realized through additive manufacturing. The size and position of the internal support beam can be parameterized and defined. The weight is reduced by 54.3% to 69.7% compared with the original structure. The stress is lower than the material limit. The fatigue test passed 250,000 cycles, but the condyle head, bone plate fracture and screw loosening occurred in the bone plate group.
针对不同医学专科患者，现有研究显示，使用定制或通用3D打印解剖模型能显著提升患者: For patients with different medical specialties, existing research shows that the use of customized or universal 3D printed anatomical models can significantly improve patients' understanding of diseases, treatments and anatomical structures, improve satisfaction, reduce anxiety, and has been proven to help improve doctor-patient communication in a variety of clinical scenarios.
针对不同性别和年龄组的患者，基于3D模型平均化设计了专用切割导板，经3D打印后用: For patients of different genders and age groups, a special cutting guide was designed based on the average of 3D models and used for deep annular iliac bone flap lifting after 3D printing. The measurement results showed that there was a significant difference in spatial thickness between groups, and the overall average model did not reach the maximum thickness. However, the cutting guide can effectively achieve precise flap lifting, saving radiation exposure and medical resources.
针对不同截肢水平患者，该研究设计了一款基于3D打印的仿人上肢假肢，通过肌电图解读: For patients with different levels of amputation, this study designed a humanoid upper limb prosthesis based on 3D printing. It interprets user intentions through electromyography and combines μLCD visual feedback to achieve control. It has the characteristics of modularity, low cost and easy customization. Experiments show that it performs well in grabbing daily objects and has accurate control response.
